nyene iyo nzu aze agende abimenyeshe umuherezi ati: ‘Nabonye igisa n’ifira mu nzu yanje.’

Uwo muherezi aze asabe bakuremwo ibintu isigare igaragara imbere y’uko aja gusuzuma iryo fira, kugira ngo ntihagire na kimwe co muri iyo nzu kivugwa ko gihumanye. Hanyuma y’ivyo, umuherezi aze agende agendure iyo nzu.
Aze asuzume iryo fira ku mpome, niyasanga iryo fira rifise utunogonogo dusa n’urwatsi rubisi canke dutukura kandi dusa n’utwimburutse mu ruhome,
uwo muherezi aze asohoke aciye mu muryango w’iyo nzu, ace yugara iyo nzu imisi indwi.
Ku musi ugira indwi, uwo muherezi aze agaruke gusuzuma iyo nzu. Niyasanga iryo fira ryatandukiriye ahandi ku mpome,
aze ategeke bakureho amabuye yafashwe n’iryo fira, bace bayata mu kibanza gihumanye inyuma y’igisagara.
Aze asabe baharagure impome zose ku ruhande rw’imbere bace bata ivyo bivunguka mu kibanza gihumanye inyuma y’igisagara.
Hanyuma baze barondere ayandi mabuye yo gusubiriza ya yandi n’ivyo guhoma bishasha bisubirira ivyaharaguwe.
Iryo fira niryasubira kuboneka muri iyo nzu kandi bakuyeho amabuye n’ivyari bihomye kuri yo bakabisubiriza n’ibindi,
uwo muherezi aze asubire agende ayisuzume. Niyasanga iryo fira ryagwiriye mu nzu, izoba ari imibembe; iyo nzu izoba ihumanye.
Iyo nzu ize isamburwe. Amabuye yayo, imbaho zayo n’ivyo bakoresheje mu kuyihoma, bize bisamburwe bitabwe inyuma y’igisagara ahantu hahumanye.
Umuntu wese azokwinjira iyo nzu mu gihe izoba yugawe azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Umuntu wese azorira canke akarara muri iyo nzu aze amesure impuzu ziwe.
Ariko wa muherezi niyaza kuyisuzuma agasanga iryo fira ritabandanije rigwira bamaze kuyisiga bushasha, aze avuge ko iyo nzu idahumanye, kuko iryo fira rizoba ryaheze.
Mu guhumanura iyo nzu aze azane inyoni zibiri n’igiti c’isederi, n’ubwoya bw’intama busize irangi ritukura, hamwe na ezobu.
Aze akererere imwe muri izo nyoni hejuru y’ibesani ikozwe mw’ibumba irimwo amazi meza.

Hanyuma aze afate ca giti c’isederi, ya ezobu na bwa bwoya bw’intama busize irangi ritukura, na ya nyoni ibona, avyibize muri ya maraso ya ya nyoni yakererwa avanze na ya mazi meza, hanyuma amijagire iyo nzu incuro indwi.
Aze ahumanuze iyo nzu amaraso ya ya nyoni, ya mazi meza, ya nyoni ibona, ca giti c’isederi, ezobu na bwa bwoya bw’intama busizwe irangi ritukura.
Aze aheze arekure ya nyoni ibona yigurukire inyuma y’igisagara. Uko ni ko azotanga ikimazi co gucungura iyo nzu, na yo izoba ihumanuwe."
Ivyo ni vyo vyagezwe bigenga ubwoko bwose bw’imibembe, ibinyoro,
ifira mu mpuzu canke mu nzu,
ibihute, ibisekera n’ibibara,
kugira ngo vyerekane ko ikintu gihumanye canke kidahumanye. Ivyo ni vyo vyagezwe bigenga ingwara zo ku rukoba no mu mpuzu.
Uhoraho abwira Mose na Aroni ati:
"Bwira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Umugabo niyafatwa n’ingwara yo mu bihimba vy’irondoka, ibimuvamwo vyose bizoba bihumanye.
Igihe cose bizoba bikiza biva mu mubiri wiwe canke vyazibiwe, uwo muntu azoba ahumanye. Uku ni ko ivyo bimuvamwo bizotuma umuntu ahumana:
Uburiri bwose uwo muntu azoryamako buzoba buhumanye, n’ikintu cose azokwicarako kizoba gihumanye.
Umuntu wese azokora kuri ubwo buriri aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi aze agume ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Umuntu wese azokwicara ku kintu na kimwe uwo muntu yicayeko aze amesure impuzu ziwe kandi yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi aze agume ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Umuntu wese azokora kuri uwo muntu aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi aze agume ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Uwo muntu agwaye niyacira ku muntu yari asanzwe adahumanye, uwo yaciriyeko aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi aze agume ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Ikintu cose uwo muntu agwaye azokwicarako ari kw’ifarasi kizoba gihumanye,

kandi umuntu wese azokora kuri ivyo bintu vyose vyari musi yiwe azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba; uwuzoterura ikintu na kimwe muri ivyo aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi aze agume ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Umuntu wese uwo mugwayi azokorako adakaravye n’amazi aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi aze agume ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Inkono y’ibumba yose uwo mugwayi azokorako ize imenagurwe, kandi nicaba ari igikoresho gikozwe mu giti ico ari co cose kize cozwe n’amazi.
Umuntu niyakira iyo ngwara yamutera ubuhumane, aze aharure imisi indwi imbere yo guhumanurwa. Niyahera aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi meza, azoba ahumanuwe.
Ku musi ugira umunani aze atware intunguru zibiri zikiri nto canke inuma zikiri nto azishikane imbere y’ Uhoraho mu bwinjiriro bw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro abihe umuherezi.
Umuherezi aze abitangeko ibimazi, kimwe kibe ikimazi c’ivyaha, ikindi kibe ikimazi co guturirwa. Azoba atangiye uwo muntu ikimazi co kwicungura imbere y’ Uhoraho kubera ivyamuvuyemwo.
Umugabo niyasesa imbuto ziwe mw’ijoro, aze yiyuhagire umubiri wose n’amazi, aze agume ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Impuzu yose canke ikintu cose gikozwe mu rusato izo mbuto zashitseko kize kimesurwe n’amazi, kandi kizoba gihumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Umugabo niyaryamana n’umugore hakaba gusohora imbuto, baze biyuhagire n’amazi, kandi bazoba bahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Umugore niyaja mu miziro yiwe, azoba ahumanye imisi indwi, kandi umuntu wese azomukorako azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Ico azoryamako cose akiri mu miziro yiwe kizoba gihumanye, kandi ico azokwicarako cose kizoba gihumanye.
Uwuzokora ku buriri yaryamyeko aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Umuntu wese azokora ku kintu na kimwe uwo mugore yicayeko aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Bwaba uburiri canke ikintu cose yicayeko, nihagira umuntu agikorako, azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Nihagira umugabo aryamana n’uwo mugore maze amaraso amuvamwo ku bw’iyo miziro yiwe agakora kuri uwo mugabo, azoba ahumanye imisi ndwi, mbere n’uburiri bwose azoryamako buzoba buhumanye.
Umugore niyaguma ava amaraso imisi myinshi mu gihe ciwe c’imiziro, canke niyaba aguma ava amaraso kurenza ukwezi kwiwe, azoguma ahumanye imisi yose bizomara, nk’uko bigenda igihe ari mu kwezi kwiwe.

Uburiri bwose azoryamako igihe azoba ari muri ivyo bihe buzoba buhumanye, ni co kimwe n’uburiri bwiwe aryamako mu gihe c’ukwezi kwiwe, kandi ikintu cose azokwicarako kizoba gihumanye, nk’uko bimeze mu gihe c’ukwezi kwiwe gusanzwe.
Kandi umuntu wese azobikorako azoba ahumanye. Aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, kandi azoguma ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba.
Kuva amaraso nivyahagarara, aze aharure imisi ndwi, niyahera azoba ahumanutse.
Ku musi ugira umunani aze azane intunguru zibiri zikiri nto, inuma zibiri zikiri nto azizanire umuherezi imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Uwo muherezi aze abitange, kimwe kibe ikimazi c’ivyaha, ikindi kibe ikimazi co guturirwa. Aho ni ho azoba amutangiye ikimazi co kumucungura imbere y’ Uhoraho kubera ubuhumane yatewe n’ayo maraso.
Muze murinde Abisirayeli ibintu vyose vyobahumanya, kugira ngo ntibapfe bazize ubwo buhumane kuko bohava bahumanya inzu yanje yera iri hagati muri bo.’ "
Ivyo ni vyo vyagezwe bigenga ibiva mu bihimba vy’irondoka, yaba umugabo yahumanijwe n’uko yasohoye imbuto ziwe,
yaba umugore ari mu kwezi kwiwe, yaba umugabo canke umugore bagwaye mu bihimba vy’irondoka, bigatuma bava ibintu bibahumanya, canke umugabo yaryamanye n’umugore asanzwe ahumanye.
Uhoraho yaravuganye na Mose inyuma y’urupfu rwa ba bahungu babiri ba Aroni bapfuye igihe begera Uhoraho bafise umuriro utari wo imbere yiwe.

Uhoraho abwira Mose ati: "Bwira mukuru wawe Aroni ntaze yinjire uko yishakiye Ahera Cane inyuma ya ca gihuzu gikingiriye imbere ya wa mupfundikizo batangirako ibimazi vyo kwicungura uri kw’Isandugu y’Isezerano, kugira ngo ntapfe; kuko nzobonekera mu gicu hejuru ya wa mupfundikizo utangirwako ikimazi co gucungura.
Uku ni ko Aroni azokwinjira Ahera Cane: azoshikane ishuri kw’ikimazi c’ivyaha n’impfizi y’intama kw’ikimazi co guturirwa.

Aze yambare umwambaro wiwe wera ujishe mu nyuzi zera derere, hamwe n’ibutura rijishe muri izo nyuzi nyene ngo ahishe ubwambure bwiwe; aze akenyeze wa mukanda wo mu nyuzi zera derere, yambare na ca gitambara cera derere. Izo ni impuzu zera; ni co gituma azobanza kwiyuhagira n’amazi imbere y’uko azambara.
Aze ashikane n’isuguru z’impene zivuye mu Bisirayeli kw’ikimazi c’ivyaha n’impfizi y’intama kw’ikimazi co guturirwa.
Aroni aze atange iyo shuri kw’ikimazi c’ivyaha vyiwe kugira ngo yitangire ishikanwa we n’umuryango wiwe.
Hanyuma aze afate za suguru z’impene azizane imbere y’ Uhoraho ku muryango w’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro.
Aze akoreshe ubupfindo kuri izo mpene kugira ngo amenye iyegukira Uhoraho n’iyo gutabwa mu bugaragwa.
Aroni aze afate iyo ubupfindo bweguriye Uhoraho ayitange kw’ikimazi c’ivyaha.
Ariko iyerekanywe ko ari iyo gutabwa mu bugaragwa izozanwe imbere y’ Uhoraho ikiri nzima kugira ngo ikoreshwe nk’ikimazi co gucungura bazorungika mu bugaragwa nk’impene yo gutabwa.
Aroni aze ashikane ya shuri kw’ikimazi ciwe c’ivyaha kugira ngo yitangire ikimazi ku gatwe kiwe n’abiwe, aheze ayikerere ibe ikimazi c’ivyaha vyiwe.
Aze yakire ico kwokoza amakara yaka avuye ku gicaniro imbere y’ Uhoraho ayore amashi abiri y’ifu inoze y’ibimota neza kandi ikaranze, hamwe n’ibimota neza ace avyinjirana inyuma ya ca gihuzu gikinze.

Aze ashire ivyo bimota neza kuri wa muriro imbere y’ Uhoraho , hanyuma umwotsi uvuye muri ivyo bimota neza uzotwikira wa mupfundikizo utangirwako ikimazi co gucungura uri kw’Isandugu y’Isezerano, na we ntazoheza ngo apfe.

Aze ajane no ku maraso y’iyo shuri ace ayamijagira n’urutoke kuri wa mupfundikizo ku ruhande ruhera mu buseruko; aze ayamijagire kandi n’urutoke nyene incuro indwi imbere y’uwo mupfundikizo utangirwako ikimazi co gucungura.

Hanyuma azoce akerera ya mpene y’ikimazi c’ivyaha c’abantu, atware amaraso yayo inyuma ya ca gihuzu gikingiriye ayakoreshe nk’uko yakoze kuri ya yandi ya ya shuri: Azoyamijagire ku mupfundikizo utangirwako ikimazi co gucungura n’imbere yawo.

Ni muri ubwo buryo azotangira Ahera Cane ikimazi co gucungura kubera ubuhumane n’ubugarariji bw’Abisirayeli, uko ivyaha vyabo vyongana kwose. Aze agire atyo no ku bw’ihema ry’ibonaniro, kuko riri hagati muri bo, hagati mu buhumane bwabo.
Ntihaze hagire umuntu n’umwe yinjira mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro kuva igihe Aroni azoba yinjiye Ahera Cane gushika asohotse, amaze kwitangira impongano yiwe, iy’abo mu nzu yiwe hamwe n’iy’Abisirayeli bose.
Hanyuma aze asohoke aje ku gicaniro kiri imbere y’ Uhoraho agitangire ikimazi na co nyene. Aze afate ku maraso ya ya shuri no ku ya ya suguru y’impene ayasige ku mahembe y’ico gicaniro.
Aze amijagire ayo maraso kuri co n’urutoke rwiwe incuro indwi kugira ngo agihumanure yongere aceze ubuhumane bwose bw’Abisirayeli.
Maze Aroni niyaheza gutangira impongano Ahera Cane, n’ihema ry’ibonaniro hamwe n’igicaniro, aze azane ya mpene ikibona.

Aze ayirambikeko ibiganza vyiwe vyompi ku mutwe yaturire kuri yo ukugabitanya n’ubugarariji bw’Abisirayeli, ivyaha vyabo vyose, abiremeke ku mutwe w’iyo mpene. Ahejeje azoce ayirungika mu bugaragwa ijanwe n’umuntu yatoranirijwe gukora ico gikorwa.
Iyo mpene izokwiremeka ivyaha vyabo vyose ibitware ahantu hatagira abantu; uwo muntu aze aheze ayirekurire mu bugaragwa.
Aroni azoce asubira yinjire mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro akure za mpuzu zera derere yambara imbere y’uko yinjira Ahera Cane, azisigeyo,

hanyuma yiyuhagirire n’amazi ahantu hera ace yambara impuzu ziwe zisanzwe. Azoce asohoka atange ca kimazi co guturirwa ciwe na ca kimazi co guturirwa c’abantu bose, kugira ngo yitangire ikimazi we ubwiwe hamwe n’abantu bose.
Azoce aturirira ku gicaniro ibinure vyavuye kuri ca kimazi c’ivyaha.
Wa muntu yatwara ya mpene yo gutabwa mu bugaragwa agarutse aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi; hanyuma ashobore kuja aho mucumbitse.

Ya shuri na ya suguru zatangwa nk’ibimazi vy’ivyaha, amaraso yavyo akajanwa Ahera Cane kugira ngo atangweko ikimazi co gucungura, bize bijanwe inyuma y’aho mucumbitse maze insato zavyo, inyama zavyo n’ivyo mu nda bize biturirwe.
Umuntu azobiturira aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, abone kugaruka aho mucumbitse.

Iri rize ribe ibwirizwa rihoraho kuri mwebwe: ku musi ugira icumi w’ukwezi kw’indwi muze mwisonzeshe kandi ntihagire igikorwa na kimwe mukora, yaba uwavukiye muri mwebwe canke umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe,
kuko kuri uwo musi hazoba gucungurwa kwanyu, kugira ngo muhumanurwe. Namwe muzoba mwejejwe ivyaha vyanyu vyose.
Izoba ari Isabato y’ukuruhuka, muze muwuruhukeko kandi mwisonzeshe; iri rize ribe ibwirizwa rihoraho.
Umuherezi yasizwe amavuta kandi yatoranirijwe gusubirira se wiwe nk’umuherezi mukuru ni we azotanga ikimazi co gucungura. Aze yambare za mpuzu zera derere,
atange ikimazi co gucungura Ahera Cane, ihema ry’ibonaniro, igicaniro, abaherezi n’abantu bose.
Iri rize ribe ibwirizwa rihoraho kuri mwebwe: ico kimazi co gucungura kizohora gitangwa rimwe mu mwaka gitangirwe ivyaha vyose vy’Abisirayeli." Nuko baca bakora nk’uko Uhoraho yategetse Mose.
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
"Vugana na Aroni n’abahungu biwe n’Abisirayeli bose ubabwire uti: ‘Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho yategetse:
Umwisirayeli wese azotangira ikimazi c’ishuri, umwagazi w’intama canke w’impene aho mucumbitse canke inyuma yaho,

aho kukizana ku muryango w’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro ngo agitange nk’ikimazi gishikaniwe Uhoraho imbere y’Ihema ry’ Uhoraho , uwo muntu azokwagirwa n’icaha co gusesa amaraso; azoba yasheshe amaraso kandi azoce acibwa mu muryango wiwe.

Iki cagezwe gitegeka Abisirayeli guhora bazanira Uhoraho ibimazi bahora batangira aho ari ho hose. Baze babizanire umuherezi, ni ko kubishikanira Uhoraho , imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro babitange nk’ibimazi vy’ishimwe.
Umuherezi aze amijagire amaraso ku gicaniro c’ Uhoraho imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro, bace baturira ibinure nk’umubabwe umota neza uhimbara Uhoraho .
Ntibaze basubire gutanga ibimazi vyabo babishikanira imana z’impene izo bihumanishije mu kwifatanya na zo. Iri rize ribe itegeko ry’intahava kuri bo uko urunganwe ruzokurakuranwa n’urundi.’
Nuko ubabwire uti: ‘Umwisirayeli wese canke umunyamahanga aba muri bo azotanga ishikanwa rituriwe canke ikimazi
atakizanye imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro ngo agishikanire Uhoraho , uwo muntu aze acibwe mu bwoko bwiwe.
Umwisirayeli wese canke umunyamahanga aba muri bo azorya amaraso, igitsure canje kizoba kuri uwo muntu arya amaraso kandi nzomukura mu bantu banje.
Kuko ubuzima bw’icaremwe buri mu maraso yaco, kandi nayabahaye kugira ngo ababere ikimazi co ku gicaniro co kubacungura; amaraso ni yo aba ikimazi c’ubuzima bw’umuntu.
Ni co gituma mbwiye Abisirayeli nti: "Ntihaze hagire umuntu n’umwe wo muri mwebwe canke umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe azorya amaraso."
Umwisirayeli wese canke umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe azohiga igikoko ico ari co cose canke inyoni ishobora kuribwa aze asese amaraso yose hanyuma ayarenzeko ivu,

kuko ubuzima bw’icaremwe cose ari amaraso yaco. Ni co gituma mbwiye Abisirayeli nti: "Ntimuze murye amaraso y’icaremwe na kimwe, kuko ubuzima bw’icaremwe cose ari amaraso yaco. Uwuzoyarya wese aze akurwe mu bantu."

Umuntu, yaba imvukira canke umunyamahanga, azorya ikintu yasanze capfuye canke catabaguwe n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba, aze amesure impuzu ziwe yiyuhagire n’amazi, ashishikare kuba uwuhumanye gushika ku mugoroba; aheze abe ahumanuwe.
Ariko natamesura impuzu ziwe ngo yiyuhagira n’amazi, azobiharurwako nk’ukugabitanya.’ "
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
"Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimuze mukore nk’uko mwahora mukora muri Egiputa, aho mwahora muba, kandi ntimuze mukore nk’uko bakora mu gihugu c’i Kanani, aho ngiye kubinjiza. Ntimuze mwigane ivyo bakora.
Muze mwumvire ivyagezwe vyanje, mwitondere ivyo ndabategetse. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Muze mwitondere ivyo nashinze n’ivyagezwe vyanje, kuko umuntu wese azovyitondera azobeshwaho na vyo. Ndi Uhoraho .
Ntihaze hagire umuntu yegera incuti yiwe ya hafi ngo barangurane amabanga mpuzabitsina. Ndi Uhoraho .
Ntuze umaramaze so mu kuryamana na nyoko. Ni umuvyeyi wawe; ntuze uryamane na we.
Ntuze uryamane n’umugore wa so; kuko ni ukumaramaza so.
Ntuze uryamane na mushikawe, yaba uwo musangiye so gusa canke uwo musangiye nyoko gusa, yaba ari uwavukiye muri iyo nzu canke uwavukiye ahandi.
Ntuze uryamane n’umwuzukuru wawe, yaba uwo ku muhungu canke uwo ku mukobwa; ivyo ni ibiterasoni.
Ntuze uryamane n’umukobwa w’umugore wa so, uwo so yavyaranye na we; kuko ni mushikawe.
Ntuze uryamane na mushiki wa so, kuko ari incuti ya so ya hafi.
Ntuze uryamane n’umuvukanyi wa nyoko, kuko ari incuti ya nyoko ya hafi.
Ntuze umaramaze sowanyu mu kuryamana n’umugore wiwe; kuko ari nyogosenge kuri wewe.
Ntuze uryamane n’umukazana wawe, kuko ari umugore w’umuhungu wawe; ntuze uryamane na we.
Ntuze uryamane na muramwawe; kuko kwoba ari ukumaramaza umuvukanyi wawe.
Ntuze uryamane n’umugore ngo wongere uryamane n’umukobwa wiwe. Kandi, ntuze uryamane n’umwuzukuru wiwe wo ku muhungu canke wo ku mukobwa; kuko ari incuti ziwe za hafi. Ico ni ikizira.
Ntuze uharike umugore wawe, umuharikishije uwo bavukana, ngo uryamane na we umugore wawe akiriho.
Ntuze uryamane n’umugore ari mu miziro yiwe.
Ntuze uryamane n’umugore wa mugenzawe ngo umwihumanishe.
Ntuze utange umwana wawe ngo atangwe kw’ikimazi c’ikigirwamana Moleki, kuko ukwiye kwirinda ngo ntukengere izina ry’Imana yawe. Ndi Uhoraho .
Ntuze uryamane n’umugabo nk’uko baryamana n’umugore. Ico ni ikintu co kwankwa urunuka.
Ntuze uryamane n’igikoko ngo uciyandurishe. Ntihaze hagire umugore yitega igikoko ngo kiryamane na we; ni ubuhumane butavugwa.
Ntimuze mwiyanduze mu buryo na bumwe muri ubwo bwose, kuko uko ari ko amahanga ngiye gusohora mu gihugu ngiye kubinjiza biyanduje.
Igihugu ubwaco caranduye; ni co gituma nagihanye kubera icaha caco, hanyuma na co gica kidahwa abakibamwo bose.
Ariko mwebwe muze mwitondere ivyo nabategetse vyose n’ivyo nashinze. Yaba imvukira canke umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe, ntimuze mukore ibintu nk’ivyo vyo kwankwa urunuka,
kuko ivyo vyose vyakorwa n’amahanga yaba muri ico gihugu imbere yanyu, bituma ico gihugu gihumana.
Nimwahumanya ico gihugu, kizobadahwa nk’uko cadashwe amahanga yariho imbere yanyu.
Umuntu wese azokora na kimwe muri ivyo bintu vyo kwankwa urunuka aze akurwe mw’ihanga ryiwe.
Muze mwitondere ivyo ndabasaba ntimuze mukurikire ingeso mbi n’ivyo bakora imbere y’uko muza, kugira ngo ntimwihumanishe izo ngeso. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.’ "
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
"Vugana n’ishengero ryose ry’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Mube abera kuko jewe, Uhoraho Imana yanyu, ndi uwera.
Umuntu wese aze yubahe se na nyina, kandi aze yubahirize amasabato yanje. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimuze muhindukirire ibigirwamana canke ngo mwikorere ibigirwamana mu butare buvugutiwe mu muriro. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Nimwashikanira Uhoraho ikimazi c’ishimwe, muze mugitange neza ku buryo butuma mwemerwa.
Kize kiribwe ku musi mwagitangiyeko canke ku musi ukurikira; ibizoba bisigaye vyose gushika ku musi wa gatatu bize biturirwe.
Nihagira ikintu na kimwe kiribwa ku musi wa gatatu, kizoba gihumanye kandi ntikizokwemerwa.
Umuntu wese azokiryako azotsindwa n’urubanza rw’uko yahumanije ivyera vy’ Uhoraho ; uwo muntu aze acibwe mu bwoko bwiwe.
Nimwimbura ibivuye mu ndimiro zanyu, ntimuze mutware ivyamereye inyuma y’urubibe rwanyu canke ngo musubire inyuma gutora ivyo mwibagiriye mu mirima.
Ntimuze musubire mu ruzabibu rwanyu ubugira kabiri canke ngo mutore imbuto z’imizabibu zakorokeye hasi. Muze mubisigarize umukene n’inyambukira. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimukibe. Ntimukabeshe. Ntimugahendane.
Ntimuze murahire ibinyoma, kugira ngo mwoye guhumanya izina ryanje; ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntuze urenganye canke ngo wibe muganzawe. Ntuze urare udahemvye umukozi wakoresheje.
Ntuze uvume igipfamatwi canke ngo ushire igitsitaza imbere y’impumyi: wubahe Imana yawe. Ndi Uhoraho .
Ntimuze muce imanza zigoramye mu guhengamira ku muntu ngo ni uko ari umugorwa canke ari umukuru, ahubwo mucire bagenzi banyu imanza z’ukuri.
Ntimuze mugende muravuga nabi bagenzi banyu. Ntimuze mukore ikintu gishobora gushira mu kaga k’urupfu bagenzi banyu. Ndi Uhoraho .
Ntuze ugirire urwanko mu mutima wawe abo mu bwoko bwanyu. Ariko uze wihanize mugenzawe ariko arakora ikibi kugira ngo ntuhave usangira na we icaha ciwe.
Ntuze wihore canke ngo ugumanire inzigo uwo mu bwoko bwanyu, ariko uze ukunde mugenzawe nk’uko wikunda. Ndi Uhoraho .
Muze mwitondere ivyo nategetse. Ntimuze mubangurire ibikoko ku bindi bidahuje ubwoko. Ntimuze mutere mu mirima yanyu imbuto z’ubwoko bubiri. Ntimuze mwambare impuzu zijishwe mu nyuzi z’ubwoko bubiri.
Umugabo niyaryamana n’umwigeme w’umugurano arehejwe n’uwundi ariko ataracungurwa canke ngo aronke ukwidegemvya, aze ahanwe bikwiye. Ariko ntibaze bicwe, kuko uwo mwigeme atari bwaronke umwidegemvyo.
Ariko uwo mugabo we, aze ashikanire Uhoraho impfizi y’intama imbere y’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, impfizi y’intama y’ikimazi c’indishi gishikanirwa Uhoraho .
Umuherezi aze amutangire ikimazi imbere y’ Uhoraho akoresheje ico kimazi co kwikurako icaha, kubera icaha yakoze, na we azoharirwa icaha ciwe.
Nimwashika mu gihugu mugatera igiti c’icamwa ico ari co cose, muze mumare imyaka itatu mufata ko ivyamwa vyaco ari ibizira; ntibize biribwe.
Umwaka ugira kane, ivyamwa vyaco bizoba ari ivyera, ishikanwa ryo guhimbaza Uhoraho .
Ariko mu mwaka ugira gatanu muremerewe kurya ivyamwa vyaco. Nimwakora uko, ni ho umwimbu wanyu uzogwira. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimuze murye inyama zikirimwo amaraso. Ntimuze mukoreshe ivy’ubupfumu no guhamagara imizimu.
Ntimuze mumwe umushatsi wo mu misaya yanyu canke ubwanwa bwanyu.
Ntimuze mwikebagure ku mibiri yanyu kubera abapfuye canke ngo mwishushanyeko ibintu ku mibiri. Ndi Uhoraho .
Ntimuze mutetereze umukobwa wanyu mu kumushorera mu bumaraya, kuko vyohava bikwegera igihugu kwuzura ubumaraya n’ubundi bubi.
Muze mwitondere amasabato yanje kandi mwubahe ahera hanje. Ndi Uhoraho .
Ntimuze muhindukirire abahamagara imizimu canke abanyamareba, kuko bobanduza. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Uze uhaguruke kubera icubahiro c’umutama, wubahe abakuruta kandi uhe icubahiro Imana yawe. Ndi Uhoraho .
Umuntu w’umunyamahanga niyaba muri mwebwe, ntimuze mumufate nabi.
Umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe aze afatwe nk’imvukira. Mumukunde nk’uko mwikunda, kuko mwari inyambukira muri Egiputa. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimuze mukoreshe ingero zidakwiye iyo muriko murapima uburebure, uburemere canke ubwinshi.
Muze mukoreshe iminzane itabesha, ingero efa ikwiye n’ingero hini y’ukuri. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu, nabakuye mu gihugu ca Egiputa.
Muze muzigame amategeko n’amabwirizwa yanje yose mwongere muyitondere. Ndi Uhoraho .’ "
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:

"Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Umwisirayeli canke umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe azotanga umwe mu bana biwe ngo ashikanirwe ikigirwamana Moleki aze yicwe. Abantu b’ubwoko bwanyu baze bamwicishe amabuye.
Igitsure canje nzogishira kuri uwo muntu kandi nzomukura mu bwoko bwiwe; kuko azoba ahumanije ahera hanje kandi atukishije izina ryanje, mu gutanga abana biwe kw’ibimazi vya Moleki.
Abantu nibirabira hirya igihe uwo muntu azotanga umwe mu bana biwe kuri Moleki ntibamwice,
nzohindukiriza igitsure canje kuri abo bantu n’imiryango yabo kandi nzobakura mu bwoko bwabo. Ivyo bizoba kuri we no ku bamukurikira mu kwihumanisha ico kigirwamana Moleki.
Igitsure canje kizoba ku muntu wese ahamagara imizimu n’abapfumu akihumanisha kuvyizigira no kubikurikira. Nzomuca mu muryango wiwe.
Mwitange mube abera, kuko ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Mugumye ivyo nabategetse kandi mubikurikize. Ni jewe Uhoraho ndabeza.
Nihagira uwo muri mwebwe avuma se canke nyina, aze yicwe. Kuko yavumye se canke nyina, amaraso yiwe azoje ku mutwe wiwe.
Umugabo azosambana n’umugore w’uwundi mugabo, ni ukuvuga umugore wa mugenziwe, uwo mugabo n’uwo mugore bompi baze bicwe.
Umugabo niyasambana na muka se, azoba atetereje se. Uwo mugabo n’uwo mugore bompi baze bicwe; amaraso yabo azoje ku mitwe yabo.
Umugabo niyasambana n’umukazana wiwe, bompi baze bicwe. Kuko bazoba bakoze ikizira; amaraso yabo azoje ku mitwe yabo ubwabo.
Umugabo niyasambana n’uwundi mugabo nk’uko umugabo asambana n’umugore, bompi bazoba bakoze ivyo kwankwa urunuka. Baze bicwe; amaraso yabo azoje ku mitwe yabo ubwabo.
Umugabo niyarongora umugore na nyina w’uwo mugore, ico ni ubuyobe, yaba uwo mugabo, baba abo bagore, bose baze baturirwe, kugira ngo mukure ubuyobe muri mwebwe.
Umugabo niyasambana n’igikoko, aze yicwe, kandi n’ico gikoko muze mucice.
Umugore niyasambana n’igikoko, muze mwice uwo mugore n’ico gikoko. Vyompi bize vyicwe kandi amaraso yavyo azoje ku mutwe wiwe n’uw’ico gikoko.
Umugabo niyarongora mushikiwe, yaba uwo bavukana kuri se canke kuri nyina, bakaryamana, ni agatetereza. Baze bakurwe imbere yanyu. Kuko azoba yatetereje mushikiwe, azobizire.

Umugabo niyaryamana n’umugore ari mu miziro y’ukwezi, aze azire ko yerekanye isoko y’amaraso y’uwo mugore, uwo mugore na we ko yemeye kwiyambura no kuyerekana. Bompi baze bakurwe mu bwoko bwabo, kuko bemeranije kwerekana isoko y’amaraso y’uwo mugore.
Ntihaze hagire uwuryamana na nyinabo canke na inasenge, kuko kwoba ari ugutetereza incuti ya hafi; kandi bompi ntibaze babure kubizira.
Umugabo niyaryamana na muka sewabo canke na muka inarume, azoba atetereje sewabo canke inarume. Bompi bazobizira; bazopfa batavyaye.
Umugabo niyarongora muramuwe, kizoba ari igikorwa gitera guhumana. Nta mwana bazoronka, kuko azoba atetereje uwo bavukana.
Muze muzigame ivyo nabategetse vyose, n’amabwirizwa yanje yose, kandi muze mubikurikize, kugira ngo igihugu ngiye kubaha ntikize kibadahwe.
Ntimuze mukore ivyo amahanga ngiye gusohora imbere yanyu akora, kuko yakoze ivyo vyose nababujije, nanje nca ndayazinukwa.
Ariko mwebwe nababwiye nti: "Muzoragwa igihugu cabo; nzokibaha nk’iragi, ico gihugu gitemba amata n’ubuki." Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu, yabatoranije mu yandi mahanga.

Mukwiye rero gutandukanya ibikoko bihumanye n’ibidahumanye, n’ibiguruka bihumanye n’ibidahumanye. Ntimuze mwihumanishe igikoko na kimwe canke ikiguruka na kimwe canke igikwega inda hasi, ivyo nababwiye ko bihumanye kuri mwebwe.
Mumbere abera kuko jewe, Uhoraho , ndi uwera, kandi nabatoranije mu yandi mahanga ngo mumbere ihanga niharije.
Umugabo canke umugore ahamagara imizimu canke abapfumu ari muri mwebwe aze yicwe. Muze mumwicishe amabuye; amaraso yiwe azoje ku mutwe wiwe ubwiwe.’ "
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati: "Vugana n’abaherezi, abahungu ba Aroni, ubabwire uti: ‘Ntihaze hagire umuherezi yihumanisha umuvyimba w’umuntu n’umwe w’incuti yiwe yapfuye,
kiretse incuti ya hafi, nka nyina canke se, umuhungu wiwe canke umukobwa wiwe, uwo bavukana w’umuhungu,
canke mushikiwe akiba iwe kuko atararongorwa; kuko abikoze ashobora kwihumanya.
Ntaze yihumanishe ab’iwabo n’umugore, ngo bitume ahumana.
Abaherezi ntibaze bimoshe umushatsi wose canke ubwanwa bwose canke ngo bikebagure ku mibiri yabo.
Baze babere Imana yabo abera kandi ntibaze batukishe izina ry’Imana yabo. Kuko ari bo bashikana ibimazi bituririwe Uhoraho , ari zo mfungurwa z’Imana yabo; ni co gituma bakwiye kuba abera.
Ntibaze barongore abagore bahumanijwe n’ubumaraya canke bahukanye n’abagabo babo, kuko abaherezi ari abejerejwe Uhoraho Imana yabo.
Muze mubafate nk’abera, kuko bashikanira Imana yanyu imfungurwa. Muze mubafate nk’abera, kuko jewe, Uhoraho , ndi uwera kandi ni jewe ndabeza.
Umukobwa w’umuherezi niyiyandurisha kuba maraya, azoba atetereje se; aze aturirwe mu muriro.

Umuherezi mukuru, umwe muri bamwe bavukana yasutswe ku mutwe ya mavuta yo kumurobanura, agatoranirizwa kuzokwambara za mpuzu z’ubuherezi, ntaze yigere asambura umushatsi canke ngo yitabagurireko impuzu.
Ntaze yigere yinjira ahari umuvyimba w’umuntu. Ntaze yigere yiyandurisha umuvyimba naho yoba ari se canke nyina,
canke ngo ave ahera h’Imana yiwe, canke ngo ahahumanye, kuko yatoranijwe asizwe amavuta yo kurobanura y’Imana yiwe. Ndi Uhoraho .
Umuherezi mukuru aze arongore umukobwa akiri isugi.
Ntaze arongore umupfakazi, uwahukanye, canke uwihumanishije kuba maraya, ahubwo aze arongore umukobwa akiri isugi wo mu bwoko bwiwe,
kugira ngo ntahumanye uruvyaro rwiwe mu bwoko bwiwe. Ndi Uhoraho , ni jewe ndamweza.’ "
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
"Bwira Aroni uti: ‘Uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi, ntihaze hagire uwo mu ruvyaro rwawe afise agasembwa azokwegera ngo ahereze imfungurwa z’Imana yiwe.
Ntihaze hagire uwufise agasembwa yegera ngo abikore, ari impumyi canke ikimuga, afise agasembwa mu maso, canke afise ubumuga bundi;
amugaye ikirenge canke ikiganza,
uwufise inyonzo canke ari impfunya, uwupfuye ijisho, uwugwaye uruhere, canke ibisebe biva amazi, canke uwamenetse amatengatwa.
Ntihaze hagire uwukomoka kuri Aroni umuherezi afise agasembwa azokwegera kugira ngo ashikane ishikanwa rituririrwa Uhoraho . Uwufise agasembwa ntaze yegere guhereza imfungurwa z’Imana yiwe.
Ashobora kurya kuri za mfungurwa zera z’Imana yiwe, no ku zera zose;
ariko kubera ubumuga bwiwe, ntaze yegere ca gihuzu gikingira ahera cane canke ngo yegere igicaniro, kuko yohava ahumanya ahera hanje. Ndi Uhoraho kandi ni jewe ndabeza.’ "
Nuko Mose abibwira Aroni n’abahungu biwe n’Abisirayeli bose.
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
"Barira Aroni n’abahungu biwe bitondere cane amashikanwa Abisirayeli bateguye kunshikanira, kugira ngo ntibahumanye izina ryanje. Ndi Uhoraho .

Ubabwire uti: ‘Uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi, nihagira umwe wo mu ruvyaro rwanyu azoba ahumanye ariko akegera amashikanwa yera Abisirayeli bangeneye jewe Uhoraho , uwo muntu aze akurwe imbere yanje. Ndi Uhoraho .

Uwo mu ruvyaro rwa Aroni azogwara imibembe canke akagira ibimuva mu bihimba vy’irondoka, ntaze arye ku bimazi vyera gushika igihe azohumanurirwa. Azoba kandi ahumanye niyakora ku kintu candujwe n’umuvyimba canke n’umuntu yasheshe imbuto ziwe,
canke niyakora ku gakoko gatoya kose gashobora kumuhumanya, canke ku muntu wese yomuhumanya, ubuhumane ubwo ari bwo bwose.
Uwuzokora ku kintu nk’ico azoba ahumanye gushika ku mugoroba. Ntaze yegere ibimazi vyera kiretse amaze kwiyuhagira n’amazi.
Izuba niryarenga, azoba ahumanuwe, hanyuma yaho azoba yemerewe kurya ku bimazi vyera, kuko ari imfungurwa ziwe.
Ntaze arye igikoko capfuye ata wucishe canke icatabaguwe n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba, kuko yohava avyiyandurisha. Ndi Uhoraho .
Abaherezi baze bitondere ivyo nihanikirije vyose kugira ngo ntibaze batsindwe n’urubanza bagahava bapfa bazize ko babikengereye. Ndi Uhoraho kandi ni jewe ndabeza.
Ntihaze hagire umuntu atari uwo mu muryango w’abaherezi, umushitsi agendeye umuherezi canke umukozi wiwe, arya ku bimazi vyera.
Ariko uwo muherezi niyagura umugurano n’amahera yiwe, canke niyaba ari umugurano yavukiye mu nzu yiwe, uwo mugurano ashobora kurya ku ndya ziwe.
Umukobwa w’umuherezi niyarongorwa n’uwundi muntu atari umuherezi, ntazoba yemerewe kurya ku vyera vyashikaniwe Imana.

Ariko umukobwa w’umuherezi niyaba umupfakazi canke akahukana, kandi ata bana araronka, hanyuma agasubira mu nzu kwa se nk’uko yari ari atararongorwa, azoba yemerewe kurya kuri izo ndya za se. Nta muntu n’umwe atabifitiye uburenganzira akwiye kurya kuri izo ndya.
Nihagira uwurya ku bimazi vyera atabizi, aze arihe uwo muherezi ico kimazi yariye yongereko ica gatanu c’ikiguzi caco.
Abaherezi ntibaze bakengereze ibimazi vyera Abisirayeli bashikaniye Uhoraho
mu kubemerera kubiryako bikabazanira gutsindwa, maze bigatuma batanga indishi. Ndi Uhoraho kandi ni jewe ndabeza.’ "
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:

"Vugana na Aroni n’abahungu biwe n’Abisirayeli bose uti: ‘Nihagira n’umwe wo muri mwebwe, yaba Umwisirayeli canke umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe, azotanga impano y’ikimazi co guturirira Uhoraho , caba ari ico gushitsa isezerano canke ico atanze avyishakiye,
aze atange ishuri itagira agasembwa akuye mu busho bwiwe, intama canke impene, kugira ngo ikimazi ciwe cemerwe.
Ntimuze muzane igikoko na kimwe gifise agasembwa, kuko kitazokwemerwa nk’ikimazi mutanze.

Nihagira uwuzana ikivuye mu masho canke mu mikuku kw’ikimazi c’ishimwe k’ Uhoraho co gushitsa isezerano canke co gushikana kuko avyishakiye, kize kibe ikitagira agasembwa canke umugayo kugira ngo cemerwe.

Ntimuze mushikanire Uhoraho icahumye, icamugaye canke icacitse amaboko canke amaguru, icagwaye urukoma canke uruhere canke ibisebe. Ntimuze muzane ku gicaniro ikimazi kimeze gityo ngo kibe ikimazi gishikaniwe Uhoraho giturizwa umuriro.

Mushobora kuzana ikimazi mutanze muvyishakiye; ishuri, intama canke impene ifise ukuguru canke ukuboko kugufi cane canke kurekure cane canke ngufi cane, ariko ntikizokwemerwa nk’ikimazi co gushitsa isezerano.
Ntimuze mushikanire Uhoraho igikoko gifise amatengatwa yamenetse, yajanjaguritse canke yacitse. Ntimuze mubikorere mu gihugu canyu,
kandi ntimuze mwemere ibikoko nk’ivyo mubihawe n’umunyamahanga ngo mubitange nk’imfungurwa z’Imana yanyu. Ntibizokwemerwa, kuko bimugaye kandi bifise agasembwa.’ "
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
"Nihavuka inyana, umwagazi w’intama canke w’impene, ize igumane na nyina imisi indwi. Kuva ku musi ugira umunani kubandanya, izoba yemewe gutangwa kw’ikimazi co guturirira Uhoraho .
Ntimuze mukerere inka canke intama n’inyana canke n’umwagazi wayo ku musi umwe.
Nimwatanga ikimazi co gukenguruka k’ Uhoraho , muze mugitange ku buryo cemerwa.
Kize kiribwe kuri uwo musi nyene; ntimuze musigaze na kimwe gushika mu gitondo. Ndi Uhoraho .
Muze mwitwararike ivyo ndabategeka kandi mubigendere. Ni jewe Uhoraho .
Ntimuze mukengereze izina ryanje. Ukwera kwanje gukwiye kumenyekana mu Bisirayeli. Ni jewe Uhoraho nabejeje
ndabakuye mu gihugu ca Egiputa kugira ngo ndababere Imana. Ndi Uhoraho ."
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
"Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Iyi ni yo misi mikuru nashinze, jewe Uhoraho , iyo mukwiye gutangaza no kumenyesha ko ari iyera.

Mufise imisi itandatu yo gukora, ariko umusi ugira indwi ni Isabato yo kuruhuka, umusi w’ihuriro ryera. Ntimuze mugire igikorwa na kimwe mukora kuri uwo musi; aho muba hose, izoba ari Isabato y’ Uhoraho .
Iyi ni yo misi mikuru Uhoraho yashinze, amakoraniro yera mukwiye kumenyesha mu bihe vyayo:
Pasika y’ Uhoraho itangura ku mugoroba izuba rirenze ku musi ugira icumi na kane w’ukwezi kwa mbere.
Ku musi ugira icumi na gatanu w’ukwo kwezi, hazoba umusi mukuru w’imikate itambiye w’ Uhoraho ; muze mumare imisi indwi murya imikate itarimwo umwambiro.
Ku musi wa mbere muze mugire ikoraniro ryera kandi ntimuze mugire igikorwa muwukorako.
Muze mumare imisi indwi mushikanira Uhoraho ikimazi co guturirwa. Hanyuma ku musi ugira indwi muze mugire ikoraniro ryera kandi ntimuze mugire igikorwa muwukorako.’ "
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
"Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Nimwinjira mu gihugu ngiye kubaha, hanyuma mukimbura ivyeze muri co, muze muzanire umuherezi umukama w’ivyeze imbere y’ibindi mu vyo mwimbuye.
Na we aze azungagize uwo mukama imbere y’ Uhoraho , na wo uzokwemerwa ku bwanyu; uwo muherezi aze awuzungagize ku musi ukurikira Isabato.
Ku musi wo kuzungagiza uwo mukama, muze mutange umwagazi w’intama umaze umwaka kandi utagira agasembwa kw’ikimazi co guturirwa,

hamwe n’ishikanwa ry’ifu ingana na bibiri vy’icumi vy’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza ivanze n’amavuta; ishikanwa ryo guturirwa rishikaniwe Uhoraho , ubumote bwiza; hamwe n’ishikanwa ry’ica kane c’ingero hini y’umuvinyu.

Ntimuze murye umukate n’umwe, intete zikaranze canke intete nshasha, kugeza kuri uwo musi muzotanga ico kimazi ku Mana yanyu. Iri rize ribe ibwirizwa rihoraho uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana n’urundi, aho muzoba muba hose.
Kuva ku musi ukurikira isabato, ari wo musi mwazanyeko wa mukama w’ishikanwa ryo kuzunguza, muze muharure amayinga indwi yuzuye.
Muze muharure imisi mirongo itanu kugeza ku musi ukurikira Isabato igira indwi, hanyuma muce mutanga ishikanwa ry’ifu nshasha k’ Uhoraho .

Kuva aho muba hose, muze muzane imikate ibiri, umwe wose ukozwe muri bibiri vya cumi vy’ingero efa y’ifu inoze neza, kandi ikaranze irimwo n’umwambiro, nk’ishikanwa ryo kuzungagiza ry’ivyeze imbere y’ibindi rishikaniwe Uhoraho .

Muze mutange uwo mukate hamwe n’impfizi z’intama indwi zikiri imyagazi, umwagazi wose uzobe umaze umwaka kandi utagira agasembwa, n’ishuri ikiri nto n’impfizi zibiri z’intama; ivyo bibe ibimazi vyo guturirirwa Uhoraho , ishikanwa ritanzwe hamwe n’amashikanwa y’ifu n’amashikanwa y’ibinyobwa bijanye, ari ryo shikanwa riturirwa rikaba ubumote bwiza buhimbara Uhoraho .
Hanyuma muze mushikane isuguru y’impene, ibe ikimazi c’ivyaha, hamwe n’imyagazi y’intama ibiri, imaze umwaka, ibe ikimazi c’ishimwe.

Umuherezi aze azungagize iyo myagazi ibiri imbere y’ Uhoraho nk’ishikanwa ryo kuzungagiza, hamwe na wa mukate ukozwe mu vyimburwa vyeze imbere y’ibindi. Bizoba ari ishikanwa ryera k’ Uhoraho kandi rizoba ari iry’umuherezi.
Kuri uwo musi nyene, muze mutangaze ikoraniro ryera kandi ntihaze hagire igikorwa na kimwe mukora. Iryo rize ribe itegeko rihoraho uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi, aho muzoba muba hose.

Nimwimbura ivyo mu gihugu canyu, ntimuze mwimbure ivyameze hirya y’urubibe rwanyu canke ngo musubire inyuma gutoragura ivyasigaye mu mirima. Muze mubirekere abakene n’inyambukira. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.’ "
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
"Barira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Umusi wa mbere w’ukwezi kw’indwi muze muwuruhukeko, ribe ikoraniro ryera muhimbarisha kuvuza inzamba.
Ntimuze mugire igikorwa muwukorako ariko muze mushikanire Uhoraho ikimazi co guturirwa.’ "
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
"Umusi ugira icumi w’uko kwezi kw’indwi uzobe umusi wo gutanga ikimazi co kwicungura. Muze mugire ikoraniro ryera mwisonzeshe, kandi mushikanire Uhoraho ikimazi co guturirwa.
Ntimuze mukore kuri uwo musi, kuko uzoba ari umusi wo gutanga ikimazi co kwicungura, umusi mutangirako ikimazi gituma mwemerwa n’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Umuntu wese atazokwisonzesha kuri uwo musi aze arandurwe mu bwoko bwiwe.
Nzorandura mu muryango wiwe umuntu wese azogira ico akoze kuri uwo musi.
Ntihaze hagire ikintu na kimwe mukora. Iri rize ribe itegeko rihoraho uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana n’urundi, aho muzoba muba hose.
Izoba ari Isabato yo kuruhuka kuri mwebwe, kandi muze mwisonzeshe. Kuva ku mugoroba w’umusi ugira icenda w’uko kwezi gushika ku mugoroba ukurikira muze mwitondere Isabato yanyu."
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
"Barira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Ku musi ugira icumi na gatanu w’ukwezi kw’indwi ni ho umusi mukuru w’ Uhoraho w’insago uzoba utanguye, kandi uzomara imisi indwi.
Umusi wa mbere uze ube uw’ikoraniro ryera; ntimuze muwukoreko igikorwa na kimwe.

Muze mumare imisi indwi mushikanira Uhoraho ibimazi vyo guturirwa, hanyuma ku musi ugira umunani muze mugire ikoraniro ryera, mushikane ibimazi bituririrwa Uhoraho . Rizoba ari ikoraniro ryo gusozera; ntimuze mugire igikorwa na kimwe muwukorako.

(Iyo ni yo misi mikuru itegetswe n’ Uhoraho . Muze muyihimbaze mukoranya amakoraniro yejejwe yo gutanga kw’ibimazi vyo guturirira Uhoraho , ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’amashikanwa y’ifu, ibimazi n’amashikanwa vy’ibinyobwa vyategetswe ku musi ku musi.

Ivyo bimazi ni ibizoba vyiyongera kuri bimwe bitangwa ku masabato y’ Uhoraho no kuri vya bimazi mutanga nk’ingabire, no kuri bimwe vyo gushitsa isezerano n’ivyo mutanga muvyishakiye mukabishikanira Uhoraho .)

Nuko rero kuva ku musi ugira icumi na gatanu w’ukwezi kw’indwi, mumaze kwimbura ivyimburwa vyo mu gihugu, muze muhimbaze umusi mukuru w’ Uhoraho uzomara imisi indwi; umusi wa mbere uzoba ari uwo kuruhuka, n’umusi w’umunani na wo nyene ni uwo kuruhuka.

Ku musi wa mbere muze muzane ibirusha ibindi kuba vyiza mu vyamye ku biti, amashami y’ibigazi, amashami y’ibiti vy’amababi maninimanini n’ibiti bimera i ruhande y’amazi atemba, hanyuma munezererwe imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu kumara imisi indwi.
Muze muwuhimbaze nk’umusi mukuru w’ Uhoraho uzomara imisi indwi uko umwaka utashe. Iri rize ribe itegeko rihoraho uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana n’urundi; muze muwuhimbaze mu kwezi kw’indwi.
Muze mube mu nsago kumara imisi indwi: Abisirayeli bose b’imvukira baze babe mu nsago
kugira ngo abana banyu baze bamenye ko jewe natumye Abisirayeli baba mu nsago igihe nabakura mu gihugu ca Egiputa. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.’ "
Nuko Mose amenyesha Abisirayeli imisi mikuru yose yashinzwe n’ Uhoraho .
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
"Ubarire Abisirayeli bazane amavuta ya elayo ateguwe neza yo gucana amatara, kugira ngo azogume yaka ibihe vyose.

Mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, hino y’igitambara gikingira Isandugu y’Isezerano, ni ho Aroni azoyatereka kugira ngo yame yaka adahengeshanya imbere y’ Uhoraho , kuva ku mugoroba gushika mu gitondo. Iryo rize ribe ibwirizwa rihoraho uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana n’urundi.
Ayo matara aze yame ashirwa ku giterekwako amatara c’inzahabu itavanze imbere y’ Uhoraho ubudasiba.
Muze mufate ifu mucumbe imikate icumi n’ibiri, mukoresheje bibiri vya cumi vy’ingero efa ku mukate umwe umwe.
Muze muyitondeke ku mirongo ibiri, ku murongo wose hajeko itandatu itandatu, ku meza ikozwe mu nzahabu itavanze imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Muze mushire ibimota neza i ruhande y’umurongo wose, bibe ku mikate nk’icibutso, nk’ishikanwa riturirwa imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Iyo mikate ize yame ishirwa imbere y’ Uhoraho ubudasiba, uko Isabato ikurikirana n’iyindi, kubw’Abisirayeli, nk’isezerano ridahera.
Izoba ari iya Aroni n’abahungu biwe, na bo baze bayirire ahera, kuko ari umugabane wera cane bagerewe kuzohora baronka ku mashikanwa atuririwe Uhoraho ."
Umusi umwe habaye amatati aho bari bacumbitse, hagati y’Umwisirayeli n’umuhungu yari afise se w’Umunyegiputa na nyina w’Umwisirayelikazi.
Maze uwo muhungu w’Umunyegiputa n’Umwisirayelikazi atuka rya Zina ararivuma; maze baca bamuzanira Mose. (Nyina wiwe yitwa Shelomite, umukobwa wa Diburi wo mu muryango wa Dani.)
Baca bamushira mw’ibohero gushika bamenyeshejwe neza ubugombe bw’ Uhoraho .
Nuko Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
"Sohora uwo yatutse izina ryanje inyuma y’aho mucumbitse. Maze abamwumvise bose babe ari bo barambika ibiganza ku mutwe wiwe, maze ikoraniro ryose rimwicishe amabuye.
Bwira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Nihagira uwuvuma Izina ry’Imana yiwe, azobizira;
umuntu wese azotuka izina ry’ Uhoraho aze yicwe. Ikoraniro ryose rize rimwicishe amabuye. Yaba imvukira canke umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe; niyatuka iryo zina, aze yicwe.
Nihagira uwica umuntu, na we aze yicwe.
Nihagira uwica igitungano c’uwundi aze akirihe, ubugingo bwishurwe ubundi.
Umuntu niyakomeretsa mugenziwe, ico azoba yakoze na we aze agikorerwe.
Imvune ihorwe iyindi, ijisho rihorwe irindi, iryinyo rihorwe irindi. Uko azoba yakomerekeje mugenziwe, na we aze abe ari ko akomeretswa.
Uwishe igikoko aze akirihe, ariko uwishe umuntu aze yicwe.
Muze mugire itegeko rimwe ku munyamahanga n’imvukira. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.’ "
Nuko Mose avugana n’Abisirayeli, na bo bafata wa muntu yatutse izina ry’ Uhoraho bamujana inyuma y’aho bacumbitse. Abisirayeli bakora nk’uko Uhoraho yari yategetse Mose.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ari ku musozi Sinayi ati:
"Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Nimwinjira igihugu ngiye kubaha, ico gihugu ubwaco kize cubahirize Isabato y’ Uhoraho .
Muze murime imirima yanyu imyaka itandatu, kandi muri iyo myaka itandatu muze mututurire imizabibu yanyu mwongere mwegeranye ivyimburwa vyayo.
Ariko mu mwaka ugira indwi isi ize ironke akaruhuko k’Isabato, Isabato y’ Uhoraho . Ntimuze mubibe canke ngo mutere ikintu na kimwe mu mirima yanyu canke ngo mututurire imizabibu yanyu.
Ntimuze mwimbure ivyimejeje muri yo kandi ntimuze mwamure imizabibu yamye ku biti bidatuturiye. Isi ize ironke umwaka w’akaruhuko.
Ivyo imirima izokwama vyose bize bibe ivyokurya vyanyu, mwebwe ubwanyu, abagurano banyu n’abaguranokazi banyu, n’abakozi banyu canke abashitsi bari i wanyu,
n’ibitungano vyanyu n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba vyo mu gihugu canyu. Ivyo igihugu kimejeje vyose bishobora kuribwa.
Muze muharure amasabato indwi y’imyaka, ni ukuvuga imyaka indwi incuro indwi, kugira ngo ayo masabato indwi y’imyaka akwize imyaka mirongo ine n’icenda.
Hanyuma muzoce muvuza inzamba hose ku musi ugira icumi w’ukwezi kw’indwi; ku musi wo gutanga ikimazi co kwicungura muze muvuze inzamba mu gihugu cose.
Muze mweze umwaka ugira mirongo itanu muri mu gihugu mwamamaze umwidegemvyo ku bakibamwo bose.
Uwo mwaka ugira mirongo itanu uze ube Yubile kuri mwebwe; ntimuze mugire ico mubiba canke mutera ngo mugire ico mwimbura ku vyimejeje canke ngo mwamure inzabibu ku mizabibu mutatuturiye.
Kuko izoba ari Yubile kandi izoba ari iyejejwe kuri mwebwe; muze murye ivyo mwamuye mu mirima.
Muri uwo mwaka wa Yubile umuntu wese aze asubire mw’itongo ryiwe.
Nimwagurisha itongo ku wo mu bwoko bwanyu canke mukarimugurira, ntihaze hagire uwuzimba uwundi.
Muze mugure amatongo y’abo mu bwoko bwanyu mukurikije imyaka mumaze Yubile ibaye. Kandi muze mugurishe amatongo kuri bagenzi banyu mukurikije imyaka isigaye yo kwimbura mu mirima yanyu.
Imyaka niyaba ari myinshi, muze muduze igiciro, na ho niyaba ari mike, muze mumanure igiciro, kuko ico muzoba muriko muragurisha ari igitigiri c’ibihe vyo kwimbura.
Ntihaze hagire uwurenganya uwundi, ariko muze mutinye Imana yanyu. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Muze mukurikize amategeko yanje kandi mwitwaririke kwumvira ivyagezwe vyanje, ni ho muzoba amahoro muri ico gihugu.
Aho ni ho igihugu kizokwera ivyamwa vyaco, namwe muzorya muhage kandi muzokibamwo mu mutekano.
Mwoshobora kubaza muti: "Tuzorya iki mu mwaka ugira indwi nitutatera ngo twimbure ivyimburwa vyacu?"
Nzobarungikira umugisha mu mwaka ugira gatandatu ku buryo imirima izotanga ivyimburwa vyo kubatunga imyaka itatu.
Mu gihe co kubiba mu mwaka ugira umunani, muzoba mukirya ibihitira kandi muzokomeza kubirya gushika aho muzokwimburira ivyo mu mwaka ugira icenda.
Ntihaze hagire uwugurisha itongo rimwe burundu, kuko amatongo ari ayanje namwe mukaba ba kavantara n’abakozi banje.
Mu gihugu cose muhawe ngo mucegukire, muze mutegurire amatongo igihe co gucungurwa.
Umwisirayeli wo mu bwoko bwanyu niyakena akagurisha igice c’itongo ryiwe, uwo mu ncuti ziwe za hafi aze acungure rya tongo yagurishije.
Ariko uwo muntu niyaba atagira uwo kumucungurira iryo tongo, ariko hanyuma agatunga akaronka ivyo kuricungura,
aze aharure ikiguzi gikwiranye n’igihe rimaze uhereye igihe yarigurisha ace asubiza ayasigaye uwari yariguze; aho rero azoce asubirana itongo ryiwe.
Ariko nataronka ivyo kurigaruza, aho yagurishije haze hagume ari aha nyene kuhagura kugeza ku mwaka wa Yubile. Haze hasubizwe kuri Yubile, hasubire kuba aha nyeneho.
Umuntu niyagurisha inzu iri mu gisagara kizitijwe inzitiro, azoba ashobora kuyicungura mu kiringo c’umwaka kuva igurishijwe. Muri ico kiringo gusa ni ho azoba ashobora kuyicungura.
Niyaba atashoboye kuyicungura ico kiringo kikamurengana, iyo nzu iri mu gisagara kizitijwe uruzitiro ize yegukire nyene kuyigura n’uruvyaro rwiwe. Ntize isubizwe mu gihe ca Yubile.
Ariko inzu ziri mu mihana ahantu hatagira inzitiro zize zifatwe nk’amatongo. Zirashobora gucungurwa, kandi zize zisubizwe kuri Yubile.
Abalewi bazokwama bafise uburenganzira bwo gucungura inzu zabo ziri mu bisagara vyagerewe Abalewi.

Nuko rero amatongo y’Abalewi ashobora gucungurwa; yaba inzu yagurishijwe iri mu gisagara ico ari co cose bagabiwe, kandi ize isubizwe mu gihe ca Yubile, kuko inzu muri ivyo bisagara vy’Abalewi ari umugabane wabo mu Bisirayeli.
Ariko ahantu h’uburagiro bwegukira ibisagara vyabo ntivyemewe kuhagurisha; ni umugabane wabo imyaka yose.

Umuntu wo mu bwoko bwanyu niyakena ntashobore kuronka ikimutunga kimubeshaho, muze mumufashe nk’uko mwobikorera umunyamahanga canke inyambukira iri muri mwebwe, kugira ngo ashobore kubaho muri mwebwe.
Ntimuze murondere kumuronkako inyungu iyo ari yo yose, ariko muze mwubahe Imana yanyu, kugira ngo uwo muntu wo mu bwoko bwanyu ashishikare kuba muri mwebwe.
Ntimuze mumugurane amahera mwiteze ko abungukira canke ngo mumugurisheko ivyo gufungura mugomba kumwungukako.
Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu, nabakuye mu gihugu ca Egiputa kugira ngo ndabahe igihugu c’i Kanani nongere ndababere Imana.
Nihagira uwo mu bwoko bwanyu aba umukene ari muri mwebwe hanyuma akigurisha kuri mwebwe, ntimuze mumukoreshe nk’umugurano.
Aze akoreshwe nk’umukozi aca ingero canke nk’umunyamahanga aba muri mwebwe, aze abakorere gushika ku mwaka wa Yubile.
Hanyuma we n’abana biwe baze bidegemvye, na we aze asubire mu muryango wiwe no mw’itongo rya ba sekuruza.
Kuko Abisirayeli ari abakozi banje, abo naguze nkabakura muri Egiputa, ntibaze bagurishwe nk’abagurano.
Ntimuze mubatwaze igitugu, ariko mwubahe Imana yanyu.
Abagurano n’abaguranokazi banyu baze bave mu mahanga abakikuje; muri abo ni ho muzoshobora kugura abagurano.
Mushobora kandi kubagura mu bantu b’inyambukira baba muri mwebwe no mu bo mu miryango yabo bavukiye iwanyu, na bo bazoba inyegu zanyu.
Mushobora no kubaraga abahungu banyu kandi mushobora kubatunga nk’abagurano ubuzima bwabo bwose, ariko ntimuze mutwaze amanyama Umwisirayeli mugenzi wanyu.
Uwo mu banyamahanga aba muri mwebwe niyatunga maze uwo mu bwoko bwanyu agakena akigurisha kuri uwo munyamahanga aba muri mwebwe canke ku bo mu muryango wiwe,
aze agumane uburenganzira bwo gucungurwa amaze kwigurisha, uwo mu ncuti ziwe ashobora kumucungura.
Sewabo canke inarume canke muvyarawe canke incuti iyo ari yo yose yo mu muryango wiwe ishobora kumucungura; canke niyatunga, ashobora kwicungura.
We n’uwo yamuguze baze baharure uhereye umwaka yamuguzemwo kugeza ku mwaka wa Yubile. Igiciro co kumucungura kize giharurwe bakoresheje impembo y’umukozi muri iyo myaka yose.
Nihaba hasigaye imyaka myinshi, aze arihe igice kinini c’amahera yaguzwe.
Nihaba hasigaye imyaka mike ngo Yubile ishike, aze aharure amahera asigaye abe ari yo ariha.
Aze afatwe nk’umukozi yahawe akazi ku mwaka ku mwaka; muze mubikurikirane neza kugira ngo uwo yamuguze ntamutwaze amanyama.
Naho atoshobora gucungurwa muri ubwo buryo, we n’abana biwe baze bidegemvye mu mwaka wa Yubile,
Kuko Abisirayeli ari abakozi banje, abo naguze nkabakura muri Egiputa. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Ntimuze mukore ibigirwamana canke ngo mwishingire ibishushanyo canke inkingi z’amabuye, kandi ntimuze mushinge ivyabajwe mu mabuye mu gihugu ngo muvyunamire. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Muze mwitondere amasabato yanje kandi mwubahe ahera hanje. Ndi Uhoraho .
Nimwitondera ivyo nashinze, mugashira umutima ku kwitondera amabwirizwa yanje,
nzobarungikira imvura mu gihe cayo, kandi isi izokwera ivyimburwa vyayo n’ibiti vyame ivyamwa vyavyo.
Iyimbura ryanyu ry’ingano rizogeza kw’iyimbura ry’inzabibu, n’iyimbura ry’inzabibu rishike mw’ibiba, kandi muzorya ivyo mugomba mube amahoro mu gihugu canyu.
Nzobaha amahoro mu gihugu, kandi muzokwiryamira ata kintu kibaca ivutu. Nzokura ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba mu gihugu, kandi nta nkota izoca mu gihugu canyu.
Muzokinagiza abansi banyu, kandi bazokwicwa n’inkota imbere yanyu.
Batanu bo muri mwebwe bazokinagiza ijana, n’ijana bo muri mwebwe bakinagize ibihumbi icumi, kandi abansi banyu muzobamarisha inkota.
Nzobarabisha ijisho ry’urukundo kandi nzobaha kurondoka mugwire, ngumizeho isezerano nasezeranye namwe.
Muzoba mukirya ivyo mwimbuye umwaka uheze, hanyuma murondere ingene mubisohora kugira ngo muronke aho mwimburira ivyeze.
Nzoshinga ihema ryanje hagati muri mwebwe, kandi sinzobaheba.
Nzogendera hagati yanyu, mbe Imana yanyu namwe mube abantu banje.
Ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu, nabakuye muri Egiputa kugira ngo muve mu buja bw’Abanyegiputa. Navunaguye ivyuma vy’ingogo vyanyu ndabaha kugenda mwemye.
Ariko nimutanyumvira ngo mwitondere aya mabwirizwa yose,
maze mugashiburira kure ivyo nashinze vyose mugakengera ivyagezwe vyanje mukananirwa no kwitondera amabwirizwa yanje yose, mukongera mukava mw’isezerano ryanje,
nanje uku ni ko nzobagirira: nzobateza ibibaca ivutu, ingwara zidakira n’akaranda bitume muba impumyi bibamare inkomezi. Muzobibira ubusa, kuko abansi banyu ari bo bazobirya.
Igitsure canje kizoguma kuri mwebwe bitume mutsindwa n’abansi banyu; ababanka ni bo bazobaganza, kandi muzohunga ata wubirukanye.
Ivyo nibitatuma munyumvira, nzobahanira ivyaha vyanyu incuro indwi.
Nzovunagura ubwibone bwanyu ntume ijuru ribabera nk’icuma isi na yo ibabere nk’umuringa.
Muzoruhira ubusa, kuko igihugu kitazokwera ivyimburwa vyaco, canke ngo ibiti vyo mu gihugu canyu vyame ivyamwa vyavyo.
Nimwashishikara kuba abansi banje mukanka kunyumvira, nzogwiza ivyago vyanyu incuro indwi ndabahora ivyaha vyanyu.
Nzobarungikira ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba bibatere, bibatware abana banyu, bihonye n’amasho yanyu bitume muba inkehwa maze amayira yanyu asigare agaragara.
Naho nyene nimwanka kwemera ngo muhanurwe mugashishikara kuba abansi banje,
nanje nzohinduka umwansi wanyu ndabateze ivyago birushirije incuro indwi kubera ivyaha vyanyu.
Nzoca ndabateza inkota ndabahoye ko mwavuye mw’isezerano ryanje. Nimwahungira mu bisagara vyanyu nzobateza ikiza kandi muzogwa mu maboko y’abansi banyu.
Ninazibira aho mukura ivyokurya, abagore icumi bazoshobora gukarangira mu nkono imwe, kandi bazobagaburira ibipimwe, kandi naho muzobirya ntimuzohaga.
Naho nzoba nabagiriye gutyo, nimwashishikara kuja kure yanje,
nanje nzobarakira ndabaje kure, kandi jewe ubwanje nzobahanira ivyaha vyanyu incuro indwi.
Muzorya inyama z’abahungu banyu n’abakobwa banyu.
Nzosambura ibibanza vyanyu vyo gusengeramwo ku misozi, n’ibicaniro vy’ibimota neza vyanyu nzobisenyurira hasi, ngerekeranye imivyimba yanyu ku bigirwamana vyanyu bitagira ubugingo, ndabanke urunuka.
Ibisagara vyanyu nzobihindura imisaka, nsambure ingoro musengeramwo, kandi n’ibimota neza vy’amashikanwa yanyu bizoba igisesema kuri jewe.
Jewe ubwanje nzosambura igihugu canyu, gushika aho abansi banyu bazokigereramwo bazotangara cane.
Nzobasanzariza mu mahanga nsokorore inkota yanje ndabakinagize. Igihugu canyu kizoba amatongo, kandi ibisagara vyanyu bizosigara ari imisaka.
Igihugu kizonezererwa imyaka y’amasabato yaco igihe cose kizoba ari amatongo namwe muri mu gihugu c’abansi banyu; igihugu na co kizoruhuka amasabato yaco.
Mu gihe cose kizoba ari amatongo, kizoruhuka akaruhuko k’amasabato kitaruhutse igihe mwari mukiri muri co.

Nzotuma abasigaye ari amasigarira baranduka imitima bari mu bihugu vy’abansi babo, ku buryo n’akababi kaguruwe n’umuyaga gatuma bahunga. Bazokwiruka nk’abahunga inkota, maze bagwe hasi, naho ata n’umwe azoba ariko arabakinagiza.
Umuntu azotsitara kuri mugenziwe nk’aho boba bariko barahunga inkota, naho ata n’umwe azoba ariko arabakinagiza. Uko ni ko mutazoshobora guhagarara imbere y’abansi banyu.
Muzohonera mu mahanga; igihugu c’abansi banyu kizobatsontsomera.
Abazosigara bazohonera mu gihugu c’abansi banyu ku bw’ivyaha vyabo n’ivya ba sekuruza babo.
Ariko nibatura ivyaha vyabo n’ivya ba sekuruza babo, ubuhemu bwabo n’urwanko banyanka jewe,
rwatumye nanje ndabazinukwa bigatuma ndabirukanira mu gihugu c’abansi babo, maze imitima yabo y’intakebwa igacishwa bugufi bakishura ivyaha bakoze,
nzokwibuka isezerano nasezeranye na Yakobo n’iryo nasezeranye na Isaka n’iryo nasezeranye na Aburahamu, bitume nibuka igihugu.
Kuko igihugu bazokivamwo na co kikanezererwa amasabato yaco igihe kizoba ari amatongo batakikibamwo. Bazokwishura ivyaha bakoze kuko bataye ivyagezwe vyanje bagatera ibitugu ivyo nihanikirije.
Ariko naho biri uko, igihe bazoba bari mu gihugu c’abansi babo, sinzobata canke ngo ndabahebe ngo bitume ndabaherengeteza rwose, ngo mve mw’isezerano nasezeranye na bo. Ndi Uhoraho Imana yabo.
Ariko ku bwabo nzokwibuka isezerano nasezeranye na ba sekuruza babo, abo nakuye mu gihugu ca Egiputa amahanga yose abibona, ngo mbe Imana yabo. Ndi Uhoraho .’ "
Ivyo ni vyo vyashinzwe, vyagezwe n’amabwirizwa, ivyo Uhoraho yashingiye ku musozi Sinayi, hagati yiwe n’Abisirayeli abicishije kuri Mose.
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati:
"Vugana n’Abisirayeli ubabwire uti: ‘Umuntu niyasezerana isezerano ryo gushikanira Uhoraho umuntu, aze abikore abicishije mu gutanga amahera angana n’igiciro ciwe,
muze mushinge ko igiciro c’izina muhungu ari hagati y’imyaka mirongo ibiri na mirongo itandatu gihuye na shekeli mirongo itanu z’ifeza, hakoreshejwe ingero shekeli y’Ahera;
niyaba ari umuntu w’igitsina gore, muze mushinge shekeli mirongo itatu.
Niyaba umuntu ari hagati y’imyaka itanu na mirongo ibiri, muze mushinge igiciro c’umuhungu kuri shekeli mirongo ibiri na shekeli icumi ku mukobwa.
Niyaba ari umuntu ari hagati y’ukwezi kumwe n’imyaka itanu, ku muhungu muze mushinge shekeli zitanu na shekeli zitatu z’ifeza ku mukobwa.
Niyaba ari umuntu afise imyaka mirongo itandatu n’iyirenga, muze mushinge shekeli icumi na zitanu ku mugabo na shekeli icumi z’ifeza ku mugore.

Uwagize iyo ndahiro niyaba ari umukene cane ku buryo atoshobora kuriha ico kiguzi cashinzwe, aze azane uwo muntu ku muherezi, na we aze amushingire igiciro gihwanye n’ico nyene gusezerana ashobora kuronka.
Ico yasezeranye nicaba ari igikoko cemewe gutangwako ikimazi gishikanirwa Uhoraho , ico gikoko gihawe Uhoraho kizoba kibaye icera.

Ntaze akiguze n’ikindi, ari ciza ngo agisubirize na kibi canke ari kibi ngo agisubirize na ciza; bikenewe ko asubiriza ico gikoko, caba ico gusubirizwa canke ikigisubirira, vyompi bizoba bibaye ivyera.
Niyaba ico yasezeranye ari igihumanye, kidashobora gushikanirwa Uhoraho nk’ikimazi, ico gikoko kize kizanirwe umuherezi,
na we aze arabe uko kimeze ko ari ciza canke kibi. Igiciro uwo muherezi azoshinga ico ari co cose kizoba ari ico nyene.
Nyeneco niyashaka kugicungura, aze yongereko ikigira gatanu c’igiciro caco.
Umuntu niyatanga inzu yiwe ngo ibe iyerejwe Uhoraho , umuherezi aze avuge ko ari nziza canke ari mbi. Igiciro ico ari co cose umuherezi azoshinga kizoguma ari ico nyene.
Uwo muntu nyene kuyitanga niyagomba kuyicungura, aze yongereko ica gatanu ku giciro cayo, iyo nzu rero izoheza isubire kumwegukira.

Umuntu niyatanga igice c’itongo ry’umuryango wiwe ngo ribe iryerejwe Uhoraho , igiciro caryo kize gishingwe baravye imbuto ziterwa muri ryo uko zingana: shekeli mirongo itanu ku ngero homeru imwe ya sayiri.
Niyatanga iryo tongo mu mwaka wa Yubile, igiciro cashinzwe kizoguma ari ico nyene.
Ariko niyatanga iryo tongo inyuma ya Yubile, umuherezi aze ashinge igiciro yisunze imyaka isigaye kugira ngo Yubile yindi ishike, kugira ngo igiciro caryo kigabanurwe.
Uwo muntu yaritanze niyagomba kuricungura, aze yongereko ica gatanu c’igiciro caryo, hanyuma iryo tongo rize risubire kumwegukira.
Ariko natacungura iryo tongo, canke niyaba yarigurishije n’uwundi, ntirize ryigere ricungurwa.
Igihe iryo tongo rizosubirizwa kuri Yubile, rizoca riba iryera, nk’uko bigenda kw’itongo ryeguriwe Uhoraho ; rizoca riba iry’abaherezi.
Umuntu niyatanga itongo yaguze ngo ribe iryerejwe Uhoraho , itongo atari iry’umuryango,
umuherezi aze ashinge igiciro caryo aharuye imyaka isigaye ngo Yubile ishike, hanyuma uwo muntu aze arihe ico kiguzi kuri uwo musi nyene nk’ikintu cerejwe Uhoraho .
Mu mwaka wa Yubile iryo tongo rizoca risubizwa nyene kurigurisha, nyeneryo imbere y’uko rigurishwa.
Ikiguzi cose kize gishingwe hakoreshejwe ingero shekeli y’Ahera, ingero gera mirongo ibiri zibe shekeli imwe.
Ariko ntihaze hagire n’umwe azotanga igikoko c’uburiza, kuko ivy’uburiza vyose bisanzwe ari ivy’ Uhoraho ; yaba inka, canke intama, ni ivy’ Uhoraho .
Nicaba ari kimwe mu bikoko bihumanye, ashobora kugitangira ikiguzi cashinzwe, akongerako ica gatanu caco. Natagicungura, kize kigurishwe ku giciro cashinzwe.

Ariko ntihaze hagire ikintu na kimwe ceguriwe Uhoraho , yaba umuntu canke igikoko canke itongo ry’umuryango, kizogurishwa canke ngo gicungurwe; ikintu cose ceguriwe Uhoraho kizoba ari icera cane k’ Uhoraho .
Naho yoba ari umuntu yeguriwe Uhoraho ngo yicwe, ntaze acungurwe; aze yicwe.
Ikigiracumi c’ibintu vyose biva mu mirima, vyaba ivyo mu kuzimu canke ivyama ku biti, ni ic’ Uhoraho ; kandi ni icera k’ Uhoraho .
Umuntu niyacungura na kimwe mu bigiracumi, aze yongereko ica gatanu c’igiciro caco.
Ikigiracumi gikwiye co mu masho no mu mikuku, ni ukuvuga ikigiracumi mu vyo umwungere aharuye biciye musi y’inkoni yiwe, kizoba ari icera k’ Uhoraho .
Ntaze atoranyemwo nziza muri mbi canke ngo agire iyo asubiriza iyindi. Niyagira iyo asubiriza, iyasubirijwe n’iyayisubiriye zose zizoba ari izera kandi ntizize zicungurwe.’ "
Ayo ni yo mategeko Uhoraho yahaye Mose ku musozi Sinayi ngo ayashikirize Abisirayeli.

name: Guharura
chapters: Uhoraho avugana na Mose ari mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro mu bugaragwa bw’i Sinayi ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa kabiri, mu mwaka ugira kabiri Abisirayeli bavuye muri Egiputa, amubwira ati:
"Harura Abisirayeli bose ukurikije imiryango yabo n’inzu zabo, ushire ku rutonde amazina y’ingabo kandi uharure umwumwe.
Mwe na Aroni muze muharure abagabo bose b’Abisirayeli bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri canke irenga, bashobora kuja ku rugamba, mubashire mu migwi yabo.
Umugabo aserukira umuryango akaba n’umukuru wawo azobafashe muri ico gikorwa.
Aya ni yo mazina y’abazogufasha: mu muryango wa Reyubeni, ni Elisuri mwene Shedewuri;
mu muryango wa Simeyoni, ni Shelumiyeli mwene Zurishadayi;
mu muryango wa Yuda, ni Nahashoni mwene Aminadabu;
mu muryango wa Isakari, ni Netaneli mwene Zuwari;
mu muryango wa Zebuloni, ni Eliyabu mwene Heloni;
muri bene Yosefu: mu muryango wa Efurayimu, ni Elishama mwene Amihudi; mu muryango wa Manase, ni Gamaliyeli mwene Pedasuri;
mu muryango wa Benyamini, ni Abidani mwene Gidiyoni;
mu muryango wa Dani, ni Ahiyezeri mwene Amishadayi;
mu muryango wa Asheri, ni Pagiyeli mwene Okurani;
mu muryango wa Gadi, ni Eliyasafu mwene Dewuyeli;
mu muryango wa Nafutali, ni Ahira mwene Enani."
Abo ni bo batowe mw’ihanga ryose, bakaba bari abakuru b’imiryango ya ba sekuruza babo. Ni bo kandi bari abakuru b’amazu y’imiryango ya Isirayeli.
Nuko Mose na Aroni begeranya abo bantu batowe,

baca batumako ikoraniro ry’ihanga ryose ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa kabiri. Abantu bariyandikisha bakurikije amazu yabo n’imiryango yabo, hanyuma abagabo bakwije imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga barandikwa, umwumwe wese ku rutonde rw’amazina,
nk’uko Uhoraho yari yategetse Mose. Yabaharuriye mu bugaragwa bw’i Sinayi.

Mu bakomoka kuri Reyubeni imfura ya Isirayeli: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Reyubeni cari ibihumbi mirongo ine na bitandatu n’amajana atanu.

Mu bakomoka kuri Simeyoni: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Simeyoni cari ibihumbi mirongo itanu n’icenda n’amajana atatu.

Mu bakomoka kuri Gadi: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Gadi cari ibihumbi mirongo ine na bitanu n’amajana atandatu na mirongo itanu.

Mu bakomoka kuri Yuda: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Yuda cari ibihumbi mirongo indwi na bine n’amajana atandatu.

Mu bakomoka kuri Isakari: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Isakari cari ibihumbi mirongo itanu na bine n’amajana ane.

Mu bakomoka kuri Zebuloni: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Zebuloni cari ibihumbi mirongo itanu n’indwi n’amajana ane.

Abo mu bahungu ba Yosefu: Mu bakomoka kuri Efurayimu, Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Efurayimu cari ibihumbi mirongo ine n’amajana atanu.

Mu bakomoka kuri Manase, Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwe umwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Manase cari ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bibiri n’amajana abiri.

Mu bakomoka kuri Benyamini: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwe umwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Benyamini cari ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bitanu n’amajana ane.

Mu bakomoka kuri Dani: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Dani cari ibihumbi mirongo itandatu na bibiri n’amajana indwi.

Mu bakomoka kuri Asheri: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Asheri cari ibihumbi mirongo ine na kimwe n’amajana atanu.

Mu bakomoka kuri Nafutali: Abagabo bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba barandikwa, amazina y’umwumwe wese ashirwa ku rutonde, hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri c’abakomoka kuri Nafutali cari ibihumbi mirongo itanu na bitatu n’amajana ane.
Abo ni bo bagabo baharuwe na Mose na Aroni na ba bakuru icumi na babiri batowe mu Bisirayeli, umwe wese aserukira umuryango na ba sekuruza akomokako.
Abisirayeli bose bari bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga bashobora kuja ku rugamba baraharuwe hakurikijwe amazu ya ba sekuruza n’imiryango yabo.
Igitigiri cabo bose hamwe cari ibihumbi amajana atandatu na bitatu n’amajana atanu na mirongo itanu.
Ariko abakomoka kuri Lewi ntibaharuwe hamwe n’abandi.
Uhoraho yari yarabariye Mose ati:
"Ntimuze muharure abakomoka kuri Lewi canke ngo mubashire hamwe n’abandi mu guharura Abisirayeli.

Ariko, Abalewi uzobazeze igikorwa co kwitaho ivyo mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro, bazezwe ibikoresho vyaho hamwe n’ibintu vyose biri muri ryo. Ni bo bazoterura ihema n’ibikoresho vyaryo vyose; baze baryitwararike kandi bacumbike barikikuje.
Igihe cose bizoba bikenewe ko ihema ryimurwa, Abalewi baze bazobe ari bo barizinga, na ho bikenewe ko rishingwa, Abalewi bazobe ari bo barishinga. Uwundi muntu wese azoryegera aze yicwe.
Abisirayeli baze bashinge amahema yabo mu migwi, umuntu wese azobe mu muce agenewe, abe musi y’ibendera ryabo.
Ariko Abalewi bo baze bashinge amahema yabo bakikuje iryo hema ry’isezerano kugira ngo simpave ndakira Abisirayeli. Abalewi ni bo bajejwe kwitaho ihema ry’isezerano."
Nuko Abisirayeli bakora vyose nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabitegetse Mose.
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni ati:
"Abisirayeli baze bacumbike bakikuje Ihema ry’Ibonaniro ariko bataryegereye cane, umuntu wese azobe musi y’ibendera ry’umuryango wiwe no musi y’ibendera ry’inzu yiwe."
Mu buseruko hazobe hari: Abakomoka kuri Yuda bari musi y’ibendera ryabo. Umukuru wabo ni Nahashoni mwene Aminadabu.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo indwi na bine n’amajana atandatu.
Abakomoka kuri Isakari baze bakurikire. Umukuru wabo ni Netaneli mwene Zuwari.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo itanu na bine n’amajana ane.
Abakomoka kuri Zebuloni baze bakurikire. Umukuru wabo ni Eliyabu mwene Heloni.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo itanu n’indwi n’amajana ane.

Abagabo bose bazoba bari ku ruhande rwa Yuda, nk’uko imigwi yabo iri, ni ibihumbi ijana na mirongo umunani na bitandatu n’amajana ane. Abo ni bo bazoja imbere y’Abisirayeli. Ni bo bazofata inzira ubwa mbere.
Mu bumanuko hazoba hari: Abakomoka kuri Reyubeni, bari musi y’ibendera ryabo. Umukuru wabo ni Elisuri mwene Shedewuri.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo ine na bitandatu n’amajana atanu.
Abakomoka kuri Simeyoni baze bakurikire. Umukuru wabo ni Shelumiyeli mwene Zurishadayi.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo itanu n’icenda n’amajana atatu.
Abakomoka kuri Gadi baze bakurikire. Umukuru wabo ni Eliyasafu mwene Reyuweli
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo ine na bitanu n’amajana atandatu na mirongo itanu.
Abagabo bose bazoba bari ku ruhande rwa Reyubeni, nk’uko imigwi yabo iri, ni ibihumbi ijana na mirongo itanu na kimwe n’amajana ane na mirongo itanu. Ni bo bazofata inzira ubwa kabiri.

Hanyuma haze hakurikire ihema ry’ibonaniro n’abakomoka kuri Lewi, bagendere hagati y’iyindi migwi. Baze bakurikirane mu guhaguruka nk’uko bakurikirana mu gucumbika, umwe wese mu kibanza ciwe, kandi ari musi y’ibendera ryabo.
Mu burengero hazoba hari: Abakomoka kuri Efurayimu, bari musi y’ibendera ryabo. Umukuru wabo ni Elishama mwene Amihudi.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo ine n’amajana atanu.
Abakomoka kuri Manase baze bakurikire. Umukuru wabo ni Gamaliyeli mwene Pedasuri.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bibiri n’amajana abiri.
Abakomoka kuri Benyamini baze bakurikire. Umukuru wabo ni Abidani mwene Gidiyoni.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bitanu n’amajana ane.
Abagabo bose bazoba bari ku ruhande rwa Efurayimu, nk’uko imigwi yabo iri, ni ibihumbi ijana n’umunani n’ijana. Baze bafate inzira ubwa gatatu.
Mu buraruko hazoba hari: Abakomoka kuri Dani bari musi y’ibendera ryabo. Umukuru wabo ni Ahiyezeri mwene Amishadayi.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo itandatu na bibiri n’amajana indwi.
Abakomoka kuri Asheri baze bakurikire. Umukuru wabo ni Pagiyeli mwene Okurani.
Igitigiri c’umugwi wabo ni ibihumbi mirongo ine na kimwe n’amajana atanu.
Abakomoka kuri Nafutali baze bakurikire. Umukuru wabo ni Ahira mwene Enani.
Igitigiri c’umugwi w’abo ni ibihumbi mirongo itanu na bitatu n’amajana ane.
Abagabo bose bazoba bari ku ruhande rwa Dani ni ibihumbi ijana na mirongo itanu n’indwi n’amajana atandatu. Abo ni bo bazohaguruka ubwa nyuma.

Abo ni bo Bisirayeli, baharuwe hakurikijwe imiryango bakomokamwo. Abaharuwe bose mu mice y’igisoda cabo, nk’uko imigwi yabo iri, ni ibihumbi amajana atandatu na bitatu n’amajana atanu na mirongo itanu.
Ariko Abalewi bo, ntibaharuwe hamwe n’abandi Bisirayeli, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabitegetse Mose.

Nuko Abisirayeli bakora vyose nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabitegetse Mose. Bashinga amahema musi y’amabendera yabo, umwe wese mu nzu ya ba sekuruza no mu muryango wiwe, kandi ni muri urwo rutonde nyene bahaguruka bagafata inzira.
Uru ni rwo ruvyaro rwa Aroni n’urwa Mose igihe Uhoraho yavugana na Mose ku musozi Sinayi.
Amazina y’abahungu ba Aroni yari Nadabu, imfura yiwe, Abihu, Eliyazeri na Itamari.
Ayo ni yo mazina y’abahungu ba Aroni, abaherezi basizwe amavuta, barobanuriwe igikorwa c’ubuherezi.

Ariko Nadabu na Abihu bapfiriye imbere y’ Uhoraho igihe batanga ikimazi bakoresheje umuriro utemewe imbere yiwe mu bugaragwa bw’i Sinayi. Nta bahungu bari bafise; ni co catumye Eliyazeri na Itamari bonyene ari bo bakoze nk’abaherezi igihe se Aroni yari akiriho.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
"Zana abakomoka kuri Lewi imbere ya Aroni umuherezi kugira ngo bamufashe.
Baze bakore ibikorwa vyerekeye Ihema ry’Ibonaniro bakorera Aroni n’Abisirayeli bose.
Bazoba bajejwe gutunganya ibikoresho vyose vyo mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, bakorera Abisirayeli bose ivyashinzwe mu gukora ibikorwa vyabo vyo mw’Ihema.
Abo Balewi ubashikirize Aroni n’abahungu biwe; kuko ni bo bitanze mu Bisirayeli bose ngo babafashe ibikorwa.
Uze utoranye Aroni n’abahungu biwe ni bo bazokora nk’abaherezi; uwundi muntu wese azokwegera ihema aze yicwe."
Uhoraho yongera abarira Mose ati:
"Natoranije Abalewi mu bandi Bisirayeli ngo babe mu gishingo c’abahungu bose b’imfura bavyawe n’umugore wese w’Umwisirayelikazi. Abalewi ni abanje,
kuko abana bose b’imfura ari abanje. Igihe nica abana b’imfura bose bo muri Egiputa, naciye nitoraniriza imfura zose zo muri Isirayeli, imfura z’abantu n’iz’ibitungwa. Ni izanje; ndi Uhoraho ."
Uhoraho abarira Mose ari mu bugaragwa bw’i Sinayi ati:
"Harura Abalewi ukurikije imiryango yabo n’amazu ya ba sekuruza babo. Muze muharure umuhungu wese kuva ku wumaze ukwezi kumwe avutse no kuduga."
Nuko Mose arabaharura, nk’uko yategetswe n’ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .
Aya ni yo mazina y’abahungu ba Lewi: Gerishoni, Kohati na Merari.
Amazu akomoka kuri Gerishoni yitiriwe abahungu biwe babiri: Libuni na Shimeyi
Amazu akomoka kuri Kohati yitiriwe abahungu biwe bane: Amuramu, Izihari, Heburoni na Uziyeli.
Amazu akomoka kuri Merari yitiriwe abahungu biwe babiri: Mahuli na Mushi. Ayo ni yo yari amazu y’abakomoka kuri Lewi, hakurikijwe imiryango yabo.
Abakomoka kuri Gerishoni bari Abalibuni n’Abashimeyi; ayo ni yo yari amazu akomoka kuri Gerishoni.
Abahungu bamaze ukwezi bavutse n’abakurenza baharuwe bari ibihumbi indwi n’amajana atanu.
Abakomoka kuri Gerishoni bacumbika mu burengero, inyuma y’ihema.
Umukuru w’amazu akomoka kuri Gerishoni yari Eliyasafu mwene Layeli.
Mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro, Abagerishoni bari bashinzwe gutunganya ihema imbere n’inyuma, n’igipfutse ihema, n’igihuzu gikingiriye ku muryango w’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro,
ibihuzu bigize urugo, n’igihuzu co ku muryango w’irembo ry’urugo rukikuje ihema n’igicaniro, n’imigozi y’ihema, n’ibikoresho vyose bijanye n’ikoreshwa ryayo.
Imiryango iva kuri Kohati ni Abamurani, Abayizari, Abaheburoni n’Abawuziyeli; abo ni bo bari bagize imiryango y’Abakohati.
Igitigiri c’abahungu bamaze ukwezi n’ukurenga cari ibihumbi umunani n’amajana atandatu. Abakohati bari bajejwe gutunganya ahera.
Imiryango y’Abakohati bacumbika mu ruhande rwo mu bumanuko rw’ihema.
Umukuru w’amazu ya ba sekuruza y’imiryango y’Abakohati yari Elizafani mwene Uziyeli.
Bari bajejwe gutunganya Isandugu y’Isezerano, imeza, igiterekwako amatara, ibicaniro, ibikoresho vy’ahera bikoreshwa mu gikorwa caho, igihuzu gikingiriye ahera, n’ibindi vyose bijanye n’ivyo.
Umukuru yatwara bose mu Balewi yari Eliyazeri mwene Aroni, umuherezi. Yari ashinzwe kurongora abari bashinzwe gutunganya ahera.
Imiryango y’Abamahuli n’Abamushi bari Aba Merari; abo ni bo bari bagize imiryango y’Abamerari.
Igitigiri c’abahungu bamaze ukwezi n’ukurenga baharuwe cari ibihumbi bitandatu n’amajana abiri.
Umukuru w’amazu y’abo mu miryango y’Abamerari yari Zuriyeli mwene Abihayili; bategerezwa gucumbika mu ruhande rwo mu buraruko bw’ihema.
Abamerari bari bashinzwe gutunganya ibishimaryango vy’ihema, ibizingiti, inkingi, ivyo gushingamwo inkingi n’ibikoresho vyaryo vyose, n’ibijanye na vyo vyose n’ikoreshwa ryavyo,
n’inkingi z’urugo rukikuje ihema n’ivyo kuzishingamwo vyose, imambo n’imigozi vy’ihema.

Mose na Aroni n’abahungu babo bategerezwa gushinga amahema mu buseruko bw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, batumbereye iyo izuba riserukira, imbere y’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro. Bari bajejwe gutunganya ivy’Ihema mu gishingo c’abandi Bisirayeli. Uwundi wese yegera Ihema yategerezwa kwicwa.

Igitigiri cose c’Abalewi baharuwe na Mose na Aroni nk’uko Uhoraho yabitegetse hakurikijwe imiryango yabo, bagizwe n’abahungu bakwije ukwezi bavutse n’abakurenza, cari ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bibiri.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: "Harura imfura z’Abisirayeli zose z’abahungu bamaze ukwezi n’abakurenza ushire ku rutonde amazina yabo.
Uce wakira Abalewi ubanzanire mu gishingo c’imfura zose z’Abisirayeli, n’imfura z’ibitungwa vy’Abalewi mu gishingo c’imfura zose z’ibitungwa vy’Abisirayeli. Ndi Uhoraho ."
Nuko Mose aharura imfura zose z’Abisirayeli, nk’uko Uhoraho yabimutegetse.
Igitigiri cose c’imfura z’abahungu bamaze ukwezi kumwe n’abakurenza, bashizwe ku rutonde, cari ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bibiri n’amajana abiri na mirongo indwi na batatu.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
"Fata Abalewi mu gishingo c’imfura z’Abisirayeli, n’ibitungwa vy’Abalewi mu gishingo c’ibitungwa vy’Abisirayeli. Abalewi ni abanje. Ndi Uhoraho .
Mu gucungura abo bana b’imfura amajana abiri na mirongo indwi na batatu barenga ku gitigiri c’Abalewi,
uze wegeranye shekeli zitanu ku muntu umwe umwe, ukoresheje ingero shekeli y’Ahera, ipima ingero gera mirongo ibiri.
Uyatange kwa Aroni n’abahungu biwe kugira ngo ucungure abo Bisirayeli barengako."
Nuko Mose yegeranya ayo mahera y’incungu y’Abisirayeli barenga kuri ca gitigiri cacunguwe n’Abalewi.
Mu mfura z’Abisirayeli yegeranije ifeza zipima shekeli igihumbi n’amajana atatu na mirongo itandatu na zitanu , hakoreshejwe ingero shekeli y’Ahera.
Mose atanga ayo mahera y’incungu kwa Aroni n’abahungu biwe, nk’uko yari yabitegetswe n’ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni ati:
"Andika amazina y’abakomoka mu nzu kwa Kohati hamwe n’imiryango y’Abakohati bose bakomoka kuri Lewi.
Uharure abagabo bose bafise imyaka mirongo itatu gushika kuri mirongo itanu bashobora gukora ibikorwa mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro.
Iki ni co gikorwa c’Abakohati mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro: ni ugutunganya ibintu vyeguriwe Uhoraho kuruta ibindi.
Igihe Abisirayeli bazoba bagomba kuva aho bazoba bacumbitse, Aroni n’abahungu biwe baze binjire bamanure ca gihuzu gikingiriye ahera bagipfukishe ya Isandugu y’Isezerano.
Hanyuma baze barenzeko igipfukisho gikozwe mu rusato, bongereko igitambara gikozwe mu bwoya bw’intama c’ubururu bace bashirako vya biti vyo guterura iyo sandugu.

Hanyuma, baze basanze igitambara c’ubururu ku meza aho bahora bashira imikate yejejwe, bace bashiraho imibehe, amasahani n’ibikombe, n’ibikoresho vyo gutanga ishikanwa ry’ibinyobwa; ya mikate yama kuri iyo meza ize igumeko.
Hejuru y’ivyo, baze basanzeko igitambara gitukura, barenzeko impuzu ikozwe mu rusato bace bashirako vya biti vyo guterura iyo meza.
Hanyuma, baze bafate igitambara c’ubururu bagipfukishe igiterekwako amatara n’amatara yaco, ivyo kuduza intambi n’ibijako umunyota, n’ibijamwo amavuta yo gusukwa mu matara.
Bazoce bakizingira mu mpuzu ikozwe mu rusato hamwe n’ibikoresho bijanye na co babitereke ku nderuzo yaco.
Hanyuma, baze bapfukishe ca gicaniro c’inzahabu igitambara c’ubururu barenzeko impuzu ikozwe mu rusato bace bashirako vya biti vyo kugiterura.
Bazoheze bafate ibindi bikoresho vyose bikoreshwa imbere mw’ihema, babizingire mu mpuzu y’ubururu, barenzeko impuzu y’urusato bace babishira ku nderuzo yavyo.
Baze bakure iminyota kuri ca gicaniro c’umwakaka, hanyuma bagipfuke impuzu itukura.

Bazoce bagishirako ibikoresho bikoreshwa mu bikorwa vyo ku gicaniro, harimwo ivyotezo, amakanya yo guterura inyama, amapanu n’ibikoresho vyo kumijagira amaraso. Baze bagipfukishe impuzu ikozwe mu rusato bace bashiramwo vya biti vyo kugiterura.

Aroni n’abahungu biwe nibaheza gupfuka ibikoresho vyose vyejejwe, abantu na bo bakaba biteguye kugenda bava aho bahora bacumbitse, Abakohati bazoce baza guterura ivyo bikoresho vyose. Ariko ntibaze bakore kuri vya bikoresho vyejejwe kuko bohava bapfa. Abakohati baze baterure vya bikoresho biri mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro.

Eliyazeri mwene Aroni, umuherezi, azoba ajejwe kuraba amavuta yo mu matara, ivyo guturirwa bimota neza, amashikanwa y’ifu atangwa imisi yose n’amavuta yo kurobanura. Azoba ajejwe ahera hose n’ibintu vyose biri ngaho, harimwo n’ibikoresho vyose vy’ahera."
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni ati:
"Muze mwiyubare kugira ngo inzu y’Abakohati ntize izimangane mu Balewi.

Kugira ngo ntibaze bapfe igihe bazoba begereye ibintu vyera, ng’ibi ivyo mukwiye kubakorera: Aroni n’abahungu biwe baze baje mw’ihema kugira ngo umuntu wese bamwereke igikorwa akwiye gukora canke akwiye guterura.
Ariko Abakohati ntibaze binjire mw’ihema ngo barabe ivyera, naho hoba akanya gatoya, kuko boca bapfa."
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
"Andika amazina y’abakomoka mu nzu kwa Gerishoni hamwe n’imiryango y’Abagerishoni bose bakomoka kuri Lewi.
Uharure abagabo bose bamaze imyaka mirongo itatu gushika kuri mirongo itanu baza gukora mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro.
Ibi ni vyo bikorwa vy’imiryango y’Abagerishoni:
Bazoba bajejwe guterura ibihuzu bikingira ahera n’ivyo mw’ihema ry’ibonaniro, n’ico gupfuka ahera hamwe n’ibipfuka hanze bikozwe mu nsato, n’ibihuzu bikingira ku muryango w’ihema ry’ibonaniro,
ibihuzu bikingira bigize urugo rw’ihema n’igicaniro, igihuzu gikingiriye irembo, imigozi n’ibindi bikoresho bijanye bigize urwo rugo. Abagerishoni baze bakore ibikeneye gukorwa vyo kuri ivyo bintu.
Aroni n’abahungu biwe baze bereke Abagerishoni ibikorwa vyose bajejwe vyaba ivyo bakora canke ivyo baterura.
