Abantu bo mu muryango wa Efurayimu bakoranya ingabo zabo, bajabuka Yorodani baja i Zafoni, babarira Yefuta bati: "Ni kubera iki wagiye kugwanya Abamoni utaduhamagaye ngo tujane? Tugira tuguturirane n’inzu yawe."
Yefuta arishura ati: "Jewe n’abantu banje twari mu ngorane zikomeye n’Abamoni, kandi igihe nabahamagara, ntimwigeze muza kuntabara mu maboko yabo.
Mbonye mutaje kuntabara naciye nibako nja kubagwanya tutari kumwe, kandi Uhoraho yampaye intsinzi ku Bamoni. None ubu ni igiki gitumye muza kungwanya?"

Yefuta aca akoranya abantu b’i Gileyadi kugira ngo bagwanye aba Efurayimu. Abanyagileyadi barabatera, barabanesha, barabica kuko aba Efurayimu bari bavuze bati: "Mwebwe Abanyagileyadi muri abahunze bava mu turere twa Efurayimu na Manase."

Abanyagileyadi bafata ivyambu vyo kuri Yorodani bija muri Efurayimu. Uwucitse kw’icumu mu bo kwa Efurayimu avuze ati: "Nimundeke ndengane," Abanyagileyadi bakamubaza bati: "Uri uwo mu Befurayimu?" Akishura ati: "Oya,"

baca bamubwira bati: "Subiramwo uti ‘Shiboleti.’ " Ari Umwefurayimu yaca avuga ati: "Siboleti," kuko Abefurayimu batashobora kuvuga neza iryo jambo. Baca bamufata bakamwicira kw’ijabukiro rya Yorodani. Ico gihe hishwe abantu bangana n’ibihumbi mirongo ine na bibiri vy’Abefurayimu.
Yefuta aca amara imyaka itandatu arongora Abisirayeli. Maze Yefuta Umunyagileyadi apfuye, ahambwa mu gisagara ca Gileyadi.
Inyuma ya Yefuta haza Ibuzani w’i Betelehemu, arongora Abisirayeli.

Yari afise abahungu mirongo itatu n’abakobwa mirongo itatu nyene. Abakobwa biwe barongowe mu yindi miryango, maze na we azana abandi bakobwa mirongo itatu bavuye mu yindi miryango, barongorwa n’abahungu biwe. Ibuzani arongora Abisirayeli imyaka indwi.
Hanyuma arapfa, ahambwa i Betelehemu.
Inyuma yiwe haje Eloni yava mu muryango wa Zebuloni, arongora Abisirayeli imyaka icumi.
Hanyuma arapfa, ahambwa muri Ayijaloni mu ntara ya Zebuloni.
Eloni amaze gupfa, haje Abudoni mwene Hileli, yava i Piratoni, arongora Abisirayeli.
Yari afise abahungu mirongo ine, n’abuzukuru b’abahungu mirongo itatu, bari bafise indogoba mirongo indwi bagenderako. Yarongoye Abisirayeli imyaka umunani.
Apfuye, yahambwe i Piratoni mu ntara ya Efurayimu, mu misozi y’Abamaleki.
Abisirayeli basubira gukora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu maso yiwe, maze Uhoraho abarekurira mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya, babacunaguza imyaka mirongo ine.
Hariho umugabo yaba i Zora yitwa Manowa, yava mu muryango wa Dani, yari afise umugore w’ingumba, babaho ata mwana bafise.
Umumarayika w’ Uhoraho abonekera uwo mugore, amubwira ati: "Naho uri ingumba ata mwana ufise, ugiye gusama inda, uvyare umwana w’umuhungu.
Nuko rero wirinde, ntihagire umuvinyu canke ikiboreza, canke ico kurya gihumanye kizokugera ku munwa.

Uzotwara inda uvyare umwana w’umuhungu. Ntihagire urwembe ruzomugera ku mutwe. Kuko uwo muhungu azokwegurirwa Imana nk’Umunaziri kuva akivuka. Ni we azotangura igikorwa co kurokora Abisirayeli mu minwe y’Abafilisitiya."

Wa mugore aca arirukanga, abwira umugabo wiwe ati: "Hari umuntu w’Imana yaje aho ndi. Yasa n’umumarayika w’ Uhoraho , yari ateye ubwoba kuraba. Sinamubajije iyo aje ava, kandi ntiyambwiye izina ryiwe.

Ariko yambwiye ati: ‘Uzotwara inda, uvyare umwana w’umuhungu. Ntihazogire umuvinyu canke ikiboreza uzonywa, kandi ntihazogire ikintu gihumanye uzorya, kuko uwo muhungu azoba Umunaziri w’Imana kuva akivuka gushika apfe.’ "
Maze Manowa aca asenga Uhoraho avuga ati: "Ndakwinginze Uhoraho, uturungikire uwo muntu w’Imana watumye, agaruke atwigishe ingene dukwiye kurera uwo mwana agiye kuvuka."
Imana yumva isengesho rya Manowa, wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho asubira kwiyereka wa mugore ari mu mirima, ariko Manowa umugabo wiwe ntibari kumwe.
Wa mugore aca arirukanga abwira umugabo wiwe ati: "Wa muntu yanyiyereka wa musi yagarutse!"
Manowa aca arahaguruka akurikira umugore wiwe. Bashikiriye wa muntu, Manowa aramubaza ati: "Ni wewe uvuganye n’umugore wanje?" Na we yishura ati: "Ni jewe nyene!"
Manowa aca amubaza ati: "Ivyo wavuze nivyashika, mbega amategeko azogenga uwo mwana ku bw’ubuzima bwiwe n’ivyo azokora azoba ameze gute?"
Wa mumarayika amwishura ati: "Umugore wawe aze akore ivyo namubwiye vyose.
Ntaze arye inzabibu, canke ngo anywe umuvinyu canke ikindi cose kiboreza, canke ngo arye ikintu na kimwe gihumanye. Hanyuma azokurikize ivyo namubariye vyose."
Manowa aca abarira uwo mumarayika w’ Uhoraho ati: "Turakwinginze ugume ngaha tugutegurire ishashi y’impene ufungure."

Wa mumarayika aramwishura ati: "Naho mwongumiza ngaha, sinobarira igifungurwa na kimwe. Ariko murashobora gutegura ikimazi co guturirwa, mukagihereza Uhoraho ." (Manowa ntiyari yamenye ko ari umumarayika w’ Uhoraho .)
Nuko Manowa abaza uwo mumarayika w’ Uhoraho ati: "Izina ryawe ni nde kugira ngo tuzokwibuke ivyo wavuze nivyashika?"
Na we arishura ati: "Ni kubera iki ugomba kumenya izina ryanje? Ni izina rirengeye ugutahura kwawe."
Manowa aca afata umwagazi w’impene hamwe n’ishikanwa ry’ifu, abishikanira Uhoraho ku gitandara. Uhoraho aca akora igitangaza Manowa n’umugore wiwe babona:
Imbeya ziriko zirarabagirana ziduga mu kirere, wa mumarayika aca aduga muri izo mbeya. Manowa n’umugore wiwe babibonye, baca bakubita amavi hasi barunama.
Uwo mumarayika w’ Uhoraho ntiyabaye agisubira kwiyereka Manowa n’umugore wiwe, Manowa aca aratahura ko yari umumarayika w’ Uhoraho .
Aca abarira umugore wiwe ati: "Nta kabuza turapfuye, kuko twabonye Imana."

Ariko umugore wiwe aramubwira ati: "Iyo Uhoraho agomba kutwica, ntiyari kutwakirira ikimazi gituriwe n’ishikanwa ry’ifu twamuhereje, canke ngo atwereke ivyo twabonye, ntiyari no kutubwira ivyo yatubwiye."
Haheze igihe, uwo mugore avyara umwana w’umuhungu, amwita Samusoni. Arakura, kandi umuhezagiro w’ Uhoraho uba kuri we,
Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho atangura gukorera muri we ari i Mahane Dani, hagati y’ibisagara vya Zora na Eshitayoli.
Umusi umwe, Samusoni amanuka i Timuna, abona umwigeme w’Umufilisitiya, aramwipfuza.
Agarutse i muhira, abwira se na nyina ati: "Nashimye umukobwa w’Umufilisitiya i Timuna, muramunsabira, nipfuza ko twubakana ambere umugore."

Se na nyina bamwishura bati: "Mbega nta mukobwa n’umwe wo mu miryango ya Isirayeli yoshobora kuba umugore wawe, aho urongora uwo mu ntakebwa z’Abafilisitiya?" Ariko Samusoni abarira se ati: "Genda umunsabire, kuko ni we numva nashimye."
Se na nyina ntibari bazi ko ivyo vyari bivuye k’ Uhoraho kugira ngo haboneke akaryo ko kugwanya Abafilisitiya bari baganje Abisirayeli ico gihe.
Samusoni n’abavyeyi biwe bariko baramanuka bashika ku ruzabibu rw’i Timuna, intambwe itera Samusoni itontoma.
Ako kanya Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho amuzako n’ubushobozi bwinshi, aca ayitabaguza intoke nk’uko yotabagura umwagazi w’impene. Ariko ivyo ntiyigeze abibwira se na nyina.
Nuko Samusoni aramanuka i Timuna, avugana na wa mugore aca aramukunda cane.
Haheze igihe, ari mu nzira asubira i Timuna kugira ngo bagire ubugeni, akebereza gato hirya y’inzira kugira ngo arabe igikankara ca ya ntambwe, asanga cuzuyemwo inzuki nyinshi n’ubuki.
Aca abuhakuza amaboko agenda araburya. Ashikiriye abavyeyi biwe arabahako na bo bararya. Ariko ntiyigeze ababwira ko yabukuye mu magufa y’iyo ntambwe.
Mu gihe se wa Samusoni yari yagiye gutunganya ibisigaye ku bw’ubukwe, Samusoni yagize umusi mukuru i Timuna, nk’uko vyaba mu migenzo y’abasore.
Abavyeyi b’umugeni bamubonye, bamutoraniriza imisore mirongo itatu ngo ibe abagendanyi biwe.

Samusoni arababwira ati: "Reka ndabahe igisokozo. Nimwashobora kumpa inyishu mu misi indwi tuzomara turi mu misi mikuru, nzobaha imitamana mirongo itatu yera cane, hamwe n’imyambaro y’impuzu mirongo itatu.
Ariko namwe nimutagitora muzompa imitamana mirongo itatu yera cane, hamwe n’imyambaro y’impuzu mirongo itatu." Na bo baramubwira bati: "Tubwire ico gisokozo."
Arababwira ati: "Mu muryi havuyemwo ivyokurya, mu munyenkomezi havuyemwo ibisosa." Inyuma y’imisi itatu ntibari bwaronke inyishu.

Ku musi ugira kane, babwira umugore wa Samusoni bati: "Hendahenda umugabo wawe agusigurire igisokozo yaduhaye, ahandi ho turaguturirana n’inzu ya so. Mwaduhamagariye ngaha kugira ngo mudusahure utwacu?"

Maze umugore wa Samusoni amugwako arira, avuga ati: "Urambesha ntunkunda, ahubwo uranyanka. Ni kubera iki ab’iwacu wabahaye igisokozo hanyuma ntiwambarira inyishu?" Na we aramwishura ati: "Na data na mama nta co nabasiguriye, wewe nari kukigusigurira kubera iki?"

Wa mugore aca yama arira igihe cose yaba ari kumwe na Samusoni muri iyo misi mikuru. Ariko ku musi ugira indwi, Samusoni abarira umugore wiwe inyishu, kuko yama ariko aramuririra i ruhande. Na we aca aja kubwira iyo nyishu ba basore.

Ku musi ugira indwi, imbere y’uko izuba rirenga, ba bantu baza aho Samusoni ari, bamubwira bati: "Mbega ni igiki gisosa gusumvya ubuki? Ni igiki gikomeye gusumvya intambwe?" Samusoni arababwira ati: "Iyo mutarimisha ishashi yanje ntimwari kumenya igisokozo canje."

Maze Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho amuzako mu nkomezi nyinshi. Aca aja mu gisagara ca Ashikeloni, ahica abagabo mirongo itatu, abambura ivyabo, impuzu zabo aziha bamwe basigura ca gisokozo. Ariko Samusoni ababazwa cane n’ivyabaye, hanyuma asubira i muhira, abana na se na nyina.
Umugore wa Samusoni aca arongorwa n’umwe mu bagendaniye Samusoni mu misi mikuru yiwe.

Inyuma y’aho, hari mw’iyimbura ry’ingano, Samusoni afata umwagazi w’impene, awushira umugore wiwe nk’akaganuke. Avuga ati: "Ndagiye mu cumba c’umugore wanje turyamane." Ariko se w’umukobwa aramwankira.
Amubwira ati: "Erega nagira ngo waramwanse. Ni co catumye ndamuha wa mugendanyi wawe wa mbere. Ariko ehe raba, murumunawe ni we mwiza kumurusha. Nabe ari we urongora."
Samusoni ababwira ati: "Ubu rero ndaronse imvo yo gukorera Abafilisitiya ico nshaka. Nzobagirira nabi."
Nuko aca arasohoka afata imbwebwe amajana atatu, azibohanya imirizo zibirizibiri, kuri iyo mirizo ibohanye akaja araboherako ibimuri.
Vya bimuri abidometse agaca azirungika mu mirima y’ingano y’Abafilisitiya. Aturira izo batekeye mu mikama hamwe n’izari zikiri mu mirima, aturira n’inzabibu hamwe n’imyelayo.

Abafilisitiya barabaza bati: "Ni nde yakoze ibi?" Bishura bati: "Ni Samusoni, umukwe w’umuntu w’i Timuna, kuko umugore wiwe yahawe umugendanyi wiwe." Nuko Abafilisitiya baca baraduga bafata wa mugore bamuturirana na se.
Samusoni aca ababwira ati: "Ko mukoze ivyo, sinzogenda ntabihoye!"
Aca atera Abafilisitiya n’uburake bwinshi, yica benshi muri bo. Hanyuma aca amanuka mu bitandara vy’amabuye vy’i Etamu, abayo.
Abafilisitiya baca baraduga bashinga amahema yabo i Buyuda, amahema yabo yashika hafi y’igisagara ca Lehi.
Abantu b’i Buyuda barababaza bati: "Ni igiki gitumye muza kutugwanya?" Bishura bati: "Twaje gufata Samusoni tumugire imbohe, tumugirire nk’ivyo yatugiriye."

Maze abantu ibihumbi bitatu bo mu Bayuda baca bamanuka kw’isenga ryo ku gitandara c’i Etamu, babwira Samusoni bati: "Mbega ntuzi ko Abafilisitiya ari bo batware bacu? Wabakoreye iki?" Abishura ati: "Nabakoreye ivyo na bo bankoreye."
Na bo baramubwira bati: "Tuje kukuboha tugutange ku Bafilisitiya." Samusoni arababwira ati: "Nimundahire ko mutanyica mwebwe nyene."
Na bo bati: "Turakurahiye. Turakuboha gusa tugutange ku Bafilisitiya. Ntitukwica." Baca bamubohesha ibiziriko bibiri bishasha, bamukura muri iryo senga.
Yegereye i Lehi, Abafilisitiya baca baza biha akamo k’intsinzi. Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho amuzako mu bushobozi bwinshi, acagagura vya biziriko nk’utunyuzi duhuye n’umuriro, birakoroka bimuva ku maboko.
Samusoni aravye ku ruhande abona igufa ry’umubangabanga w’indogoba, araritora, aryicisha Abafilisitiya igihumbi.
Samusoni aravuga ati: "Umubangabanga w’indogoba ndawurundishije ikirundo. Umubangabanga w’indogoba nawicishe abantu igihumbi."
Ahejeje kuvuga ivyo aca ashibura wa mubangabanga, aho hantu haca hitwa Ramati-Lehi risigura ngo "agasozi k’umubangabanga".
Kubera yari anyotewe cane, arasemerera asaba Uhoraho avuga ati: "Uhaye intsinzi ihambaye umusavyi wawe. None urandetse ngo nicwe n’inyota, ngwe mu maboko y’izi ntakebwa?"

Maze Imana isatura ahantu hari ikinogo i Lehi, ituma haza amazi, Samusoni aranywa, asubira kugira inkomezi. Iryo riba rica ryitwa Eni-Hakore, bisigura "Iriba ry’Uwasemereye" kandi riracariho i Lehi gushika n’ubu.
Samusoni yarongoye Abisirayeli imyaka mirongo ibiri igihe bari bagitwarwa n’Abafilisitiya.
Umusi umwe Samusoni aja i Gaza, ahura na maraya, aca aja kurarana na we.
Abantu b’i Gaza baramenya ko Samusoni ari ho ari, baca barakorana barara bamurindiririye ijoro ryose ku muryango w’igisagara bibwira bati: "Ejo nibwaca, tuzomwica."

Ariko Samusoni wewe aryamayo gushika ijoro rigeze hagati gusa. Araheza aravyuka arandura umuryango w’ico gisagara, awurandurana n’ibihindizo hamwe n’ibizingiti vyawo. Avyiremeka ku rutugu, abidugana ku mutumba urabana na Heburoni.
Haheze imisi akunda umukobwa wo mu kiyaya ca Soreki, yitwa Delila.

Abatware b’Abafilisitiya baja kuraba Delila bamubwira bati: "Uzohendahende Samusoni akubwire aho akura inkomezi, akubwire n’ukuntu twomunesha kugira ngo tumubohe, tumumare amanyama. Umwe wese muri twebwe azoguha shekeli igihumbi n’ijana z’ifeza."
Nuko Delila abaza Samusoni ati: "Ndakwinginze umbarire aho ukura izo nkomezi hamwe n’ukuntu umuntu yokuboha akakumara amanyama."
Samusoni aramwishura ati: "Umuntu ambohesheje imigozi indwi ikiri mibisi, nca mba umunyantegenke nk’abandi bose."
Nuko abatware b’Abafilisitiya bamuzanira imigozi indwi ikiri mibisi, arayimubohesha.

Yari yanyegeje abagabo mu cumba co haruguru c’iyo nzu, aca arasemerera ati: "Samusoni! Abafilisitiya baraje kugufata." Samusoni aca avutagura ya migozi nk’uko inyuzi zicika zifashwe n’umuriro. Nuko inkomezi ziwe ntizamenyekana aho ziva.
Delila abwira Samusoni ati: "Ni kuki umpenda ukambwira ibinyoma? Mbwira neza rero ingene umuntu yokuboha akakugumya."
Aramubwira ati: "Umuntu ambohesheje ibiziriko bishasha bitarakoreshwa, noca mba umunyantegenke nk’abandi bose."

Nuko Delila aca afata ibiziriko bishasha arabimubohesha. Ba bantu bari binyegeje muri ca cumba nka kumwe kwa mbere. Delila aca arasemerera ati: "Samusoni! Ngaho Abafilisitiya baraje kugufata." Samusoni acagagura vya biziriko nk’uwucagagura inyuzi.

Delila aca abwira Samusoni ati: "Wahereye kera umpenda. Mbwira rero ingene umuntu yokuboha." Samusoni aramubwira ati: "Ibitsibo indwi vy’umushatsi wanje ubifatanije n’igitambara c’impuzu, hanyuma ukabibohera ku giti noca mba umunyantegenke nk’abandi bose." Nuko Delila ahengera Samusoni asinziriye, afata vya bitsibo indwi vy’umushatsi wiwe abifatanisha igitambara c’impuzu.
Nuko arabijisha, abigumisha urumambo, aca asubira gusemerera ati: "Samusoni! Ngaho Abafilisitiya baraje kugufata!" Aca arazanzamuka ava mw’itiro, ashingura rwa rumambo hamwe n’ikijishirwako impuzu.
Delila aravuga ati: "Uvuga gute ngo urankunda, udashobora kumbwira amabanga yawe? Ubu bubaye ubwa gatatu umpenda, utambwira aho ukura inkomezi zawe."
Maze akomeza kumuzigiriza uko bukeye uko bwije, gushika aho amubuza amahoro.

Ni ko kumubwira vyose ati: "Nta rwembe rurangera ku mutwe, kuko namye ndi Umunaziri w’Imana kuva nkivuka. Uwomwa uwu mushatsi, inkomezi zanje zose zoca zimvako, noca mba umunyantegenke nk’abandi bose."

Delila abonye ko amubwiye vyose, aca atuma intumwa kuri ba batware b’Abafilisitiya, ababwira ati: "Nimusubire mugaruke, kuko ubu yambwiye vyose." Ba batware baca baragaruka bazanye na za feza mu minwe.
Nuko Delila amusinziririza ku bibero vyiwe, aca ahamagara umuntu amumwa vya bitsibo indwi vy’umushatsi wiwe, gutyo aba amuhinduye umunyantegenke. Inkomezi zica ziramuvako.
Aca aramuhamagara ati: "Samusoni, ngaho Abafilisitiya baraje kugufata!" Aca arakanguka ava mw’itiro, yibwira ko abakira nk’ubwa mbere. Ariko ntiyari azi ko Uhoraho yamuretse.
Abafilisitiya baca baramufata, bamunogora amaso, bamumanukana i Gaza, bamubohesha umunyororo w’umwakaka, bamugira umusyi wo mw’ibohero.
Ariko umushatsi wiwe uca urasubira kumera inyuma yo kumumwa.

Umusi umwe abatware b’Abafilisitiya bakoranira hamwe ngo bashikanire ibimazi Dagoni imana yabo, bongere bagire umusi mukuru, kuko bagira bati: "Imana yacu yarekuriye Samusoni, umwansi wacu, mu maboko yacu."
Abantu bose bamubonye bashima imana yabo bavuga bati: "Imana yacu ni yo yarekuriye umwansi wacu mu maboko yacu, uwatikije imirima yacu, akica benshi muri twebwe."

Mu gihe abo bantu basa n’ababorewe, baca bavuga bati: "Nimukure Samusoni mw’ibohero abe aradutwenza." Nuko bahamagara Samusoni ava mw’ibohero ngo abe arabatwenza. Nuko bamuhagarika hagati y’inkingi zibiri zari zifashe igisenge.
Samusoni abwira uwari amufashe ukuboko ati: "Nshira aho nshobora kwumva inkingi zibiri zifashe iyi ngoro, kugira ngo ndazegamire."
Iyo nzu yari yuzuyemwo abagabo n’abagore, kandi n’abatware b’Abafilisitiya bose bari aho. Mu bibanza vyo hejuru hariyo abantu ibihumbi bitatu bariko bararaba ivyo Samusoni agira.
Maze Samusoni asenga Uhoraho avuga ati: "Ewe Uhoraho , Nyeninganji, ndakwinginze unyibuke. Mana, ndakwinginze umpe inkomezi iri rimwe gusa, kugira ngo nihore Abafilisitiya ku maso yanje abiri."
Maze Samusoni aramvurira amaboko yiwe kuri za nkingi zibiri iyo nzu yari ihagazeko. Azisunikisha amaboko yose,

asenga ati: "Ndeka mpfane n’Abafilisitiya." Asunika za nkingi n’inguvu nyinshi, iyo nzu isenyukira kuri ba batware n’abandi bose bari muri yo. Aho hantu yahiciye abantu baruta kure abo yishe mu yindi misi yose yabayeho.

Hanyuma abo bavukana hamwe n’umuryango wiwe wose baca baramanuka gutora ikiziga ciwe. Bamutahana iwabo, bamuhamba hagati y’i Zora n’i Eshitayoli, aho se wiwe Manowa yahambwe. Samusoni yatwaye Abisirayeli imyaka mirongo ibiri.
Hariho umugabo yitwa Mika yava mu karere k’imisozi ya Efurayimu.
Umusi umwe abarira nyina wiwe ati: "Narumvise uvuma uwakwivye shekeli igihumbi n’ijana z’ifeza. Ni jewe nazivye, ni jewe ndazifise." Nyina amwishura ati: " Uhoraho aguhezagire, mwana wanje."

Amugarukaniye za shekeli igihumbi n’ijana z’ifeza, nyina aca avuga ati: "Izi feza ndazeguriye Uhoraho ku bw’umuhungu wanje kugira ngo zikorwemwo igishushanyo n’ikigirwamana cometseko ifeza. Nzoheza ndabiguhe bibe ivyawe."
Mika aca asubiza ya mahera nyina wiwe, na we aca akuramwo shekeli amajana abiri aziha umucuzi, na we azicuramwo igishushanyo n’ikigirwamana, baca babishira mu nzu kwa Mika.
Mika yari afise akazu asengeramwo, aca akoresha efodi n’ibindi bishushanyo, agena n’umuhungu wiwe ngo abe umuherezi wiwe.
Muri ico gihe Abisirayeli nta mwami bari bafise, umuntu wese yakora ibintu uko avyumva.
Umusi umwe haza umusore w’Umulewi avuye i Betelehemu i Buyuda, yabaye mu muryango wa Yuda,
ava i Betelehemu arondera aho yoba. Ari ku rugendo ni ho yashika kwa Mika, mu ntara y’imitumba mu gihugu ca Efurayimu.
Mika aramubaza ati: "Uva he?" Aramwishura ati: "Ndi Umulewi w’i Betelehemu i Buyuda. Ndiko ndondera aho noba."
Mika aramubwira ati: "Bana natwe, ube umuherezi wa data, nzoguhemba shekeli icumi ku mwaka, ndakwambike nongere ndakugaburire."
Wa Mulewi aca aremera kubana na we, maze uwo musore aca aba nk’umwe mu bahungu biwe.
Mika agira uwo Mulewi umuherezi wiwe, aba mu nzu yiwe.
Mika aravuga ati: "Noneho menye ko Uhoraho azobana nanje, ko ndonse umuherezi w’Umulewi."
Muri ico gihe Abisirayeli nta mwami bari bafise. Kandi muri ico gihe nyene, umuryango wa Dani wari ukiriko urironderera aho kuba, kuko batari bwaronke iragi ryabo mu miryango ya Isirayeli.

Nuko abo mu muryango wa Dani barungika abasoda batanu bava i Zora baja muri Eshitayoli gutata iyo ntara no kuyigenzura. Abo bantu baserukira umuryango wose wa Dani. Barababwira bati: "Genda mugenzure iyo ntara." Ba bantu binjira mu karere k’imisozi ya Efurayimu, bashika ku nzu kwa Mika, bararaho.
Begereje inzu ya Mika, bumvise ijwi rya wa muhungu w’Umulewi baramumenya. Baca binjirayo baramubaza bati: "Ni nde yakuzanye ino? Ukora iki aha hantu? Ni kubera iki uri ngaha?"
Aca ababwira ivyo Mika yamukoreye ati: "Mika yampaye akazi ko kumubera umuherezi."
Baca bamubwira bati: "Turakwinginze utubarize Imana ko urugendo rwacu ruzogenda neza."
Wa muherezi arabishura ati: "Nimugende amahoro, Uhoraho azobana namwe mu rugendo rwanyu."

Ba bantu baca baragenda bashika i Layishi, aho hantu basanga abantu baho bibereye mu mahoro nk’Abanyesidoni, ata co binona, batekaniwe. Kandi kubera ko intara yabo ata co yari ikenye, bari bateye imbere. Baba kure cane y’Abanyesidoni, kandi nta migenderanire bari bafitaniye n’abandi bantu na bamwe.
Basubiye i Zora n’i Eshitayoli, benewabo barababaza bati: "Mwasanze ibintu vyifashe gute?"
Bishura bati: "Nimuze tugende tubatere! Twabonye ko intara yabo ari nziza cane. Mbega murindiriye iki? Ntimwijijanye imitima, ingo tugende kuhafata.
Nitwashikayo, muzohasanga abantu ata co binona, hamwe n’intara nini cane Imana yarekuriye mu maboko yanyu, intara ata kintu na kimwe ikenye."
Nuko abasoda amajana atandatu bo mu muryango wa Dani biteguriye intambara, bava i Zora n’i Eshitayoli.
Bari ku rugendo bashinga ikambi yabo ahitwa Kiriyati-Yeyarimu i Buyuda. Ni co gituma aho hantu hiswe Mahanehi Dani gushika n’ubu.
Bavuye aho baciye baja mu gihugu c’imitumba ca Efurayimu, bashika ku nzu kwa Mika.

Ba bantu batanu bari bagiye gutata iyo ntara ya Layishi babwira benewabo bati: "Mbe murazi ko muri izi nzu harimwo efodi, ibigirwamana vyo mu nzu, igishushanyo kibajwe hamwe n’ikindi c’igicurano? None tubigenze dute?"
Nuko baca barinjira mu nzu ya wa musore w’Umulewi kwa Mika, baramuramutsa.
Ba bantu amajana atandatu bari biteguriye urugamba basigara kw’irembo,

bamwe batanu bari bagiye gutata iyo ntara baba ari bo binjira, batwara ca gishushanyo c’ikibazano, efodi hamwe n’imana z’uwo muryango na ca gishushanyo c’igicurano, kandi wa muherezi na bamwe amajana atandatu bari bahagaze kw’irembo.
Wa muherezi abonye ba bantu binjiye mu kanyabugoro ka Mika bagatora ca gishushanyo, efodi, utugirwamana hamwe n’ikigirwamana gikozwe mu cuma, arababaza ati: "Ivyo mukora ni ibiki?"

Baramwishura bati: "Numa! Ntihagire ijambo na rimwe usubira kuvuga. Ingo ujane natwe utubere umuvyeyi n’umuherezi. Mbega si vyiza ko wobera umuherezi umuryango ukwiye wo mu Bisirayeli gusumba kumubera inzu y’umugabo umwe gusa?"
Wa muherezi aca aranezerwa, cane. Ahitana efodi n’ibindi bishushanyo vyo mu muryango na ca gishushanyo c’ikibazano, aca ajana n’abo bantu.
Ashira imbere abana batobato, ibitungwa hamwe n’ayandi matungo yabo, barahindukira bafata urugendo.
Bageze kure gatoya yo kwa Mika, ababanyi ba Mika na bo barahamagarana, bakurikira abo mu muryango wa Dani.
Bagenda barasemerera inyuma ya bene Dani, na bo barahindukira babwira Mika bati: "Ni ibiki? Ni kubera iki wahamagaye abo bantu ngo baze kutugwanya?"
Mika arabishura ati: "Mwatwaye imana nakoze, mutwarana n’umuherezi wanje. Hari na kimwe mwansigiye? Ni kubera iki mumbaza muti ‘Ni ibiki?’ "
Bene Dani baramubwira bati: "Ntiwirirwe uraharira rero, ahandi ho abakaza ishavu bari ngaha boraka bakakurandurana n’umuryango wawe."
Nuko bene Dani babandanya urugendo rwabo, Mika abonye ko bakomeye kumusumvya, aca arahindukira asubira i muhira.

Bene Dani baca bafata vya bigirwamana vya Mika hamwe n’umuherezi wiwe, barabandanya baja i Layishi, batera abantu bari bibereye mu mahoro ata co binona. Babaririkisha inkota, bongera baturira ico gisagara.

Nta muntu n’umwe bari bafise wo kubatabara kuko baba kure cane ya Sidoni kandi nta migenderanire bari bafitaniye n’abandi bantu na bamwe. Igisagara cari mu kiyaya hafi y’i Beti-Rehobu. Bene Dani baca basanura ico gisagara baciberamwo.
Baca bacita Dani, izina rya sekuruza wabo, yavutse kuri Isirayeli, ariko ico gisagara cari cahoze citwa Layishi.
Bene Dani baca bashinga vya bigirwamana, Yonatani mwene Gerishomu, Gerishomu mwene Mose, n’abahungu biwe, baba abaherezi b’umuryango wa Dani ibihe vyose gushika igihe batwarwa nk’inyagano.
Babaho bakoresha ivyo bigirwamana Mika yari yarikoreye mu gihe ihema ry’Imana ryari i Shilo.

Muri ico gihe, Abisirayeli nta mwami bari bafise. Hariho Umulewi yaba kure cane mu karere k’imisozi ya Efurayimu. Umusi umwe akura umugore i Betelehemu h’i Buyuda amuzana i muhira nk’umugore wa kabiri.
Ariko uwo mugore ntiyemera kugumana na we, asubira iwabo kwa se i Betelehemu.
Haciye amezi ane, umugabo wiwe afata ingingo yo kuja kumugarukana. Agenda ajanye umukozi wiwe n’indogoba zibiri. Wa mugore aramwakira, amushikana mu nzu kwa se. Se amubonye amwakirana urweze.
Sebukwe aramugobera aguma ngaho gato, na we ahamara imisi itatu, asangira na bo, aryama ngaho.
Ku musi ugira kane bazinduka kare, baritegura ngo bagende, ariko sebukwe aramubwira ati: "Banza ufungure hanyuma muheze mugende."
Nuko bompi baricara, bararya, baranywa. Hanyuma se w’umukobwa amubwira ati: "Ndakwingize usubire urare, unezereze umutima wawe."
Wa mugabo asubira kwizindura ngo agende, sebukwe yongera kumugobera, asubira kuharara irindi joro.
Mu gatondo k’umusi ugira gatanu, azindutse kugira ngo agende, sebukwe aramubwira ati: "Akira imfungurwa ufungure, uraba uragenda n’inyuma y’umutaga." Nuko bamara uwundi musi.

Wa mugabo n’umugore wiwe hamwe n’umukozi wiwe bahagurutse ngo batahe, sebukwe aramubwira ati: "Ehe raba bugira bwire; umusi usa n’uwurangiye, rara iri joro unezereze umutima wawe, hanyuma ejo uzozinduke witahira."
Ariko kuko uwo mugabo atashaka gusubira kuharara irindi joro, aca afata inzira ija i Yebusi ari ho i Yerusalemu, ari kumwe n’umugore wiwe na za ndogoba zibiri ziriko amatandiko yazo.
Begereje i Yebusi, bwari bumaze kwira cane, wa mukozi abwira shebuja ati: "Ingo tuje mu gisagara c’Abayebusi dusabeho indaro."
Shebuja aramubwira ati: "Oya ntibishoboka. Ntitwinjira mu gisagara c’abanyamahanga, kitabamwo Abisirayeli. Turabandanya dushike i Gibeya.
Reka tubandanye turabe ko twoshika i Gibeya canke i Rama, turaza gusaba indaro muri ivyo bisagara."
Nuko barabandanya, izuba rirenga begereje i Gibeya mu ntara ya Benyamini.
Bajayo kugira ngo baharare. Baragenda bahagarara ku mbuga y’igisagara ariko ntihagira n’umwe abakira ngo abahe indaro.
Kuri uwo mugoroba, haza umutama ava mu karere k’imisozi ya Efurayimu aba i Gibeya yari atashe avuye mu mirima. (Abantu baba ngaho bava mu umuryango wa Benyamini).
Abonye izo ngenzi ziri ku mbuga y’igisagara, abaza ati: "Muva he, mukaja he?"

Wa mugabo arishura ati: "Tuvuye i Betelehemu h’i Buyuda tuja kure cane mu karere k’imisozi ya Efurayimu, ni ho mba. Nahora i Betelehemu h’i Buyuda, ubu nkaba ndiko nsubira i muhira ariko habuze n’umwe yompa indaro y’iri joro.
Turifitiye ivyokurya bikwiye vy’indogoba zacu n’ivyacu twebwe abasavyi bawe, jewe, uwu musavyikazi, n’uwu musore turi kumwe. Nta na kimwe dukeneye."
Wa mutama arababwira ati: "Nimushike muhira iwanje, ndabaha ivyo mukeneye vyose. Nawe nu ntimworara ku mbuga."
Nuko arabashikana mu nzu, agaburira n’indogoba ziwe. Ahejeje kuboza ibirenge, baca barasangira ivyokurya.

Bakiriko baranezeranwa, abantu b’inkozi z’ibibi bo mu gisagara baraza bakikuza iyo nzu. Batangura guhondagura ku muryango bahamagara uwo mutama, bavuga bati: "Sohokana uwo mugabo aje kurara mu nzu yawe tumusambanye."
Uwo mutama arasohoka ababwira ati: "Oya bagenzi banje, ndabinginze ntimukore ikibi kingana gityo. Uwu muntu ni umushitsi wanje, ntimukore igiterasoni nk’ico.
Ehe raba mfise umukobwa w’isugi, hari kandi n’umugore w’uwu mugabo. Reka ndababasohokanire mubakoze ico mushaka. Ariko uwo mugabo, ntimumukorere igiterasoni nk’ico."
Ariko ba bantu ntibamwumviriza. Wa mugabo aca afata wa mugore wiwe amuterera hanze, bamukuranwako bamusambanya ijoro ryose, maze bugiye guca baramurekura.
Umutwenzi utamanzuye, wa mugore aca asubira ku nzu ya wa mutama, aho umugabo wiwe yari ari, ariko aca agwa imbere y’umuryango, agumaho gushika bukeye.
Mu gitondo, wa mugabo avyutse, yugurura umuryango, arasohoka ngo abandanye urugendo, asanga aho wa mugore yaguye imbere y’umuryango, afashe igishimaryango.
Aramubwira ati: "Haguruka tugende." Ariko wa mugore ntiyamwishura. Wa mugabo aca amushira ku ndogoba, aramutahana.
Bashitse i muhira, wa mugabo aca afata imbugita, amucagaguramwo ibihimba icumi na bibiri, abirungika mu miryango icumi n’ibiri y’Abisirayeli.
Abantu bose babibonye baravuga bati: "Ububi nk’ubu ntibwari bwakaboneke kuva Abisirayeli bavuye muri Egiputa. Nimuvyiyumvireko, muheze mutubwire ico twokora."
Abisirayeli bose uhereye i Dani ugashika i Berisheba no mu ntara ya Gileyadi baza bafise umutima umwe, bakoranira i Misipa imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Harimwo n’abarongozi b’imiryango ya Isirayeli. Abasoda bari ibihumbi amajana ane bitwaje inkota.
Abo mu muryango wa Benyamini baramenya ko Abisirayeli baduze i Misipa. Abisirayeli bavuga bati: "Tubwire ingene iryo bara ryaguye."
Wa Mulewi, ari we mugabo wa wa mugore yishwe, aca ababwira ati: "Twe n’umugore wanje twashitse i Gibeya muri bene Benyamini ngo turareho.
Mw’ijoro haza abagabo b’i Gibeya bakikuza inzu twarimwo, bagomba kunyica. Ni ko gufata umugore wanje bakamusambanya gushika apfe.
Naciye mfata umugore wanje, ndamucamwo ibice icumi na bibiri, ndabirungika mu ntara zose zahawe Isirayeli, kuko aba bantu bakoze icaha c’agahomerabunwa.
None yemwe Bisirayeli, nimuvyiyumvire maze mugire ico mukoze."
Bose bahagurukira rimwe bahuje umutima n’inama, bavuga bati: "Nta n’umwe muri twebwe asubira i muhira. Nta n’umwe!
Ahubwo Nguku uko tuja kugirira Gibeya: Reka tugire ubupfindo dutore abaja kuhatera.

Turatoranya ic’icumi c’abo mu miryango yose ya Isirayeli kugira ngo baje kuronderera ivyokurya ingabo. Abasoda bacu nibashika i Gibeya muri bene Benyamini, babakorere ibikwiranye n’ico caha giteye isoni bakoreye muri Isirayeli."
Nuko Abisirayeli bose bahuriza umutima n’inama hamwe ko baja gutera ico gisagara.
Imiryango ya Isirayeli irungika intumwa muri bene Benyamini bati: "Vyangenze gute ngo ivyaha vy’agahomerabunwa nk’ivyo bikorerwe muri mwebwe?
Nimuduhe izo nkozi z’ibibi z’i Gibeya kugira ngo tuzice, dukure ikibi muri Isirayeli." Ariko bene Benyamini ntibumvira benewabo b’Abisirayeli.
Ahubwo bava mu bisagara vyabo, bakoranira i Gibeya ngo bagwanye Abisirayeli.
Bene Benyamini bakoranya abasoda ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitandatu bagwanisha inkota bavuye mu bisagara vyabo, biyongera ku bandi amajana indwi batoranijwe mu baba i Gibeya.
Muri abo harimwo abasoda amajana indwi bari abanyebamfu, bashobora guteza ibuye umugozi, bagatumbereza umushatsi ntibawuhushe.
Ingabo zo mu Bisirayeli bandi, havuyemwo bene Benyamini, bari bafise abasoda ibihumbi amajana ane bagwanisha n’inkota, bamenyereye intambara.
Abisirayeli baca baduga i Beteli, babaza Imana bati: "Ni nde muri twebwe akwiye gutera bene Benyamini ubwa mbere?" Uhoraho abishura ati: "Yuda nabe ari we agenda imbere."
Bukeye Abisirayeli baravyuka bashinga amahema hafi y’i Gibeya.
Abasoda ba Isirayeli baja kugwanya bene Benyamini, bashinga ibirindiro hafi y’i Gibeya.
Abasoda bo muri bene Benyamini bavuye i Gibeya bica Abisirayeli ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bibiri uwo musi.
Ariko Abisirayeli barongera baterana intege, basubira ku birindiro vyabo, aho baheruka kugwanira.
Kuko Abisirayeli bari baduze i Beteli kuririra Uhoraho kugeza izuba rirenze, basaba Imana bavuga bati: "Dusubire tuduge gutera bene Benyamini benewacu?" Uhorago abishura ati: "Nimugende mubatere."
Abisirayeli barasubira begereza bene Benyamini umusi ugira kabiri.
Uwo musi na ho nyene bene Benyamini basohoka kubatangira, babicamwo abandi ibihumbi cumi n’umunani bazi kugwanisha inkota.
Maze Abisirayeli bose baca bongera kuduga i Beteli bicarayo, baririra imbere y’ Uhoraho umusi wose, barisonzesha gushika rirenze, bashikanira Uhoraho ibimazi bituriwe hamwe n’amashikanwa y’ishimwe.
Abisirayeli barondera mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho . Muri ico gihe Isandugu y’Isezerano y’Imana yari ikiri aho,

na Finehasi mwene Eliyazeri, Eliyazeri mwene Aroni yari umuherezi. Barabaza bati: "Dusubire tuduge kugwanya Ababenyamini benewacu? Canke tureke?" Uhoraho ababwira ati: "Nimugende kuko ejo nzobarekurira mu maboko yanyu."
Maze Abisirayeli baragenda babunda inyuma y’i Gibeya bahakikuje.
Batera Ababenyamini umusi ugira gatatu, bagira ibirindiro nk’uko bari babigize ubwa mbere.
Ababenyamini barasohoka baza kubagwanya, barabirukana bava mu gisagara. Batangura kubica nk’ubwa mbere, Abisirayeli mirongo itatu bagwa mu gahinga no mu mabarabara aja i Beteli n’i Gibeya.
Ababenyamini bakiriko baravuga bati: "Turabanesheje nk’ubwa mbere," Abisirayeli na bo bariko baravuga bati: "Reka tumere nk’abahunga dusubira inyuma tubakwege bave mu gisagara baje mu mabarabara."
Abisirayeli bose baca bava aho bari bari bagira ibirindiro i Bayali-Tamari, abari babibundiye na bo baca baratera ku ruhande rwo hirya rwa Gibeya.
Abantu ibihumbi cumi bazi kugwana cane bavuye mu Bisirayeli bose baba ari bo baja imbere batera Gibeya. Urugamba rwari rukomeye cane, ariko Ababenyamini ntibari bwamenye amakuba abarindiriye.
Uhoraho aha Abisirayeli kunesha Ababenyamini, uwo musi Abisirayeli bica Ababenyamini ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitanu n’ijana bari bazi kugwanisha inkota.
Ababenyamini baca barabona ko baneshejwe. Abisirayeli bari bigize nk’abahunze imbere y’Ababenyamini kuko bari bizigiye ko bamwe binyegeje baca baronka ingene batera i Gibeya.
Maze abari binyegeje baca binjira ubwo nyene mu gisagara i Gibeya, baririkisha inkota ababayo bose.
Bari bumvikanye ko abo binyegeje bamaze kwinjira baca baturira ibintu vyinshi hakaduga umwotsi mwinshi mu kirere nk’ikimenyetso,
hanyuma Abisirayeli babonye uwo mwotsi, bagaca batera Ababenyamini. Ababenyamini bari bamaze kwica Abisirayeli mirongo itatu, baca bibwira bati: "Turiko turabanesha nk’ubwa mbere."
Ariko wa mwotsi upfundutse uduga uva mu gisagara, Ababenyamini barahindukira babona umwotsi w’igisagara cose uduga kw’ijuru.
Abisirayeli baca barabahindukirira, Ababenyamini baca batekerwa n’ubwoba, kuko bari babonye ko uguhona kubashitseko.
Baca bahunga Abisirayeli baja mu bugaragwa, ariko ntivyakunda ko bahunga, kuko Abisirayeli bari mu gisagara baciye babatangira.
Nuko Abisirayeli bakikuza Ababenyamini, barabakurikira babafatira mu buseruko bwa Gibeya.
Abasoda ibihumbi cumi n’umunani bo muri bene Benyamini bamenyereye intambara bagwa muri iyo ntambara.
Bahindukiye ngo bahungire mu bugaragwa ku gitandara c’i Rimoni, Abisirayeli bicira ibihumbi bitanu mu nzira. Babandanya gusugereza bene Benyamini gushika i Gidomu, bica abandi ibihumbi bibiri.
Kuri uwo musi, abasoda ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitanu bo muri bene Benyamini bagwanisha inkota barishwe, kandi bose bari abahizi bakomeye.
Ariko amajana atandatu yo mu Babenyamini barashoboye guhungira mu bugaragwa ku gitandara c’i Rimoni, aho bamaze amezi ane.
Abisirayeli baca basubira mu bisagara vy’Ababenyamini baririkisha inkota ababibamwo bose, harimwo ibitungwa n’ikindi kintu cose bahasanze. Igisagara cabo cose bashikira baca bagiturira.
Igihe Abisirayeli bari bahuriye i Misipa bagira baje kugwanya Ababenyamini, bari barahiye bati: "Nta n’umwe wo muri twebwe azoshingira umukobwa wiwe Ababenyamini."
Inyuma y’intambara n’Ababenyamini, abantu bose baca bahurira i Beteli, bicara imbere y’Imana gushika ku mugoroba, baborogana umubabaro mwinshi,
bavuga bati: " Uhoraho , Mana ya Isirayeli, ni kubera iki ibi vyashikiye Isirayeli, bituma umuryango umwe uzimangana muri Isirayeli?"
Bukeye mu gatondo ka kare, abantu bubaka igicaniro bashikana ibimazi bituriwe hamwe n’ibimazi vy’ishimwe.

Abisirayeli baca barabaza bati: "Ni nde wo mu miryango ya Isirayeli atari kumwe natwe i Misipa aho twakoranira imbere y’ Uhoraho ?" Babajije gutyo kubera bari barahiriye imbere y’ Uhoraho ko uwutazokwifatanya na bo azokwicwa.
Maze Abisirayeli bagandarira benewabo ari bo Babenyamini, bavuga bati: "Uno musi umwe mu miryango ya Isirayeli wazimanganye.
None abacitse kw’icumu tuzobakwera abagore gute ko twarahiriye imbere y’ Uhoraho ko ata mukobwa wacu tuzobashingira?"
Barabaza bati: "Nta muryango wo mu Bisirayeli utakoraniye hamwe natwe imbere y’ Uhoraho i Misipa?" Basanga nta n’umwe w’i Yabeshi Gileyadi yaje muri iryo koraniro.
Kuko bamaze guharura abari bahari bose, basanze ata wo muri Yabeshi Gileyadi yari ngaho.
Ikoraniro rica rigena abasoda ibihumbi cumi na bibiri bamenyereye intambara, ngo baje i Yabeshi Gileyadi, bicishe inkota ababayo bose, harimwo abagore n’abana
Bababwira bati: "Uku abe ari ko muzobagenza: muzotikize abagabo n’abahungu bose, hamwe n’abagore bose batakiri inkumi."
Baca basanga mu baba i Yabeshi Gileyadi harimwo inkumi amajana ane batararyamana n’abagabo, baca babatwara mw’ikambi i Shilo muri Kanani.
Ikoraniro ryose ry’Abisirayeli rica rirungika intumwa ku masigarira y’Ababenyamini bari ku gitandara c’i Rimoni kubabwira ko bashaka ko babana amahoro.
Nuko Ababenyamini basubira iwabo, bahabwa za nkumi z’i Yabeshi Gileyadi zari zazigurijwe. Ariko ntibabakwiye.
Abantu bose bagira umubabaro mwinshi ku bw’Ababenyamini kuko Uhoraho yari yaciye igihengeri mu miryango ya Isirayeli.
Abari barongoye ikoraniro baravuga bati: "Mbega abagabo basigaye bo muri bene Benyamini tuzobaha abagore dukuye he ko abagore bose bo mu muryango wa Benyamini bapfuye?"
Barongera bati: "Amasigarira yo mu muryango wa Benyamini ategerezwa kuronka abagore kugira ngo uwo muryango wa Isirayeli ntuzimangane ibihe vyose.
Ntidushobora kubaha abakobwa bacu kuko twarahiye tuti: ‘Azoba avumwe umuntu azoshingira umukobwa wiwe ku muntu wo mu muryango wa Benyamini.’
Baravugana bati: Ehe raba, hariho isabukuru y’ Uhoraho uko umwaka uheze ibera i Shilo, mu buraruko bwa Beteli no hakuno y’inzira iva i Beteli ija i Shekemu, hamwe no mu bumanuko bwa Lebona."
Baca babwira abo mu muryango wa Benyamini bati: "Muzogende mwinyegeze mu mizabibu,
nimwabona abakobwa b’i Shilo bakoranye ngo batangure gutamba, muzoce muva mu mizabibu, umwe wese acakire umukobwa umwe amutware mu ntara ya Benyamini abe umugore wiwe.

Ba se babo canke basaza babo nibatwitwarako tuzobabwira tuti: ‘Nimutugirire ubuntu mubafashe, kuko tutashoboye kubaha abagore muri ya ntambara. Mwebwe nta co mwagirizwa kuko si mwebwe mwabashingiyeko abakobwa banyu.’ "

Ababenyamini babikora uko babibwiwe. Mu gihe abakobwa bariko baratamba, umwe wese aca asumira umukobwa umwe aramutwara ngo abe umugore wiwe. Baca basubira mu ntara yabo, basubira kwubaka ibisagara, babibamwo.
Inyuma y’ivyo Abisirayeli baca basubira inyuma bamwebamwe bose mu miryango yabo, baja mu ntara zabo.
Muri ico gihe, Abisirayeli nta mwami bari bafise, umuntu wese yakora ibintu uko avyumva.

name: Rusi
chapters: Mu gihe Abisirayeli baganzwa n’abacamanza, hateye inzara mu gihugu, maze umugabo umwe w’i Betelehemu mu karere ka Yuda, hamwe n’umugore wiwe n’abahungu biwe babiri, baja kuba baraba mu gihugu c’i Mowabu.
Uwo mugabo yitwa Elimeleki, umugore wiwe yitwa Nawomi, abahungu biwe na bo bitwa Mahiloni na Kiliyoni. Abo bari Abanyefurata baba i Betelehemu, mu karere ka Yuda. Nuko baja i Mowabu babayo.
Haheze igihe, Elimeleki, umugabo wa Nawomi, arapfa, Nawomi asigarana n’abahungu biwe babiri.
Mu nyuma abo bahungu barongora Abanyamowabukazi, umwe yitwa Orupa uwundi akitwa Rusi. Bamazeyo nk’imyaka icumi,
Mahiloni na Kiliyoni na bo nyene barapfa. Nawomi asigara wenyene abahungu biwe bompi n’umugabo wiwe bamaze gupfa.
Nawomi akiri i Mowabu yumva ko Uhoraho yatabaye abantu biwe akabarungikira ivyokurya. Nuko yitegura gusubira mu gihugu ciwe hamwe n’abakazana biwe.
Ava aho yaba ari kumwe n’abakazana biwe bafata inzira isubira mu karere ka Yuda.
Ariko Nawomi abwira abakazana biwe ati: "Nimwisubirire inyuma, umwe wese aje mu nzu kwa nyina. Uhoraho aze abagirire neza nk’uko mwatugiriye twe n’abahisi.
Uhoraho aze abahe impore mu ngo muzoja kwubakamwo." Nuko arabagumbira arabasezera, bose bararira cane,
baca baramubwira bati: "Turajana nawe mu bwoko bw’iwanyu."
Ariko Nawomi arababwira ati: "Nimwisubirire iwanyu, bakobwa banje. Ni igiki cotuma mujana nanje? Mbega nzosubira kuvyara abandi bahungu, ngo bababere abagabo?
Nimwitahire iwanyu, bakobwa banje; kuko ndashaje cane nta mugabo wundi nkironka. Naho nokwiyumvira ko ngifise ibindi vyizigiro vyo kuronka umugabo iri joro nyene nkavyara abahungu,
mbega mwobarindira gushika bakuze? Mworeka kurongorwa mubarindiriye? Oya ntivyokunda, bakobwa banje. Ivyanje ni umururazi kurusha ivyanyu, kuko Uhoraho ubwiwe yambanguriye ukuboko kwiwe!"
Bumvise ivyo bongera kurira cane. Maze Orupa agumbira inabukwe aramusezera, ariko Rusi amwumirako.
Nawomi abwira Rusi ati: "Raba mugenzawe arisubiriye mu b’iwabo no ku mana ziwe. Ehe jana na we."

Ariko Rusi aramwishura ati: "Reka kunyingingira kuvana nawe canke gusubira inyuma ngo ndaguhebe. Aho uzoja ni ho nzoja, aho uzoba ni ho nzoba. Ihanga ryawe ni ryo rizoba ihanga ryanje kandi Imana yawe ni yo izoba Imana yanje.
Aho uzopfira ni ho nzopfira, kandi ni ho bazompamba. Uhoraho aze abimpanire, mbere birushirije, nihagira ikintandukanya na wewe atari urupfu."
Nawomi amaze kubona ko Rusi yafashe ingingo ntabanduka yo kujana na we, ntiyasubira kumwinginga.
Abo bagore uko ari babiri baragenda gushika bashitse i Betelehemu. Bahashitse, abo mu gisagara bose bazira rimwe kubaraba. Abagore baho baravuga bati: "Mbega uwu si Nawomi?"
Na we arababwira ati: "Ntimunyite Nawomi, munyite Mara, kuko Iyishoboravyose yahinduye ubuzima bwanje umururazi ukomeye.
Nkigenda nta co nari nkenye, ariko Uhoraho angarukanye ata kintu na kimwe mfise. None ni igiki cotuma munyita Nawomi? Uhoraho yanteje amagorwa; Iyishoboravyose yanteje ivyago."
Nuko Nawomi agaruka avuye i Mowabu ari kumwe n’umukazana wiwe Rusi, Umunyamowabukazi, bashika i Betelehemu mu gihe iyimbura ry’ingano ryari ritanguye.
Nawomi yari afise incuti ku ruhande rw’umugabo wiwe, umugabo yari atunze kandi w’umwubahwa wo mu muryango wa Elimeleki, yitwa Bowazi.
Umusi umwe Rusi wa Munyamowabukazi abwira Nawomi ati: "Nyemerera nje mu mirima ntoratore ingano zakorotse inyuma y’umuntu wese aza kundaba ijisho ryiza." Nawomi aramubwira ati: "Genda mwana wanje."
Nuko aragenda atangura gutoratora ingano zasigaye mu mirima inyuma y’abimbuzi. Maze birahurirana asanga ariko atoratora mu murima wa Bowazi, wo mu muryango wa Elimeleki.
Maze Bowazi aca arashika avuye i Betelehemu, aramutsa abimbuzi ati: " Uhoraho abane namwe!" Baramwishura bati: " Uhoraho aguhe umugisha!"
Bowazi abaza umukozi yari ajejwe abimbuzi ati: "Urya mukobwa ni uwa nde?"
Uwo mukozi aramwishura ati: "Ni wa Munyamowabukazi yazanana na Nawomi bavuye i Mowabu.

Yaje asaba ati: ‘Ndabinginze mundeke ntoratore utwasigaye hagati y’imikama inyuma y’abimbuzi.’ Yaje mu murima kuva mu gitondo kandi gushika n’ubu ntarahagarika gukora, uretse akanya gato yicaye mu gitutu ngo aruhuke."
Nuko Bowazi abwira Rusi ati: "Mukobwa wanje, nyumviriza. Ntuze uje gutoratora ingano mu wundi murima kandi ntuze uje kure y’aha. Uze ugumane n’abakobwa bankorera.

Uze urabe umurima abimbuzi banje bariko barimburamwo, hanyuma ugende ukurikira abakobwa bankorera. Nihanije abakozi ngo ntihagire uwugukorako. Kandi unyotewe, uzoce ugenda wihe amazi yo kunywa ku mibindi abakozi bavomye."
Amubwiye ivyo, Rusi aca aramwunamira, amubwira ati: "Ni igiki gitumye ngirirwa ubuntu imbere yawe ngo unyiteho, jewe umunyamahangakazi?"
Bowazi aramwishura ati: "Barambwiye ivyo wakoreye nyokobukwe vyose kuva umugabo wawe apfuye, ko wahevye so na nyoko n’igihugu c’amavukiro ukaza kuba mu bantu utigeze umenya.
Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, uwo waje guhungira musi y’amababa, aze aguhembere ivyo wakoze. Uhoraho aze akwishure birushirije."

Rusi aramubwira ati: "Icompa ngashishikara kugirirwa ubuntu imbere yawe, Nyakwubahwa. Urandemesheje kandi umbwiye amajambo meza jewe umusavyikazi wawe, naho ntari mpwanye n’umwe mu bakobwa bagukorera."
Hageze gufungura, Bowazi aramubwira ati: "Ingo hano. Niwakire umukate ukoze mu muvinyu w’inkarisha." Maze yicaye hamwe n’abimbuzi, amuha intete zikaranze. Ararya arahaga kandi aranasigaza.
Ahagurutse ngo atoratore ingano zakorotse, Bowazi ategeka abimbuzi biwe ati: "Naho yotoratora hagati y’imikama, ntimumugore.
Ahubwo, muze murakororera hasi ingano zimwe kugira ngo azitoratore, kandi ntimumukarire."
Nuko Rusi atorora ingano muri uwo murima gushika ku mugoroba. Asekuye izo yegeranije, akwiza ingero efa .
Araheza azijana mu gisagara, maze inabukwe abona ingene yegeranije ingano nyinshi. Kandi Rusi arongera asokorora ivyo yari yashigaje ahejeje gufungura agahaga, arabimuha.

Inabukwe aramubaza ati: "Mbega watoratoye he uwu musi? Wakoreye he? Uwo mugabo yakwitayeho aragahezagirwa!" Maze Rusi abwira inabukwe nyene aho hantu yakoreye. Aravuga ati: "Izina ry’uwo mugabo nyene umurima nakoreyemwo uno musi ni Bowazi."
Nawomi abwira umukazana wiwe ati: " Uhoraho amuhezagire. Ntiyigeze ahagarika kugirira neza twebwe abazima n’abahisi." Arongerako ati: "Urya mugabo ni incuti yacu ya hafi; ni umwe mu bacunguzi bacu."
Maze Rusi Umunyamowabukazi aravuga ati: "Kandi yambwiye ngo: ‘Uze ugumane n’abakozi banje kugeza bahejeje kwegeranya umwimbu wanje wose.’ "
Nawomi abwira Rusi umukazana wiwe ati: "Bizokubera vyiza, mukobwa wanje, kujana n’abakobwa bamukorera, kuko ugiye mu murima w’uwundi muntu wohava ugira ingorane."
Nuko Rusi aguma hafi y’abakobwa bakorera Bowazi atorora gushika iyimbura rya sayiri n’ingano rirangiye. Kandi ico gihe yabana na inabukwe.
Umusi umwe Nawomi, inabukwe wa Rusi, aramubwira ati: "Mukobwa wanje, ntegerezwa kukuronderera urugo, ahantu uzoshobora kuronka ibigutunga.
Bowazi, shebuja wa barya bakobwa mwakorana, ni umucunguzi wacu. Muri iri joro ahava aja kugosoza sayiri ku mbuga yo kugosorerako.
Niwiyuhagire maze wisige, uheze wambare agahuzu keza kurusha izindi. Maze umanuke ku mbuga, ariko ntamenye ko ari ho uri kugeza ahejeje kurya no kunywa.
Niyaryama, urabe neza ahantu aryamye. Hanyuma uce ugenda umupfukure ibirenge vyiwe uce uryama. Azoheza akubwire ico ukwiye gukora."
Rusi arishura ati: "Ndakora ivyo umbwiye vyose."
Nuko aramanuka aja ku mbuga yo kugosorerako akora ivyo inabukwe yamubwiye gukora vyose.
Maze Bowazi ahejeje kurya no kunywa ahaze, aca aja kuryama i ruhande y’ikigunguzi c’imikama ya sayiri. Rusi aramwegera mu gacerere, apfukura ibirenge vyiwe araryama.
Ijoro rigeze hagati, sinzi icakomye uwo mugabo, arihindukiza maze asanga hari umugore aryamye ku birenge vyiwe.
Arabaza ati: "Uri nde?" Aravuga ati: "Ndi umuguranokazi wawe Rusi. Numpfuke igice co hepfo c’impuzu yawe, kuko uri umucunguzi w’umuryango wanje."
Arishura ati: " Uhoraho aguhezagire, mukobwa wanje. Ugize neza gusumba n’ubwa mbere: ntiwakurikiye abagabo bakiri bato, baba abatunze canke abakenye.
None rero, mukobwa wanje, ntutinye. Nzokora ivyo wasavye vyose. Abagabo bagenzanje bo mu gisagara bose barazi ko uri umugore w’imico myiza.
Naho vy’ukuri ndi umucunguzi, hari umucunguzi andusha kuba uwa hafi.
Guma ngaha iri joro, maze mu gitondo niyashima kugucungura, bizoba ari vyiza; azogucungura. Ariko niyo atabishima, ndahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho jewe nzobikora. Ryama ngaha gushika mu gitondo."

Nuko aca aryama hafi y’ibirenge vyiwe gushika mu gitondo ca kare hatarabona neza, ata muntu yoshobora kumenya uwundi; maze Bowazi aramubwira ati: "Ntihaze hagire uwumenya ko hari umugore yaje ku mbuga yo kugosorerako."
Arongera aramubwira ati: "Tega uwo mwitero wambaye uwugumye." Rusi abigira nk’uko amubwiye, maze asukamwo ingero zitandatu za sayiri aramukorera. Aca asubira mu gisagara.
Rusi ashitse aho inabukwe ari, Nawomi aramubaza ati: "Vyagenze gute, ga mukobwa wanje?" Nuko Rusi amudondera ivyo Bowazi yamukoreye vyose
kandi arongerako ati: "Yampaye izi ngero zitandatu za sayiri, arambwira ati: ‘Ntuje kwa nyokobukwe iminwe misa.’ "
Maze Nawomi aravuga ati: "Rindira, mukobwa wanje, gushika aho umenyera iyo biherera. Kuko uwo mugabo ataza kuruhuka adatunganije iki kibazo uwu musi."
Mu nyuma, Bowazi aduga kw’irembo ry’igisagara yicaraho. Wa mucunguzi yari yavuze ahaciye, Bowazi aravuga ati: "Ingo, mugenzi, wicare hano." Nuko aragenda aricara.
Bowazi aca ahamagara icumi mu bakuru b’igisagara aravuga ati: "Nimwicare hano," na bo baricara.
Maze abwira wa mucunguzi ati: "Nawomi, umwe yagaruka avuye i Mowabu, ariko aragurisha igice c’itongo ryari irya mwenewacu Elimeleki.

Niyumviriye kubikumenyesha kugira ngo urigure imbere y’aba bicaye hano n’imbere y’aba bakuru b’ubwoko bwacu. Niwaba ushaka kuricungura, ubikore. Ariko niwaba udashaka, ubimbwire, ndabimenye. Kuko ata n’umwe afise uburenganzira bwo kubikora atari wewe, jewe nza inyuma yawe." Na we avuga ati: "Nzoricungura."
Bowazi na we aravuga ati: "Ku musi uzogurirako iryo tongo rya Nawomi, uzoca utwara na Rusi wa Munyamowabukazi, umupfakazi w’umuhisi, kugira ngo tuzigame izina ry’umuhisi n’itongo ryiwe."
Yumvise ivyo, wa mucunguzi aravuga ati: "Aho rero sinshobora kuricungura kuko vyohava bintera ingorane ku bw’itongo ryanje bwite. Ba ari wewe uricungura. Jewe sinshobora kubikora."

Muri ico gihe muri Isirayeli, kugira ngo umuntu yerekane ko ahaye uwundi uburenganzira bwo gucungura canke kugura, yakura ikirato ciwe akagiha uwo wundi. Ico ni co cemeza ku mugaragaro ukwo gutanga uburenganzira.
Nuko wa mucunguzi abwira Bowazi ati: "Nabe ari wewe urigura." Akura ikirato ciwe.
Maze Bowazi abwira ba bakuru n’abantu bose bari aho ati: "Uno musi mubaye ivyabona ko nguze na Nawomi itongo rya Elimeleki, Kiliyoni na Mahiloni.

Kandi nakiriye na Rusi Umunyamowabukazi, umupfakazi wa Mahiloni, nk’umugore wanje, kugira ngo mponore izina ry’uwapfuye n’itongo ryiwe, izina ryiwe ntirizimangane mu muryango wiwe canke mu gisagara avukamwo. Uwu musi mubaye ivyabona!"

Nuko ba bakuru n’abari kw’irembo baravuga bati: "Turi ivyabona. Uhoraho aze agire uwo mugore aje mu nzu yawe nka Rasheli na Leya, abo imiryango yose ya Isirayeli yakomotseko. Uze ugire igihagararo muri Efurata ube rurangiranwa i Betelehemu.
Umuryango wawe uzobe nk’uwa Perezi, uwo Yuda yavyaye kuri Tamari, biciye mu ruvyaro Uhoraho azoguha kuri uwu mugore akiri muto."
Nuko Bowazi atwara Rusi, aba umugore wiwe. Maze aryamana na we, Uhoraho amuha gusama inda, avyara umwana w’umuhungu.
Abagore babwira Nawomi bati: " Uhoraho ahimbazwe, atakuretse ngo ubure uwo kugucungura uwu musi. Izina ry’uwu mwana rize ribe rurangiranwa muri Isirayeli!
Azotuma ubuzima bwawe butotahara kandi agushigikire ugeze mu zabukuru. Kuko umukazana wawe, umwe agukunda kandi akurutira abahungu indwi, ari we yamuvyaye."
Maze Nawomi atora wa mwana, aramukikira amushira mu gikiriza, aba ari we amurera.
Abagore babana na we baravuga bati: "Nawomi yaronse umuhungu." Nuko bamwita Obedi. Ni we yabaye se wa Isayi, Isayi se wa Dawidi.
Uwu, rero, ni wo muryango wa Perezi: Perezi yavyaye Hezironi,
Hezironi avyara Ramu, Ramu avyara Aminadabu,
Aminadabu avyara Nahashoni, Nahashoni avyara Salumoni,
Salumoni avyara Bowazi, Bowazi avyara Obedi,
Obedi avyara Isayi, Isayi na we avyara Dawidi.

name: 1 Samweli
chapters: Habaye umugabo umwe yaba i Ramatayimu-Zofimu mu karere k’imisozi y’Abefurayimu, yitwa Elukana mwene Yerohamu, Yerohamu mwene Elihu, Elihu mwene Tohu, Tohu mwene Zufi, wo mu muryango wa Efurayimu.
Yari afise abagore babiri, umwe yitwa Hana uwundi yitwa Penina. Penina yari afise abana, ariko Hana ntiyagira n’umwe.

Uko umwaka utashe uwo mugabo yama ava mu gisagara c’iwabo akaduga gusenga no gushikanira Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ikimazi i Shilo, aho abahungu ba Eli babiri, Hofuni na Finehasi, bakorera nk’abaherezi b’ Uhoraho .
Igihe cose hageze ko Elukana atanga ikimazi, yama aha imigabane y’inyama umugore wiwe Penina n’abahungu biwe n’abakobwa biwe bose.
Ariko Hana we yamuha umugabane ungana incuro zibiri uwa Penina kuko yamukunda, naho Uhoraho yari yaramwimye uruvyaro.
Mukeba wiwe yama amucurira ngo amubabaze, kubera Uhoraho yari yaramwimye uruvyaro.
Ivyo vyabandanije gutyo uko imyaka yakurikirana. Igihe cose Hana yaja mu nzu y’ Uhoraho , mukeba wiwe yama amucurira gushika aho arira ntagire n’ico afungura.
Elukana umugabo wiwe akamubwira ati: "Hana, ni kuki urira? Ni kuki udafungura? Ni kuki ubabaye? Mbega sindakurutira abahungu icumi wovyaye?"
Igihe kimwe bahejeje kurya no kunywa i Shilo, Hana arahaguruka. Ico gihe Eli umuherezi yari yicaye ku ntebe ku muryango w’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .
Hana asenga Uhoraho n’umubabaro mwinshi wo mu mutima ararira cane.

Asezerana isezerano, avuga ati: "Yewe Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, niwaraba amagorwa yanje umusavyikazi wawe ukanyibuka, ntiwibagire umusavyikazi wawe ukampa umwana w’umuhungu, nanje nzomushikanira Uhoraho mu misi y’ukubaho kwiwe kwose, kandi nta rwembe ruzokwigera rumugera ku mutwe."
Uko yashishikara gusenga Uhoraho , ni ko Eli yamuraba ku munwa.
Hana yasengera ku mutima, kandi agakubita iminwa naho ijwi ryiwe ritumvikana. Eli we yibaza ko yaborewe,
aca aramubwira ati: "Uzogeza ryari kwama uborewe? Heba uwo muvinyu wawe."

Hana aramwishura ati: "Oyaye nyakwubahwa, si ko biri, ndi umugore afise ingorane nyinshi. Sinanyoye umuvinyu canke ikindi kiboreza na kimwe, nariko ndasuka umubabaro wo mu mutima wanje imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Ntiwibaze ko umusavyikazi wawe ndi umugore w’umunyangesombi, nariko ndasenga kubera umubabaro n’agahinda biri muri jewe."
Eli aramwishura ati: "Niwigire amahoro, Imana y’Abisirayeli ikwishure iguhe ico wayisavye."
Na we aravuga ati: "Icompa umusavyikazi wawe nkagirirwa ubuntu imbere yawe." Nuko aca ava aho hantu, arafungura, maze mu maso hiwe ntihasubira kwiraburanirwa.
Mu gitondo ca kare baravyuka basenga Uhoraho hanyuma basubira iwabo i Rama. Elukana aryamana n’umugore wiwe Hana, maze Uhoraho aramwibuka.
Nuko Hana asama inda avyara umuhungu amwita Samweli, avuga ati: "Kuko namusavye Uhoraho ."
Hageze ko Elukana adugana n’umuryango wiwe wose gushikanira Uhoraho ikimazi c’umwaka no gushitsa isezerano ryiwe,
Hana ntiyashoboye kujana na bo. Nuko abwira umugabo wiwe ati: "Uwu muhungu niyacuka, nzomujana ndamushikanire Uhoraho , na we azoba imbere y’Uhoraho ibihe vyose."

Elukana umugabo wiwe aramubwira ati: "Uze ukore ikizokubera ciza. Guma ngaha gushika umucukije; kimwe gusa Uhoraho ashitse ijambo ryiwe." Nuko uwo mugore aguma i muhira arera umuhungu wiwe gushika aho yamucukirije.
Amaze kumucutsa, ajana wa muhungu, naho yari akiri muto, n’ishuri imaze imyaka itatu, n’ifu ingana n’ingero efa n’umukuza w’umuvinyu, amujana mu nzu y’ Uhoraho i Shilo.
Bamaze gutanga ya shuri kw’ikimazi, bazanira Eli wa muhungu,
nyina wiwe aramubwira ati: "Nyakwubahwa, urakaramba! Ndi wa mugore nahagarara i ruhande yawe nsenga Uhoraho .
Nariko ndasaba uwu mwana, none Uhoraho yampaye ico namusavye.
None ubu ndamushikaniye Uhoraho . Ubuzima bwiwe bwose azoba ari uw’ Uhoraho ." Maze bapfukamira Uhoraho baramusenga.
Maze Hana asenga Uhoraho avuga ati: "Umutima wanje unezererewe Uhoraho ; Uhoraho we wangize uwukomeye. Ubu ndafise ico nishura abansi banje, kuko nezerejwe n’ugutabara kwawe.
Nta wera nk’ Uhoraho ; nta wundi yoboneka i ruhande yawe; nta Gitandara gihwanye n’Imana yacu.
Nimureke kuvugana ubwibone, iminwa yanyu ntivuge ivyo kwishira hejuru, kuko Uhoraho ari Imana izi vyose, kandi ni yo ipima ibikorwa vyose ku munzane.
Imiheto y’abagwanyi iravunaguritse, ariko abahoze ari abanyantegenke bambitswe inkomezi.
Abari bafise ivyuzuye, babaye abacangero, bakorera ivyo barya kandi abahora bashonje, bashize inzara. Uwahora yitwa ingumba, avyaye abana indwi, ariko uwari afise abahungu benshi arakabiranye.
Uhoraho ni we atuma umuntu apfa kandi ni we atuma abaho; ni we amanura bamwe i kuzimu, abandi akabakurayo.
Uhoraho ni we atuma bamwe bakena, kandi ni we atuma abandi batunga; ni we acisha bugufi bamwe, agashira hejuru abandi.
Akura umugorwa mu mukungugu, ashira hejuru umukene, amukuye mu mwavu; akamwicarikana n’abakomeye, akamuha intebe y’icubahiro. Kuko imfatiro z’isi ari iz’ Uhoraho ; Kandi kuri zo ni ho yashinze isi.
Ni we azozigama ibirenge vy’abamukorera mu bwizigirwa, ariko abanyakibi bazokamanganira mu mwijima. Inkomezi z’umuntu si zo zituma anesha;

abagwanya Uhoraho bazocika ubunywenywe. Iyisumbavyose izobaturagarirako iri mw’ijuru; Uhoraho azocira urubanza impera z’isi. Azoha inkomezi umwami yimitse kandi yongere inkomezi uwo yimikishije amavuta."
Hanyuma Elukana ataha iwe i Rama, ariko wa muhungu akorera Uhoraho ari musi y’uburongozi bwa Eli umuherezi.
Abahungu ba Eli bari abantu babi; ntibubaha Uhoraho .

Hariho ingeso abaherezi bari basigaye bafise y’uko igihe cose umuntu yaza gushikana ikimazi, umukozi w’umuherezi yaca azana icaruzo c’amenyo atatu mu minwe, akaza igihe inyama z’ico kimazi zikiriko ziratogotera ku ziko,
agaca yinjiza ca caruzo mu nkono canke mu kintu cose batetsemwo izo nyama, umuherezi agaca atwara izo ico caruzo caruye. Ivyo ni vyo bagirira Abisirayeli bose baza i Shilo.

Vyaranashika ko umukozi w’umuherezi aza ibinure vy’ikimazi bitaraturirwa n’umuriro ku gicaniro, akabwira uwariko arashikana ikimazi ati: "Zana inyama zo kwokereza umuherezi; ntashaka izimaze gutekwa, ashaka izikiri mbisi."
Iyo uwo muntu yishuye ati: "Reka mbanze nturire ibinure vyazo, hanyuma uheze utware izo ugomba zose," uwo mukozi yaca yishura ati: "Oya zizane ubu nyene; utazizanye naho, ndaziha ku nguvu."
Ico caha c’abo bahungu cari kinini cane mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , kuko bakengera ibimazi vyiwe.
Ariko Samweli we naho yari akiri agahungu gatoya yakomeje gukorera Uhoraho . Yambara efodi yera nk’iyo abaherezi bambara.
Uko umwaka utashe, nyina yama amushonera agakanzu gatoya akakamushira aduganye n’umugabo wiwe gutanga ikimazi c’umwaka.

Imbere y’uko bataha, Eli yama aca ahezagira Elukana n’umugore wiwe, akavuga ati: " Uhoraho aguhe abana kuri uwu mugore kugira ngo baje mu gishingo c’uwu yasengeye agaca amuha Uhoraho ." Bagaca bataha.
Kandi Uhoraho agirira ubuntu Hana; avyara abahungu batatu n’abakobwa babiri. Wa mwana Samweli na we abandanya akurira imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Ico gihe Eli yari ashaje cane, ariko yarumva ivyo abahungu biwe bakorera Abisirayeli, ko baryamana n’abagore bakorera ibikorwa mu rwinjiriro rw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro.
Nuko akama ababwira ngo: "Ni kuki mukora ibintu nk’ivyo? Numva abantu bose babavuga ko mwigenza nabi.
Nimusigeho, bana banje! Inkuru numva ivugwa mu bantu b’ Uhoraho si nziza.

Iyo umuntu acumuye ku wundi, Imana ishobora kubuzuriza; ariko umuntu acumuye k’ Uhoraho , ni nde yomuvugira?" Ariko abahungu biwe ntibumvira impanuro za se, kuko Uhoraho yari yagabiye ko bategerezwa gupfa.
Samweli we abandanya gukura mu mubiri no kugira igikundiro k’ Uhoraho no ku bantu.
Nuko haza umuntu w’Imana ashikira Eli aramubwira ati: "Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Siniyeretse abo mu nzu ya so igihe bari bakiri muri Egiputa baganzwa na Farawo?’ "

Natoranije so mu yindi miryango yose y’Abisirayeli ngo ambere umuherezi, ngo aje ku gicaniro canje, acane ibimota neza, kandi yambare efodi imbere y’inyonga zanje. Kandi nahaye abo mu nzu ya so ibimazi vyose vyoswa n’Abisirayeli.
None ni kuki mukengera ikimazi canje n’ishikanwa ryanje? Ni kuki wubaha abahungu bawe ukabandutisha mu kwirira inyama z’indobanurwa z’ibimazi vyose ihanga ryanje ry’Abisirayeli batanze?

"Nguku rero uko Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: ‘Nari narasezeranye ko inzu ya so ari yo izokorera imbere yanje ibihe vyose.’ Ubu rero Uhoraho avuze ati: ‘Ntibikabe!’ Abanyubaha ni bo nzokwubaha, ariko abankengera nanje nzobakengera."
Ehe igihe kiraje aho nzokwaka inkomezi wewe n’inzu ya so nkabaka ubuherezi, kugira ngo ntihabe hakibaho umuntu aramba mu ruvyaro rwawe,
kandi uzoba mu mubabaro uri mu nzu yanje. Naho Abisirayeli bazogirirwa neza, mu ruvyaro rwawe ntihazokwigera hongera kuboneka umuntu aramba agashika mu zabukuru.
Uwo nzosigaza adakuwe ku gicaniro canje azoba ari uwo kuguteza umubabaro no kukwihebuza, kandi abo mu ruvyaro rwawe bose bazopfa bakiri bato. Ariko abandi bose bazopfa bakiri mu myaka y’ubuto.
" ‘Ibizoba kuri Hofuni na Finehasi, abahungu bawe babiri, bizoba ikimenyetso c’ivyo, bazopfira umusi umwe.

Nzokwitorera uwuzombera umuherezi w’umwizigirwa, azokora ibiri ku mutima wanje no mu vyiyumviro vyanje. Kandi nzokomeza inzu y’ubuherezi bwiwe, baze bame bakorera imbere y’abami nasize amavuta ibihe vyose.

Ico gihe umuntu wese wo mu muryango wawe azosigara azoza amwunamire kugira ngo amuhe igiceri kimwe c’ifeza n’akavunguka k’umukate kandi amwinginge ati: "Ntabara umpe ico nkora mu bikorwa vy’ubuherezi kugira ngo ndonke ico kurya." ’ "
Uwo muhungu Samweli akorera Uhoraho musi y’uburongozi bwa Eli. Kandi, muri iyo misi, kwumva ijambo ry’ Uhoraho vyari imbonekarimwe; no kwerekwa kwari guke cane.
Ico gihe, Eli ntiyari akibona neza, amaso yiwe yari atanguye guhuma. Ijoro rimwe, Eli aja kuryama aho yari asanzwe aryama.
Itara ry’ Uhoraho ntiryari bwazime, kandi na Samweli yari aryamye mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , impande y’Isandugu y’Imana.
Maze Uhoraho ahamagara Samweli. Samweli aritaba ati: "Sabwe!"
Aca yiruka iyo Eli ari aravuga ati: "Ndi hano; wampamagaye?" Ariko Eli aravuga ati: "Sinaguhamagaye, subira kuryama." Nuko aragenda araryama.
Uhoraho asubira guhamagara ati: "Samweli!" Maze Samweli aravyuka aja iyo Eli ari aravuga ati: "Ndi hano; wampamagaye?" Eli aramwishura ati: "Mwana wanje, sinaguhamagaye; subira kuryama."
Samweli ntiyari bwamenye Uhoraho kuko ntiyari bwumve ijambo rivuye k’ Uhoraho .
Uhoraho ahamagara Samweli ubugira gatatu, maze Samweli aravyuka aja iyo Eli ari aravuga ati: "Ndi hano; wampamagaye?" Maze Eli aca amenya ko ari Uhoraho ariko arahamagara uwo muhungu.
Nuko Eli aca abwira Samweli ati: "Genda uryame, niyasubira kuguhamagara, uce uvuge uti: ‘Vuga, Uhoraho , kuko umusavyi wawe ndaguteze amatwi.’ " Nuko Samweli aragenda araryama mu kibanza ciwe.
Maze Uhoraho araza asubira guhamagara nk’uko yari yamye abigira ubwa mbere ati: "Samweli! Samweli!" Maze Samweli aravuga ati: "Vuga, kuko umusavyi wawe ndaguteze amatwi."
Nuko Uhoraho abwira Samweli ati: "Ehe, ngira nkore ikintu mu Bisirayeli kizotuma uwuzocumva wese agira iminzerere mu matwi.
Ngiye gushitsa kuri Eli ivyo namuburiye vyose ko bizomubako n’umuryango wiwe, uhereye ku ca mbere gushika ku ca nyuma.
Naramuburiye ko ngiye gucira urubanza rw’ibihe vyose umuryango wiwe kubera icaha co gucokora Uhoraho asanzwe azi neza ko abahungu biwe bakora, ariko ntababuze.
Kubera ivyo nararahiye abo mu nzu ya Eli nti: ‘Icaha c’inzu ya Eli ntikizokwigera gitangirwa impongano yaba iy’ikimazi canke iy’ishikanwa.’ "
Samweli asubira kuryama gushika mu gitondo aca yugurura imyango y’inzu y’ Uhoraho , ariko aratinya kubwira Eli ivyo yabwiwe.
Ariko Eli aramuhamagara amubwira ati: "Samweli mwana wanje." Samweli arishura ati: "Sabwe!"
Eli aramubaza ati: "Mbega bwabundi, Uhoraho yakubwiye iki? Ntubimpishe. Imana ibiguhanire, kandi birushirije, niwaramuka umpishije na kimwe mu vyo yakubariye."
Nuko Samweli amubwira vyose, ata na kimwe amuhishije. Nuko Eli aravuga ati: "Ni Uhoraho ; nakore ibibereye mu nyonga ziwe."
Uhoraho abana na Samweli mu gukura kwiwe, kandi ijambo ryose Samweli yavuga Imana yararyubahiriza ikarishitsa.
Kandi Abisirayeli bose uhereye i Dani ugushika i Berisheba bamenya ko Samweli ari uwuvugishwa n’ Uhoraho w’ukuri.
Uhoraho abandanya kwiyerekanira aho i Shilo, akiyereka Samweli biciye mw’ijambo ryiwe.

Kandi amajambo ya Samweli yagenda ashikirizwa Abisirayeli bose. Muri ico gihe, Abisirayeli baja kugwana n’Abafilisitiya. Abisirayeli bakoranira ahitwa Ebenezeri, Abafilisitiya na bo bakoranira ahitwa Afeki.
Abafilisitiya bakoranya ingabo zabo zose kugira ngo baje gutera Abisirayeli. Intambara irakomera cane, maze Abisirayeli baneshwa n’Abafilisitiya, babicamwo abantu ibihumbi bine ku rugamba.

Abasoda bagarutse aho bari bacumbitse, abakuru b’Abisirayeli barabaza bati: "Ni kuki Uhoraho yatumye tuneshwa uwu musi imbere y’Abafilisitiya? Nimuze tuzane Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho iri i Shilo, kugira ngo ajane natwe adukize ukuboko kw’abansi bacu."

Nuko abantu batuma intumwa i Shilo, baragenda bazana ya Sandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, avyagiye ku ntebe y’ubwami hagati y’Abakerubi. Abahungu ba Eli babiri, Hofuni na Finehasi, bari kumwe n’Isandugu y’Isezerano y’Imana.
Ya Sandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho ishitse aho bacumbitse, Abisirayeli bose barahaguruka biha akamo gakomeye kugeza aho isi inyiganyiga.
Abafilisitiya bumvise ako kamo, barabazanya bati: "Mbega ako kamo ko mu Baheburayo kavuye ku ki?" Bamaze kumenya ko ari kubera Isandugu y’ Uhoraho ishitse aho bacumbitse,
Abafilisitiya bagira ubwoba. Baravuga bati: "Imana yaje hagati muri bo. Turashize! Nta kintu nk’ico cari bwigere kibaho!
Turashize! Ni nde yodukiza ukuboko kw’izo mana zikomeye z’Abisirayeli? Izo ni zo zateje ivyago bikomeye cane Abanyegiputa igihe Abisirayeli bari mu bugaragwa.
Yemwe Bafilisitiya nimushikame! Mube abagabo, atari aho na ho muca muba abagurano b’Abaheburayo, nk’uko na bo bahora ari abagurano bacu. Nimube abagabo, mugwane!"
Nuko Abafilisitiya baragwana, hanyuma Abisirayeli baraneshwa, umuntu wese ahungira mw’ihema ryiwe. Abishwe bari benshi cane; uwo musi mu Bisirayeli hapfa abasoda ibihumbi mirongo itatu.
Isandugu y’Imana irafatwa, na Hofuni na Finehasi bene Eli barapfa.
Kuri uwo musi nyene, umuntu umwe wo mu muryango wa Benyamini ariruka ava ku rugamba aja i Shilo, yitabaguriyeko impuzu ziwe, yisutse n’umukungugu mu mutwe.

Ashitse asanga Eli yicaye ku ntebe yiwe i ruhande y’inzira, agerageza kwumva amakuru y’intambara, kuko yari ahagaritswe umutima n’Isandugu y’Imana. Uwo muntu yinjiye mu gisagara ababwira ivyabaye, abo muri ico gisagara bose baca bakoma induru.
Eli yumvise iyo nduru aca abaza ati: "Mbega iyo nduru ni iy’iki?" Wa muntu yihutira kuja aho Eli yari ari.
Eli yari amaze imyaka mirongo icenda n’umunani, amaso yiwe yarahumye atakibona.
Nuko abwira Eli ati: "Mvuye ubu nyene ku rugamba; mpunze mvayo uwu musi nyene." Eli aramubaza ati: "None vyagenze gute ga mwana wanje?"

Wa muntu yazanye inkuru arishura ati: "Abisirayeli bahunze imbere y’Abafilisitiya, kandi hapfuye abasoda benshi cane. Mbere n’abahungu bawe bompi, Hofuni na Finehasi bapfuye, n’Isandugu y’Imana bayitwaye."

Amaze kuvuga ivy’Isandugu y’Imana, Eli yikubita hasi atanguza umugongo avuye kuri ya ntebe yiwe aho yari ari i ruhande y’irembo. Izosi ryiwe riravunika aca arapfa, kuko yari ashaje kandi avyibushe cane. Yari amaze imyaka mirongo ine ari umucamanza w’Abisirayeli.

Umukazana wiwe, muka Finehasi, yari afise inda igeze kuvuka, yumvise iyo nkuru ko Isandugu y’Imana yafashwe kandi ko sebukwe n’umugabo wiwe bose bapfuye, afatwa n’ibise aca aravyara, ariko agira umubabaro urenze urugero.
Ari ku mpfiro, abakirizi baravuga bati: "Ntiwihebure; uvyaye umuhungu." Ariko ntiyagira ico yishura canke ngo anavyiteho.
Yita uwo muhungu Ikabodi, risigura ngo: "Icubahiro kivuye kuri Isirayeli," kuko bafashe Isandugu y’Imana kandi sebukwe n’umugabo wiwe bakaba bapfuye.
Aravuga ati: "Icubahiro cavuye kuri Isirayeli ko Isandugu y’Imana yafashwe."
Abafilisitiya bamaze gufata Isandugu y’Imana, bayikura i Ebenezeri bayijana i Ashidodi.
Batwara iyo Sandugu mu ngoro y’ikigirwamana Dagoni baca bayishira hambavu ya Dagoni.

Ariko, umusi ukurikira mu gitondo, abantu b’i Ashidodi, baravye babona ico kigirwamana Dagoni caguye cubamye hasi imbere ya ya Sandugu y’ Uhoraho ! Baca bafata ico kigirwamana Dagoni bagisubiza mu kibanza caco.
Bukeye mu gitondo bavyutse, babona ico kigirwamana Dagoni cubamye imbere y’Isandugu y’ Uhoraho , umutwe waco n’ibikonjo vyaco vyacitse birambaraye mu rwinjiriro; umutumba waco usigaye uri wonyene.
Ni co gituma gushika n’ubu ata muherezi wa Dagoni canke uwundi muntu yinjira mu ngoro ya Dagoni iri i Ashidodi ashobora gukandagira mu rwinjiriro.
Ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kwari guhanamiye abantu b’i Ashidodi n’imihana ihakikije; kuko kwabateza ivyago n’ibihute.
Abantu b’i Ashidodi babonye ibibaye, baravuga bati: "Isandugu y’Imana y’Abisirayeli ntishobora kuguma hano muri twebwe, kuko ukuboko kwayo kugomba kuturandura twebwe n’imana yacu Dagoni."

Nuko batumako abatware bose b’Abafilisitiya barababaza bati: "Iyi Sandugu y’Imana y’Abisirayeli tuyigire dute?" Na bo barabishura bati: "Iyo Sandugu y’Imana y’Abisirayeli nimuyimurire i Gati." Nuko barayimura.
Ariko bamaze kuyimura, ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kubangamira abantu b’ico gisagara, bituma bacika ivutu rwose. Abantu b’ico gisagara, uhereye ku bakiri bato ukageza ku bashaje, bose baterwa n’ibihute.

Nuko baca barungika iyo Sandugu y’Imana i Ekuroni. Ya sandugu igiseruka i Ekuroni, abantu baho bose bakoma induru bati: "Bazanye ya Sandugu y’Imana y’Abisirayeli muri twebwe kugira ngo itwicane n’abacu."

Nuko baca batumako abatware bose b’Abafilisitiya baravuga bati: "Nimwirukane iyo Sandugu y’Imana y’Abisirayeli; muyisubize aho yahora, bitari uko na ho izotumara twebwe n’abantu bacu." Abantu bo muri ico gisagara bari bacitse ivutu rwose, kubera ubwoba, batinya gupfa; kuko ukuboko kw’Imana kwari kubangamiye ico gisagara.
Abatapfuye bafashwe n’ibihute birabasesereza cane, gushika aho amaborogo y’abo muri ico gisagara aduga agashika mw’ijuru.
Iyo Sandugu y’ Uhoraho imaze mu gihugu c’Abafilisitiya amezi indwi,
Abafilisitiya bahamagara abaherezi n’abapfumu barababaza bati: "Iyi Sandugu y’ Uhoraho tuyigire dute? Tubwire uko twoyirungika igasubira iyo yaje iva."

Barabishura bati: "Nimwasubiza iyo Sandugu y’Imana y’Abisirayeli, ntimuyirungike igaragara, ariko muyirungikane n’ikimazi co kwisaba, kugira ngo mukire ivyo vyago. Nimwakira, muzoca mumenya ko ivyo vyago mwabiterwa n’ukuboko kwayo."

Abafilisitiya barababaza bati: "Ni ikihe kimazi co kwisaba twoyishikanira?" Barabishura bati: "Ni ibihute bitanu bicuzwe mu nzahabu n’imbeba zitanu zicuzwe mu nzahabu, nk’uko igitigiri c’abatware b’Abafilisitiya kingana, kuko ivyo vyago vyabateye mwebwe n’abatware banyu bose.

Mucure ibishushanyo vy’ivyo bihute n’izo mbeba biriko biratikiza igihugu, hanyuma mubirungikire iyo Mana y’Abisirayeli muyihe icubahiro. Kumbure yobagirira ikigongwe ikabakurako ukuboko kwayo kubahanamiye mwebwe n’imana zanyu n’igihugu canyu.
Ni kuki mukomantaza imitima yanyu nka kumwe Abanyegiputa na Farawo bagira? Mbega iyo Mana imaze kubahana bikomeye, ntibahavuye barekura Abisirayeli bakigira?
Nuko rero, nimurondere umukogote mushasha, n’inka zibiri zonsa kandi zitigeze zambikwa ingogo, muheze muziremeke uwo mukogote, ariko inyana zazo muzisubize mu ruhongore.

Mwakire ya Sandugu y’ Uhoraho muyishire kuri wa mukogote, mushire i ruhande yayo akandi gasandugu karimwo vya bihute na za mbeba bicuzwe mu nzahabu mwateguye kumushikanira nk’ikimazi co kwisaba, hanyuma muce mureka izo nka zigende,

ariko muzikurikize amaso. Nizaduga zija mu gihugu ca Isirayeli, zikagenda zerekeye i Beti-Shemeshi, azoba ari Uhoraho yaduteje ibi vyago. Ariko nibitaba uko, tuzoca tumenya ko atari ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kwadukubise, ko ivyadushikiye ari ivyizanye gutyo gusa."
Nuko bakora uko nyene. Bafata za nka baziboherako wa mukogote baca basubiza inyana zazo mu ruhongore.
Bashira ya Sandugu y’ Uhoraho ku mukogote hamwe na ka gasandugu karimwo za mbeba zicuzwe mu nzahabu na vya bimenyetso vy’ibihute.

Nuko za nka zigenda zerekeye i Beti-Shemeshi, zitumbereye inzira kandi zigenda zabira inzira yose; ntizahindukira i buryo canke i bubamfu. Abatware b’Abafilisitiya barazikurikira gushika zigeze ku rubibe rw’i Beti-Shemeshi.
Abantu b’i Beti-Shemeshi bariko barimbura ingano mu kiyaya, bunamutse babona ya Sandugu y’ Uhoraho , banezerezwa cane no kuyibona.

Uwo mukogote uraza ushika mu murima wa Yosuwa w’i Beti-Shemeshi, uhagararaho i ruhande y’igitandara kinini. Abantu baca basatagura ibiti bigize wa mukogote baca batanga za nka kw’ikimazi co guturirwa bagishikanira Uhoraho .

Abalewi bururutsa ya Sandugu y’ Uhoraho , na ka gasandugu karimwo vya bintu bicuzwe mu nzahabu, babirambika kuri ca gitandara kinini. Kuri uwo musi abantu b’i Beti-Shemeshi bashikanira Uhoraho amashikanwa aturiwe n’ibimazi.
Ba bakuru batanu b’Abafilisitiya babonye ivyo vyose baca basubira i Ekuroni kuri uwo musi nyene.
Vya bihute bicuzwe mu nzahabu Abafilisitiya barungitse nk’ikimazi co kwisaba bashikaniye Uhoraho vyatanzwe n’abakuru b’ibisagara vya Ashidodi, Gaza, Ashikeloni, Gati na Ekuroni.

Igitigiri ca za mbeba zicuzwe mu nzahabu cangana n’igitigiri c’ibisagara vy’i Bufilisitiya vyatwarwa n’abatware batanu, ibisagara bizitijwe inzitiro n’imihana ihakikije. Ico gitandara kinini, bateretseko iyo Sandugu y’ Uhoraho , ni icabona c’ivyabaye gushika n’uno musi aho kiri mu murima wa Yosuwa w’i Beti-Shemeshi.
Ariko Uhoraho ahana abantu bamwe b’i Beti-Shemeshi, yica mirongo indwi muri bo kuko baravye mw’Isandugu y’ Uhoraho . Abantu barabagandarira bababajwe n’uko Uhoraho yari yabahanye bikomeye.
Abantu b’i Beti-Shemeshi barabazanya bati: "Ni nde yoshobora guhagarara imbere y’ Uhoraho , iyo Mana itunganye? Mbega iyi sandugu twoyijana kwa nde ngo tuyikure hano?"
Baca barungika intumwa ku bantu b’i Kiriyati-Yeyarimu, bavuga bati: "Abafilisitiya bagarukanye ya Sandugu y’ Uhoraho . Nimumanuke muyidugane iwanyu."
Nuko abantu b’i Kiriyati-Yeyarimu badugana iyo Sandugu y’ Uhoraho , bayijana mu rugo kwa Abinadabu rwari ku gasozi, baca barobanura Eliyezeri umuhungu wiwe kugira ngo yiteho iyo Sandugu y’ Uhoraho .

Iyo Sandugu y’ Uhoraho imara igihe kirekire kingana n’imyaka mirongo ibiri yose, ikiri i Kiriyati-Yeyarimu. Muri ico gihe, Abisirayeli bose batakambira Uhoraho bababaye kuko bumva umenga Uhoraho yarabahevye.

Maze Samweli abwira Abisirayeli bose ati: "Nimwaba mugarutse k’ Uhoraho n’imitima yanyu yose, nimwitandukanye n’ibigirwamana vy’amahanga hamwe n’ibishushanyo vya Ashitaroti, mwiyegurire Uhoraho kandi mumukorere wenyene, na we azobakiza abakure mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya."
Nuko Abisirayeli bitandukanya n’ibigirwamana Bayali na Ashitaroti, bakorera Uhoraho wenyene.
Hanyuma Samweli aravuga ati: "Nkoraniriza Abisirayeli bose i Misipa nanje ndabasengera k’ Uhoraho ."

Bamaze gukoranira i Misipa, bavoma amazi bayasuka imbere y’ Uhoraho . Kuri uwo musi barisonzesha maze baratura bati: "Twaracumuye k’ Uhoraho ." Aho i Misipa ni ho Samweli yakorera nk’umucamanza w’Abisirayeli.
Abafilisitiya bamenye ko Abisirayeli bakoraniye i Misipa, abatware b’Abafilisitiya baca baduga kubatera. Abisirayeli na bo bavyumvise, baca baterwa n’ubwoba bwinshi kubera abo Bafilisitiya.
Babwira Samweli bati: "Ntuhagarike gutakambira Uhoraho Imana yacu ku bwacu, kugira ngo adutabare adukure mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya."
Maze Samweli afata umwagazi w’intama uconka awushikanira wose Uhoraho kw’ikimazi co guturirwa n’umuriro. Atakambira Uhoraho kubw’Abisirayeli, Uhoraho aramwishura.

Samweli agitanga ca kimazi giturirwa n’umuriro, Abafilisitiya barabegereza ngo babahwikire. Ariko kuri uwo musi Uhoraho aturagarira hejuru y’Abafilisitiya nk’umuturagaro ukomeye, bacika ivutu kubera ubwoba, bituma Abisirayeli babatsinda.
Abisirayeli baca bavuduka i Misipa bakurikira Abafilisitiya, bagenda barabicira mu nzira gushika musi y’igisagara ca Beti-Kari.
Maze Samweli afata ibuye arishinga hagati y’i Misipa n’i Sheni, aryita Ebenezeri, bisigura ngo: "Gushika n’ubu Uhoraho aracadutabara."
Nuko Abafilisitiya baratsindwa ntibasubira kwongera gutera Abisirayeli. Igihe cose Samweli yari akiriho, ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho kwagumye guhanamiye Abafilisitiya.

Abisirayeli bigarurira ibisagara vyose vyari hagati y’i Ekuroni n’i Gati, ivyo Abafilisitiya bari barabanyaze, kandi Abisirayeli bigarurira n’intara yari ibegereye bayinyaze Abafilisitiya. Haba impore hagati y’Abisirayeli n’Abamori.
Nuko Samweli aguma ari umucamanza w’Abisirayeli imisi yose yabayeho.
Ku mwaka yama afata urugendo akava i Beteli aja i Gilugali gushika i Misipa, acira Abisirayeli imanza muri ivyo bice vyose.
Ariko yama ataha i Rama, ahari urugo rwiwe, kandi n’aho nyene yarahacira imanza z’Abisirayeli. Maze yubakira Uhoraho igicaniro aho nyene.
Samweli ariko arasaza, aha abahungu biwe uburongozi, baba abacamanza b’Abisirayeli.
Imfura yiwe yitwa Yoweli, uwa kabiri akitwa Abiya, kandi bakorera i Berisheba.
Ariko abahungu ba Samweli ntibakurikije akarorero ka se, kuko bakikamye bakarondera inyungu mbi, batangura kurya ibiturire no guca imanza zitabereye.
Nuko abakuru bose bo mu Bisirayeli baja hamwe baja aho Samweli yari ari i Rama.
Baramubwira bati: "Raba urashaje, kandi abana bawe ntibakurikiza akarorero kawe; nuko rero turonderere umwami wo kuturongora, nk’uko bimeze mu yandi mahanga."
Ariko bamaze kuvuga bati: "Duhe umwami wo kuturongora," ivyo bibabaza Samweli; aca asenga Uhoraho ngo amusobanuze.
Uhoraho aramubwira ati: "Niwemere ivyo vyose abantu bariko barakubwira; kuko si wewe banse, ni jewe banse ko nshishikara kuba umwami wabo.
Uko bari bameze kuva igihe nabakura muri Egiputa gushika n’uwu musi, ni ko bakimeze, bama bantera ibitugu bakaja gukorera izindi mana, kandi nawe ni vyo bakugiriye.
Ubu rero bumvirize; ariko ubagabishe, ubamenyeshe neza ivyo umwami azobaganza bazotegerezwa kumukorera."
Nuko Samweli abwira abo bantu bariko baramusaba umwami amajambo yose Uhoraho yamubwiye.
Ababwira ati: "Ibi ni vyo umwami azobaganza azobasaba ko mumukorera: azofata abahungu banyu abakoreshe ku mikogote no ku mafarasi yiwe, kandi bazohora bama bagenda bariruka imbere y’imikogote yiwe.

Bamwe azobagira abo kuganza abasoda igihumbi, abandi abo kuganza abasoda mirongo itanu gutyo gutyo, abandi babe abo kumurimira amatongo yiwe no kwimbura ivyimburwa vyiwe, kandi abandi bazoba abo gucura ibigwanisho vy’intambara n’ibikoresho vy’imikogote yiwe.
Abakobwa banyu azobatwara babe abo guhingura ibimota neza, abatetsi n’abotsa imikate.
Azotwara imirima, imizabibu n’imyelayo vyanyu vyizavyiza, abihe abamukorera.
Azotwara ikigiracumi c’ingano zanyu n’imizabibu yanyu abihe abishikira biwe n’abamukorera.
Abakozi banyu b’abahungu n’abakobwa n’ivyiza vyo mu nka n’indogoba vyanyu azobitwara abikoreshe ivyiwe.
Azotwara ikigiracumi c’amasho yanyu, kandi namwe ubwanyu muzoba abagurano biwe.
Uwo musi niwashika, muzotaka musaba icobakurako uwo mwami muriko murasaba, ariko Uhoraho ntazobishura."
Ariko abantu banka kwumviriza Samweli. Baravuga bati: "Oya, dushaka umwami wo kutuganza.
Natwe tuzoca tuba nk’ayandi mahanga, dufise umwami wo kuturongora kandi akatuja imbere tugiye kugwana mu ntambara."
Maze Samweli yumvise ivyo abantu bavuze vyose, abibwira Uhoraho .
Uhoraho amwishura ati: "Kora ivyo bagusavye ubahe umwami." Nuko Samweli abwira Abisirayeli ati: "Umuntu wese nasubire mu gisagara ciwe."
Hariho Umuntu wo mu muryango wa Benyamini, yari atunze, yitwa Kishi wa Abiyeli, Abiyeli wa Zerori, Zerori wa Bekorati, Bekorati wa Afiya, Afiya wa Benyamini.
Uwo Kishi yari afise umuhungu yitwa Sawuli, yari umuhungu mwiza w’akaranga kurusha Abisirayeli bose, kandi no mu burebure yarabasumba bose.
Umusi umwe indogoba za Kishi se wa Sawuli zirazimira, maze Kishi abwira umuhungu wiwe Sawuli ati: "Jana n’umukozi umwe muje kurondera izo ndogoba."

Nuko baca mu ntara y’imisozi ya Efurayimu no mu karere kegereye Shalisha, ariko ntibazibona. Barabandanya baca mu ntara y’i Shayalimu, ariko izo ndogoba ntizariyo. Nuko baca mu ntara ya Benyamini, ariko ntibazitora.
Bashitse mu karere k’i Zufi, Sawuli abwira wa mukozi bari kumwe ati: "Nuze dusubire inyuma, kuko data yohava areka kwiyumvira indogoba ziwe agatangura guhagarikira umutima twebwe."
Ariko wa mukozi amwishura ati: "Raba muri iki gisagara hari umuntu w’Imana; arubashwe rwose, kandi ico avuze cose kiba kuno. Reka tujeyo ubu nyene. Kumbure yotubwira inzira dukwiye kujana."
Sawuli abwira uwo mukozi wiwe ati: "Mbega nitwajayo uwo muntu tumugemurira iki? Ehe indya zaheze mu mifuko yacu! Nta co dufise tugemurira uwo muntu w’Imana. Nta co dusigaranye?"
Uwo mukozi arongera amubwira ati: "Raba ndafise ica kane ca shekeli y’ifeza. Ndaja kugiha uwo muntu w’Imana kugira ngo aturangire inzira dukwiye kujana."
(Kera muri Isirayeli, iyo umuntu agiye gusiguza Imana, yavuga ati: "Ingo, tuje kuraba uwerekwa," kuko uwitwa uwuvugishwa n’Imana uno musi, ico gihe yitwa uwerekwa.)
Sawuli abwira umukozi wiwe ati: "Ni vyiza, ingo tugende." Nuko bagenda batumbereye ico gisagara wa muntu w’Imana yabamwo.
Bakiduga umusozi baja muri ico gisagara, bahura n’abakobwa bavuyeyo bamanutse kuvoma amazi, barababaza bati: "Mbega uwerekwa yoba ari ho ari?"
Barabishura bati: "Ni ho ari. Ari aho imbere yanyu. Nimwihute; ashitse mu gisagara ubu nyene, kuko abantu bateguye gutanga ikimazi hejuru ku musozi.

Nimunyaruke mumushikire ataraja ahabera amazimano. Abantu ntibaja gufungura adashitse, kuko ategerezwa kubanza guhezagira ikimazi; mu nyuma yaho abatumiwe baca bafungura. Nimuduge; muca mumubona mu mwanya."
Baraduga baja mu gisagara, maze bacinjira, babona Samweli, aza atumbereye aho bari ariko araduga muri ico kibanza kiri hejuru ku musozi.
Ariko umusi umwe imbere y’uko Sawuli aza, Uhoraho yari yiyeretse Samweli amubwira ati:

"Ejo nk’aya masaha nzokurungikira umuntu avuye mu muryango wa Benyamini. Uze umurobanuze amavuta abe umurongozi w’abantu banje b’Abisirayeli; ni we azorokora abantu banje abakure mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya. Nahindukirije inyonga zanje ku bantu banje, kandi ugutakamba kwabo kwanshikiriye."
