Abo bagwanyi bose baje bafise umutima umwe kandi ukunze kugira ngo bimike Dawidi abe umwami wa Isirayeli. Mbere n’abandi Bisirayeli bose basigaye baremeza ko Dawidi ari we akwiye kubabera umwami.
Abo bantu bamara imisi itatu bari kumwe na Dawidi, barya banywa, kuko imiryango yabo yari yabagemuriye.

Vyongeye, n’abo hirya no hino gushika no mu Bisakari, Abazebuloni no mu Banafutali baraza bazanye ivyokurya ku ndogoba, ku ngamiya, ku nyumbu, no ku nka. Hariho n’ibintu vyinshi bigizwe n’ifu, n’insukoni zikaranze, inzabibu zikaranze, umuvinyu, amavuta, inka n’intama, kuko hari umunezero mwinshi mu Bisirayeli.
Dawidi avugana n’abakuru barongoye abandi, abarongoye imice y’ingabo igihumbi n’abarongoye imice y’ingabo ijana.

Maze abwira Abisirayeli bose ati: "Nivyaba bibahimbaye kandi ari ubugombe bw’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, reka dutume intumwa ku bari kure n’abari hafi benewanyu bari mu bice vyose vya Isirayeli, no ku baherezi n’Abalewi bari kumwe na bo mu bisagara vyabo n’uburagiro bwavyo, baze bafatanye natwe.
Tugende tugarukane iwacu Isandugu y’Imana yacu, kuko tutigeze tuvyitaho ku ngoma ya Sawuli."
Ikoraniro ryose riremera ko bakora uko, kuko abantu bose babonye ko ari vyiza.
Nuko Dawidi akoranya Abisirayeli bose, kuva ku ruzi Shihori ari ko kagezi ka Egiputa gushika i Lebo-Hamati, ngo baje kuzana Isandugu y’Imana yari i Kiriyati-Yeyarimu.
Dawidi n’Abisirayeli bose bajana na we i Bayala h’i Buyuda, ari ho Kiriyati-Yeyarimu, kugira ngo bakureyo isandugu y’ Uhoraho Imana, ivyagiye hagati y’abakerubi, isandugu yitirirwa rya Zina.
Bakura isandugu y’Imana mu nzu kwa Abinadabu iri ku mukogote mushasha, Uza na Ahiyo bayoboye uwo mukogote.
Dawidi n’Abisirayeli bose bariko bariginagura imbere y’Imana n’inkomezi zabo zose, baririmba bavuza inanga, amakembe, udushako tw’ingoma, inzumbete n’ibindi bicurarangisho.
Bashitse ku mbuga yo kugosorerako ya Kidoni, Uza agorora ukuboko kwiwe ngo asame iyo sandugu, kuko impfizi zikwega uwo mukogote zari zitsitaye.
Uhoraho ashavurira cane Uza, maze aramukubita arapfa kuko akoze kuri iyo sandugu. Nuko aca apfira ngaho nyene imbere y’Imana.
Maze Dawidi arashavura kuko Uhoraho yarakiye Uza. Aca yita aho hantu Perezi-Uza, bisigura "gushavurira Uza"; kandi ni ko hacitwa kugeza n’uno musi.
Dawidi aca atinya Imana kuri uwo musi, maze arabaza ati: "Mbega noshobora nte kuzana Isandugu y’Imana iwanje?"
Ntiyatwara iyo Sandugu ngo ije mu Gisagara ca Dawidi, ariko aca ayikebereza mu nzu kwa Obedi-Edomu w’i Gati.
Iyo Sandugu y’Imana iguma mu nzu kwa Obedi-Edomu no mu muryango wiwe amezi atatu, maze Uhoraho ahezagira umuryango wa Obedi-Edomu n’ivyo ari atunze vyose.
Maze Hiramu umwami w’i Tiro arungika intumwa kwa Dawidi, azirungikana n’ibiti vy’amasederi, n’abubatsi bubakisha amabuye n’ababaji bo kumwubakira ikirimba.
Maze Dawidi aca amenya ko Uhoraho yemeje ko ari we mwami w’Abisirayeli bose kandi ko yashize hejuru ubwami bwiwe kubera abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli.
Dawidi arongorera i Yerusalemu abandi bagore, avyara abandi bahungu n’abakobwa.
Aya ni yo mazina y’abana yavyariye i Yerusalemu: Shamuwa, Shobabu, Natani, Salomo,
Ibuhari, Elishuwa, Elupeleti,
Nogahu, Nefegi, Yafiya,
Elishama, Beyeliyada na Elifeleti.
Abafilisitiya bumvise ko Dawidi yasizwe amavuta ngo abe umwami w’Abisirayeli bose, baraduga n’inkomezi zabo zose bagiye kumurondera ngo bamufate; ariko Dawidi avyumvise aca aja guhura na bo.
Maze Abafilisitiya barashika bacumbika mu kiyaya c’i Refayimu;
Dawidi aca asiguza Imana ati: "Mbega nje gutera Abafilisitiya? Urabampa mu maboko yanje?" Uhoraho aramwishura ati: "Genda, nzobatanga mu maboko yawe."

Nuko Dawidi n’ingabo ziwe baraduga baja i Bayali-Perazimu, kandi aho ni ho yabaneshereje. Aravuga ati: "Imana yansaturiye inzira mu bansi banje ikoresheje ukuboko kwanje nk’uko amazi asenyura urugomero." Ni co catumye aho hantu hitwa Bayali-Perazimu.
Abafilisitiya bari batayeho ibigirwamana vyabo, maze Dawidi aca atanga itegeko ngo babiturire.
Ikindi gihe Abafilisitiya bongera gucumbika mu kiyaya;
maze Dawidi yongera kubaza Imana ico yokora, na yo iramwishura iti: "Ntubatere ubaturutse imbere, ariko ubazunguruke ubatere ubaturutse inyuma aharabana na biriya biti vy’imibaka.
Niwumva imirindi mu bushorishori bw’ivyo biti, uce utangura kubagwanya, kuko Imana izoba ikugiye imbere kugwanya ingabo z’Abafilisitiya."
Nuko Dawidi akora nk’uko Imana yamutegetse, maze bica ingabo z’Abafilisitiya kuva i Gibeyoni gushika i Gezeri.
Nuko Dawidi aba rurangiranwa mu gihugu cose, kandi Uhoraho atuma ibihugu vyose bimutinya.
Dawidi amaze kwubaka inyubakwa ziwe mu Gisagara ca Dawidi, aca ategura ikibanza c’Isandugu y’Imana, ayishingira ihema.
Maze Dawidi aravuga ati: "Nta muntu n’umwe atari Umulewi akwiye guterura Isandugu y’Imana, kuko Uhoraho yabatoranirije kurerura iyo Sandugu yiwe no kwama bamukorera bari imbere yiwe ibihe bidashira."
Dawidi akoranya Abisirayeli bose i Yerusalemu ngo badugane Isandugu y’ Uhoraho bayizane mu kibanza yari yayiteguriye.
Ahamagara abo mu ruvyaro rwa Aroni n’Abalewi:
Abo mu nzu ya Kohati, Uriyeli umukuru wabo hamwe na benewabo ijana na mirongo ibiri;
abo mu nzu ya Merari, Asaya umukuru wabo hamwe na benewabo amajana abiri na mirongo ibiri;
abo mu nzu ya Gerishomu, Yoweli umukuru wabo hamwe na benewabo ijana na mirongo itatu;
abo mu nzu ya Elizafani, Shemaya umukuru wabo hamwe na benewabo amajana abiri;
abo mu nzu ya Heburoni, Eliyeli umukuru wabo hamwe na benewabo mirongo umunani;
abo mu ya Uziyeli, Aminadabu umukuru wabo hamwe na benewabo ijana na cumi na babiri.
Hanyuma Dawidi atumako Sadoki na Abiyatari abaherezi, na Uriyeli, Asaya, Yoweli, Shemaya, Eliyeli na Aminadabu Abalewi.

Arababwira ati: "Ni mwebwe bakuru b’inzu zigize umuryango w’Abalewi; mwebwe na bagenzi banyu b’Abalewi nimwiyeze kugira ngo muje kudugana Isandugu y’ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli, muyizane mu kibanza nayitunganirije.
Kubera yuko, mwebwe Abalewi, mutayireruye ca gihe ni co catumye Uhoraho Imana yacu aturakira. Ntitwamusiguje ngo atubwire uko yavuze bizohora bikorwa."
Nuko abaherezi n’Abalewi bariyeza kugira ngo baje kudugana Isandugu y’ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli.
Kandi Abalewi barerura Isandugu y’Imana iri ku biti bibiri biteruwe n’abantu bane ku bitugu vyabo, nk’uko Mose yari yarabitegetse yisunze ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .
Dawidi abwira abakuru bo mu Balewi ngo batoranye muri bagenzi babo b’abaririmvyi abo kuririmba indirimbo z’umunezero, bavuza n’ibicurarangisho: amakembe, inanga n’udushako tw’ingoma.
Maze Abalewi batoranya Hemani mwene Yoweli; mu bavukanyi biwe, Asafu mwene Berekiya; no muri benewabo b’Abamerari, Etani mwene Kushaya;
bari kumwe na benewabo bo ku rwego rwa kabiri: Zakariya, Yayaziyeli, Shemiramoti, Yehiyeli, Uni, Eliyabu, Benaya, Mayaseya, Matitiya, Elifelehu, Mikuneya, Obedi-Edomu na Yeyiyeli, abarinzi b’irembo.
Abacuraranzi Hemani, Asafu na Etani bavuza ivyuma vy’imiringa;
Zakariya, Aziyeli, Shemiramoti, Yehiyeli, Uni, Eliyabu, Mayaseya na Benaya bacuraranga amakembe mw’ijwi ryitwa alamoti,
nayo Matitiya, Elifelehu, Mikuneya, Obedi-Edomu, Yeyiyeli na Azaziya bavuza inanga, mw’ijwi ryitwa Sheminite.
Kenaniya umukuru w’Abalewi yari arongoye abaririmvyi, kuko yari umuhinga muri vyo.
Berekiya na Elukana bari abarinzi b’urugi rw’ihema ry’isandugu.

Shebaniya, Yoshafati, Netaneli, Amasayi, Zakariya, Benaya na Eliyezeri abaherezi bari bashinzwe kuvuza inzamba imbere y’Isandugu y’Imana. Obedi-Edomu na Yehiya na bo nyene bari bashinzwe kurinda umuryango w’isandugu.
Nuko Dawidi n’abakuru bose b’Abisirayeli n’intwazangabo zirongoye ingabo igihumbihumbi, bagenda kudugana Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho bayikura mu nzu kwa Obedi-Edomu, bari n’umunezero mwinshi.
Kandi kubera ko Imana yafashije Abalewi bari bareruye iyo Sandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho , baciye batanga ibimazi vy’amashuri y’inka indwi n’amapfizi y’intama indwi.

Muri ico gihe Dawidi yari yambaye ikanzu yera derere, co kimwe n’Abalewi bose bari bareruye iyo Sandugu, n’abaririmvyi, na Kenaniya umukuru w’imigwi y’abaririmvyi; kandi Dawidi yari yambaye na efodi yera.

Nuko Abisirayeli bose badugana iyo Sandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho batera akamo k’umunezero, bavuza inzamba zikozwe mu mahembe y’intama n’inzumbete, n’ivyuma bivuzwa bigasama, bavuza n’amakembe n’inanga.
Maze Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho yinjiye mu Gisagara ca Dawidi, Mikali umukobwa wa Sawuli abirabira mw’idirisha. Abonye umwami Dawidi atamba yiginagura, amugayira mu mutima.
Maze bazana ya Sandugu y’Imana bayinjiza muri rya hema Dawidi yari yarayiteguriye, hanyuma batanga ibimazi biturirwa n’umuriro hamwe n’ivy’ishimwe imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Ahejeje gutanga ivyo bimazi biturirwa n’umuriro n’ivy’ishimwe, ahezagira abantu mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho .
Aca aha Umwisirayeli wese, yaba umugabo canke umugore, umukate, inyama n’akandi gakate gakozwe mu nzabibu.
Aca atoranya bamwe mu Balewi ngo bakorere imbere y’Isandugu y’ Uhoraho , bambaze, bashime, bahimbaze Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli:

Asafu ni we yari umukuru, Zakariya akaba uwa kabiri, hanyuma Yeyiyeli, Shemiramoti, Yehiyeli, Matitiya, Eliyabu, Benaya, Obedi-Edomu na Yeyiyeli. Bari bashinzwe kuvuza amakembe n’inanga, Asafu akavuza ivyuma bisama,
Benaya na Yahaziyeli abaherezi na bo bakavuza inzamba uko igihe cagenywe gishitse imbere y’Isandugu y’Isezerano y’Imana.
Kuri uwo musi Dawidi ashinga ubwa mbere Asafu n’abo bari bafatanije ngo baririmbe iyi ndirimbo yo gutanga ishimwe k’ Uhoraho :
Nimuhimbaze Uhoraho , mwamamaze izina ryiwe; mumenyekanishe mu mahanga ivyo yakoze.
Nimumuririmbire, mumuhimbaze; muvuge ibikorwa vyiwe bihambaye.
Mwirate izina ryiwe ryera; imitima y’abarondera Uhoraho inezerwe.
Nimurondere Uhoraho n’inkomezi ziwe; mwame murondera mu nyonga hiwe.
Nimwibuke ibitangaza yakoze, utwumiza, n’imanza yaciye;
Yemwe ruvyaro rwa Isirayeli, umusavyi wayo; yemwe bene Yakobo, abo yatoranije.
Uhoraho ni we Mana yacu; imanza ziwe ziri mw’isi yose.
Nimwibuke isezerano ryiwe ibihe vyose, n’ijambo yasezeranye, gushika ku runganwe rugira igihumbi,
Isezerano yagiranye na Aburahamu, indahiro yarahiye Isaka.
Yararyemeje kuri Yakobo nk’itegeko, no kuri Isirayeli nk’isezerano ry’intahava ngo:
"Nzoguha igihugu c’i Kanani, kibe umugabane wawe uzoragwa."
Igihe bari bakiri inkehwa gusa, mbere ari inkehwa vy’ukuri, kandi ari inyambukira muri co,
Bagenda bangara bava mu gihugu baja mu kindi, bava mu bwami baja mu bundi.
Ntiyakundira umuntu n’umwe kubacinyiza; ku bwabo yakankamiye abami ati:
"Ntimukore ku bo narobanuje amavuta; ntimugirire nabi abavugishwa banje."
Yemwe abari mw’isi mwese, muririmbire Uhoraho , mwamamaze agakiza kiwe uko bukeye,
Muvuge ivy’icubahiro ciwe mu mahanga yose, n’ibitangaza yakoze mu moko yose.
Kuko Uhoraho ahambaye kandi abereye gushimwa; akwiye kwubahwa kuruta ibigirwamana vyose.
Kuko imana zose z’amahanga ari ibigirwamana, ariko Uhoraho yaremye amajuru.
Ubwiza n’icubahiro biri imbere yiwe; inkomezi n’umunezero biri mu ngoro yiwe.
Nimwemere Uhoraho , yemwe miryango yose yo mu mahanga, mwemere ko Uhoraho afise icubahiro n’inkomezi.
Nimuhe Uhoraho icubahiro kibereye izina ryiwe; Muzane ishikanwa, mushike mu birimba vyiwe. Musenge Uhoraho muri mu bwiza bw’ukwera kwiwe.
Yemwe abari mw’isi mwese, muhindire agashitsi imbere yiwe! Isi irashimangiye; ntishobora kunyiganyizwa.
Ijuru nirinezerwe, isi nihimbarwe; nibivuge mu mahanga yose biti: " Uhoraho araganje!"
Ikiyaga nikibomborane, n’ibiri muri co vyose; imirima yose nivyine, n’ibiri muri yo vyose!
Maze ibiti vyo mw’ishamba bizoririmba. Bizoririmbishwa n’umunezero mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , kuko aje gucira isi urubanza.
Nimushime Uhoraho kuko ari mwiza; kuko urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Nimutakambe muti: "Dukize, yewe Mana y’agakiza kacu; twegeranye udukure mu mahanga, kugira ngo dushime izina ryawe ryera, twongere tuguhimbaze."
Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, ahimbazwe Uhereye ibihe bidashira ukageza ibihe bidashira. Maze abantu bose baritabira bati: "Amen"; bongerako bati: "Dutazire Uhoraho."
Dawidi aca ashinga ko Asafu n’abo bari kumwe imbere y’Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho bazoguma aho bayikorera imisi yose, nk’uko vyari bitegekanijwe ku musi ku musi.
Ashinga ko Obedi-Edomu mwene Yedutuni, na Hosa, n’abandi Balewi mirongo itandatu n’umunani, baba abarinzi b’irembo.
Dawidi ashinga ko Sadoki umuherezi na bagenzibe b’abaherezi bama imbere y’ihema ry’ Uhoraho ku mpinga y’umusozi i Gibeyoni
ngo bashikanire Uhoraho ibimazi vyo guturirirwa ku gicaniro bashikanirako ibimazi vyo ku musi ku musi, nk’uko vyanditswe mu Vyagezwe Uhoraho yahawe Abisirayeli.
Abandi bari kumwe na bo ni Hemani na Yedutuni n’abandi bose bari baratoranijwe uko amazina yabo ari ngo bashime Uhoraho bavuga bati: "Kuko urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira."
Hemani na Yedutuni bari bashinzwe kuvuza inzamba n’ivyuma bisama no kuvuza ibindi bicurarangisho mu kuririmba indirimbo z’Imana. Bene Yedutuni bahabwa igikorwa co gucungera irembo.
Nuko abantu bose barataha, umwe wese aja iwe, Dawidi na we asubira iwe ahezagira umuryango wiwe.
Dawidi amaze gushika neza mu ngoro iwe, abwira Natani uwavugishwa n’Imana ati: "Ehe raba, jewe mba mu nzu yubatswe n’ibiti vy’amasederi, nayo Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho iba mw’ihema."
Natani yishura Dawidi ati: "Ivyo wiyumvira gukora vyose, genda ubikore kuko Imana iri kumwe nawe."
Ariko muri iryo joro, ijambo ry’Imana riza kuri Natani riti:
"Genda ubwire umusavyi wanje Dawidi uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Si wewe uzonyubakira inzu yo kubamwo.
Sinigeze mba mu nzu kuva igihe nakuriye Abisirayeli muri Egiputa gushika uwu musi. Namye nimuka mva mu kibanza kimwe nja mu kindi, nkibera mw’ihema.
Ahantu hose nimukiye ndi kumwe n’Abisirayeli bose, hari aho nigeze mbwira umutware n’umwe mu barongozi nabahaye ngo baragire ubwoko bwanje nti: Ni kuki mutanyubakira inzu mu biti vy’amasederi?’
None rero, genda ubwire umusavyi wanje Dawidi uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: nagukuye mu bwungere aho waragira intama, ndagutoranya ngo ube uwuganza abantu banje b’Abisirayeli.
Nabanye nawe aho wagiye hose, kandi naherengeteje abansi bawe imbere yawe. None ngira nkuze izina ryawe ribe nk’amazina y’abahambaye bo kw’isi.

Kandi nzoha abantu banje b’Abisirayeli aho kuba, ndabateragire ahantu hatekanye ngo bagire inzu yabo bwite, aho batazokwongera kuburagizwa. Abansi babo ntibazosubira kubacinyiza nk’uko bahora babigira kera,

canke nk’uko bamye babikora uhereye igihe nashiraho abacamanza bo kurongora abantu banje b’Abisirayeli. Kandi nzocisha bugufi abansi bawe bose. Kandi ikirenze kuri ivyo, ndakumenyesheje ko ari Uhoraho azokwubakira inzu.
Imisi yawe niyashira ugahamvya ba sogokuruza, nzohagurutsa uwo mu ruvyaro rwawe wo kugusubirira ku ngoma, umwe wo mu bahungu bawe wivyariye, kandi nzokomeza ubwami bwiwe.
Uwo ni we azonyubakira ingoro, nanje nzokomeza ingoma yiwe ibihe bidashira.
Nzomubera se, na we azombera umwana. Kandi sinzokwigera ndamukurako urukundo rwanje, nka kurya narukuye ku wo wasubiriye ku ngoma.
Nzomuzeza inzu yanje n’ubwami bwanje ibihe vyose; intebe y’inganji yiwe izokwama ihangamye ibihe bidashira."
Nuko Natani aragenda ashikiriza Dawidi ayo majambo yose y’uko guhishurirwa.
Nuko umwami Dawidi arinjira yicara imbere y’ Uhoraho , maze avuga ati: "Jewe ndi iki, yewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, kandi n’umuryango wanje wari iki, ko wanshikanye aha hose?
Kandi nk’aho umenga ivyo vyose ntivyari bihagije mu nyonga zawe ga Mana, warongeyeko uvuga ivya kazoza k’inzu y’umusavyi wawe. Wewe Uhoraho Mana, wandavye nk’uko umenga ndi hejuru y’abandi bose.
Mbega jewe Dawidi ikindi novuga ni iki ku vy’icubahiro wampaye jewe umusavyi wawe? Kuko urazi umusavyi wawe,
yewe Uhoraho . Wakoze iki kintu gihambaye, wongera umenyesha amasezerano yawe ahambaye nk’uko wabigomvye.
Nta n’umwe asa nawe Uhoraho , kandi nta yindi Mana atari wewe, nk’uko twavyiyumviye n’amatwi yacu.

Kandi ni irihe hanga kw’isi yose rimeze nk’abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli; ihanga wewe Imana wihagurukiye ukaja gucungura kugira ngo ribe iryo wiharije; kandi kugira ngo wiheshe icubahiro, ugakora ibihambaye biteye ubwoba, ukirukana amahanga imbere y’abantu bawe wacunguye ukabakura muri Egiputa?
Wahinduye abantu bawe b’Abisirayeli kuba abo wiharije ibihe vyose, kandi nawe Uhoraho , wahindutse Imana yabo.
None rero, Uhoraho , ivyo wasezeraniye umusavyi wawe n’inzu yiwe uze ubikomeze kugeza ibihe vyose. Uze ukore nk’uko wasezeranye,

kugira ngo bishike kandi izina ryawe ribe irihambaye ibihe bidashira. Maze abantu bazovuge bati: ‘ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana iganza Abisirayeli, ni yo Mana y’Abisirayeli!’ Kandi n’inzu y’umusavyi wawe Dawidi izokomerera imbere yawe.
Ewe Mana yanje, wahishuriye umusavyi wawe ko uzomwubakira inzu. Ni co catumye umusavyi wawe nterwa intege zo kugusenga.
None rero Uhoraho , uri Imana! Wasezeraniye umusavyi wawe ibi vyiza bingana bityo.
Vyaguhimbaye guha umugisha inzu y’umusavyi wawe, ngo izohore iri imbere yawe ibihe vyose; kuko ubwawe, yewe Uhoraho wayihezagiye, kandi izokwama ihezagiwe ibihe vyose."
Inyuma y’ivyo, Dawidi atera Abafilisitiya arabanesha, maze afata Gati n’imihana ihakikije abikura mu maboko y’Abafilisitiya.
Dawidi arongera anesha Abanyamowabu, bacika abagurano biwe bakama bamuzanira amashikanwa yo kumwisaba.
Vyongeye, Dawidi agwanya Hadadezeri umwami w’i Zoba aramunesha gushika i Hamati, mu gihe Hadadezeri yari agiye gukomeza inganji yiwe mu karere k’uruzi Efurate.

Dawidi amunyaga imikogote igihumbi, abayigenderamwo ibihumbi indwi n’abasoda bagwanira ku maguru ibihumbi mirongo ibiri. Acagagura ibinono vy’amafarasi akwega iyo mikogote, asigaza ayo gukwega imikogote ijana gusa.
Maze Abaramu b’i Damasiko baja gutabara Hadadezeri umwami w’i Zoba, Dawidi abicamwo abantu ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bibiri.
Aca ashinga ibirindiro i Damasiko ku mugwa mukuru w’i Siriya kandi Abaramu bacika abagurano biwe, bakama bamuzanira amashikanwa yo kumwisaba. Uhoraho yama aha Dawidi intsinzi aho yaja hose.
Dawidi afata inkinzo z’inzahabu zari iz’intwazangabo za Hadadezeri, azijana i Yerusalemu.

Mu bisagara vy’i Tibuhati n’i Kuni vyari ivya Hadadezeri, Dawidi ahanyaga ubutare bwinshi bw’umwakaka, ubwo Salomo yakoresheje mu kwubaka ibesani nini y’umwakaka bita ikiyaga, inkingi n’ibindi bikoresho vyari bikozwe muri ubwo butare.
Maze Towu umwami w’i Hamati yumvise ko Dawidi yanesheje ingabo zose za Hadadezeri umwami w’i Zoba,

aca arungika umuhungu wiwe Hadoramu ku mwami Dawidi kumuramutsa no kumukeza, kuko yanesheje Hadadezeri yahora yama amugwanya. Hadoramu ajana ibikoresho vy’ubwoko bwinshi, vy’inzahabu n’ivy’ifeza n’ivy’umwakaka.

Umwami Dawidi aca yegurira Uhoraho ivyo bikoresho vyose, nk’uko yari yabigize ku nzahabu n’ifeza yari yakuye muri ivyo bihugu vyose ari vyo vy’Abanyedomu, Abanyamowabu, Abamoni, Abafilisitiya n’Abamaleki.
Abishayi mwene Zeruwiya yica Abanyedomu ibihumbi cumi n’umunani mu Kiyaya c’Umunyu.
Ashira ibirindiro mu gihugu ca Edomu, kandi Abanyedomu bose baca baba abagurano ba Dawidi. Uhoraho yama aha intsinzi Dawidi aho yaja hose.
Dawidi aganza Abisirayeli bose, akora ibibereye n’ibigororotse ku bantu biwe bose.
Yowabu mwene Zeruwiya ni we yari umukuru w’ingabo; Yehoshafati mwene Ahiludi na we yari umwanditsi w’ivyaja biraba;
Sadoki mwene Ahitubu na Abimeleki mwene Abiyatari bari abaherezi; Shavisha yari umunyamabanga;
Benaya mwene Yehoyada yari ajejwe Abakereti n’Abapeleti; kandi abahungu ba Dawidi bari abahanuzi bakuru b’umwami.
Hanyuma y’ivyo, Nahashi umwami w’Abamoni arapfa, maze umuhungu wiwe amusubirira ku ngoma.

Dawidi ariyumvira ati: "Nzogirira neza Hanuni mwene Nahashi, kuko se yangiriye neza." Nuko Dawidi atuma intumwa ngo zije kugarukira kuri Hanuni kuko yari yabuze se. Ba bantu ba Dawidi bashitse kwa Hanuni mu gihugu c’Abamoni kumwirura,

abaganwa b’Abamoni babwira Hanuni bati: "Wibaza ko Dawidi yubashe so mu kukurungikira abantu ngo bakugarukireko? Abantu biwe ubwo ntibazanywe no kugenzura igihugu no kuraba ingene kimeze ngo baze bagitere?"
Nuko Hanuni afata ba bantu ba Dawidi, abamwa umushatsi, asatura impuzu zabo uhereye aho itako ritangurira, aca arabarungika.

Haza abantu babwira Dawidi ivyashikiye abo bagabo, aca arungika intumwa ngo zihure na bo, kuko bari buzuye ibiteterwe. Umwami abatumako ati: "Nimugume i Yeriko gushika aho ubwanwa bwanyu buzokurira, hanyuma muze mubone kugaruka."

Abamoni babonye ko bakoze ikintu giteye isoni imbere ya Dawidi, Hanuni n’Abamoni baca barungika italanto igihumbi z’ifeza i Aramu-Naharayimu, Aramu-Mayaka n’i Zoba kugira ngo babahe imikogote n’abayikoresha mu ntambara.

Bakotesha ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bibiri vy’imikogote n’abayigwanisha, hamwe n’umwami w’i Mayaka n’ingabo ziwe, baraza bacumbika hafi y’i Medeba, Abamoni na bo bariko barasohoka mu bisagara vyabo baja gutonda urugamba.
Dawidi avyumvise, aca arungika Yowabu n’ingabo zose zizi kugwana.
Abamoni baragenda batonda urugamba kw’irembo ry’igisagara, abami bari baje na bo bari ku musozi inyuma y’igisagara.
Yowabu abona ko urugamba rumuturutse imbere n’inyuma; aca atoranya bamwe mu ngabo z’indobanurwa mu Bisirayeli abarungika ngo bagwanye Abarameya.
Abasigaye abazeza murumunawe Abishayi ngo abatware, aca abatuma kugwanya Abamoni.
Yowabu amubwira ati: "Abarameya nibandusha inkomezi, uce uza kuntabara; ariko Abamoni nibakurusha inkomezi, ndagutabara.
Nureme kandi tugwane rugabo, tugwanire ihanga ryacu n’ibisagara vy’Imana yacu. Uhoraho ari bukore ivyo abona ko ari vyiza mu nyonga ziwe."
Maze Yowabu n’ingabo bari kumwe baragenda ngo bagwane n’Abarameya, na bo barabahunga.
Abamoni babonye ko Abarameya bariko barahunga, na bo nyene baca bahunga murumunawe Abishayi binjira mu gisagara. Maze Yowabu aca yisubirira i Yerusalemu.
Abarameya babonye ko baneshejwe n’Abisirayeli, batumako abandi Barameya bo hakurya y’uruzi Efurate, barongowe na Shofaki umukuru w’ingabo za Hadadezeri.
Dawidi avyumvise, akoranya Abisirayeli bose bajabuka Yorodani; batonda urugamba ngo babagwanye. Dawidi atondesha ingabo ngo zihangane n’Abarameya, na bo baraza bagwana na we.
Ariko Abarameya bahunga Abisirayeli, kandi Dawidi yica ibihumbi indwi mu bagwanira ku mikogote n’ibihumbi mirongo ine vy’abagwanira ku maguru. Yica na Shofaki umukuru w’ingabo zabo.
Abari barongowe na Hadadezeri babonye ko baneshejwe n’Abisirayeli, baca bisaba Dawidi bemera kuba abagurano biwe. Maze Abarameya ntibasubira kwiyumvira gutabara Abamoni.

Mu gihe imvura yaba itanguye kugabanuka hakaza ici, ni ho abami bahora baja mu ntambara. Yowabu arongora ingabo, aja gutera igihugu c’Abamoni arakinesha; ariko Dawidi yigumira i Yerusalemu. Yowabu yugariza igisagara c’i Raba arakinesha, agihindura umusaka.

Dawidi amaze gushika afata urugori rw’ubwami rwari ku mutwe w’umwami waho, asanga rupima italanto imwe y’inzahabu, kandi rwari rusharijwe n’utubuye tw’agaciro, baca barwambika Dawidi. Atwara iminyago myinshi akuye muri ico gisagara,

atwara n’abantu bo muri ico gisagara, abashingira ibikebere, bamwe baba abasatura imbaho, abandi bagakoresha amasipiri n’incabiti. Dawidi abigenza atyo mu bisagara vyose vy’Abamoni. Hanyuma Dawidi n’ingabo zose basubira i Yerusalemu.

Hanyuma y’ivyo, havyuka intambara hagati y’Abisirayeli n’Abafilisitiya, ibera ahitwa Gezeri. Muri ico gihe Sibekayi Umuhushati yica Sipayi, umwe mu bakomoka ku Barefayimu, kandi Abafilisitiya baraneshwa.
Mu yindi ntambara bagwana n’Abafilisitiya, Eluhanani mwene Yayiro yica Lahimi umuvukanyi wa Goliyati w’i Gati, uruti rw’icumu ryiwe rwangana n’umuhini.

Kandi mu yindi ntambara yabereye i Gati, hari umugabo munini cane yari afise intoke zitandatu ku kiganza cose n’amano atandatu ku kirenge cose; vyose hamwe vyari mirongo ibiri na bine. Na we nyene yakomoka kuri Rafa.
Atanguye gucokora Abisirayeli, Yonatani mwene Shimeya, yavukana na Dawidi, aramwica.
Abo bari abakomoka kuri Rafa w’i Gati, kandi bishwe na Dawidi n’abantu biwe.
Maze Satani ahagurukira Abisirayeli aca yosha umutima wa Dawidi ngo aharure Abisirayeli bose.
Nuko Dawidi abwira Yowabu n’intwazangabo ati: "Genda muharure Abisirayeli kuva i Berisheba gushika i Dani. Muce mumbwira kugira ngo menye igitigiri cabo."

Ariko Yowabu amwishura ati: " Uhoraho arakagwiza ingabo ziwe incuro ijana. Mwami wanje, mbega bose si abasavyi bawe? None ni iki gitumye umwami wanje akora atyo? Ni igiki cotuma uteza Abisirayeli kubonekako icaha?"
Ariko ijambo ry’umwami riremera Yowabu; maze Yowabu ava imbere yiwe aca akwiragira mu Bisirayeli bose aca agaruka i Yerusalemu.
Yowabu ashikiriza Dawidi igitigiri c’abantu baja ku rugamba. Muri Isirayeli hari umuliyoni umwe n’ijana b’ababahizi bazi kugwanisha inkota, mu Buyuda na ho ibihumbi amajana ane na mirongo indwi.
Ariko Yowabu ntiyashiramwo Abalewi n’Ababenyamini mu guharura, kuko atashaka gukora iryo tegeko ry’umwami.
Kandi iryo tegeko ntiryanezereje Imana; ivyo bituma ihana Abisirayeli.
Nuko Dawidi abwira Imana ati: "Nacumuye cane ku bw’ico kintu nakoze. None rero, ndakwinginze, unkureko icaha canje jewe umusavyi wawe. Nakoze ivy’ubupfu rwose."
Uhoraho abwira Gadi, uwerekwa wa Dawidi ati:
"Genda ubwire Dawidi uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Ndaguhaye ibintu bitatu. Hitamwo kimwe nzoguhanisha.’ "
Nuko Gadi aja kwa Dawidi aramubwira ati: "Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Hitamwo kimwe:

imyaka itatu y’inzara, amezi atatu uneshwa n’abansi aho inkota y’abansi banyu izobashikako, canke imisi itatu y’inkota y’ Uhoraho ; imisi y’ikiza mu gihugu, aho umumarayika w’ Uhoraho azokwica abantu mu bice vyose vya Isirayeli.’ None rero, hitamwo hanyuma umbwire ico nishura uwantumye."
Dawidi abwira Gadi ati: "Ndi n’umubabaro mwinshi. Reka mpfume ngwa mu maboko y’ Uhoraho , kuko imbabazi ziwe ari nyinshi; ariko singwe mu maboko y’abantu."
Nuko Uhoraho arungika ikiza mu Bisirayeli, abantu ibihumbi mirongo indwi vy’Abisirayeli barapfa.

Maze Imana ituma umumarayika ngo arandure Yerusalemu. Ariko igihe uwo mumarayika yariko arabikora, Uhoraho arabiraba ababazwa n’ico cago aca abwira uwo mumarayika yariko aratikiza abantu ati: "Geza aho! Garukana ukuboko kwawe." Umumarayika w’ Uhoraho yari ahagaze ku mbuga yo kugosorerako ingano ya Orunani Umuyebusi.

Dawidi aravye hejuru abona wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho ahagaze hagati y’isi n’ijuru, afise inkota iri mu kuboko kwiwe ibanguye kuri Yerusalemu. Nuko Dawidi n’abakuru muri Isirayeli, baca bambara amagunira bubama hasi.

Dawidi abwira Imana ati: "Mbega si jewe nategetse ko baharura ingabo? Ni jewe nacumuye nkora ibidakwiye. Aba bo ni intama gusa. None bakoze iki? Yewe Uhoraho Mana yanje, ukuboko kwawe niguhane jewe n’umuryango wanje, ariko iki kiza ntikigume mu bantu bawe."
Maze umumarayika w’ Uhoraho ategeka Gadi kubwira Dawidi ngo aduge yubakire Uhoraho igicaniro ku mbuga yo kugosorerako ingano ya Orunani Umuyebusi.
Nuko Dawidi araduga yubashe iryo jambo Gadi yamubwiye mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho .
Mu gihe Orunani yariko aragosora ingano, ahindukiye abona wa mumarayika; maze abahungu biwe bane bari kumwe na we biruka kwinyegeza.
Maze Dawidi arashika, Orunani yunamuye amaso aramubona, aca ava kuri ya mbuga yo kugosorerako yunama imbere ya Dawidi, ashika hasi.
Dawidi aramubwira ati: "Numpe iki kibanza c’imbuga yawe kugira ngo ndahubakire Uhoraho igicaniro, maze ikiza kiri mu bantu gihagarare. Ndahakugurira ku giciro bikwiranye."

Orunani abwira Dawidi ati: "Hashikire! Umwami wanje nahakoreshe ico ashaka cose. Ehe, ndatanga n’impfizi z’ikimazi co guturirwa n’umuriro, imihini yo gusekura ingano ndayitanze ngo ibe inkwi, n’ingano na zo ngo zibe ishikanwa ry’ifu. Ivyo vyose ndabiguhaye."

Ariko umwami Dawidi yishura Orunani ati: "Oya, ndakwinginze unyemerere ndakurihe igiciro bikwiranye. Sinshobora gushikanira Uhoraho ibintu vyawe, canke ngo nshikane ikimazi co guturirwa ata co ndakiguze."
Nuko Dawidi ariha Orunani shekeli amajana atandatu vy’inzahabu ku bw’ico kibanza.

Dawidi yubakira Uhoraho igicaniro aho nyene aca ashikana ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’ivy’ishimwe. Yambaza Uhoraho , maze Uhoraho na we aramwishura, amanura umuriro uvuye mw’ijuru uza kuri ca gicaniro c’ibimazi vyo guturirwa.
Nuko Uhoraho avugana na wa mumarayika, asubiza inkota yiwe mu rwubati.
Muri ico gihe, Dawidi abonye ko Uhoraho yishuye isengesho ryiwe kuri ya mbuga yo kugosorerako ingano ya Orunani Umuyebusi, aca atangiraho ibimazi.
Ihema ry’ Uhoraho , iryo Mose yari yarubatse mu bugaragwa, n’igicaniro co guturirirako ibimazi vyari mw’itaba ry’umusozi i Gibeyoni.
Ariko Dawidi ntiyashoboye kujayo ngo asiguze Imana, kuko yari yatekewe n’ubwoba igihe yabona ya nkota y’umumarayika w’ Uhoraho .
Maze Dawidi aca avuga ati: "Ingoro y’ Uhoraho Imana izoba aha nyene, n’igicaniro co guturirirako ibimazi vy’Abisirayeli ni uko nyene."
Maze Dawidi atanga amategeko ko bakoranya abantu b’abanyamahanga baba mu Bisirayeli, atoranya muri bo abo kubaza amabuye ngo bategure amabuye abajwe yo kuzokwubaka Ingoro y’Imana.
Ategura ubutare bw’ivyuma vyo gukoramwo imisumari y’imyango y’amarembo n’iyo kumanikako ibintu, n’ubutare bw’ivyuma bwinshi budashobora gupimwa uburemere.
Ategura n’ibiti vy’amasederi vyinshi bitoharurika, kuko Abanyesidoni n’Abatiro bari babizaniye Dawidi ari vyinshi cane.

Dawidi avuga ati: "Umuhungu wanje Salomo aracari muto kandi nta burambe afise mu bikorwa, kandi Ingoro yo kwubakira Uhoraho ikwiye kuba ari akaroruhore kandi ari rurangiranwa imbere y’amahanga yose. Nkwiye rero gutegura ivyo kuzokwubakisha." Nuko Dawidi agira imyiteguro myinshi imbere y’uko apfa.
Maze ahamagara umuhungu wiwe Salomo amushinga kuzokwubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli.
Dawidi abwira Salomo ati: "Mwana wanje, nari narabigabiye mu mutima wanje ko nzokwubaka Ingoro yo guhesha icubahiro Izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana yanje.

Ariko Uhoraho ambwira iri jambo ati: ‘Wavishije amaraso menshi kandi wagwanye intambara nyinshi. Ntiwoshobora kwubaka Ingoro yitirirwa izina ryanje, kuko wavishije amaraso menshi kw’isi mu nyonga zanje.
Ariko uzoronka umuhungu azoba umuntu w’amahoro n’itekane, kandi nzomuha kuruhuka abansi biwe mu mpande zose. Izina ryiwe azokwitwa Salomo, kandi nzoha Isirayeli amahoro n’umutekano ku ngoma yiwe.
Uwo ni we azokwubaka Ingoro yitirirwa izina ryanje. Azombera umuhungu, nanje ndamubere se. Kandi nzokomeza ingoma y’ubwami bwiwe mu Bisirayeli ibihe bidashira.’
None rero mwana wanje, Uhoraho abane nawe, kugira ngo ushobore kwubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho Imana yawe, nk’uko yavuze ko uzobikora.
Uhoraho aze aguhe kuroranya n’ugutahura niyagushira ku ntebe y’inganji y’Abisirayeli, kugira ngo uze witondere Ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho Imana yawe.
Nuko uzotera imbere niwitondera ivyo yashinze n’ivyagezwe vyose Uhoraho yahaye Mose ngo abihe Abisirayeli. Ukomere kandi ushire ubwoba. Ntutinye canke ngo ucike intege.

Narakoze ndaruha kugira ngo ntegure ibikoresho vyose bikenewe vy’iyo Ngoro y’ Uhoraho . Negeranije italanto ibihumbi ijana z’inzahabu, italanto umuliyoni umwe z’ifeza, ubutare bwinshi bw’umwakaka n’ivyuma vyinshi bitoharurika, n’ibiti n’amabuye. Kandi ushobora kwongerako n’ibindi.
Ufise abakozi benshi: ababaza amabuye, abubakisha amabuye n’abubakisha ibiti n’imbaho, n’abahinga mu gikorwa ico ari co cose
mu nzahabu no mw’ifeza, umwakaka n’ivyuma; abacuzi barenze igitigiri. Nuko shirako wubake, kandi Uhoraho ari kumwe nawe."
Maze Dawidi ategeka abatwara abandi mu Bisirayeli gufasha umuhungu wiwe Salomo.

Arababwira ati: "Mbega Uhoraho Imana yanyu ntari kumwe namwe? Ntiyanabemereye kubaha impore impande zose? Kuko yampaye abantu bose baba muri iki gihugu, kandi iki gihugu cose kiri mu minwe y’ Uhoraho n’abantu biwe.

Nuko rero mushire imitima yanyu n’imishaha yanyu k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu. Mushireko mwubake Ingoro y’ Uhoraho Imana, kugira ngo muzane Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho n’ibikoresho vyera vy’Imana muri iyo Ngoro izokwubakirwa Izina ry’ Uhoraho ."
Igihe Dawidi yari ashaje ageze mu zabukuru, yaciye yimika umuhungu wiwe Salomo ngo abe umwami w’Abisirayeli.
Akoranya abakuru barongoye abandi mu Bisirayeli, hamwe n’abaherezi n’Abalewi.
Abalewi bafise imyaka mirongo itatu n’iyirenga baraharurwa, maze igitigiri cabo bose gishika ku bantu ibihumbi mirongo itatu n’umunani.
Dawidi avuga ati: "Muri aba, ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine baze barongore abandi mu bikorwa vyo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , abandi ibihumbi bitandatu na bo baze babe abakuru n’abacamanza.
Ibihumbi bine baze bazezwe kurinda irembo maze ibindi bihumbi bine baze babe abo guhimbaza Uhoraho n’ibicurarangisho nateguye ku bw’ico gikorwa."
Dawidi aca agabura Abalewi mu migwi nk’uko bene Lewi bari bari: Gerishoni, Kohati na Merari.
Abo mu Bagerishoni bari: Ladani na Shimeyi.
Bene Ladani ni: umukuru wabo Yehiyeli, Zetamu na Yoweli, bose hamwe bari batatu.
Bene Shimeyi ni: Shelomoti, Haziyeli na Harani, bose hamwe bari batatu. Abo ni bo bari abakuru b’inzu mu muryango wa Ladani.
Kandi bene Shimeyi bari: Yahati, Ziza, Yewushi na Beriya. Abo ni bo bari bene Shimeyi, bose bari bane.
Yahati yari imfura Ziza akaba uwa kabiri, ariko Yewushi na Beriya ntibavyaye abahungu benshi; ni co gituma baharuwe nk’umuryango umwe bahabwa n’igikorwa kimwe.
Bene Kohati ni: Amuramu, Izihari, Heburoni na Uziyeli, bose bari bane.

Bene Amuramu ni: Aroni na Mose. Aroni aratoranywa, we n’uruvyaro rwiwe ibihe bidashira, ngo bazezwe ibintu vyose vyejejwe, bashikane ibimazi imbere y’ Uhoraho , bakorere imbere yiwe bongere bahezagire abantu mw’izina ryiwe ibihe bidashira.
Bene Mose umuntu w’Imana baharuwe nk’abo mu muryango wa Lewi.
Bene Mose ni: Gerishomu na Eliyezeri.
Abo mu ruvyaro rwa Gerishomu: umukuru wabo yari Shubayeli.
Abakomoka kuri Eliyezeri: umukuru wabo yari Rehabiya. Eliyezeri nta bahungu yari afise, ariko bene Rehabiya bari benshi.
Bene Izihari: umukuru wabo yari Shelomiti.
Bene Heburoni: umukuru yari Yeriya, uwa kabiri akaba Amariya, uwa gatatu akaba Yahaziyeli, uwa kane akaba Yekameyamu.
Bene Uziyeli: umukuru wabo yari Mika, Isihiya akaba uwa kabiri.
Bene Merari: Mahuli na Mushi. Bene Mahuli: Eliyazeri na Kishi.
Eliyazeri yapfuye ata bahungu avyaye: yari afise abakobwa gusa. Bene sewabo, bene Kishi, ni bo babarongoye.
Bene Mushi: Mahuli, Ederi na Yeremoti, bose bari batatu.

Abo ni bo bakomoka kuri Lewi nk’uko amazu yabo yari ari: abakuru b’amazu bari banditswe hakurikijwe urutonde rw’amazina yabo. Umuntu wese yaharuwe yaba amaze imyaka mirongo ibiri canke irenga kugira ngo akore mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Kuko Dawidi yari yaravuze ati: "Ko Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli, yemeye guha impore abantu biwe kandi ko yaje akaba i Yerusalemu ibihe vyose,
Abalewi ntibagikeneye kurerura ihema canke ibikoresho na bimwe bikoreshwa muri ryo."
Nk’uko vyari vyarashinzwe na Dawidi mu misi yiwe ya nyuma, Abalewi bari baharuwe kuva ku bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga.

Ico Abalewi bari bashinzwe kwari ugufasha bene Aroni mu bikorwa vyo mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho : ibikorwa vyo mu rugo, ivyo mu vyumba, guhumanura ivyera vyose no gutunganya ibindi bikorwa vyo mu Ngoro y’Imana.
Bari bashinzwe ya mikate yategerezwa kwama ishirwa ku meza, ifu y’indobanurwa itangwako amashikanwa y’ifu, imitsima itarimwo umwambiro, gukaranga no kuvanga, hamwe no gupima urugero rw’ikintu cose.
Bategerezwa guhagarara uko bukeye bashimira Uhoraho bamuhimbaza no ku mugoroba bagakora uko nyene,

n’igihe cose abantu baje gushikanira Uhoraho ibimazi vyo guturirwa ku masabato no ku misi mikuru y’ukwezi gutashe hamwe no ku misi mikuru yashinzwe. Bategerezwa gukorera imbere y’ Uhoraho ubudasiba hakurikijwe igitigiri c’abakenewe muri bo kandi nk’uko bari bategetswe kubikora.
Uko ni ko Abalewi bakora ivyo bashinzwe gukora mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, ivyerekeye Ahera, barongowe n’ab’iwabo bo mu ruvyaro rwa Aroni, bagakora ivyo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Iyi ni yo mice y’uruvyaro rwa Aroni: Bene Aroni bari Nadabu, Abihu, Eliyazeri na Itamari.
Ariko Nadabu na Abihu batanze se gupfa, kandi nta bahungu basize. Nuko Eliyazeri na Itamari baciye bakora nk’abaherezi.
Dawidi abashira mu migwi yisunze ivyo bazokora n’urutonde bari bakwiye gukorerako, afashijwe na Sadoki akomoka kuri Eliyazeri na Ahimeleki akomoka kuri Itamari.

Abarongozi benshi bavuye mu ruvyaro rwa Eliyazeri kuruta abavuye mu rwa Itamari, maze bashirwa mu migwi bisunze ico nyene: abakuru b’amazu bava mu bakomoka kuri Eliyazeri bari cumi na batandatu, hanyuma abakuru b’amazu bava ku bakomoka kuri Itamari bari umunani.

Babagabuye mu migwi y’ibikorwa batarenganije n’umwe kuko bakoresheje ubupfindo. Ivyo vyatumwe n’uko hariho benshi bari babereye gukora mu Ingoro y’Imana bava mu bakomoka kuri Eliyazeri na Itamari bompi.

Umwanditsi Shemaya mwene Netaneli Umulewi, yanditse amazina yabo ari imbere y’umwami n’abakuru bose: Sadoki umuherezi, Ahimeleki mwene Abiyatari n’abakuru b’amazu y’abaherezi n’Abalewi, bagafata umwe wo mu nzu kwa Eliyazeri hanyuma uwundi wo mu nzu kwa Itamari.
Ubupfindo bwa mbere bwerekanye Yehoyaribu, ubwa kabiri bwerekanye Yedayiya,
ubwa gatatu bwerekanye Harimu, ubwa kane bwerekanye Seyorimu,
ubwa gatanu bwerekanye Malikiya, ubwa gatandatu bwerekanye Miyamini,
ubw’indwi bwerekanye Hakozi, ubw’umunani bwerekanye Abiya,
ubw’icenda bwerekanye Yesuwa, ubw’icumi bwerekanye Shekaniya,
ubw’icumi na rimwe bwerekanye Eliyashibu, ubw’icumi na kabiri bwerekanye Yakimu,
Ubw’icumi na gatatu bwerekanye Hupa, ubw’icumi na kane bwerekanye Yeshebeyabu,
ubw’icumi na gatanu bwerekanye Biluga, ubw’icumi na gatandatu bwerekanye Imeri,
ubw’icumi n’indwi bwerekanye Heziri, ubw’icumi n’umunani bwerekanye Hapizezi,
ubw’icumi n’icenda bwerekanye Petahiya, ubwa mirongo ibiri bwerekanye Yehezikeli,
ubwa mirongo ibiri na rimwe bwerekanye Yakini, ubwa mirongo ibiri na kabiri bwerekanye Gamuli,
ubwa mirongo ibiri na gatatu bwerekanye Delaya, ubwa mirongo ibiri na kane bwerekanye Mayaziya.

Urwo ni rwo rutonde bakurikiza mu gukora igikorwa c’Imana iyo baramukiwe kwinjira mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho , bisunze amategeko yabagenga yashizweho na sekuru wabo Aroni kandi nk’uko Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli, yari yaramutegetse.
Aba ni bo bandi bakuru b’imiryango yakomoka kuri Lewi: Mu bakomoka kuri Amuramu: umukuru wabo yari Shubayeli; mu bakomoka kuri Shubayeli: umukuru wabo yari Yehudeya.
Mu bakomoka kuri Rehabiya, abavuye ku bahungu biwe: umukuru wabo yari Isihiya.
Mu bakomoka kuri Izihari: umukuru wabo yari Shelomoti; mu bakomoka kuri Shelomoti: umukuru wabo yari Yahati.
Mu bakomoka kuri Heburoni: Yeriya ni we yari mukuru, uwa kabiri ni Amariya, uwa gatatu ni Yahaziyeli, uwa kane na we ni Yekamiyami.
Mu bakomoka kuri Uziyeli: umukuru wabo yari Mika; mu bakomoka kuri Mika: umukuru wabo yari Shamiri.
Umuvukanyi wa Mika: yari Isihiya. Mu bamukomokako, Zakariya ni we yari mukuru.
Mu bakomoka kuri Merari: abakuru babo bari Mahuli na Mushi. Mu bakomoka kuri Yayaziya: umukuru wabo yari Beno.
Mu bakomoka kuri Merari: Kuva kuri Yayaziya: abakuru babo bari Beno, Shohamu, Zakuri na Iburi.
Mu bakomoka kuri Mahuli: umukuru wabo yari Eliyazeri, naho atigeze aronka abahungu.
Mu bakomoka kuri Kishi: umukuru wabo yari Yerahimeyeli.
Ku bakomoka kuri Mushi: abakuru babo bari Mahuli, Ederi na Yerimoti. Abo bari Abalewi, nk’uko imiryango yabo yari iri.

Na ho nyene barakoresheje ubupfindo, nk’uko benewabo bakomoka kuri Aroni babikoze, imbere y’umwami Dawidi na Sadoki, Ahimeleki, n’abakuru b’amazu y’abaherezi n’Abalewi. Inzu zikomoka ku muvukanyi mukuru zafatwa co kimwe n’inzu zikomoka kuri mutoya muri bo.

Dawidi, ari kumwe n’abakuru b’ingabo, atoranya bamwe muri bene Asafu, Hemani na Yedutuni ngo bakore igikorwa co kuvuga amajambo avuye ku Mana, bavugira inanga, amakembe n’ivyuma bisama. Uru ni rwo rutonde rw’abakora ico gikorwa:
Mu bahungu ba Asafu hari: Zakuri, Yosefu, Netaniya na Asarela. Bene Asafu bari barongowe na se Asafu, yavuga amajambo avuye ku Mana akurikije amategeko y’umwami.

Mu bahungu ba Yedutuni, hari: Gedaliya, Zeri, Yeshaya, Shimeyi, Hashabiya na Matitiya, bose hamwe bari batandatu, barongowe na se Yedutuni, yavuga amajambo y’Imana, avuza inanga mu gushimira no mu guhimbaza Uhoraho .
Mu bahungu ba Hemani hari: Bukiya, Mataniya, Uziyeli, Shubayeli na Yerimoti; Hananiya, Hanani, Eliyata, Gidaliti na Romamuti-Ezeri; Yoshibekasha, Maloti, Hotiri na Mahaziyoti.
Abo bose bari bene Hemani uwerekwa w’umwami. Imana yari yabamuhaye biciye mw’isezerano ngo imushire hejuru. Imana imuha abahungu icumi na bane n’abakobwa batatu.

Abo bose bari barongowe na ba se babo mu kuririmba no mu gucuraranga mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho , bakoresheje ivyuma bisama, amakembe n’inanga, ku bw’ico gikorwa co mu Ngoro y’Imana. Asafu, Yedutuni na Hemani bari musi y’uburongozi bw’umwami.
Abo bari kumwe n’abo mu nzu zabo, bose bari barigishijwe bongera bamenyerezwa ivyerekeye kuririmbira Uhoraho , bashika amajana abiri na mirongo umunani n’umunani.
Abacuraranga bose bashirwa ku bikorwa vyabo hakoreshejwe ubupfindo, ntibaraba ngo umuntu aracari muto canke arakuze, ni umwigisha canke ni umwigishwa.

Ubupfindo bwa mbere bwerekanye Yosefu wo mu nzu kwa Asafu, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri. Ubupfindo bwa kabiri bwerekana Gedaliya, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa gatatu bwerekana Zakuri, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa kane bwerekana Iziri, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa gatanu bwerekana Netaniya, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa gatandatu bwerekana Bukiya, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bw’indwi bwerekana Yesarela, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bw’umunani bwerekana Yeshaya, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bw’icenda bwerekana Mataniya, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bw’icumi bwerekana Shimeyi, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi na rimwe bwerekana Azareli, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi na kabiri bwerekana Hashabiya, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi na gatatu bwerekana Shubayeli, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi na kane bwerekana Matitiya, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi na gatanu bwerekana Yeremoti, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi na gatandatu bwerekana Hananiya, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi n’indwi bwerekana Yoshibekasha, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi n’umunani bwerekana Hanani, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa cumi n’icenda bwerekana Maloti, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa mirongo ibiri bwerekana Eliyata, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa mirongo ibiri na rimwe bwerekana Hotiri, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa mirongo ibiri na kabiri bwerekana Gidaliti, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa mirongo ibiri na gatatu bwerekana Mahaziyoti, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Ubupfindo bwa mirongo ibiri na kane bwerekana Romamuti-Ezeri, abahungu biwe hamwe na benewabo, baba cumi na babiri.
Imigwi y’abarinzi b’irembo: Mu bakomoka kuri Kora hari Meshelemiya umuhungu wa Kore, umwe muri bene Abiyasafu.
Abahungu ba Meshelemiya bari: Zakariya imfura, Yediyayeli uwa kabiri, Zebadiya uwa gatatu, Yatuniyeli uwa kane,
Elamu uwa gatanu, Yehohanani uwa gatandatu na Eliyehowenayi uw’indwi.
Abahungu ba Obedi-Edomu na bo nyene bari abarinzi b’irembo: Shemaya imfura, Yehozabadi uwa kabiri, Yowa uwa gatatu, Sakari uwa kane, Netaneli uwa gatanu,
Amiyeli uwa gatandatu, Isakari uw’indwi na Pewuletayi uw’umunani. Imana yari yarahaye umugisha mwinshi Obedi-Edomu.
Shemaya mwene Obedi-Edomu na we nyene yari afise abahungu, bari abakuru mu mazu y’abakomoka kuri se kuko bari abantu babishoboye.
Bene Shemaya bari: Otini, Refayeli, Obedi na Elizabadi; hamwe na benewabo Elihu na Semakiya na bo nyene bari abantu babishoboye.

Abo bose bari abakomoka kuri Obedi-Edomu; bo ubwabo, abahungu babo n’abuzukuru babo, bari abantu bashoboye b’inkomezi zo gukora ico gikorwa; bose hamwe abakomoka kuri Obedi-Edomu, bari mirongo itandatu na babiri.
Abahungu ba Meshelemiya n’abo mu nzu yiwe bose babakomokako, bari bashoboye, bose hamwe bari cumi n’umunani.
Hosa akomoka mu nzu kwa Merari yari afise abahungu: Umukuru wabo yari Shimuri naho atari we yari imfura, se wiwe yari yamutoye ngo abe uwa mbere,
Hilukiya uwa kabiri, Tabaliya uwa gatatu na Zakariya uwa kane. Abahungu ba Hosa n’abo mu nzu yiwe bose babakomokako bakora igikorwa co kurinda irembo bari icumi na batatu.
Iyo migwi y’abarinzi b’irembo, biciye mu bakuru babo, bari bafise ibikorwa vyo gukorera mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho , nk’uko benewabo bandi b’Abalewi babikora.
Abakora kw’irembo ryose batorwa hakoreshejwe ubupfindo, bataravye umuto canke umukuru, bakurikiza inzu zabo gusa.

Ubupfindo bw’abarinda Irembo ryo mu Buseruko bwerekanye Shelemiya n’abo bari kumwe. Maze bakora ubundi bupfindo bwerekana umuhungu wiwe Zakariya azezwa irembo ryo mu buraruko, yari umujenama w’umunyabwenge.
Ubupfindo bw’abarinda Irembo ryo mu Bumanuko bwerekana Obedi-Edomu, kandi ubupfindo bwo kwerakana abarinda inzu y’ububiko bwerekana abahungu biwe.
Ubufindo bw’abarinda Irembo ryo mu Burengero no kw’Irembo rya Shaleketi ku nzira iduga bwerekana Shupimu na Hosa. Abarinzi bagenwa hakurikijwe ingene aho bakorera hahambaye:
Hari Abalewi batandatu ku musi kw’Irembo ryo mu Buseruko, bane ku musi kw’Irembo ryo mu Buraruko, bane ku musi kw’Irembo ryo mu Bumanuko na babiribabiri bakorera rimwe ku nzu y’ububiko.
Kw’Irembo ryo mu Burengero hari abarinzi babiri n’abandi bane barinda inzira yaca inyuma y’urugo.
Iyo yari imigwi y’abarinzi b’irembo bakomoka ku mazu ya Kora na Merari.
Uwundi mugwi w’Abalewi, urongowe na Ahiya, wari uw’abanyabigega b’ubutunzi bwo mu Ngoro y’Imana n’ubutunzi bw’ibintu vyeguriwe Imana.
Abakomoka kuri Ladani, wo mu nzu kwa Gerishoni bari abakuru b’amazu kandi umukuru wabo yari Yehiyeli,
abahungu ba Yehiyeli ari bo Zetamu n’uwo bavukana Yoweli, bari bajejwe ubutunzi bwo mu ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Aba ni bo bari abakuru mu mazu y’abakomoka kuri Amuramu, Izihari, Heburoni na Uziyeli:
Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Amuramu, Shubayeli akomoka kuri Gerishomu mwene Mose, yari umukuru ajejwe ubutunzi.
Abo mu muryango wiwe uciye kuri Eliyezeri bari: Rehabiya, Yeshaya, Yoramu, Zikuri na Shelomoti.

Shelomoti n’abo mu muryango wiwe bari bajejwe ubutunzi bwose bw’ibintu umwami Dawidi, abakuru b’imiryango batwara ingabo igihumbi n’abatwara ingabo ijana, n’abandi bakuru b’ingabo bari bareguriye Imana.
Bimwe mu vyanyazwe mu gihe c’intambara vyari vyeguriwe gusanura ingoro y’ Uhoraho .
N’ibintu vyose Samweli uwerekwa, Sawuli mwene Kishi, Abuneri mwene Neri, Yowabu mwene Zeruwiya, n’abandi bose bari bareguriye Imana vyari bijejwe Shelomoti n’abo mu nzu yiwe.
Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Izihari: Kenaniya n’abahungu biwe bari bashinzwe ibikorwa bitajanye n’Ingoro, bari abakuru bajejwe ubucamanza mu Bisirayeli.

Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Heburoni: Hashabiya we n’abo mu muryango wiwe; abagabo igihumbi n’amajana indwi bashoboye, bari bajejwe Abisirayeli baba mu burengero bwa Yorodani, mu gikorwa cose c’ Uhoraho n’igikorwa cose kiraba uwami muri ako karere.

Kandi mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Heburoni na bo, hari Yeriya akaba umukuru wabo nk’uko vyanditswe mu bitabu bidondagura ingene bagiye bararondoka. Mu mwaka ugira mirongo ine Dawidi ari ku ngoma, harabaye kurondera mu vyanditswe, basanga harimwo abagabo bashoboye mu bakomoka kuri Heburoni b’i Yazeri i Gileyadi.

Yeriya yari afise abantu ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana indwi, bari abagabo bashoboye bakaba abakuru b’inzu zigize umuryango, kandi umwami Dawidi abazeza Abareyubeni, Abagadi n’igice c’Abamanase mu kintu cose cerekeye Imana n’icerekeye umwami mu buseruko bwa Yorodani.

Uru ni rwo rutonde rw’Abisirayeli, bari abakuru b’amazu, abakuru b’ingabo igihumbi, abakuru b’ingabo ijana, n’abakuru batwara abandi, bakorera umwami mu bijanye n’imice y’ingabo baramukirwa gukora uko ukwezi gutashe mu mwaka wose. Umuce wose waba ugizwe n’ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Yashobeyamu mwene Zabudiyeli ni we yari ajejwe umuce wa mbere, wari ujejwe gukora mu kwezi kwa mbere. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Yari uwo mu ruvyaro rwa Perezi kandi yari umukuru yatwara abakuru mu ngabo bajejwe gukora mu kwezi kwa mbere.
Dodayi Umwahohi ni we yari ajejwe umuce wo mu kwezi kwa kabiri; Mikiloti ni we yari umukuru w’uwo muce. Uwo muce wari ugizwe n’ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira gatatu, yari ajejwe ukwezi kwa gatatu, yari Benaya mwene Yehoyada umuherezi. Yari umukuru kandi umuce wiwe warimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Uwo Benaya ni we yari umuhizi muri bamwe mirongo itatu kandi ni we yari umukuru wabo. Umuhungu wiwe Amizabadi yari ajejwe uwo muce wa se.

Umukuru w’ingabo agira kane, yari ajejwe gukora mu kwezi kwa kane, yari Asaheli yavukana na Yowabu; umuhungu wiwe Zebadiya ni we yamusubiriye. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira gatanu, yari ajejwe ukwezi kwa gatanu, yari Shamuhuti Umwizirahi. Umuce wiwe warimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira gatandatu, yari ajejwe ukwezi kwa gatandatu, yari Ira mwene Ikeshi w’i Tekowa. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira indwi, yari ajejwe ukwezi kw’indwi, yari Helezi Umupeloni, Umwefurayimu. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira umunani, yari ajejwe ukwezi kw’umunani, yari Sibekayi Umuhushati w’Umuzera. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira icenda, yari ajejwe ukwezi kw’icenda, yari Abiyezeri Umwanatoti, w’Umubenyamini. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira icumi, yari ajejwe ukwezi kw’icumi, yari Maharayi Umunetofati, w’Umuzera. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira icumi na rimwe, yari ajejwe ukwezi kw’icumi na rimwe, yari Benaya Umupiratoni, w’Umwefurayimu. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Umukuru w’ingabo agira icumi na kabiri, yari ajejwe ukwezi kw’icumi na kabiri, yari Heludayi Umunetofati, wo mu muryango wa Otiniyeli. Mu muce wiwe harimwo ingabo ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bine.
Abari abakuru b’imiryango y’Abisirayeli ni aba: Mu bakomoka kuri Reyubeni: Eliyezeri mwene Zikuri; mu bakomoka kuri Simeyoni: Shefatiya mwene Mayaka;
mu bakomoka kuri Lewi: Hashabiya mwene Kemuweli; mu bakomoka kuri Aroni: Sadoki;
mu bakomoka kuri Yuda: Elihu, yavukana na Dawidi; mu bakomoka kuri Isakari: Omuri mwene Mikayeli;
mu bakomoka kuri Zebuloni: Ishimaya mwene Obadiya; mu bakomoka kuri Nafutali: Yerimoti mwene Aziriyeli;
mu bakomoka kuri Efurayimu: Hoseya mwene Azaziya; mu bakomoka ku gice c’umuryango wa Manase: Yoweli mwene Pedaya;
mu bakomoka ku gice c’umuryango wa Manase kindi c’i Gileyadi: Ido mwene Zakariya; mu bakomoka kuri Benyamini: Yayasiyeli mwene Abuneri;
mu bakomoka kuri Dani: Azareli mwene Yerohamu. Abo ni bo bari abakuru batwara imiryango y’Abisirayeli.
Igihe Dawidi yaharura abantu ntiyaharuyemwo abafise imyaka mirongo ibiri canke batarayishikana, kuko Uhoraho yari yarasezeranye ko azogwiza Abisirayeli ngo bangane n’inyenyeri zo kw’ijuru.
Yowabu mwene Zeruwiya atangura guharura abantu ariko ntiyaheza. Uburake buziriringira Abisirayeli kubera ukwo guharurwa, maze ico gitigiri nticandikwa mu gitabu c’ibigenda biraba c’umwami Dawidi.
Azimaveti mwene Adiyeli yari ajejwe amazu y’ububiko bw’umwami. Yonatani mwene Uziya yari ajejwe amazu y’ububiko yari mu ntara, mu bisagara, mu bigwati no ku minara yo gucungererako.
Ezuri mwene Kelubi yari ajejwe abakozi bo mu mirima barima mu matongo.
Shimeyi w’i Ramati yari ajejwe imirima y’imizabibu. Zabudi w’i Shifumi yari ajejwe umwimbu w’imizabibu n’ububiko bw’umuvinyu.
Bayali-Hanani w’i Gederi yari ajejwe imyelayo n’imisukomora mu gice c’uburengero. Yowashi yari ajejwe ububiko bw’amavuta ya elayo.
Shiturayi w’i Sharoni yari ajejwe inka zarisha i Sharoni. Shafati mwene Adulayi yari ajejwe amasho yo mu biyaya.
Obili Umwishimayeli yari ajejwe ingamiya. Yehudeya w’i Meronoti yari ajejwe indogoba.
Yazizi Umuhaguri yari ajejwe imikuku y’impene n’intama. Abo bose bari abakuru bajejwe ubutunzi bw’umwami Dawidi.
Yonatani, sewabo wa Dawidi, yari umuhanuzi, umugabo w’ubwenge akaba n’umwanditsi. Yehiyeli mwene Hakumoni yari ajejwe abahungu b’umwami.
Ahitofeli yari umuhanuzi w’umwami. Hushayi umwaruki yari umugenzi w’umwami.
Ahitofeli yasubiriwe na Yehoyada mwene Benaya na Abiyatari. Yowabu yari umukuru w’ingabo z’umwami.

Dawidi ahamagaza abakuru bose bo mu Bisirayeli ngo bakoranire i Yerusalemu: Abakuru b’imiryango, abakuru barongora ingabo igihumbi n’abakuru barongora ingabo ijana, n’abakuru bajejwe itunga n’ibitungwa vy’umwami n’abahungu biwe, n’abakuru bakorera ku kirimba, abahambaye bose n’abahizi bo mu ntambara.

Umwami Dawidi arahaguruka avuga ati: "Nimunyumvirize, bavukanyi mukaba n’abantu banje. Nari nariyumviriye mu mutima kwubaka inzu Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho izoruhukiramwo, indava y’ibirenge vy’Imana yacu, kandi naragize integuro yo kuyubaka.
Ariko Imana irambwira iti: ‘Ntushobora kwubaka inzu yitirirwa izina ryanje, kuko wagwanye intambara nyinshi kandi ukavisha amaraso menshi.’

Ariko Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli, yantoranije mu muryango wanje wose ngo mbe umwami w’Abisirayeli ibihe bidashira. Yatoranije Yuda nk’umukuru, maze mu muryango wa Yuda itoranya inzu yanje, kandi no mu bahungu ba data yahimbawe no kunyimika ngo mbe umwami w’Abisirayeli bose.
Mu bahungu banje bose Uhoraho yampaye, kandi ni benshi, yatoranije umuhungu wanje Salomo ngo yicare ku ntebe y’ubwami bw’ Uhoraho aganze Abisirayeli.
Yambwiye ati: Salomo umuhungu wawe ni we azonyubakira Ingoro aho nzovyagira, kuko ndamutoranije ngo ambere umuhungu, nanje ndamubere se.
Nzokomeza ubwami bwiwe ibihe vyose niyashira umutima ku kwumvira amateka n’ivyo nashinze, nk’uko bikorwa ubu.

None rero ndabibasabiye imbere y’Abisirayeli bose n’ikoraniro ryose ry’ Uhoraho , n’imbere y’Imana yacu ivyumva: muze mwitwararike kwumvira amabwirizwa y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, kugira ngo muze mugumane iki gihugu ciza kandi ngo muze mukirage uruvyaro rwanyu ibihe bidashira.

Nawe, Salomo mwana wanje, menya Imana ya so, uyikorere n’umutima wawe wose kandi ubikunze, kuko Uhoraho asesa umutima wose kandi azi ivyo umuntu yiyumvira akagabira. Niwamurondera, uzomubona; ariko niwamutera ibitugu, na we azoguta ibihe vyose.
Menya rero ibi, Uhoraho yaragutoranije ngo wubake Ingoro yiwe yera. Shikama ukore ico gikorwa."
Nuko Dawidi aha umuhungu wiwe Salomo ya nteguro y’intangaro y’Ingoro, inyubako yayo, amazu y’ububiko bwayo, ibice vyo hejuru vyayo, ivyumba vy’imbere n’ikibanza co gutangiramwo impongano.

Amuha izo nteguro nk’uko Mpwemu yari yazishize mu bwenge bwiwe, harimwo izerekeye urugo rw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , ivyumba birukikije, ivyumba vy’ububiko bw’Ingoro y’Imana n’ivyumba vy’ububiko bw’ivyagizwe inyegu.
Amubwira ivyo akwiye kwitondera vyerekeye imice y’abaherezi n’Abalewi, n’igikorwa cose co gukora mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , n’ivyerekeye ibikoresho vyose bikoreshwa muri iyo Ngoro.
Ashinga n’uburemere bw’inzahabu buzokora ku bikoresho vyose vy’inzahabu bizokora mu bikorwa bitandukanye, n’uburemere bw’ifeza buzokora ku bikoresho vyose vy’ifeza bizokora mu bikorwa bitandukanye:

Uburemere bw’inzahabu zo mu biterekwako amatara no mu matara yavyo, uburemere bw’igiterekwako amatara kimwekimwe cose n’amatara yaco, n’uburemere bw’ifeza z’igiterekwako amatara c’ifeza kimwekimwe cose n’amatara yaco, bijanye n’ico igiterekwako amatara cose kizokora;
uburemere bw’inzahabu bw’imeza yose y’imikate yejejwe; n’uburemere z’ifeza z’imeza zindi;

uburemere bw’inzahabu ihinguwe neza y’ivyaruzo vy’amenyo, amabakure yo gusukira n’ibindi bikoresho bikozwe mu nzahabu ihinguwe neza; uburemere bw’inzahabu yokoreshwa kw’isahani y’inzahabu imw’imwe yose; uburemere bw’ifeza kw’isahani y’ifeza imw’imwe yose;

n’uburemere bw’inzahabu ihinguwe neza y’igicaniro baturirirako ibimota neza. Yarongeye amuha ishusho y’umukogote, ni ukuvuga abakerubi bacuzwe mu nzahabu bashanje amababa yabo bakayapfukisha ya Sandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho .
Dawidi aravuga ati: "Ivyo vyose biri mu gitabu naronse kivuye k’ Uhoraho , ampa no gutahura ivyo vyose bikwiye gukorwa nk’uko biri muri iyi nteguro."

Dawidi arongera abwira Salomo umwana wiwe ati: "Shikama ushire amanga, ukore ico gikorwa. Ntutinye canke ngo wihebure, kuko Uhoraho Imana, ari yo Mana yanje, iri kumwe nawe. Ntizoguta kandi ntizoguhemukira gushika aho igikorwa co kwubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho kizoherera.

Imice y’abaherezi n’Abalewi bariteguye gukora igikorwa co mu Ngoro y’Imana, n’umuntu wese avyishakiye afise ubuhinga mu kintu ico ari co cose azogufasha muri iki gikorwa. Abakuru n’abantu bose bazokwumvira mu co uzobategeka cose."

Hanyuma umwami Dawidi abwira ikoraniro ryose ati: "Umuhungu wanje Salomo, ari we Imana yatoranije, aracari muto kandi ntabimenyereye cane. Igikorwa ni kinini, kandi iyi Ngoro si iy’umuntu ahubwo ni iy’ Uhoraho Imana.

Nakoresheje inkomezi zanje zose mu gutegura ivyo kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana yanje: inzahabu zizokora ibikorwa vy’inzahabu, ifeza zizokoreshwa mu gukora ibikorwa vy’ifeza, imyakaka izokoreshwa mu gukora ibikorwa vy’imyakaka, ivyuma bizokoreshwa mu gukora ibikorwa bisaba ivyuma, n’ibiti bizokoreshwa mu gukora ibikorwa bisaba ibiti, n’amabuye azokoreshwa mu gukora ibikorwa bisaba amabuye yitwa onigisi yo gukora mu materanirizo, amabuye akayangana y’amabara atandukanye, n’ubwoko butandukanye bw’amabuye y’igiciro kinini hamwe na marubule; vyose ni vyinshi cane.

I ruhande y’ivyo, kubera ukwitangira Ingoro y’Imana yanje, ntanze ubutunzi bwanje bw’inzahabu n’ifeza ngo bibe ivy’iyo Ngoro y’Imana yanje, ndavyongeye kuri vya bindi vyose nateguriye kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana yanje birenze ku vyo nategekanije kubera iyo Ngoro yera:
Italanto ibihumbi bitatu z’inzahabu zavuye muri Ofiru, n’iz’ifeza ibihumbi indwi zihinguwe neza, zo guhomesha ku mpome y’iyo nyubakwa,
ivyo gukoreshwa mu gikorwa c’ifeza n’inzahabu, hamwe n’ibikorwa vyose bikwiye gukorwa n’abahinga. None rero ni nde agomba kwitanga uwu musi kubera Uhoraho ?"
Maze abakuru b’imiryango igize Isirayeli, abakuru barongoye ingabo igihumbi n’abarongoye ingabo ijana, n’abakuru bashinzwe gukora i bwami batanga bavyishakiye.

Batanga ivyo gukoresha ku Ngoro y’Imana bingana n’italanto ibihumbi bitanu na dariki ibihumbi cumi vy’inzahabu, italanto ibihumbi cumi z’ifeza, italanto ibihumbi cumi n’umunani z’umwakaka n’italanto ibihumbi ijana z’ivyuma.
Umuntu wese yari afise amabuye y’igiciro arayazana ngo aje mu bubiko bw’iyo Ngoro y’ Uhoraho bwari bujejwe Yehiyeli Umugerishoni.
Abantu baranezerwa kuko abakuru babo bemeye gukora bavyishakiye, kuko bari bashikaniye Uhoraho ata gahato kandi n’umutima ubikunze. N’umwami Dawidi aranezerwa cane.
Dawidi ahimbaza Uhoraho imbere y’ikoraniro ryose, avuga ati: "Uhimbazwe, yewe Uhoraho , Imana ya sogokuru Isirayeli, uhereye ibihe vyose ugashitsa ibihe vyose.
Ubukuru n’ububasha ni ivyawe n’ubwiza n’icubahiro n’igitinyiro, kuko ibiri mw’ijuru no mw’isi vyose ari ivyawe. Ubwami ni ubwawe, yewe Uhoraho ; ushizwe hejuru nk’uganza vyose.
Ubutunzi n’iteka biva iwawe; uri uwuganza vyose. Mu ntoke zawe hari inkomezi n’ububasha vyo gushira hejuru no gukomeza uwo ishatse wese.
None rero, Mana yacu, turagukengurukiye, kandi duhimbaje izina ryawe ry’ubwiza.
Ariko jewe ndi iki, abantu banje bo ni iki, ngo dushobore gutanga tuvyishakiye nk’uku? Vyose biva iwawe, natwe twaguhaye ibiva mu kuboko kwawe gusa.
Turi inyambukira n’ingenzi mu nyonga zawe, nk’uko na ba sogokuru bacu bari bari. Imisi yacu kw’isi ni nk’igitutu, nta vyizigiro.
Yewe Uhoraho Mana yacu, ibi vyose twatanze ngo bize vyubake Ingoro izokwitirirwa Izina ryawe Ryera, biva mu kiganza cawe, kandi vyose ni ivyawe.

Ndazi, Mana yanje, ko ugera umutima kandi ko uhimbarwa n’ubugororotsi. Ibi vyose nabitanze ata gahato kandi ndavyishakiye. Kandi nezerejwe no kubona uburyo abantu bawe bari aha bagushikaniye ata gahato.
Yewe Uhoraho , Mana ya ba sogokuru Aburahamu, Isaka na Isirayeli, zigama iki cipfuzo mu mitima y’abantu bawe ibihe bidashira, kandi imitima yabo yame ikuyoboka.

Kandi uze uhe umuhungu wanje Salomo kwitanga abikunze ngo aze afate nkama ivyo wamutegetse vyose, n’ivyo wihanikirije n’amabwirizwa yawe, kandi akore vyose ngo yubake iyi Ngoro nk’uko integuro yayo nateguye imeze."
Maze Dawidi abwira ikoraniro ryose ati: "Muhimbaze Uhoraho Imana yanyu." Nuko bose bahimbaza Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sekuruza; bunamira Uhoraho n’umwami.

Bukeye bashikanira Uhoraho ibimazi bamushikanira n’ibimazi vyo gutongozwa umuriro: inka igihumbi, impfizi z’intama igihumbi n’imyagazi y’intama igihumbi, hamwe n’amashikanwa y’ibinyobwa bijanye, n’ibindi bimazi vyinshi vy’Abisirayeli bose.

Kuri uwo musi bararya kandi baranywa banezerewe cane bari imbere y’ Uhoraho . Maze baca bemeza Salomo mwene Dawidi nk’umwami ubwa kabiri, bamwimikisha amavuta imbere y’ Uhoraho ngo abe umutware na Sadoki bamusiga amavuta ngo abe umuherezi.
Maze Salomo avyagira ku ntebe y’ubwami bw’ Uhoraho nk’umwami mu gishingo ca se Dawidi. Agira ikiganza ciza kandi Abisirayeli bose baramwumvira.
Abakuru bose n’abanyenkomezi, n’abahungu b’umwami Dawidi bose, basezerana kuzokwumvira umwami Salomo.
Uhoraho ashira hejuru Salomo imbere y’Abisirayeli bose kandi amuha icubahiro ubwami bwiwe buba bwiza kurusha abami bose b’Abisirayeli bamwitangiye imbere.
Dawidi mwene Isayi yari umwami w’Abisirayeli bose.
Yaganje Isirayeli imyaka mirongo ine. Yamaze imyaka indwi aba i Heburoni, iyindi mirongo itatu n’itatu aba i Yerusalemu.
Yapfuye yisaziye, yaranezererewe kuramba, ubutunzi n’icubahiro. Umuhungu wiwe Salomo amusubirira ku ngoma.
Ivyabaye ku ngoma y’umwami Dawidi, kuva mu ntango gushika kw’iherezo, vyanditswe mu gitabu ca Samweli uwerekwa, mu vyanditswe vya Natani uwavugishwa n’Imana no mu vyanditswe vya Gadi uwerekwa;
biri kumwe n’ido n’ido ry’ivyo ku ngoma yiwe n’ububasha bwiwe, n’ivyagiye biraba mu gihe ciwe hamwe n’Abisirayeli, n’ubwami bwose bwari buhakikije.

name: 2 Ngoma
chapters: Salomo mwene Dawidi aba agakomeye mu bwami bwiwe, kuko Uhoraho Imana yiwe yari kumwe na we kandi amugira uwuhambaye cane.
Maze Salomo avugana n’Abisirayeli bose, abatwara ingabo ibihumbi n’abatwara ingabo amajana, abacamanza, abarongozi, b’Abisirayeli bose n’abakuru b’amazu ya ba sekuruza.
Maze Salomo n’abantu bose baja kw’itaba ry’umusozi i Gibeyoni, kuko Ihema ry’Ibonaniro ry’Imana ari ho ryari rishinzwe, iryo Mose umusavyi w’ Uhoraho yari yarakoze bakiri mu bugaragwa.
Ico gihe Dawidi yari yaramaze kuzana Isandugu y’Imana ayikura i Kiriyati-Yeyarimu ayijana mu kibanza yari yayiteguriye, kuko yari yarayishingiye ihema i Yerusalemu.

Ariko ca gicaniro gikozwe mu butare bw’umwakaka ico Bezaleli mwene Uri, Uri mwene Huri, yari yarakoze cari kikiri i Gibeyoni imbere y’Ihema ry’ Uhoraho . Aho ni ho Salomo n’ikoraniro ryose bambariza Uhoraho .
Salomo araduga aja kuri ca gicaniro c’ubutare bw’umwakaka cari imbere y’ Uhoraho mw’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro aca agitangirako ibimazi igihumbi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro.
Muri iryo joro Imana yiyereka Salomo iramubwira iti: "Nsaba ico ushaka cose ndakiguha."
Salomo yishura Imana ati: "Wagiriye neza cane data Dawidi maze ungira umwami mu kibanza ciwe.
None rero, Uhoraho Mana, nushitse isezerano wasezeraniye data Dawidi, kuko wanyimitse ngo mbe umwami w’ihanga ry’abantu benshi bangana nk’umukungugu wo kw’isi.
Numpe ubwenge n’ubumenyi, kugira ngo nshobore kurongora ubu bwoko. Mbega none ni nde yoshobora kuganza ubu bwoko bwawe bwinshi bungana gutya?"

Imana ibwira Salomo iti: "Ko ico ari co umutima wawe wipfuza ukaba utansavye ubutunzi, ibintu canke icubahiro, canke ngo unsabe ko abansi bawe bapfa; kandi ko utansavye kuramba ariko ukansaba ubwenge n’ubumenyi kugira ngo ushobore kuganza neza abantu banje, abo naguhaye ngo ubabere umwami;

nuko ubwenge n’ubumenyi ndabiguhaye. Kandi nzoguha ubutunzi n’ibintu vyinshi, icubahiro no kuba rurangiranwa, ku buryo ata mwami n’umwe mu bakwitangiye imbere bose yigeze kuronka nk’ivyo, canke ngo habe n’umwe azobironka mu bazoza inyuma yawe."
Nuko Salomo aja i Yerusalemu avuye imbere y’ihema ry’ibonaniro ryari kw’itaba ry’umusozi Gibeyoni. Maze akomeza ivy’ubwami bwiwe mu Bisirayeli.

Maze Salomo yegeranya imikogote y’intambara n’amafarasi menshi. Yari afise imikogote igihumbi n’amajana ane, n’amafarasi ibihumbi cumi na bibiri. Bimwe abibika mu bisagara vy’imikogote, ibindi abigumiza hafi yiwe i Yerusalemu.
Umwami agwiza ifeza n’inzahabu i Yerusalemu bisigara bimeze nk’amabuye, imbaho z’agaciro z’amasederi na zo ziragwira zimera nk’ibiti vy’imisukomora vyo mu biyaya vy’i Buyuda.
Amafarasi ya Salomo yari yayakuye muri Egiputa n’i Kilikiya; abadandaza b’umwami bari bayaguriye muri Kilikiya ku giciro gisanzwe.

Umukogote umwe bawugura muri Egiputa shekeli amajana atandatu z’ifeza, ifarasi imwe na yo bakayigura shekeli ijana na mirongo itanu . Kandi abo badandaza ni bo banabigurisha no ku bami bose b’Abaheti n’ab’Abarameya.
Salomo yigira ingingo yo kwubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho n’ikirimba ciwe,
ashiraho abagabo ibihumbi mirongo indwi bo kwikorera ibikoresho n’abandi ibihumbi mirongo umunani bo kubaza amabuye bayakura mu misozi, n’abashika ibihumbi bitatu n’amajana atandatu bo kubakoresha.
Salomo arungika intumwa kuri Hiramu umwami w’i Tiro ati: "Ndungikira ibiti vy’amasederi nk’uko wabigiriye data Dawidi aho wamurungikira amasederi yo kwubaka ikirimba ciwe.

Ubu ngira nubake Ingoro y’ Uhoraho Imana yanje. Kizoba ari ikibanza catoranirijwe gutuririramwo ibimota neza imbere yayo, aho gushira imikate ihezagiye ubudasiba, no gushikaniramwo ibimazi biturijwe umuriro ku murango, ku mugoroba, ku masabato, mu mboneko z’ukwezi hamwe rero no ku misi mikuru yashinzwe n’ Uhoraho Imana yacu. Kandi ivyo ni icagezwe cahawe Abisirayeli ibihe vyose.
Iyo Ngoro ngira nubake izoba iteye igomwe, kuko Imana yacu ari iyihambaye kurusha ibindi vyitwa imana vyose.

Ariko, mbega ni nde yoshobora kuyubakira inzu ibamwo? Ko amajuru, mbere n’amajuru asumba ayandi, idashobora kuyakwirwamwo! None jewe ndi iki ngo ndayubakire Ingoro, kiretse gusa kwubaka ahantu ho kuyituririra ibimazi!

Nuko, ndungikira umuntu w’umuhinga azi gukora ivy’inzahabu n’ivy’ifeza, ivy’ubutare bw’umwakaka n’ivy’ivyuma; ivy’amarangi y’agahama, n’ay’ubururu ari ku bitambara. Yoba kandi azi ubuhinga bwo gutunganya amashusho ayarumika aho akwiye, agashobora gukorana n’abahinga b’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu, abo Data Dawidi yateguye.
Undungikire kandi ibiti vy’amasederi n’ivy’amapinusi n’ivy’amasantali vy’i Libani, kuko ndazi ko abantu bawe ari abahinga mu vyo kubaza imbaho zo hiyo. Abantu banje bazokorana n’abawe
ngo bantegurire imbaho nyinshi, kuko Ingoro nzokwubaka ibwirizwa kuba yagutse kandi ishajije.

Abakozi bawe, abantu bo kubaza imbaho, nzobaha ingero koru ibihumbi mirongo ibiri z’ingano, ingero koru ibihumbi mirongo ibiri za sayiri, ingero batu ibihumbi mirongo ibiri z’umuvinyu, n’ingero batu ibihumbi mirongo ibiri z’amavuta ya elayo."
Hiramu umwami w’i Tiro yishura Salomo mw’ikete yamwandikiye ati: " Uhoraho arakunda abantu biwe, ni co catumye akugira umwami wabo."

Kandi Hiramu arongera ati: " Uhoraho ahimbazwe, Imana y’Abisirayeli, yaremye ijuru n’isi! Yahaye umwami Dawidi umuhungu w’ubwenge, yuzuye n’ubumenyi bwo kumenya ibibereye, akaba ari we azokwubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho n’ikirimba ciwe c’ubwami.
Ndakurungikiye Huramu Abi, umuntu w’umuhinga cane,

nyina wiwe akomoka mu muryango wa Dani, se na we ava i Tiro. Yigishijwe gukora ibintu bitandukanye mu nzahabu, mw’ifeza, mu miringa n’ivyuma, mu mabuye n’ibiti, ivy’amabara atukura n’ay’ubururu, n’ayavanze y’ubururu n’agahama, n’ayera derere. Ni umuhinga amenyereye ivyo kubaza amashusho kandi ashobora gukora ivyo womusaba vyose. Azokorana n’abahinga bawe n’aba databuja, so wawe Dawidi.
None rero nyakwubahwa urungikire abasavyi bawe za ngano na sayiri na ya mavuta ya elayo na wa muvinyu nk’uko wasezeranye,
natwe tuzoca ibiti vyose mukeneye vy’i Libani tubizane ku kiyaga gushika i Yopa. Namwe muzoheza mubitoreho mubidugane i Yerusalemu."
Salomo aharura abantu bose b’inyambukira bari muri Isirayeli, inyuma y’iharura ryari ryakozwe na se Dawidi; basanga ni ibihumbi ijana na mirongo itanu na bitatu n’amajana atandatu.

Atoranya ibihumbi mirongo indwi bo muri bo abashinga kuba abikorezi abandi ibihumbi mirongo umunani abashinga kuba abo kubaza amabuye mu misozi, abandi ibihumbi bitatu n’amajana atandatu abashinga kuba abakoresha abandi baraba ko abantu bariko barakora.

Maze Salomo atangura kwubakira Uhoraho Ingoro i Yerusalemu ku musozi Moriya, hamwe Uhoraho yari yariyerekeye se Dawidi. Hari ku mbuga yo kugosorerako ingano ya Orunani Umuyebusi, ikibanza cari categuwe na Dawidi.
Atangura kwubaka ku musi ugira kabiri w’ukwezi kwa kabiri mu mwaka ugira kane ari ku ngoma.
Umushinge Salomo yubatse wo kwubakako iyo Ngoro y’Imana wari ufise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itandatu z’uburebure n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri z’ubwaguke.

Ibaraza ry’amaja imbere y’iyo Ngoro ryari rifise uburebure bungana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri hamwe n’igihagararo kingana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri nyene. Imbere mu Ngoro ahomeka inzahabu ihinguwe neza.
Icumba gikuru acubakisha imbaho z’amasederi, azomekako inzahabu zihinguwe neza, hanyuma ashushanyako ibigazi n’imigufu.
Ashariza impome z’Ingoro n’amabuye y’igiciro kinini. Inzahabu yakoresheje zavuye i Paruvayimu.
Imyamba ifashe igisenge, ibishimaryango, impome hamwe n’imiryango y’Ingoro avyomekako inzahabu, hanyuma impome azishushanyako abakerubi.

Yubaka Ahera Cane, uburebure bwaho bwangana n’ubwaguke bw’Ingoro; ni ukuvuga ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri hamwe rero n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri z’ubwaguke. Imbere ahomeka inzahabu ihinguwe neza ipima italanto amajana atandatu .
Imisumari y’inzahabu yapima shekeli mirongo itanu . Ivyumba vyo hejuru na vyo nyene avyomekako inzahabu.
Abaza ibishushanyo bibiri vy’abakerubi vyo gushira Ahera Cane, avyomekako inzahabu.

Ubwaguke bw’amababa y’abo bakerubi uko ari babiri bwangana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri . Ibaba rimwe ry’umukerubi wa mbere ryari rifise uburebure bungana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu kandi ryakora ku ruhome rw’Ingoro, mu gihe irindi baba, na ryo nyene rifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu, ryafatana n’ibaba ry’uwundi mukerubi.

Ibaba ry’umukerubi wa kabiri ryapima ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu rigakora ku kindi gihome c’urusengero, irindi baba na ryo nyene ryapima ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu z’uburebure, rigakora kw’ibaba ry’umukerubi wa mbere.
Amababa y’abo bakerubi yari afise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri . Bari bahagaze, batumbereye Ahera Cane.
Ashona igihuzu mu nyuzi z’amabara y’ubururu avanze n’ayatukura hamwe n’ayera derere, gishushanijweko abakerubi.

Imbere y’Ingoro yubaka inkingi zibiri, zose hamwe zareha n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itatu na zitanu z’uburebure bw’igihagararo, imwe yose ku mutwe yari ifise umwashi upima ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu .
Akora imigufu isobekeranye ayishira ku mitwe y’izo nkingi, aca acura ibisa n’ivyamwa vyitwa amakomamanga ijana abimanika kuri iyo migufu.
Ahagarika za nkingi imbere y’Ingoro, imwe ayishira amaja mu bumanuko iyindi amaja mu buraruko. Iyo mu bumanuko ayita Yakini, iyo mu buraruko ayita Bowazi.

Salomo acurisha mu butare bwitwa umwakaka igicaniro kingana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri z’uburebure, ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri z’ubwaguke hamwe n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi z’igihagararo .

Yongera akoresha ibesani nini ayita ikiyaga, bayikora ari umuzingi mu butare bw’umwakaka. Ubwaguke bwayo ku rubiga, uva ku ruhande rumwe uja ku rundi uciye hagati bwangana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi , kandi yari ifise igihagararo kingana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu . Uburebure bw’uwo muzingi na wo uwuzungurutse bwari ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itatu .

Musi y’urubiga, hari ibibumbano bisa n’impfizi z’inka bikikuje hose, vyari cumicumi ku hantu hangana n’ingero y’igice c’ukuboko imwe . Ivyo bibumbano vy’impfizi vyari bitonze ku mirongo ibiri bifatanye n’ico kiyaga gikozwe mu butare bw’umwakaka.

Iyo besani yari ihagaze ku bibumbano vy’impfizi cumi na zibiri zicuzwe mu butare bw’umwakaka, zitatu zikaraba mu buraruko, zitatu mu burengero, izindi zitatu mu bumanuko hamwe n’izindi zitatu zaraba mu buseruko. Iyo besani bita ikiyaga, yari iteretse hejuru kuri ivyo bibumbano vy’izo mpfizi, maze ibice vy’inyuma vyazo bikaraba hagati musi y’ico kiyaga.
Cari gifise intimbatimba ingana n’ikiganza c’umuntu, kandi urubiga rwaco rwari rumeze nk’urw’igikombe, nk’ishurwe ry’ikirungu risambuye. Cashobora kwuzuzwa n’ingero batu ibihumbi bitatu.

Salomo aca akoresha amabesani matomato cumi yo kwogerezamwo ibikoresho bakoresha mu gutanga ibimazi bitongozwa umuriro: atanu ayashira ku ruhande rw’ubumanuko, ayandi atanu ayashira ku ruhande rwo mu buraruko. Ariko ya besani yitwa ikiyaga, yari iyo abaherezi bakarabiramwo.
Salomo akoresha ibiterekwako amatara cumi nk’uko amategeko yavyo yari ari, abishira mu Ngoro, bitanu mu ruhande rw’ubumanuko, bindi bitanu mu ruhande rw’uburaruko.
Salomo akoresha imeza icumi azishira mu Ngoro, zitanu zija mu ruhande rwo mu bumanuko izindi zitanu zija mu ruhande rwo mu buraruko. Yongera akoresha mu nzahabu utubakure two kumijagira ijana.
Yubakisha n’ibaraza ry’abaherezi, hamwe n’ikindi kibanza c’ibaraza kinini. Aca akoresha n’inzugi z’imiryango ija muri ayo mabaraza, azomekako ubutare bw’umwakaka.
Ashira ya besani yitwa ikiyaga ku ruhande rw’ubumanuko, mu gice c’iyo Ngoro giherereye mu buseruko.
Huramu yarakoze kandi inkono, ivyaruzo, hamwe n’utubakure two kumijagira. Maze Huramu aheraheza ico gikorwa c’umwami Salomo yari yatanguye mu Ngoro y’Imana:
za nkingi zibiri; ya myashi ibiri imeze nk’ibikombe yo ku mutwe w’izo nkingi; ya migufu ibiri isobekeranye yo gushariza iyo myashi ibumbwe bwa bikombe biri ku mitwe y’izo nkingi;
vya bicurano bisa n’amakomamanga amajana ane yo kuri ya migufu ibiri; imirongo ibiri y’ibisa n’amakomamanga ku mugufu umwumwe usharije ya myashi iri ku mitwe ya za nkingi;
Ivyo guterekako ya mabesani hamwe n’ayo mabesani nyene;
ca kiyaga na vya bibumbano vy’amashuri cumi n’abiri cari giteretseko;

za nkono, vya vyaruzo, amakanya yo guterura inyama n’ibindi bikoresho bijanye na vyo. Ibikoresho vyose Huramu Abi yakoreye umwami Salomo ku bw’iyo Ngoro y’ Uhoraho vyari mu butare bw’umwakaka uhinguwe neza.
Umwami ategeka ko bifyaturirwa mu maforoma y’ibumba mu kiyaya ca Yorodani hagati ya Sukoti na Zereda.
Ivyo bintu vyose Salomo yakoze vyari vyinshi cane ku buryo igipimo c’ubutare bw’umwakaka bwakoreshejwe kitashobora kumenyekana.
Salomo yongera akora ibikoresho vyose vyari mu Ngoro y’Imana: igicaniro c’inzahabu, imeza yo gushirako ya mikate ihezagiye,
vya biterekwako amatara vy’inzahabu ihinguwe neza n’amatara yavyo, yo kubonesha imbere y’Ahera Cane nk’uko vyategetswe;
ya mashurwe acuzwe mu nzahabu, amatara, n’ivyo kuyora umunyota vyose vyari bikozwe mu nzahabu ihinguye neza;
imbugita, utubakure, ibikombe n’udusahani tw’umunyota bicuzwe mu nzahabu ihinguye neza; n’inzugi z’Ingoro zikozwe mu nzahabu: inzugi zinjira Ahera n’iz’Ahera Cane.

Igikorwa cose Salomo yakoreye Ingoro y’ Uhoraho giheze, aca yinjiza ibintu vyose se Dawidi yari yaragize inyegu y’ Uhoraho : ifeza, inzahabu n’ibindi bikoresho abishira mu bubiko bw’iyo Ngoro y’Imana.

Nuko umwami Salomo aca atumako abakuru b’Abisirayeli, abatware b’imiryango bose n’abaserukira amazu y’Abisirayeli, bakoranira i Yerusalemu kugira ngo bazane Isandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho , bayikure aho yari iri i Siyoni mu Gisagara ca Dawidi, bayijane mu kibanza gishasha kiri muri iyo Ngoro.
Abisirayeli bose bakoranira imbere y’umwami ku musi mukuru w’insago, hari mu kwezi kw’indwi.
Abakuru bose b’Abisirayeli bamaze gushika, Abalewi baterura ya sandugu,
badugana Isandugu y’ Uhoraho n’Ihema ry’Ibonaniro, badugana n’ibikoresho vyose vyakoreshwa muri ryo. Abaherezi ari bo Balewi ni bo babiduganye.
Umwami Salomo n’ikoraniro ryose ry’Abisirayeli bari bakoraniye hamwe bari imbere y’iyo sandugu, batanga ibimazi vyinshi vy’intama n’inka bitashoboye kwandikwa canke ngo biharurwe.
Abo baherezi baca bajana iyo Sandugu y’Isezerano y’ Uhoraho aho yateguriwe mu gice c’imbere mu Ngoro, ari ho hitwa Ahera Cane, baca bayishira musi y’amababa ya ba bakerubi.
Abo bakerubi bari bashanje amababa hejuru y’aho iyo Sandugu yari iri, agapfuka Isandugu hamwe n’imyamba bayireruza.
Iyo myamba yari miremire ku buryo umuntu ari Ahera Cane yashobora kubona aho igarukira. Ariko umuntu atarashika Ahera, ntivyashoboka ko ayibona; kandi n’uwu musi ni ho ikiri.
Nta kindi kintu cari muri iyo sandugu kiretse vya bisate Mose yashiramwo ari i Horebu, aho Uhoraho yagiraniye isezerano n’Abisirayeli bamaze kuva muri Egiputa.
Abaherezi baca barasohoka bava Ahera. Abaherezi bari ngaho bose bari bihumanuye, hadakurikijwe imice yabo.

Abalewi bose bari abaririmvyi, Asafu, Hemani, Yedutuni n’abahungu babo n’ab’iwabo bose, barahaguruka bahagarara mu buseruko bw’igicaniro, bambaye impuzu zera derere bavuza ivyuma bisama, inanga n’amakembe. Bari baherekejwe n’abaherezi ijana na mirongo ibiri bavuza inzamba.

Abavuza inzamba n’abaririmvyi baririmba mw’ijwi rimwe, nk’umuntu umwe, mu guhimbaza bashimira Uhoraho . Baherekejwe n’inzamba, ivyuma bisama n’ibindi bicurarangisho, bashira amajwi hejuru bahimbaza Uhoraho baririmba bati: "Ni mwiza; urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira." Maze Ingoro y’ Uhoraho yuzura igicu c’ubwiza,
abaherezi ntibaba bagishobora gukora igikorwa cabo kubera ico gicu, kuko ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho bwari bwuzuye Ingoro y’Imana.
Maze Salomo avuga ati: "Ewe Uhoraho , wavuze ko uba mu gicu c’umwijima w’umuzitanya.
Ariko jewe nakwubakiye Ingoro y’igitangaza, ikibanza uzokwiberamwo ibihe vyose."
Ikoraniro ryose ry’Abisirayeli rigihagaze ngaho, umwami arahindukira arabahezagira.
Maze avuga ati: " Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli ahimbazwe, we ashikije n’amaboko yiwe ivyo yari yarasezeraniye data Dawidi n’akanwa kiwe, aho yavuga ati:

‘Uhereye umusi nakuriye ubwoko bwanje mu gihugu ca Egiputa, sinigeze ntoranya igisagara na kimwe co mu miryango ya Isirayeli ngo cubakwemwo Ingoro yitirirwa izina ryanje, canke ngo ntoranye umuntu n’umwe ngo abe uwo kurongora ubwoko bwanje bw’Abisirayeli.
Ariko ubu ntoranije Yerusalemu ngo izina ryanje rihabe, kandi ntoranije Dawidi kugira ngo abe ari we aganza abantu banje b’Abisirayeli.’
Data Dawidi yari afise umugambi mu mutima wo kwubakira Ingoro izina ry’ Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli;
ariko Uhoraho amubwira ati: ‘Wagize neza kwiyumvira kwubakira Ingoro izina ryanje,
ariko si wewe uzoyubaka. Umuhungu wawe, uwo wivyariye, ni we azokwubakira Ingoro izina ryanje.’

Uhoraho yazigamye isezerano ryiwe. Yansubije mu gishingo ca data Dawidi; none ubu nicaye ku ntebe y’ubwami bwa Isirayeli, nk’uko Uhoraho yabisezeranye, kandi nanje nubatse Ingoro yo guhesha icubahiro izina ry’ Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli.
Aho ni ho nashize ya sandugu irimwo rya sezerano Uhoraho yagiranye n’ubwoko bw’Abisirayeli."
Maze Salomo ahagarara imbere y’igicaniro c’ Uhoraho n’imbere y’ikoraniro ryose ry’Abisirayeli agorora amaboko yiwe.

Salomo yari yarubatse hagati na hagati muri rwa rugo, ahantu hataramutse ho guhagarara mu butare bw’umwakaka, hangana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu z’uburebure n’ubwaguke, hakagira n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitatu z’igihagararo . Ahagararaho, araheza apfukama imbere y’ikoraniro ryose ry’Abisirayeli agorora amaboko ayerekeje mw’ijuru.
Nuko aravuga ati: "Ewe Uhoraho Mana ya Isirayeli, nta yindi Mana ihwanye nawe mw’ijuru no mw’isi, wewe uzigama isezerano wagiriye abasavyi bawe, bagukurikira n’imitima yabo yose.
Wazigamye isezerano wagiriye data Dawidi umusavyi wawe, urisezeranishije akanwa kawe, none uwu musi urishikishije amaboko yawe.

None rero Uhoraho , Mana ya Isirayeli, zigamira umusavyi wawe Dawidi ari we data, isezerano wamugiriye, aho wavuga uti: ‘Mu ruvyaro rwawe, ntihazokwigera habura uwuba ku ngoma ya Isirayeli, nirwagendera mu Vyagezwe vyanje nk’uko wabigendeyemwo.’
None rero Uhoraho , Mana ya Isirayeli, shitsa isezerano wasezeraniye data Dawidi umusavyi wawe.
