Barongera bugara inzugi z’ibaraza, bazimya n’amatara. Vyongeye ntibashikaniye Imana y’Abisirayeli ibimota neza canke ikimazi na kimwe co guturirirwa Ahera hayo.
Ni co gituma uburake bw’ Uhoraho bwasutswe ku Bayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu; akabahindura ibimaramare, bakaba akabarore n’agatwengo, nk’uko mushobora kuvyibonera n’amaso yanyu.
Iki ni co catumye ba sogokuruza bacu bicwa n’inkota, abahungu bacu n’abakobwa bacu, eka mbere n’abagore bacu bakajanwa nk’imbohe.
None rero ubu nagabiye kugiriranira isezerano n’ Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli, kugira ngo uburake bwiwe butuveko.
Nuko rero bagenzi, ibi ntimubifate minenerwe, kuko Uhoraho yabatoranije ngo muhagarare imbere yiwe mumukorera, ngo mukore igikorwa ciwe, mumuturirire ibimota neza."

Nuko aba Balewi baca bitegurira gukora. Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Kohati ni: Mahati mwene Amasayi na Yoweli mwene Azariya. Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Merari ni: Kishi mwene Abudi na Azariya mwene Yehaleleli. Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Gerishoni ni: Yowa mwene Zima na Edeni mwene Yowa.
Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Elizafani ni: Shimuri na Yeyiyeli. Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Asafu ni: Zakariya na Mataniya.
Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Hemani ni: Yehiyeli na Shimeyi. Mu bakomoka mu nzu kwa Yedutuni ni: Shemaya na Uziyeli.
Bamaze gukoranya benewabo b’Abalewi no kwihumanura, baca barinjira kugira ngo bahumanure Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , nk’uko umwami yari yabibategetse, yisunze ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .

Abaherezi binjira imbere mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho kugira ngo bayihumanure. Maze basohora hanze mu rugo rw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho ikintu cose gihumanye basanze muri iyo Ngoro. Abalewi na bo baca baravyakira babimanukana mu mwonga wa Kidironi.

Batanguye guhumanura Ingoro ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa mbere, maze ku musi w’umunani w’ukwo kwezi bashika ku rwinjiriro rw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho . Mu misi umunani yakurikiye, bahumanura Ingoro ubwayo; barangiza ico gikorwa ku musi wa cumi na gatandatu w’ukwezi kwa mbere.

Baca binjira aho umwami Hezekiya yari ari bamubwira bati: "Twahumanuye ingoro yose y’ Uhoraho , igicaniro co guturirirako ibimazi n’ibikoresho vyaco, n’imeza y’imikate ishikaniwe Imana n’ibikoresho vyayo vyose.
Twateguye turongera turahumanura ibikoresho vyose umwami Ahazi yari yarasohoye kubera kutubaha Imana kwiwe igihe yari umwami. Ubu biri imbere y’igicaniro c’ Uhoraho ."
Bukeye mu gatondo ka kare umwami Hezekiya akoranya abakuru bo mu gisagara baca baduga ku Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .

Bazana amashuri y’inka indwi, impfizi z’intama indwi, imyagazi y’intama indwi, n’amasuguru y’impene indwi, babitanga kw’ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha ku bw’ubwami, ku bw’Ingoro no ku bw’Abayuda. Umwami ategeka abaherezi, abo mu ruvyaro rwa Aroni, ngo babitangire ku gicaniro c’ Uhoraho .

Nuko bakerera ya mashuri, maze abaherezi batwara amaraso bayamija ku gicaniro; hanyuma bakerera za mpfizi z’intama, amaraso yazo bayamija ku gicaniro; baca bakerera na ya myagazi y’intama, amaraso yayo bayamija ku gicaniro.
Za suguru z’impene zo gutangwako ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha zizanwa imbere y’umwami n’ikoraniro ryose, bazirambikako ibiganza.

Abaherezi baca barazikerera, amaraso yazo bayazana ku gicaniro co gutangirako ikimazi c’ivyaha kugira ngo batangire impongano Abisirayeli bose, kuko umwami yari yategetse ko baturira ikimazi c’ivyaha bagatanga n’ishikanwa ry’ivyaha kubw’Abisirayeli bose.

Ahagarika Abalewi mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho bafise ibicurarangisho bisamirana, inanga n’amakembe, nk’uko vyashinzwe na Dawidi na Gadi uwerekwa w’umwami hamwe n’uwavugishwa n’Imana Natani. Ivyo vyari vyategetswe n’ Uhoraho abicishije mu bo yavugisha.
Nuko Abalewi bahagarara bafise ivyo bicurarangisho vya Dawidi, abaherezi na bo bafise inzamba zabo.

Nuko Hezekiya ategeka ko batangira vya bimazi biturirwa ku gicaniro. Bagitangura kubitanga, indirimbo zo guhimbaza Uhoraho zica zirasamirana, inzamba ziravuzwa, na vya bicurarangisho vya Dawidi umwami w’Abisirayeli.
Ikoraniro ryose rirunama rirasenga, mu gihe abaririmvyi bariko bararirimba bavuza n’inzamba. Ivyo birabandanya gushika bahejeje gutanga vya bimazi vyo guturirwa.
Bahejeje gutanga ivyo bimazi, umwami n’abari ngaho bose barapfukama barasenga.

Umwami Hezekiya n’abakuru bari kumwe na we bategeka Abalewi guhimbaza Uhoraho bakoresheje amajambo ya Dawidi n’aya Asafu uwerekwa. Nuko baririmba indirimbo zo gutazira banezerewe, baca bunamika imitwe yabo barasenga.

Maze Hezekiya aravuga ati: "Ubu rero mwamaze kwiyegurira Uhoraho . Nimuzane ibimazi n’amashikanwa y’ishimwe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho ." Nuko ikoraniro ryose rizana ibimazi n’amashikanwa y’ishimwe, n’abandi bose bavyishakiye bazana n’ibimazi vyo guturirwa.
Igitigiri c’amashikanwa ikoraniro ryazanye cari amashuri y’inka mirongo indwi, impfizi z’intama ijana, n’imyagazi y’intama amajana abiri; vyose hamwe biba ibimazi vyo guturirwa bishikaniwe Uhoraho .
Ibitungwa vyose vyashikaniwe Uhoraho nk’ibimazi vyari amashuri y’inka amajana atandatu n’intama n’impene ibihumbi bitatu.

Ariko Abaherezi bari bake cane ntibashobora kubaga vya bimazi vyose. Nuko bagenzi babo b’Abalewi barabafasha gushika igikorwa giheze, mbere gushika n’abandi baherezi barobanuwe, kuko Abalewi bashize umutima ku gukora ibitunganye kurusha abaherezi.

Hariho ibimazi vyo guturirwa vyinshi cane, hamwe n’ibinure vy’ibimazi vy’ishimwe n’amashikanwa y’ibinyobwa aherekeza ivyo bimazi vyo guturirwa. Nuko igikorwa co mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho kiba kirasubijweho.
Hezekiya n’abantu bose baranezerwa kubera ivyo Imana yari ishikije ku bantu bayo, kuko vyari bikozwe mu mwanya muto.

Hezekiya atumako Abisirayeli bose n’Abayuda, kandi yandikira amakete Abefurayimu n’Abamanase, abaha ubutumire ngo baze mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho i Yerusalemu guhimbaza Pasika y’ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli.
Umwami n’abaganwa biwe n’ikoraniro ryose bari i Yerusalemu bari biyemeje guhimbaza Pasika mu kwezi kwa kabiri.
Ntibari bwashobore kuyihimbaza mu bihe vyategekanijwe kuko ata baherezi bakwiye bari bwarobanurwe, kandi abantu ntibari bwigere bakoranira i Yerusalemu.
Iyo nteguro yo guhimbaza Pasika yabonetse ko ari nziza ku mwami no ku bantu bose.

Baca bafata ingingo yo gutuma intumwa mu Bwisirayeli hose, uhereye i Berisheba mu bumanuko ugashika i Dani mu buraruko, bahamagara abantu ngo baze i Yerusalemu guhimbaza Pasika y’ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli. Ntibari bwayihimbaze ari benshi nk’uko vyari vyaranditswe.

Kw’itegeko ry’umwami, intumwa zikwira hose mu Bwisirayeli n’i Buyuda zitwaye amakete avuye ku mwami no ku baganwa biwe, avuga ngo: "Yemwe Bisirayeli mwese, nimugaruke k’ Uhoraho , Imana ya Aburahamu, na Isaka na Isirayeli, kugira ngo na we abagarukeko mwebwe abasigaye, mutahitanywe n’agatikizo k’abami b’i Ashuri.
Ntimube nka ba sogokuruza na benewanyu, babaye ibigaba imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza, ari co catumye ibahindura akajoreza nk’uko mubibona.

Ntimukomantaze imitima nk’uko ba sogokuruza banyu bayikomantaje; mwumvire Uhoraho . Muze mu Ngoro yiwe, iyo yejeje akayitoranya ibihe bidashira. Mukorere Uhoraho Imana yanyu, kugira ngo uburake bwiwe bw’inkazi bubaveko.

Nimwahindukirira Uhoraho , benewanyu n’abana banyu bazogirirwa akagongwe n’ababajanye nk’inyagano maze bagaruke muri iki gihugu, kuko Uhoraho Imana yanyu ari inyembabazi kandi igira ikigongwe cinshi. Nimwamuhindukirira, ntazobakurako inyonga ziwe."
Za ntumwa ziragenda, ziva mu gisagara zija mu kindi, mu Befurayimu no mu Bamanase, gushika mu Bazebuloni; ariko abantu baritwengera, barabakengera.
Yamara abantu bamwe bo mu Basheri, Abamanase n’Abazebuloni bicisha bugufi baja i Yerusalemu.
No mu Buyuda, ukuboko kw’Imana kuba ku bantu baho, abaha kugira umutima umwe wo gukora ivyo umwami n’abaganwa biwe bari bategetse, bivuye mw’ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .
Nuko mu kwezi kwa kabiri, abantu benshi bakoranira i Yerusalemu ngo bahimbaze Umusi Mukuru w’imikate itarimwo umwambiro.
Bakuraho ibicaniro vyari i Yerusalemu, basambura n’ibicaniro batangirako ibimota neza, babita mu mwonga wa Kidironi.

Maze ku musi ugira cumi na kane w’ukwezi kwa kabiri, bakerera umwagazi wa Pasika. Abaherezi n’Abalewi bari buzuye ibimaramare, baca barihumanura maze bazana ibimazi vyo guturirwa mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Maze baca baja mu bibanza vyabo nk’uko vyanditswe mu Vyagezwe vya Mose umuntu w’Imana. Abaherezi bamija ku gicaniro amaraso baherejwe n’Abalewi.

Kubera ko mw’ikoraniro harimwo abantu benshi batari bihumanuye, Abalewi ni bo bahavuye bakerera imyagazi y’intama ya Pasika y’abantu bose bari bahumanye, kuko batashobora gushikiriza iyo myagazi yabo Uhoraho .

Kandi naho abantu benshi mu bari bavuye mu Befurayimu, mu Bamanase, mu Bisakari no mu Bazebuloni batari bihumanuye, barariye Pasika, banyuranya n’uko vyanditswe. Ariko, Hezekiya arabasengera, avuga ati: "Icompa Uhoraho , kuko ari mwiza, akababarira umuntu wese
yashize umutima wiwe ku kurondera Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sekuruza naho ahumanye ku bw’amategeko y’Ahera."
Maze Uhoraho yumva ugusenga kwa Hezekiya, akiza abantu.

Abisirayeli bari i Yerusalemu bahimbaza Umusi Mukuru w’imikate itarimwo umwambiro, bamara imisi indwi banezerewe cane, mu gihe Abalewi n’abaherezi baguma bararirimbira Uhoraho ku musi ku musi, bakoresheje ibicurarangisho bisamirana, vyeguriwe Uhoraho .

Hezekiya avuga amajambo yo gutera intege Abalewi bose bari berekanye ko batahura neza igikorwa c’Imana. Muri iyo misi indwi bariye umugabane wabo batanga n’ibimazi vy’ishimwe barongera bahimbaza Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza.
Maze ikoraniro ryose rica ryemeranya kwongerako iyindi misi indwi, bayimara bahimbaza Imana kandi banezerewe.

Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda ategura amashuri y’inka igihumbi n’intama n’impene ibihumbi indwi ku bw’iryo koraniro, n’abaganwa na bo batanga amashuri y’inka igihumbi n’intama n’impene ibihumbi cumi. Igitigiri kinini c’abaherezi barihumanura.
Ikoraniro ryose ry’Abayuda riranezerwa, hamwe n’abaherezi n’Abalewi n’abari bakoraniye hamwe na bo bavuye mu Bisirayeli, harimwo n’abanyamahanga bari baje bava mu Bwisirayeli n’ababa i Buyuda.
Hari umunezero mwinshi cane i Yerusalemu, kuko kuva mu misi ya Salomo mwene Dawidi umwami w’Abisirayeli hatari bwabe ikintu nk’ico i Yerusalemu.
Abaherezi n’Abalewi barahaguruka ngo bahezagire abantu, maze Imana irabumva, kuko isengesho ryabo ryashitse mw’ijuru, ahera hayo, aho iba.

Ivyo vyose biheze, Abisirayeli bose bari ngaho barasohoka baja mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda, basitagura inkingi z’amabuye zose, batemagura n’inkingi za Ashera. Basambura ibicaniro vyo ku mataba y’imisozi n’ibicaniro vyari i Buyuda hose, i Bubenyamini, mu Befurayimu no mu Bamanase. Abisirayeli bamaze gusambura vyose, baca basubira mu bisagara vyabo no mu ngo zabo.

Hezekiya ashira abaherezi n’Abalewi mu mice; umuce wose ukurikije ibikorwa vyabo, ngo batange ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’ivy’ishimwe, bongere bakore ibikorwa vy’Imana, batange amashimwe kandi bahimbarize ku marembo y’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .

Umwami na we araterera, atanga ku bivuye mu butunzi bwiwe ngo bikoreshwe mu bimazi vyo guturirwa mu gitondo, ivyo ku mugoroba, ivyo ku masabato, ivy’ukwezi guserutse, n’ivyo ku misi mikuru yashinzwe nk’uko vyanditswe mu Vyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho .
Ategeka abantu baba i Yerusalemu ngo batange ivyo bakuye mu vyabo bigenewe abaherezi n’Abalewi kugira ngo abo na bo bashobore kwiyegurira ibikorwa vy’Ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho .

Iryo tegeko rigisohoka, Abisirayeli batangana umutima ubikunze ku vya mbere vyeze vyo mu vyimburwa vyabo vy’ibinyantete, umuvinyu mushasha, amavuta, ubuki n’ibindi vyose biva mu burimyi. Bazana ibintu vyinshi, n’ikigiracumi c’ibintu vyose.

Abantu bo mu Bwisirayeli n’i Buyuda baba mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda, na bo bazana ikigiracumi co mu masho yabo n’imikuku yabo hamwe n’ikigiracumi c’ibintu vyeguriwe Uhoraho Imana yabo, barabirunda biba ikirundo kinini.
Batanguye kubikora mu kwezi kwa gatatu babiheza mu kwezi kw’indwi.
Maze Hezekiya n’abaganwa biwe baje bakabona ivyo birundo, bahimbaza Uhoraho kandi bahezagira abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli.
Hezekiya abaza abaherezi n’Abalewi ivyerekeye ivyo birundo ati: "Mbega ibi bintu vyose vyavuye hehe?"

Maze Azariya umuherezi mukuru, yava mu muryango wa Sadoki, amwishura ati: "Kuva igihe abantu batanguriye kuzana intererano zabo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , dufise ivyokurya bikwiye hamwe n’ibirenzeko vyinshi twimbuye, kuko Uhoraho yahezagiye abantu biwe, kandi ibi vyinshi ubona ni ibirenzeko."
Hezekiya ategeka ko bategura ububiko mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , na bo babigenza gutyo.

Maze bazana intererano zabo mu bwizigirwa, ivyo batanze ku bw’ico gikorwa, ibigiracumi n’ivyo batanze nk’ingabire zeguriwe Imana. Konaniya, Umulewi, ni we yari ajejwe kubiraba; uwo bavukana Shimeyi akaba icegera ciwe.

Yehiyeli, Azaziya, Nahati, Asaheli, Yerimoti, Yozabadi, Eliyeli, Isimakiya, Mahati na Benaya bari abunganizi bafasha Konaniya na Shimeyi mwenewabo. Bashizweho n’umwami Hezekiya na Azariya umukuru yari ashinzwe Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .

Kora mwene Imuna Umulewi, yari umurinzi w’Irembo ryo mu Buseruko; yari ajejwe n’amashikanwa yashikaniwe Imana, atanzwe nk’uko umuntu wese avyishakiye, no kugabura izo ntererano zihawe Uhoraho hamwe n’ingabire zatanzwe ngo zibe inyegu y’Imana.

Mu bisagara vy’abaherezi, yari afise abamufasha mu bwizigirwa ari bo Edeni, Miniyamini, Yesuwa, Shemaya, Amariya na Shekaniya; bakagaburira bagenzi babo b’abaherezi nk’uko imice yabo yari iri, baba abakuze canke abakiri bato.

Hamwe n’ivyo, bagaburira n’abahungu bose, uhereye ku bamaze imyaka itatu n’iyirenga, abo amazina yabo yari yanditswe mu ntonde z’ingene abantu bagiye bararondoka, abashobora kwinjira mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , bose ngo bakore ibikorwa bajejwe kandi bitandukanye vyo ku musi ku musi, hakurikijwe kandi imigwi yabo n’ivyo yashinzwe.

Bagaburira abaherezi bahawe ibikorwa hakurikijwe imiryango yabo nk’uko vyari mu ntonde z’ingene bagiye bararondoka, kandi n’Abalewi bikagenda gutyo, abamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga, nk’uko ibikorwa vyabo n’imice yabo vyari biri.
Bongeramwo n’abakiri bato, abagore, abahungu n’abakobwa bo muri uwo muryango bose banditswe ku ntonde z’ingene bagiye bararondoka; kuko bari babaye abizigirwa mu kwiyegurira Imana rwose.

Ku vy’abaherezi, abakomoka kuri Aroni baba mu matongo akikije ibisagara vyabo canke mu bindi bisagara ivyo ari vyo vyose, hariho abagabo bari batoranijwe, bagenwa ku mazina yabo ngo bagaburire imigabane umugabo wese yari muri bo n’abandi bose bari ku rutonde rw’Abalewi.
Ivyo ni vyo Hezekiya yakoze mu Buyuda hose; akora ibigororotse, bitunganye kandi vyo kwizigirwa imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe.
Ivyo yakoze vyose, vyaba ibijanye n’igikorwa co mu Ngoro y’Imana canke ivyo kwumvira Ivyagezwe vyayo n’amabwirizwa yayo, yarondeye Imana yiwe n’umutima wiwe wose. Ivyo vyatumye aroranirwa muri vyose.
Inyuma y’ivyo vyose Hezekiya yakoze mu bwizigirwa, Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri aza gutera i Buyuda. Yugariza ibisagara bizitijwe inzitiro z’amabuye, agomba kuvyigarurira.
Maze Hezekiya abonye ko Senakeribu yaje kandi ko atumbereye kugwanya Yerusalemu,
avugana n’abaganwa biwe n’abakuru b’ingabo ngo bazibire amazi yo mu masoko yose yari inyuma y’igisagara, maze baramufasha.
Abantu benshi barakorana, bazibira amasoko yose n’umugezi wose watemba mu gihugu. Baravuga bati: "Ni iki cotuma umwami w’i Ashuri aza agasanga amazi yuzuye?"

Aca akora cane mu gusanura ibihengeri vyose vy’uruzitiro no mu kwubaka iminara kuri rwo. Yubaka n’urundi ruzitiro inyuma y’urwo, akomeza n’amabaraza yo mu Gisagara ca Dawidi. Yongera acurisha ibigwanisho vyinshi n’inkinzo nyinshi.
Ashinga abakuru b’ingabo bo kurongora abantu, aca arabakoranya imbere yiwe i ruhande y’irembo ry’igisagara, maze abatera intege muri aya majambo ati:
"Mukomere kandi mureme. Ntimutinye canke ngo mwihebure kubera umwami w’i Ashuri n’ingabo nyinshi ziri kumwe na we; kuko hari ubushobozi bwinshi buri kumwe natwe kuruta uburi kumwe na we.
We yishimikije inkomezi z’umuntu w’inyama n’amaraso, ariko tweho turi kumwe n’ Uhoraho Imana yacu ngo itugwanire intambara." Maze abantu bararema kubw’amajambo Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda avuze.

Hanyuma y’ivyo, igihe Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri n’ingabo ziwe zose bari bugarije i Lakishi, yaciye arungika abaganwa biwe i Yerusalemu, abarungikana ubutumwa kwa Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda n’abantu bose b’i Buyuda bari aho, ati:
"Uku ni ko Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri avuze: ngo mbega mwishimirije iki cotuma muguma i Yerusalemu kandi hugarijwe?
Iyo Hezekiya ababwiye ngo: ‘ Uhoraho Imana yacu iradukiza idukure mu kuboko kw’umwami w’i Ashuri,’ aba ariko arabahenda, kugira ngo mwicwe n’inzara n’inyota.

Mbega Hezekiya ubwiwe si we yakuyeho ibicaniro vyo ku misozi n’ibindi bicaniro vyose vy’imana, akabwira Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu ati: ‘Muzohora musengera imbere y’igicaniro kimwe kandi ni co muzoturirirako ibimazi’?
Mbega ntimuzi ivyo twe na ba sogokuruza banje twakoreye abantu bose bo mu yandi mahanga? Mbega imana z’ayo mahanga hari aho zigeze zishobora kuyakiza ngo zikure igihugu cayo mu kuboko kwanje?
Mbega mu mana zose z’ayo mahanga ba data basanganguye, ni izihe zashoboye gukiza abantu bazo ukuboko kwanje? None imana yanyu yobakiza gute mu maboko yanje?

Nuko ntimwemere ko Hezekiya abahenda canke ngo abazimize kugeza hiyo. Ntimwemere ivyo ababwira, kuko ata mana y’ihanga na rimwe canke y’ubwami na bumwe yashoboye gukiza abantu bayo ngo ibakure mu kuboko kwanje canke kwa ba sogokuruza bacu. Mbega ibi ntibirushirije kubereka ko imana yanyu itazoshobora kubakura mu kuboko kwanje?"
Maze izo ntumwa za Senakeribu zivuga n’ibindi vyinshi vyo gucokora Uhoraho Imana n’umusavyi wayo Hezekiya.

Uwo mwami yandika n’ayandi amakete yo gutuka Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli; mu kuyicokora yongera avuga ngo: "Nk’uko imana z’ayandi mahanga zitashoboye gutabara abantu bazo ngo zibakure mu kuboko kwanje, ni ko n’imana ya Hezekiya itazokiza iri hanga mu kuboko kwanje."
Nuko bahamagara abantu b’i Yerusalemu bari ku ruzitiro, bababwira mu Giheburayo kugira ngo babace ivutu, maze babone gufata igisagara.
Bavuga Imana y’i Yerusalemu bayigereranya n’imana z’ayandi mahanga yo mw’isi, zakozwe n’intoke z’abantu.
Umwami Hezekiya n’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yesaya mwene Amozi barasemerera, basenga barangamije mw’ijuru ku bw’ivyo.

Nuko Uhoraho arungika umumarayika, yica ingabo z’abahizi bose, harimwo n’intwazangabo nkurunkuru, abasanze aho umwami w’Abashuri yari acumbitse. Maze wa mwami w’Abashuri aca asubira inyuma mu gihugu ciwe ateterewe. Umusi umwe agiye mu ngoro y’imana yiwe, bamwe mu bahungu biwe bamucumita inkota arapfa.
Uko ni ko Uhoraho yatabaye Hezekiya n’abantu b’i Yerusalemu, abakiza ukuboko kwa Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri n’ukuboko kw’abandi bansi; abarinda impande zose.
Benshi bazanira Uhoraho ibimazi i Yerusalemu n’amashikanwa y’agaciro, bayazanira Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda. Kuva ico gihe amahanga yose aca aramutinya.
Muri iyo misi Hezekiya aragwara ashika ku mpfiro. Asenga Uhoraho , na we aramwishura, amuha ikimenyetso c’igitangaza.
Ariko umutima wa Hezekiya wari wuzuye ubwibone bituma atamenya ubuntu yagiriwe. Nuko Uhoraho arakira Hezekiya, arakira Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu bose.
Mu nyuma Hezekiya yihana ubwibone bwo mu mutima wiwe, n’ab’i Yerusalemu; ivyo bituma uburake bw’ Uhoraho bubavako, ntiyasubira kubarakira mu misi yose Hezekiya yabayeho.
Hezekiya yari afise ubutunzi bwinshi n’icubahiro, kandi yari yaraziganije ifeza n’inzahabu n’amabuye y’igiciro, n’ibimota neza, inkinzo n’ibindi bintu vy’igiciro kinini.
Yubaka kandi amazu yo kwimburiramwo ingano, imivinyu n’amavuta; yubaka n’impongore z’amasho y’ubwoko bwose, n’iz’imikuku y’intama n’impene.
Yubaka ibigwati yironkera ibitigiri binini vy’imikuku n’amasho, kuko Imana yari yamuhaye ubutunzi bwinshi cane.
Hezekiya ni we yagomeye amazi y’umugezi wa Gihoni aca ashiraho umuringoti w’amazi uyajana, uciye mu burengero bw’Igisagara ca Dawidi. Ivyo yipfuza gukora vyose yarabishikako.
Ariko igihe intumwa zatumwa kuri we zivuye ku baganza i Babiloni ngo bamubaze ivyerekeye ibitangaza vyari vyabaye mu gihugu, Imana iramureka kugira ngo imugeze imenye ivyari mu mutima wiwe vyose.
Ibindi vyose vyabaye ku ngoma ya Hezekiya n’ibikorwa vyiwe vy’ubwizigirwa, vyanditswe mu vyo uwavugishwa n’Imana Yesaya mwene Amozi yeretswe, biri mu gitabu c’abami b’i Buyuda n’abo muri Isirayeli.

Nuko Hezekiya ahamvya ba sekuruza, bamuhamba ku gasozi ahari itongo bahambamwo abo mu ruvyaro rwa Dawidi. Amaze gupfa, Abayuda bose n’ab’i Yerusalemu bamuha icubahiro. Maze Manase umuhungu wiwe amusubirira ku ngoma.
Manase yabaye umwami afise imyaka cumi n’ibiri, aganza imyaka mirongo itanu n’itanu ari i Yerusalemu.
Manase akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, agendera mu bizira vy’ubuyobe vyakorwa n’amahanga Uhoraho yari yarirukanye imbere y’Abisirayeli.

Asubira kwubaka ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo, ku mataba y’imisozi, ivyo se Hezekiya yari yarasambuye; yongera kwubaka ibicaniro vya Bayali, ashinga n’inkingi za Ashera. Yunamira ibinyenyeri vyose vyo kw’ijuru arabisenga.
Yubaka ibicaniro mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , iyo Uhoraho yari yaravuzeko ati: "Izina ryanje rizoba i Yerusalemu ibihe vyose."
Mu rugo rwose rw’Ingoro y’Uhoraho ahubaka ibicaniro vy’ibinyenyeri vyose vyo kw’ijuru.

Agera n’aho atanga abahungu biwe kw’ibimazi vyo guturirwa mu kiyaya ca Beni-Hinomu, agendera mu bupfumu n’amareba, akoresha abahamagara imizimu na ba kamenyi. Akora ibibi vyinshi mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , bimutera kuraka.

Afata inkingi ya Ashera yabazishije, ayishira mu Ngoro, imwe Imana yari yabwiye Dawidi n’umuhungu wiwe Salomo iti: "Muri iyi Ngoro n’i Yerusalemu ni ho natoranije mu yindi miryango yose ya Isirayeli, ngo hitirirwe izina ryanje ibihe vyose.

Sinzosubira gutuma Abisirayeli bakura ikirenge hasi ngo bave mu gihugu nahaye ba sekuruza, nibitwararika gukora ivyo nabategetse vyose, bagakurikiza ivyagezwe vyanje vyose, amabwirizwa n’amategeko nabahaye ncishije ku musavyi wanje Mose."
Ariko Manase azimiza Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu bose, bituma bakora ibibi birengeye ivy’amahanga Uhoraho yari yarahonereje imbere y’Abisirayeli.
Uhoraho aburira Manase n’abantu biwe, ariko ntibavyitaho.
Nuko Uhoraho abateza abakuru b’ingabo z’umwami w’i Ashuri, bafata Manase bamugira imbohe, bacisha igera mu zuru ryiwe, bamubohesha iminyororo y’ubutare bw’umwakaka, maze bamujana i Babiloni.
Abonye ko ari mu mubabaro mwinshi, arondera Uhoraho Imana yiwe, yicisha bugufi cane imbere y’ Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza.
Atakambiye Uhoraho , na we aterwa n’akagongwe yumva ugutakamba kwiwe; maze amugarukana i Yerusalemu no mu bwami bwiwe. Nuko Manase amenya ko Uhoraho ari Imana.

Inyuma y’ivyo aca yubaka uruzitiro rw’inyuma y’Igisagara ca Dawidi, mu burengero bw’umugezi Gihoni mu kiyaya, gushika kw’Irembo ry’Amafi, no kuzunguruka umusozi wa Ofeli; arongera arugira rurerure cane. Ashiraho abatwara ingabo mu bisagara vyose bizitijwe inzitiro vy’i Buyuda.
Akuraho imana z’abanyamahanga, akuraho na ca gishushanyo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , n’ibicaniro vyose yari yarubatse ku musozi w’Ingoro n’i Yerusalemu; abiterera inyuma y’igisagara.
Hanyuma asana igicaniro c’ Uhoraho agitangirako ibimazi vy’ishimwe n’ibimazi vyo gukenguruka, aca abwira Abayuda ngo bakorere Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli.
Ariko abantu bakomeza gutangira ibimazi ku bicaniro vyo ku mataba y’imisozi, mugabo babishikanira Uhoraho Imana yabo gusa.

Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Manase, harimwo n’isengesho yasenze Imana yiwe, amajambo aberekwa bamubwiye mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana y’Abisirayeli, vyanditswe mu bitabu bidonda ivyagenda biraba ku ngoma z’abami b’Abisirayeli.

Isengesho ryiwe n’uburyo Imana yamugiriye ikigongwe kubera gutakamba kwiwe hamwe n’ibibi vyose yakoze, n’uguta ubwizigirwa, n’ahantu hose yubatse ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo ku misozi, akongera agashiramwo inkingi za Ashera n’ibigirwamana yunamira, vyose vyanditswe mu bitabu vy’aberekwa.
Nuko Manase arapfa; ahamvya ba sekuruza ahambwa ku kirimba iwe. Amoni umuhungu wiwe amusubirira ku ngoma.
Amoni yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’ibiri igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, aca aganza imyaka ibiri ari i Yerusalemu.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, nk’uko se Manase yakoze. Amoni asenga kandi atanga ibimazi ku bigirwamana Manase yari yaracurishije.
Ariko ntiyicisha bugufi imbere y’ Uhoraho nk’uko se Manase yakoze; Amoni arushaho gukora ibibi.
Nuko abaganwa biwe baja inama yo kumugirira nabi, maze bamugandagurira mu ngoro iwe.
Ariko abantu bo muri ico gihugu baca bafata abishe umwami Amoni barabica, bimika Yosiya umuhungu wiwe, aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.
Yosiya yari afise imyaka umunani igihe yaba umwami, aca aganza imyaka mirongo itatu n’umwe ari i Yerusalemu.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari vyiza mu nyonga ziwe; agendera mu nzira za sekuruza Dawidi, ntiyahengamira i buryo canke i bubamfu.

Mu mwaka ugira umunani ari ku ngoma, mu gihe yari akiri muto, atangura kurondera Imana ya sekuruza Dawidi. Mu mwaka ugira cumi na kabiri atangura guhumanura i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu, akuraho ibicaniro vyo hejuru ku mataba y’imisozi, akuraho inkingi za Ashera, akuraho n’ibishushanyo bibajwe n’ibicuzwe.

Ategeka ko basenyurira hasi ibicaniro vya Bayali; abomora ibicaniro baturirirako ibimota neza vyari hejuru kuri ivyo bigirwamana, asenyura n’inkingi za Ashera, ibigirwamana n’ibishushanyo. Ivyo yarabijanjaguye bicika umukungugu, aca awusuka ku mva z’ababishikaniye ibimazi;
yongera aturirira amagufa y’abaherezi ku bicaniro vyabo. Uko ni ko yahumanuye Ubuyuda n’i Yerusalemu.
Mu bisagara vy’Abamanase, Abefurayimu n’Abasimeyoni gushika mu Banafutali, no mu misaka yose yari ihakikije,
ahomvorera hasi ibicaniro n’inkingi za Ashera, amenagura n’ibigirwamana bicika umukungugu, asenyagurira hasi ibicaniro baturirirako ibimota neza mu gihugu cose ca Isirayeli, aca asubira i Yerusalemu.

Mu mwaka ugira cumi n’umunani umwami Yosiya ari ku ngoma, mu guhumanura igihugu n’Ingoro, arungika Shafani mwene Azaliya na Mayaseya umukuru w’igisagara, hamwe na Yowa mwene Yowahazi, umwanditsi, ngo basanure Ingoro y’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe.

Baja kwa Hilukiya umuherezi mukuru bamuha amahera yari yazanywe mu Ngoro y’Imana, ayo Abalewi bari bajejwe kurinda amarembo bari baregeranije mu bantu bava mu miryango y’Abamanase n’Abefurayimu, mu masigarira yose y’Abisirayeli, mu bantu bose b’i Buyuda, mu muryango w’Ababenyamini no mu baba i Yerusalemu.
Na bo bayahereza abantu bagenewe gukurikirana ico gikorwa c’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho . Abo bantu bahemba abakora ibikorwa vyo gusanura no gusubiramwo ingoro.
Baha amahera ababaji n’abubatsi ngo bagure amabuye abajwe, n’imbaho zo kubarata hejuru, mu gusanura inyubakwa abami b’i Buyuda bari bararetse zikaba imisaka.

Abo bantu bakora igikorwa mu bwizigirwa. Yahati na Obadiya, Abalewi bava mu Bamerari, hamwe na Zakariya na Meshulamu, bava mu Bakohati, ni bo bari barongoye abandi. Mu Balewi, abari bafise ubuhinga bwo kuvuza ibicurarangisho,
ni bo bari bajejwe abakozi, bagakurikirana abakozi bose bari mu bikorwa bitandukanye. Bamwe bo mu Balewi bari abanyamabanga, abanditsi n’abarinzi b’amarembo.
Bakiriko barasohora amahera yari yazanywe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , Hilukiya umuherezi arenguka ku gitabu c’ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho vyahawe Abisirayeli biciye kuri Mose.
Hilukiya abwira Shafani umwanditsi ati: "Ndatoye Igitabu c’Ivyagezwe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho ." Aca agiha Shafani.
Maze Shafani ashira ico gitabu umwami aca amubwira ati: "Abasavyi bawe bariko barakora ivyo basabwe gukora vyose.
Barakiriye amahera yari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho bayazeza abashinzwe gukurikirana abakozi."
Nuko Shafani umwanditsi arongera abwira umwami ati: "Hilukiya umuherezi yampaye igitabu." Maze Shafani agisomera imbere y’umwami.
Umwami yumvise amajambo ari mu Vyagezwe, yitabagurirako impuzu.
Aca ategeka Hilukiya, Ahikamu mwene Shafani, Abudoni mwene Mika, Shafani umunyamabanga w’umwami na Asaya umukozi w’umwami, ati:

"Nimugende munsigurize Uhoraho , jewe n’amasigarira ari muri Isirayeli n’i Buyuda, ku vyerekeye ivyanditswe muri iki gitabu catowe. Uburake bw’ Uhoraho bwasutswe kuri twebwe burateye ubwoba kuko ba sogokuruza batitondeye ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , ngo bakore ibihwanye n’ivyanditswe muri iki gitabu."

Hilukiya n’abo umwami yari yarungitse baja kuvugana na Hulida umuvugishwa, yari umugore wa Shalumu mwene Tokati, Tokati mwene Hasira uwari ajejwe imyambaro. Uwo Hulida yaba i Yerusalemu, mu gice gishasha c’igisagara.
Na we ababwira ati: "Uku ni ko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze: Nimugende mubwire uwabantumyeko muti:
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Ngiye guteza icago aha hantu n’abantu baho, mu gushitsa imivumo yose yanditswe muri ico gitabu casomewe imbere y’umwami w’i Buyuda.
Kuko bantaye, bagaturirira ibimota neza izindi mana, bakandakisha izo nyene amaboko yabo yakoze, uburake bwanje buzosukwa aha hantu, kandi nta kizobuhwamika.’
Nimugende mubwire umwami w’i Buyuda yabatumye kumusiguriza Uhoraho, muti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze ku vyerekeye amajambo wumvise:

Ko umutima wawe wakozweko, ukicisha bugufi imbere y’Imana ucumva amajambo yavuze kuri aha hantu no ku bantu baho, kandi ko wicishije bugufi imbere yanje ukitabagurirako impuzu, ukaririra imbere yanje; nanje nakwumvise, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
None rero nzoguha kwitahira amahoro uhamvye ba sogokuruza bawe. Amaso yawe ntazobona ivyago vyose ngiye guteza aha hantu n’abantu bose bahaba.’ " Nuko bashira umwami iyo nyishu abahaye.
Maze umwami akoranya abakuru bose b’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu.

Adugana ku Ngoro y’ Uhoraho n’abantu bose b’i Buyuda, ababa i Yerusalemu, abaherezi n’Abalewi, n’abantu bose uhereye ku mukuru ugashitsa ku muto. Abasomera amajambo yo muri ca Gitabu c’Isezerano, cari catowe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .

Umwami ahagarara mu kibanza ciwe, asubizaho isezerano imbere y’Uhoraho ko agiye kwubaha Uhoraho no gukurikiza amabwirizwa, amategeko hamwe n’ivyagezwe vyiwe, akabikora n’umutima wiwe wose n’umushaha wiwe wose, mu gushitsa ivyanditswe muri ico gitabu.
Asaba abantu bose b’i Yerusalemu n’Ababenyamini kwiyemeza gushira mu ngiro iryo sezerano. Maze ab’i Yerusalemu bakora bisunze iryo sezerano ry’Imana ya ba sekuruza.

Yosiya akuraho ibigirwamana vy’ubuyobe vyose mu ntara yitirirwa Abisirayeli, ategeka abari mu Bwisirayeli ngo bakorere Uhoraho Imana yabo. Mu gihe cose yari akiriho, ntibigeze bareka gukurikira Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sekuruza babo.
Yosiya ahimbariza Pasika y’ Uhoraho i Yerusalemu, kandi babaga umwagazi wa Pasika ku musi ugira icumi na kane w’ukwezi kwa mbere.
Ashira abaherezi mu bikorwa vyabo kandi abatera intege ngo bakore igikorwa c’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .

Abwira Abalewi, ari bo bajejwe kwigisha Abisirayeli kandi barobanuriwe Uhoraho , ati: "Nimushire ya Sandugu Yera mu Ngoro Salomo mwene Dawidi umwami w’Abisirayeli yubaka. Ntimuzosubira kuyitwara ku bitugu vyanyu. Ubu rero nimukorere Uhoraho Imana yanyu n’abantu biwe b’Abisirayeli.
Nimwitegure nk’uko imiryango yanyu iri mu mice yanyu, nk’uko mwabitegetswe na Dawidi umwami w’Abisirayeli n’umuhungu wiwe Salomo.
Muhagarare Ahera muri kumwe n’Abalewi bavuye mu bice vyose vyo mu miryango yose ya benewanyu musangiye igihugu, hamwe n’abantu bose.
Mubage imyagazi ya Pasika, mwihumanure, maze mutegurire iyo myagazi bagenzi banyu b’Abisirayeli; mukore nk’uko Uhoraho yabitegetse abicishije kuri Mose."
Yosiya ategurira abantu bose bari aho intama n’impene ibihumbi mirongo itatu vy’ibimazi vya Pasika, n’inka ibihumbi bitatu, ivyo vyose vyavuye mu butunzi bw’umwami.

N’abaganwa biwe na bo bazana ivyo guterera abantu bari ngaho n’abaherezi n’Abalewi. Hilikiya, Zakariya na Yehiyeli, abajejwe gukurikirana ivy’Ingoro y’Imana, baha abaherezi ibimazi vya Pasika ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana atandatu vy’imyagazi y’intama n’impene hamwe n’inka amajana atatu.
Kandi na Konaniya hamwe na Shemaya na Netaneli, abavukana na we, na Hashabiya, Yeyiyeli na Yozabadi, abakuru b’Abalewi, baha Abalewi ibimazi vya Pasika ibihumbi bitanu n’inka amajana atanu.
Ico gikorwa kirategurwa, maze abaherezi bahagarara mu bibanza vyabo bari kumwe n’Abalewi, na bo bigabuye mu mice yabo nk’uko umwami yari yabitegetse.
Bakerera imyagazi ya Pasika, maze abaherezi baca bamijagira ku gicaniro amaraso bahawe n’Abalewi; Abalewi na bo baca bakora igikorwa co kuyikurako insato.
Batoranya ibimazi vyo guturirwa babishira i ruhande ngo babihe imigwi y’imiryango y’abantu; ngo na bo babishikanire Uhoraho , nk’uko vyanditswe mu gitabu ca Mose. Babigenza gutyo no ku nka.

Botsa inyama za ya myagazi ya Pasika ku muriro nk’uko bitegekanijwe, baca bateka vya bimazi vyera mu nkono z’ibumba, no mu nkono zo gushusha amazi, eka no mu masafuriya, baca babigaburira abantu bose banyarutsa.

Inyuma y’ivyo, baca bategura ivyabo n’ivy’abaherezi, kuko abaherezi bakomoka kuri Aroni, bariko baratanga ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro n’ibinure gushika bwije. Ni co gituma Abalewi bateguye ivyabo n’ivy’abaherezi bene Aroni.

Abacuraranzi bakomoka kuri Asafu bari mu bibanza vyabo nk’uko vyashinzwe na Dawidi, Asafu, Hemani na Yedutuni uwerekwa w’umwami. Abarinzi bo ku marembo yose ntibarinda guhagarika igikorwa cabo, kuko Abalewi benewabo bari babateguriye ivyabo.
Nuko muri ico gihe igikorwa cose c’ Uhoraho kirakorwa kugira ngo bahimbaze Pasika, batange n’ibimazi vyo guturirwa ku gicaniro c’ Uhoraho , nk’uko umwami Yosiya yari yabitegetse.
Muri ico gihe, Abisirayeli bari ngaho bahimbaza Pasika, barongera bamara iyindi misi indwi bahimbaza umusi mukuru w’imikate itarimwo umwambiro.

Ntihari bwigere hahimbazwa umusi mukuru wa Pasika nk’uwo mu Bisirayeli, uhereye mu gihe c’uwavugishwa n’Imana Samweli. Kandi nta n’umwe wo mu bami b’Abisirayeli yari bwahimbaze Pasika nk’uko Yosiya yayihimbaje, ari kumwe n’abaherezi, Abalewi n’Abayuda n’Abisirayeli bose, bari kumwe n’abantu b’i Yerusalemu.
Iyo Pasika yahimbajwe mu mwaka ugira cumi n’umunani Yosiya ari ku ngoma.
Inyuma y’ivyo, Yosiya amaze gutunganya neza ivyo mu Ngoro, Neko umwami wa Egiputa araduga ngo atere i Karikemishi ku ruzi Efurate; maze Yosiya aja kumutegera ngo amugwanye.

Ariko Neko arungika intumwa kuri we, amubwira ati: "Hari intambara nki hagati yawe nanje ga yewe mwami w’Abayuda? Ubu si wewe nje gutera, ariko hari irindi hanga duhamana ni ryo mviriye hasi. Imana yambwiye ngo nihute; nuko rero reka kugwanya Imana, kuko iri kumwe nanje, kandi yokurandura."

Yamara Yosiya ntiyahindukira ngo amureke, ahubwo ariyoberanya ngo amutere. Ntiyumvira ivyo Neko yamubwiye ategetswe n’Imana, ahubwo aja kumugwanya; baca bahurira mu kiyaya c’i Megido ari ho bagwaniye.
Abagwanisha imiheto barasa umwami Yosiya; aca abwira abakuru b’ingabo biwe ati: "Nimunkure hano kuko nkomeretse cane."
Nuko bamukura mu mukogote wiwe, bamushira mu wundi mukogote yari afise bamujana i Yerusalemu, apfirayo. Bamuhamba mu mva za ba sekuruza, maze Abayuda bose n’ab’i Yerusalemu baramuririra.

Yeremiya yandika amajambo yo gucura intimba ku bwa Yosiya, kandi gushika n’ubu abagabo n’abagore b’abaririmvyi bose bama bibuka Yosiya mu gucura intimba. Ivyo vyabaye umugenzo mu Bisirayeli kandi vyanditswe mu ndirimbo zo gucura intimba.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yosiya n’ibikorwa vyiwe vy’ubwizigirwa, nk’uko vyanditswe mu Vyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho
ivyabaye vyose, kuva ku ntango gushika kw’iherezo, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’abami b’Abisirayeli n’Abayuda.
Maze abantu bo muri ico gihugu bafata Yehowahazi mwene Yosiya bamwimika ngo abe umwami i Yerusalemu mu gishingo ca se.
Yehowahazi yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itatu igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, aca aganza amezi atatu ari i Yerusalemu.
Umwami wa Egiputa amukura ku ngoma i Yerusalemu aca ategeka Abayuda ko batanga amashikanwa yo kwisaba angana n’italanto ijana z’ifeza n’italanto imwe y’inzahabu.

Umwami wa Egiputa yimika Eliyakimu avukana na Yehowahazi, ngo abe umwami w’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu; ahindura izina ryiwe amwita Yehoyakimu. Ariko Neko atwara Yehowahazi umuvukanyi wa Eliyakimu amumanukana muri Egiputa.
Yehoyakimu yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itanu igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka cumi n’umwe ari i Yerusalemu, akora ivyo Uhoraho Imana yiwe abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe.
Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni aramutera amubohesha iminyororo y’umwakaka amujana i Babiloni.
Nebukadineza yongera atwara i Babiloni ibikoresho vyari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho abishira mu ngoro yiwe i Babiloni.

Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yehoyakimu, ibibi vy’ubuyobe yakoze n’ivyamubayeko vyose, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami b’Abisirayeli n’Abayuda. Maze Yehoyakini umuhungu wiwe aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.
Yehoyakini yari afise imyaka cumi n’umunani igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, aganza amezi atatu n’imisi cumi ari i Yerusalemu. Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe.

Mu ntango z’umwaka, umwami Nebukadineza amutumako ngo bamuzane i Babiloni, hamwe n’ibikoresho vy’agaciro vyari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , aca yimika Zedekiya sewabo wa Yehoyakini, ngo abe umwami w’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu.
Zedekiya yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’umwe igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka cumi n’umwe ari i Yerusalemu.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho Imana yiwe abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, kandi ntiyicisha bugufi imbere y’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya, yavuga ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .
Yongera agarariza umwami Nebukadineza, yari yaramurahije mw’izina ry’Imana. Yigira ntagondwa akomantaza umutima kandi ntiyahindukirira Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli.
Vyongeye, abakuru mu baherezi n’abantu bose barushaho gukora ibibi, bakurikira ivy’ubuyobe vy’ayandi mahanga mu guhumanya Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , iyo yari yaratoranije ngo ibe i Yerusalemu.
Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sekuruza, abatumako intumwa nyinshi, kuko yari agiriye akagongwe abantu biwe n’Ingoro yiwe.
Ariko bakengera izo ntumwa, bakengera n’amajambo yiwe, bahindura agatwengo abavugishwa na we gushika aho uburake bw’ Uhoraho bwaziriringiye ku bantu biwe ku buryo ata wari kuba agishobora kubakiza.

Abateza umwami w’i Babiloni, na we yicisha inkota urwaruka rwabo, mbere no mu Ngoro abicirayo, ntiyasigaza n’umwe yaba umusore canke inkumi, uwukuze canke umutama. Imana ibatanga mu maboko ya Nebukadineza.
Atwara i Babiloni ibintu vyose vyo mu Ngoro y’Imana, binini na bito, n’ubutunzi bwose bwari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho n’ubutunzi bw’umwami n’abaganwa biwe.
Baturira Ingoro y’Imana kandi basenyurira hasi uruzitiro rw’i Yerusalemu; baturira ibirimba vyose, basambura n’ikintu cose c’agaciro cariyo.
Abasigaye bacitse kw’icumu abajana nk’inyagano i Babiloni, baba abo kumukorera we n’abahungu biwe kugeza ubwami bw’Abaperesi bugiye ku ngoma.
Igihugu kiruhuka akaruhuko k’Isabato. Igihe cose camaze ari umusaka, cararuhutse, kugeza imyaka mirongo indwi iheze nk’uko ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryari ryaravugiye muri Yeremiya.

Mu mwaka wa mbere Kuro ari umwami w’Ubuperesi, Uhoraho kugira ngo ashitse ijambo yari yaravuze aciye kuri Yeremiya, akangura umutima wa Kuro umwami w’Ubuperesi na we atanga mu bwami bwiwe itegeko ryanditswe rivuga ngo:

"Ibi ni vyo Kuro umwami w’Ubuperesi avuze: ‘ Uhoraho , Imana yo mw’ijuru, yampaye ubwami bwose bwo mw’isi kandi yantoranije ngo ndamwubakire Ingoro i Yerusalemu i Buyuda. Umuntu wese wo mu bantu biwe ari muri mwebwe naduge, kandi Uhoraho Imana yiwe abane na we.’ "

chapters: Mu mwaka wa mbere Kuro ari umwami w’Ubuperesi, Uhoraho kugira ngo ashitse ijambo yari yaravuze aciye kuri Yeremiya, akangura umutima wa Kuro umwami w’Ubuperesi na we atanga mu bwami bwiwe itegeko ryanditswe rivuga ngo:
"Ibi ni vyo Kuro umwami w’Ubuperesi avuze: ‘ Uhoraho , Imana yo mw’ijuru, yampaye ubwami bwose bwo mw’isi kandi yantoranije ngo ndamwubakire Ingoro i Yerusalemu i Buyuda.
Umuntu wese wo mu bantu biwe ari muri mwebwe naduge i Yerusalemu i Buyuda yubake Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, ari yo Mana iri i Yerusalemu. Imana yiwe ibane na we.
Kandi abantu bose babana n’abo bacitse kw’icumu babahe inzahabu, ifeza, n’ubundi butunzi n’imikuku, hamwe n’ivyo umuntu ashikana avyishakiye ku bw’iyo Ngoro y’Imana i Yerusalemu.’ "
Nuko abakuru b’imiryango y’Abayuda n’Ababenyamini, n’abaherezi hamwe n’Abalewi, n’umuntu wese Imana yakoze ku mutima, bitegurira kuduga ngo bubake Ingoro y’ Uhoraho i Yerusalemu.
Ababanyi babo bose babafashisha ibikoresho vy’ifeza, vy’inzahabu, ubundi butunzi n’imikuku, n’izindi ngabire z’agaciro, vyiyongera ku mashikanwa abantu batanze n’umutima ubikunze.
Vyongeye, umwami Kuro asohora ibikoresho vyakora mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , ivyo Nebukadineza yari yaranyaze abikuye i Yerusalemu akabishira mu ngoro y’ikigirwamana ciwe.
Kuro umwami w’i Buperesi yari yarabitumye Mitiredati umuzezwabintu, na we arabiharura abishikiriza Sheshubazari umuganwa w’i Buyuda.
Uru ni urutonde hamwe n’ibitigiri vyavyo: amasiniya y’inzahabu mirongo itatu, amasiniya y’ifeza igihumbi, amapanu y’ifeza mirongo ibiri n’icenda,
ibikombe vy’inzahabu mirongo itatu, ibikombe bitobito vy’ifeza amajana ane na cumi, n’ibindi bikoresho igihumbi.
Vyose na vyose, vyari ibikoresho ibihumbi bitanu n’amajana ane vy’inzahabu n’ifeza. Sheshubazari azana ivyo vyose ari kumwe n’abavuye mu kinyago batashe bavuye i Babiloni baja i Yerusalemu.

Uru ni rwo rutonde rw’abantu bo muri iyo ntara baduze bavuye mu kinyago, abo Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni yari yarajanye nk’inyagano i Babiloni. Abo ni bo bagarutse i Yerusalemu n’i Buyuda, umwe wese aca aja mu gisagara c’iwabo.
Bari baherekejwe na Zerubabeli, Yesuwa, Nehemiya, Seraya, Reyelayiya, Moridekayi, Bilushani, Misipari, Bigivayi, Rehumu na Bayana. Urutonde rw’abagabo bo mu Bisirayeli ni uru:
Abakomoka kuri Paroshi ni ibihumbi bibiri n’ijana na mirongo indwi na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Shefatiya, ni amajana atatu na mirongo indwi na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Ara ni amajana indwi na mirongo indwi na batanu.
Abakomoka kuri Pahati-Mowabu (biciye kuri Yesuwa na Yowabu) ni ibihumbi bibiri n’amajana umunani na cumi na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Elamu ni igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongo itanu na bane.
Abakomoka kuri Zatu ni amajana icenda na mirongo ine na batanu.
Abakomoka kuri Zakayi ni amajana indwi na mirongo itandatu.
Abakomoka kuri Bani ni amajana atandatu na mirongo ine na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Bebayi ni amajana atandatu na mirongo ibiri na batatu.
Abakomoka kuri Azigadi ni igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongo ibiri na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Adonikamu ni amajana atandatu na mirongo itandatu na batandatu.
Abakomoka kuri Bigivayi ni ibihumbi bibiri na mirongo itanu na batandatu.
Abakomoka kuri Adini ni amajana ane na mirongo itanu na bane.
Abakomoka kuri Ateri, biciye kuri Hezekiya ni mirongo icenda n’umunani.
Abakomoka kuri Bezayi ni amajana atatu na mirongo ibiri na batatu.
Abakomoka kuri Yorahi ni ijana na cumi na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Hashumi ni amajana abiri na mirongo ibiri na batatu.
Abakomoka kuri Gibari ni mirongo icenda na batanu.
Abantu b’i Betelehemu ni ijana na mirongo ibiri na batatu.
Abantu b’i Netofa ni mirongo itanu na batandatu.
Ab’i Anatoti ni ijana na mirongo ibiri n’umunani.
Ab’i Azimaveti ni mirongo ine na babiri.
Ab’i Kiriyati-Yeyarimu, Kefira na Beroti ni amajana indwi na mirongo ine na batatu.
Ab’i Rama n’i Geba ni amajana atandatu na mirongo ibiri n’umwe.
Ab’i Mikimashi ni ijana na mirongo ibiri na babiri.
Ab’i Beteli n’i Hayi ni amajana abiri na mirongo ibiri na batatu.
Ab’i Nebo ni mirongo itanu na babiri.
Ab’i Magibishi ni ijana na mirongo itanu na batandatu.
Ab’i Elamu handi ni igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongo itanu na bane.
Abakomoka kuri Harimu ni amajana atatu na mirongo ibiri.
Abakomoka kuri Lodi, Hadidi na Ono ni amajana indwi na mirongo ibiri na batanu.
Ab’i Yeriko ni amajana atatu na mirongo ine na batanu.
Abakomoka kuri Senaya ni ibihumbi bitatu n’amajana atandatu na mirongo itatu.
Abaherezi: Abakomoka kuri Yedaya biciye mu muryango wa Yesuwa ni amajana icenda na mirongo indwi na batatu.
Abakomoka kuri Imeri ni igihumbi na mirongo itanu na babiri.
Abakomoka kuri Pashuri ni igihumbi n’amajana abiri na mirongo ine n’indwi.
Abakomoka kuri Harimu ni igihumbi na cumi n’indwi.
Abalewi: abakomoka kuri Yesuwa biciye kuri Kadimiyeli mu ruvyaro rwa Hodaviya ni mirongo indwi na bane.
Abacuraranzi: abakomoka kuri Asafu ni ijana na mirongo ibiri n’umunani.
Abarinzi b’irembo ry’urusengero: abakomoka kuri Shalumu, Ateri, Talumoni, Akubu, Hatita na Shobayi ni ijana na mirongo itatu n’icenda.
Abakozi bo mu Ngoro: abakomoka kuri Ziha, Hasufa, Tabawoti,
Kerosi, Siyaha, Padoni,
Lebana, Hagaba, Akubu,
Hagabu, Shamulayi, Hanani,
Gideli, Gahari, Reyaya,
Rezini, Nekoda, Gazamu,
Uza, Paseya, Besayi,
Asina, Meyunimu, Nefusimu,
Bakibuki, Hakufa, Harihuri,
Baziluti, Mehida, Harisha,
Barikosi, Sisera, Tema,
Neziya na Hatifa.
Abakomoka ku bakozi ba Salomo: abakomoka kuri Sotayi, Hasofereti, Peruda,
Yayala, Darukoni, Gideli,
Shefatiya, Hatili, Pokereti-Hazebayimu na Ami.
Abakozi bo mu Ngoro n’abakomoka ku bakozi ba Salomo bose hamwe ni amajana atatu na mirongo icenda na babiri.
Aba bakurikira baduze bavuye mu bisagara vya Teli-Melahi, Teli-Harusha, Kerubi, Adoni na Imeri, ariko ntibashoboye kwerekana ko imiryango yabo ikomoka ku Bisirayeli.
Abakomoka kuri Delaya, Tobiya na Nekoda ni amajana atandatu na mirongo itanu na babiri.
Mu baherezi: abakomoka kuri Habaya, Hakozi na Baruzilayi (umugabo yari yarongoye umukobwa wa Baruzilayi Umunyagileyadi agaca yitirirwa iryo zina nyene).
Abo ni bo barondeye intonde za ba sekuruza b’imiryango yabo, ariko ntibashobora kuzironka, maze baca bakurwa mu gikorwa c’ubuherezi nk’abahumanye.
Umukuru w’intara, aca abategeka kutarya ivyejejwe gushika haje umuherezi agasiguza Uhoraho akoresheje Urimu na Tumimu.
Igitigiri c’abantu bose cari ibihumbi mirongo ine na bibiri n’amajana atatu na mirongo itandatu,
ukuyemwo ibihumbi indwi n’amajana atatu na mirongo itatu n’indwi vy’abagurano n’abaguranokazi; kandi bari bafise abagabo n’abagore b’abaririmvyi amajana abiri.
Bari bafise amafarasi amajana indwi na mirongo itatu n’atandatu, inyumbu amajana abiri na mirongo ine na zitanu,
ingamiya amajana ane na mirongo itatu na zitanu n’indogoba ibihumbi bitandatu n’amajana indwi na mirongo ibiri.
Bamaze gushika ku Ngoro y’ Uhoraho i Yerusalemu, bamwe bo mu bakuru b’imiryango batanga amashikanwa bavyishakiye kugira ngo aze yubake Ingoro y’Imana aho yahora.
Bakurikije uburyo bafise, batanze mu bubiko bw’iki gikorwa ingero dariki ibihumbi mirongo itandatu n’imwe z’inzahabu, ingero mina ibihumbi bitanu z’ifeza, n’impuzu z’abaherezi ijana.
Abaherezi, Abalewi, abarinzi b’irembo, abaririmvyi n’abakozi bo mu Ngoro, bari kumwe n’abandi bantu hamwe n’Abisirayeli bose baja kuba mu bisagara vyabo.
Ukwezi kw’indwi gushitse, Abisirayeli bamaze gushika mu bisagara vyabo, abantu bakoranira hamwe i Yerusalemu nk’umuntu umwe.

Maze Yesuwa mwene Yozadaki na bagenziwe b’abaherezi na Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalutiyeli n’abo bari bafatanije batangura kwubaka igicaniro c’Imana y’Abisirayeli kugira ngo bashobore gushikana ibimazi bituririrwa kuri co, nk’uko vyari vyanditswe mu Vyagezwe vya Mose umuntu w’Imana.

Naho bari bafise ubwoba kubera gutinya amahanga yari abakikije, barubatse igicaniro kw’itanguriro ryaco baca bagitangirako ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro, babishikanira Uhoraho , vyaba ivyo mu gitondo canke ivyo ku mugoroba.
Maze nk’uko vyari vyanditswe, bahimbaza umusi mukuru w’insago, batanga igitigiri c’ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro nk’uko vyasabwa ku musi ku musi.

Inyuma y’ivyo, baca bashikana ibimazi vyo guturirwa bisanzwe bitangwa, ibimazi vyo mu mboneko z’ukwezi n’ibimazi vy’imisi mikuru y’ Uhoraho yose yategetswe, hamwe n’ivyazanywe n’umuntu wese ashikaniye Uhoraho avyishakiye.
Ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kw’indwi batangura gushikanira Uhoraho ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro, naho itanguriro ry’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho ritari bwashirweho.

Nuko baha amahera abubatsi n’ababaji, baha abantu b’i Sidoni n’i Tiro ivyokurya, ibinyobwa n’amavuta kugira ngo bazane ibiti vy’amasederi babikuye i Libani gushika i Yopa, babicishije mu kiyaga, nk’uko vyari vyaremewe n’umwami Kuro w’i Buperesi.

Mu kwezi kwa kabiri kw’umwaka ugira kabiri kuva bashitse i Yerusalemu ahari Ingoro y’Imana, Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalutiyeli, Yesuwa mwene Yozadaki na benewabo basigaye b’abaherezi n’Abalewi n’abari bagarutse i Yerusalemu bavuye mu kinyago, batangura igikorwa. Bashiraho Abalewi bamaze imyaka mirongo ibiri n’iyirenga ngo bakurikirane igikorwa co gusanura Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .

Yesuwa n’abahungu biwe n’abo bavukana, Kadimiyeli n’abahungu biwe (bakomoka kuri Hodaviya), abahungu ba Henadadi n’abahungu babo n’abo bavukana, bose bakaba bari Abalewi, barifatanya kugira ngo bashobore gukurikirana abakozi bariko barakora ku Ngoro y’Imana.

Abubatsi bamaze gushiraho itanguriro ry’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , abaherezi bambaye ya myambaro yabo bafise n’inzamba, n’Abalewi, bene Asafu bafise n’ivyuma bisama, bafata ibibanza vyabo ngo bahimbaze Uhoraho , nk’uko vyashinzwe na Dawidi umwami w’Abisirayeli.

Baririmbira Uhoraho indirimbo zo gutazira no gushima bati: "Ni mwiza; urukundo akunda Abisirayeli rwamaho ibihe bidashira." Maze abantu bose barasemerera cane bahimbaza Uhoraho , kuko itanguriro ry’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho ryari rimaze kwubakwa.

Ariko benshi mu baherezi n’Abalewi n’abakuru b’imiryango bashaje, bari barabonye Ingoro ya mbere, bararira cane babonye itanguriro ry’iyo Ngoro yindi ririko rirubakwa, mu gihe abandi na bo bariko baravuza urwamo kubera umunezero.
Nta n’umwe yashobora gutandukanya akamo k’umunezero n’ijwi ry’abarira, kuko abantu basemerera cane rwose. Kandi urwamo rwarumvikana umuntu akiri kure.
Abansi b’Abayuda n’Ababenyamini bumvise ko abahora ari inyagano bariko barubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli,

baraza bashikira Zerubabeli n’abakuru baserukira imiryango bababwira bati: "Reka tubafashe kwubaka kuko na twebwe dusenga Imana yanyu, kandi twamye tuyishikanira ibimazi kuva mu gihe ca Esaruhadoni umwami w’i Ashuri, ari we yatuzanye hano."

Ariko Zerubabeli, Yesuwa n’abandi bose bo mu bakuru b’imiryango y’Abisirayeli babishura bati: "Nta co dusangiye mu kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana yacu. Ni twebwe twenyene tuzoyubakira Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli, nk’uko umwami Kuro, umwami w’i Buperesi, yadutegetse."
Nuko amahanga yari abakikije akura hasi ngo ace intege Abayuda abatera n’ubwoba ngo ntibashishikare kwubaka.

Barondera abakozi b’ubwo bwami babaha impera kugira ngo babagwanye. Ivyo vyatumye imigambi yabo idatera imbere mu gihe cose umwami Kuro w’i Buperesi yamaze ari ku ngoma gushika no ku ngoma y’umwami Dariyusi w’i Buperesi.
Igihe Ahasuwerusi yari akija ku ngoma, abansi b’Abayuda banditse ikete ryo kwagiriza Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu.

Maze mu misi ya Ahasuwerusi umwami w’i Buperesi, Bishulamu, Mituredati, Tabeyeli n’abandi bari bafatanije bandikira Ahasuwerusi. Iryo kete ryari ryanditswe mu rurimi rw’Icarameya hanyuma bararisobanurira umwami.
Rehumu umukuru w’ingabo na Shimushayi umunyamabanga bandikira umwami Aritazeruzi ikete ryo kwagiriza ab’i Yerusalemu rivuga riti:

Rehumu umukuru w’ingabo na Shimushayi umunyamabanga, hamwe n’abandi dufatanije, abacamanza n’abakuru batwara abantu baturuka i Tiriporisi, i Buperesi, i Babiloni hamwe n’abantu bava i Ereki n’i Susa, ari bo Banyalamu.
Barongera kandi barungika n’indamukanyo z’abantu umwubahwa Ashurubanipali yatwaye akabashira mu gisagara c’i Samariya n’ahandi muri iyo ntara iri mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate.
Iyi ni ikopi y’iryo kete banditse. Ku mwami Aritazeruzi, Bivuye ku basavyi bawe, abantu bo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate:

Umwami yomenya neza ko Abayuda baduze baza iwacu bavuye iwanyu bashikiye i Yerusalemu kandi bariko barubaka ca gisagara kigarariza kandi gikora ibibi. Bariko barasanura impome basubiramwo amatanguriro.
Vyongeye, umwami akwiye kumenya ko ico gisagara nicubakwa inzitiro zaco zigasanurwa, ata matagisi, ivyagerewe umwami canke ikori bizosubira gutangwa, kandi ubutunzi bw’umwami buzogira ingorane.
None rero kubera yuko twubaha ikirimba kandi akaba atari vyiza kureka umwami ngo akengerwe, twandikiye ubu butumwa umwami kugira ngo tubimumenyeshe,

hanyuma hakorwe amatohoza mu vyanditswe bivuga ivyabaye ku ngoma z’Abakwitangiye imbere. Muri ivyo vyanditswe uzosanga ico gisagara ari igisagara c’abagarariji, bakunda gutera umudugararo ku bami n’abatwara intara, abantu bamye bagarariza kuva kera. Ni co gituma ico gisagara cari carasambuwe.
Tumenyesheje umwami ko ico gisagara nicubakwa inzitiro zaho zigasanurwa, ata co uzoba ugisigaranye mu ntara yo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate.
Umwami yishura ati: Kuri Rehumu umukuru w’ingabo, Shimushayi umunyamabanga n’abandi bose mufatanije baba i Samariya n’ahandi hose mu ntara yo hakurya y’uruzi Efurate: Ndabaramukije.
Ikete mwaturungikiye ryarasomwe kandi ryahinduriwe mu rurimi imbere yanje.
Naratanze itegeko maze hakorwa amatohoza, dusanga ko ico gisagara gifise kahise ko kugarariza abami kandi ko camye kibamwo imigumuko.
I Yerusalemu harigeze kugira abami bakomeye batwaye intara yose yo mu buseruko bw’uruzi Efurate, amatagisi, amashikanwa yo kwisaba n’ayandi makori vyahabwa bo.
None rero nimutumeko abo bantu mubategeke guhagarika ico gikorwa, kugira ngo ico gisagara ntigisubire kwubakwa kugeza ntanze irindi tegeko.
Mwitonde kugira ngo ntimufate minenerwe ico kibazo. Ni igiki cotuma iyi ngorane ikura, ikageramira inyungu z’ubwami?

Iyo kopi y’ikete ry’umwami Aritazeruzi rigisomewe Rehumu na Shimushayi umunyamabanga n’abo bari bafatanije, baca bihuta kuja ku Bayuda bari i Yerusalemu babategeka guhagarika ku nguvu ivyo bariko barakora.
Nuko igikorwa co kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana i Yerusalemu kiba kirahagaze kugeza mu mwaka ugira kabiri umwami Dariyusi w’i Buperesi ari ku ngoma.
Muri ico gihe Hagayi na Zakariya mwene Ido, abavugishwa n’Imana, baravugishwa babwira Abayuda bari i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu mw’izina ry’Imana y’Abisirayeli, ari yo yari ibarongoye.
Maze Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalutiyeli na Yesuwa mwene Yozadaki barahaguruka ngo bongere gusanura Ingoro y’Imana y’i Yerusalemu. Kandi abavugishwa b’Imana bari kumwe na bo, ngo babafashe.

Ico gihe nyene Tatenayi, umukuru w’intara yo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate, na Shetari Bozenayi n’abo bari bafatanije baja aho bari barababaza bati: "Ni nde yabahaye uruhusha rwo gusubira kwubaka iyi Ngoro no gusanura aha hantu?"
Bongera barababaza bati: "Ni ba nde bariko barubaka iyi nzu?"
Ariko kubera inyonga z’Imana yabo zari kuri abo barongozi b’Abayuda, ntibahagaritse igikorwa kugeza bishikiriye Dariyusi na we akabishura kandi ikete ryiwe rikabashikira.
Iyi ni ikopi y’ikete Tatenayi, umukuru w’intara yo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate, na Shetari Bozenayi n’abari kumwe na bo, abakuru bo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate, barungikiye umwami Dariyusi.
Raporo bamurungikiye ni yo y’iyi: Ku mwami Dariyusi, Turabaramukije bivuye ku mutima.

Umwami yomenya neza ko twagiye mu ntara y’i Buyuda, ku Ngoro y’Imana nkuru. Abantu bariko barayubakisha amabuye maninimanini bashirako n’imbaho mu bihome. Ico gikorwa kiriko kirabandanya ata ngorane kandi kiriko kiratera kija imbere kirongowe na bo.
Twarabajije abarongozi tuti: "Ni nde yabahaye uruhusha rwo gusubira kwubaka Ingoro no gusanura aho hantu?
Kandi twarababajije n’amazina, kugira ngo tuyakwandikire umenye amazina y’abarongozi babo."

Iyi ni yo nyishu baduhaye: "Turi abasavyi b’Imana y’ijuru n’isi, kandi turiko turasanura Ingoro yari yarubatswe mu myaka myinshi yarenganye, imwe umwami ahambaye wa Isirayeli yari yarubatse akayirangiza.

Maze kubera ko ba sogokuruza bashavuje Imana yo mw’ijuru, vyatumye ibagabura mu maboko ya Nebukadineza Umukaludaya, umwami w’i Babiloni, ari we yasambuye iyi Ngoro agatwara abantu nk’inyagano i Babiloni.
Ariko, mu mwaka wa mbere Kuro umwami w’i Babiloni agiye ku ngoma, umwami yatanze itegeko ryo gusubira kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana.

Yarongeye akura mu ngoro y’i Babiloni ibikoresho vy’inzahabu n’ivy’ifeza vyahoze mu Ngoro y’Imana, ivyo Nebukadineza yari yaranyaze abikuye mu Ngoro i Yerusalemu akabijana mu ngoro i Babiloni. Nuko umwami Kuro abiha umuntu yitwa Sheshubazari, uwo yari yagenye ngo abe umukuru w’intara,
kandi aramubwira ati: ‘Fata ibi bikoresho ubijane ubisubize mu Ngoro y’Imana i Yerusalemu, kandi ize yubakwe mu kibanza yahozemwo.’
Nuko uwo Sheshubazari araza ashiraho amatanguriro y’Ingoro y’Imana i Yerusalemu. Kuva ico gihe kugeza uwu musi iracubakwa ntirahera.

None rero nivyaba bihimbaye umwami, nihagirwe itohoza mu vyanditswe vyabaye biri i Babiloni kugira ngo murabe koko ko umwami Kuro yoba yaratanze iryo tegeko ryo gusubira kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana i Yerusalemu. Maze umwami ace aturungikira ico azoba ategetse ku vyerekeye ico kibazo."
Umwami Dariyusi araheza atanga itegeko, avuga ko barondera mu bitabu bivuga ivyabaye, vyari mu bubiko bw’i Babiloni.
Hatorwa umuzingo mu munara wa Ekubatana mu ntara ya Medi, uwo na wo ukaba wari wanditswemwo ngo: Icibutso:

Mu mwaka wa mbere umwami Kuro ari ku ngoma yasohoye itegeko ryerekeye Ingoro y’Imana i Yerusalemu rivuga ngo: "Ingoro nisubire kwubakwa ahantu Abayuda bahora batangira ibimazi, kandi amatanguriro yayo niyubakwe. Izoba ifise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itandatu z’uburebure n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itandatu z’ubwaguke,
yubakishijwe n’imirongo ibiri y’amabuye maninimanini n’umurongo umwe w’imbaho. Amahera yose akenewe azova mu butunzi bw’i bwami.

Kandi, ibikoresho vy’inzahabu n’ivy’ifeza vyo mu Ngoro y’Imana, ivyo Nebukadineza yanyaze abikuye mu ngoro i Yerusalemu akabitwara i Babiloni, bize bisubizwe mu bibanza vyavyo mu Ngoro i Yerusalemu, bishirwe mu Nzu y’Imana."

Maze umwami Dariyusi aca arungika ubu butumwa: Nuko rero, Tatenayi, umukuru w’intara yo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate, na Shetari Bozenayi na we nyene, hamwe n’abandi bakuru batwara iyo ntara, mwigire kure y’aho hantu.
Ntimuhungabanye iyubakwa ry’iyo Ngoro y’Imana. Nimureke umukuru w’Abayuda n’abatware babo basubire bayubake mu kibanza yahozemwo.

Vyongeye, ntanze itegeko ryerekeye ivyo muzokorera abo bakuru b’Abayuda bijanye no kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana: Amahera yose bazokoresha aze arihwe avuye mu butunzi bw’i bwami, buva mu matagisi atozwa mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate, kugira ngo ico gikorwa ntigihagarare.

Ibikenewe vyose: amashuri, impfizi z’intama hamwe n’imyagazi y’intama bitangwa nk’ibimazi vyo guturirwa bishikanirwa Imana yo mw’ijuru, ingano, umunyu, umuvinyu n’amavuta, nk’uko bisabwa n’abaherezi i Yerusalemu, baze babihabwe imisi yose ata na kimwe kibuze,
kugira ngo bashobore gushikanira ibimazi bihimbara Imana yo mw’ijuru bongera basengera umwami n’abahungu biwe kugira ngo bamererwe neza.
Ikindi, ntegetse ko nihagira umuntu n’umwe arenga kuri iri tegeko, bazoce bakura inkingi mu nzu yiwe bayimumanikeko kandi inzu yiwe ize ihindurwe umusaka.

Imana, yo yagenye ko izina ryayo riba aho hantu, ize ikure ku ngoma umwami wese canke ihanga ryose rizoramvurira ukuboko guhindura iri tegeko canke gusambura iyi Ngoro y’i Yerusalemu. Jewe Dariyusi nshinze iki cagezwe. Nigishirwe mu ngiro uku nyene gishinzwe ata guca i ruhande.
Hanyuma, kubera ico cagezwe c’umwami Dariyusi, Tatenayi, umukuru w’intara yo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate na Shetari Bozenayi n’abo bari bafatanije bagishira mu ngiro ata co bahinduye.

Nuko Abarongozi b’Abayuda babandanya kwubaka kandi bagenda batera imbere barongowe n’ubutumwa bw’uwavugishwa n’Imana Hagayi na Zakariya, wo mu ruvyaro rwa Ido. Barangiza kwubaka iyo Ngoro nk’uko Imana y’Abisirayeli yategetse kandi nk’uko Kuro, Dariyusi na Aritazeruzi, abami b’i Buperesi, bari babitegetse.
Ingoro y’Imana yahejeje kwubakwa ku musi ugira gatatu w’ukwezi kwa Adari, mu mwaka ugira gatandatu umwami Dariyusi ari ku ngoma.
Nuko Abisirayeli, abaherezi, Abalewi n’abandi bose bari baravuye mu kinyago, bahimbaza umusi mukuru wo gushikiriza Imana Ingoro yayo banezerewe.

Mu gushikiriza iyo Ngoro y’Imana batanga amashuri y’inka ijana, impfizi z’intama amajana abiri, imyagazi y’intama amajana ane, hamwe n’ikimazi gitangirwa ivyaha vy’Abisirayeli bose kigizwe n’amasuguru y’impene icumi n’abiri, imw’imwe ku muryango wose w’Abisirayeli.
Baca bashiraho abaherezi mu mice yabo n’Abalewi mu migwi yabo ngo bakore igikorwa c’Imana i Yerusalemu, nk’uko vyari vyanditswe mu gitabu ca Mose.
Ku musi ugira icumi na kane w’ukwezi kwa mbere, Abavuye mu kinyago bahimbaza Pasika.
Abaherezi n’Abalewi bari bihumanuye bejejwe neza. Abalewi bakererera umwagazi w’intama wa Pasika abavuye mu kinyago bose, benewabo b’abaherezi hamwe na bo nyene ubwabo.

Nuko Abisirayeli bari bagarutse bavuye mu kinyago barawurya, hamwe n’abo bose bari bitandukanije n’ibikorwa bihumanya vyakorwa n’abanyamahanga babana na bo kugira ngo barondere mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli.

Bamara imisi indwi bahimbaza umusi mukuru w’imikate itarimwo umwambiro kandi banezerewe kuko Uhoraho yari yabujuje umunezero mu guhindura ivyiyumviro vy’umwami w’i Ashuri, kugira ngo abafashe mu gikorwa co kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana, Imana y’Abisirayeli.
Inyuma y’ivyo, ku ngoma ya Ahasuwerusi umwami w’i Buperesi, haza Ezira mwene Seraya, Seraya mwene Azariya, Azariya mwene Hilukiya,
Hilukiya mwene Shalumu, Shalumu mwene Sadoki, Sadoki mwene Ahitubu,
Ahitubu mwene Amariya, Amariya mwene Azariya, Azariya mwene Merayoti,
Merayoti mwene Zerahiya, Zerahiya mwene Uzi, Uzi mwene Buki,
Buki mwene Abishuwa, Abishuwa mwene Finehasi, Finehasi wene Eliyazeri, Eliyazeri mwene Aroni umuherezi mukuru.

Uwo Ezira aduga avuye i Babiloni. Yari umwigisha yize neza Ivyagezwe vya Mose, ivyo Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli yari yaratanze. Umwami yari yamuhaye ivyo yari yamusavye vyose, kuko ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe kwari kuri we.
Bamwe mu Bisirayeli, harimwo n’abaherezi, Abalewi, abaririmvyi, abarinzi b’irembo n’abakozi bo mu Ngoro, na bo nyene baraduga i Yerusalemu mu mwaka ugira indwi umwami Ahasuwerusi ari ku ngoma.
Ezira ashika i Yerusalemu mu kwezi kugira gatanu kw’umwaka ugira indwi uwo mwami ari ku ngoma.
Yari yavuye i Babiloni ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa mbere, ashika i Yerusalemu ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa gatanu, kuko ukuboko kw’ubuntu bw’Imana kwari kuri we.
Kandi Ezira yari yariyeguriye kwiga no kwitondera Ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho no kwigisha ivyo yihanikirije n’amabwirizwa yatanze mu Bisirayeli.
Iyi ni ikopi y’ikete umwami Ahasuwerusi yahaye Ezira umuherezi n’umwigisha w’Ivyagezwe, umuntu yanonosoye ivyerekeye amabwirizwa n’amategeko Uhoraho yahaye Abisirayeli:
Jewe Aritazeruzi, umwami w’abami, Kuri Ezira umuherezi, umwigisha w’Ivyagezwe vy’Imana yo mw’ijuru: Ndakuramukije.
Ubu rero ntegetse ko Umwisirayeli wese ari mu bwami bwanje, harimwo n’abaherezi n’Abalewi, bipfuza kuja i Yerusalemu bajanye nawe, bashobora kugenda.
Urungitswe n’umwami hamwe n’abahanuzi biwe indwi ngo uje gutohoza neza ivyerekeye i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu ku bijanye n’Ivyagezwe vy’Imana yanyu, biri mu maboko yawe.
Vyongeye, uze ujane ifeza n’inzahabu ivyo umwami n’abahanuzi biwe bashikaniye Imana y’Abisirayeli iba i Yerusalemu bavyishakiye,
hamwe n’ifeza n’inzahabu ushobora kuronka mu ntara y’i Babiloni, hamwe n’amashikanwa yose abantu n’abaherezi bazotanga ku bw’Ingoro y’Imana yabo iri i Yerusalemu.
Muri ayo mahera, uze uguremwo amashuri y’inka, impfizi z’intama n’imyagazi y’intama, hamwe n’amashikanwa y’ifu n’ay’ibinyobwa, maze ubishikane ku gicaniro kiri mu Ngoro y’Imana yanyu i Yerusalemu.
Wewe na benewanyu b’Abayuda mushobora gukoresha ico cose muzobona ko kibereye ifeza n’inzahabu bizosigara, mwisunze ivyo Imana yanyu igomba.
Uze utereke imbere y’Imana y’i Yerusalemu ibikoresho vyose wahawe vyo gutazirisha Imana mu Ngoro y’Imana yanyu.
Muze mukure mu nzu y’ubutunzi bw’umwami ivyo muzokenera gukoresha ku bw’iyo Ngoro y’Imana yawe.
Ubu rero, jewe umwami Aritazeruzi, ntegetse abazezwabintu bose bo hakurya y’uruzi Efurate ngo batange ivyo Ezira umuherezi, umwigisha w’Ivyagezwe vy’Imana yo mw’ijuru, azobasaba vyose,
gushika kw’italanto ijana z’ifeza, ingero koru ijana z’ingano, ingero batu ijana z’umuvinyu, ingero batu ijana z’amavuta ya elayo hamwe n’umunyu wose ukenewe.
Ikintu cose Imana yo mw’ijuru yategetse, kize gikorwe uko nyene gitegetswe ata gihazemwo ku bw’iyo Ngoro y’Imana yo mw’ijuru. Ni iki cotuma dukwegera uburake bwayo umwami n’abahungu biwe?

Mumenye kandi ko mutemerewe kwaka itagisi, ishikanwa ryo kwisaba canke ikori umuherezi n’umwe canke Abalewi, abaririmvyi, abarinzi b’irembo, abakozi bo mu Ngoro canke abandi bose bakora muri iyo Ngoro.

Nawe, Ezira, ukoresheje ubwenge usanganywe bw’Imana yawe, uze utoranye abacamanza bakuru n’abandi basanzwe kugira ngo bacire imanza abantu bose bo mu burengero bw’uruzi Efurate; abantu bose bazi Ivyagezwe vy’Imana yawe. Kandi uze uyigishe abatayazi bose.
Umuntu wese atazokwumvira Ivyagezwe vy’Imana yawe n’amategeko y’umwami aze ahanishwe igihano co gupfa, kwirukanwa mu gihugu, kunyagwa itongo, canke gushirwa mw’ibohero.
Nihashimwe Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sogokuruza, we yashize ku mutima w’umwami guhezagira Ingoro y’ Uhoraho iri i Yerusalemu muri ubu buryo

kandi yangiriye ubuntu bungana gutya imbere y’umwami n’abahanuzi biwe n’abandi bashizwe hejuru bo mu bwami bwiwe. Kubera ukuboko kw’ Uhoraho Imana yanje kwari kuri jewe, narumvise ko ndemye, maze ndegeranya abantu barongora abandi bava muri Isirayeli ngo badugane nanje.
Aba ni bo bakuru b’imiryango hamwe n’abo bandikanywe, twaduganye tuvuye i Babiloni ku ngoma y’umwami Ahasuwerusi.
Mu bakomoka kuri Finehasi ni Gerishomu. Mu bakomoka kuri Itamari ni Daniyeli. Mu bakomoka kuri Dawidi ni Hatushi
yakomotse kuri Shekaniya; mu bakomoka kuri Paroshi ni Zakariya n’abagabo ijana na mirongo itanu bari banditswe hamwe na we.
Mu bakomoka kuri Pahati-Mowabu ni Eliyehowenayi mwene Zerahiya, yari kumwe n’abagabo amajana abiri.
Mu bakomoka kuri Zatu ni Shekaniya mwene Yahaziyeli, n’abagabo amajana atatu bari kumwe na we.
Mu bakomoka kuri Adini ni Ebedi mwene Yonatani, n’abagabo mirongo itanu bari kumwe na we.
Mu bakomoka kuri Elamu ni Yeshaya mwene Ataliya, n’abagabo mirongo indwi bari kumwe na we.
Mu bakomoka kuri Shefatiya ni Zebadiya mwene Mikayeli, n’abagabo mirongo umunani bari kumwe na we.
Mu bakomotse kuri Yowabu ni Obadiya mwene Yehiyeli, n’abagabo amajana abiri na cumi n’umunani bari kumwe na we.
Mu bakomoka kuri Bani ni Shelomiti mwene Yosifiya, n’abagabo ijana na mirongo itandatu bari kumwe na we.
Mu bakomoka kuri Bebayi ni Zakariya mwene Bebayi, n’abagabo mirongo ibiri n’umunani bari kumwe na we.
Mu bakomoka kuri Azigadi ni Yohanani mwene Hakatani, n’abagabo ijana na cumi bari kumwe na we.
Mu bakomoka kuri Adonikamu ni abanyuma muri uwo muryango; amazina yabo akaba yari Elifeleti, Yeweli na Shemaya, n’abagabo mirongo itandatu bari kumwe na bo.
Mu bakomoka kuri Bigivayi ni Utayi na Zakuri, n’abagabo mirongo indwi bari kumwe na bo.
Ndabakoraniriza ku mugezi utemba uja Ahava, aho hantu tuhamara imisi itatu. Maze kuraba neza mu bantu no mu baherezi, nsanga nta Mulewi n’umwe arimwo.
Nuko ntoranya Eliyezeri, Ariyeli, Shemaya, Elunatani, Yaribu, Elunatani, Natani, Zakariya na Meshulamu, bari abarongozi, na Yoyaribu na Elunatani, bari abantu b’incabwenge,

maze ndabarungika kwa Ido, umutware w’i Kasifiya. Ndababwira ivyo baza kubwira Ido na benewabo, abakozi bo mu Ngoro bari i Kasifiya, kugira ngo baturungikire abakozi bo kudufasha igikorwa co mu Ngoro y’Imana yacu.

Kubera ukuboko kw’ubuntu bw’Imana yacu kwari kumwe natwe, baturungikira Sherebiya, umuntu afise ugutahura, wo mu bakomotse kuri Mahuli mwene Lewi, Lewi mwene Isirayeli, n’abahungu n’abavukanyi ba Sherebiya, abagabo icumi n’umunani;
na Hashabiya, hamwe na Yeshaya wo mu bakomotse kuri Merari, n’abavukanyi biwe n’abahungwabo, abagabo mirongo ibiri.
Bazana n’abandi amajana abiri na mirongo ibiri b’abakozi bo mu Ngoro, urwego Dawidi n’abaganwa biwe bari barashizeho ngo bafashe Abalewi. Bose barandikwa amazina.

Aho nyene ku nkombe z’umugezi uja muri Ahava, menyesha abantu ko bisonzesha, kugira ngo twicishe bugufi imbere y’Imana yacu duheze tuyisabe iduhe kugira urugendo rwiza twebwe n’abana bacu, n’ivyo dutunze vyose.

Kuko vyaranteye isoni gusaba umwami ingabo n’abagendera ku mafarasi bo kudukingira abansi bodutegera mu nzira, kandi twari twarabwiye umwami ko ukuboko kw’ubuntu bw’Imana yacu kuri kumwe n’umuntu wese amuhanze amaso, ariko ko uburake bwiwe buri ku bamutera ibitugu.
Nuko turisonzesha twinginga Imana yacu ku bw’ivyo, na yo yishura ugusenga kwacu.
Maze ntoranya abaherezi icumi na babiri bo kuturongora, bari kumwe na Sherebiya, Hashabiya n’abandi icumi bo muri benewabo,
ndabapimira za feza n’inzahabu zo gushikana na vya bikoresho umwami, abahanuzi biwe, abatware biwe n’Abisirayeli bose bari ngaho bari batangiye Ingoro y’Imana yacu.
Ndabapimira italanto amajana atandatu na mirongo itanu z’ifeza, ibikoresho bikozwe mw’ifeza bingana n’italanto ijana , n’izindi ijana z’inzahabu,
ibikombe mirongo ibiri vy’inzahabu vy’agaciro kangana n’ingero dariki igihumbi , n’ibikoresho bikozwe mu mwakaka usenye neza bifise agaciro nk’inzahabu.
Ndababwira nti: "Mwebwe n’ibi bikoresho mwejerejwe Uhoraho . Ifeza n’inzahabu ni ishikanwa ryahawe Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sogokuruza n’umutima ubikunze.
Mubizigame neza kugeza mubipimye mugeze mu vyumba vy’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho i Yerusalemu imbere y’abakuru b’abaherezi n’Abalewi n’abakuru b’imiryango y’Abisirayeli."
Nuko abaherezi n’Abalewi bakira izo feza n’inzahabu n’ivyo bikoresho vyejejwe vyari vyateguriwe kujanwa mu Ngoro y’Imana yacu i Yerusalemu.

Ku musi ugira icumi na kabiri w’ukwezi kwa mbere tuva kuri wa mugezi uja muri Ahava tuja i Yerusalemu. Ukuboko kw’Imana yacu kwari kuri twebwe, maze iratuzigama iturinda abansi n’abambuzi mu rugendo rwose.
Maze dushika i Yerusalemu, tuharuhukira imisi itatu.

Ku musi ugira kane, mu Ngoro y’Imana yacu, dupima za feza n’inzahabu na vya bikoresho vyejejwe tubiha Meremoti mwene Uriya, umuherezi. Eliyazeri mwene Finehasi yari kumwe na we, hamwe n’Abalewi Yozabadi mwene Yesuwa na Nowadiya mwene Binuwi.
Vyose vyarapimwe biraharurwa, maze ibipimo vyose birandikwa muri ico gihe.

Maze abagarutse bavuye mu kinyago bashikanira Imana y’Abisirayeli ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro: amashuri y’inka icumi n’abiri kubw’Abisirayeli bose, impfizi z’intama mirongo icenda na zitandatu, imyagazi y’intama mirongo indwi n’indwi n’amasuguru y’impene cumi n’abiri y’ikimazi c’ivyaha. Ivyo vyose vyari ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro bishikaniwe Uhoraho .
Kandi bashikiriza ya mategeko y’umwami abishikira b’umwami n’abakuru b’intara bo hakurya y’uruzi Efurate, na bo baca bafasha abantu baterera n’Ingoro y’Imana.

Ivyo vyose bimaze gukorwa, abarongozi baza aho ndi baravuga bati: "Abisirayeli, harimwo n’abaherezi n’Abalewi, ntibitandukanije n’abanyamahanga babana mu gihugu hamwe n’imigenzo yabo mibi birenze urugero, nk’iy’Abanyakanani, Abaheti, Abaperizi, Abayebusi, Abamoni, Abanyamowabu, Abanyegiputa n’Abamori.

Abagabo b’Abisirayeli babatoyemwo abakobwa babagira abagore babo kandi babakwera n’abahungu babo na bo. Ivyo vyatumye haba ikivange c’ubwoko bwera n’ayo mahanga. Kandi abarongozi n’abacamanza ni bo babaye aba mbere gukora ico kizira."
Numvise ivyo, nitabagurirako umwambaro wanje n’ikoti, nishikura umushatsi n’ubwanwa, hanyuma nicara hasi mbabaye cane.

Abantu bose bajugumizwa n’amajambo y’Imana y’Abisirayeli baza aho ndi barankikuza kubera ico kibi abagarutse bava mu kinyago bakoze. Maze nguma ngaho nicurikiriye kugeza igihe co gutanga ikimazi co ku mugoroba.
Nuko hageze gutanga ikimazi co ku mugoroba, mpaguruka aho nari nicurikiririye, umwambaro wanje n’umutamana wanje vyatabutse, nca mpfukama hasi nduza amaboko Uhoraho Imana yanje
ndaheza ndasenga nti: "Ewe Mana yanje, maramajwe cane kandi nteterejwe no kukurangamiza, kuko ivyaha vyacu ari vyinshi kugeza n’aho bidusumba kandi igicumuro cacu cashitse mw’ijuru.

Kuva mu misi ya ba sogokuruza gushika n’ubu, ukugabitanya kwacu kwamye ari kwinshi. Kubera ivyaha vyacu, twebwe n’abami bacu n’abaherezi bacu bagerewe inkota no kuba inyagano, kunyagwa ivyacu no gucurangurizwa mu maboko y’abami b’amahanga, nk’uko bimeze uwu musi.

Ariko noneho, Uhoraho Imana yacu, muri kano kanya gato, ahejeje kutugirira ubuntu mu kudusigariza amasigarira no kuduha ikibanza gikomeye mu ngoro yiwe yera, ku bw’ivyo Imana yacu ikaba itumurikiye kandi iduhaye agahengwe mu buja bwacu.

Naho turi abagurano, Imana yacu ntiyaduhebeye mu buja bwacu. Yatweretse ukugira neza kwayo imbere y’abami b’i Buperesi: Yadusubije ubuzima bushasha ngo dusubire kwubaka Ingoro y’Imana yacu no gusanura aho yasambutse, kandi yaduhaye uruzitiro rwo kudukingira i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu.
Ariko ubu, ewe Mana yacu, twovuga iki inyuma y’ivyo? Ko twakengereye amabwirizwa yawe

watanze ucishije mu bavugishwa bawe aho wavuga uti: Igihugu mugiye kwinjiramwo ngo mucegukire ni igihugu candujwe n’abantu bakibamwo. Bacujuje ibihumanya vyabo kuva ku mpera gushika ku yindi ku bw’ibikorwa vyabo bibi.

Nuko rero, ntimuze mukoshe abakobwa banyu ku bahungu babo canke ngo musabire abahungu banyu abakobwa babo. Ntimuze mwigere mugiranira amasezerano y’ubugenzi na bo, kugira ngo mube abanyenkomezi kandi murye ivyiza vyo mu gihugu muze mukirage abana banyu nk’umugabane w’ibihe bidashira.
Ivyadushitseko ni ingaruka y’ibikorwa vyacu bibi n’ukugabitanya kwacu gukomeye, ariko n’ubwo biri uko, Mana yacu waduhanye buhoro ugereranije n’ivyo twakoze kandi waduhaye amasigarira nk’aya.
None twosubira kugarariza amabwirizwa yawe tugahana abageni na ya mahanga yakora ibibi vy’akaburarugero? Mbega ntivyotuma uraka bigatuma uturandura, ntudusigire amasigarira canke n’uwocika kw’icumu?

Ewe Uhoraho , Mana y’Abisirayeli, uragororotse! Uyu musi twasigaye nk’amasigarira. Turi hano imbere yawe dutsinzwe n’ivyo twakoze, naho ata woshobora guhagarara imbere y’inyonga zawe ku bw’ivyaha vyiwe."
Ezira agisenga yatura, arira yubamye imbere y’Ingoro y’Imana, abantu benshi b’Abisirayeli, abagabo, abagore n’abana, bakoranira aho ari. Na bo nyene bararira cane.

Nuko Shekaniya mwene Yehiyeli, umwe wo mu bakomoka kuri Elamu, abwira Ezira ati: "Ntitwabaye abizigirwa imbere y’Imana yacu mu kurongora abagore b’abanyamahangakazi dukuye mu mahanga adukikije. Ariko naho bimeze uko, haracariho ivyizigiro ku Bisirayeli.

Ubu rero, nimuze dusezeranire imbere y’Imana yacu, twemere kwirukana abo bagore bose n’abana babo, nk’uko wewe nyakwubahwa ubiduhanura n’abandi bose bahindira agashitsi imbere y’amabwirizwa y’Uhoraho Imana yacu. Kandi tubikore twisunze ivyagezwe.
Haguruka; iki kibazo kiri mu maboko yawe. Natwe turagushigikiye, komera kandi ubikore."
Nuko Ezira aca ava hasi arahiza abakuru mu baherezi n’Abalewi n’Abisirayeli bose ngo bakore ivyo vyavuzwe. Bose bararahira.

Maze Ezira aca ava imbere y’Ingoro y’Imana aja mu cumba ca Yehohanani mwene Eliyashibu. Ari ngaho, ntiyariye ikintu na kimwe kandi ntiyanyoye n’amazi, kuko yabandanije agandaye kubera ubuhemu abavuye mu kinyago bagize.
Nuko babimenyesha mu Buyuda hose n’i Yerusalemu ngo abagarutse bavuye mu kinyago bakoranire hamwe i Yerusalemu.

Umuntu wese atashoboye kuboneka mu misi itatu yaca anyagwa itongo ryiwe, nk’uko vyari vyashinzwe n’abatware hamwe n’abakuru b’imiryango, kandi na we nyene ubwiwe agaca akurwa mw’ikoraniro ry’abagarutse bavuye mu kinyago.

Mu misi itatu, abagabo bose b’i Buyuda n’i Bubenyamini bari bakoraniye i Yerusalemu, maze ku musi wa mirongo ibiri w’ukwezi kw’icenda, abantu bose bari bicaye mu kibuga c’Ingoro y’Imana, batetemera kubera iyo ngorane hamwe rero n’imvura nyinshi.
Nuko Ezira umuherezi arahaguruka arababwira ati: "Ntimwabaye abizigirwa; mwarongoye abagore b’abanyamahangakazi, mwongereza ku bibi Abisirayeli bari barakoze.
None rero nimwaturire Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sogokuruza icaha canyu, kandi mukore ivyo agomba. Mwitandukanye n’abanyamahanga mubana n’abagore mwazanye b’abanyamahangakazi."
Ikoraniro ryose ririshura n’ijwi rirenga riti: "Uvuze ukuri! Turakora nk’uko uvuze.

Ariko hano hari abantu benshi kandi ni mu gihe c’imvura; kubera ivyo ntidushobora guhagarara hanze. Ikigeretse kuri ivyo, ibi ntibishobora gutunganywa ku musi umwe canke ibiri, kuko twakoze icaha gikomeye mu gukora ivyo.

Abatware bacu nibabikore mu gishingo c’ikoraniro ryose. Maze umuntu wese wo mu bisagara vyacu yarongoye umunyamahangakazi mu gihe kinaka cemejwe, azoze azananye n’abakuru n’abacamanza bo mu gisagara kimwe cose, kugira ngo uburake bw’inkazi bw’Imana yacu bwatewe n’iyi ngorane bushobore kutuvako."
Yonatani mwene Asaheli na Yahizeya mwene Tikuva ni bo bonyene bagwanije iyo ngingo, bashigikiwe na Meshulamu na Shabetayi Umulewi.

Nuko abatahutse bavuye mu kinyago bakora nk’uko bagiriwe inama. Ezira umuherezi atoranya abagabo bari abakuru b’imiryango, umw’umwe mu muce w’umuryango, kandi abagabo bose babavuga mu mazina. Ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kw’icumi baricara ngo bige ivyo bintu,
kandi kugeza ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa mbere baraheza kwihweza ivyerekeye abagabo bose bari barongoye abagore b’abanyamahangakazi.
Mu bakomotse ku baherezi, aba bakurikira ni bo bari bararongoye abanyamahangakazi: Mu bakomoka kuri Yesuwa mwene Yozadaki, n’abavukanyi biwe ni Mayaseya, Eliyezeri, Yaribu na Gedaliya.
(Bose basezerana mu ndahiro kwirukana abagore babo, no gutanga impfizi y’intama ivuye mu mukuku ngo ibe ikimazi co kwisaba ku bw’icaha cabo.)
Mu bakomoka kuri Imeri ni Hanani na Zebadiya.
Mu bakomoka kuri Harimu ni Mayaseya, Eliya, Shemaya, Yehiyeli na Uziya.
Mu bakomoka kuri Pashuri ni Eliyowenayi, Mayaseya, Ishimayeli, Netaneli, Yozabadi na Elasa.
Mu Balewi ni Yozabadi, Shimeyi, Kelaya ari we Kelita, Petahiya, Yuda na Eliyezeri.
Mu baririmvyi ni Eliyashibu. Mu barinzi b’irembo ni Shalumu, Telemu na Uri.
Mu bakomotse ku bandi Bisirayeli: Mu bakomoka kuri Paroshi ni Ramiya, Iziya, Malikiya, Miyamini, Eliyazeri, Malikiya na Benaya.
Mu bakomoka kuri Elamu ni Mataniya, Zakariya, Yehiyeli, Abudi, Yeremoti na Eliya.
Mu bakomoka kuri Zatu ni Eliyowenayi, Eliyashibu, Mataniya, Yeremoti, Zabadi na Aziza.
Mu bakomoka kuri Bebayi ni Yehohanani, Hananiya, Zabayi na Atilayi.
Mu bakomoka kuri Bani ni Meshulamu, Maluki, Adaya, Yashubi, Sheyali na Yeremoti.
Mu bakomoka kuri Pahati-Mowabu ni Adina, Kelali, Benaya, Mayaseya, Mataniya, Bezaleli, Binuwi na Manase.
Mu bakomoka kuri Harimu ni Eliyezeri, Ishiya, Malikiya, Shemaya, Shimeyoni,
Benyamini, Maluki na Shemariya.
Mu bakomoka kuri Hashumi ni Matenayi, Matata, Zabadi, Elifeleti, Yeremayi, Manase na Shimeyi.
Mu bakomoka kuri Bani ni Mayadayi, Amuramu, Uweli,
Benaya, Bedeya, Keluhi,
Vaniya, Meremoti, Eliyashibu,
Mataniya, Matenayi na Yayasu.
Mu bakomoka kuri Binuwi ni Shimeyi,
Shelemiya, Natani, Adaya,
Makinadebayi, Shashayi, Sharayi,
Azareli, Shelemiya, Shemariya,
Shalumu, Amariya na Yosefu.
Mu bakomoka kuri Nebo ni Yeyiyeli, Matitiya, Zabadi, Zebina, Yadayi, Yoweli na Benaya.
Abo bagabo bose bari bararongoye abanyamahangakazi kandi bamwe muri bo bari bafitaniye abana n’abo bagore.

name: Nehemiya
chapters: Aya ni amajambo ya Nehemiya mwene Hakaliya: Mu kwezi kwa Kisilevu mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri, umwami Aritazeruzi ari ku ngoma, nari ku mugwa i Suza.
Hanani, umwe mu bo tuvukana, aza avuye i Buyuda ari kumwe n’abandi bagabo bamwe, maze ndababaza amakuru y’amasigarira y’Abayuda batashe bavuye mu kinyago, n’ivyerekeye Yerusalemu.

Barambwira bati: "Abarokotse mu bari barajanywe ari inyagano, bakaba baragarutse mu ntara y’iwabo i Buyuda, bari mu mibabaro myinshi no mu biteterwe. Uruzitiro rw’i Yerusalemu rwarasenyutse, kandi n’amarembo yaho yatongojwe umuriro."
Maze kwumva ivyo, nicara hasi ndarira. Mara imisi ngandaye nisonzesheje kandi nsenga Imana yo mw’ijuru.
Maze ndavuga nti: "Yewe Uhoraho , Mana yo mw’ijuru, Mana nkuru kandi uhambaye, uzigama isezerano ryawe ry’urukundo wagiranye n’abagukunda kandi bubaha amabwirizwa yawe,

ndakwinginze untege ugutwi kandi inyonga zawe ntizive kuri jewe, wumve ugusenga kw’umusavyi wawe ndiko ndasengera imbere yawe ku murango no mw’ijoro nsengera abasavyi bawe ari bo Bisirayeli. Ndatuye ivyaha twebwe Abisirayeli, na jewe ndimwo n’umuryango wa data, twakoze tugucumurako.
Twakoze ibibi vyinshi mu nyonga zawe. Ntitwitondeye ivyo wategetse, amabwirizwa n’ivyagezwe vyawe ivyo wahaye umusavyi wawe Mose.
Wibuke ivyo wabwiye umusavyi wawe Mose, uvuga uti: ‘Nimutaba abizigirwa, nzobasanzariza mu yandi mahanga,

ariko nimwangarukako maze mukumvira ivyo nategetse, nanje naho abantu banyu bazoba barasanzaye bagashika ku mpera y’isi, nzobegeranya ndabakureyo ndabagarukane mu kibanza natoranije ngo Izina ryanje abe ari ho riba.’
Ni abasavyi bawe kandi ni ubwoko bwawe, abo wacunguye ukoresheje ubushobozi bwawe n’ukuboko kwawe gukomeye.

Yewe Uhoraho, niwumve ugusenga kw’umusavyi wawe n’ugusenga kw’abasavyi bawe bahimbarwa no kwubaha izina ryawe. Uhe umusavyi wawe kuroranirwa uwu musi ngo aze kugira ikiganza ciza imbere y’uwu muntu." Nari njejwe guhereza ibinyobwa umwami.
