Nimuhimbaze Uhoraho , yemwe bikorwa vyiwe aho muri hose mu bwami bwiwe. Mutima wanje, himbaza Uhoraho .
Mutima wanje, himbaza Uhoraho . Uhoraho Mana yanje, urahambaye cane; wambaye icubahiro n’igitinyiro.
Uhoraho yitwikiriza umuco nk’umutamana; yubaka amajuru nk’ihema
agashinga inkingi z’inzu ziwe zo hejuru ku mazi menshi. Ahindura ibicu umukogote wiwe akagendera ku mababa y’umuyaga.
Ahindura imiyaga intumwa ziwe, abakozi biwe akabagira imbeya z’umuriro.
Ashinga isi ku matanguriro yayo; kandi ntiyigera inyiganyizwa.
Wayitwikirije amadamba y’amazi nk’impuzu; amazi yarenze udutwe tw’imisozi.
Ariko uvuze gusa amazi arahunga, yumvise uguturagara kwawe yaciye ahunga;
yaduze imisozi, amanuka mu biyaya, aho wayashingiye kuba.
Wayashingiye akarimbi atarenga; ntazosubira kurengera isi.
Atuma amasoko adudubiza amazi aja mu myonga; agatembera hagati y’imisozi.
Agaha amazi ibikoko vyose vyo mw’ishamba; indogoba z’inyeshamba zikimara inyota.
Inyoni zo mu kirere zubaka ivyari vyazo i ruhande y’amazi; ziririmbira mu mashami y’ibiti.
Avomerera imisozi ari mu nzu yiwe mw’ijuru; igihugu kigahazwa n’ibivuye mu bikorwa vyiwe.
Atuma ivyatsi bikura kubera amasho, n’ibiterwa birimwe n’abantu, kugira ngo isi bayikuremwo ivyokurya:
umuvinyu unezereza imitima y’abantu, amavuta atuma abantu bakayangana mu maso, n’umutsima ubaha inkomezi.
Ibiti vy’ Uhoraho bivomererwa neza, amasederi y’i Libani, ayo yateye.
Raba inyoni uko zijisha ivyari vyazo; agasoza kironkera inzu yako mu tujwari.
Mu misozi miremire ni ho impene z’inyeshamba zibera; ibitandara ni ubuhungiro bw’inkezi.
Yaremye ukwezi ngo kugene ibihe, n’izuba rirazi igihe rirengerako.
Uzana umwijima bukira, maze ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba bigaturuka.
Intambwe zikivuga zirondera ico zihiga zikarondera indya zazo ziva ku Mana.
Izuba ryaseruka, zikigira, zikisubirira kubunda mu bibundo vyazo.
Maze abantu bagasohoka bakaja ku bikorwa vyabo, bagakora bakaruha gushika ku mugoroba.
Uhoraho we, ese ingene ibikorwa vyawe ari vyinshi! Wabiremesheje ubwenge vyose; isi yuzuyemwo ivyaremwe vyawe.
Raba ikiyaga, ingene cagutse kikaba kinini, cuzuye ivyaremwe birenze urugero; ibiri n’ubuzima binini na bitoya.
Raba ubwato ingene buja hirya no hino, na Leviyatani, iyo waremye ngo ikiniremwo.
Ivyaremwe vyose biguhanga amaso ngo ubigaburire ivyokurya vyavyo mu gihe cavyo.
Iyo ubigaburiye, biregeranya indya; iyo upfunduruye ikiganza cawe, bihazwa ivyiza.
Uhishije mu nyonga zawe, vyicwa n’ubwoba; ubikuyemwo umwuka wavyo, birapfa bigasubira mu mukungugu.
Iyo urungitse Mpwemu wawe biraremwa, ugasubiza isi kuba nshasha.
Icubahiro c’ Uhoraho kiragahoraho ibihe vyose; Uhoraho ahimbariwe ibikorwa vyiwe;
we araba isi, na yo igahinda agashitsi, akora ku misozi, igapfunduka umwotsi.
Nzoririmbira Uhoraho ubuzima bwanje bwose; nzoririmba ishimwe ry’Imana yanje imisi yose nzoba nkiriho.
Icompa ukurimbura kwanje kugahimbara Uhoraho , kuko nezererwa muri we.
Ariko abanyavyaha nibaherengetere kw’isi, abanyakibi ntibasubire kubaho. Himbaza Uhoraho , ewe mutima wanje. Himbaza Uhoraho .
Nimuhimbaze Uhoraho , mwamamaze izina ryiwe; mumenyekanishe mu mahanga ivyo yakoze.
Nimumuririmbire, mumuhimbaze; muvuge ibikorwa vyiwe bihambaye.
Mwirate izina ryiwe ryera; imitima y’abarondera Uhoraho inezerwe.
Nimurondere Uhoraho n’inkomezi ziwe; mwame murondera mu nyonga hiwe.
Nimwibuke ibitangaza yakoze, utwumiza, n’imanza yaciye;
yemwe ruvyaro rwa Aburahamu, umusavyi wayo; yemwe bene Yakobo, abo yatoranije.
Uhoraho ni we Mana yacu; imanza ziwe ziri mw’isi yose.
Yama yibuka isezerano ryiwe ibihe vyose, n’ijambo yasezeranye, gushika ku runganwe rugira igihumbi,
Isezerano yagiranye na Aburahamu, indahiro yarahiye Isaka.
Yararyemeje kuri Yakobo nk’itegeko, no kuri Isirayeli nk’isezerano ry’intahava ngo:
"Nzoguha igihugu c’i Kanani, kibe umugabane wawe uzoragwa."
Igihe bari bakiri inkehwa gusa, mbere ari inkehwa vy’ukuri, kandi ari inyambukira muri co,
Bagenda bangara bava mu gihugu baja mu kindi, bava mu bwami baja mu bundi.
Ntiyakundira umuntu n’umwe kubacinyiza; ku bwabo yakankamiye abami ati:
"Ntimukore ku bo narobanuje amavuta; ntimugirire nabi abavugishwa banje."
Yahamagaye ikigoyi mu gihugu asambura ibigega vyabo vy’indya vyose;
maze urungika umuntu imbere yabo; ni Yosefu yagurishijwe nk’umugurano.
Baboshe amaguru yiwe mu minyororo, izosi ryiwe rishirwa mu vyuma,
kugeza ivyo yari yaravuze bishitse, kugeza ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryemeje ko yavuze ukuri.
Umwami atumako baramurekura, abakuru bo mu bantu bamuha kwidegemvya.
Amuhindura uwuganza abo mu rugo rwiwe, uwuganza ivyo yari atunze vyose,
ngo yigishe abaganwa biwe nk’uko bimuhimbaye kandi ngo yigishe abatware baho ubwenge.
Maze Isirayeli yinjira muri Egiputa; Yakobo aba inyambukira mu gihugu ca Hamu.
Uhoraho atuma abantu biwe bagwira; atuma baba benshi ku bansi babo,
abo yatumye imitima yanka abantu biwe, ngo bagire inama yo kubagirira nabi.
Yatumye Mose umusavyi wiwe, na Aroni, uwo yari yaratoranije.
Bakora ibitangaza muri bo, n’utwumiza mu gihugu ca Hamu.
Yarungitse umwijima apfuka igihugu cabo cose; kuko bari bamugararije.
Yahinduye amazi yabo amaraso, bituma amafi yabo apfa.
Igihugu cabo cuzuye ibikere, biraduga no mu buriri bw’abatware babo.
Yaravuze, haca hatera ibibugu, imibu ikwira igihugu cose ca Egiputa.
Yahinduye imvura yabo urubura, imiravyo iboneka mu gihugu cabo cose;
yahungururiye hasi imizabibu n’imisukoni vyabo avunagura ibiti vyo muri Egiputa.
Yaravuze, maze inzige ziraza, intoteza zitagira igitigiri;
zirya ibitotahaye vyose vyo mu gihugu cabo, zirya ivyimburwa bimera kw’isi yabo.
Maze yica abana b’imfura bo mu gihugu cabo, ivyamwa vya mbere vyo mu buto bwabo.
Yasohoye Isirayeli, bagenda bikoreye ifeza n’inzahabu mu bo mu miryango yabo nta n’umwe yatsitaye.
Egiputa bari banezerewe igihe bagenda kuko bari batekewe n’ubwoba kubera Abisirayeli.
Yagaranzuye igicu co kubapfuka, n’umuriro wo kubamurikira mw’ijoro.
Barasavye, na we abaha inkware; yarabagaburiye barahaga umukate uvuye mw’ijuru.
Yasatuye igitandara, amazi aradudubiza; atemba nk’uruzi mu bugaragwa.
Kuko yibutse isezerano ryiwe ryera iryo yahaye umusavyi wiwe Aburahamu.
Yasohoye abantu biwe banezerewe, abo yitoranirije bavuza impundu z’umunezero;
yabahaye igihugu c’amahanga, barazwe ico abandi bahabiye;
kugira ngo bitondere ivyo yihanikirije bagendere mu vyagezwe vyiwe. Uhoraho ahimbazwe.
Haleluya. Nimushime Uhoraho kuko ari mwiza; kuko urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Ni nde ashobora kumenyekanisha ivyo Uhoraho yakoze canke ngo amuhimbaze nk’uko bikwiye?
Hahiriwe abakora ibitunganye, bakama bakora ibigororotse.
Ewe Uhoraho , uranyibuka niwagirira imbabazi abantu bawe, uze untabare niwabakiza,
kugira ngo nezererwe amahirwe y’abo watoranije. Kugira ngo nsangire umunezero n’ihanga ryawe nifatanye n’ishamvu yawe mu kugutazira.
Twaracumuye, nk’uko ba sogokuruza bakoze; twakoze ibitabereye dukora ibibi.
Igihe ba sogokuruza bari muri Egiputa, ntibamenye ibitangaza wakoze; ntibibutse ivy’ukugira neza kwawe kwinshi, maze baragarariza bari ku kiyaga, Ikiyaga Gitukura.
Ariko arabakiza kubera izina ryiwe, ngo amenyekanishe ubushobozi bwiwe.
Yakankamiye Ikiyaga Gitukura, maze kiruma; yabacishije i bwina nko mu bugaragwa.
Yarabakijije abakura mu kuboko kw’umwansi; arabacungura abakura mu kuboko k’uwabagwanya.
Amazi arengera ababahiga; nta n’umwe wo muri bo yarokotse.
Nuko bizera amasezerano yiwe baririmba ishimwe ryiwe.
Ariko baca bibagira vuba ivyo yari yabakoreye ntibarindira ko ashira mu ngiro umugambi wiwe.
Mu bugaragwa bagiye mu vyo kwipfuza kwabo; mu bweranyange bagerageje Imana.
Nuko ibaha ivyo basavye, ariko ibarungikira ikiza gihonya.
Bari aho bacumbitse bagiriye ishari Mose hamwe na Aroni, uwari yatoranirijwe Uhoraho .
Isi irasama imira Datani; ihamba umugwi wa Abiramu.
Umuriro wadutse mu babakurikira; urubeya rwarigase abanyakibi.
I Horebu bacuze imasa basenga ikigirwamana cacuzwe mu butare.
Baguza Imana yabo y’ubwiza igishushanyo c’impfizi, irisha ubwatsi.
Bibagira Imana yabakijije, yakoze ibihambaye muri Egiputa,
ibitangaza mu gihugu ca Hamu n’ibikorwa bihambaye ku Kiyaga Gitukura.
Nuko avuga ko azobahonya; iyo Mose, uwo yatoranije, adahagarara mu gihengeri imbere yiwe kugira ngo uburake bwiwe ntibubarigate.
Mu nyuma banka igihugu ciza; ntibizera isezerano ryiwe.
Baridodomvye bari mu mahema yabo ntibubaha Uhoraho .
Aca arahira amanitse ukuboko kwiwe ko azobahonereza mu bugaragwa,
agatuma uruvyaro rwabo rugwa mu banyamahanga akabasanzariza mu bihugu.
Bifatanije na Bayali y’i Peyori maze barya ivyaterekerejwe imana zitagiramwo ubuzima;
bavyura uburake bw’ Uhoraho kubera ibikorwa vyabo bibi, haca haduka ikiza muri bo.
Ariko Finehasi arahaguruka ngo ahane uwacumuye, ico kiza gica kirahagarara.
Ivyo yabiharuweko nk’ukugororoka uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi ibihe vyose.
Bashavuje Uhoraho bari ku mazi y’i Meriba, ivyago biza kuri Mose kubera bo;
kuko batumviye Mpwemu w’Imana, bituma Mose yadukana amajambo atiyumviriye.
Ntibaranduye amahanga nk’uko Uhoraho yari yababariye,
ariko bivanga n’ayo mahanga bigana ingeso zabo.
Basenga imana zabo, na zo zibabera umutego.
Bashikanira izo mana abahungu n’abakobwa babo.
Basesa amaraso y’abatagira icaha, amaraso y’abahungu n’abakobwa babo, abo bashikaniye ibigirwamana vy’i Kanani nk’ibimazi, maze ayo maraso ahumanya igihugu.
Bihumanishije ivyo bakoze; bacika abasambanyi kubera ibikorwa vyabo.
Ni co catumye Uhoraho ashavurira abantu biwe, azinukwa umugabane wiwe.
Yabarekuriye mu maboko y’amahanga, maze abansi babo barabaganza.
Abansi babo barabacinyiza baba musi y’ububasha bwabo.
Yabatabaye kenshi, ariko bashishikara kumugarariza kandi baguma bamucumurako.
Ariko yumvise umubabaro wabo igihe yumva ugutakamba kwabo;
Ku bwabo yibutse isezerano ryiwe maze kubera urukundo rwiwe rwinshi arigarura.
Yatumye ababagize abagurano babagirira akagongwe.
Dukize, Uhoraho Mana yacu, twegeranye udukure mu mahanga, kugira ngo dushime izina ryawe ryera Twongere tuguhimbaze.
Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, ahimbazwe, uhereye ibihe bidashira ukageza ibihe bidashira. Abantu bose nibavuge bati: "Amen." Haleluya.
Nimushimire Uhoraho , kuko ari mwiza; urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Abacunguwe n’ Uhoraho nibashinge iyo intahe; abo yacunguye akabakura mu kuboko kw’umwansi,
abo yegeranije abakura mu bihugu, mu buseruko no mu burengero, mu buraruko no mu bumanuko.
Bamwe bayerera mu bugaragwa, kw’isi igadutse, ntibabona inzira yobashikana mu gisagara boshobora kubamwo.
Bari bashonje kandi banyotewe, bari bihebuye.
Maze mu magorwa yabo, batakambiye Uhoraho , na we arabakiza, abakura mu marushwa yabo.
Yabarongoreye mu nzira igororotse abajana mu gisagara bari bagiye kubamwo.
Abo nibashime Uhoraho ku bw’urukundo rwiwe rudashira, n’ibikorwa bihambaye yakoreye abana b’abantu,
kuko amara inyota abanyotewe agahaza ivyiza abashonje.
Bamwe bicara mu mwiza, umwijima w’urupfu, ari imbohe ziri mu mubabaro mu minyororo y’ivyuma,
kuko batumviye ivyo Imana yategetse bagakengera imigambi y’Iyisumbavyose.
Nuko ibashira ku bikebere; baratsitara, ntibaronka uwo kubatabara.
Maze mu magorwa yabo batakambira Uhoraho , na we arabakiza, abakura mu marushwa yabo.
Yabakuye mu mwijima, umwijima w’urupfu, acagagura iminyororo yabo.

kuko yamenye inzugi z’imiringa agacagagura ibihindizo vy’ivyuma.
Bamwe babaye ibipfu kubera inzira zabo mbi bagira amagorwa ku bwo kugabitanya kwabo.
Banka kurya indya zose bituma begereza ku marembo y’urupfu.

Yarungitse ijambo ryiwe, arabakiza; arabatabara abakuye mu rupfu.
Abo nibashime Uhoraho Ku bw’urukundo rwiwe rudashira, n’ibikorwa bihambaye yakoreye abana b’abantu.
Nibamushikanire ibimazi vy’ishimwe bavuge ivyo yakoze mu ndirimbo z’umunezero.
Bamwe bagiye n’ubwato mu kiyaga; bari abadandaza hejuru y’amazi y’inkomezi.
Babonye ibikorwa vy’ Uhoraho , ibitangaza yakoreye i bwina.
Kuko yavuze akavyura umuyaga wavyuye imipfunda.
Baraduze baja hejuru bongera baramanuka i bwina; muri ayo marushwa barihebura.
Barazunguriwe, baradandabagirana nk’imborerwa; bari babaye nk’abatagira ubwenge.
Maze mu magorwa yabo, batakambiye Uhoraho , na we abakura mu marushwa yabo.
Yahagaritse ingunza y’amazi; imikuba iratekereza.
Baranezerewe aho catekereza, na we arabarongora abashitsa aho bipfuza gushika.
Abo nibashime Uhoraho Ku bw’urukundo rwiwe rudashira, n’ibikorwa bihambaye yakoreye abana b’abantu.
Nibamushire hejuru bari mw’ikoraniro ry’abantu bamuhimbarize mw’ikoraniro ry’abakuru.
Yahinduye inzuzi ubugaragwa, imigezi itemba ayihindura isi igadutse,
isi yimbuka nayo ayihindura igihugu c’umunyu, kubera ibibi vy’abahaba.
Yahinduye ubugaragwa amariba y’amazi n’isi igadutse ahantu h’amariba;
aho ni ho yahaye abashonje kubaho, maze bubaka igisagara aho kuba.
Babiba mu mirima batera n’imizabibu bimbura vyinshi;
abaha umugisha, n’ibitigiri vyabo birongerekana, kandi ntiyemera ko amasho yabo agabanuka.
Hanyuma igitigiri cabo kiragabanuka, bacishwa bugufi n’agahahazo, ivyago n’umubabaro;
Imana ituma abaganwa bamaramara ituma bangara mu bugaragwa butagira inzira.
Ariko yakuye abakene mu mubabaro wabo aca agwiza imiryango yabo nk’imikuku.
Abatunganye barabibona baranezerwa, ariko abanyakibi bazibwa akanwa.
Nihaba hariho umunyabwenge niyiyumvire kuri ivyo kugira ngo atahure ibikorwa vy’urukundo vy’ Uhoraho .
Umutima wanje urashikamye ewe Mana; nzoririmba ncurarange n’umushaha wanje wose.
Ewe nanga nawe kembe, nimwikangure! Nzovyura umutwenzi.
Ewe Uhoraho , nzoguhimbaza mu moko menshi; nzokuririmba ndi mu mahanga.
Kuko urukundo rwawe ari rwinshi, rushika no mu majuru; ubwizigirwa bwawe bushika no mu birere.
Nushirwe hejuru, ewe Mana, hejuru y’amajuru; icubahiro cawe gikwire kw’isi yose.
Dutabarishe ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo, kandi utwishure; kugira ngo abo ukunda bakire.
Imana yavugiye ahera hayo iti: "Mu kunesha kwanje nzogaburamwo ibice Shekemu, kandi nzogeresha umugozi ikiyaya c’i Sukoti.
Gileyadi ni uwanje, kandi Manase ni uwanje; Efurayimu ni we nkofero yanje, Yuda ni icumu ryanje ry’ubugabe.
Mowabu ni ibesani niyogeramwo, kuri Edomu ni ho nkunkumurira ibirato vyanje; Kuri Filisitiya ni ho nivugira amazina yo kunesha."
Ni nde azonshikana mu gisagara gikikujwe inzitiro? Ni nde azondongora gushika kuri Edomu?
Mbega si wewe ga Mana wadutaye, Ntube ukijana n’ingabo zacu ku rugamba?
Dufashe kugwanya umwansi, kuko ugutabara kw’abantu ata co kumaze.
Turi kumwe n’Imana tuzonesha intambara, Kandi izosiribanga abansi bacu.
Mana, wewe mpimbaza, ntucereze,
kuko abantu babi kandi b’ingunge buguruye akanwa kabo ngo bangwanye; bavugishije indimi zabo bambeshera.
Barankikuje bavuga amajambo y’urwanko; banteye ata nyanduruko.
Aho kunkunda nk’uko ndabakunda, baranyagiriza, ariko ndi umuntu asenga.
Banyishuye ibibi ku vyiza nabakoreye, n’urwanko mu gishingo c’urukundo.
Tuma uwo kugwanya umwansi wanje; uwumwagiriza nahagarare i buryo bwiwe.
Niyacirwa urubanza, natsindwe, kandi amasengesho yiwe amutsindishe.
Ese imisi yiwe yoba mike; agasubirizwa mu mabanga yiwe y’uburongozi.
Ese abana biwe boba impfuvyi umugore wiwe na we akaba umupfakazi.
Ese abana biwe bokwama bangara basega; bakirukanwa bakava mu mazu yabo yahindutse imisaka.
Ese uwo aheraniye yofata ivyo afise vyose; abanyamahanga bagasahura ivyo yaruhiye vyose.
Ese yobura n’umwe amugirira neza canke ngo agirire akagongwe impfuvyi ziwe.
Ese uruvyaro rwiwe rwohona, amazina yabo agasibanganywa mu bo mu runganwe ruzoza.
Ese ukugabitanya kwa ba sekuruza kwokwibukwa imbere y’ Uhoraho ; icaha ca nyina nticigere gisibanganywa.
Ese ivyaha vyabo vyokwama imbere y’ Uhoraho imisi yose, kugira ngo asibanganye amazina yabo mw’isi.
Kuko atigeze yiyumvira ivyo kugira neza, ariko yababaje umukene gushika ku rupfu n’umugorwa n’uwufise umutima umenetse.
Yakunze kuvuma; nibimugarukeko. Ntiyanezererwa no guhezagira; nibibe kure yiwe.
Yambara kuvuma nk’impuzu; kwinjiye mu mubiri wiwe nk’amazi, no mu magufa yiwe nk’amavuta.
Nikube nk’ikoti izingiriwe kuri we, nk’umukanda akenyeje ibihe vyose.
Ivyo nibibe ingero Uhoraho aha abanyagiriza, abamvuga nabi.
Ariko wewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, ntabara kubera izina ryawe; ku bwo kugira neza kw’urukundo rwawe, nkiza.
Kuko ndi umukene n’umugorwa, kandi umutima wanje unkomerekeyemwo.
Ndiko ndahera numva kurya kw’igitutu co ku mugoroba; bampiga nk’uko bahiga inzige.
Amavi yanje adendebuwe no kwisonzesha; umubiri wanje uranyankabiranye kubera kwonda.
Abanyagiriza barancokora; iyo bambonye bazunguza imitwe.
Mfasha, Uhoraho Mana yanje; unkize kubera urukundo rwawe rudashira.
Nibamenye ko ari wewe n’ukuboko kwawe Uhoraho , ko ari wewe wabikoze.
Nibavuma, wewe urahezagira; abantera nibakorwe n’isoni, ariko abasavyi bawe nibanezerwe.
Icompa abanyagiriza bakicwa n’isoni bakambara ibiteterwe nk’ikoti.
Nzoshira ijwi hejuru nshima Uhoraho ; nzomuhimbariza mw’ikoraniro rinini.
Kuko ahagaze i buryo bw’abakene, ngo abakize amaboko y’abagomba kubatsindisha.
Uhoraho yabariye umwami wanje ati: "Icara i buryo bwanje kugeza abansi bawe bose ndabashize musi y’ibirenge vyawe."
Uhoraho azokuza icumu ry’ubugabe ryawe rihambaye kuva i Siyoni, avuga ati: "Ganza hagati y’abansi bawe!"
Ingabo zawe zizoba zifise ugushaka ku musi wawe w’intambara. Bashazishije ukwera, imisore yawe izoza aho uri imeze nk’ikime co mu gitondo ka kare.
Uhoraho ararahiye, kandi ntazohindura ico yavuze: "Uri umuherezi w’ibihe bidashira, mu buryo bwa Melekisedeki."
Uhoraho ari i buryo bwawe; azomenagura abami ku musi w’uburake bwiwe.
Azocira urubanza amahanga, arundanye imivyimba amenagure abatware bo kw’isi yose.
Azonywa ku mugezi w’iruhande y’inzira, uko ni ko azoraramura umutwe wiwe.
Himbaza Uhoraho . Nzohimbaza Uhoraho n’umutima wanje wose ndi mw’ikoraniro ry’abatunganye no mu bantu benshi.

Iyo umuntu amenye ijambo ryawe, abona umuco; abadaciye ubwenge ribaha ugutahura.
Ndasamye kandi ndahuzagizwa, nipfuza amabwirizwa yawe.
Hindukira maze ungirire imbabazi, nk’uko wama ugirira abakunda izina ryawe.
Rongora intambuko zanje nk’uko ijambo ryawe ryavuze; ntureke ngo hagire ikibi kinganza.
Uncungure unkure mu gacinyizo k’abantu, kugira ngo nitondere ivyo wihanikirije.
Umurikishirize umusavyi wawe inyonga zawe unyigishe amategeko yawe.
Imigende y’amosozi itemba iva mu maso yanje, kuko abantu batumvira Ivyagezwe vyawe. Tsade
Uragororotse, ewe Uhoraho , kandi ivyagezwe vyawe biratunganye.
Ivyo washinze biragororotse; ni ivyo kwizigira rwose.
Ishaka ryanje ryaka muri jewe nk’umuriro, kuko abansi banje birengagije amajambo yawe.
Amasezerano yawe yaragejejwe rwose, ni co gituma nanje umusavyi wawe ndayakunda.
Naho ndi umunyantegenke n’inkengerwa, sinibagira ivyo wihanikirije.
Ukugororoka kwawe ni uko ibihe bidashira kandi Ivyagezwe vyawe ni ivy’ukuri.
Ivyago n’akabonge vyanjeko, ariko amabwirizwa yawe ni yo anezera.
Ivyo washinze vyama bigororotse; umpe ugutahura kugira ngo mbeho. Kofu
Ndakwambaje n’umutima wanje wose, nunyishure, ewe Uhoraho , nanje nzokwitondera amategeko yawe.
Ndagutakambiye; nkiza nanje nzokwitondera ivyo washinze.
Mvyuka umutwenzi utaratambika ngatakamba; nizigiye ijambo ryawe.
Nguma ndi maso ijoro ryose, kugira ngo ndimbure amasezerano yawe.
Niwumve ijwi ryanje nk’uko urukundo rwawe rungana; ukingire ubugingo bwanje, Uhoraho , nk’uko ivyagezwe vyawe biri.
Abagira imigabo mibi baranyegereye, ariko bari kure y’Ivyagezwe vyawe.
Ariko weho, Uhoraho , uri hafi yanje, kandi amabwirizwa yawe yose ni ay’ukuri.
Kuva kera nize mu vyo washinze ko wabishinze ngo bigume bihamye gushika ibihe vyose. Reshi
Raba umubabaro wanje maze untabare, kuko ntibagiye Ivyagezwe vyawe.
Mburanira kandi uncungure; uzigame ubugingo bwanje nk’uko wasezeranye.
Agakiza kari kure y’abanyakibi, kuko batarondera kumenya amategeko yawe.
Ikigongwe cawe, ewe Uhoraho , kirahambaye; zigama ubugingo bwanje nk’uko ivyagezwe vyawe bivuga.
Abampiga babaye benshi, ariko sinavuye mu vyo washinze.
Abatizera ndabarabana agakengerwe, kuko batumvira ijambo ryawe.
Raba uko nkunda ivyo wihanikirije; uzigame ubugingo bwanje, Uhoraho , ku bw’urukundo rwawe.
Amajambo yawe yose ni ay’ukuri; ivyagezwe vyawe vyose bigororotse vyamaho ibihe vyose. Sini na Shini
Abakomeye barampiga ata nyanduruko, ariko umutima wanje uhindira agashitsi ijambo ryawe.
Jewe nezererwa isezerano ryawe nk’uwironkeye iminyago myinshi.
Ndanka kandi ngakengera ibinyoma ariko nkunda Ivyagezwe vyawe.
Ndaguhimbaza incuro indwi ku musi ku bw’ivyagezwe vyawe bigororotse.
Abakunda Ivyagezwe vyawe bafise amahoro menshi, kandi ntagishobora kubatsitaza.
Uhoraho , niteze agakiza kawe, kandi nitondera amabwirizwa yawe.
Jewe nitondera ivyo washinze, kuko ndabikunda cane.
Jewe nitondera ivyo wihanikirije n’ivyo washinze, kuko inzira zanje zose uzizi. Tawu
Icompa ugutakamba kwanje kugashika imbere yawe, Uhoraho ; umpe ugutahura nk’uko ijambo ryawe rivuga.
Ukwinginga kwanje nigushike imbere yawe; undokore nk’uko wasezeranye.
Icompa iminwa yanje ikuzura ishimwe, kuko unyigisha ivyo washinze.
Icompa ururimi rwanje rukaririmba ijambo ryawe, kuko amabwirizwa yawe yose agororotse.
Icompa ikiganza cawe kikitegurira kuntabara, kuko nahisemwo ivyo washinze.
Ndipfuza rwose agakiza kawe, ewe Uhoraho , kandi Ivyagezwe vyawe bimpa kunezerwa.
Umpe kubaho ngo ndaguhimbaze, kandi ivyagezwe vyawe binshigikire.
Nazimiye nk’intama yatakaye. Rondera umusavyi wawe, kuko ntibagiye amabwirizwa yawe.
Mu magorwa yanje nambaza Uhoraho , na we akanyishura.
Nkiza, ewe Uhoraho , iminwa ibesha n’indimi z’ibinyoma.
Ewe wa rurimi rw’ibinyoma, mbega azogukorera iki, canke azoguhanisha ikindi nyabaki?
Azoguhanisha imyampi isongoye y’umuhizi, n’amakara y’umurotemu yaka.
Jewe ndagowe kuko mba i Mesheki, nkaba hagati mu mahema y’i Kedari!
Kuva kera cane nabaye hagati y’abanka amahoro.
Jewe nshaka amahoro; ariko iyo mvuze, bo bashaka intambara.
Ndunamurira amaso yanje ku misozi; ugutabarwa kwanje kuva hehe?
Ugutabarwa kwanje kuva k’ Uhoraho , Umuremyi w’ijuru n’isi.
Ntazoreka ibirenge vyawe ngo binyerere; uwukuzigama ntazohunyiza;
ni ivy’ukuri, uwuzigama Isirayeli ntazokwigera ahunyiza canke ngo asinzire.
Uhoraho ni we akuzigama; Uhoraho ni we gitutu cawe i buryo bwawe;
izuba ntirizokubabaza ku murango, canke ukwezi mw’ijoro.
Uhoraho azokurinda ikibi cose; azozigama ubugingo bwawe;
Uhoraho azokuzigama amaja n’amaza uhereye ubu ukageza ibihe vyose.
Naranezerewe igihe bambwira bati: "Tuje mu nzu y’ Uhoraho ."
Ibirenge vyacu bihagaze mu marembo yawe, Yerusalemu.
Yerusalemu hubatswe nk’igisagara cegeranye kandi gifatanye.
Aho ni ho imiryango iduga; imiryango y’ Uhoraho ; ngo bahimbaze izina ry’ Uhoraho nk’uko yabishingiye Isirayeli.
Aho ni ho hari intebe z’imanza, intebe z’inzu ya Dawidi.
Musabire Yerusalemu ironke amahoro muti: "Icompa abagukunda bakaba amahoro.
Icompa mu nzitiro zawe hakaba amahoro n’umutekano ukaba mu minara yawe."
Kubera umuryango wanje n’abagenzi banje, nzovuga nti: "Amahoro abe muri wewe."
Kubera inzu y’ Uhoraho Imana yacu, nzokwama ngusabira ivyiza.
Ndunamurira amaso kuri wewe, wewe uvyagiye mw’ijuru.
Nk’uko abasavyi bahanga amaso ukuboko kwa shebuja, nk’uko abasavyikazi bahanga ukuboko ba inabuja, uko ni ko amaso yacu tuyahanze Uhoraho Imana yacu, kugeza aho azotugirira imbabazi.
Tugirire akagongwe, Uhoraho , tugirire akagongwe, kuko twakengererwe igihe kirekire.
Twacokowe igihe kirekire n’agacokoro k’abibone, twakengerewe n’abanyamanyama.
Iyo Uhoraho ataba mu ruhande rwacu; Abisirayeli nibavuge batyo;
iyo Uhoraho ataba mu ruhande rwacu igihe abantu badutera,
baba baratumize miyonzwa tukibona aho uburake bwabo bwatuziriringira,
isuri iba yaraturengeye, imipfunda iba yaraturenzeko,
amazi asuriranya aba yaradutembanye.
Uhoraho ahimbazwe, ataturetse ngo dutabagurwe n’amenyo yabo.
Ducitse mu mutego nk’inyoni tuvuye mu mutego w’umutezi; umutego uracitse, natwe tuwuvuyemwo turakira.
Ugutabarwa kwacu kuri mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho , Umuremyi w’ijuru n’isi.
Abizigiye Uhoraho bameze nk’umusozi Siyoni, udashobora kunyiganyizwa, ariko uhora ushikamye ibihe vyose.
Nk’uko imisozi ikikije Yerusalemu, ni ko Uhoraho akikije abantu biwe uhereye ubu ukageza ibihe bidashira.
Icumu ry’ubugabe ry’umunyakibi ntirizokwama rishinze mu gihugu cahawe abagororotsi, kuko abagororotsi bohava bakoresha amaboko yabo ibibi.
Uhoraho , girira neza abeza, abatunganye mu mutima.
Ariko abahindukira bakaja mu nzira zigoramye Uhoraho azobirukanana n’inkozi z’ikibi. Amahoro abe kuri Isirayeli.
Hamwe Uhoraho yagarukana i Siyoni abajanwe ari inyagano, twari tumeze nk’abarota.
Akanwa kacu kari kuzuye ibitwengatwenge indimi zacu zari zuzuye indirimbo z’umunezero. Maze biravugwa mu mahanga ngo: " Uhoraho yabakoreye ibikomeye."
Uhoraho yadukoreye ibikomeye, natwe turanezerewe.
Uhoraho garukana abacu bajanywe ari inyagano, bamere nk’imigezi y’i Negebu.
Ababiba barira bazokwimbura baririmba.
Abasohoka barira, bajanye imbuto kubiba, bazogarukana indirimbo z’umunezero, bikoreye ivyimburwa.
Iyo Uhoraho atari we yubaka inzu, abubatsi baba baruhira ubusa. Iyo Uhoraho atari we arinze igisagara, abararirizi babera maso ubusa.
Muvyukira kare ubusa mukaryama mutevye, mucumukura ngo muronke ivyokurya; kuko abo ikunda ibibahera mw’itiro.
Abana ni umugabane uva k’ Uhoraho , uruvyaro ni impera atanga.
Nk’uko imyampi imera mu kuboko kw’umuhizi ni ko n’abana bo mu buto bamera.
Hahiriwe umuntu yujuje umutana wiwe imyampi nk’iyo. Ntibazomaramara nibahangana n’abababuranya mu bucamanza.
Hahiriwe uwubaha Uhoraho wese, akagenda mu nzira ziwe.
Uzorya ivyo ubutame bwawe bwamye; imigisha n’amahirwe bizoba ivyawe.
Umugore wawe azoba nk’umuzabibu wama cane mu nzu yawe; abana bawe bazoba nk’utugemwe twa elayo bakikuje imeza yawe.
Egome, uwo ni wo uzoba umugisha w’umuntu yubaha Uhoraho .
Uhoraho aguhe umugisha uva i Siyoni; uze ubone amahirwe ya Yerusalemu mu misi yose y’ukubaho kwawe.
Uze urambe kugira ngo wibonere abuzukuru bawe; amahoro abe kuri Isirayeli.
"Barangwanije cane kuva nkiri muto." Abisirayeli nibavuge batyo:
"Barangwanije cane kuva mu buto bwanje, ariko ntibanesheje.
Abarimyi barimye ku mugongo wanje bahaciye imirongo miremire.
Ariko Uhoraho aragororotse; yacagaguye imigozi y’abanyakibi."
Icompa abanka Siyoni bose bagasubira inyuma bamaramaye.
Icompa bakamera nk’ivyatsi vyameze ku nzu, vyuma bitarakura;
umwimbuzi ntashobora kuvyuzuza ibiganza vyiwe, canke uwegeranya ngo aronke ivyo guteruza amaboko;
Icompa ababarengana ntibababwire bati: "Umugisha w’ Uhoraho ubane na we; tubahezagiye mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho ."
Uhoraho ndagutakambira, bivuye i bwina;
Niwumve ijwi ryanje, ewe Mana. Utege amatwi ukwinginga kwanje.
Iyaba wama wibuka ivyaha, ewe Uhoraho , ni nde yohagarara?
Ariko ufise uguharira hafi yawe, kugira ngo dushobore kugukorera, tukwubashe.
Niteze Uhoraho , ubugingo bwanje bwose buramwiteze kandi ivyizigiro vyanje biri kw’ijambo ryiwe.
Niteze Imana kurusha uko abararirizi barindira ko buca, kurusha uko abararirizi barorera ko buca.
Ewe Isirayeli, niwizigire Uhoraho , kuko hafi yiwe ari ho urukundo rudashira ruri n’ugucungurwa gushitse.
Ni we ubwiwe azokwicungurira Abisirayeli abakure mu vyaha vyabo.
Umutima wanje ntiwishira hejuru, Uhoraho , amaso yanje ntiyibona; sinivanga n’ibintu vyo hejuru canke ibintu bindengeye.
Ariko naratekereje ndacereza, meze nk’umwana acutse ari i ruhande ya nyina; nk’umwana acutse uko ni ko ntekereje.
Ewe Isirayeli, niwizigire Uhoraho uhereye none kugeza ibihe vyose.
Uhoraho , niwibuke Dawidi n’amarushwa yiwe yose.
Yarahiye Uhoraho indahiro, yasezeraniye Inyenkomezi ya Yakobo ati:
"Sinzokwinjira mu nzu yanje canke ngo nurire uburiri bwanje,
sinzokwemerera amaso yanje gusinzira canke ingohe zanje guhunyiza,
kugeza aho nzoronkera Uhoraho ikibanza, inzu y’Inyenkomezi ya Yakobo."
Twavyumviye muri Efurata, twabisanze mu gahinga k’i Yayari ngo:
"Nimuze tuje mu ngoro yiwe, nimuze dusengere ku ndava yiwe, tuti:
‘Haguruka, ewe Uhoraho , uze mu buruhukiro bwawe, wewe n’Isandugu ari co ki kimenyetso c’inkomezi zawe.
Abaherezi bawe nibambare ukugororoka kwawe, abizigirwa bawe bavuze impundu.’ "
Ku bwa Dawidi umusavyi wawe, ntushiburire kure uwo warobanuje amavuta.
Uhoraho yarahiye Dawidi indahiro, ni iy’ukuri ntazokwisubirako ngo: "Umwe wo mu ruvyaro rwawe nzomwimika ku ntebe yawe y’ubwami.
Abana bawe nibagumya isezerano ryanje n’ivyo nashinze nkabibigisha, nuko abana babo bazokwicara ku ntebe yawe y’ubwami ibihe vyose."
Kuko Uhoraho yatoranije Siyoni, yavyipfuje ari iwe avuga ati:
"Aha ni ahantu hanje ho kuruhukira ibihe n’ibihe; aha ni ho nzovyagira nganze, kuko navyipfuje;
Nzohaha umugisha w’ibintu, abakene baho bazohazwa ivyokurya.
Nzokwambika abaherezi baho agakiza, n’abizigirwa baho bazokwama bavuza impundu!
Aha ni ho nzotuma ihembe rya Dawidi rikura kandi nzodomeka itara ry’uwo narobanuje amavuta.
Nzotuma abansi biwe bamaramara, ariko umutwe wiwe uzosharizwa n’urugori rukayangana."
Ese ingene ari vyiza kandi bihimbaye iyo abantu b’Imana babana mu bumwe!
Bimeze nk’amavuta y’igiciro kinini asutswe ku mutwe, agatembera ku bwanwa, agatembera ku bwanwa bwa Aroni, no ku buyonga bw’ikanzu yiwe.
Ni nk’ikime co ku musozi Herumoni gitembera ku musozi Siyoni. Kuko aho ni ho Uhoraho asuka umugisha wiwe, mbere n’ubugingo kugeza ibihe vyose.
Nimuhimbaze Uhoraho , yemwe basavyi b’ Uhoraho mwese, mwebwe mukorera mu nzu y’ Uhoraho mugakesha ijoro.
Nimutarike ibiganza vyanyu hejuru muri mu Ngoro, muhimbaze Uhoraho .
Uhoraho aguhezagire ari i Siyoni, ni we Muremyi w’ijuru n’isi.
Himbaza Uhoraho . Nimuhimbaze izina ry’ Uhoraho ; mumuhimbaze, yemwe basavyi biwe,
mwebwe mukorera mu nzu y’ Uhoraho , mu birimba vy’Ingoro y’Imana yanyu.
Nimuhimbaze Uhoraho , kuko Uhoraho ari mwiza; muririmbe mushima izina ryiwe, kuko ari vyo bihimbaye.
Kuko Uhoraho yatoranije Yakobo ngo abe uwiwe, Isirayeli ngo amubere inyegu yiwe.
Ndazi ko Uhoraho ahambaye, ko umwami wacu ahambaye asumba ibigirwamana vyose.
Uhoraho akora ibimuhimbaye vyose, mw’ijuru no mw’isi, mu biyaga no mw’idamba ryavyo.
Atuma ibicu biva ku mpera z’isi; atuma umuravyo n’imvura agasohora umuyaga awukuye mu bubiko bwawo.
Yishe imfura zo muri Egiputa, imfura zo mu bantu n’ibikoko.
Yarungitse ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza hagati muri mwebwe, muri Egiputa, kugwanya Farawo n’abasavyi biwe.
Yatsinze hasi amahanga yica abami bahambaye;
Sihoni umwami w’Abamori, Ogi umwami w’i Bashani, n’abami bose b’i Kanani;
maze atanga igihugu cabo ngo kibe umugabane, umugabane w’abantu biwe ba Isirayeli.
Izina ryawe, Uhoraho ryamaho ibihe vyose, no kuba rurangiranwa kwawe, ewe Uhoraho , uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi.
Kuko Uhoraho azocira iziroranye abantu biwe agirire akagongwe abasavyi biwe.
Ibigirwamana vy’amahanga ni ifeza n’inzahabu, vyakozwe n’intoke z’abantu.
Bifise akanwa, ariko ntibivuga, bifise amaso, ariko ntibibona.
Bifise amatwi, ariko ntivyumva, kandi nta mpwemu ziri mu kanwa kavyo.
Ababicura bazomera nka vyo, co kimwe n’abavyizigira bose.
Yemwe Bisirayeli mwese nimuhimbaze Uhoraho ; ab’inzu ya Aroni, nimuhimbaze Uhoraho ;
Ab’inzu ya Lewi, nimuhimbaze Uhoraho ; abamwubaha mwese, nimuhimbaze Uhoraho .
Uhoraho ahimbarizwe i Siyoni, Uhoraho aba i Yerusalemu. Himbaza Uhoraho .
Nimushimire Uhoraho , kuko ari mwiza. Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Nimushimire Uhoraho aganza imana zose. Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Nimushimire Umwami aganza abami: Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Ni we wenyene akora ibitangaza, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Ni we yaremesheje amajuru ubwenge, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Uwashanje isi hejuru y’amazi, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Uwaremye ivyaka binini, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Izuba ryo kuganza umurango, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Ukwezi n’inyenyeri vyo kuganza ijoro, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Uwahoneje imfura zo muri Egiputa, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Agakura Isirayeli muri bo, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Abakujeyo ukuboko kw’inkomezi kuramvuye, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Yagabuyemwo kabiri Ikiyaga Gitukura, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Agacisha Isirayeli hagati muri co, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Ariko agatsinda Farawo n’ingabo ziwe mu Kiyaga Gitukura, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Ni we yarongoye abantu biwe mu bugaragwa, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Ni we yatsinze hasi abami bahambaye, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Akica abami bakomeye, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Sihoni umwami w’Abamori, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Na Ogi umwami w’i Bashani, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Agatanga igihugu cabo ngo kibe iragi, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Iragi ry’umusavyi wiwe Isirayeli, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Yaratwibutse igihe twari dusuzuguritse, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Adukiza abansi bacu, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Agaburira ivyaremwe vyose, Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Nimushime Imana yo mw’ijuru. Urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe bidashira.
Ku nzuzi z’i Babiloni ni ho twicara tukarira twibutse Siyoni.
Ku biti vy’imilebeni vyaho ni ho twamanika inanga zacu,
kuko aho ni ho abatujanye nk’inyagano badusabira kubaririmbira, abatugaraguza agati badusaba indirimbo z’umunezero; bavuga bati: "Nimuturirimbire imwe mu ndirimbo z’i Siyoni!"
Twoshobora gute kuririmba indirimbo z’ Uhoraho turi mu gihugu c’ikinyamahanga?
Yerusalemu, ninakwibagira, ukuryo kwanje kwibagire gucuraranga.
Ururimi rwanje rufatane n’amagage nintakwibuka, nintiyumvira kuri Yerusalemu ibihimbaro vyanje.
Uhoraho , niwibuke ivyo Abanyedomu bakoze ku musi Yerusalemu hasambuka. Basemerera ngo: "Hasambure, samburira hasi amatanguriro yaho!"
Mukobwa w’i Babiloni, uzosamburwa, hahiriwe uwukwishura ibihwanye n’ivyo wadukoreye.
Hahiriwe uwufata inzoya zawe akazihonda ku bitandara.
Uhoraho , nzoguhimbaza n’umutima wanje wose; imbere "y’ibigirwamana" nzokuririmbira ishimwe.
Nzokwunama ntumbereye Ingoro yawe yera, maze mpimbaze izina ryawe kubera urukundo rwawe rudashira n’ukwizigirwa kwawe, kuko washize hejuru izina ryawe n’ijambo ryawe ubirutisha ibindi bintu vyose.
Igihe nahamagara, waranyishuye; maze urandemesha mu kunyongera inkomezi.
Abami bose bo kw’isi nibaguhimbaze, Uhoraho , nibumva ivyo washinze.
Baze baririmbe ivy’inzira z’ Uhoraho , kuko icubahiro c’ Uhoraho gihambaye.
Naho Uhoraho ashizwe hejuru, ararabana ubugwaneza abaciye bugufi; naho ari uwuhambaye, ababonera kure.
Naho ngendera hagati y’amarushwa, uzigama ubugingo bwanje; uramvurira ukuboko kwawe kugwanya abangwanya; unkirisha ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo.
Uhoraho azoshitsa ivyo yasezeranye ku bugingo bwanje; urukundo rwawe, Uhoraho , rwamaho ibihe vyose; ntuhebe ibikorwa vy’intoke zawe.
Uhoraho we, waransuzumye, ugirako uramenya.
Urazi iyicara ryanje n’iva hasi ryanje; umenyera kure ivyo niyumvira.
Umenya iyo ngendagenda n’iyo ndyamye; umenyereye inzira zanje zose.
Ijambo ritarashika ku rurimi rwanje wewe, Uhoraho , uba warimenye ido n’ido.
Unkikuje imbere n’inyuma, kandi unshizeko ikiganza cawe.
Ukumenya bene uko ni igitangaza kuri jewe, gushika kure aho ntoshika.
Mbega Mpwemu wawe nomuhungira hehe? Noja he ngo mpunge mu nyonga hawe?
Noja mw’ijuru, ni ho uri; nokwubaka uburiri bwanje i bwina, ni yo uri.
Nova hasi nkaja ku mababa y’umutwenzi, noja kuba hirya kure hakurya y’ikiyaga,
naho nyene ikiganza cawe cohandongorera, ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo kwoncakira.
Novuga nti: "Ni ukuri umwijima ugiye kumpisha n’umuco uhinduke ijoro ahankikuje,"
n’umwijima na wo nyene ntiwoba umwijima kuri wewe; ijoro rizokayangana nk’umurango, umwijima na wo ni nk’umuco kuri wewe.
Kuko ari wewe waremye ibimbamwo vyose; wanteranirije mu nda ya mama;
Ndaguhimbaza kuko naremwe mu buryo buteye ubwoba kandi butangaje; ivyo ukora biratangaje, ivyo ndabizi neza.
Igikankara canje nticari gihishijwe inyonga zawe igihe naremerwa mw’ibanga, igihe nateranirizwa i bwina mw’isi.
Amaso yawe yarabona umubiri wanje ukiri amazi; imisi wanshingiye yari yanditswe mu gitabu cawe imbere yuko habaho n’umwe.
Ese ukungene ivyiyumviro vyawe ari ivy’igiciro, ewe Mana! Ese ukungene ari vyinshi!
Nobiharura, vyoruta umusenyi; iyo nikanguye, nsanga nkiri kumwe na we.
Ese icompa akaba ari wewe wenyene, ewe Mana, wica abanyakibi! Mva i ruhande mwa binywamaraso mwe!
Bakuvugako ibibi; abansi bawe bakoresha nabi izina ryawe.
Mbega sinanka abakwanka, ga yewe Uhoraho , kandi sinkengera abakugarariza?
Nta kindi mfise atari urwanko ndabanka; ndababona nk’abansi banje.
Nsesa, ewe Mana, umenye umutima wanje; ungeze umenye ivyiyumviro vyanje.
Raba ko hoba hari inzira y’icaha iri muri jewe, kugira ngo undongorere mu nzira y’ibihe bidashira.
Ntabara, Uhoraho , unkize inkozi z’ibibi; undinde abanyamuryano,
bagira imigambi mibi mu mitima yabo bakavyura intambara imisi yose.
Indimi zabo bazisongora nk’iz’inzoka; ubumara bw’inzoka buri mu kanwa kabo.
Uhoraho , undinde amaboko y’abanyakibi; undinde abanyamuryano, bagira imigabo yo kuntsinda hasi.
Abibone banteze umutego wo mu mpisho; bamaze gutega insenga zabo no gushinga imitego yabo mu nzira ncamwo.
Ndabwira Uhoraho nti: "Uri Imana yanje." Uhoraho , niwumve ugutakamba kwanje.
Uhoraho Nyeninganji, mutabazi wanje w’inkomezi, wambika inkinzo umutwe wanje ku musi w’intambara.
Uhoraho , ntuhe abanyakibi ivyo bipfuza; ntureke ngo imigambi yabo ishirwe mu ngiro.
Abankikuje bazunguza imitwe yabo mu bwibone; amajambo mabi y’akanwa kabo abasubire ku mitwe.
Amakara yaka asukwe ku mitwe yabo; nibatererwe mu muriro, batererwe mu vyobo vy’amazi, ntibigere bavayo.
Abavuga abandi nabi ntibagume mu gihugu; ivyago nibihige abantu b’umuryano.
Ndazi ko Uhoraho aburanira abakene agakiranira aboro.
Ni ukuri abagororotsi bazohimbaza izina ryawe, kandi abatunganye bazoba mu nyonga zawe.
Uhoraho , ndagutakambiye, tebuka uze aho ndi; unyumve ninagutakambira.
Ugusenga kwanje nigushike imbere yawe nk’umubavu; ugutarika amaboko kwanje kube nk’ikimazi co ku mugoroba.
Ushire umurinzi ku munwa wanje, Uhoraho ; ugume uteramye ku rugi rw’iminwa yanje.
Ntureke umutima wanje ngo uje mu bibi ngo nifatanye n’inkozi z’ibibi mu bikorwa bibi; ntundeke ngo nsangire na bo ivyo bakunda kurya.

Reka umugororotsi aze ankubite; kuko azoba ariko arangirira neza; aze ampane; kuzoba ari ukunsiga amavuta ku mutwe. Umutwe wanje ntuzovyanka, kuko isengesho ryanje rizokwama rigwanya ibikorwa vy’inkozi z’ibibi.
Abaganza babo nibatembagarizwe ku bitandara, maze abanyakibi ni ho bazomenya ko amajambo yanje yari ay’ukuri.
Bazovuga bati: "nk’uko umuntu arima agashitsa isuka, ni ko amagufa yacu yasanzariye ku munwa w’imva."
Ariko amaso yanje ndayahanze wewe, Uhoraho Nyeninganji; muri wewe ni ho mpungiye; ntundeke ngo mpfe.
Undinde kugwa mu mitego yatezwe n’inkozi z’ibibi, mu mitego bateze imbere yanje.
Abanyakibi nibagwe mu mitego bateze ubwabo, nanje ndengane mu mahoro.
Ndatakambira Uhoraho n’ijwi rirenga; nzoshira ijwi hejuru ntakambira Uhoraho .
Ndasuka amajojwa yanje imbere yiwe; ndavuga ivyago vyanje imbere yiwe.
Iyo impwemu yanje icikiye intege muri jewe, ni wewe urinda inzira yanje. Mu nzira ngenderamwo abantu banteze umutego.
Birabe ubibone, nta n’umwe ari i buryo bwanje; nta n’umwe anyitayeho. Singira ubuhungiro; nta n’umwe yitayeho ubugingo bwanje.
Ndagutakambiye, Uhoraho ; ndavuga nti: "Uri ubuhungiro bwanje, umugabane wanje mw’isi y’abazima."
Niwumve ugutakamba kwanje, kuko ngowe cane; ntabara unkize abampiga, kuko bandusha inkomezi.
Umbohore unkure mw’ibohero ndimwo, kugira ngo mpimbaze izina ryawe. Maze abagororotsi bazokoranira aho ndi, kuko unyeretse ukugira neza kwawe.
Uhoraho , niwumve ugusenga kwanje, wumvirize ugutakamba kwanje; mu bwizigirwa bwawe no mu kugororoka kwawe nuze untabare.
Ntujane umushumba wawe imbere y’intahe, kuko ata n’umwe mu bakiri bazima agororotse imbere yawe.
Umwansi arampiga, antsinze hasi; atumye mba ahantu h’umwijima nk’abapfuye kera.
Ni co gitumye impwemu yanje impondobereramwo; umutima wanje ukaba wiheburiye muri jewe.
Ndibuka imisi ya kera; ndimbura ibikorwa vyawe vyose nkiyumvira ku vyakozwe n’intoke zawe.
Ndakugaranzurira amaboko; ndakunyotewe nk’uko isi igadutse inyotererwa amazi.
Uhoraho unyishure vuba; umushaha wanje ucitse intege. Ntumpishe mu nyonga hawe kuko noca mba nk’abamanuka baja muri rwa rwobo.
Igitondo nikinzanire ijambo ry’urukundo rwawe rudashira, kuko nakwizigiye. Nyereka inzira nkwiye kujana, kuko ubugingo bwanje ari wewe nabujeje.
Ntabara unkize abansi banje, Uhoraho , kuko muri wewe ari ho ninyegeje.
Nyigisha gukora ivyo ugomba, kuko uri Imana yanje; icompa Mpwemu wawe mwiza akandongorera ahantu hagororotse.
Ku bw’izina ryawe, Uhoraho , kingira ubugingo bwanje; mu kugororoka kwawe, nkura mu vyago.
Mu rukundo rwawe rudashira, ziba akanwa k’abansi banje; honya abangwanya, kuko ndi umusavyi wawe.
Uhoraho igitandara canje ahimbazwe, yigisha amaboko yanje kugwana, n’intoke zanje kuja mu ntambara.
Ni Imana yanje y’urukundo n’igihome kinkingira, umunara nihishamwo n’umurokozi wanje, inkinzo yanje, uwo mpungirako, acisha bugufi amoko musi y’ibirenge vyanje.
Uhoraho , abantu ni iki aho ubitwararika, canke abana b’abantu aho ubiyumvirako?
Bameze nk’impwemu zihumetswe; imisi yabo ni nk’igitutu kirengana gusa.
Uhoraho , ugurura ijuru ryawe, umanuke kw’isi; kora ku misozi, kugira ngo ipfunduke umwotsi.
Rungika umuravyo usanzaze umwansi; rasa imyampi yawe ubasanzaze.
Ramvura ukuboko kwawe uri iyo mw’ijuru; untabare undokore unkize amazi asuriranya, unkure mu kuboko kw’abanyamahanga;
akanwa kabo kuzuye ibinyoma, amaboko yabo y’i buryo arimwo ivy’ubugunge.
Mana yanje, nzokuririmbira indirimbo nsha, nzogucurarangira inanga y’imirya cumi,
wewe uha abami intsinzi, ugakiza umusavyi wawe Dawidi inkota yica.
Ndokora untabare; unkure mu maboko y’abanyamahanga akanwa kabo kuzuye ibinyoma, amaboko yabo y’i buryo ni ingunge.
Maze abahungu bacu, mu buto bwabo, bazomera nk’imivyaro yatabiwe neza, abakobwa bacu na bo bazoba nk’inkingi zabarijwe gushariza ikirimba.
Ibigega vyacu bizokwuzura ivyimburwa vy’ubwoko bwose. Intama zacu zizogwira incuro ibihumbi, incuro ibihumbi cumi ziri ku misozi yacu;
inka zacu zizokwega imitwaro iremereye. Nta birengero bizoba mu mpome zacu, nta bazojanwa nk’inyagano, nta bazoniha bari mu mayira yacu.
Hahiriwe ihanga ibi bizoshikako; hahiriwe ihanga rifise Uhoraho nk’Imana yaryo.
Nzogushira hejuru, Mana yanje, wewe Mwami; nzohimbaza izina ryawe ibihe bidashira.
Imisi yose nzoguhimbaza nshire hejuru izina ryawe ibihe n’ibihe.
Uhoraho arahambaye kandi abereye gushimwa; nta n’umwe yomenya ubukuru bwiwe.
Urunganwe rubwira urundi ivyiza wakoze; bavuga ivy’inkomezi wakoze.
Bavuga ugukayangana kw’ubwiza bw’icubahiro cawe; nanje nzorimbura ibikorwa vyawe bitangaje wakoze.
Bavuga ivy’ubushobozi bw’ibihambaye wakoze; nanje nzokwamamaza ibikorwa vyawe bihambaye.
Bazohimbaza ukugira neza kwawe kwinshi, baririmbane umunezero ivy’ukugororoka kwawe.
Uhoraho agira impuhwe n’ubuntu, ateba kuraka akagira urukundo rwinshi.
Uhoraho agirira bose neza; agirira imbabazi ivyo yaremye vyose.
Uhoraho , ibikorwa vyawe vyose biraguhimbaza; abizigirwa bawe bagushira hejuru.
Bavuga icubahiro c’ubwami bwawe kandi bavuga ivy’inkomezi wakoze,
kugira ngo abantu bose bamenye ibikorwa vyawe bihambaye n’ugukayangana kw’ubwiza bw’ubwami bwawe.
Ubwami bwawe ntibuzogira iherezo, n’ukuganza kwawe guhoraho uko urunganwe ruzokuranwa n’urundi. Uhoraho ni uwo kwizigirwa mu vyo asezerana vyose kandi ni umwizigirwa mu vyo akora vyose.
Uhoraho ashigikira abaguye, akavyura abacishijwe bugufi.
Bose baguhanga amaso, nawe ukabahaza ivyokurya mu gihe gikwiye.
Upfundurura ikiganza cawe ugahaza ukwipfuza kw’ibiri n’ubuzima vyose.
Uhoraho aragororotse mu nzira ziwe zose kandi ni umwizigirwa mu vyo akora vyose.
Uhoraho aba hafi y’abamwambaza bose, abamwambaza mu kuri bose.
Ashitsa ivyo abamwubaha bipfuza; yumva ugutakamba kwabo maze akabakiza.
Uhoraho azigama abamukunda bose, ariko abanyakibi azobahonya.
Akanwa kanje kazovuga ivyo guhimbaza Uhoraho . Ivyaremwe vyose nibihimbaze izina ryiwe ryera ibihe bitazoshira.
Haleluya. Mutima wanje, himbaza Uhoraho .
Nzohimbaza Uhoraho ubuzima bwanje bwose; nzoririmba izo guhimbaza Imana yanje nkiriho.
Ntimukishimire abahambaye, canke abana b’abantu, badashobora gukiza.
Iyo impwemu yabo ibavuyemwo, basubira mw’ivu, kuri uwo musi nyene imigambi yabo igahinduka ubusa.
Hahiriwe abahungira ku Mana ya Yakobo, ivyizigiro vyabo bikaba k’ Uhoraho Imana yabo.
Ni we yaremye ijuru n’isi, ikiyaga n’ibiri muri vyo vyose; aguma ari umwizigirwa ibihe bidashira.
Ni we aburanira abacinyizwa akagaburira abashonje. Uhoraho ni we abohora imbohe,
Uhoraho ni we ahumura impumyi, Uhoraho ni we ashira hejuru abaciye bugufi, Uhoraho ni we akunda abagororotsi.
Uhoraho azigama inyambukira agashigikira impfuvyi n’umupfakazi, ariko inzira z’abanyakibi arazigoramika.
Uhoraho aganje ibihe bidashira, Imana yawe, ewe Siyoni, iraganje uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi. Haleluya.
Haleluya. Ese ukuntu ari vyiza guhimbaza Imana yacu, ese ukuntu bihimbaye kandi bibereye kuyihimbaza!
Uhoraho yubaka Yerusalemu; yegeranya aba Isirayeli bari barashwiragiye.
Akiza abafise imitima imenetse agapfuka inguma zabo.
Aharura igitigiri c’inyenyeri agahamagara imwimwe yose mw’izina.
Umwami wacu arahambaye kandi ni umuhizi mu nkomezi: ugutahura kwiwe ntikugira akarimbi.
Uhoraho ashigikira abaciye bugufi agacisha bugufi abanyakibi akabashitsa hasi.
Nimuririmbire Uhoraho indirimbo yo gushima; nimucurarangire inanga Imana yacu.
Apfukisha ijuru ibicu; agaha isi imvura akameza ivyatsi ku turambi.
Ategurira amasho ivyokurya n’ivyana vy’ibikona iyo bijwiragiye.
Ntahimbarwa n’inkomezi z’ifarasi, canke ngo yishimire amaguru y’umuhizi;
Uhoraho ahimbarwa n’abamwubaha, abishimira urukundo rwiwe rudashira.
Nushime Uhoraho , ewe Yerusalemu; uhimbaze Imana yawe, ewe Siyoni.
Ni we akomeza imyugariro yawe agaha umugisha abantu baba muri wewe.
Atanga impore ku mbibe zawe, akaguhaza ingano nziza cane.
Atuma amabwirizwa yiwe kw’isi, ijambo ryiwe rikagenda rinyaruka.
Akwiragiza shelegi nk’ubwoya bw’intama, ugukanya akagusanzaza nk’umunyota.
Arekura urubura rwiwe nk’amabuye. Ni nde yoshobora kurinda imbeho yiwe?
Atuma ijambo ryiwe ngo riyashongeshe; atuma umuyaga wiwe, amazi agashonga.
Yahishuriye Yakobo ijambo ryiwe, ivyagezwe vyiwe n’amategeko yiwe yabihishuriye Isirayeli.
Nta rindi hanga na rimwe yakoreye nk’ivyo; ntibazi ivyagezwe vyiwe. Haleluya.
Haleluya. Nimuhimbarize Uhoraho iyo mw’ijuru; mumuhimbarize ahasumba amajuru.
Mumuhimbaze, yemwe bamarayika biwe; mumuhimbaze, namwe nyenyeri zo kw’ijuru.
Nimumuhimbaze, zuba n’ukwezi; mumuhimbaze yemwe nyenyeri zaka mwese.
Nimumuhimbaze, yemwe majuru asumba ayandi namwe mazi yo hejuru.
Abo nibahimbaze izina ry’ Uhoraho , kuko yategetse bikabaho,
kandi yabishingiye aho kuba ibihe bidashira; yashinze itegeko ritazokwigera rivaho.
Nimuhimbaze Uhoraho mw’isi, yemwe vyaremwe bininibinini vyo mu kiyaga namwe madamba y’ibiyaga,
miravyo, rubura, shelegi namwe bicu, mwa bihuhusi mwumvira itegeko ryiwe,
yemwe misozi n’uturambi twose, biti vyama n’amasederi yose,
bikoko vyo mw’ishamba n’amasho yose, ivyaremwe bitobito n’inyoni zo mu kirere,
bami bo kw’isi n’amahanga yose, yemwe baganwa n’abatware bose bo kw’isi,
yemwe basore n’inkumi, batama namwe bana.
Abo nibahimbaze izina ry’ Uhoraho , kuko izina ryiwe ryo nyene ari ryo rishizwe hejuru; icubahiro ciwe kiri hejuru y’isi n’ijuru.
Kandi yahagurukirije ihembe abantu biwe, ishimwe ry’abasavyi biwe bose bizigirwa, rya Isirayeli, ihanga riri ku mutima wiwe. Haleluya.
Haleluya. Nimuririmbire Uhoraho indirimbo nsha, mumuririmbire ishimwe mw’ikoraniro ry’abera biwe.
Isirayeli nibanezerererwe Umuremyi wabo; ab’i Siyoni nibanezerererwe Umwami wabo.
Nibahimbaze izina ryiwe batamba bamuvugirize umurya w’inanga n’umurisho w’ingoma.
Kuko Uhoraho ahimbarirwa abantu biwe; yambika abaciye bugufi ukunesha nk’igitsibo.
Abera biwe nibanezererwe icubahiro ciwe bamuvugirize impundu bari ku mariri yabo.
Uguhimbaza Imana kube mu kanwa kabo bafise inkota y’ubugi bubiri mu ntoke,
kugira ngo bihore amahanga bahane amoko,
bongere baboheshe iminyororo abami bayo, abaganwa bayo bababoheshe imigozi y’ivyuma,
maze bashitse urubanza bandikiwe ko bazohanwa; ico ni co cubahiro c’abera biwe. Haleluya.
Haleluya. Nimuhimbarize Imana ahera hayo; muyihimbarize no mu majuru yayo yuzuye inkomezi.
Nimuyihimbarize ivy’inkomezi yakoze; muyimbarize ubukuru bwayo buhambaye.
Nimuyihimbarishe ijwi rirengera ry’inzamba, muyishimishe inanga n’ikembe,
muyihimbarishe umurisho w’ingoma n’imvyino, muyihimbarishe imirya y’inanga n’umwironge,
muyihimbaze muvuza ivyuma bisamirana. Muyihimbarishe ijwi rirengera ry’ivyuma bisamirana.
Ibihumeka vyose nibihimbaze Uhoraho . Haleluya.

name: Imigani
chapters: Iyi ni imigani ya Salomo, mwene Dawidi, umwami wa Isirayeli.
Intumbero y’iyi migani ni ukwigisha abantu ubwenge no kubatoza indero, no kubafasha gutahura amajambo y’ubwenge.
Yigisha abantu kugira ubwenge bwo kuroranya ibintu mu buzima, bagakora ibigororotse, ibitunganye n’ibibereye.
Iyo migani yigisha ubwenge abazi bike, abakiri bato ikabaha ubumenyi bwo guserangura.
Umunyabwenge niyumve iyi migani, yongereze ubumenyi, uwufise ubuseranguzi aronke ukurongorwa,
kugira ngo atahure iyi myibutsa n’iyi migani, amajambo y’abanyabwenge n’amabanga yayo.
Ukwubaha Uhoraho ni kwo tanguriro ry’ubwenge, ariko ibipfu bikengera ubwenge n’ugutozwa indero.
Mwana wanje, wumvire ico so akubwira, kandi ntukanke ico nyoko akwigisha.
Bizokubera urugori rw’ubuntu ku mutwe, n’umugufu ushariza izosi.
Mwana wanje, abanyavyaha nibakwosha, ntukabumvire.
Nibakubwira bati: "Ingo tujane; tuje gusesa amaraso, dutege umutego abatagira icaha;
ingo tubamire ari bazima, nk’uko imva imira abantu, tubamire bose nk’abaja muri rwa rwobo rw’urupfu;
ni ho tuzoronka ivyiza vyinshi, amazu yacu tuyuzuze ivyo tunyaze;
ingo nawe uzoronka umugabane wawe, tuzogabura ivyo tuzoronka vyose."
Mwana wanje, ntuze wifatanye na bo, ntuze utumbereze ibirenge vyawe mu nzira zabo;
kuko birukira gukora ivyaha, bakihutira gusesa amaraso.
Gutega umutego inyoni zikubona ni ukwiruhiriza ubusa.
Abo bantu bazohitanwa n’umutego bateze; bicwe n’ivyo bateze abandi.
Iryo ni ryo herezo ry’abirukira inyungu mbi, izo nyungu mbi ni zo zihitana ubuzima bwabo.
Bwenge asemerera ari mu nzira, akaduza ijwi mu bibanza abantu bakoraniramwo.
Asemerera ari mu mayirabiri yuzuye urwamo, akavugira amajambo yiwe ku marembo y’igisagara ati:
"Yemwe banyabwengebuke mwe; muzogeza ryari kudakunda ubwenge? Namwe bacokoranyi, muzogeza ryari kunezerererwa ubucokoranyi? Namwe bipfu, muzogeza ryari kwanka ubumenyi?
Nimuze mwumvirize ukwihaniza kwanje, ndababwire ikiri ku mutima wanje, maze ntume muba abanyabwenge.
Ariko narabahamagaye muranka, ndabatega ibiganza ariko ntihagira n’umwe avyitaho.
Mwirengagije impanuro zanje, ntimwemera ukugabisha kwanje.
Nanje nzobatwenga nimwagwa mu vyago; nzokwitwengera nimwashikirwa n’amakuba,
ubwoba nibwabazako nk’igihuhusi, amakuba akabagwako kurya kw’agashururu, imibabaro n’agahinda bikabahwikira.
Maze abo bazompamagara ariko sinzobitaba; bazondonderana umwete ariko ntibazombona,
kuko banse ubumenyi, ntibahitamwo kwubaha Uhoraho .
Ko banse impanuro zanje, bakagaya ukugabisha kwanje,
bazorya ivyamwa vy’ingeso zabo, bahazwe n’ivyamwa vy’inama zabo.
Kuko ubunebwe bw’abanebwe ni bwo bubica, kandi ukuba sindabibazwa kw’ibipfu ni kwo kubirandura.
Ariko abanyumvira bose bazobaho amahoro, bagubwe neza, ata cago batinya."
Mwana wanje, niwakira amajambo yanje, ukazigama ivyo ndakwihanikiriza,
ugatega ugutwi amajambo y’ubwenge, ugashira umutima wawe ku gutahura,
ugahamagara ubwenge, ukaririra ugutahura,
ukabirondera nk’uwurondera ifeza canke ubutunzi buhishijwe,
ico gihe uzomenya kwubaha Uhoraho ico ari co, kandi uzogira ugutahura kuvuye ku Mana.
Kuko Uhoraho ni we atanga ubwenge, kandi mu kanwa kiwe ni ho hava ubumenyi n’ugutahura.
Ni we afise intsinzi y’abagororotsi mu bubiko bwiwe, kandi ni we nkinzo y’abagenda batunganye.
Ni we azigama inzira z’abagororotsi, agakingira abamwizigiye.
Aho ni ho uzomenya ibigororotse, ibitunganye hamwe n’ibibereye, umenye n’inzira zibereye,
kuko ubwenge buzokwinjira mu mutima wawe, maze ubumenyi bube umunezero w’umushaha wawe.
Guhitamwo neza kuzoba umurinzi wawe, kandi ugutahura kuzokuzigama.
Ubwenge buzokurinda kugendera mu nzira z’ababi, bukurinde n’abavuga amajambo y’ubupfu.
Abo bata inzira zigororotse, bakagendera mu nzira z’umwijima.
Bahimbarwa no gukora ikibi, bagahimbarirwa ubuhumane bwabo.
Iminyuro yabo iragoramanze, kandi inzira bajana zirabazimiza.
Ubwenge buzokurinda umugore w’umusambanyikazi, bukurinde n’amajambo asosa y’umugore w’umunyangesombi,
yataye umugabo wo mu buto bwiwe akava mw’isezerano yagize imbere y’Imana.
Kwinjira inzu yiwe bijana mu rupfu, ni inzira ijana i kuzimu mu mva.
Nta wuja iwe ngo agaruke, canke ngo yongere asubire mu nzira y’ubuzima.
Ahubwo ugendere mu nzira y’abantu b’intungane, ugume mu nzira y’abagororotsi.
Kuko abagororotsi ni bo bazoba mu gihugu kandi inyankamugayo ni zo zizokigumamwo.
Ariko abanyakibi bazogikurwamwo, abahemu na bo bakirandurwemwo.
Mwana wanje, ntuze wibagire ivyo nakwigishije, ahubwo uzigame amabwirizwa yanje mu mutima wawe.
Ivyo niwabikora, bizokwongera imyaka yo kubaho, kandi ubuzima bwawe buzororanirwa.
Urukundo n’ubwizigirwa bize vyamane nawe, uze uvyambare mw’izosi, uvyandike mu mutima wawe.
Ni ho uzogira ikiganza ciza n’izina ryiza imbere y’Imana n’abantu.
Wizigire Uhoraho n’umutima wawe wose, ntiwishimire ugutahura kwawe.
Wame urondera ugushaka kwiwe mu vyo ukora vyose, na we azogorora inzira zawe.
Ntiwishimire ubwenge bwawe, ahubwo wubahe Uhoraho kandi uve mu kibi.
Ivyo bizotuma umubiri wawe ugira amagara meza, bitume n’amagufa yawe yoroherwa.
Wubahishe Uhoraho ubutunzi bwawe, hamwe n’ivya mbere vyo mu vyeze mu mirima yawe.
Na we azosesekaza umwimbu mu bigega vyawe, amato yawe yame asesekaye umuvinyu.
Mwana wanje, ntukagaye uguhana kw’ Uhoraho , kandi ntukanke ukugabisha kwiwe;
kuko Uhoraho agabisha abo akunda, kurya umuvyeyi abikorera umwana akunda.
Hahiriwe umuntu yironkeye ubwenge, akironkera ugutahura.
Kuko ubwenge busumvya agaciro ifeza, kandi ivyamwa vyabwo birusha agaciro inzahabu.
Ubwenge burusha agaciro akabuye kitwa imaragarita, kandi nta co kwipfuzwa na kimwe cogereranywa na bwo.
Kuramba kuri mu kuboko kwabwo kw’i buryo, mu kubamfu kwabwo na ho hari ubutunzi n’icubahiro.
Inzira zabwo ni inzira zinezereye, kandi ni iz’amahoro.
Ubwenge ni igiti c’ubugingo ku babugumbira, kandi ni umugisha ku babwumirako bose.
Ubwenge ni bwo Uhoraho yashingishije imfatiro z’isi, kandi ugutahura ni kwo yashirishijeho amajuru.
Kubera ubumenyi bwiwe, amasoko y’i kuzimu yaratobotse, ibicu na vyo bitonyanga imvura.
Mwana wanje, ntukareke ubwenge nyabwo n’ukurobanura, ngo bive imbere y’amaso yawe;
kuko ni vyo bizokubera ubuzima, bikubere ikirezi co gushariza mw’izosi.
Bizokuzigama mu nzira zawe, kandi ibirenge vyawe ntibizotsitara.
Niwaryama ntuzogira ico utinya; kandi niwasinzira, uzogira itiro riryoshe.
Ntugatinye ivyago bishitse giturumbuka, canke ukurandurwa gushikiye abanyakibi;
kuko Uhoraho ari we azokurinda, kandi azorinda ibirenge vyawe ngo ntibigwe mu mutego.
Mwana wanje, ntukareke kugirira neza ababikwiye mu gihe ufise ububasha bwo kubikora.
Ntukabwire umubanyi wawe uti: "Genda uzogaruka; nzoguha ejo," kandi ufise ico womuha ubwo nyene.
Ntugategure kugirira nabi umubanyi wawe, uwo musanzwe mubanye mwumvikana.
Ntugatongane n’umuntu ata mpamvu, ata kibi yagukoreye.
Ntukipfuze kumera nk’abantu b’ibirandamuke, canke ngo wigane ingeso zabo na zimwe;
kuko abanyakibi ari ikizira k’ Uhoraho , ariko abamwubaha abagira abakunzi biwe.
Umuvumo w’ Uhoraho uri ku nzu y’umunyakibi, ariko ahezagira urugo rw’umugororotsi.
Uhoraho agaya abacokoranyi, ariko agirira ubuntu abaciye bugufi.
Umunyabwenge azoragwa icubahiro, ariko ibipfu bizokorwa n’isoni.
Bana banje, nimutege amatwi inyigisho z’umuvyeyi; muzishireko umutima kugira ngo mugire ubwenge.
Ndiko ndabaha inyigisho nyazo; none rero ntimukanke inyigisho zanje.
Kuko nanje narabaye umwana kuri data, kandi narakundwa cane na mama nk’umwana w’ikinege.
Data yanyigishije ati: "Ushire amajambo yanje ku mutima, ugendere mu mabwirizwa yanje, ni ho uzobona kubaho.
Rondera ubwenge, rondera ugutahura; ntiwibagire amajambo yanje canke ngo uyavemwo.
Ntugahebe ubwenge kuko ni bwo buzokuzigama; ahubwo ubukunde kuko ni bwo buzokurinda.
Kugira ngo ube umunyabwenge, rondera ubwenge. Naho vyogusaba gutanga ivyawe vyose, bitange uronke ugutahura.
Niwabuha agaciro, na bwo buzokugira uwuhambaye. Bugumbire, na bwo buzoguhesha icubahiro.
Buzokwambika urugori rusharije ku mutwe, bukwerekane wambaye urugori rw’ubwiza."
Ntega amatwi mwana wanje, wemere ivyo nkubwira, ni ho imyaka yo kubaho kwawe izokwongerekana.
Ndakwigisha inzira z’ubwenge, kandi ndakurongorera mu nzira zigororotse.
Mu gutambuka ntakizogutangira, kandi niwiruka ntuzotsitara.
Ucakire inyigisho zanje, ntuziveko. Uzizigame neza kuko ni zo buzima bwawe.
Ntuze utumbereze ibirenge vyawe mu nzira z’abanyakibi, canke ngo ugendere mu ngeso z’inkozi z’ikibi.
Irinde inzira yabo, ntuyicemwo, ahubwo hindukira ufate inzira yawe.
Kuko ntibashobora gusinzira badakoze ikibi; ntibaruhuka batagize uwo batsitaza.
Barya ivyokurya bivuye mu kibi, bakanywa umuvinyu w’umuryano.
Inzira y’abagororotsi ni nk’umuco wo mu mutwenzi, ugenda urushiriza gukayangana gushitsa ku murango.
Ariko inzira y’abanyakibi imeze nk’umwijima w’umuzitanya, ntibamenya n’ico batsitarako.
Mwana wanje, niwumve ivyo nkubwira, utege amatwi amajambo yanje.
Ntuze wigere uyibagira, uyazigame mu mutima,
kuko azanira ubuzima abayakira, akabaha amagara meza mu mubiri wabo wose.
Urinde umutima wawe kuruta ibindi vyose, kuko muri wo ari ho hari isoko y’ubugingo.
Ushire kure yawe amajambo y’ubupfu, urinde akanwa kawe kuvuga amajambo mabi.
Wame uraba imbere yawe, amaso yawe uyahange ibiri imbere yawe.
Wiyumvire cane ku nzira ugiye gucamwo, utumbereze ibirenge vyawe mu nzira y’ukuri.
Ntukebereze i buryo canke i bubamfu, urinde ibirenge vyawe vyoye gukurikira ikibi.
Mwana wanje, shira umutima ku majambo y’ubwenge nkwigisha, wumvirize neza amajambo yanje akwigisha ugutahura,
kugira ngo ushobore kumenya ikibereye, akanwa kawe kavuge ivy’ubwenge.
Kuko akanwa k’umugore w’umusambanyikazi gasosa nk’ubuki, amajambo yiwe anyerera gusumvya amavuta.
Ariko mu nyuma arura gusumvya ikintu cose kirura, agacumita kurusha inkota y’ubugi bubiri.
Ibirenge vyiwe bimanuka bija mu rupfu, kandi intambuko ziwe nta handi zijana atari mu mva.
Ntiyiyumvira ku nzira ijana mu buzima, inzira ziwe ziramuzimiza, ariko ntabibona.
None rero, mwana wanje, ntega amatwi; ntiwirengagize ivyo ndakubwira.
Uze wigire kure uwo mugore, ntuze wegere n’umuryango w’inzu yiwe,
kugira ngo ntiwiyake icubahiro cawe ngo ugihe abandi, imyaka y’ubuzima bwawe ukayiha ruburakigongwe.
Abantu utazi ntibabe ari bo barya ubutunzi bwawe, ngo ivyo wabiriye akuya bitungishe inzu y’uwundi muntu.
Mu misi yawe ya nyuma uzoboroga, umubiri wawe umaze kuba akaheze.
Uzovuga uti: "Ese ingene nanse gutozwa indero! Ese ukuntu nirengagije ukugabishwa!
Vyangendeye gute ngo sinumvire abigisha banje, canke ngo ntege amatwi abarezi banje?
Ehe ngeze aho umwansi ashaka bidatevye, maramariye imbere y’ikoraniro ry’abantu."
Unywe amazi yo mw’iriba ryawe wiharije, amazi atemba ava mw’iriba ryawe.
Mbega amasoko yawe akwiye gutemba akuzura amabarabara, canke imigende yawe igatembera mu bibanza vy’amahuriro?
Nibibe ivyawe bwite, ntukabisangire n’abahita.
Isoko ryawe riragahezagirwa, nawe unezerererwe umugore wo mu buto bwawe.
Ameze nk’impongokazi iteye igomwe, nk’ingeregere ihimbaye. Amabere yiwe akubumbe ibihe vyose, kandi wame ukwegwa n’urukundo rwiwe ibihe vyose.
Mwana wanje, ni igiki cotuma ukwegwa n’umusambanyikazi, ukagumbira igikiriza c’umugore w’icigenze?
Kuko ingeso z’umuntu zigaragarira Uhoraho , ni we asuzuma inzira ziwe zose.
Ibikorwa bibi vy’umunyakibi ni vyo bimubera umutego, kandi imigozi y’ivyaha vyiwe ni yo imuboha.
Azokwicwa no kutamenya ingene yitwara, azimizwe n’ubujuju bwiwe bwinshi.
Mwana wanje, nimba waremeye kurihira ideni mugenzawe, canke ugafata ingingo yo kwishingira umunyagahinga,
umaze gafatwa n’indahiro warahiye, waguye mu mutego w’amajambo yavuye mu kanwa kawe;
uzobigenze uku kugira ngo wibohore, kuko uzoba wamaze gukorokera mu maboko ya mugenzawe. Uze ugende wicishe bugufi imbere yiwe, umwinginge ushimitse.
Ntuze ukundire amaso yawe gusinzira, canke ibigohe vyawe ngo bitwarwe n’itiro.
Uze wikize nk’ingeregere ivuye mu maboko y’umuhigi, canke nk’inyoni ivuye mu mutego.
Niwigire ku kimonyo, yewe wa munebwe we! Raba ingene gikora hanyuma uce ubwenge.
Ntikigira uwugitegeka, uwukiganza, canke uwugikoresha.
Ariko cegeranya ivyokurya mu ci, kigatororokanya imfungurwa mw’iyimbura.
Mbega uzogeza ryari kuryama, yewe wa munebwe we? Uzova mw’itiro ryawe ryari?
Uravuga uti: "Hinge nisinzirire gatoya, mpungure gakeya, nigorore gatoya, mpfunye amaboko."
Uko ni ko ubukene buzoguhwikira nk’igisuma, ubworo bugutere nk’umwambuzi.
Umuntu w’imburakimazi kandi w’umunyakibi, ni we yama abesha.
Abesha ku rwenge mu kuvuna ingohe, agakeburanisha ibirenge vyiwe, agakoresha ibimenyetso n’intoke ziwe.
Umutima wiwe wama utegura gukora ibibi, kandi ibihe vyose avyura imitongano.
Ni co gituma ivyago bizomugwako mu kanya gato, akarandurwa giturumbuka ubutakivyuka.
Hari ibintu bitandatu Uhoraho yanka, ahubwo ni indwi bimusesema:
amaso arabana abandi ubwibone, ururimi ruvuga ibinyoma, amaboko asesa amaraso y’uwutaco azira,
umutima utegura imigambi mibi, ibirenge vyirukira gukora ikibi,
icabona kivuga ibinyoma, hamwe n’umuntu ateranya abavukana.
Mwana wanje, wumve ivyo so agutegeka, kandi ntiwanke ivyo nyoko akwigisha.
Ubizigame mu mutima wawe ibihe vyose, uvyambare mw’izosi.
Uri ku rugendo, bizokurongora, uryamye bizokurarira; kandi niwavyuka bizokuganiriza.
Kuko ibwirizwa ni itara, inyigisho ni urumuri, ukugabisha no gutoza indero na vyo ni inzira ijana mu buzima.
Bizokurinda umugore w’ingeso mbi, n’akarimi gasosa k’umugore w’icigenze.
Ntukamwipfuze mu mutima wawe kubera ubwiza bwiwe, kandi ntiwemere ko agukwegakwegesha amaso yiwe.
Kuko maraya azogukwegera mu bukene, ariko umugore w’uwundi we kugukwegera urupfu.
Mbega umuntu yonyegeza umuriro mu mpuzu, impuzu ziwe ntizishe?
Umuntu yohonyora ku makara yaka, hanyuma ntashe?
Ni ko bimeze no ku wuryamana n’umugore w’uwundi muntu; nta wumukorako ngo abure guhanwa.
Abantu ntibagaya uwivye iyo ashaka kwivuna inzara.
Ariko iyo afashwe, ariha ivyo yivye bigwijwe incuro indwi, naho vyosaba kugurisha ubutunzi bw’umuryango wiwe bwose.
Ariko uwusambana n’umugore w’uwundi we ni igipfu; uwubikoze wese aba ashaka kuranduka.
Inguma n’ibimaramare ni vyo mugabane wiwe, kandi umugayo ntuzokwigera umuvako.
Ugupfuha gutuma umugabo w’uwo mugore agira ishavu ry’inkazi, kandi ntazogira ikigongwe nihagera ko yihora.
Ntazokwakira indishi y’akababaro n’imwe, ntazokwemera ingabire zawe naho womuha ibingana iki.
Mwana wanje, uzigame amajambo yanje, ubike amabwirizwa yanje muri wewe.
Uzigame amabwirizwa yanje kugira ngo ubone kubaho; urinde inyigisho zanje nk’uko urinda imbone y’ijisho ryawe.
Uzambare nk’impeta uzandike ku mutima wawe.
Bwira ubwenge uti: "Uri mushikanje," ugutahura ukwite incuti yawe.
Bizokurinda umugore w’umunyangesombi, bikurinde umugore w’icigenze n’amajambo yiwe asosa.
Umusi umwe nari kw’idirisha ry’inzu yanje, maze ncishije mu gitambara gikinze,
ndaba muvbantu ata co binona. Muri bo mbonamwo umusore umwe, umusore w’umuyabaga atagira ubwenge,
ajabuka ibarabara hafi y’aho umwe muri abo bagore yaba, agenda atumbereye inzu yiwe.
Bwari buhwibiriye, buriko burira; ijoro n’umwijima bitanguye kuza.
Maze wa mugore, aza kumusanganira, yambaye nka maraya, yuzuye uburyarya mu mutima.
Yari umugore avugira hejuru kandi w’intumva ibirenge vyiwe ntivyaragama mu nzu yiwe.
Hamwe yaba ari mw’ibarabara; ahandi mu masoko, aronderera impande zose.
Nuko afata wa musore, aramusomagura, amubwira ata dusoni ati:
"Uno musi nashikanye ikimazi c’ishimwe; nashikije ico nasezeranye.
Ni co gituma naje kugusanganira; nashaka kukubona, none ehe turahuye.
Uburiri bwanje bushasheko uburengeti bwiza, n’amashuka meza yera derere ava muri Egiputa.
Uburiri bwanje nabusize ibimota neza bitamirana, ari vyo imibavu, alowe na kinamoni.
Kaze twinywere ku rukundo gushika buce; ingo twinezereze mu rukundo,
kuko umugabo wanje si ho ari, yafashe urugendo rwa kure.
Yatwaye amahera menshi, ntazogaruka ukwezi kudaheze."
Nuko amuhendahendesha amajambo asosa, amukwegesha akarimi kiwe karesha.
Ubwo nyene aca aramukurikira nk’impfizi igiye mw’ibagiro, nk’igipfu baboshe bagira bagihane,
gushika umwampi umutobekeranije igitigu, nk’inyoni yiroha mu mutego itazi ko iza kuhasiga ubuzima.
None rero, bana banje, nimunyumvirize; mutege amatwi amajambo yanje.
Ntimukareke imitima yanyu ngo ihindukirire inzira ziwe, canke ngo izimirire mu nzira acamwo.
Kuko yagwishije benshi, kandi abo yishe ntibaharurika.
Inzu yiwe ni inzira ijana mu mva, imanuka ija mu kibanza c’abapfuye.
Ntiwumva ko Bwenge ariko ahamagara n’ijwi rirenga? Ntiwumva ko ugutahura kudugije ijwi ryakwo?
Ahagaze ku gatwe k’umusozi, no ku mahwane y’inzira.
Arasemerera ari ku marembo aja mu gisagara no ku mabarabara ajayo.
Avuga ati: "Yemwe bagabo, ni mwebwe mbwira; ndugije ijwi mpamagara abantu bose.
Yemwe mwa mburabwenge, nimuronke ubwenge. Namwe mwa bijuju, nimuronke ugutahura.
Nimunyumvirize, kuko mfise ivyiza vyo kubabwira, nteranuye akanwa kanje ngo mbabwire ibibereye.
Akanwa kanje kavuga ukuri, kuko iminwa yanje yanka ububeshi bw’uburyo bwose.
Amajambo yo mu kanwa kanje yose aragororotse, nta na rimwe muri yo rigoramye canke ry’uruhendo,
yose arumvikana ku bafise ubwenge, kandi aragororotse ku baronse ubumenyi.
Nimuhitemwo inyigisho zanje muzirutishe ifeza, n’ubumenyi muburutishe inzahabu.
Kuko ubwenge buhambaye kurusha amabuye y’agaciro, kandi nta co kwipfuzwa cogereranywa na bwo.
Jewe Bwenge mbana no kwiyubara. Kandi mfise ubwenge no kurobanura.
Kwubaha Uhoraho bitera kwanka ikibi. Ni co gituma nanka ubwibone, ukwishira hejuru, ingeso mbi hamwe n’amajambo y’uruhendo.
Kuja inama no kugira ivyiyumviro birashe ni ivyanje; mfise ugutahura hamwe n’ububasha.
Abami ni jewe ndabaha kuganza, abatware nkabaha gushinga amategeko abereye.
Abaganwa baganza kubera jewe, co kimwe n’abashizwe hejuru hamwe n’abacamanza bo kw’isi bose.
Nkunda abankunda, kandi abandondera bose bazondonka.
Ubutunzi n’icubahiro biri kumwe nanje, hamwe n’amatungo n’ubugororotsi.
Icamwa canje ni ic’agaciro gusumba inzahabu itunganijwe, ivyamwa vyanje bisumvya agaciro ifeza yarobanuwe.
Ngendera mu nzira z’ukugororoka, no mu nzira z’ubutungane.
Abankunda baragwa ubutunzi, kandi nzokwuzuza ibigega vyabo.
Uhoraho yambumvye mu ntango y’igikorwa ciwe, imbere y’uko arema ibindi vyose.
Nashizweho imbere y’ibihe, uhereye mbere na mbere, isi itararemwa.
Navutse ibiyaga bitararemwa, amasoko adudubiza amazi atarabaho.
Imbere y’uko imisozi ishirwaho, n’imbere y’uko imitumba ibaho, nari naravutse.
Navutse kera cane imbere y’uko Imana irema isi n’imirima, canke urushi rwa mbere rw’ivu.
Igihe yashiraho amajuru ni ho nari ndi, n’igihe yashiraho urubibe rw’i kuzimu ni ho nari ndi.
Igihe Uhoraho yashira ibicu hejuru ni ho nari ndi, kandi n’igihe yaha inkomezi amasoko y’i kuzimu ni ho nari ndi.
Igihe yashiraho imbibe z’ibiyaga, kugira ngo ntibirenge inkombe zavyo, kandi n’igihe yashiraho imfatiro z’isi ni ho nari ndi.
Ico gihe nari kumwe na yo ndi nk’umuhinga. Namana akamwemwe imisi yose, nezererewe imbere yiwe.
Nari nezererewe isi yose yaremye, nezererewe abana b’abantu.
None rero, bana banje, nimuntege amatwi; hahiriwe abagendera mu nzira zanje.
Nimwumve inyigisho zanje, maze mugire ubwenge, ntimuzirengagize.
Hahiriwe umuntu antega amatwi, akaguma anderetse ari ku muryango wanje ku musi ku musi, akandindirira mu rwinjiriro.
Kuko uwundonse aba aronse ubuzima, kandi agira ikiganza ciza k’ Uhoraho .
Ariko uwutandondeye aba yishe ubuzima wiwe, kuko abanyanka bose bakunda urupfu."
Bwenge yubatse inzu yiwe, ayishigikiza inkingi indwi.
Hanyuma ategura inyama z’amazimano, ategura n’umuvinyu arawutunganya, mbere ategura n’imeza yiwe.
Maze atuma abamukorera ngo baje gutumira, ahamagara n’ijwi rirenga ari ahataramutse ho mu gisagara, avuga ati:
"Abanyabwenge buke bose nibaze mu nzu yanje!" Ni ko abwira ibijuju, ati:
"Nimuze murye ivyokurya vyanje, munywe n’umuvinyu natunganije.
Nimuve mu nzira zanyu z’ukutamenya mubone kubaho; nimugendere mu nzira z’ugutahura."
Uwuhanura umucokoranyi aba yikwegeye ibitutsi, kandi uwuhana umunyakibi yikwegera kugirirwa nabi.
Ntuze uhanure umucokoranyi, kuko azoca akwanka; uzohanure umunyabwenge, kuko azoca agukunda.
Niwigisha abanyabwenge, bazokwongererezwa ubwenge; kandi niwigisha abagororotsi, bazoca bongereza ubumenyi.
Ukwubaha Uhoraho ni kwo tanguriro ry’ubwenge, kandi kumenya Uwera ni kwo gutahura.
Muri jewe Bwenge ni ho imisi yawe izokwongererezwa, n’ubuzima bwawe bukongerwa imyaka.
Niwaba umunyabwenge, ubwenge bwawe buzoguha impera. Ariko niwaba inshirasoni, ni wewe nyene bizobabaza.
Umugore w’igipfu avugira hejuru; ntagira indero, nta n’ubwenge afise.
Yicara ku muryango w’inzu yiwe, ku ntebe iri ahataramutse ho mu gisagara,
agahamagara abahita, bigiriye mu vyabo,
Akabwira ibijuju ati: "Umunyabwenge buke wese niyinjire hano!"
"Amazi y’amibano araryoshe, n’indya ziririwe mu kinyegero ziri n’akanovera."
Ariko abo ntibamenya ko aho ari ho abapfuye bari, ko abashitsi b’uwo mugore bari mu rwobo i kuzimu.
Imigani ya Salomo Umwana w’ubwenge anezereza se, ariko umwana w’igipfu ababaza nyina.
Ubutunzi buvuye mu kwiba ntiburamba, ariko ubugororotsi bukiza umuntu urupfu.
Uhoraho ntareka umugororotsi ngo yicwe n’inzara, ariko abuza umunyakibi kuronka ivyo umutima wiwe uhahamiye.
Amaboko anebwa akwega ubukene, ariko amaboko y’umwete aratungisha.
Uwusarura mu ci ni umwana w’ubwenge, ariko uwusinzira mw’iyimbura ni umwana ateye isoni.
Imigisha ni urugori rw’umugororotsi, ariko umuryano wuzuye akanwa k’umunyakibi.
Kwibuka umugororotsi ni umugisha, ariko izina ry’umunyakikibi rizozimangana.
Umutima w’umunyabwenge wemera ukurongorwa, ariko igipfu kidaharura ivyo kivuga cikwegera uguhona.
Intungane igenda ata co yinona, ariko uwuca mu nzira zigoramanze azomenyekana.
Uwuvuna urugohe rw’uburyarya atera umubabaro, kandi iminwa y’igipfu izana uguhona.
Akanwa k’umugororotsi ni isoko y’ubuzima, ariko akanwa k’umunyakibi kuzura umuryano.
Urwanko ruvyura amatati, ariko urukundo rupfuka ibibi vyose.
Ubwenge ubusanga ku minwa y’uwuzi kurobanura, ariko inkoni iri ku mugongo w’abatagira ubwenge.
Abanyabwenge bimbura ubumenyi, ariko akanwa k’igipfu kagikwegera uguhona.
Ubutunzi bw’umutunzi bumubera igisagara gikomeye, ariko ubukene ni bwo buhitana aboro.

Niwavuga uti: "Ariko ntitwabimenye," mbega uwusesa imitima ntazoba abibona? Uwuzigama ubugingo bwawe arazi ko wari ubizi. Ni we azoha impera umuntu wese, ikwiranye n’ibikorwa yakoze.
Mwana wanje, uzoje urarya ubuki, kuko ni bwiza. Ubuki buvuye mu kimamara burasosa ku rurimi.
Ariko kandi umenye ko ubwenge na bwo busosera umushaha. Niwaburonka, uzogira ivyizigiro vya kazoza keza, kandi ivyo vyizigiro ntibizogutetereza.
Ntuzokwibunde inyuma y’inzu y’umugororotsi ugomba kumugirira nabi, kandi ntugasahure ivy’aho aba.
Kuko umugororotsi naho yogwa incuro indwi azosubira ahaguruke. Ariko abanyavyaha bazogwishwa n’amakuba.
Ntuze unezerwe umwansi wawe niyagwa, kandi niyatsitara umutima wawe ntuze unezerwe.
Kuko vyohava bibabaza Uhoraho , bigatuma amukurako uburake bwiwe.
Ntugashavurire inkozi y’ikibi, kandi ntugashake kuba nk’umubi.
Kuko inkozi z’ibibi ntizigira ivyizigiro vya kazoza, kandi itara ry’umubi rizozimwa.
Mwana wanje, wubahe Uhoraho , wongere wubahe umwami, kandi ntukifatanye n’abagarariji,
kuko abo bompi bazomuteza ivyago ningoga. Kandi mbega ni nde yoshobora kumenya ivyago bazomuteza ingene bingana?
Iyi ni iyindi migani y’abanyabwenge: Guhengama mu rubanza ni bibi:
Umucamanza abwira umubi ati: "Urera," azovumwa n’abantu, kandi amahanga azomurakira.
Ariko uwuhana uwakoze icaha azoba agize neza, kandi imigisha myinshi izomuzako.
Inyishu igororotse imeze nk’ugusomana kw’abakundana.
Banza uringanize neza ivyo hanze, utegure imirima yawe, hanyuma ubone kwubaka inzu yawe.
Ntukaburanye umubanyi wawe ata mvo, kandi ntukamubeshere.
Kandi Ntukavuge uti: "Reka ndamwishure ivyo yankoreye, ndamusubirize mu nkoko ibihwanye n’ivyo yakoze."
Umusi umwe naciye mu murima w’umunebwe, nca no mu ruzabibu rw’umuntu w’imburabwenge;
nsanga ahantu hose hameze amahwa, urwiri rwameze hose, inzitiro z’amabuye zarahenaguritse.
Maze niyumvira ku vyo mbonye, na vyo bimpa icigwa:
Niwavuga uti: "Hinge nisinzirire gatoya, mpungure gakeya, nigorore gatoya, mpfunye amaboko,"
ubukene buzoguhwikira nk’igisuma, ubworo bugutere nk’umwambuzi.
Iyi ni iyindi migani ya Salomo, yegeranijwe n’umujenama w’umwami Hezekiya, umwami w’i Buyuda:
Icubahiro c’Imana ni uguhisha ibintu, ariko icubahiro c’abami ni ukubihishura.
Nk’uko ijuru riri hejuru cane, n’i kuzimu hakaba harehare, ni ko umutima w’umwami ata wumenya ibiwurimwo.
Tyorora ifeza, izohinduka igikoresho c’umucuzi.
Kura umubi imbere y’umwami, inganji yiwe izokomezwa n’ubugororotsi.
Ntukishire hejuru imbere y’umwami, kandi ntugasabe icicaro mu bahambaye.
Ni vyiza kurindira bakakubwira bati: "Shika hano imbere" aho kwirukanwa kure umaramara imbere y’abubahwa. Ivyo ni vyo umaze kwibonera.
Ntukihute kwitwarira umubanyi mu bucamanza, kuko agutsinze womaramara, ukabura uko ubigenza.
Nihagira ico mupfa n’umubanyi wawe, ntuzobifatireko ngo umene ibanga uwundi muntu yakubwiye,
abandi bohava bavyumva bakakwagiriza urusaku, ukaba wambaye iceyi utazikurako.
Ijambo rivuzwe mu gihe caryo ni ryiza; rimeze nk’icamwa c’inzahabu mu nkoko y’ifeza.
Ku wufise ugutwi kwumva, impanuro y’umunyabwenge imeze nk’ihereni ry’inzahabu, canke urugori rw’inzahabu nziza.
Nk’uko amazi akanye amerera isi mu bushuhe bwo mu ci, ni ko intumwa y’umwizigirwa imerera uwayitumye. Isubiza itoto umutima wa shebuja.
Uwusezerana gutanga ingabire ariko ntashitse, ameze nk’ibicu n’umuyaga bitazana imvura.
Ukwihangana bigondoza umutware, kandi ururimi rwiyoroheje rushobora kuvuna igufa.
Niwaronka ubuki, uzorye ubugereranye, kuko niwarya bwinshi cane uzobudahwa.
Ntukamize ikirenge mu rugo rw’umubanyi, kugira ngo ntibazoguharuruke, bakakwanka.
Umuntu arementaniriza ibinyoma umubanyi wiwe ameze nk’ishoka, inkota canke umwampi usongoye.
Gushira ivyizigiro ku muhemu mu gihe c’ivyago, ni nko guhekenyesha iryinyo ricitse, canke kugendesha ukuguru kuvunitse.
Uwuririmbira uwufise umutima ubabaye ameze nk’uwiyambura impuzu mu gihe c’imbeho, canke uwusuka inkarisha mu gikomere.
Umwansi wawe niyasonza, uramugaburira; niyanyoterwa umuhe ico kunywa.
Uzoba umusutse amakara yaka ku mutwe, kandi Uhoraho azobiguhera impera.
Nk’uko umuyaga uturuka mu buraruko uzana imvura, ni ko ururimi ruvuga urusaku rutera kwiraburanirwa.
Wopfuma wibana mu mfuruka y’igisenge c’inzu, hako ubana mu nzu nziza n’umugore w’intonganya.
Nk’uko amazi apfutse amerera umuntu anyotewe, ni ko inkuru nziza ivuye kure imera.
Umugororotsi ahendwa n’umunyakibi akifatanya na we aba ameze nk’iriba ritobwe canke ryuzuyemwo isuri.
Si vyiza kurya ubuki bwinshi kandi si vyiza ko umunyacubahiro arondera ko bakimuha.
Umuntu adashobora kwirinda ishavu ameze nk’igisagara gifise inzitiro zasenyutse.
Nk’uko shelegi itabereye kugwa mu ci canke imvura mw’iyimbura, ni ko icubahiro kidakwiye igipfu.
Nk’uko intamba iguruka kandi nk’uko inyamanza iguruka, ni ko umuvumo uvumiwe ubusa umera.
Nk’uko ikimoko kibereye ifarasi, n’umujiginya ukabera indogoba, ni ko umugongo w’igipfu ubereye inkoni.
Ntugasubize igipfu ibihwanye n’ubupfu bwaco, ahandi ho uzoba ubaye nka co.
Ariko uze wishure igipfu ibigaragaza ubupfu bwaco, kugira ngo nticigire umunyabwenge.
Kurungikana ubutumwa igipfu ni nko kwica ukuguru canke kunywa uburozi.
Amajambo y’ubwenge mu kanwa k’igipfu, ni nk’ukuguru kuvunitse gusigaye kurereta ata co kumaze.
Guha icubahiro igipfu ni nko kubohera ibuye ku mugozi
Umugani uciwe n’igipfu umeze nk’ihwa rihanda mu kigaza c’imborerwa.
Uwuha akazi igipfu canke uwuhita wese ameze nk’uwupfa kurasa mu bantu.
Nk’uko imbwa isubira ku vyo yadashwe, ni ko igipfu gisubiramwo ubupfu bwaco.
Igipfu gifise amahirwe kurusha uwibaza ko ari umunyabwenge kandi atari we.
Umunyabute avuga ati: "Hari intare mu nzira, intare y’inkazi iriko iratontoma mu nzira!"
Nk’uko urugi rwizungurutsa ku mapata yarwo ni ko umunebwe yihindukiza ku buriri bwiwe.
Umunebwe atwara ukuboko mw’isahani, ariko akananirwa no kukugarukana ku munwa.
Umunyabute yibwira ko ari umunyabwenge kurusha abantu indwi bashobora kwishurana ubwenge.
Umuntu ari ku nzira arengana akisuka mu bihari bitamwerekeye ameze nk’umuntu afashe imbwa amatwi.
Umuntu abesha mugenziwe, agaca yivugira ati: "Nariko ndatebura,"
ameze nk’uwurasa ibishirira canke imyampi yica mu bantu.
Nk’uko iyo inkwi ziheze, umuriro uzima, ni ko n’iyo ata rusaku ruhari ibihari bihera.
Nk’uko urubeya rufatisha amakara canke inkwi, ni ko uwukunda gutongana atangura ibihari.
Amajambo y’urusaku ameze nk’ivyokurya biryoshe; aramanuka agashika i bwina mu mutima w’umuntu.
Amajambo meza ava mu mutima mubi ameze nk’umuringa w’ifeza ushizwe ku nkono y’ibumba.
Umwankanyi yihisha inyuma y’amajambo yiwe aryoshe, ariko umutima wiwe urimwo inama z’ubuhemu.
Naho amajambo yiwe aryohera amatwi, ntukamwizere; umutima wiwe wuzuye ubuyobe.
Naho yogenda arabesha ahisha uburyarya bwiwe, ibikorwa bibi vyiwe bizoja ku mugaragaro.
Uwimbira ikinogo uwundi ni we azokigwamwo; kandi uwuzotembagariza ikibuye ku wundi, ni we kizofyonyora.
Ururimi rubesha rwanka abo rubabaza, kandi akanwa kavuga ibinyomya karasenyura.
Ntukishimire ivy’ejo, kuko nta wumenya ivyo haramukana.
Uzoshimwe n’uwundi, atari akanwa kawe; azobe uwo hanze, atari iminwa yawe.
Ibuye riraremereye, kandi umusenyi ugira ibilo vyinshi, ariko ugusotora kw’igipfu kuremera gusumba ivyo vyompi.
Ishavu ni umwicanyi, kandi uburake butwara nk’umukuba w’uruzi; ariko ni nde yohagarara imbere y’ishari?
Gukeburirwa ahabona kuruta urukundo rwinyegeje.
Umukunzi agukomeretsa aba ari uwo kwizigira, ariko ukugumbirana kw’umwansi ni agahemo gasa.
Ku wuhimvye ubuki burabiha, ariko ku wushonje n’ibirura birasosa.
Uwangarira kure y’i muhira ameze nk’inyoni iyererera kure y’icari.
Ibimota neza binezera umutima, nayo ibinezero vy’umugenzi bikava ku mutima umuhanura neza.
Ntugahebe umugenzi wawe canke umugenzi w’umuryago wawe, kandi ntukaje ku ncuti yawe ku musi ivyago biguteye, kuko umubanyi wa hafi asumba incuti ya kure.
Gira ubwenge, mwana wanje, maze uhimbare umutima wanje; ni ho nzoronka ico nishura abantuka.
Umunyamakenga yama abona icago kitaramushikira akacikinga, ariko igipfu gipfa kugenda, hanyuma kikisanga mu kaga.
Twara impuzu y’uwishinze uwo atazi, ufate ingwati y’uwishinze abahita.
Nihagira uwuzinduka guhezagira mugenziwe n’ijwi rirenga, ico kizomubera nk’umuvumo.
Ivano riguma ritonyanga ku musi imvura yirijeko ni nk’umugore atongana.
Kumutesha ni nko kugumya umuyaga, canke kugumya amavuta mu kiganza.
Nk’uko icuma gikarisha ikindi cuma; ni ko umuntu akarishanya na mugenziwe.
Uwututurira umusukoni azorya ivyamwa vyawo; kandi uwukingira shebuja azohabwa icubahiro.
Nk’uko umuntu abona ishusho yiwe mu mazi; ni ko ubuzima bw’umuntu bwerekana umutima wiwe.
Uko Rupfu na Muranduzi batigera bahaga; ni ko n’amaso y’abantu ameze.
Ifeza n’inzahabu bitunganywa n’umuriro, ariko umuntu asuzumwa n’ugushimagizwa.
Naho wosekura igipfu mw’isekuro, ukakinoza nk’uwusekuza ingano umuhini, ntiwogikuramwo ubupfu bwaco.
Gira umwete wo kumenya ibitungwa vyawe ingene vyifashe; umenye neza amasho yawe ingene ameze
kuko ubutunzi ntibwamaho, nk’uko urugori rutamaho uko urunganwe rugenda rukurikirana.
Ubwatsi bumaze gutemwa haza ubundi, ubwo ku misozi bukegeranywa,
imyagazi yawe izokwambika, kandi impene zawe zizokugurira itongo.
Uzokamira umuryango wawe amata y’impene akwiye, agutungire incoreke zawe.
Abanyakibi bahunga ata wubirukanye, ariko umugororotsi arinda nk’intare.
Iyo igihugu kigumutse kiganzwa na benshi, ariko umutware afise ubwenge abungabunga umutekano.
Umutware acinyiza aboro ameze nk’imvura y’isegenya idasiga igiterwa inyuma.
Abataye ivyagezwe bashira hejuru abanyakibi, ariko abavyubaha barabagwanya.
Inkozi z’ibibi ntizitahura ibibereye, ariko abarondera Uhoraho batahura vyose.
Umukene agendera mu bugororotsi aruta umutunzi w’indyarya.
Umunyabwenge wese yumvira ivyagezwe, ariko uwugendana n’abakunzi b’inda atetereza se.
