Uwigwiriza ubutunzi mu kwaka inyungu y’umurengera ku vyo aguranye umukene, abwegeraniriza uwundi azofasha aboro.
Uwanka kwumva ivyagezwe, amasengesho yiwe aba igisesema.
Uwuzimiza umugororotsi agaca mu nzira mbi ni we agwa mu mutego, ariko inyankamugayo izoragwa ivyiza.
Umutunzi yigira umunyabwenge mu vyiyumviro vyiwe; ariko umukene w’umunyabwenge aramuhinyura.
Iyo abagororotsi banesheje haba umunezero mwinshi, ariko iyo umunyakibi ashizwe hejuru, abantu bose barinyegeza.
Uwuhisha ivyaha vyiwe nta mahirwe agira, ariko uwuvyatura akabiheba agirirwa ubuntu.
Hahiriwe umuntu yama ahindira agashitsi imbere y’ Uhoraho , ariko abakomantaza imitima bazogwa mu vyago.
Uko intare itontoma ihiga idubu ni ko umutware mubi amerera abakene.
Umutware atagira ugutahura aracinyiza, uwanka amaronko mabi azorambira ku ngoma.
Uwubujijwe amahororo n’amaraso yasheshe ahungira mu mva; ntimuze mumutangire.
Inyankamugayo izorokorwa mu vyago, ariko uwugoramika inzira ziwe azogwa mu rwobo.
Uwurima itongo ryiwe azoronka umwimbu mwinshi, ariko uwirukira ibitagira ikimazi azohaga ubukene.
Umwizigirwa azokwuzuzwa imigisha, ariko uwihutira kuronka ubutunzi ntazobura guhanwa.
Kurenganya si vyiza; ariko hariho abarya igiturire c’umukate.
Uwipfuza ivy’abandi yihutira gutunga, kandi ntamenya ko ubukene bumurindiriye.
Uwuhanura mugenziwe azobimushimira, gusumvya uwumushigikira mu gahemo.
Uwusahura se na nyina akibwira ati: "Nta co bitwaye," ni umugenzi w’umuranduzi.
Uwipfuza ivy’abandi atera umuvurungano, ariko uwizigira Uhoraho aratera imbere.
Uwiyizigira ubwiwe ni igipfu, ariko uwugendana ubwenge asimba ivyago.
Uwugaburira aboro nta co azobura, ariko uwubiyobagiza azokwuzurako imivumo.
Iyo umunyakibi agiye ku butegetsi abantu barinyegeza, ariko iyo umunyakibi apfuye, abagororotsi baragwira.
Uwugamika izosi akanka guhanurwa, azovunagurwa vuba, ata gitabara.
Iyo abagororotsi bagiye ku butegetsi, abantu baranezerwa; ariko iyo umunyakibi atwaye, abantu baraboroga.
Uwukunda ubwenge azanira umunezero se, ariko uwugendana n’abasambanyi yisesagurirako itunga ryiwe.
Iyo umwami aca izibereye, aha impore igihugu, ariko uwukunda ibiturire aragitabagura.
Uwuhenda umubanyi wiwe aba ateze umutego ibirenge vyiwe.
Umunyakibi agwa mu mitego yiwe, ariko umugororotsi araririmba akanezerwa.
Umugororotsi yitwararika gucira abakene iziroranye, ariko umunyakibi nta bwenge bwo kubimenya agira.
Abacokoranyi bagumura igisagara, ariko abanyabwenge bakuraho uburake.
Iyo umunyabwenge ajanye ikijuju imbere y’intahe, gishobora kuraka canke kigatwenga, nta co abikuramwo.
Abasesa amaraso banka inyankamugayo, kandi bica abagororotsi.
Igipfu cirata uburake bwaco, ariko umunyabwenge arabuhwamika.
Iyo umutegetsi yumvirije ibinyoma, abatware biwe bose baba babi.
Umukene n’uwumucinyiza bafise ico bahurirako: Uhoraho ni we aha amaso yabo bompi kubona.
Umwami niyacira izibereye abakene, inganji yiwe izohoraho.
Inkoni yo guhana itanga ubwenge, ariko umwana atarezwe amaramaza nyina.
Iyo umunyakibi ateye imbere, n’icaha ni uko, ariko umugororotsi azokwihweza ukugwa kwiwe.
Toza indero umwana wawe, na we azoguha amahoro; azonezereza umutima wawe.
Iyo ata yerekwa rihari, abantu barazimira; ariko hahiriwe umuntu agendera mu vyagezwe.
Umukozi ntakosorwa n’amajambo gusa, n’iyo yumvise ico abwiwe ntagishirako umutima.
Hari ivyizigiro ku muntu w’igipfu, kurusha uwuvuga atiyumviriye.
Uwufyinisha umukozi wiwe akiri muto, amutera kugira iherezo ribi.
Uwihuta kuraka atera imivurungano, kandi uwukaza ishavu akora ivyaha vyinshi.
Ubwirasi bw’umuntu bumusubiza hasi, ariko uwicishije bugufi arubahwa.
Uwifatanya n’umusuma aba yiyanka, urahira ko uvuga ukuri, kandi utari bukuvuge.
Gutinya abantu bita mu mutego, ariko abizera Uhoraho barawusimba.
Abantu benshi barondera kwakirwa n’umutware, ariko gucirwa iziroranye bitangwa n’ Uhoraho .
Abagororotsi banka uburyarya, ariko abanyakibi banka abubaha Imana.
Aya ni amajambo ya Aguri mwene Yake, uwavugishijwe. Uwo yabariye Utiyeli, Itiyeli na Ukali, ati: "Ndatuntuye, ewe Mana, ndatuntuye kandi ndarushe, ewe Mana.
Ndi ikijuju kurusha abandi bose, singira ugutahura kw’abantu.
Sinigishijwe ubwenge, kandi sinzi Uwera.

Ni nde yagiye mw’ijuru hanyuma akagaruka? Ni nde yegeranirije umuyaga mu kiganza ciwe? Ni nde yegeranirije amazi mu mutamana wiwe? Ni nde yashizeho impera z’isi? Izina ryiwe ni nde, kandi imfura yiwe ni nde? Mbarira nimba ubizi!
Ijambo ry’Imana ryose ni iryo kwizerwa; ni inkinzo ku bayihungirako.
Ntihagire ico uzokwongera ku majambo yayo, ahandi ho izoguhana ikwereke ko uri umubeshi.
Hari ibintu bibiri ngusaba, ewe Mana; kandi ntubinyime nkiriho:
undinde ibinyoma n’ububeshi, bimbe kure; ntumpe ubukene canke ubutunzi bwinshi, ariko umpe ibinkwiye buri musi.
Nohava ntunga nkakugaya, nti Uhoraho ni iki? Canke nkaba umukene nkiba, nkatukisha izina ry’Imana yanje.
Ntukavuge nabi umukozi imbere ya shebuja, kuko azokuvuma, kandi uzohanirwa icaha cawe.
Hari abavuma ba se, kandi ntibahezagire ba nyina,
bakibwira ko ari beza, kandi batikuyeko imyanda ibariko;
bafise amaso y’ubwibone, barabira abandi hasi.
Hari abafise amenyo ameze nk’inkota, imibangabanga yabo irimwo imbugita. Batabagura aboro kw’isi, abakene bakabatabagurira mu bantu.
Umuyoka ufise abakobwa babiri. Barasemerera bati: ‘Zana! Zana!’ Hari ibintu bitatu bidahaga, n’ica kane kitigera kivuga kiti: ‘Geza aho’:
imva, inda y’ingumba, isi idahaga amazi, hamwe n’umuriro utigera uvuga uti: ‘Geza aho!’
Ijisho ry’uwugaya se, rigakengera nyina ashaje, rizonokorwa n’ibikona vyo mu biyaya, riribwe n’ibinyakabaka.
Hari ibintu bine bintangaza cane, mbere ni bine ntatahura:
inzira y’inkona mu kirere, inzira y’inzoka ku gitandara, inzira y’ubwato mu kiyaga, n’inzira y’umusore ku nkumi.
Uku ni ko umusambanyikazi abigenza: ararya hanyuma akihanagura, maze akavuga ati: ‘Nta kibi nigeze nkora.’
Hari ibintu bitatu bijugumiza isi, mbere ni bine idashobora kwihanganira:
umugurano abaye umwami, igipfu cujuje ivyokurya,
umugore atisonera mugabo akarongorwa, hamwe n’incoreke isubirira inabuja.
Hari ibintu bine bitobito kw’isi, ariko biciye ubwenge cane:
Ibimonyo ni udukoko dutoduto, ariko biriziganiriza ivyokurya vyo mu ci;
inkezi ni uturemwa tw’utunyantegenke, ariko twubaka inzu yatwo mu gitandara,
inzige ntizigira umwami, ariko zigira hamwe mu migwi;
umuserebanyi ushobora gufatishwa amaboko, ariko uwusanga mu birimba vy’abami.
Hari ibinyabuzima bitatu bitambuka neza, mbere ni bine bigenda birashonyanga:
intare, ikomeye gusumvya ibindi bikoko, itigera ihunga na kimwe,
isake ihagaze ku maguru yayo, isuguru y’impene, hamwe n’umwami agendera imbere y’ingabo ziwe.
Iyo wigize igipfu ukishira hejuru, canke ugategura gukora ikibi, pfuka n’urushi akanwa kawe.
Kuko nk’uko amata aterewe avamwo amavuta, izuru rikubiswe rikava umwuna, ni ko kuratsa umuntu bitera ibihari."
Iyi ni imigani y’umwami Lemuweli, yavugishwa amajambo y’ubwenge yigishijwe na nyina.
Nyumviriza, mwana wanje! Ntega amatwi bura bwanje! Nyumviriza, mwana wanje, wewe nyishu y’amasengesho yanje.
Ntugahereze inkomezi zawe mu bagore, canke inguvu zawe ku bagwisha abami.
Si ivy’abami, ewe Lemuweli, si ivy’abami kunywa umuvinyu, n’abatware kunohokera inzoga,
kuko bonywa bakibagira ivyashinzwe, bakananirwa kugirira neza abacinyijwe.
Reka inzoga zibe iz’abahona, umuvinyu ube uw’abababaye!
Nibabe ari bo banywa, bibagire ubukene bwabo, ntibasubire kwibuka amagorwa yabo.
Uvugire abadashobora kwivugira, ugirire neza ba ntahonikora.
Uvuge kandi uce izibereye; uburanire aboro n’abakene.
Umugore w’imico myiza yova hehe? Asumba utubuye tw’agaciro.
Umugabo wiwe aramwizigira cane, kandi nta c’agaciro amuburana.
Azanira ivyiza umugabo, atari ibibi, imisi yose yo kubaho kwiwe.
Atoranya ubwoya bw’intama n’ipampa, akajisha impuzu n’amaboko yiwe anezerewe.
Ameze nk’ubwato bw’umudandaza, azana ivyokurya abikuye kure.
Avyuka bugihwibiriye; akaronderera indya umuryango, akaronderera n’incoreke ziwe.
Abona itongo akarishima, maze akarigura; maze mu biva mu vyo akora, ahatera uruzabibu.
Agira umwete mwinshi mu vyo akora, amaboko yiwe ayaha kurema.
Aramenya ko urudandazwa rwiwe rutera ruja imbere, kandi itara ryiwe ntirizima mw’ijoro.
Amaboko yiwe atunganya ubwoya bw’intama, intoke ziwe zikajisha impuzu
Apfumbaturura ibiganza agafasha aboro, akaramvurira amaboko gufasha abakene.
Mu gihe c’imbeho nyinshi, ntatinyira umuryango wiwe, kuko abambika izisusurutse.
Yijishira ivyo kwipfuka mw’ijoro, akambara izera derere n’izitukura.
Umugabo wiwe arubahwa kw’irembo ry’igisagara, iyo yicaranye n’abatware baho.
Ajisha imitamana yera derere akayigurisha, akaronkera imikenyezo abadandaza.
Yambaye inkomezi n’icubahiro ategekanya kazoza mu munezero.
Avugana ubwenge, kandi impanuro z’ubwizigirwa ziri mu kanwa kiwe.
Yitaho ibikorwa vy’umugabo wiwe, kandi ntarya ivyo atabiriye akuya.
Abana biwe bose baramushimagiza, umugabo wiwe akamushima avuga ati:
"Hari abagore benshi bakora ivyiza, ariko bose urabaruta."
Kugira uburanga gusa birahenda, kandi ubwiza bwo ku rukoba nta co bumaze. Ariko umugore yubaha Uhoraho azoshimwa.
Arabereye guhabwa ibiva mu maboko yiwe, kandi ibikorwa yakoze bimushire hejuru kw’irembo ry’igisagara.

name: Umusiguzi
chapters: Amajambo y’umusiguzi, mwene Dawidi, umwami w’i Yerusalemu:
"Ni ubusa! Ni ubusa!" Ni ko umusiguzi avuga. "Ni ubusa gusa! Vyose ni ubusa."
Umuntu yunguka iki mu butame bwiwe bwose, mu bikorwa vyose akorera musi y’izuba?
Urunganwe ruraza urundi rukagenda, ariko isi igumaho ibihe vyose.
Izuba riraseruka bwije rikarenga, hanyuma rikihutira gusubira iyo riserukira.
Umuyaga uhuha uja mu bumanuko, hanyuma ugahindukirira mu buraruko, ukagenda uzunguruka, ukama usubiramwo inzira yawo.
Inzuzi zose zitemba zija mu kiyaga, ariko ikiyaga nticigera cuzura. Aho za nzuzi zatanguriye, ni ho amazi asubira.
Ibintu vyose biraruhisha, kurusha uko umuntu yobivuga. Ijisho ntirihaga kuraba, n’ugutwi ntiguhaga kwumva.
Icabayeho kizosubira kubaho, icakozwe kizokwongera gukorwa; nta gishasha musi y’izuba.
Hoba hariho na kimwe umuntu yovuga ati: "Raba, iki ni gishasha"? Carabayeho, kera muri kahise; cariho imbere yacu.
Nta kwibuka ivyabaye kera, kandi n’ibizoba muri kazoza ntibizokwibukwa n’abazoza inyuma yavyo.
Jewe, umusiguzi, nari umwami w’Abisirayeli i Yerusalemu.
Nafashe ingingo yo kwiyegurira kwiga no kurondera kumenya nkoresheje ubwenge mu bintu vyose biri musi y’izuba. Ni umutwaro uremereye Imana yaremetse abantu!
Nabonye ibintu vyose bikorerwa musi y’izuba ari ubusa, ni ukwiruka inyuma y’umuyaga.
Icagoramitswe ntigishobora kugororwa; ikibuze ntigishobora guharurwa.
Nariyumviriye muri jewe nti: "Raba, nararonse kandi naragwije ubwenge kurusha abatwaye i Yerusalemu imbere yanje; kandi nagize ubwenge bwinshi no gutahura kwinshi."
Maze nca mfata ingingo yo kwiga ngo menye ivy’ubwenge, ivy’ubusazi n’ivy’ubupfu, ariko natahuye ko n’ivyo na vyo nyene ari ukwiruka inyuma y’umuyaga.
Kuko kugira ubwenge bwinshi bizanana n’umubabaro mwinshi; kandi uko umuntu yongereza ubumenyi ni ko yongereza imibabaro.
Niyumviriye mu mutima wanje nti: "Hinge ndawugeragereshe ibihimbaro kugira ngo menye ivyiza ivyo ari vyo." Ariko na vyo nyene nasanze ari ubusa.
Naravuze nti: "Ugutwenga ni ubupfu. Kandi ibihimbaro bimara iki?"
Nagerageje kwinezeresha umuvinyu, ngo nifatanye n’ubupfu ariko ngume ndongorwa n’ubwenge muri jewe. Ivyo nakoze nshaka kumenya ikibereye abantu bokorera musi y’ijuru mu misi mike y’ukubaho kwabo.
Nagize imigambi ihambaye: Niyubakiye amazu ntera imizabibu.
Narimye imirima y’ivyamwa minini na mitoya ndayiteramwo ibiti vy’ubwoko bwose bw’ivyamwa.
Nimvye ibinogo vyo kubikamwo amazi yo kuvomera imivyaro y’ibiti.

Naguze abagurano n’abaguranokazi nongerako n’abandi bagurano abahungu n’abakobwa babo bavukiye mu nzu iwanje. Kandi nari ntunze amasho n’imikuku kurusha abantu bose b’i Yerusalemu banyitangiye imbere.
Nironkeye ifeza n’inzahabu, n’ubutunzi bw’abami n’abarongoye intara. Nironkeye abaririmvyi b’abagabo n’abagore, hamwe n’abahabara benshi, ngira ibihimbaro umutima w’umugabo wese wipfuza.
Nabaye agahambaye kuruta abanyitangiye imbere b’i Yerusalemu. Muri ivyo vyose ubwenge bwanje bwagumanye nanje.
Ikintu cose amaso yanje yipfuje sinakiyimye; umutima wanje sinawimye igihimbaro na kimwe. Umutima wanje wanezererewe igikorwa canje cose, kandi iyo ni yo ngero y’ubutame bwanje bwose.
Ariko ndavye ivyo amaboko yanje yakoze n’ivyo nacumukuriye, nasanze vyose ari ubusa, ari ukwiruka inyuma y’umuyaga; nta na kimwe umuntu yunguka musi y’izuba.
Maze mpindukiza ivyiyumviro vyanje ngo ndabe ubwenge, n’ubusazi mbere n’ubupfu. None uwuzosubira ku ngoma y’umwami yokora iki kindi atari icamaze gukorwa?
Nasanze ubwenge buruta ubupfu, nk’uko umuco uruta umwijima.
Umunyabwenge afise amaso mu mutwe wiwe, ariko igipfu kigendera mu mwiza; ariko nasanze bompi ikibarindiriye ari kimwe.
Hanyuma ndiyumvira mu mutima wanje nti: "Iherezo ry’igipfu nanje nyene rirandindiriye. None nunguka iki mu kuba umunyabwenge?" Nibwiye mu mutima wanje nti: "N’ibi na vyo ni ubusa."
Kuko umunyabwenge, mbere n’igipfu, ntazokwibukwa; uko imisi ihera, bompi bazokwibagiranwa. Nk’uko bigenda ku gipfu, umunyabwenge na we nyene azopfa!
Ni co catumye nanka ubuzima, kuko igikorwa gikorerwa musi y’izuba ari kibi ku bwanje. Vyose ni ubusa, ni ukwiruka inyuma y’umuyaga.
Nanse ibintu vyose vyo mu butame bwanje musi y’izuba, kuko nzobisigarana uwuzoza mu nyuma zanje.
Kandi ni nde azi nimba azoba ari umunyabwenge? Ariko ni we azoganza ivyo nakoresheje inkomezi zanje n’ubwenge bwanje musi y’izuba. N’ivyo ni ubusa.
Nuko umutima wanje watanguye kwihebura ku bw’ibikorwa biruhije nakoreye musi y’izuba.
Kuko umuntu ashobora gukoresha igikorwa ubwenge, ubumenyi n’ubuhinga, maze agasigarana ivyiwe vyose uwutabiruhiye. N’ibi na vyo ni ubusa kandi ni ikibi gikomeye.
Umuntu yunguka iki mu butame n’umwitwarariko yagize musi y’izuba?
Imisi yose y’ubutame bwiwe ni umubabaro n’amaganya; no mw’ijoro umutima wiwe nturuhuka. N’ibi na vyo ni ubusa.
Nta co umuntu ashobora gukora kiruta kurya n’ukunywa no kunezerererwa igikorwa ciwe. N’iki na co, ndabona ko kiva mu kiganza c’Imana,
kuko itarimwo, ni nde yorya akanezerwa?

Ku wuyihimbaye, Imana itanga ubwenge, ukumenya n’umunezero, ariko iha umunyavyaha igikorwa co kwegeranya no kurundanya ubutunzi kugira ngo aze abihe uwuhimbara Imana. N’iki na co ni ubusa, ni ukwiruka inyuma y’umuyaga.
Ikintu cose cashingiwe igihe caco, hari igihe c’igikorwa cose kibera musi y’ijuru:
igihe co kuvuka n’igihe co gupfa, igihe co gutera n’igihe co kurandura icatewe,
igihe co kwica n’igihe co gukiza, igihe co gusambura n’igihe co kwubaka,
igihe co kurira n’igihe co gutwenga, igihe co kugandara n’igihe co gutamba,
igihe co gusanzaza amabuye n’igihe co kuyegeranya, igihe co kugumbirana n’igihe co kwigirana kure,
igihe co kurondera n’igihe co gutakaza, igihe co kuzigama n’igihe co gushiburira kure,
igihe co gutabura n’igihe co kubarira, igihe co guhora n’igihe co kuvuga,
igihe co gukunda n’igihe co kwanka, igihe c’intambara n’igihe c’amahoro.
Umukozi yunguka iki mu butame bwiwe?
Nabonye umutwaro Imana yaremetse abantu twese.
Yatumye ikintu cose kiba ciza mu gihe caco. Kandi yashizeho ibihe bidashira mu mitima y’abantu; ariko ntibashobora gutahura ivyo Imana yakoze kuva mu ntango gushika kw’iherezo.
Ndazi ko ku bantu ata kiruta kunezerwa no gukora ivyiza bakiriho.
Iyi ni yo ngabire y’Imana, ni uko umuntu wese arya akanywa, agahimba mu bivuye mu butame bwiwe bwose.
Ndazi ko ivyo Imana ikora bizohoraho ibihe vyose; nta na kimwe cokwongerwako kuri vyo kandi nta na kimwe cokurwako. Imana yabikoze gutyo kugira ngo abantu bayubahe.
Ikiriho cose carigeze kubaho; n’ikizobaho carabayeho kera; kandi Imana ihamagara akahise ngo kagaruke.
Kandi hari n’ikindi kintu nabonye musi y’izuba: mu gishingo c’imanza zibereye, hari ubukozi bw’ikibi, mu gishingo c’ubutungane, hari ubukozi bw’ikibi.
Nariyumviriye mu mutima wanje nti: "Imana izoshira mu rubanza abagororotsi n’abanyakibi, kuko hazoba igihe c’ikintu cose, igihe c’urubanza ku gikorwa cose."
Nariyumviriye kandi nti: "n’abantu na bo, Imana irabapima ngo bamenye ko bameze nk’ibikoko.
Ibishikira abantu ni nk’ibishikira ibikoko; nta tandukaniro kuri vyompi: uko kimwe gipfa ni ko n’ikindi gipfa. Vyose bifise impwemu zimwe; nta co umuntu arushije igikoko. Vyose ni ubusa.
Vyose bija mu kibanza kimwe; vyose biva mu mukungugu, kandi bigasubira mu mukungugu.
Ni nde azi ko impwemu z’abantu ziduga mw’ijuru, canke impwemu z’ibikoko zimanuka zija i kuzimu?"
Nuko mbona ko ata kintu kiruta ko umuntu anezererwa igikorwa ciwe, kuko ari vyo yagerewe. None ni nde azomuha kubona ibizobaho inyuma yiwe?

Narongeye kandi ndaraba mbona agacinyizo kose gakorerwa musi y’izuba: Nabonye amosozi y’abacinyizwa, kandi ata muntu wo kubahoza bafise; ubushobozi bwari bufiswe n’ababacinyiza, kandi nta muntu wo kubahoza bari bafise.
Maze nca ndavuga ko abapfuye, abamaze gupfa, bahiriwe kurusha abazima, kurusha abakiriho.
Ariko uwurusha abo bompi guhirwa ni uwutarabaho, uwutarabona ikibi gikorerwa musi y’izuba.
Kandi nabonye ko ubutame bw’umuntu bwose n’ivyo ashikako vyose bidudubiza biva mu kwipfuza ivya mugenziwe. N’iki na co ni ubusa, ni ukwiruka inyuma y’umuyaga.
Ibipfu bipfunya amaboko yavyo bikaba vyiranduye vyo nyene.
Kugira igipfunsi kimwe cuzuye itekane, biruta ibipfunsi bibiri birimwo ubutame no kwiruka inyuma y’umuyaga.
Nongeye kubona ikintu na co nyene ari ubusa musi y’izuba:

Ni umuntu nyamwigendako; atagira umuhungu canke umuvukanyi. Ubutame bwiwe ntibwagira iherezo, ariko amaso yiwe ntiyahazwa n’itunga ryiwe. Yaribajije ati: "Ndiko ndaruhira nde, kandi ni kuki nibuza umunezero?" N’ibi na vyo ni ubusa, ni ibikorwa vy’ubutindi!
Babiri baruta umwe, kuko baronka inyungu nziza mu gikorwa cabo:
Umwe atemvye, mugenziwe ashobora kumuvyura. Ariko haragowe umuntu atemba ntagire n’umwe wo kumuvyura!
Vyongeye, iyo babiri baryamanye, barasusuruka. Ariko umwe yosusuruka ate?
Ariko nimba umuntu yoshobora kunesha umwe, babiri bashobora kwigwanira. Mbere batatu barushaho kuko ikiziriko c’imigozi itatu ntigicika vyoroshe.
Wopfuma ubona umukene akiri muto kandi afise ubwenge, hako ubona umwami ashaje kandi w’igipfu atemera impanuro.
Uwo musore ashobora kuba yavuye mw’ibohero akaba umwami, canke akaba yavukiye mu bukene muri ubwo bwami.
Nabonye ko ababa musi y’izuba bakunda kugenda bakurikira uwo musore iyo babona ari hafi kuja ku ngoma.
Aba ari imbere y’abantu benshi, ariko abo mu runganwe ruzokurikira ntibazomunezererwa. N’ibi na vyo ni ubusa, ni ukwiruka inyuma y’umuyaga.
Urinde intambuko zawe niwaja mu nzu y’Imana. Utege amatwi wumvirize kuko ivyo ari vyiza kuruta ugutanga ibimazi kw’ibipfu, kuko ntibimenya ko bikora nabi.
Ntiwihute kuvuga usezerana, ntiwihute mu mutima wawe, ngo wihutire gusezerana imbere y’Imana. Kuko Imana iri mw’ijuru nawe uri kw’isi, nuko rero amajambo yawe abe make.
Nk’uko inzozi ziza ku muntu yiganyira cane, ni ko bigenda kw’ijambo ry’igipfu kivuga menshi.
Niwasezerana isezerano imbere y’Imana, ntutebe kurishitsa. Ntinezerwa n’ibipfu; uze ushitse indahiro yawe.
Ni vyiza kutagira ico usezerana hako usezerana ntushitse ico wasezeranye.
Akanwa kawe ntikakujane mu caha. Kandi ntuze wivuguruze imbere y’intumwa yo mu Ngoro ngo: "Narihenze." Ni kubera iki Imana yokurakira ku vyo wavuze igasambura igikorwa c’intoke zawe?
Inzozi nyinshi n’amajambo menshi ni ubusa. Nuko rero tinya Imana.

Niwabona umukene acinyizwa mu ntara, kandi uguca imanza zibereye n’agateka k’abantu bikibagirwa, ntibize bigutangaze; kuko umutware ashinzwe ijisho n’uwumutwara na we, kandi hejuru yabo bompi hari abandi babatwara, ubutungane bukanyikira hagati y’abafata ingingo.
Inyungu zo mu vyimburwa zitwarwa na bose; n’umwami ubwiwe aronka ku bivuye mu mirima.
Inkunzi y’amahera ntiyigera iyahaga; n’uwukunda ubutunzi ntiyigera ahazwa n’ivyo aronka. N’iki na co ni ubusa.
Ubutunzi nibwagwira, ni ko n’ababurya bazogwira. Kandi nyenebwo yunguka iki muri bwo atari ukunezereza amaso yiwe aburaba?
Agatiro k’umukozi kararyoshe, arya bike canke vyinshi, ariko ibihinda vy’umutunzi ntibimwemerera gusinzira.
Nabonye ikibi gikomeye musi y’izuba: Ni umuntu yazigamye itunga, na ryo rikamutera amagorwa,
canke agatakaza ubwo butunzi mu rudandazwa rubi, maze umuhungu wiwe ntagire ico asigarana.
Umuntu ava mu nda ya nyina yambaye ubusa, kandi uko yaje ni ko agenda. Nta co ajana mu vyo yaruhiye nta co atwara mu ntoke.
N’iki na co ni ikibi kirenze urugero: uko umuntu aza, ni ko agenda, none yunguka iki, kuko acumukurira umuyaga?
Arira imisi yiwe yose mu mwiza, no mu mubabaro mwinshi, amarushwa n’uburake.
Maze nsanga ari vyiza kandi bibereye ko umuntu arya akanywa, akinezereza mu butame bwiwe bwose agirira musi y’izuba mu misi mike y’ubuzima bwiwe Imana yamuhaye, kuko ari wo mugabane wiwe.
Vyongeye, mu gihe Imana ihaye umuntu itunga n’ibintu vyinshi, ikamwemerera kubinezererwamwo, ngo yakire umugabane wiwe yongere anezererwe igikorwa ciwe, iyo ni ingabire y’Imana.
Ni gake umuntu yiyumvira ku misi y’ubuzima bwiwe ingene ari mike, igihe Imana yujuje umutima wiwe umunezero.
Nabonye ikindi kibi musi y’izuba, kandi kiremereye abantu:

Imana iha umuntu ubutunzi bwinshi, n’icubahiro, kugira ngo ntagire ico akena mu vyo umutima wiwe wipfuza, ariko Imana ntimwemerere kubinezererwamwo, maze kavantara akaba ari we abinezererwamwo. Ivyo ni ubusa, ni ikibi giteye umubabaro.
Umuntu ashobora kugira abana ijana akaramba imyaka myinshi; ariko naho yoramba, adashobora kunezererwa ubutunzi bwiwe kandi ntahambwe neza, ndavuga nti arutwa n’ikivutse gihwereye.
Kivuka ari ubusa, kikazimirira mu mwiza, izina ryaco rikazimirira mu mwiza.
Naho kitigeze kibona izuba canke ngo kimenye ikintu na kimwe, kiraruhuka neza kurusha uwo muntu,
naho yoramba imyaka igihumbi incuro zibiri ariko ntanezererwe ubutunzi bwiwe. Mbega bose ntibaja hamwe?
Igituma umuntu atama ni ukugira ngo aronke ico arya, ariko ntiyigera ahaga.
None umunyabwenge arusha iki igipfu? Umukene yunguka iki mu kumenya ingene yigenza imbere y’abandi?
Ivyo ijisho ribona biruta ukwipfuza kw’akayabagu. N’ivyo na vyo ni ubusa, ni ukwiruka inyuma y’umuyaga.
Ikiriho cose caramaze kwitwa izina, kandi ico umuntu ari camenywe kera; nta muntu ashobora guharira n’umuntu amurusha inkomezi.
Uko umuntu avuga menshi, ni ko avuga ibitagira ikimazi, none ivyo bimarira iki umuntu?
None ni nde yoshobora kumenya icoba ciza mu buzima bw’umuntu, mu misi yiwe y’ubusa imeze nk’igitutu? Ni nde yomubwira ikizobaho musi y’izuba amaze gupfa?
Kuvugwa neza bifise agaciro kuruta imibavu imota neza, kandi umusi wo gupfa uruta umusi wo kuvuka.
Kuja mu nzu y’ikigandaro biruta kuja mu nzu y’ibirori, kuko urupfu ari iwabo wa twese; ni vyiza ko abariho babishira ku mutima.
Umubabaro uruta ibitwengo, kuko kugira mu maso hijiriwe bihingura umutima.
Umutima w’abanyabwenge wiyumvira ivyo mu nzu y’abagandaye, ariko umutima w’ibipfu wiyumvira ivyo mu nzu y’ibirori.
Ni vyiza kwumviriza igikangiro c’umunyabwenge kuruta kwumviriza indirimbo z’ibipfu.
Nk’uko amahwa aturagurikira mu muriro, ni ko n’ugutwenga kw’ibipfu kumera. N’ico na co ni ubusa.
Gucinyiza abandi bihindura umunyabwenge igipfu, kandi igiturire conona ingeso nziza.
Iherezo ry’ikintu riruta intango yaco, kandi ukwihangana kuruta ubwibone.
Ntiwihute kuraka muri wewe, kuko uburake buba mu mitima y’ibipfu.
Ntukavuge ngo: "Ni kuki imisi ya kera yari myiza kurusha iy’ubu?" Kuko ata bwenge buri mu kubaza ibibazo nk’ivyo.
Ubwenge, ni nk’iragi, ni ikintu ciza kandi bugirira ikimazi uwubona izuba wese.
Ubwenge ni ubwugamo nk’uko amahera ari ubwugamo, ariko inyungu y’ukumenya ni iyi: ni uko ubwenge buzigama ubuzima bw’uwubufise.
Raba ivyo Imana yakoze: Ni nde yogorora ico yagoramitse?

Iyo ibihe ari vyiza, nezerwa; ariko iyo bibaye bibi, menya ibi: Imana ni yo yashizeho ivyo bihe vya mbere nk’uko ari yo yashizeho n’ivyo vya kabiri. Nuko rero, umuntu ntashobora kumenya ikintu na kimwe ca kazoza kiwe.
Muri ubu buzima bw’akanya gato ibi vyompi narabibonye: umugororotsi apfira mu bugororotsi bwiwe, n’umunyakibi arambana ubukozi bw’ikibi bwiwe.
Nuko rero ntiwigire intungane birengeje, kandi ntiwigire umunyabwenge arengeje, ni igiki cotuma wiyica?
Ntiwigire umunyavyaha arengeje, kandi ntiwigire igipfu, ni iki cotuma upfa hataragera?
Ni vyiza ko ukurikira kimwe ariko n’ikindi ntukireke. Uwubaha Imana azokwirinda kurenza urugero.
Ubwenge butuma umunyabwenge aba umunyabushobozi kurusha abantu cumi baganza mu gisagara.
Nta mugororotsi kw’isi akora ibigororotse gusa ntacumure.
Nturondere kwumva ivyo abantu bavuga vyose, kuko wohava wumva umukozi wawe akuvuma,
kuko uzi mu mutima wawe ko nawe ubwawe kenshi wavumye abandi.
Ivyo vyose nabigerageresheje ubwenge maze ndavuga nti: "Mpisemwo kuba umunyabwenge." Ariko ivyo vyari bindengeye.
Uko ubwenge bwomera kwose, bushika kure, ni nde yobumenya?
Maze mpindukiriza umutima wanje ku gutahura, ngo ndondere kandi ntohoze ivyerekeye ubwenge n’iminyuro y’ibintu nongere ntahure ubupfu bw’ikibi n’ubusazi n’ubupfu.

Nsanga ikirusha urupfu kurura ni umugore yikwegerako abagabo, umutima wiwe umeze nk’umutego amaboko yiwe akamera nk’iminyororo. Umuntu yubaha Imana ni we wenyene azomuva mu maboko, ariko umunyavyaha we ntazomwifatura.
Umusiguzi aravuga ati: "Raba, ibi ni vyo namenye: maze kurabira ibintu mu nzira zose kugira ngo menye.
Nkiriko ndarondera ariko ntarabona, nasanze umugabo w’umugororotsi umwe mu gihumbi, ariko nta mugore n’umwe agororotse nabonye muri bo.
Iki ni co conyene nabonye: Imana yaremye abantu bagororotse, ariko abantu bironderera inzira nyinshi zigoramye."
Ni nde ameze nk’umunyabwenge? Ni nde azi insiguro y’ibintu? Ubwenge butuma mu maso h’umuntu haca, bugatuma ukwijirirwa kuvaho.
Wubahe itegeko ry’umwami, kuko warahiye imbere y’Imana ko uzobikora.
Ntiwihute kuva imbere y’umwami, kandi ntuhaguruke ku bw’inyanduruko mbi, kuko ashobora gukora ikimuhimbaye cose.
Kubera ijambo ry’umwami riruta ayandi yose, ni nde yomubwira ngo: "Ivyo ukora ni ibiki?"
Uwumvira amabwirizwa yiwe wese ntazogira ingorane, kandi umunyabwenge azomenya igihe gikwiye n’uburyo bwo kubikora.
Kuko hari igihe gikwiye n’uburyo bwo gukora ikintu cose, naho ubworo bw’umuntu buremera cane.
Ko ata n’umwe azi ibizoba ejo, none ni nde yobwira uwundi ibigira bibe?

Nta n’umwe ashobora kugumya impwemu yiwe ngo ntigende, ni co gituma ata n’umwe afise ububasha bwo kwigizayo umusi wo gupfa kwiwe. Muri iyo ntambara nta buryo bwo guhunga, kandi n’ubukozi bw’ikibi ntibushobora gutabara ababukoresha.
Ivyo vyose narabibonye, mu gihe nariko ndiyumvira ku bikorerwa musi y’izuba vyose. Hari igihe umuntu aganza abandi bikamutera amagorwa.
Kandi nabonye abanyakibi bahambanwa icubahiro; abahora baja mu Ngoro y’Imana maze bagashimagizwa n’abantu bo mu gisagara bakoreyemwo ibibi. N’ibi na vyo ni ubusa.
Iyo urubanza rw’icaha rudaciwe vuba, imitima y’abantu yuzura imigabo yo gukora ibibi.
Naho umunyakibi yokora ibibi ijana kandi akaramba, ndazi neza ko abubaha Imana, bafise ugutinya Imana mu mitima, ivyabo bizogenda neza kurusha.
Ariko kuko ata kwubaha Imana kw’abanyakibi, nta mahoro kuri bo, kandi imisi yabo izoyonga nk’igitutu.

Hari n’ikindi kibera kw’isi na co nyene ari ubusa: ni abagororotsi baronka ibihano vyari bikwiye abanyakibi, abanyakibi na bo bakaronka impera yari ikwiye abagororotsi. Ivyo na vyo, ndabivuze, ko ari ubusa.

Nuko ico nzi ntakekeranya ni uko umuntu akwiye kunezerererwa ubuzima, kuko ata kindi ku muntu ari musi y’izuba kiruta kurya no kunywa no kunezerwa. Maze umunezero uzomuherekeza mu gikorwa ciwe imisi yiwe yose yo kubaho Imana yamuhaye musi y’izuba.
Igihe nashira umutima ku kumenya ubwenge no kuraba ubutame bw’umuntu kw’isi, amaso yiwe ntaronke agatiro ku murango no mw’ijoro,

nabonye ivyo Imana yakoze. Nta n’umwe ashobora gutahura ivyo Imana ikorera musi y’izuba. Naho agerageza kubirondera, umuntu ntashobora kumenya insiguro yavyo. Naho umunyabwenge avuga ko abizi, ntashobora kubitahura.
Nariyumviriye kuri ivyo vyose nsanga umugororotsi n’umunyabwenge bompi n’ivyo bakora vyose biri mu kuboko kw’Imana, ariko nta n’umwe azi nimba urukundo canke urwanko bimurindiriye.

Iherezo ni rimwe kuri bose, umugororotsi n’umunyakibi, abeza n’ababi, uwuhumanye n’uwudahumanye, abatanga ibimazi n’abatabitanga. Nk’uko bimera ku muntu mwiza, ni ko bimera no ku munyavyaha; uko bimeze ku wusezerana, ni ko bimera no ku wutinya gusezerana.

Iki ni ikibi kiri mu bintu vyose bibera musi y’izuba: bose bafise iherezo rimwe. Vyongeye, imitima y’abantu yuzuye ibibi kandi mu mitima yabo huzuye ubusazi mu gihe bakiriho, maze iherezo bagahamvya abapfuye.
Umuntu wese akiri muzima afise ivyizigiro, kandi imbwa nzima iruta intambwe ipfuye!
Kuko abariho bobo barazi ko bazopfa, ariko abapfuye nta na kimwe bazi; nta yindi ngero biteze, kandi ntibasubira kwibukwa.
Urukundo rwabo, urwanko rwabo n’ishari ryabo vyaribagiranywe; nta mugabane na mutoya bazosubira kuronka mu biba musi y’izuba.
Genda, urye ivyokurya vyawe unezerewe, kandi unywe umuvinyu wawe n’umutima unezerewe, kuko ari ubu nyene Imana inezererwa ivyo ukora.
Wame wambaye impuzu zera, kandi wisige amavuta ku mutwe.
Nezererwa ubuzima hamwe n’umugore wawe ukunda, imisi yose y’ubu buzima butoya Imana yaguhaye musi y’izuba. Kuko ivyo ari vyo mugabane wawe mu buzima no mu butame bwawe musi y’izuba.
Ibintu vyose amaboko yawe ahawe gukora, ubikore n’inkomezi zawe zose, kuko mu mva, iyo uzoja, ata gukora canke imigambi, kumenya canke ubwenge.

Hari ikindi nabonye musi y’izuba. Abanyaruka si bo batsinda mw’ihiganwa, mbere si n’abakomeye mu ntambara. Abanyabwenge si bo baronka ivyokurya, mbere si n’abakerebutse baronka itunga, si n’abize baronka amahirwe; kuko ivyago n’uguhirwa bishika kuri bose.
Vyongeye, nta muntu azi igihe isaha yiwe izoshikira. Nk’uko ifi zifatwa mu rusenga, canke inyoni zigafatwa n’umutego, ni ko n’abantu bafatwa n’ibihe bibi bibashikako giturumbuka.
Kandi nabonye musi y’izuba akandi karorero k’ubwenge kantangaje:
Kera hariho igisagara kimwe kandi gitoya, carimwo abantu bakeya. Maze giterwa n’umwami akomeye, aragikikuza akirundira ibigunguzi vyo kwuririrako ngo agitere.
Muri ico gisagara harimwo umuntu w’umukene ariko w’umunyabwenge, maze akirisha igihugu ubwenge bwiwe. Ariko nta n’umwe yasubiye kwibuka uwo mukene.
Maze ndavuga nti: "Ubwenge buruta inkomezi." Ariko bwa bwenge bwa wa mukene bwarakengerewe, kandi amajambo yiwe ntiyasubiye kwibukwa.
Amajambo yiyoroheje y’umunyabwenge aruta gukankama kw’umutware w’ibipfu.
Ubwenge buruta ibigwanisho vy’intambara, ariko umunyavyaha umwe asambura ivyiza vyinshi.
Nk’uko isazi zipfiriye mu mavuta zituma anuka, ni ko n’ubupfu bukeya buhindura ubusa ubwenge n’icubahiro.
Umutima w’umunyabwenge uhengamira i buryo, ariko umutima w’igipfu uhengamira i bubamfu.
No mu gihe igipfu kigendagenda mu nzira, kigenda ata bwenge kandi abantu bose barabona ubupfu bwaco.
Uburake bw’uwukuganza nibwaba bwinshi, ntuze uve ku kirindiro cawe; ukwitonda kwawe gushobora gutuma uharirwa ibibi vyinshi.
Hari ikibi nabonye musi y’izuba, ni akarenganyo gatewe n’uwuganza:
Ibipfu bishirwa mu bibanza vyo hejuru, ariko abatunzi bagashirwa hasi.
Nabonye abagurano bagendera ku mafarasi, ariko abaganwa bagenda n’amaguru nk’abagurano.
Uwimba ikinogo azokigwamwo; kandi uwumena uruhome ashobora gukomorwa n’inzoka.
Uwutembagaza amabuye azomukomeretsa; kandi uwicira ibiti incabiti ishobora kumutera ingorane.
Incabiti niyapfuha ubugi bwayo ntibukarishwe, umuntu azoba akwiye gukoresha inkomezi nyinshi ariko ubuhinga butuma umuntu ashika ku vyo yateguye.
Inzoka igukomoye imbere y’uko igotwa, uwuyigota nta co aba akimaze.
Amajambo yo mu kanwa k’umunyabwenge yuzuye ubuntu, ariko iminwa y’igipfu izogihitana.
Mu ntango amajambo yaco ni ubupfu; ariko kw’iherezo ni ubusazi bubi,
kandi igipfu kigwiza amajambo. Nta n’umwe azi ibigira bibe, ni nde yomubwira ibizoba inyuma yiwe?
Igikorwa c’igipfu kizomuremera; kuko atazi inzira ija mu gisagara.
Uragowe, wa gihugu we, umwami wawe yari umushumba, abaganwa bawe bakinezereza kuva mu gitondo.
Urahiriwe, wa gihugu we, umwami wawe yavutse ari umuganwa, abaganwa bawe bakinezereza igihe gikwiye kigeze, kugira ngo bagire inkomezi atari ukugira ngo baborerwe.
Umuntu niyaba umunebwe, inzu yiwe izosambuka; kandi niyarera amaboko, inzu yiwe izova.
Umusi mukuru utera kunezerwa, kandi umuvinyu utuma unezereza ubuzima, ariko amahera ni inyishu ku bintu vyose.
Ntuvuge umwami nabi naho hoba mu vyiyumviro, canke ngo uvume umutunzi uri mu buriri bwawe, kuko inyoni yohava itwara amajambo yawe, kandi inyoni yo mu kirere yohava imenyesha ivyo wavuze.
Terera ivyokurya vyawe ku mazi, inyuma y’imisi myinshi uzokwironkera inyungu.
Shira umutahe wawe ahantu indwi, mbere umunani, kuko utazi igihe ivyago bishobora kuzozirako mu gihugu.
Iyo ibicu vyuzuye amazi, bituma imvura igwa kw’isi. Igiti gishobora kugwa cerekeye mu bumanuko canke mu buraruko, kandi aho kiguye ni ho kizoguma kiryamye.
Uwuraba umuyaga ntazobiba; kandi uwuraba ibicu ntazokwimbura.
Uko utazi inzira y’umuyaga, canke uko umwana akurira mu nda ya nyina wiwe, ni ko udashobora gutahura igikorwa c’Imana, umuremyi w’ibintu vyose.
Biba imbuto zawe mu gitondo, no ku mugoroba nturere amaboko, kuko utazi izizokwera, nimba ari izi canke ziriya, canke ko zose zizomera neza.
Umuco ni mwiza, kandi biranezera amaso kubona izuba.
Igihe abantu baramvye bakamara imyaka myinshi, baze bayinezerererwe yose. Ariko baze bame bibuka imisi y’umwijima, kuko izoba myinshi, kandi ivyitezwe vyose bikaba ari ubusa.

Ewe muntu ukiri muto, nezererwa ubwo buto bwawe, kandi ukore ibinezereza umutima wawe mu misi y’ubuto bwawe. Ukurikire inzira z’umutima wawe, n’ibintu vyose amaso yawe akwereka, ariko umenye ko muri ivyo vyose, Imana izokurengutsa mu rubanza.
Nuko rero, irinde kugira amaganya mu mutima wawe ushire kure y’umubiri wawe ikibi cose, kuko ubuto no kugira inkomezi ari ubusa.
Uze wame wibuka umuremyi wawe mu misi y’ubuto bwawe, imisi mibi itaraza n’imyaka itarashika aho uzovuga uti: "Ntibikinezereza";
izuba n’umuco n’ukwezi n’inyenyeri bitaracura umwijima, n’ibicu bitaragaruka imvura ihise;
aho abarinzi b’inzu bajugumira, abanyenkomezi bakunama, abasyi bagahagarika gusya kuko babaye bake, n’abarungurukira mu madirisha bagahuma;
aho inzugi ziraba kw’ibarabara zugarwa, ijwi ry’urusyo rigahora; aho abantu bavyuka inyoni zivuze, ariko indirimbo zabo zose zikagenda zigabanuka;

aho abantu bazotinya imisozi n’ibiteye ubwoba vyo mu nzira; mu gihe igiti ca alumonde gishurika, igihori kikikwega mu nzira, n’ibirungo ntibibe bikiryoha. Maze umuntu agataha iwabo h’ibihe vyose, abamuririra bakaba benshi mu nzira.
Umwibuke, urunyuzi rw’ifeza ari bwo buzima rutaracika, n’igikombe c’inzahabu kitarameneka; n’umubindi utaramenekera kw’ivomo, umugozi wo gukwega amazi utaracikira kw’iriba,
n’umukungugu ugasubira mw’ivu aho wavuye, impwemu igasubira ku Mana yayitanze.
"Ni ubusa! Ni ubusa!" Ni ko umusiguzi avuga. "Vyose ni ubusa!"
Umusiguzi ntiyari umunyabwenge gusa, ariko kandi yigishije abantu ukumenya. Yaragerageje kurondera maze ashira ku rutonde imigani myinshi.
Umusiguzi yarondeye gushiraho amajambo atunganye, kandi ivyo yanditse vyari bigororotse kandi ari ivy’ukuri.
Amajambo y’abanyabwenge ameze nk’imambo, imigani yabo na yo ni nk’imisumari itewe neza, itangwa n’Umwungere umwe.
Mwana wanje, hanurwa wumve ku kintu cose ciyongera kuri yo. Ukwandika ibitabu vyinshi ntibigira iherezo, kandi kwiga cane kuruhisha umubiri.
Vyose vyarumviswe; iyi ni yo ndunduro ya vyose: Wubahe Imana witondere amabwirizwa yayo, kuko ari co kibereye ku muntu.
Kuko Imana izoshira mu rubanza igikorwa cose, harimwo n’ibintu bihishijwe vyose, ari bibi canke ari vyiza.

name: Indirimbo
chapters: Indirimbo iruta izindi ya Salomo. Umugeni
Nunsomeshe iminwa yawe, kuko urukundo rwawe ruryoshe kuruta umuvinyu.
Ugutamirana kw’ibimota vyawe ni kwiza; izina ryawe ni nk’ibimota neza bisutswe. Ni co gituma abigeme bagukunda.

Nkwega ukuboko, twiruke! Umwami nantware mu cumba ciwe. Abakobwa b’i Yerusalemu Turakunezererwa kandi uraduhimbara; mwami. Tuzohimbaza urukundo rwawe kuruta umuvinyu. Umugeni Ni vyo birababereye ko bagukunda!
Ndirabura, ariko ndi mwiza, yemwe bakobwa b’i Yerusalemu, nirabura nk’amahema y’i Kedari, nsa n’impuzu nziza zigize amahema ya Salomo.
Ntimunkengere kuko nirabura, kuko nirabujwe n’izuba. Basazanje barandakiye bandungika kurinda imizabibu yabo; maze siniraba jewe ubwanje, kandi sinitaho uruzabibu rwanje.
Mbwira, yewe mukunzi wanje, mbega uragira hehe umukuku wawe uno musi? Mu mashoka uzivyagiza hehe? Ni kubera iki norinda kuba nk’umugore yazimiye, i ruhande y’imikuku ya bagenzawe? Abagenzi
Niwaba utahazi, yewe mugore mwiza kuruta abandi bagore, kurikirana amakanda y’intama zanje kandi uturukirize imyagazi y’impene zawe i ruhande y’amahema y’abungere. Umukwe
Mukunzi wanje, ndakugereranya n’ifarasi ikwega umwe mu mikogote ya Farawo.
Mbega ukuntu nkunda amatama yawe, ni meza hagati y’impeta zo ku matwi yawe, n’izosi ryawe ni ryiza hagati mu migufu.
Tuzogucurira amahereni yo ku matwi y’inzahabu, zisharijwe n’ifeza. Umugeni
Umwami akiri ku kigwa ciwe, amavuta yanje yaratamiranye.
Umukunzi wanje, kuri jewe ameze nk’umukama w’ibimota neza uryamye hagati y’amabere yanje.
Umukunzi wanje, kuri jewe ameze nk’ishurwe ryitwa ikirungu iyo gishuritse mu mizabibu y’i Eni-Gedi. Umukwe
Ese ingene uri mwiza, mukunzi wanje! Ese ingene uri mwiza! Amaso yawe asa n’ay’akanuma kitwa kolombe. Umugeni
Ese ukuntu uri mwiza, mukunzi wanje! Ese ukuntu unezera! Kandi uburiri bwacu busa n’umurima utotahaye. Umukwe
Inkingi z’inzu yacu ni amasederi; kandi igisenge c’inzu yacu ni utujwari.
Ndi ishurwe, ikirungu c’i Sharoni, ishurwe ryo mu biyaya. Umukwe
Nk’uko ishurwe rimera iyo riri hagati mu mahwa ni ko umukunzi wanje ameze hagati mu bandi bakobwa. Umugeni
Nk’uko igiti c’ivyamwa vyitwa pome kimera mu biti vyo mw’ishamba ni ko umukunzi wanje ameze hagati mu bandi basore. Nezerwa no kwicara mu gitutu ciwe, kandi ivyamwa vyiwe biransosera.
Yanjanye mu nzu y’ibirori, aca aduza hejuru yanje ibendera ry’urukundo.
Nsubizamwo intege ukoresheje inzabibu, zimya inyota yanje n’ivyamwa vyitwa pome, kuko urukundo runtwaye inkomezi.
Ukuboko kwiwe kw’i bubamfu kuranseguye, ukuboko kwiwe kw’i buryo kurambumbatiye.
Bakobwa b’i Yerusalemu ndabihanikirije, ingeregere n’impongokazi vyo mw’ishamba vyumva: Ntimukome urukundo canke ngo murukangure, gushika rwishakiye kuvyuka.
Umviriza! Ndumva umukunzi wanje! Raba! Araje, yiginagura ku misozi, asimbagurika ku dusozi.
Umukunzi wanje ameze nk’ingeregere canke nk’inyana y’impongo. Raba! Ahagaze hariya inyuma y’uruzitiro, arungurukira mu madirisha, arungurukira mu rusika.
Umukunzi wanje ambwira ati: "Haguruka, mukunzi wanje, mwiza wanje, uze aho ndi.
Raba! Urushana ruraheze; imvura irahise iracitse.
Amashurwe arashuritse kw’isi; igihe co kuririmba kirashitse, inuma ziraguguza kandi zirumvikana mu gihugu cacu.
Umusukoni uratanguye kwama; imizabibu ishuritse iratamirana ugutamirana kwayo. Haguruka uze, mukunzi wanje; mwiza wanje, uze aho ndi." Umukwe
Kanuma kanje kinyegeje mu bitandara, mu bibundo vyo ku musozi, nyereka mu maso hawe, nyumvisha ijwi ryawe; kuko ijwi ryawe riryoshe, mu maso hawe hakaba ah’igikundiro.
Nimudufatire imbwebwe, utubwebwe dutoduto twonona imizabibu, kandi imizabibu yacu ishuritse. Umugeni
Umukunzi wanje ni uwanje, nanje ndi uwiwe; aragira mu mashurwe.
Gushika umutwenzi utambitse ijoro riheze, hindukira mukunzi wanje, ube nk’ingeregere canke nk’inyana y’impongo mu bitandara vyo ku misozi.
Mw’ijoro ndi ku buriri bwanje narondeye uwo umutima wanje ukunda; naramurondeye sinamuronka.
Ngira mvyuke ubu nyene nzunguruke mu gisagara, mu mabarabara yaco no mu bibuga vyaco; ndondere uwo umutima wanje ukunda. Maze ndamurondera ariko ndamubura.
Abarinzi barinda igisagara barambona aho bariko barazunguruka igisagara. "Mwamboneye uwo umutima wanje ukunda?"
Nkibarengana ni ho nabona uwo umutima wanje ukunda. Ndamufata kandi nanka kumurekura gushika aho namushikanye mu nzu ya mama, mu cumba c’uwanyibungenze.
Bakobwa b’i Yerusalemu ndabihanikirije, ingeregere n’impongokazi vyo mw’ishamba vyumva: Ntimukome urukundo canke ngo murukangure, gushika rwishakiye kuvyuka.
Ni nde aje avuye mu bugaragwa ameze nk’inkingi y’umwotsi, yisize ibimota neza vyakozwe mu bimota vyose vy’abadandaza?
Raba! Ni umukogote wa Salomo, ukikijwe n’abagwanyi mirongo itandatu, b’intore zo mu Bisirayeli,
bose bambaye inkota, kandi bamenyereye kugwana, umwe wese yambaye inkota yiwe kw’itako, biteguye kugwanya ibiteye ubwoba vyo mw’ijoro.
Umwami Salomo yikoreye umukogote; yawukoze mu biti vy’i Libani.
Ufise inkingi z’ifeza, umushinge wawo ni uw’inzahabu. Intebe yawo yasa n’agahama, imbere muri wo hashazishijwe urukundo n’abakobwa b’i Yerusalemu.
Nimusohoke, yemwe bakobwa b’i Siyoni, murabe umwami Salomo yambaye urugori, urwo nyina yamwambitse ku musi w’ubukwe bwiwe, ku musi umutima wiwe wanezerwa.
Ese ingene uri mwiza, mukunzi wanje! Mbega ukuntu uri mwiza! Amaso yawe ari mu mwitwikiro ameze nk’ay’inuma yitwa kolombe. Umushatsi wawe umeze nk’umukuku w’impene umanuka ku musozi Gileyadi.
Amenyo yawe yera nk’umukuku w’intama zamowe ubwoya, ziduga zivuye kwoga. Imwe yose yonsa amahasa; nta n’imwe iri yonyene.
Iminwa yawe isa n’umugozi w’agahama; akanwa kawe ni keza. Amatama yawe mu mwitwikiro ni nk’ibimanyu vy’ikomamanga.
Izosi ryawe rimeze nk’umunara wa Dawidi, wubatswe nk’umuzingi; kuri wo hamanitse inkinzo igihumbi, zose zari iz’abahizi.
Amabere yawe yompi ameze nk’inyana zibiri, nk’amahasa y’inyana z’ingeregere, zirisha hagati mu mashurwe.
Gushika umutwenzi utambike ijoro rishize, nzoguma ku musozi w’ibimota neza vyawe no ku gasozi k’ibitamirana neza.
Uri mwiza hose, mwiza wanje; nta gatosi kari kuri wewe.
Nuze tuve i Libani, mugeni wanje, nuze tuve i Libani. Manuka uve ku gatwe ka Amana, ku gatwe ka Seniri, ku gatwe ka Herumoni, aho intambwe zifise ibinogo zibamwo ahari uburyamo bw’ingwe.
Wantwaye umutima, mushikanje, mugeni wanje; wantwaye umutima ku bwo kuraba kw’amaso yawe, kubera agatete kamwe ko ku rudede rwawe.
Ese ukuntu urukundo rwawe ari rwiza, mushikanje, mugeni wanje! Urukundo rwawe ruraryoshe kurusha umuvinyu, n’ukumota kw’amavuta yawe kuryoshe kurusha ibindi bimota vyose!
Iminwa yawe isosa nk’ikigigu c’ubuki, mugeni wanje; amata n’ubuki biri musi y’ururimi rwawe. Ukumota kw’impuzu zawe ni nk’ukw’i Libani.
Uri umurima uzitiye, mushikanje, mugeni wanje; uri iriba rizitiye, isoko rishizeko ikidodo.
Imivyaro yawe ni umurima w’amakomamanga w’ivyamwa vy’indobanurwa, aho hena na narada biri,
narada na safaroni, kalamusi na kinamoni, n’ibiti vyose bimota neza, n’isenga na alowe n’ibimota birusha ibindi.
Uri iriba rivomera umurima, iriba ry’amazi atemba atemba ava i Libani. Umugeni

Ikangure wa muyaga wo mu buraruko, nawe muyaga wo mu bumanuko, nuze! Muhuhe ku murima wanje, kugira ngo ubumote bwawo bukwire hose. Umukunzi wanje naze mu murima wiwe anezerererwe ivyamwa vyawo vy’indobanurwa.

Ninjiye mu murima wanje, mushikanje, mugeni wanje; negeranije isenga ryanje n’ibimota neza vyanje. Nariye n’ikigigu c’ubuki canje n’ubuki bwanje; nanyoye umuvinyu wanje n’amata yanje. Abagenzi Nimurye, yemwe bagenzi, kandi munywe; nimunywe muhage, ivy’urukundo. Umugeni

Nari nsinziriye ariko umutima wanje uri maso. Nca numva umukunzi wanje ariko aradodora: "Nyugururira, mushikanje, mukunzi wanje kanuma kanje, utagira agatosi. Kuko umutwe wanje watonzeko urume, umushatsi wanje ukaba watonzweko n’amatonyanga yo mw’ijoro."
Ko namaze kwambura umwambaro wanje, noshobora gusubira kuwambara? Ko namaze kwoga ibirenge, nosubira kuvyanduza?
Umukunzi wanje acisha ukuboko mu rugi; umutima wanje utangura gusimba ku bwiwe.
Ndavyuka ngo nugururire umukunzi wanje, kandi ibiganza vyanje vyajobetswe mu bimota neza, intoke zanje zajejeta isenga, aho nugurura urugi.
Maze nugururira umukunzi wanje, ariko umukunzi wanje si ho yari; yari yagiye. Umutima wanje unshongeramwo kuko yagiye. Ndamurondera ariko sinamuronka. Ndamuhamagara ariko ntiyishura.
Abarinzi baramfata aho bariko baragenzura igisagara. Barankubita, barankomeretsa; bantwara ikoti yanje, abo barinzi b’inzitiro!
Yemwe bakobwa b’i Yerusalemu, ndabihanikirije, mbega nimwambonera umukunzi wanje, muza kumubwira iki? Mumubwire ko urukundo rundembeje. Abagenzi
Umukunzi wawe arusha iki abandi, yewe wewe urusha abandi ubwiza? Umukunzi wawe aruta abandi gute, kugeza aho utwihanikiriza bigeze iyo? Umukwe
Umukunzi wanje ni mwiza kandi arakomeye, arisa wenyene mu bantu ibihumbi cumi.
Umutwe wiwe ni inzahabu yamazwe inkamba; umushatsi wiwe uratsivye kandi urirabura nk’igikona.
Amaso yiwe ni nk’ay’intunguru iyo turi ku migezi y’amazi, tumeze nk’utwogejwe mu mata, duhagaze nk’intete z’ibidede.
Amatama yiwe ni nk’uburiri buriko ibimota neza bugatamirana ibimotesha. Iminwa yiwe ni amashurwe atemba isenga.
Amaboko yiwe ni inkoni z’inzahabu zisharijwe n’utubuye twitwa kirisolito. Umubiri wiwe umeze nk’ihembe ry’inzovu risharijwe n’ibuye ry’agaciro ryitwa lapisi lazuli.
Amaguru yiwe ni nk’inkingi za marubule zashinzwe ku matanguriro y’inzahabu nziza. Mu maso hiwe hasa n’i Libani, hatoranijwe kubera amasederi yaho.
Akanwa kiwe karasosa gusa; eka ni umukundwa hose. Uyu ni umukunzi wanje, umugenzi wanje, yemwe bakobwa b’i Yerusalemu.
Umukunzi wawe yagiye hehe, yewe mugore urusha abandi bagore ubwiza? Umukunzi wawe yajanye iyihe nzira, kugira ngo tugufashe kumurondera? Umugeni
Umukunzi wanje yamanutse mu murima wiwe, ahari ibimota neza vyiwe, kuragira mu mirima, no kwamura amashurwe.
Ndi uw’umukunzi wanje n’umukunzi wanje ni uwanje; aragira mu mashurwe. Umukwe
Uri mwiza, mukunzi wanje, nk’igisagara c’i Tiriza, uri uw’igikundiro nk’i Yerusalemu, uteye ubwoba nk’ingabo zifise amabendera.
Hindukira ureke kundaba; kuko amaso yawe andengeye. Umushatsi wawe ni nk’umukuku w’impene umanuka uva i Gileyadi.
Amenyo yawe yera nk’umukuku w’intama zamowe ubwoya, ziduga zivuye kwoga. Imwe yose yonsa amahasa, nta n’imwe iri yonyene.
Amatama yawe ari mu mwitwikiro wawe ameze nk’ibice vy’ikomamanga.
Abamikazi naho boba mirongo itandatu, n’incoreke zikaba mirongo umunani, n’inkumi zirenze igitigiri;
ariko inanuma wanje, uwutagira agatosi, arisa, ni umukobwa umwe kuri nyina, ni umukundwa cane ku wamuvyaye. Abaguranokazi baramubonye bamwita umuhirwe; abamikazi n’incoreke baramuhimbaza. Abagenzi
Urya ni nde aserutse nk’umutwenzi, mwiza nk’ukwezi, akayagana nk’izuba, akayangana nk’inyenyeri? Umukwe
Namanutse nja mu biti vy’imirinzi ngo ndabe imivyaro yo mu kiyaya, ngo ndabe ko uruzabibu rwatotahaye, n’amakomamanga ko yashuritse.
Ariko ntarabimenya, ivyipfuzo vyanje vyantwaye ku mikogote y’umwami w’abantu banje. Abagenzi
Garuka, garuka, wa Munyashulamukazi we; garuka, garuka, kugira ngo tukwihweze! Umukwe Ni igiki cotuma mwihweza Umunyashulamukazi nko mu gihe co gutamba c’i Mahanayimu?
Ese ingene ibirenge vyawe ari vyiza mu birato vyavyo, yewe mukobwa w’umwami! Amaguru yawe meza ameze nk’ubudede, igikorwa cahinguwe n’amaboko y’umuhinga.
Urukenyerero rwawe rumeze nk’igikombe kitigera kiburamwo umuvinyu umota neza. Inda yawe ni ikirundo c’ingano gikikujwe n’amashurwe.
Amabere yawe yompi ameze nk’inyana zibiri, nk’amahasa y’ingeregere.
Izosi ryawe ni nk’umunara wubakishijwe amahembe y’inzovu. Amaso yawe ni amariba y’i Heshiboni ari i ruhande rw’i Bati Rabimu. Izuru ryawe ni nk’umunara w’i Libani werekeye i Damasiko.
Umutwe wawe ukubereye urugori nk’umusozi Karumeli. Umushatsi wawe ni nk’umusezero w’i bwami; umwami yafashwe mu bitsibo vyawo.
Ese ingene uri mwiza kandi uhimbaye, yewe rukundo rwanje, munezero wanje!
Igihagararo cawe ni nk’ikigazi, kandi amabere yawe ni nk’amahando y’ivyamwa vyaco.
Ndavuga nti: "Ndurira ico kigazi; nakire ku vyamwa vyaco." Amabere yawe arakaba nk’ibisoko vy’inzabibu, ukumota kw’akanwa kawe ni nk’icamwa citwa pome,
kandi mu kanwa kawe ni nk’umuvinyu uruta iyindi. Umugeni Uwo muvinyu icompa ukagenda utumbereye umukunzi wanje, ukagenda utemba neza ku minwa no ku menyo.
Jewe ndi uw’umukunzi wanje, kandi ni jewe yipfuza.
Nuze, mukunzi wanje, tugende mu mirima, tumare ijoro mu bigwati.
Tuzozinduka tuja mu mirima y’inzabibu turabe ko imizabibu yameze, turabe ko imimera yayo yasambuye, kandi ko amakomamanga ashuritse, aho ni ho nzoguhera urukundo rwanje.
Amapome aratamirana, kandi i ruhande y’urugi rwacu hari ivyamwa vyose, bishasha n’ivya kera, ivyo nakubikiye, mukunzi wanje.
Icompa ukaba nka musazanje, uwonse ibere rya mama! Gutyo, ndagusanze hanze, nogusomaguye, kandi nta n’umwe yoneguye.
Nokugiye imbere nkakujana mu nzu ya mama, we yanyigishije. Noguhaye umuvinyu urimwo ibimota neza ukawunywa, umutobe w’amapome yanje.
Ukuboko kwiwe kw’i bubamfu kuranseguye, ukuboko kwiwe kw’i buryo kurambumbatiye.
Bakobwa b’i Yerusalemu, ndabihanikirije: Ntimukome urukundo canke ngo murukangure, gushika rwishakiye kuvyuka. Abagenzi
Urya ni nde aje ava mu bugaragwa yegamiye umukunzi wiwe? Umugeni Nagukanguye uri musi y’igiti c’amapome; aho ni ho nyoko wawe yagusamiye inda, aho ni ho uwari ku gise yakwibarukiye.
Nshira ku mutima wawe nk’ikidodo, nk’ikidodo ku kuboko kwawe; kuko urukundo rukomeye nk’urupfu, ishari ryarwo rigakomera nk’i kuzimu. Ruturira nk’umuriro waka, nk’urubeya rukomeye.
Amazi menshi ntashobora kuzimya urukundo; inzuzi ntizishobora kuruzimanganya. Niyo umuntu yotanga ivyo atunze vyose mu nzu yiwe ngo agure urukundo, yogawa rwose. Abagenzi
Dufise murumuna wacu, kandi amabere yiwe ntarasonga. Mbega tuzokorera iki murumuna wacu ku musi azogira ubukwe?
Niyaba ari uruzitiro, tuzokwubaka iminara y’ifeza kuri we. Niyaba ari urugi, tuzomwugaza ibihindizo vy’amasederi. Umugeni
Ndi uruzitiro, kandi amabere yanje ni nk’iminara. Ni co gituma mu maso yiwe nabaye nk’uwuzana akaneza.
Salomo yari afise uruzabibu i Bayali-Hamoni, maze asigarana urwo ruzabibu abakozi biwe. Umwe wese yasabwa kuriha shekeli igihumbi z’ifeza zihuye n’ivyamwa yamuye.
Yamara uruzabibu rwanje ni urwanje ubwanje; izo shekeli igihumbi nuzigumirize, yewe Salomo. Ariko amajana abiri ni az’abitayeho inzabibu zarwo. Umukwe
Wewe uba mu mirima uri kumwe n’abagenzi bagukorera, nyumvisha ijwi ryawe! Umugeni
Hunga, mukunzi wanje, umere nk’ingeregere canke nk’inyana y’impongokazi ku misozi yuzuye ibimota neza.

name: Yesaya
chapters: Ibi ni ivyo Yesaya mwene Amozi yeretswe vyerekeye Ubuyuda na Yerusalemu, ku ngoma ya Uziya, iya Yotamu, iya Ahazi n’iya Hezekiya, abami b’i Buyuda.
Nimwumve mwa majuru mwe! Umviriza wa si we! Kuko Uhoraho avuze ati: "Naronkeje abana, ndabakuza, ariko barangararije.
Inka iramenya shebuja, n’indogoba ikamenya ubwato shebuja ayigabuririramwo. Ariko Abisirayeli nta na kimwe bazi, ubwoko bwanje nta co butahura."
Uragowe wa hanga rikora ivyaha, abantu bagirizwa ibigabitanyo bikomeye, uruvyaro rw’inkozi z’ibibi, abana bononekaye! Bataye Uhoraho , bakengera Uwera wa Isirayeli, bamuvako, basubira inyuma.
Ni igiki gitumye mushaka kwongera guhanwa? Ni igiki gituma muguma mu bugarariji? Ehe raba umutwe wuzuye ibikomere, umutima na wo uragwaye.
Uhereye mu kirenge ugashitsa ku mutwe, nta na hamwe hagikomeye. Mwuzuye inguma, ibivyimba n’ibisebe binuka, bitigeze vyozwa canke ngo bipfukwe, canke ngo bisigweko amavuta ya elayo.
Igihugu canyu carasanganguwe, ibisagara vyanyu vyarahiye. Amatongo yanyu ariko aranyagwa n’abanyamahanga mubiraba n’amaso yanyu, hasigaye ari mu gahinga, nk’ahasenyuwe n’abanyamahanga.
I Siyoni hasigaye hameze nk’akazu kashaje ko mu ruzabibu, hameze nk’akazu k’ivyatsi k’uwurarira umurima w’imyungu, hameze nk’igisagara gikikujwe n’ingabo zagiteye.
Iyo Uhoraho Mushoboravyose atadusigariza abadukomokako bakeya, tuba twararanduwe nk’ab’i Sodomu, tuba twaraherengetejwe nk’ab’i Gomora.
Nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , yemwe batware b’i Sodomu! Nimwumve Ivyagezwe vy’Imana yacu yemwe bantu b’i Gomora.

"Mbega ibimazi vyanyu vyinshi bimariye iki?" ni ko Uhoraho abaza. "Ndarambiwe n’ibimazi vyanyu bituriwe, vyaba ivy’amapfizi y’intama n’ibindi bitungwa binuze, ivyo mwama munshikanira, ndabihaze. Sinezerwa n’amaraso y’amashuri, canke ay’amapfizi y’intama, canke amasuguru y’impene.
Iyo muje kunshengerera, ni nde aba yababwiye ngo muze kumponyangira mu rugo?

Ntimuze musubire kunzanira ibimazi bitagira akamaro. Ibimota neza vyanyu biranukira. Ndarambiwe n’amakoraniro yanyu yo ku mboneko z’ukwezi n’ayo ku masabato, sincihanganira amakoraniro yanyu avanze n’ibibi.
Nzinutswe imisi mikuru y’imboneko z’ukwezi n’iyindi misi mikuru mwishingiye. Irandemereye. Naniwe no kuyihanganira.
Nimwaduza ibiganza musenga, nanje nzobanyegeza mu nyonga hanje. Naho mwosenga amasengesho menshi cane, sinzobumviriza. Ibiganza vyanyu vyuzuye amaraso.
Nimwiyuhagire, mushire ubuhoma. Nimunkure mu maso ibikorwa vyanyu bibi. Mureke gukora ibibi.
Nimwige gukora ivyiza. Murondere guca izigororotse, murenganure abarenganijwe. Muburanire impfuvyi, muvugire abapfakazi."
"Ehe nimuze tuje inama," ni ko Uhoraho avuze. "Naho ivyaha vyanyu vyotukura tukutuku nzovyeza vyere derere nka shelegi. Naho vyotukura nk’amaraso, bizohinduka nk’ubwoya bwera cane.
Nimwemera mukanyumvira, muzorya ku vyiza vyo mu gihugu.
Ariko nimwaguma mungarariza, inkota izobarya." Kuko ari ko Uhoraho avuze.
Nimurabe ingene Yerusalemu, umugwa wari umwizigirwa, ubu wahindutse maraya. Wahora wuzuye imanza zigororotse, ubugororotsi ni ho bwibera, ariko ubu hasigaye ari ah’abicanyi.
Amafeza yanyu aguye ingese, n’imivinyu yanyu nta kanovera, yasutswemwo amazi.
Abatware banyu ni abagarariji, bagendana n’inkozi z’ibibi. Bose barya ibiturire, bagakunda gushikanirwa. Ntibaburanira impfuvyi, n’urubanza rw’abapfakazi ntirubashikira.
Ni co gituma Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Umunyenkomezi wa Isirayeli, avuze ati: Nzokwimarira ishavu kuri mwebwe mungwanya, ndabihore mwebwe abansi banje.
Nzohindukiza ukuboko ngwanye Yerusalemu, nzokuvugutira ndagukureko ingese, nzogukuramwo umwanda wose.
Nzogarukana abarongozi beza nk’abo mu gihe ca kera, nsubizeho abahanuzi nk’abo mu gihe ca mbere. Hanyuma uzokwitwa igisagara c’ubugororotsi, umugwa wizerwa.
Siyoni hazotabarwa n’ubutungane, abazokwihana bo muri Yerusalemu bazokizwa n’ukugororoka.
Ariko abagarariji n’abanyavyaha bazovunagurwa, n’abareka Uhoraho bazorandurwa.
"Muzoterwa isoni n’ugusenga ibigirwamana kwanyu muri musi y’imirinzi iyo mwanezerererwamwo, muzomaramara nimwibuka ya matongo, ayo mwatoranirije ibigirwamana.
Muzomera nk’umurinzi ufise amababi akabiranye, mumere nk’amatongo atagiramwo amazi.
Abahambaye bo muri mwebwe bazomera nk’icatsi cumye, ibikorwa vyabo na vyo bimere nk’ivyatsi bifashwe n’umuriro. Bazoshana na vyo, habure uwuzimya umuriro."
Ibi ni ibindi Yesaya mwene Amozi yeretswe vyerekeye Ubuyuda na Yerusalemu:
Mu misi y’iherezo, umusozi uriko ingoro y’ Uhoraho uzoba ushimangiwe nk’umusozi usumba iyindi yose, uzoshirwa hejuru usumbe udusozi twose; kandi amahanga yose azohondogana aja kuri wo.

Amoko menshi azoza, avuge ati: "Nimuze tuduge tuje ku musozi w’ Uhoraho , mu ngoro y’Imana ya Yakobo. Izotwigisha inzira zayo kugira ngo tuzigenderemwo." Kuko i Siyoni ari ho hazova ivyagezwe, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rive i Yerusalemu.

Azocira imanza amahanga, atature amatati hagati y’amoko menshi. Inkota zabo bazozicuramwo amasuka, amacumu yabo bayacuremwo imihoro. Nta hanga rizosubira gutera irindi, kandi ntibazosubira kwiga ivy’intambara.
Nimuze, yemwe ruvyaro rwa Yakobo, ehe nimuze tugendere mu muco w’ Uhoraho !
Uhoraho we, warahevye ubwoko bwawe, ari rwo ruvyaro rwa Yakobo. Buzuyemwo ivyo kugendereza vy’abanyamahanga bo mu buseruko, baraguza nk’Abafilisitiya, kandi bifatanya n’abanyamahanga.
Igihugu cabo cuzuye ifeza n’inzahabu; ubutunzi bwabo ntibugira iherezo. Igihugu cabo cuzuye amafarasi; imikogote yabo ntigira igitigiri.
Igihugu cabo cuzuye ibigirwamana, bunamira ibintu bakoresheje amaboko yabo, ivyo bacurishije intoke zabo.
Ni co gituma abo bantu bazocinyizwa, n’umuntu wese agacishwa bugufi. Ntuze ubaharire.
Nimwinjire mu masenga, mwinyegeze mu kuzimu ntimuhure n’ Uhoraho kuko biteye ubwoba cane ntimuhure n’ugukayangana kw’ubwiza bwiwe!
Amaso y’ubwibone azocishwa bugufi, n’ubwibone bwose bw’abantu bunyitswe; kuri uwo musi Uhoraho wenyene ni we azoshirwa hejuru.
Kuko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, arafise umusi yibikiye uwo azokwihorerako abishira hejuru n’abibona kandi n’igishizwe hejuru cose gicishwe bugufi.
Azoca amasederi maremere y’i Libani, hamwe n’imirinzi ikomakomeye y’i Bashani.
Imitumba miremire hamwe n’uturambi, bizoringanizwa.
Iminara miremire hamwe n’ibihome vyose bikomeye azobisenyagura.
Azomenagura amato y’abadandaji, n’amato y’igiciro kinini.
Ubwibone bw’abantu buzoshirwa hasi, abishira hejuru bose bacishwe bugufi. Uwo musi Uhoraho wenyene ni we azoba ashizwe hejuru.
Ibigirwamana bizokurwaho vyose.
Abantu bazohungira mu masenga y’amabuye no mu binogo vyimbwe mu kuzimu, ngo bahunge uburake bw’ Uhoraho , n’ugukayangana kw’ubwiza bwiwe igihe azohagurukira gutigitisha isi.
Kuri uwo musi w’urubanza, abantu bazota kure, baterere imbeba n’ubuhungarema, ibigirwamana vyabo bicuzwe mw’ifeza no mu nzahabu, ivyo bicuriye ngo babisenge.
Bazohungira mu masenga y’amabuye, no mu binogo vyo mu kuzimu, ngo bahunge uburake bw’ Uhoraho , n’ugukayangana kw’ubwiza bwiwe igihe azohagurukira gutigitisha isi.
Nimureke kwizigira abantu, kuko bameze nk’impwemu zo mu mazuru yabo. Mbega hari ico bobamarira?
Ehe raba, Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, agira anyage ab’i Yerusalemu n’ab’i Buyuda ivyo baronka n’ivyabashigikira: ivyo baronka vyose vyokurya n’ivyo baronka vyose vy’amazi.
Azohonya abahizi mu ntambara, abacamanza, abavugishwa, abapfumu hamwe n’abakuru,
intwazangabo irongora abasoda mirongo itanu n’abanyacubahiro, abahanuzi, abanyamyuga bahambaye hamwe n’inkerebutsi z’abaragura.
Nzobaha abana babo bababere abatware, abana bato babe ari bo babategeka.
Abantu bazocinyizanya, umugabo acinyize uwundi mugabo, umubanyi acinyize umubanyi wiwe. Umwana azosuzugura umutama, umuntu ata co amaze asuzugure umunyacubahiro.
Ico gihe umuntu azobwira uwo bavukana ati: "Ko ari wewe ufise umwambaro, ba ari wewe uba umutware wacu, abe ari wewe witaho ico kirundo c’umusaka!"
Ariko muri ico gihe na we azosemerera ababwire ati: "Erega nta co nobafasha! Simfise ivyokurya canke ivyambarwa mu nzu yanje; ntimungire umurongozi w’abantu."
Yerusalemu haradandabagirana, n’i Buyuda haratemvye. Amajambo n’ibikorwa vyabo bigwanya Uhoraho , bagashinyagurira imbere y’ubwiza bwiwe.
Mu maso habo harabagiriza, bagenda berekana ivyaha vyabo nk’ab’i Sodomu, ntibabinyegeza. Baragowe! Bihamagariye ivyago.
Bwira abagororotsi ko bazomererwa neza, kuko bazorya ibivuye mu maboko yabo.
Ariko abanyavyaha bazobona ibara! Ivyago bizobagwako. Bazosubirizwa mu nkoko, ibihwanye n’ivyo bakoze.
Ubwoko bwanje bucinyijwe n’abana, abagore ni bo babutegeka. Yewe bwoko bwanje, abarongozi bawe barakuzimije, bagutesheje inzira.
Uhoraho yicaye ku ntebe y’imanza, ahagurukijwe no gucira urubanza ubwoko bwiwe.
Uhoraho yinjiye ngo ace urubanza arucira abatware n’abarongozi b’ubwoko bwiwe: "Ni mwebwe mwamponereje uruzabibu, ivyo mwanyaze abakene bikaba biri mu mazu yanyu.
Ni iki catumye musiribanga ubwoko bwanje, mukamenagura imitwe y’aboro?" ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.

Uhoraho aravuze ati: "Abakobwa b’i Siyoni buzuye ubwibone, bagenda baneze amazosi, barabisha amaso yuzuye ubushirasoni, kandi bakagenda baneze amazosi, bajegeza ibisharizo vy’imigufu bambaye ku maguru.
Ni co gituma Imana izoteza abakobwa b’i Siyoni ibisekera ku mitwe, imitwe yabo iyigire ibiharabuga."
Kuri uwo musi Imana izokuraho ubwiza bw’ivyambarwa vyabo:
amahereni, imiringa yo ku maboko, hamwe n’imyitwikiro,
ingori, imigufu yo ku maguru, uducupa tw’ibimota neza, utugirwamana,
impeta zo ku ntoke n’izo ku mazuru,
amakanzu mezameza, impuzu zo kurenza hejuru n’udusaho,
ivyirore, inkenyerano zera hamwe n’ibitambara vyo ku mutwe.

Maze aho kumota neza, bazonuka; mu gishingo c’umukanda, azobakenyeza umugozi, mu gishingo co gusokoza uruhanika, azobaharangura imitwe, mu gishingo c’impuzu nziza azobambika amagunira, mu gishingo c’ubwiza, azobambika ibimaramare.
Abagabo banyu bazomarwa n’inkota, abagwanyi banyu na bo bazogwa ku rugamba.
Amarembo y’i Siyoni azorira aboroge, igisagara gisanganguwe, kizokwicara hasi.

Muri ico gihe, abagore indwi bazofata umugabo umwe, bamubwire bati: "Tuzorya ivyokurya twirondereye, kandi tuzokwironderera impuzu twambara. Twemerere gusa twitirirwe izina ryawe, udukureko ibimaramare."
Ariko muri ico gihe ishami ry’ Uhoraho rizokwambikwa ubwiza n’ugukayangana, kandi amasigarira y’Abisirayeli azokwishimira yongere anezererwe ivyamwa vyo mu gihugu.
Abazoba basigaye i Siyoni, bakaguma i Yerusalemu, bazokwitwa abera. Ni abazoba barokotse bakaba banditswe mu gitabu c’abazima i Yerusalemu.
Imana izokwoza imyanda y’abakobwa b’i Siyoni, ihanagure amaraso yasesekeye i Yerusalemu ikoresheje impwemu y’urubanza n’impwemu y’umuriro.
Ku murango, Uhoraho azorema igicu kibe hejuru y’umusozi Siyoni hamwe n’abahakoranira bose, mw’ijoro na ho aharemere imbeya z’umuriro. Icubahiro ciwe kizoba hejuru ya vyose nk’ihema rinini rihapfutse.
Kizoba ubwugamo n’igitutu mu bushuhe bwo ku murango, n’ubuhungiro n’ubwihisho mu gihe c’igihuhusi n’imvura.
Reka ndirimbire umukunzi wanje, indirimbo y’umurima wiwe w’imizabibu: Umukunzi wanje yari afise umurima w’imizabibu ku musozi umera cane.

Uwo musozi yarawurimye, akuraho amabuye, atoranya imizabibu myiza kurusha iyindi, ayitera kuri wo. Awubakako umunara, ashiramwo n’ubwato baganiramwo. Mu nyuma aja kuraba ko yoronka inzabibu nziza yokwimbura, ariko asanga huzuyeyo ibihumbwa gusa.
None rero yemwe ababa i Yerusalemu, namwe bagabo b’i Buyuda, nimuducire urubanza twe n’uwo murima wanje.
Ni igiki kirengeye ivyo nari gukorera uwo murima wanje w’imizabibu? Ni kuki wamye ibihumbwa, kandi nari niteze ko unyamira inzabibu nziza?
Hinge ndababwire ico ngiye gukorera uwo murima wanje w’imizabibu: Nzosambura inzitiro zawo, kugira ngo wonwe. Nzosenyura impome ziwukikuje, kugira ngo uze uhonyangwe.
Nzowuhonya, ntuzotuturirwa, ntuzonabagarirwa, amahwa n’ibitovu ni vyo bizowumeramwo. Nzotegeka ibicu, ntihagire imvura iwugwamwo.

Umurima w’imizabibu w’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ni inzu ya Isirayeli, abantu b’i Buyuda na bo ni bo murima wamuhimbara. Uhoraho yari abitezeko imanza zigororotse, ariko abona ugusesa amaraso, yabarondeyeko ukugororoka, ariko abumvamwo amarira n’imibabaro.
Muragowe mwebwe mwomeka amazu ku yandi, amatongo ku yandi mukifataniriza, igihugu mukaciganzira, ngo mukibemwo mwenyene.
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yabivuze numva, ati: "Ndababwije ukuri, amazu mezameza azosambuka, kandi n’amazu maninimanini azosigara ata wuyabamwo.
Ihegitari zitatu z’imizabibu zizovamwo ingero batu imwe gusa y’umutobe, ingero homeru y’imbuto z’ingano izovamwo ingero efa imwe gusa y’umwimbu."
Muragowe mwebwe muzindukira kunywa ibiboreza mukarara mwicaye, mwishusha mu kunywa umuvinyu.
Ibirori vyabo birimwo inanga, amakembe, ingoma, imyironge n’umuvinyu, ariko nta wubabara ibikorwa vy’ Uhoraho , nta wuha agaciro ibikorwa vy’amaboko yiwe.
Ni co gituma abantu banje bazoja mu kinyago, kuko batigeze bagira ugutahura. Abashizwe hejuru bo muri bo bazokwicwa n’inzara, abaciye bugufi bicwe n’inyota.
Ni co gituma i kuzimu haguye umuhogo waho, hagataburura umunwa cane. Abubashwe n’amasinzi hazobamira, bajane n’amasinzi y’imborerwa zaho.
Abantu bazosubizwa hasi, kandi n’umwana w’umuntu acishijwe bugufi, amaso y’abibone amaramare.
Ariko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose azoshirwa hejuru mu bugororotsi bwiwe, kandi Imana Yera izokwerekanwa ko ari iyera n’ibikorwa vyayo vy’ubugororotsi.
Ico gihe intama zizorisha nk’iziri mu buragiro bwazo, imyagazi na yo izorisha ahahora amazu y’abatunzi.
Bazobona ibara abakwegesha ivyaha imigozi y’ububeshi. Bakwegana n’ivyaha vyabo nk’uko umuntu akwega umukogote.
Ni bo bavuga bati: " Uhoraho nanyaruke; nanyarutse igikorwa ciwe, natwe tukibone. Integuro y’Uwera wa Isirayeli nitwegere, nishike aho tuyibona kugira ngo tuyimenye."
Bazobona ibara abafata ibibi bakavyita ivyiza, ivyiza na vyo bakavyita ibibi. Umuco bawita umwijima, umwijima bakawita umuco. Kuri bo, ikirura kirasosa, igisosa na co kirarura.
Baragowe abigira abanyabwenge mu mitima, bakibona ko bafise ubumenyi bukomeye.
Baragowe abigira abahizi mu kunywa umuvinyu, no mu kugana inzoga zikaze,
bakarya ibiturire kugira beze uwatsinzwe n’icaha, bagatsindisha uwutagira ico azira.

Ni co gituma, bazozimangana nk’ubwatsi buturirwa n’umuriro, imizi yabo izobora, n’amashurwe yabo azokabirana; kuko bataye Ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose, birengagiza ijambo ry’Uwera wa Isirayeli.

Ni co gituma uburake bw’ Uhoraho bururumvye ku bantu biwe, ukuboko kwiwe akakubangurira kubahonya. Imisozi izonyiganyiga, imivyimba y’abapfuye izokwandagara ku mabarabara nk’imyanda. Ariko ivyo vyose ntibizohwamika uburake bwiwe, ukuboko kwiwe kuzoba kukibanguye kuri bo.
Azorungikira amahanga ikimenyetso ari kure. Azovuza uruhwa ahamagare abo ku mpera z’isi, maze bose bazosiganwa baja i Yerusalemu.
Nta n’umwe muri bo azoruha canke ngo atsitare. Nta wuzohunyiza canke ngo asinzire. Imikanda yabo ntizokenyuruka, n’imigozi y’ibirato vyabo ntizocika.
Imyampi yabo irasongoye, n’imiheto yabo irabanze. Ibinono vy’ifarasi zabo bimeze nk’amabuye y’amasare, imikogote yabo yiruka nk’agashururu.
Ukwivuga kwabo ni nk’ukw’intambwe, bivuga nk’imikangara y’intare. Ziraroha iyo zigize ico zubura, zikagitwara ata gitabara.
Muri ico gihe, hazoba imituragaro hejuru kandi abazoterera amaso mu gihugu, bazobona ukwiraburanirwa kuvuye ku mibabaro, n’umuco uzozimanganywa n’ibicu.
Mu mwaka Uziya yapfa, nabonye Imana yicaye ku ntebe y’inganji ishizwe hejuru, imisozo y’ikanzu yayo yuzuye Ingoro.
Abaserafi bari hejuru yayo, umwumwe wese afise amababa atandatu. Amababa abiri bayipfukisha mu maso, yandi abiri bakayapfukisha amaguru yabo, ayandi abiri bakayagurukisha.
Bahamagarana bavuga bati: "Uwera, Uwera, Uwera ni we Uhoraho Mushoboravyose; isi yose yuzuye icubahiro ciwe."
Ijwi ry’indirimbo yabo rinyiganyiza ibishimaryango n’umushinge vy’Ingoro kandi na rwo rwuzura umwotsi.
Nca ndatakamba nti: "Yewe jewe ndagowe, kuko iminwa yanje yanduye, kandi mba mu bantu bafise iminwa yanduye, none amaso yanje akaba abonye Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose!"
Umwe mu baserafi aca aguruka aza aho ndi afise ikara ryaka mu ntoke, yokoje icuma cokora amakara ku gicaniro.
Arinkoza ku munwa avuga ati: "Ehe raba iri kara rikoze ku munwa wawe, ukugabitanya kwawe ugukuweko, n’ivyaha vyawe urabihariwe."
Nca numva ijwi ry’Imana ribaza riti: "Ni nde notuma? Ni nde yogenda mu gishingo cacu?" Nanje nca ndishura nti: "Ndi hano ntuma!"
Na we aca ambwira ati: "Genda umbwirire barya bantu uti: ‘Muze mwame mwumva ariko ntimuze mwigere mutahura. Muze mwame muraba ariko ntimuze mwigere mubona.’

Genda ukomantaze imitima y’abo bantu, amatwi yabo uyazivye, amaso yabo uyahumye. Kugira ngo ntibashobore kubonesha amaso yabo, no kwumvisha amatwi yabo, canke ngo batahurishe imitima yabo, bagahava bahindukira, nanje nkabakiza."

Nanje nca ndabaza nti: "None ga Mwami, ivyo bizomara igihe kingana gute?" Na we aranyishura ati: "Gushika ibisagara vyabo bisambutse, ata na kimwe gisigaye gihagaze, amazu yose agasigara agaragara, igihugu cose kigahinduka igisanze,
gushika ndabirukanye kure, bagata igihugu cabo cose.

Kandi n’aho hosigara igice kimwe kuri cumi c’igihugu, na ho nyene kizosubira gisamburwe. Ariko nk’uko ibiti vyitwa terebinti na aloni bisiga ibishitsi vyavyo iyo vyiciwe, ni ko imbuto yejejwe izozigamwa nk’igishitsi muri kino gihugu."
Ku ngoma ya Ahazi mwene Yotamu, Yotamu mwene Uziya umwami w’i Buyuda, Rezini umwami w’i Siriya hamwe na Peka mwene Remaliya umwami wa Isirayeli bagiye gutera i Yerusalemu, ariko biranka ko bahafata.
Abo mu nzu ya Dawidi babwirwa ngo: "Siriya yifatanije na Efurayimu." Umwami Ahazi n’abantu bose baranduka imitima, bahinda agashitsi kurya kw’ibiti bihuye n’umuyaga w’igihuhusi.
Maze Uhoraho abarira Yesaya ati: "Sohoka ujane n’umuhungu wawe Sheyari-Yashubi, muje guhura na Ahazi muhurire aho umugende ujana amazi kw’itangi yo haruguru ugarukira, ku nzira ija aho bamesurira.
Umubwire uti: ‘Tekana ugumye umutima, ntugire ubwoba. Ntucike ivutu kubera uburake bwa Rezini na Siriya hamwe na mwene Remaliya. Bameze nk’ibiti biri mu ziko bifumba umwotsi gusa.
Abana ba Siriya, Efurayimu na Remaliya bagiye inama yo kukugwanya, bavuga bati:
"Reka dutere i Buyuda, tuhagabangane hagati yacu maze mwene Tabeyeli tumugire umwami waho."
Ariko uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Ivyo ntibizoba, ntibizokwigera biba,

kuko Siriya ntihakomeye gusumvya umugwa mukuru waho, Damasiko. Kandi Damasiko ntihakomeye gusumvya umwami waho, Rezini. Nayo mu myaka mirongo itandatu n’itanu, aba Efurayimu bazoherengetezwa ntibabe bacitwa ihanga.
Umugwa mukuru wa Efurayimu ni Samariya, kandi uwuganza Samariya ni mwene Remaliya. Nimba mudashikamye mu kwizera, ntimuzohagarara na gatoya.’ "
Uhoraho arasubira atuma kuri Ahazi,
ati: "Saba Uhoraho Imana yawe aguhe ikimenyetso, caba ikiri kure i kuzimu, canke kure hejuru mu kirere."
Ariko Ahazi avuga ati: "Nta kimenyetso nsaba, sinokwubahuka kugerageza Uhoraho ."
Maze Yesaya aca avuga ati: "Nimwumve rero yemwe abakomoka kuri Dawidi! Mbega ntibihagije kugerageza ukwihangana kw’abantu? None mugomba no kugerageza ukwihangana kw’Imana yanje na kwo?
Ko bimeze uko Imana izokwitangira ikimenyetso yo nyene: inkumi izosama inda, ivyare umwana w’umuhungu kandi bazomwita Emanuweli.
Azotungwa n’amata avuze hamwe n’ubuki gushika amaze kumenya gutandukanya ikibi n’iciza.
Ariko imbere yo kumenya gutandukanya ivyo, ibihugu vy’abo bami babiri utinya cane bizoba bisigaye ari ubugaragwa ata muntu akihaba.
Uhoraho azozana ivyago bikomeye kuri mwebwe no ku bwoko bwanyu no ku muryango wanyu. Muzoterwa n’ubwoba mutigeze mugira kuva Abefurayimu bitandukanije n’Abayuda. Azorungika umwami wa Ashuri abatere."
Uwo musi Uhoraho azovuza uruhwa gusa, maze isazi zizanane kw’isesero ry’uruzi Nili, inzuki na zo zizanane mu gihugu ca Ashuri.
Zizozira icarimwe zisagaze ku mimanuko ihanamye, mu masenga yo mu bitandara, ku bisaka vy’amahwa yose no ku binogo vy’amazi vyose.
Uwo musi Uhoraho azokota urwembe akuye hakurya y’uruzi Efurate ari rwo mwami wa Ashuri, arukoreshe mu kubamwa ahantu hose: imitwe yanyu, ahari ubwoya hose, hamwe n’ubwanwa.
Inyuma y’ivyo bihe, umuntu atunze azoba afise inyana y’inka imwe hamwe n’impene zibiri gusa.
Ariko hazoba umusesekara w’amata zizokamwa, kuko igihugu kizoba casigayemwo abantu bake cane. Amasigarira azoba yasigaye mu gihugu azonywa amata avuze arye n’ubuki.
Uwo musi ahahora hari umurima w’imizabibu igihumbi wogurwa shekeli igihumbi z’ifeza nyene, hazosigara hari imikere n’ibitovu gusa.
Abahigi bazokwinjirayo bitwaje imyampi n’imiheto, kuko igihugu cose kizoba cuzuye amahwa n’ibitovu.
Nayo imitumba yahora irimishwa amasuka, ntimuzoba mukiyishikako kubera gutinya amahwa n’ibitovu. Hazohinduka uburagiro ibitungwa bizorishamwo.
Uhoraho ambarira ati: "Fata umuzingo munini uwandikeko n’ikaramu isanzwe uti: Maheri-Shalali-Hashi-Bazi."
Maze nca mpamagara Uriya umuherezi na Zakariya mwene Yeberekiya, ngo bambere ivyabona vyizerwa yuko nabikoze.
Hanyuma ndyamana n’umugore wanje w’umuvugishwakazi, asama inda, avyara umwana w’umuhungu. Uhoraho arambwira ati: "Numwite Maheri-Shalali-Hashi-Bazi.
Imbere y’uko uwo mwana amenya kuvuga ngo data canke mama, umwami wa Ashuri azoba yaramaze gutwara ubutunzi bwose bw’i Damasiko n’i Samariya."
Uhoraho yongera ambwira ati:
Kubera ko aba bantu bagaye ukubitaho kwanje kugereranywa n’amazi meza atemba y’i Shilowa, bakanezerererwa umwami Rezini hamwe na mwene Remaliya,
nuko rero Uhoraho agiye kubateza umwuzure w’inkomezi nyinshi, uvuye ku ruzi Efurate, ni wo mwami wa Ashuri n’ingabo ziwe. Uzosendanisha urengere imivo yose, urengere n’inkombe zarwo zose,
kugeza ushike n’i Buyuda, uharengere, uzosendanisha uduge gushika no ku mazosi y’abantu. Kandi nirwasanzara ruzokwira igihugu cawe cose, yewe Emanuweli.
Nimuje hamwe yemwe mahanga, muhinde agashitsi! Nimwumve namwe abo mu bihugu vya kure mwese. Mwitegurire intambara, ariko muhinde agashitsi! Mwitegurire intambara, ariko muhinde agashitsi!
Nimuje inama, ariko inama zanyu zizoba impfagusa. Nimwagira n’ico mupfundika ntikizorama, kuko Imana iri ku ruhande rwacu.
Uhoraho yamfatishije ukuboko kwiwe kw’inkomezi, ambwira anyihanikiriza ati: Ntuzogendere mu ngeso z’ubwo bwoko:
Ntimwite umugararizo ibintu vyose abo bita umugararizo; ntimugatinye ivyo batinya, kandi na bo ubwabo ntimubatinye.
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose abe ari we wenyene mwita Uwera, ni we mukwiye kwubaha, ni we mukwiye gutinya.
Azobazigama. Ariko kuri Yerusalemu no ku Buyuda, azobabera ibuye batsitarako, n’urutare rutuma bagwa. Kandi ababa i Yerusalemu bose, azobabera umutego.
Benshi muri bo bazomutsitarako bagwe; bazogwa bavunagurike, bazogwa mu mutego.
Bika neza ico gishingantahe, ivyagezwe ubifatanishe ikimenyetso mu bigishwa banje.
Nzororera Uhoraho , yahishije ab’inzu ya Yakobo mu maso hiwe. Ni we nzokwizigira.
Ehe raba jewe, n’abana Uhoraho yampaye, turi abo kubera Abisirayeli ibimenyetso biva k’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, ahangamye ku Musozi Siyoni.

Nihagira umuntu akubwira ngo uje kuraguza ku bapfumu n’abasiguza imizimu, bavuga bongorera kandi bajwigira kugira ngo bakubwire ivyo muri kazoza, mbega igikwiye si ugusiguza Imana yanyu? Ni kuki muja kubaza abapfuye ivy’abakiriho?
Nimusuzumire ivyo bavuga ku vyagezwe vyanje no ku ntahe! Nimba bavuga ibitandukanye n’ijambo ryanje, bazokwama mu mwijima.
Ukwihebura n’ikigoyi ni vyo bizorangwa mu gihugu cabo. Nibafatwa n’ikigoyi, bazoterwa n’ishavu, maze barabe hejuru, bavume umwami wabo n’Imana yabo.
Bazoraba hasi babone amakuba n’umwijima, n’umubabaro w’umururazi, kandi bazotererwa mu mwijima w’umuzitanya.

Naho biri uko, umwijima ntuzokwamaho ibihe vyose ku bari mu mubabaro. Muri kahise yacishije bugufi intara ya Zebuloni n’iya Nafutali. Ariko muri kazoza azotera iteka inzira ija ku kiyaga, hakurya ya Yorodani, i Galilaya h’Abanyamahanga.
Abantu bahora bagendera mu mwijima babonye umuco mwinshi. Ababa mu gihugu c’umwijima w’umuzitanya bakiwe n’umuco mwinshi.
Waragwije ihanga, wongereza umunezero w’abantu baho; banezererewe imbere yawe, nk’uko abantu banezerwa mw’iyimbura, nk’uko abagwanyi banezerwa iyo bariko baragabura iminyago.
Kuko umutwaro wahora ubaremereye, ikimoko bakubitwa ku mugongo n’inkoni bakubitwa n’uwabacinyiza, wabivunaguye, nk’uko wabigiriye Abamidiyani.
Ibirato vyose vyambawe mu ntambara, n’impuzu yavumbagajwe mu maraso, bizoturirwa, bitongorwe n’umuriro.
Kuko umwana avutse ku neza yacu, duhawe umwana w’umuhungu, ubutware bwose buzoba ku bitugu vyiwe. Azokwitwa Umujenama w’igitangaza, Imana ikomeye, Data ahoraho, Umwami w’amahoro.

Ubutware bwiwe n’amahoro yiwe ntibizogira iherezo. Azoganzira ku ntebe ya Dawidi, no mu bwami bwiwe, aganzanye ubutungane n’ukugororoka, uhereye ico gihe, gushitsa ibihe vyose. Ishaka ry’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ni ryo rizobishitsa.
Uhoraho arungikiye ubutumwa Yakobo, bushika kuri Isirayeli.
Abantu bose bazobimenya; baba Abefurayimu canke ababa i Samariya, ari bo bavugana ubwibone, bagakomantaza imitima, bavuga bati:
"Amatafari yarakoraguritse, ariko tuzosubira tugisanuze amabuye abaje. Ibiti vy’imisukomora vyariciwe, ariko tuzobisubiriza amasederi."
Ariko Uhoraho azobaneshesha umwansi wabo Rezini, kandi azokwongerereza ububasha abansi babo.
Abasiriya bo mu buseruko n’Abafilisitiya bo mu burengero, bazokwasama babatabagure. Ariko ivyo vyose ntibizohwamika uburake bwiwe, ukuboko kwiwe kuzoba kukibanguye kuri bo.
Ariko abo bantu ntibagarutse ku wabahanye, ntibarondeye Uhoraho Mushoboravyose.
None rero, ku musi umwe wonyene, Uhoraho azoca Isirayeli umutwe n’umurizo, ikigazi n’irenga abicire amababi umusi umwe.
Abatware n’abahambaye muri Isirayeli ni bo mutwe, abavugishwa b’ibinyoma na bo ni bo murizo.
Abarongora abo bantu barabayobeza, abayobowe na bo barazimijwe.

Uhoraho ntazonezererwa abasore, kandi ntazogirira impuhwe impfuvyi n’abapfakazi. Kuko bose bahevye Imana, bagakora ibibi; akanwa kabo kavuga ububeshi gusa. Ariko ivyo vyose ntibizohwamika uburake bwiwe, ukuboko kwiwe kuzoba kukibanguye kuri bo.
Erega ubugarariji buturira nk’umuriro, utongora imikere n’amahwa, ugatuma ishamba rinini rirurumba, umwotsi ugapfunduka umeze nk’igicu mu kirere.
Uburake bw’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose butumye igihugu gitongorwa, abantu biwe bamera nk’inkwi zo gucana. Abantu bazoryana ata kubabarirana.
Bazoshikura i buryo ariko bagume bashonje. Bazorya i bubamfu, na ho nyene ntibahage. Mu mperuka, abantu bazorya n’inyama z’abana babo.
Manase azorya Efurayimu, Efurayimu na we arye Manase. Bompi bazohindukira batere Yuda. Ariko ivyo vyose ntibizohwamika uburake bwiwe, ukuboko kwiwe kuzoba kukibanguye kuri bo.
Muragowe mwebwe mushinga amategeko y’akarenganyo, mugashinga amategeko acinyiza abantu.
Munyaga abakene utwabo, mukareka gucira imanza zibereye abacinyijwe bo mu bwoko bwanje, abapfakazi mubagira iminyago yanyu, impfuvyi mukazisahura utwazo.
Mbega ku musi w’imanza muzogira gute, igihe amakuba azobashikako avuye kure? Muzohungira kwa nde ngo abatabare? Mbega ubutunzi bwanyu muzobunyegeza he?
Nta kindi muzoba musigaje atari ukuburanirwa muri mu banyagano, canke imivyimba yanyu ikagwa mu basogoswe. Ariko ivyo vyose ntibizohwamika uburake bwiwe, ukuboko kwiwe kuzoba kukibanguye kuri bo.
"Uragowe, yewe Ashuri, wewe nkoni y’ishavu ryanje, inkoni witwaje ni yo burake bwanje.
Nzogutuma gutera ihanga ritubaha Imana, nzokurungika mu bwoko buntera ishavu, ubasahure wongere ubatware nk’iminyago, ubahonyangishe ibirenge nk’uwuhonyanga ivyondo mu nzira.
Ariko umwami wa Ashuri ntazoba atahura ko ari igikoresho canje, ivyo si vyo azoba afise mu mutwe; intumbero yiwe ni uguhonya, ashire iherezo ku mahanga menshi.
Kuko avuga ati: umwe wese mu baganwa banje azoba umwami vuba.
Tuzosangangura Kalino nk’uko twabikoreye Karikemishi, Hamati hazogwa mu maboko yacu nk’uko vyagendeye Arupadi. Kandi tuzosangangura Samariya nk’uko twabikoze i Damasiko.
Ko ukuboko kwanje kwashoboye gufata ubwami bufise ibigirwamana, ubwami bwasumvya ibigirwamana Yerusalemu na Samariya,
mbega sinzomara amanyama Yerusalemu n’ibigirwamana vyaho, nk’uko namaze amanyama Samariya n’ibigirwamana vyaho?"
Uhoraho niyamara gushitsa ivyago yateguriye umusozi Siyoni na Yerusalemu, azovuga ati: "Ngiye guhana umwami wa Ashuri, kuko yuzuye ubwibone n’ukwishira hejuru.

Kuko azovuga ati: ‘Narabikoze jewe ubwanje, ndabikoresheje inkomezi z’ukuboko kwanje n’ubwenge bwanje, kuko ndi umunyabwenge. Nakuyeho imbibe hagati y’amahanga, nanyaze ubutunzi bwaho; mu butwari bwinshi, nakuye ku ngoma abami benshi.

Nk’uko umuntu yaruza icari, ni ko ukuboko kwanje kwatwaye ubutunzi bw’amahanga. Nk’uko umuntu yegeranya amagi, ni ko negeranije ibihugu vyo kw’isi vyose. Nta n’umwe yakubise n’ibaba, nta n’uwaryogoye.’ "
Mbega incabiti yokwirata ku wuyikoresha? Canke umusumeno wokwishima ku wuwukoresha? Mbega inkoni yokubita ata wuyikubitishije, canke inkoni yokwigendagendesha ata wuyishimikije?
Ni co gituma Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, azoteza ingwara abasoda bawe bakomeye, amagara abashiremwo, kandi musi y’ubwiza bwiwe, hazocanwa umuriro umuriro utongora.
Uhoraho , Umuco wa Isirayeli, azohinduka umuriro; kandi Uwera azohinduka nk’urubeya. Ku musi umwe, azotongora ayo mahwa n’imikere.
Ubwiza bw’amashamba yiwe n’amatongo yiwe amera, bizotikizwa bihere, bimere nk’umugwayi acikanye.
Ibiti bizosigara muri ayo mashamba yaho bizoba ari bike, ku buryo n’umwana yobiharura.
Kuri uwo musi amasigarira ya Isirayeli, abazoba barokotse ba Yakobo, ntibazoba bakimwisunga ntibazisunga uwabakubise, ahubwo bazokwizigira Uhoraho , Uwera wa Isirayeli.
Amasigarira azogaruka, amasigarira ya Yakobo azogaruka ku Mana Ikomeye.
Isirayeli we, naho abantu bawe ari nk’umusenyi wo ku kiyaga, inkehwa gusa ni zo zizogaruka. Agatikizo karamaze gutegurwa, Uhoraho yahisemwo kubatikiza kuko ari co babereye.
Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, azoshitsa ako gatikizo ku gihugu cose, nk’uko yabiteguye.
None rero uku ni ko Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, avuze: "Yemwe bwoko bwanje buba i Siyoni, ntimutinye Abashuri, babakubita inkoni, bakababangurira ibibando, nk’uko Abanyegiputa babigira.
Hasigaye igihe gito, uburake nari mfitiye mwebwe bugahera, uburake bwanje buzoba agatikizo k’Abashuri."
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose azobakubitisha ikimoko, nk’uko yakubitiye Abamidiyani ku gitandara c’i Horebu, kandi azoramvurira inkoni yiwe hejuru y’amazi, nk’uko yabigize muri Egiputa.
Kuri uwo musi imitwaro yabo izokurwa ku bitugu vyanyu, ingogo zabo zikurwe ku mazosi yanyu; ingogo izovunika kuko muzoba mwaravyibushe cane.
