Ntibantakambira bivuye mu mitima yabo, ariko baborogera ku mariri yabo. Bakoranira hamwe gusaba imana z’amahanga basaba ingano n’umuvinyu musha ariko bakanja kure.
Narabigishije kandi ndabakomeza, ariko bangiriye inama mbi.
Ntibahindukiriye Iyisumbavyose; bameze nk’umuheto ugoramye. Abatware babo bazokwicwa n’inkota ku bw’amajambo yabo y’ubweruzi. Kubera ivyo bazocokorwa bari mu gihugu ca Egiputa.
Shira inzamba ku munwa! Umwansi amanutse nk’inkona ku nzu y’ Uhoraho kuko abantu barenze kw’isezerano ryanje bakagarariza ivyagezwe vyanje.
Abisirayeli barantakambira bavuga bati: "Ewe Mana, turakwemeye!"
Ariko Isirayeli yataye ivyari vyiza; nuko rero umwansi azomuhiga.
Biyimikiye abami batangishije inama; batoranije abaganwa ntabahaye uruhusha. Bakoresha ifeza n’inzahabu vyabo mu gucura ibigirwamana bizotuma bahona.
Yewe Samariya, terera kure ikigirwamana cawe c’inyana! Uburake bwanje burarurumvye kubera vyo. Uzogeza ryari kugendera mu bidatunganye?
Umwisirayeli ni we yakubumbiye iyo nyana, ariko ni jewe Mana jenyene. None rero izomenagurwa, ijanjagurike, iyo nyana y’i Samariya.
"Babivye umuyaga, bazokwimbura agashururu. Ingano zabo nta ntete ziriko; ntizizovamwo ifu. Naho zokwera imbuto, abanyamahanga ni bo bazozirira.
Abisirayeli baramizwe; ubu iyo bari mu mahanga bameze nk’inkono itagira ikimazi.
Kuko baduze bakaja muri Ashuri, bagiye kurya kw’indogoba yo mw’ishamba yangara yonyene. Efurayimu yishoye ku bandi bagabo yikundiye.
Naho bishoye mu mahanga bakifatanya na benshi, ngiye kubegeraniriza hamwe ndabacire urubanza. Bazoremerwa cane bari musi y’agacinyizo k’umwami ahambaye.
Naho Efurayimu yubatse ibicaniro vyinshi vyo gutanga ibimazi vy’ivyaha, vyahindutse ibicaniro vyo gukora ivyaha.
Nabandikiye vyinshi mu vyagezwe vyanje, ariko babiravye nk’ikintu c’icaduka.
Naho batanga ibimazi nk’ishikanwa bampaye, kandi naho baheza bakarya inyama, Uhoraho ntibamuhimbara. Ubu nzokwibuka ibibi vyabo ndabahanire ivyaha vyabo: bazosubira muri Egiputa.
Abisirayeli bibagiye Umuremyi wabo maze bubaka ibirimba bihambaye; Abayuda bakomeje ibisagara vyabo. Ariko nzotuma umuriro ku bisagara vyabo uzotongora iminara yabo."
Ntunezerwe, Isirayeli; ntutwarwe n’akanyamuneza nk’ayandi mahanga. Kuko wahemukiye Imana yawe; ugakunda ingero igererwa maraya usenga ibigirwamana ku mbuga yose yo kugosorerako.
Ku bw’ivyo, imbuga zo kugosorerako n’amato yo kuganiramwo ntibizoshobora kugaburira abantu; umutobe musha nta wo bazobona.
Ntimuzoguma mu gihugu c’ Uhoraho ; Efurayimu azosubira muri Egiputa kandi azorya ivyokurya bihumanye vyo muri Ashuri.

Ntibazosukira Uhoraho ishikanwa ry’umuvinyu, canke ngo ibimazi vyabo bimuhimbare. Ibimazi nk’ivyo bizobabera nk’ivyokurya vy’abagandaye; abazobirya bose bazoba bahumanye. Ivyo ni vyo bizoba ivyokurya vyabo ubwabo; ntibizoza mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Mbega muzokora iki ku misi mikuru yanyu yashinzwe, ku misi mikuru y’ Uhoraho ?
Naho bokira gutikiza kwa Ashuri, Egiputa izobegeranya, Memfisi na yo izobahamba. Ubutunzi bwanyu bw’ifeza buzorengerwa n’imikere, amahwa na yo azomera mu mahema yanyu yasanganguwe.

Imisi yo guhana Isirayeli iraje, imisi yo kugerera umuntu iri hafi. Abisirayeli nimubimenye. Kuko ivyaha vyanyu ari vyinshi cane n’ubwansi bwanyu bukaba bwinshi. Uwuvugishwa n’Imana mumufata nk’ikijuju, kandi uwuhumekerwa nanje mumufata nk’umusazi.
Uwuvugishwa n’Imana ari kumwe n’Imana yanje, ni umuteramyi ateramiye Efurayimu, ariko mwamuteze imitego mu nzira ziwe acamwo, n’ubwansi mu nzu y’Imana yiwe.
Mwinjiye i bwina mu bibi, nko mu misi ya Gibeya. Imana izokwibuka ibibi vyabo, yongere ibahanire ivyaha vyabo.

"Aho natora Isirayeli, kwari nk’ugutora inzabibu mu bugaragwa; aho nabona ba sogokuruza banyu, kwari nk’ukubona ivyamwa vyeze imbere y’ibindi ku musukoni. Ariko bashitse i Bayali-Peyori, bifatanije na ca kigirwamana Bayali giteye isoni baca baba abo kwankwa urunuka nk’ico kintu bari bifatanije.
Ubwiza bwa Efurayimu buzoguruka nk’inyoni, nta kuvuka, nta gutwara inda, nta n’ugusama inda.
Kandi naho boronka abana, nzobahonya bose nta wuzosigara. Bazoba bagowe aho nzobaterera ibitugu!
Nabonye Efurayimu, hameze nk’i Tiro, hasharijwe nk’ahantu h’igikundiro. Ariko Efurayimu we azosohokana hanze abana biwe ngo batemagurwe."
Ewe Uhoraho , bahe, mbega wobaha iki? Bahe inda zisamwa ariko zigakoroka n’amabere atagira amaberebere.
"Kubera ibibi vyabo vyose bakoreye i Gilugali, aho ni ho nabankiye. Kubera ibikorwa vyabo bibi, nzobasohora bamvire mu nzu. Sinzosubira kubakunda; abatware babo bose ni abagarariji.
Efurayimu ararashwe, imizi yiwe irakabiranye, kandi ntibazokwama ivyamwa. Naho bovyara abana, nzokwicisha inkota uruvyaro rwabo bakunda cane."
Imana yanje izobaheba kuko batamwumviye; bazoba inyererezi mu mahanga.

Isirayeli yari uruzabibu rumeze neza; yamye ivyamwa vyiwe vyiza. Ariko, uko ivyamwa vyiwe vyagwira, ni ko yarushaho kwubaka ibicaniro vy’ibigirwamana; uko igihugu ciwe catera imbere, ni ko yarushaho gushariza inkingi z’amabuye yo gusengwa.
Imitima yabo iriyorobeka, kandi bagira biremeke ibigabitanyo vyabo. Uhoraho azosambura ibicaniro vyabo kandi azosangangura izo nkingi zabo.
Maze bazovuga bati: "Nta mwami tugira kuko tutubashe Uhoraho . Ariko kandi naho twari kuba dufise umwami, yari kutumarira iki?"
Basezerana amasezerano menshi, bakarahira indahiro z’ibinyoma kandi bakiyemeza vyinshi; ni co gituma urubanza rwabo rutanguye gukura nk’igiterwa gifise ubumara cadutse mu ndimiro.

Abantu baba i Samariya baratinya ivyoshikira ikigirwamana c’imasa c’i Beti-Aveni. Abantu baho bazokigandarira, kandi n’abaherezi baco ni uko, abari bahimbawe n’ugukayangana kwaco, kuko kizojanwa kw’inyagano kive muri bo.
Kizojanwa muri Ashuri kibe ingabire ihawe umwami mukuru. Efurayimu azoteterwa; Isirayeli amaramare ku bw’amasezerano yagize n’abanyamahanga.
Samariya n’umwami waho bazotikizwa, bakamangane nk’ifuro rireremba ku mazi.

Ibibanza vyo ku misozi miremire aho basengera ibigirwamana bizosamburwa, ni co caha ca Isirayeli. Amahwa n’imikere bizomera bikure birenge ku bicaniro vyaho. Maze bazobwira imisozi bati: "Duhambe!" n’imitumba bati: "Tugweko!"
Kuva mu misi ya Gibeya, wakoze ivyaha, yewe Isirayeli, kandi aho ni ho wagumye. Mbega intambara ntizosubira guhitana abanyakibi i Gibeya?
Aho bizompimbarira, nzobahana; amahanga azokoranywa no kubagwanya ngo abashire mu minyororo kubera ivyaha vyabo vyinshi.
Efurayimu ameze nk’ishashi yigishijwe igakunda gusekura ingano; none rero nzomwambika ingogo ku kazosi kiwe kagororotse. Nzokwega Efurayimu, Yuda azomena umushike, Yakobo na we azokangaza.

Nimwibibire ubugororotsi, kugira ngo muze mwimbure ivyamwa vy’urukundo rudashira, kandi mumene imishike ari yo mitima yanyu; kuko iki ari igihe co kurondera Uhoraho , kugeza aho azozira akabacuncuburirako imvura y’ubugororotsi.
Ariko mwabivye ubugarariji, mwimbura ibibi, mwariye ivyamwa vy’ibinyoma. Kuko mwizigiye inkomezi zanyu gusa n’inkomezi z’ingabo zanyu nyinshi,

ni co gituma akaruru k’intambara kazovyuka ku bw’abantu banyu, kugira ngo inzitiro zanyu zose zize zisangangurwe, nk’uko Shalumani yasanganguye Beti-Arubeli ku musi w’intambara, aho abagore bamenagurirwa hasi hamwe n’abana babo.
Ni ko bizoba kuri wewe, yewe Beteli, kuko ibibi vyawe ari vyinshi. Aho umutwenzi wo guhanwa uzotambikira, umwami wa Isirayeli azosangangurwa rwose.
Isirayeli akiri umwana, naramukunda, kandi nahamagaye umwana wanje ngo ave muri Egiputa.
Ariko uko nabahamagara, ni ko barushaho kuja kure yanje. Bashikaniye ibimazi za Bayali kandi baturirira ibimota neza ibishushanyo.
Ni jewe nigishije Efurayimu gutambuka, ndabafashe ukuboko; ariko ntibamenye ko ari jewe nabakijije ingwara.
Nabakwegesheje imigozi y’ukugira neza kw’abantu, n’imigozi y’urukundo. Nababereye nk’uwuterura akana gatoya akagakikira, kandi narunamye kugira ngo ndabagaburire.
Mbega ntibazosubira muri Egiputa, vyongeye Abashuri ntibazobaganza ko banse kwihana?
Inkota izoza ku bisagara vyabo; izorigata abavugishwa b’ibinyoma babo ishire kw’iherezo imigambi yabo.
Abantu banje bafashe ingingo yo kuntera ibitugu. Naho banyita Imana Musumbavyose, sinzokwigera ndabashira hejuru.
"Efurayimu we, mbega noguheba nte? Isirayeli we, mbega nogutanga gute? Mbega nokugirira nk’i Adima? Mbega nokugirira nka Zeboyimu? Umutima wanje urabuze ico uhitamwo; ntewe n’akagongwe.
Sinzobahanana uburake, kandi sinzosubira gusangangura Efurayimu. Kuko ndi Imana, ntari umuntu, Uwera ari muri mwebwe. Sinzotera ibisagara vyabo.
Kuko umusi umwe bazokurikira Uhoraho ; kandi nzokwivuga nk’intambwe. Aho nzokwivugira, abana biwe bazoza bahinda agashitsi bava mu burengero.
Bazoza bavuye muri Egiputa, bahinda agashitsi nk’inyoni, bavuye muri Ashuri, bameze nk’inuma. Nzobasubiza mu mazu yabo," ni ko Uhoraho agize.
Efurayimu yankikije ibinyoma, Isirayeli na we yankikije uguhendana. Kandi Yuda yahindutse umugarariji ku Mana, ku Wera w’Umwizigirwa.
Efurayimu arya umuyaga; akurikira umuyaga uturutse mu buseruko rikarinda rirenga, akagwiza ibinyoma n’umuryano. Yagiriraniye amasezerano na Ashuri kandi yarungitse amavuta ya elayo muri Egiputa.
Uhoraho arafise ivyo yagiriza Abayuda; azohana Yakobo ibihuye n’inzira ziwe kandi azomwishura ibihwanye n’ibikorwa vyiwe.
Akiri mu nda yaniganye na mukuruwe amufashe igitsintsiri; amaze gukura naho anigana n’Imana.
Yaniganye n’umumarayika aratsinda; yararize asaba umuhezagiro. Aho i Beteli, yabonye Imana imbonankubone maze Imana ivuganira na we aho hantu.
Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose, Uhoraho ni ryo zina ryiwe!
Nuko rero, ubu nimugaruke ku Mana mugumye urukundo n’uguca imanza zibereye, maze mwame mwiteze Imana yanyu imisi yose.
Ariko si uko biri, umudandaza akoresha iminzane ibesha agakunda inyungu mbi.
Efurayimu arishima ngo: Ndatunze cane; narironkeye ubutunzi. Nta woronka ico anyagiriza mu butunzi bwanje bwose nk’icaha canke kugabitanya.
Ariko, namye ndi Uhoraho Imana yawe kuva ukiva muri Egiputa; nzotuma usubira kuba mu mahema kandi, nka kurya kwo mu misi mikuru yawe yashinzwe.
Navuganye n’abavugishwa banje ndabagutumako, ntuma berekwa vyinshi ndakubwira mu migani myinshi ncishije muri bo.
Mbega ab’i Gileyadi ni abanyakibi? Abantu baho nta co bamaze! Mbega bashikanira ibimazi vyabo i Gilugali? Ibicaniro vyabo bizoba nk’ibirundo vy’amabuye biri mu busize.
Yakobo yahungiye mu gihugu ca Aramu, Isirayeli yarakoze ngo aronke umugore, kugira ngo amukwe yaragiye intama.
Uhoraho yakoresheje uwuvugishwa na we ngo adugane Isirayeli amukuye muri Egiputa, yakoresheje uwavugishwa na we ngo abe umwungere w’abantu biwe.
Ariko Efurayimu yamuteye uburake bw’inkazi; Umwami wiwe azomusubiza ku mutwe amaraso yasheshe kandi azomusubiriza mu nkoko ivyaha vyiwe.
Iyo Efurayimu avuze, abantu barajugumira; kuko yashizwe hejuru mu Bisirayeli. Ariko Abefurayimu baracumuye mu gusenga Bayali maze barapfa.

Ubu rero barushirijeho gukora ivyaha; bicurira ibigirwamana mw’ifeza zabo, bihinguriye mu bwenge bwabo ibishushanyo. Vyose ni ibikorwa vy’abacuzi. Ehe ibivugwa kuri abo bantu: "Batanga abantu kw’ibimazi! Bagasoma ibishushanyo vy’inka!"
Ni co gituma bazoba nk’ikime co mu gitondo, nk’igipfungu co mu gatondo kiyonga gihuye n’izuba, nk’umuguruka utumuka uva ku mbuga yo kugosorerako, nk’umwotsi usohoka uca mw’idirisha.
"Ariko namye ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu kuva aho mwaviriye muri Egiputa. Nta yindi Mana muzokwemera atari jewe, kuko ata Mukiza wundi atari jewe.
Narakwitwararitse uri mu bugaragwa, mu gihugu c’ubushuhe buturira.
Aho nabagaburira, barariye barahaga; bamaze guhaga, bafatwa n’ubwibone; maze baranyibagira.
Ni co gituma nzoba nk’intambwe kuri bo, nzobabundira nk’uko ingwe ibunda i ruhande y’inzira.
Nk’idubu ryibwe ibibuguru vyaryo, nzobatera, maze ndabatabagure; nzobashihagura nk’intambwe y’ingore, igikoko co mw’ishamba kizobatabagura.
Urahonye, yewe Isirayeli, kuko wigize umwansi wanje, jewe umutabazi wawe.
Umwami wawe ari hehe, kugira ngo agukize? Abatware bawe bo mu bisagara vyose vyawe bari hehe? Abo wansavye uvuga uti: ‘Mpa umwami n’abaganwa’?
Ico catumye ndaguha umwami nshavuye, kandi mu burake bwanje ndamutwara.
Ivyaha vya Efurayimu vyaregeranijwe, ivyaha vyiwe vyaranditswe birabikwa.
Uburibwe bubajeko nk’uko ibise biza ku mugore afise inda, ariko ni nk’umwana atagira ubwenge; igihe gishitse co kuvuka, ntazoshobora gusohoka ngo ave mu nda ya nyina.
Nzotabara aba bantu ndabakure mu kuzimu; nzobacungura ndabakure mu rupfu. Wa rupfu we, ivyago vyawe biri hehe? Kuzimu we, ubushobozi bwawe bwo kwica buri hehe? Sinzogira impuhwe,

Efurayimu naho yotera imbere hagati mu bavukanyi biwe. Umuyaga uvuye k’ Uhoraho uzoza uvuye i buseruko, uzohuha uturutse mu bugaragwa; isoko yabo izokama n’iriba ryaho ryume. Ububiko bwabo buzokwibwa ubutunzi burimwo bwose bunyagwe.
Abantu b’i Samariya bazobona inkurikizi z’ivyo bakoze, kuko bagararije Imana yabo. Bazokwicwa n’inkota; abana babo b’inzoya bazobasya babamenagurire hasi, abagore babo bibungenze bazofomozwa inkota."
Nimugaruke k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, yemwe Bisirayeli. Kuko ivyaha vyanyu ari vyo vyatumye mugwa!
Nimujane amajambo yanyu yo kwihana mugende k’ Uhoraho . Mumubwire muti: "Duharire ivyaha vyacu vyose maze utwakirane ubuntu, kugira ngo tugushikanire ivyimburwa vy’ishimwe bivuye mu kanwa kacu.

Ashuri ntibashobora kudukiza; canke kwurira amafarasi yacu y’intambara. Ntituzosubira kuvuga tuti: ‘Muri imana zacu,’ tubwira ivyo amaboko yacu yakoze, kuko muri wewe honyene ni ho impfuvyi zironka kugirirwa impuhwe."
"Nzoharira ugusubira inyuma kwanyu kandi nzobakundisha umutima wanje wose, kuko uburake bwanje bubavuyeko.
Nzoba nk’ikime ku Bisirayeli; bazoshurika nk’ishurwe ryiza. Bazoshora imizi igere kure mw’ivu nk’igiti c’isederi c’i Libani
kandi imivyaro yabo izokura. Ubwiza bwabo buzoba nk’ubw’igiti c’umwelayo, ugutamirana kwabo kuzoba nk’ukw’isederi ry’i Libani.
Abantu bazosubira kuba musi y’igitutu ciwe; bazokura nk’ingano, bashurike nk’imizabibu, kumenyekana kw’Abisirayeli kuzoba nk’ukw’umuvinyu w’i Libani.
Efurayimu we, uracasangiye iki n’ibigirwamana? Nzomwishura kandi nzomwitaho. Nzoba nk’igiti c’isederi cama gitoshe; ivyamwa vyawe biva kuri jewe."
Ni nde w’umunyabwenge? Natahure ibi bintu. Ni nde afise ubumenyi? Nabimenye. Inzira z’ Uhoraho ziragororotse; kandi umugororotsi azozigenderamwo, ariko abagarariji bazozitsitaramwo bagwe.

name: Yoweli
chapters: Iri ni ijambo Uhoraho yatumye kuri Yoweli mwene Petuweli.
Nimwumve ibi, yemwe batware; nimwumvirize, yemwe ababa mu gihugu mwese. Mbega hari ikintu nk’iki cari bwigere kiba kuva aho mwabereyeho, canke kuva aho ba sogokuruza banyu babereyeho?
Nimubibwire abana banyu, n’abana banyu bazobibwire abana babo, n’abana babo bazobibwire urunganwe ruzokurikira.
Ivyo inzige zisanzwe zasigaje, inzige nininini zarabiriye; ivyo inzige nininini zasigaje, ivyana vy’inzige vyarabiriye Ivyo ivyana vy’inzige vyasigaje, izindi nzige zarabiriye.
Nimwikangure, yemwe mborerwa mwe, maze murire! Nimuboroge, yemwe mwa banywi b’umuvinyu mwe; muboroge, kubera umuvinyu mushasha, muwukuwe mu kanwa.
Ihanga riteye igihugu canje, ingabo z’inkomezi zitoharurika; bafise amenyo nk’ay’intare, n’imibangabanga nk’iy’intare y’ingore.
Bahoneje inzabibu zanje kandi barandaguye imisukoni yanje. Barabishishaguye, babishiburira hirya, basiga amashami yera.
Nimugandare nk’inkumi yambaye igunira iririra umusore yari ayikoye.
Amashikanwa y’ifu n’ay’ibinyobwa araciwe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho . Abaherezi baragandaye, ari bo bakorera imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Imirima irarandaguwe, isi iragadutse; ingano zirahonye, umutobe w’umuvinyu urakamye, n’amavuta ya elayo arabuze.
Nimwihebure, yemwe barimyi, muboroge yemwe barimyi b’imizabibu; mubabare kubera ingano na sayiri, kuko ivyimburwa vyo mu mirima bisanganguwe.
Umuvinyu urakamye umusukoni urakabiranye; amakomamanga, ibigazi n’amapome, n’ibiti vyose vy’ivyamwa birumye. Ni ukuri umunezero w’abantu uraheze.

Nimwambare amagunira, yemwe baherezi, maze mugandare; nimuboroge, yemwe abakorera imbere y’igicaniro. Nimuze mumare ijoro mwambaye amagunira, yemwe abakorera imbere y’Imana yanje; kuko amashikanwa y’ifu n’ay’ibinyobwa bibuze mu Ngoro y’Imana yanyu.
Nimwamamaze ukwisonzesha kwera; nimutumeko ikoraniro ryera. Nimutumeko abatware n’ababa mu gihugu bose ngo baze ku Ngoro y’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, maze batakambire Uhoraho .
Ewe musi uri aho! Uwo umusi w’ Uhoraho uri hafi; uzoza nk’icago gihonya uvuye ku Mana ihambaye.
Mbega ivyokurya ntivyakuweho imbere y’amaso yanyu, n’umunezero no guhimbarwa biva ku nzu y’Imana yacu?
Imbuto zumiye mu kuzimu. Ibigega bisigaye ari imisaka, ububiko bw’ingano bwarasambuwe, kuko ingano zaheze.
Ibitungwa biraniha. Amasho arasanzaye hirya no hino; kuko abuze uburagiro; n’imikuku y’intama n’impene ishikiwe n’ivyago.
Uhoraho , ni wewe ntakambiye, kuko umuriro watongoye uburagiro bwo mu bugaragwa n’ibirimi vy’umuriro vyatongoye ibiti vyo mu murima.
N’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba bihuzagizwa bikurondera; amasoko y’amazi yakamye, umuriro na wo watongoye uburagiro bwo mu bugaragwa.
Nimuvuze inzamba i Siyoni; muvuze akamo k’intambara ku musozi wanje wera. Ababa mu gihugu nibahinde agashitsi, kuko umusi w’ Uhoraho ushitse. Uregereje uri hafi,
umusi w’umwijima w’umuzitanya, umusi w’ibicu n’umuzimagiza. Nk’uko umutwenzi uza ku misozi ni ko ingabo z’inkomezi nyinshi zije, ntivyari bwabe muri kahise kandi ntibizosubira kubaho muri kazoza.
Imbere yabo umuriro uratongora, inyuma yabo imbeya zirarabagiza. Imbere yabo igihugu kimeze nk’itongo rya Edeni, inyuma yabo, ni ubugaragwa, nta na kimwe basigaza.
Bafise ishusho y’amafarasi; biruka nk’abagwanira ku mafarasi.
Urwamo rwabo ni nk’urw’imikogote Basimbagurika ku dutwe tw’imisozi, bameze nk’umuriro utongora isakamburira, ni nk’ingabo z’inkomezi zigiye mu ntambara.
Imbere yabo, amahanga ahinda agashitsi; mu maso h’abantu bose harahindurira.
Batera nk’abahizi; burira inzitiro nk’abasoda. Bose bagenda ku murongo, nta n’umwe ahesha ngo aje ku ruhande.
Nta n’umwe agunda mugenziwe; umwe wese agenda aramirije imbere yiwe; binjira baciye mu mpome nta kibatangira.
Bitera mu gisagara; biruka inyuma y’uruzitiro. Barurira bakitera mu mazu; binjira baciye mu madirisha kurya kw’ibisuma.
Imbere yabo isi iratigita, n’amajuru agahinda agashitsi izuba n’ukwezi bicuze umwijima, n’inyenyeri ntizicaka.
Uhoraho araturagaye ari imbere y’ingabo ziwe; ingabo ziwe ntiziharurika, kandi ingabo zimuyoboka ni inyenkomezi. Umusi w’ Uhoraho urahambaye; ni umusi wo guhonya. Ni nde azoshobora kuwihanganira?
"Mbere n’ubu nyene," ni ko Uhoraho avuze, "nimungarukeko n’umutima wanyu wose, mwisonzesha, murira kandi mugandaye."

Imitima yanyu nibe ari yo mutabura mureke impuzu zanyu. Nimugaruke k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, kuko ari umunyabuntu agira imbabazi, ateba kuraka kandi agira urukundo rwinshi, kandi arigarura ngo ntarungike ivyago.
Hari uwubizi? Ashobora kwigarura akabasigarana umugisha w’amashikanwa y’amafu n’ay’ibinyobwa mushikanira Uhoraho Imana yanyu.
Nimuvuze inzamba i Siyoni, nimuhamagarire abantu ukwisonzesha kwera, mukoranye ikoraniro ryera.
Nimukoranye abantu, mugire ikoraniro ryera; nimukoranye abakurambere, egeranya abana, mukoranye n’abakiri kw’ibere. Uwarongoye nasohoke n’umugeni ave mu nkinga.

Abaherezi bakorera imbere y’ Uhoraho , nibaririre hagati y’urwinjiriro n’igicaniro. Nibavuge bati: "Ziguriza abantu bawe, yewe Uhoraho . Ntuhindure umugabane wawe agatwengo, canke akamenyo hagati mu mahanga. Ni kubera iki mu mahanga bobaza bati: ‘Mbega Imana yabo iri hehe?’ "
Maze Uhoraho agirira urukundo rwinshi igihugu ciwe kandi agirira akagongwe abantu biwe.
Uhoraho arabishura ati: "Nzobarungikira ingano, umutobe musha w’umuvinyu n’amavuta ya elayo, bikwiye vyo kubahaza; sinzokwongera kubahindura agatwengo mu mahanga.

Nzokwirukana abansi banyu bo mu buraruko baje kure y’aho muri, ndabahindagize gushika mu gihugu kigadutse c’ubugaragwa. Umuce wabo wo mu buseruko nzowirukanira mu Kiyaga c’Umunyu, maze umuce wo mu burengero ndawurungike mu Kiyaga Mediterane. Kandi ukubora kwabo kuzomenyekana n’ukunuka kw’imivyimba yabo kuzoduga mu kirere." Koko yakoze ibikomeye!
Ntimutinye, yemwe ababa i Buyuda; nimunezerwe kandi muhimbarwe. Ni ukuri Uhoraho yakoze ibikomeye!
Ntimutinye, yemwe bikoko vyo mw’ishamba, kuko uburagiro bwo mu bugaragwa butanguye gutotahara. Ibiti biriko birama ivyamwa vyavyo; imisukoni n’imizabibu vyama ivyimburwa vyavyo.
Nimunezerwe, bantu b’i Siyoni, nimunezererwe Uhoraho Imana yanyu, kuko yabahaye imvura y’impeshi abitewe n’uko ari umwizigirwa. Abaha imvura nyinshi, yo ku mpeshi n’iyo mu rushana, nk’uko vyahora.
Imbuga zizokwuzura ingano; amato azosesekara imitobe y’umuvinyu n’amavuta.
"Nzogushumbusha imyaka yariwe n’inzige; inzige nininini n’abana b’inzige, hamwe n’ubundi bwoko bw’inzige, ari zo ngabo zanje zihambaye, izo narungitse muri mwebwe.
Muzoronka umusesekara w’ivyokurya, muhage, kandi muzohimbaza izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, yakoreye ibitangaza muri mwebwe; kandi abantu banje ntibazosubira kumaramara.
Ni ho muzomenya ko ndi mu Bisirayeli, ko ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu, kandi ko ata yindi iriho; abantu banje ntibazokwigera basubira kumaramara.
Kandi hanyuma y’ivyo, nzosuka Mpwemu wanje ku bantu bose. Abahungu banyu n’abakobwa banyu bazovugishwa, abatama banyu bazorota indoto, n’abasore banyu bazobona ivyo beretswe.
N’abasavyi banje, abagabo n’abagore, nzobasukako Mpwemu wanje muri iyo misi.
Nzokwerekana ibimenyetso mw’ijuru no kw’isi, amaraso n’umuriro n’ugupfunduka kw’umwotsi.
Izuba rizohinduka umwijima, ukwezi guhinduke guse n’amaraso imbere y’uko uwo musi uhambaye w’agatikizo kandi w’ Uhoraho ushika.
Kandi umuntu wese azokwambaza izina ry’ Uhoraho azokizwa; kuko ku musozi Siyoni n’i Yerusalemu hazoba ugutabarwa, nk’uko Uhoraho yavuze, mbere no mu bazoba barokotse ivyago abo Uhoraho azohamagara."
"Muri iyo misi no muri ico gihe, aho nzogarukanira Abayuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu,

nzokwegeranya amahanga yose ndayakoranirize mu kiyaya ca Yehoshafati. Aho ni ho nzobageragereza kubera ivyo bakoreye umugabane wanje, ari bo bantu banje b’Abisirayeli, kuko basanzaje abantu banje mu mahanga bakagabura igihugu canje.
Bagize ubupfindo ku bantu banje; bagurisha abahungu ngo baronke ba maraya, bakagurisha abakobwa kugira ngo baronke umuvinyu ukwiye wo kunywa.
None ga Tiro na Sidoni munyagiriza iki, mwe n’intara ziri kumwe namwe z’i Bufilisitiya? Mbega munyihora ico nabakoreye? Nimwaba muriko muranyihora, nzobasubizako vuba kandi vyihuta ivyo mwakoze.
Kuko mwafashe ifeza zanje n’inzahabu zanje, mugatwara ivyarusha ibindi kuba vyiza mu butunzi bwanje mubijana mu ngoro zanyu.
Mwagurishije abantu banje b’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu ku Bagiriki, kugira ngo mubarungike kure y’igihugu cabo.
Raba, ngiye kubavyura ndabakure aho mwabagurishije hose, kandi nzosubiza kuri mwebwe nyene ivyo mwakoze.
Nzogurisha abahungu banyu n’abakobwa banyu ku bantu b’i Buyuda, maze na bo bazobagurisha ku Basabeya, ihanga rya kure." Ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Nimubimenyeshe mu mahanga: Nimwitegurire intambara! Kangura abahizi! Abagwanyi bose nibegere hafi batere.
Ivyuma birima vy’imikogote yanyu mubicuremwo inkota imihoro yanyu muyicuremwo amacumu. Umunyantegenke avuge ati: "Ndakomeye!"
Nimuze munyaruka, yemwe mahanga mwese muve mu mpande zose, mukoranireyo. Manukana abagwanyi bawe, ewe Uhoraho !
"Amahanga navyuke; yose aje mu kiyaya ca Yehoshafati, kuko aho ari ho nzokwicara maze ncire imanza amahanga yose yo mu mpande zose.
Bangura umuhoro, kuko iyimbura rigeze. Nimuze, mugane inzabibu, kuko ubwato bwuzuye kandi ubwato bwo kuganiramwo bukaba busesekaye, ibibi vyabo ni vyinshi!"
Ibihumbi n’ibihumbi bari mu kiyaya c’imanza! Kuko umusi w’ Uhoraho uri hafi mu kiyaya c’imanza.
Izuba n’ukwezi bizokwirabura nk’umwijima, kandi n’inyenyeri ntizizoba zigikayangana.
Uhoraho azokwivuga ari i Siyoni kandi azoturagara ari i Yerusalemu; isi n’amajuru bizohinda agashitsi. Ariko Uhoraho azobera abantu biwe ubuhungiro, umunara wo guhungiramwo w’Abisirayeli.
"Ni ho muzomenyera ko jewe, Uhoraho Imana yanyu, mba i Siyoni, umusozi wanje wera. Yerusalemu hazoba ahera; abanyamahanga ntibazosubira kuhatera.
Kuri uwo musi imisozi izotembako umutobe w’umuvinyu, n’uturambi tuzotembako ubuki; imyonga yose y’i Buyuda itembemwo amazi. Isoko izotemba iva mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho kandi izovomera ikiyaya c’iminyinya.
Ariko Egiputa hazoba umusaka, Edomu habe ubugaragwa, kubera ibibi bakoreye abantu b’i Buyuda, igihugu basheshemwo amaraso y’abatagira icaha.
I Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu hazoba abantu ibihe vyose uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi.
Sinzoshirwa ntahoye amaraso y’abatagira icaha. Haba na mba." Uhoraho ahangamye i Siyoni!

name: Amosi
chapters: Aya ni amajambo yahawe Amosi, umwungere w’i Tekowa i Buyuda. Ayo majambo yayaronse mu vyo yeretswe imyaka ibiri imbere y’uko haba nyamugigima, hakaba hari ku ngoma ya Uziya umwami w’i Buyuda, n’iya Yerobowamu mwene Yowashi umwami wa Isirayeli.
Yavuze ati: " Uhoraho yivuze ari i Siyoni aturagara ari i Yerusalemu; uburagiro bw’abungere buruma, kandi ku gatwe ka Karumeli harakabirana."
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: "Kubera ivyaha bitatu vya Damasiko, mbere ni bine, sinzogenda ntabahanye! Kuko basekuje abantu banje b’i Gileyadi imihini y’ivyuma.
Nzorungika umuriro ku nzu ya Hazayeli kandi uzotongora impome zikomeye za Beni-Hadadi.
Nzohomvorera hasi amarembo y’i Damasiko; nzokwica umwami ari mu kiyaya ca Aveni n’uwufise inkoni yo kuganza ari i Beti-Edeni. Abantu b’i Siriya bazojanwa ari inyagano i Kiru," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: "Kubera ivyaha bitatu vy’i Gaza, mbere ni bine, sinzogenda ntabahanye! Ko bafashe abantu bo mu mihana yose bakabagira imbohe maze bakabagurisha kuri Edomu;
nzorungika umuriro ku mpome z’i Gaza utongore impome zikomeye zaho.

Nzorandura umwami w’i Ashidodi n’uwufise inkoni yo kuganza w’i Ashikeloni. Nzohindukiza ukuboko kwanje ngwanye Ekuroni, gushika uwa nyuma wo mu Bafilisitiya apfuye," uko ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze.

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: "Kubera ivyaha bitatu vya Tiro, mbere ni bine, sinzogenda ntabahanye! Kuko bafashe abantu bo mu mihana yose bakabagira imbohe bakabagurisha ku Banyedomu, ntibubahiriza isezerano ry’uko ari abavukanyi.
Ku bw’ivyo nzorungika umuriro ku mpome z’i Tiro, utongore impome zaho zikomeye."

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: "Kubera ivyaha bitatu vya Edomu, mbere ni bine, sinzogenda ntabahanye. Ko yakinagije umuvukanyi wiwe Isirayeli n’inkota agasogota abagore bo mu gihugu, kandi uburake bwiwe bukaziriringa urudaca, ubushangashirwe bwiwe bukarurumba ntibuhwame;
nzorungika umuriro i Temani utongore impome zikomeye z’i Bozira."
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: "Kubera ivyaha bitatu vya Amoni, mbere ni bine, sinzogenda ntabahanye! Kuko bafomoye inda z’abagore bibungenze b’i Gileyadi kugira ngo bagure imbibe zabo.
Nzorungika umuriro ku mpome z’i Raba utongore impome zikomeye zaho mu gihe hazoba hari akamo k’intambara, intambara imeze nk’umuyaga w’igihuhusi.
Umwami waho azojanwa ari inyagano, we hamwe n’abaganwa biwe bose," uko ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: "Kubera ivyaha bitatu vya Mowabu, mbere ni bine, sinzogenda ntabahanye! Ko batongoje umuriro bagahindura umunyota amagufa y’umwami w’i Edomu,
nzorungika umuriro kuri Mowabu uzotongora impome zikomeye z’i Keriyoti. Abanyamowabu bazohindikirana bicwe n’igihumura, kubera urwamo rw’intambara no kuvuza inzamba.
Nzorandura umwami waho, kandi nzomwicana n’abaganwa baho," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: "Kubera ivyaha bitatu vya Yuda, mbere ni bine, sinzogenda ntabahanye! Kuko bateye ibitugu ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho ntibitondera ivyo yihanikirije, bazimizwa n’imana z’ibinyoma, izo ba sekuruza bakurikiye.
Ni co gituma nzorungika umuriro kuri Yuda uzotongora impome zikomeye z’i Yerusalemu."
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: "Kubera ivyaha bitatu vya Isirayeli, mbere ni bine, sinzogenda ntabahanye! Bagurisha uwutagira icaha ku giciro c’ifeza, n’umukene bakamugurisha umwambaro umwe w’ibirato.
Basiribanga umutwe w’umukene nk’uko basiribanga umukungugu bakarenganya urubanza rw’impahazwa. Umuhungu na se basangira umugore mu busambanyi bwabo bagatukisha izina ryanje ryera.
Baryama i ruhande y’igicaniro cose, bakisasira impuzu batse abakene kw’ingwati. Kandi mu nzu y’imana zabo, banywa umuvinyu batse abo baciriye imanza.

Ariko naranduye Abamori mu maso yabo, naho mu burebure bwabo bari bameze nk’ibiti vy’amasederi mu gukomera na ho bari bameze nk’ibiti vy’inganzamarumpu. Nahoneje ivyamwa vyari hejuru ku mashami ndandura n’imizi yabo mu kuzimu!
Nabaduganye ndabakura muri Egiputa ndabarongora imyaka mirongo ine mu bugaragwa ngo ndabahe igihugu c’Abamori.
Kandi nahagurukije abavugishwa nanje bo mu bana banyu n’Abanaziri mu misore yanyu. Mbega ivyo si ivy’ukuri, ga yemwe bantu ba Isirayeli?" ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
"Ariko mwahatiye Abanaziri kunywa umuvinyu, mutegeka abavugishwa nanje kudakura ururimi mu kanwa.
None rero ngiye kubasiribanga nk’uko umukogote usiribanga isi iyo wiremetse ingano.
Uwuzi kwiruka cane ntibizomukiza, n’umunyenkomezi ntazokwikiza kubera inkomezi ziwe, kandi n’umuhizi mu ntambara ntazokwikiza.
Uwurasisha umuheto ntazoshobora guhagarara, uwunyaruka mu kwiruka ntazoshobora kwiruka ngo anyage amagara yiwe, kandi n’uwugendera kw’ifarasi ntazokwikiza.
Mbere, n’umuhizi mu ntambara, kuri uwo musi azohunga ata co yambaye," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Nimwumve iri jambo, yemwe Bisirayeli, ijambo Uhoraho yavuze abagiriza, yagiriza umuryango wose yaduganye akuye muri Egiputa. Yavuze ati:
"Ni mwebwe mwenyene natoranije mu miryango yose yo mw’isi; ni co gituma nzobahanira ivyaha vyanyu vyose.
Mbega babiri bojana batabanje kubisezerana?
Mbega intambwe yokwivugira mw’ishamba ata co yishe? Mbega yokwivugira mu kibundo cayo ata co yafashe?
Mbega inyoni yofatwa mu mutego ugaragara ata co kurya kirimwo ngo kiyikwege? Mbega umutego woshibuka ata co wafashe?
Iyo inzamba ivuze mu gisagara, mbega abantu ntibahinda agashitsi? Mbega icago coza ku gisagara, atari Uhoraho akirungitse?
Ni ukuri, Uhoraho Nyeninganji nta co akora atabanje kugihishurira abasavyi biwe b’abavugishwa.
Intambwe yivuze ni nde atotinya? Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze, ni nde yokwanka kumenyesha ivyo avuze?
Nimumenyeshe abari mu bihome bikomeye vy’i Ashidodi n’abo mu ngoro zikomeye zo muri Egiputa muti: ‘Nimukoranire ku misozi y’i Samariya; mwirabire umuryano waho, n’agacinyizo kari mu bantu baho.’
Ntibazi gukora ivyiza," ni ko Uhoraho avuze, "bujuje mu mazu yabo akomeye ivyo banyaze, n’ivyo bakuye mu bwicanyi."
Nuko rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: "Umwansi azokwifatira igihugu canyu, asenyurire hasi iminara yawe anyage ibiri mu ngoro zawe vyose."

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: "Nk’uko umwungere agerageza kurokora intama mu kanwa k’intambwe akayaka amagufa y’amaguru gusa canke agace k’ugutwi, ni ko Abisirayeli baba i Samariya bazorokoka, bazokiza umutwe w’uburiri gusa n’igice c’impuzu bisasiye.
Nimwumve ibi kandi mubimenyeshe aba Yakobo," ni ko Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose, avuze.
"Ku musi nzohanirako Abisirayeli kubera ivyaha vyabo, nzosambura ibicaniro vy’i Beteli; amahembe y’igicaniro azocibwa akorokere hasi.
Nzosenyurira hasi inzu yo mu gihe c’imbeho nyinshi hamwe n’inzu yo mu gihe c’ubushuhe; amazu asharijwe n’amahembe y’inzovu azosamburwa n’inyubakwa zagutse zizosamburirwa hasi," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Nimwumve iri jambo, yemwe mwa nka z’i Bashani ku Musozi Samariya, yemwe bagore muhahaza aboro mu gahonyora ku gakanu umukene, maze mukabwira abagabo banyu muti: "Nimutuzanire ivyo kunywa bindi!"
Uhoraho Nyeninganji arahiye ukwera kwiwe ati: "Ni ukuri umusi uzoshika aho muzojanwa mukwegeshwa igera, gushika ku wa nyuma muzokwegeshwa amagera nk’ifi.
Umwe wese azosohokanwa bamucishije mu gitoboro baciye mu gihome, maze muzojugunywa mu gihugu c’i Harumoni," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
"Nimuje i Beteli mukore ivyaha; hanyuma muje i Gilugali murushirize. Muzane ibimazi vyanyu uko bukeye, n’ibigiracumi vyanyu uko imyaka itatu iheze.

Nimwotse imikate irimwo umwambiro ibe ishikanwa ryo gushima muvuze inzamba mumenyesha ibimazi mutanze mwishakiye, muvyirate, yemwe Bisirayeli, kuko ari vyo mukunda gukora," ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze.
"Abo mu bisagara bimwe nabateje inzara abo mu bindi bose ndabima indya, ariko na ho nyene ntimwahindukiye ngo mungarukeko," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
"Nabimye n’imvura hagisigaye amezi atatu ngo iyimbura rigere. Narungitse imvura ku gisagara kimwe, ariko ikindi ndakiyima. Umurima umwe waronse imvura; uwundi ntiwaronka na mba uragaduka.
Abantu bayerera bava mu gisagara baja mu kindi barondera amazi ariko ntibaronka ayabamara inyota, ariko naho nyene ntimwahindukiye ngo mungarukeko," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

"Ni kenshi nakubise imirima y’ingano zanyu n’imizabibu yanyu, ndabiteza kubora no kwuma. Inzige zarishije imisukoni yanyu n’imyelayo yanyu, ariko na ho nyene ntimwahindukiye ngo mungarukeko," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

"Narungitse ibiza muri mwebwe nk’uko nabigiriye Egiputa. Nicishije inkota abahungu banyu, n’amafarasi yanyu aranyagwa. Nujuje mu mazuru yanyu umunuko uva mu bapfiriye mu nsago zanyu, ariko naho nyene ntimwahindukiye ngo mungarukeko," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

"Natembagaje bamwe bo muri mwebwe nk’uko natembagaje Sodomu na Gomora. Abo muri mwebwe barokotse, kwari kurya kw’urukwi rwokowe mu muriro, ariko na ho nyene ntimwahindukiye ngo mungarukeko," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
"None rero uku ni ko ngiye kukugirira, yewe Isirayeli, kandi kubera nzokugirira gutyo, ga Isirayeli, niwitegure guhura n’Imana yawe."
Uwabumvye imisozi, uwaremye umuyaga, agahishurira ivyo yiyumvira abana b’abantu, uwuhindura umutwenzi ukaba umwijima, akagendera ku dutwe tw’isi, Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose ni ryo zina ryiwe.
Umviriza iri jambo, yewe Isirayeli, iyi ndirimbo yo gucura intimba yerekeye wewe:
"Umukobwa ari we Isirayeli aratemvye, ntazosubira kuvyuka, bamuhebeye mu gihugu ciwe, kandi nta muntu n’umwe wo kumuvyura."

Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji abwiye Isirayeli: "Igisagara cawe cahora kirungika ingabo z’abahizi igihumbi kizosigarana ijana gusa; igisagara cawe cahora kirungika ingabo z’abahizi ijana kizosigarana icumi gusa."
Uku ni ko Uhoraho abwira Abisirayeli: "Nimundondere kugira ngo mubone kubaho;
ntimuronderere i Beteli, ntimuje n’i Gilugali, ntimufate urugendo muja i Berisheba. Kuko i Gilugali bazojanwa ari inyagano mu mahanga, kandi n’i Beteli hazohindurwa hasigare ari ubusa."
Nimurondere Uhoraho kugira ngo mubeho, atari uko, azotongora imiryango ya Yosefu nk’umuriro; umuriro uzobarigata, kandi i Beteli ntihazoboneka n’umwe wo kuwuzimya.
Hari abahindura ubutungane umururazi bagaterera hasi ubugororotsi.
Uwaremye inyenyeri, Peleyiyade na Oriyoni, agahindura umwijima ukaba umutwenzi kandi agatuma umurango uhinduka ijoro, uwuhamagara amazi yo mu kiyaga akayasuka kw’isi, Uhoraho ni ryo zina ryiwe.
Mu kubanguka nk’umuravyo arandura umunyenkomezi igisagara gikomeye akagihindura umusaka.
Hari abanka uwushigikira ubutungane mu manza, bakanka n’uwuvugisha ukuri.
Mucinyiza abakene mukabaka itagisi ku ngano. Ni co gituma, naho mwubatse inzu z’amabuye, mutazozibamwo; naho mwarimye imizabibu myiza, mutazonywa umuvinyu wazo.
Kuko nzi ko ivyaha vyanyu ari vyinshi n’ibicumuro vyanyu bikaba ibihambaye. Hari abacinyiza abatagira icaha hanyuma bakarya ibiturire, bakarenganya abakene mu manza.
Ni co gituma umunyabwenge yinumira mu bihe nk’ibi, kuko ari ibihe bibi.
Nimurondere ivyiza, aho kurondera ibibi, kugira ngo mubeho. Maze Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose azobana namwe, nk’uko mubivuga ko abana namwe.
Nimwanke ibibi, mukunde ivyiza; muce imanza zibereye mu bucamanza. Kumbure Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose yogirira imbabazi amasigarira y’aba Yosefu.

Nuko rero, uku ni ko Uhoraho, Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose avuze: "Bazoborogera mu mabarabara yose, bavuze induru kubera umubabaro mw’ihuriro ryose ry’abantu. Abarimyi bazohamagarirwa kurira, n’abagandaye ngo baboroge.
Hazoba amaborogo mu mizabibu yose, kuko nzoca hagati muri mwebwe," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Muragowe mwebwe mwipfuza umusi w’ Uhoraho ko woshika! Mbega ni kuki mwipfuza umusi w’ Uhoraho ? Uwo musi uzoba uw’umwijima, ntuzoba uw’umuco.
Bizoba nk’uko umuntu yoba ahunze intambwe, maze agaca ahura n’idubu, nk’aho yoba yinjiye mu nzu iwe, akishimikiza igihome, maze inzoka igaca imukomora.
Mbega umusi w’ Uhoraho ntuzoba uw’umwijima, aho kuba uw’umuco; umusi w’umwijima w’umuzitanya, utagiramwo umuco na mukeya?
"Ndanka urunuka, nkongera ngasesemwa n’imisi mikuru yanyu; amakoraniro yanyu y’uburyarya sinzovyihanganira.
Naho mwotanga ibimazi vyo guturirwa n’umuriro n’amashikanwa y’ifu, sinzovyakira. Naho mwozana ibimazi vy’ishimwe vy’indobanurwa, sinzobinezererwa.
Nimujane kure urwo rwamo rw’indirimbo zanyu! Sinzokwumviriza inanga zanyu.
Ariko nimureke imanza zibereye zitembe nk’uruzi, ukugororoka kumere nk’umugezi udakama!
Hari ibimazi n’amashikanwa mwanshikaniye mu myaka mirongo ine mwamaze mu bugaragwa, yemwe Bisirayeli?
Mwareruye ibigirwamana mwibumbiye, kimwe ca Sakuti, mwita umwami wanyu n’imana yanyu, n’ica Kewani, inyenyeri yanyu n’imana yanyu.
Ni co gituma nzobirukana muhungire hirya ya Damasiko," ni ko Uhoraho avuze, izina ryiwe ni Imana Mushoboravyose.
Muragowe mwebwe abidibamiye i Siyoni, na mwebwe mwumva mutekaniwe ku musozi w’i Samariya, mwebwe abaganwa b’ihanga riruta ayandi, mwebwe abo Abisirayeli baja kwitura!

Nimugende mwirabire i Kalune; muvuyeyo muje i Hamati-Raba igisagara gihambaye, hanyuma mumanuke i Gati mu Bafilisitiya. Mbega ivyo bisagara hari ico birusha ubwami bwanyu uko ari bubiri? Mbega igihugu cabo kiraruta icanyu?
Mwanka kwemera ko umusi w’ivyago ushitse ariko ibikorwa vyanyu bituma umusi w’urubanza ubegera kurusha.
Muryama ku buriri busharijwe n’amahembe y’inzovu mukiseguza imisego myiza. Mukirira inyama zoroshe z’imyagazi y’intama n’inka zinuze.
Mwigenera indirimbo nka Dawidi mukazicuraranga ku nanga zanyu.
Munywera umuvinyu mu bikombe bisesekaye mukisiga ibimota neza, bihinguwe rwose, ariko ntimubabazwa n’umusaka wa Yosefu.
Ni co gituma muzoba mu ba mbere mu bazojanwa ari inyagano; imisi mikuru yanyu n’ukwinezereza kwanyu bizoshira.
Uhoraho Nyeninganji ararahiye, Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose avuze ati: "Ndanka ubwibone bwa Yakobo kandi nanka n’ingoro ziwe zikomeye; nzotanga iki gisagara n’ibiri muri co vyose."
Abantu cumi nibasigara mu nzu imwe, na bo nyene bazopfa.

Kandi incuti yabo izoza gusohora imivyimba ngo ituririrwe hanze izobaza uwuzoba yinyegeje ngaho iti: "Mbega hari uwundi muri kumwe?" Maze na we azomwishura agomba kurahira izina ry’Imana ati: "Oya na mba!" Azoca amwamira amubwire ati: "Reka, si umwanya wo gucisha mu kanwa izina ry’ Uhoraho ."
Kuko Uhoraho yabitegetse, kandi azosangangura inzu nini ayigire ubunywenywe, n’inzu ntoya ayigire nk’utuvunguka.
Mbega ifarasi iriruka ku rutare? Hari uwurimisha inka ku kiyaga? Ariko mwahinduye ubutungane ubumara n’icamwa co kugororoka mwagihinduye umururazi,
yemwe abanezerezwa n’uko i Lo Debari hafashwe mukavuga muti: "Mbega ntitwafatishije i Karunayimu inkomezi zacu?"
Kuko Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose avuze ati: "Nzohagurutsa ihanga rizoza kugutera, yewe Isirayeli, kandi rizokubabaza urugendo rwose kuva i Lebo-Hamati gushika mu kiyaya c’i Araba."

Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho Nyeninganji yanyeretse: yariko arategura kurungika igitero c’inzige mu gihugu. Ivyo vyabaye, inyuma y’uko umwami amaze kuronka umugabane wiwe w’umwimbu, imirima yo hanyuma iriko iratangura kwera.
Izo nzige zimaze kurya igiterwa cose gitotahaye, ndasemerera nti: " Uhoraho Nyeninganji, girira imbabazi abantu bawe! Mbega Yakobo yokira gute? Erega ni inkehwa!"
Maze Uhoraho arigarura. Uhoraho aravuga ati: "Ivyo, ntibizoshika."
Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho Nyeninganji yanyeretse: Uhoraho Nyeninganji yagomba gukoresha umuriro kugira ngo ahane abantu biwe. Umuriro wakamije amazi y’i kuzimu, uturira n’igihugu cose.
Maze ndasemerera nti: "Yewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, ndakwinginze, geza aho! Mbega Yakobo yokira gute? Erega ni inkehwa!"
Maze Uhoraho arigarura. Uhoraho Nyeninganji aravuga ati: "N’ibi na vyo ntibizoshika."
Ibi ni vyo yanyeretse: Imana yari ihagaze i ruhande y’uruhome rwubatswe hakoreshejwe igipimo karisho, cerekena ukugororoka kw’uruhome, kandi na yo yari ifise uwo mugozi n’ico gipimo mu kuboko kwayo.

Maze Imana irambaza iti: "Ubona iki ga Amosi?" Ndishura nti: "Mbona umugozi uriko karisho." Maze Uhoraho aravuga ati: Raba, ndiko ndapimisha karisho abantu banje b’Abisirayeli; sinzosubira kubaziguriza na mba.
"Ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vyo ku misozi vya Isaka bizosamburwa kandi n’ibigabiro vya Isirayeli bizohinduka umusaka; nzoramvura inkota yanje ngwanye abo mu nda y’ingoma ya Yerobowamu."

Maze Amaziya umuherezi w’i Beteli arungikira ubutumwa Yerobowamu umwami w’Abisirayeli ati: "Amosi ariko ategura abantu bo kukugwanya, kandi bari aha hagati mu Bisirayeli. Igihugu ntigishobora kubandanya cihanganira amajambo yiwe.
Kuko uku ari ko Amosi avuga, ngo: ‘Yerobowamu azokwicwa n’inkota, kandi Abisirayeli nta kabuza bazojanwa ari inyagano, kure y’igihugu cabo c’amavukiro.’ "
Nuko Amaziya abwira Amosi ati: "Sohoka, yewe kamenyi! Subira mu gihugu c’i Buyuda. Wironkereyo ibigutunga kandi uvugishirizweyo.
Ntusubire kuvugishirizwa i Beteli, kuko aha ni urusengero rw’umwami n’ingoro y’ubwami."
Amosi yishura Amaziya ati: "Sinigeze mba umuvugishwa canke ngo mbe n’umwana w’umuvugishwa, ahubwo nari umwungere kandi narima imisukomora.
Ariko Uhoraho yankuye inyuma y’imikuku arambwira ati: ‘Genda, uvugishwe ku bantu banje b’Abisirayeli.’
Nuko rero, niwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho . Uvuze uti: ‘Ntuvugishwe ku Bisirayeli, kandi uhagarike kuburira bene Isaka.’

Ku bw’ivyo, uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Umugore wawe azoba maraya mu gisagara, kandi abahungu bawe n’abakobwa bawe bazokwicwa n’inkota. Igihugu cawe kizogabuzwa umugozi kigaburwemwo ibice, kandi wewe ubwawe uzopfira mu gihugu c’abanyamahanga. Kandi Abisirayeli nta kabuza bazojanwa ari inyagano, kure y’igihugu cabo c’amavukiro.’ "
Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho Nyeninganji yanyeretse: nabonye igiseke c’ivyamwa vyeze.
Arambaza ati: "Ubona iki, ga Amosi?" Ndishura nti: "Igiseke c’ivyamwa vyeze." Maze Uhoraho ambwira ati: "Igihe kirageze, c’uko abantu banje b’Abisirayeli basoromwa, sinzosubira kubaziguriza.
Kuri uwo musi," ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze, "indirimbo zo mu rusengero zizohinduka amaborogo. Imivyimba myinshi, myinshi cane, izotabwa ahantu hose! Nimucereze!"
Nimwumve ibi, mwebwe munyaga aboro mugasiribanga abakene,

mukavuga muti: "Mbega imboneko z’ukwezi zizogera ryari kugira ngo dusubire kwidandariza ingano; Isabato izohera ryari ngo dusubire kwigurishiriza ingano?" Aho rero mukoresha ingero z’ibinyoma, mukaduza ibiciro uko mwishakiye kandi mukiba mukoresheje iminzane y’ibinyoma.
Mugura umukene ifeza, n’umworo mukamugura umwambaro umwe w’ibirato, mukagurisha n’ingano mwavanze n’ibikumbi.
Uhoraho ararahiye, uwo Yakobo yishimira ati: "Sinzokwigera nibagira na kimwe mu vyo bakoze.
Mbega igihugu ntikizohinda agashitsi kubera ivyo, ababa muri co na bo ntibazogandara? Igihugu cose kizohaguruka nk’uruzi Nili; kizoduga hejuru maze gihwame nka rwa ruzi rwa Egiputa.
Kuri uwo musi," ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze, "Nzotuma izuba rirenga ku murango, bwire kw’isi mu gihe c’amashoka.

Nzohindura imisi mikuru yanyu ibe ibihe vyo kugandara n’imvyino zanyu zose ndazihindure amarira. Nzotuma mwese mwambara amagunira mwimoshe inkomvorera. Ico gihe nzokigira ico kuboroga nk’uwuborogera umwana wiwe w’ikinege kandi umusi wo kuganduka uzoba uw’umururazi.
Imisi iraje," ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze, "aho nzorungika inzara mu gihugu; ntizoba ari inzara y’ivyokurya canke inyota y’amazi, ariko izoba ari inzara yo kwumva amajambo y’ Uhoraho .
Abantu bazokubita ku kiyaga baje ku kindi, bave mu buraruko baje mu buseruko, barondera ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , ariko ntibazoribona.
Kuri uwo musi, inkumi nzizanziza n’abasore bezabeza bazorabikwa n’inyota.

Abirahira ibigirwamana biteye isoni vy’i Samariya, abavuga bati: ‘Ni ukuri nk’ukubaho kw’imana yawe, Dani,’ canke ngo: ‘Ni ukuri nk’ukubaho kw’imana y’i Berisheba,’ abo bose bazotemba, kandi ntibazokwongera kuvyuka."

Nabonye Imana ihagaze i ruhande y’igicaniro, hanyuma ivuga ati: "Kubita ubushorishori bw’inkingi z’urusengero, kugeza amatanguriro yazo anyiganyize. Zisenyurire hasi maze zigwe ku mitwe y’ubu bwoko; abazoba basigaye nzobicisha inkota. Nta n’umwe azohunga, nta n’umwe azosigara.
Naho bokwimba gushika i kuzimu, ukuboko kwanje kuzobakurayo. Naho boduga bakaja mw’ijuru hejuru, nzobamanurayo.
Naho bokwihisha ku gatwe ka Karumeli, nzobahiga ndabafate ndabamanureyo. Naho bokwinyegeza inyonga zanje i bwina mu kiyaga, nzotuma inzoka ibakomorereyo.
Naho bojanwa nk’inyagano n’abansi babo, nzotegeka inkota ibasogotereyo. Igitsure canje kizoguma kuri bo kugira ngo ndabagirire nabi, si ukubagirira neza."
Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, akoze kw’isi ica irashonga, kandi ababa muri yo bose baragandaye; igihugu cose gihagurutse nk’uruzi Nili, hanyuma kirahwama nk’urwo ruzi rwa Egiputa.
Uhoraho yubatse ikirimba ciwe iyo mw’ijuru hejuru ashira amatanguriro yaco kw’isi; ahamagara amazi yo mu kiyaga akayasuka kw’isi, Uhoraho ni ryo zina ryiwe.

"Mbega mwebwe Abisirayeli ntimumeze nk’Abanyakushi kuri jewe?" ni ko Uhoraho abaza. Mbega sinaduganye Abisirayeli ndabakuye muri Egiputa, Abafilisitiya nkabakura i Kafutori Abasiriya na bo nkabakura muri Kiru?
"Ni ukuri inyonga z’ Uhoraho Nyeninganji ziri ku bwami bucumura. Nzobusambura ndabuherengeteze kw’isi. Ariko sinzoherengeteza rwose abakomoka kuri Yakobo," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
"Kuko nzotanga itegeko, maze ntume Abisirayeli bahinda agashitsi hagati y’ayandi mahanga nk’uko ingano zigosorerwa ku rutaro, kandi ntihagire n’agatete kamwe gakorokera hasi.
Abanyavyaha bo mu bantu banje bazokwicwa n’inkota, abo bose bavuga bati: ‘Ivyago ntibizodushikira canke ngo duhure na vyo.’
Kuri uwo musi, nzovyura ihema rya Dawidi ryaguye hasi, nzosanura impome zaryo zabomotse, nsanure n’imisaka yaho; kandi nzosubira kuryubaka rimere nk’uko ryahora,
kugira ngo begukire amasigarira ya Edomu n’amahanga yose yitirirwa izina ryanje," ni ko Uhoraho avuze, ari we nyene azobishitsa.

"Imisi iraje," ni ko Uhoraho avuze, "aho umwimbuzi azokurikirana n’umubivyi, n’uwutera imbuto agakurikirana n’uwudandaza imizabibu. Umutobe musha w’umuvinyu uzotemba ku misozi, kandi n’uturambi twose tuzorengerwa n’umuvinyu,

kandi nzogarukana abantu banje b’Abisirayeli ndabavanye mu kinyago. Bazosubira bubake ibisagara vyahindutse imisaka babibemwo. Bazotera imizabibu banywe umuvinyu wayo; bazotera ibiti barye ivyamwa vyavyo.
Nzotera Abisirayeli mu gihugu cabo, kandi sinzosubira kubarandura, ngo ndabakure mu gihugu nabahaye," ni ko Uhoraho Imana yanyu avuze.

name: Obadiya
chapters: Ibi ni vyo Obadiya yeretswe. Uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze kuri Edomu. Twumvise inkuru ivuye k’ Uhoraho , kandi intumwa yatumwe ku mahanga kuyabwira iti: "Nimuhaguruke, tugende kumutera tumugwanye."
"Raba, nzokugira muto mu yandi mahanga, ube inkengerwa rwose.
Ubwibone bwo mu mutima wawe bwaraguhenze, wewe wibera mu myobo yo mu bitandara, ukiyubakira inzu mu misozi miremire, ukibwira mu mutima uti: ‘Ni nde yonkororera hasi kw’isi?’
Naho woguruka ukaja hejuru cane nk’inkona, ukarika icari cawe mu nyenyeri, nzokumanurayo ndagukororere hasi," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

Hamwe ibisuma vyogutera, canke abambuzi bakaza mw’ijoro; ese ukuntu woba ugize ivyago! Mbega ntibokwiba ikintu cose bipfuza? Abimbuzi b’inzabibu baje kwimbura mw’itongo iwawe, mbega ntibasigaza dukeya?
Ariko, ese ukuntu Esawu yatswe ikintu cose, n’ubutunzi bwiwe bwose bwari bunyegejwe bukanyagwa!
Abo mufitaniye amasezerano bazokwirukana uve mu gihugu cawe; abagenzi bawe bazoguhinduka kandi bakuneshe; abarya ivyokurya vyawe bazogutega umutego, ariko ntuzowubona.
"Kuri uwo musi," ni ko Uhoraho avuze, "mbega sinzoherengeteza abanyabwenge bose ba Edomu, abafise ugutahura bari mu misozi ya Esawu?"
Abahizi bawe b’abagwanyi, ewe Temani, bazojugumira kubera ubwoba, kandi umuntu wese wo mu misozi ya Esawu azohimbagurwa ku musi wo gutikizwa.
Kubera ibibi wakoreye umuvukanyi wawe Yakobo, ibiteterwe bizogupfuka; uzoherengetezwa ibihe vyose.
Igihe baterwa wihagarariye ku ruhande, igihe abansi banyaga ubutunzi bwiwe, abanyamahanga bakinjira mu marembo yiwe, bagapfindira ubupfindo Yerusalemu, wari umeze nk’umwe muri bo.
Ntiwari ukwiye kunezerezwa no kugirirwa nabi kw’umuvukanyi wawe ku musi yaboneyeko ivyago, canke ngo utwenge Abayuda ku musi wo kubona amakuba kwabo, canke ngo wishime cane ku musi w’ivyago vyabo.
Ntiwari ukwiye kwinjira mu marembo y’abantu banje ku musi baboneyeko ivyago, canke ngo ubatwenge batewe n’ikiza ku musi baboneyeko amagorwa, canke ngo utware ubutunzi bwabo ku musi w’ivyago vyabo.
Ntiwari ukwiye kubarindirira mu masanganzira ngo wice abo muri bo bagerageza guhunga, canke ngo utange abacitse kw’icumu ubashikirize abansi, ku musi wabo w’amagorwa.
"Umusi w’ Uhoraho uri hafi aho azocira urubanza amahanga yose. Ivyo wakoze, ni vyo uzokorerwa; ibikorwa vyawe bizogusubira ku mutwe ubwawe.
Nk’uko wimaze inyota ku bantu banje uri ku musozi wanje wera, ni ko wewe n’amahanga agukikije muzoramizwa igihano ndabaciriye; muzonywa mwongere munywe, kugeza muzimanganye.
Ariko umusozi Siyoni uzoba ubukiriro bw’abahunga; uzoba wejejwe; kandi Yakobo azoganza umugabane wiwe.
Yakobo azoba nk’umuriro Yosefu abe nk’urubeya; Esawu na we azoba nk’ivyatsi vyumye, maze bazomuturira bamuherengeteze. Ntihazosigara n’uwo kuvuga inkuru mu ba Esawu." Ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Abantu b’i Negebu bazokwegukira imisozi ya Esawu, n’abantu bo mu biyaya begukire igihugu c’Abafilisitiya. Bazokwibera mu mirima ya Efurayimu n’i Samariya, kandi Benyamini azokwegukira Gileyadi.
Abajanywe ari inyagano ba Isirayeli bazogaruka i Kanani bazokwegukira igihugu gushika i Zarefati; abajanywe ari inyagano bava i Yerusalemu bari i Sefaradi bazogaruka begukire ibisagara vy’i Negebu.
Abazoba barokotse bazoduga ku Musozi Siyoni ngo baganze imisozi ya Esawu. Maze ubwami buzoba ari ubw’ Uhoraho .

name: Yona
chapters: Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri Yona mwene Amitayi, riti:
"Va hasi uje i Ninewe, ca gisagara kinini, ukiburire, kuko ibibi abakibamwo bakora vyaduze bishika imbere yanje."

Ariko Yona afata inzira ija i Tarushishi ngo ahunge Uhoraho . Nuko aramanuka aja i Yopa, ahasanga ubwato bugira buje i Tarushishi, ariha amahera y’urugendo, hanyuma aramanuka yinjira mu bwato kugira ngo aje i Tarushishi, ahunge Uhoraho .
Maze Uhoraho ateza umuyaga ukomeye mu kiyaga; haba igihuhusi ku buryo ubwato bwagomba kumeneka.

Abari mu bwato bagira ubwoba bwinshi, maze umwe wese atakambira imana yiwe kugira ngo ibatabare. Bafata ivyo bari batwaye mu bwato babiterera mu kiyaga kugira ngo baburemurure. Ariko Yona we yari yamanutse aja hasi mu bwato, araryama asinzira ubutikoma.
Umukuru w’ubwato aza aho Yona aryamye amubwira ati: "Urubahuka gusinzira ibintu bimeze uku? Vyuka utakambire imana yawe hari n’aho yotugirira imbabazi ntidupfe."
Maze baravugana bati: "Reka tugire ubupfindo kugira ngo tumenye uwutumye ibi vyago bidushikira." Bagize ubupfindo, bwerekana ko vyavuye kuri Yona.
Baramubaza bati: "Tubarire: ni kuki ibi vyago bidushikiye? Ukora iki? Uva he? Igihugu cawe ni ikihe? Uva mu bwoko ubuhe?"
Arabishura ati: "Ndi Umuheburayo kandi nsenga Uhoraho , Imana yo mw’ijuru yaremye ikiyaga n’isi."
Ba bagabo bafatwa n’ubwoba bwinshi baramubaza bati: "Ni kuki wakoze ivyo?" Bari bamaze kumenya ko ariko arahunga ngo aje aho Uhoraho adashobora kumubona kuko yari yamaze kubibabwira.
Kubera ko igihuhusi cakomeza kwiyongeranya, baca baramubaza bati: "None tugukorere iki kugira ngo duhagarike iki gihuhusi ikiyaga gitekane?"
Arabishura ati: "Nimunterure munte mu kiyaga, maze gica gitekana kuko ndazi ko iki gihuhusi gikomeye kije kubera jewe."
Aho kumuterera mu kiyaga, ba bagabo bagerageza gusoza ubwato ngo busubire ku musozi ariko birabananira, kuko igihuhusi caca kirushiriza gukomera.
Nuko batakambira Uhoraho Imana ya Yona, bati: " Uhoraho , turakwinginze ntutwice ku bw’ivyaha vy’uwu muntu. Kandi ntuduharureko amaraso y’umuntu, kuko wewe Uhoraho , wakoze ibiguhimbara."
Nuko baterura Yona bamuterera mu kiyaga, maze ca gihuhusi kirahagarara, ikiyaga kiratekana.
Ba bagabo bagira ubwoba bwinshi ku bw’ Uhoraho , bamushikanira ikimazi, basezerana n’amasezerano imbere yiwe.
Uhoraho aca azana urufi runini cane, rumira Yona, amara imisi itatu n’amajoro atatu mu nda yarwo.
Nuko Yona asenga Uhoraho Imana yiwe ari mu nda y’urwo rufi.
Avuga ati: "Natakambiye Uhoraho ndi mu vyago bikomeye, na we aranyishura. Ndi mu kibanza c’abapfuye, naratakamvye ngo untabare, nawe wumvise ijwi ryanje.
Wantereye kure cane mu kuzimu, kure cane mu mutima w’ikiyaga; imikuba ikomeye yaranzungurutse, imipfunda n’ugusuriranya kw’amazi vyawe vyarandengeye.
Ndavuga nti: ‘Noneho nkuwe imbere y’amaso yawe. Ariko nzosubira nihweze urusengero rwawe rwera.’
Amazi yarandengeye agomba kunyica, i bwina mu mazi haranzunguruka; ivyatsi vyo mu kiyaga binyizingira ku mutwe.
Naranyitse nshikira intango y’imisozi, aho isi yanyugaraniye ubutakivayo. Ariko wewe, Uhoraho Mana yanje, waduganye ubuzima bwanje ubukuye mu cobo.
Igihe ubuzima bwanje bwariko burakabirana, nibutse wewe Uhoraho , ugusenga kwanje kuraduga kuragushikira, mu rusengero rwawe rwera.
Abashira umutima ku bigirwamana bitagira ikimazi, batera umugongo urukundo Imana ibakunda.
Ariko jewe, nzogushikanira ikimazi nshize hejuru ijwi ryo kugushimira. Kandi nzoshitsa ivyo nasezeranye, kuko agakiza kanje kava k’ Uhoraho ."
Maze Uhoraho ategeka urwo rufi, na rwo rudahwa Yona ku nkengera y’ikiyaga.
Hanyuma Uhoraho yongera kubwira Yona ubugira kabiri, ati:
"Va hasi uje muri ca gisagara kinini Ninewe ukimenyeshe bwa butumwa nakubwira."
Yona aca yumvira ijambo ry’Imana aja i Ninewe. Ninewe cari igisagara kinini ku buryo vyafata imisi itatu kugira ngo umuntu ashobore kugicamwo cose.
Nuko Yona amara umusi umwe agendagenda muri ico gisagara asemerera n’ijwi rirenga ati: "Hasigaye imisi mirongo ine gusa Ninewe hagahona."
Maze abantu b’i Ninewe bizera ubwo butumwa bw’Imana, baca bashinga ko haba ukwisonzesha kandi uhereye ku mukuru ugashika ku muntu mutoya, bambara amagunira.
Ayo majambo ya Yona ashikiriye umwami w’i Ninewe na we aca arahaguruka ava ku ntebe y’ubwami, yambura impuzu z’ubwami, yambara igunira, yongera yicara mu mukungugu.
Aca atanga itegeko i Ninewe rivuga riti: "Itegeko ry’umwami n’abaganwa biwe: Ntihagire abantu canke ibikoko, amasho n’imikuku bigira ico bikoza ku munwa, ntibigire ico birya canke binywa.
Abantu nibambare amagunira mbere n’ibikoko babiyapfuke, hanyuma abantu batakambire Imana binginga, kandi umuntu wese ave mu nzira z’ibibi, bahagarike n’umuryano uri hagati yabo.
Nta wubizi! Hari n’aho Imana yokwisubirako ikigarura, ikareka ugushangashirwa kwayo, maze ntiduhonye."
Imana ibona ibikorwa vyabo, ingene bahindukiye bakava mu nzira zabo mbi, maze irigarura ntiyabahanisha igihano yari yabateguriye.
Ariko Yona we, kwigarura kw’Imana kwamuteye ishavu ryinshi.

Ni ko gusenga Uhoraho avuga ati: "None ga Mana ibi si vyo nari navuze igihe nari nkiri mu gihugu c’iwacu? Ni na co cari catumye nihutira guhungira i Tarushishi. Kuko nari nsanzwe nzi ko wewe uri Imana igira ubuntu, ifise ikigongwe cinshi, itihutira gushavura, ifise urukundo rwinshi kandi yigarura ntirungike ivyago.
None rero Uhoraho , nyica, kuko gupfa bindutiye kubaho."
Uhoraho aramwishura ati: "Mbega aho ubona vyari bikwiye ko ushavura?"
Nuko Yona ava mu gisagara aragenda yicara mu buseruko bwaco, yiyubakira akazu ko kwikingamwo izuba, yicara mu gitutu cako, maze arindira kuraba ibishikira igisagara.
Nuko Imana imeza igiterwa c’amababi maninimanini, kirakura kija hejuru y’umutwe wa Yona kimuha agatutu. Ivyo bica bituma Yona yoroherwa maze aranezerwa cane kubera ico giterwa.
Ariko bukeye Imana irongera ituma urunyo ruraza rurya ca giterwa gica kirakabirana.
Izuba rimaze guseruka, Imana ituma umuyaga ushushe uvuye mu buseruko, iryo zuba na ryo rikubita Yona mu mutwe kugeza aho acika intege. Aca asubira kwisabira gupfa ati: "Gupfa vyondutira kubaho."
Imana yishura Yona iti: "Mbega aho ubona vyari bikwiye ko ushavura ku bw’iki giterwa?" Na we arishura ati: "Birakwiye nyene! Ahubwo ndashavuye gushika n’aho numva nopfuma mpfa."
Uhoraho aca avuga ati: "Ko ubabajwe n’igiterwa utakoreye canke ngo utume gikura, cakuze mw’ijoro rimwe bukeye kikuma,
mbega jewe sinari nkwiye kugirira ikigongwe Ninewe, igisagara kinini kibamwo abantu barenga ibihumbi ijana na mirongo ibiri badashobora gutandukanya iciza n’ikibi, hamwe n’ibitungano vyaho vyinshi?"

name: Mika
chapters: Iri ni ijambo Uhoraho yatumye kuri Mika w’i Moresheti ku ngoma ya Yotamu n’iya Ahazi hamwe n’iya Hezekiya, abami b’i Buyuda, ngo avuge ivyo yeretswe kuri Samariya na Yerusalemu.
Nimwumve, yemwe mahanga, nimwumve mwese; umviriza, ewe wa si we hamwe na mwebwe mwese abayibako, Uhoraho Nyeninganji ariko arabagiriza, Uhoraho avuga ari mu rusengero rwiwe rwera.
Raba, Uhoraho ariko araza ava iwe; aramanutse aza kandi agendagenda ku dutwe tw’isi.
Imisozi ishongera musi y’ibirenge vyiwe n’ibiyaya birasadaguritse, nk’ishashara ihuye n’umuriro, nk’amazi atemba ahamanuka.

Ivyo vyose ni kubera ukugabitanya kwa Yakobo, kubera ivyaha vy’ab’inzu y’Abisirayeli. Icaha ca Yakobo ni ikihe? Mbega si Samariya? Ikibanza co gusengeramwo ibigirwamana co ku mpinga z’umusozi ca Yuda ni ikihe? Mbega si Yerusalemu?
"Nuko rero nzohindura Samariya habe ikigunguzi c’umusaka, ahantu ho kurima imizabibu. Nzotembagariza amabuye yaho mu mwonga amatanguriro yaho ndayasige agaragara.

Ibigirwamana vyaho vyose bizomenagurwa; amashikanwa y’ingoro zaho azotongorwa n’umuriro; nzosambura ibishushanyo vyaho vyose. Kuko vyavuye mu mashikanwa y’ingero z’abamaraya, bizokwongera gukoreshwa kandi nk’ingero z’abamaraya."
Kubera ivyo nzorira mboroge; ngende gusa kandi ata birato nambaye. Nzobweja nk’imbwebwe kandi nzokwabira nk’inyanana.
Kuko igikomere ca Samariya kidakira; carandagase gishika n’i Buyuda. Cashitse no kw’irembo ry’abantu banje, mbere n’i Yerusalemu ubwaho.
Ntimubibwire abansi b’i Gati; ntimurire na gatoya. Yemwe bantu b’i Beti-Leyafura, nimwikumbagaze mu mukungugu.
Nimurengane muri ubusa mumaramaye, yemwe ababa i Shafiri. Ababa i Zanani ntibazosohoka. Beti-Ezeli bari mu kigandaro; ntihakigukingira.
Ababa i Maroti bari mu gatengo, barindiriye ugutezurirwa, kuko ikiza cavuye k’ Uhoraho , kigashika no kw’irembo ry’i Yerusalemu.
Yemwe ababa i Lakishi, nimubohere amafarasi anyaruka ku mikogote. Ni mwebwe mwatumye, umukobwa w’i Siyoni acumura kuko ibigabitanyo vya Isirayeli vyabonetse muri wewe.
Nuko rero muzosezera Moresheti-Gati. Igisagara c’i Akizibu kizoba ivyizigiro vy’uruhendo ku bami ba Isirayeli.
Nzozana uwuzobigarurira yemwe ababa i Maresha. Abanyacubahiro bo muri Isirayeli bazohungira muri Adulamu.
Nimwimoshe inkomvorera mugandare kuko abana munezerererwa bafashwe; imitwe yanyu imere nk’iy’ikinyamwanira, kuko bazovanwa muri mwebwe bajanwe ari inyagano.
Baragowe abategura imigambi y’inabi, bakiyumvirira ku buriri bwabo imigambi yo gukora ikibi! Bukeye, bakayishira mu ngiro, kuko babifitiye ubushobozi.
Bipfuza amatongo maze bakayiha ku nguvu, n’amazu, bagaca bayanyaga. Banyaga abantu amazu yabo, bakabiba ivyo barazwe.
Nuko rero, Uhoraho avuze ati: "Ndiko ndategura ivyago ku bw’aba bantu, ivyo mudashobora kwikiza. Ntimuzosubira kugendana ubwibone, kuko kizoba ari igihe c’amakuba.

Kuri uwo musi abansi banyu bazobatwenga; bazobaririmbira iyi ndirimbo y’agacurantimba bati: ‘Turaherengeteye; ishamvu y’ubwoko bwanje igabuwemwo ibice. Ehe arayinyatse! Ayihaye abatujanye nk’inyagano.’ "
Nuko rero ntuzoronka n’umwe mw’ikoraniro ry’Uhoraho, wo kugorora umugozi mu gihe co kugabanganya igihugu mu mashamvu.
Ba kamenyi babo bavuga ngo: "Ntuvugishwe! Ntuvugishwe kuri ivyo; kuko ivyago ntibizodushikako."
Yemwe abakomoka kuri Yakobo, mbega mwovuga ngo: " Uhoraho vyamunaniye kwihangana? Mbega yokora ikintu nk’ico?" Mbega amajambo yanje ntagirira neza abagenda batunganye?
Ariko ubu nyene abantu banje barahagurutse bahagurutse kurya kw’umwansi. Mwambura amakoti abantu birenganira ata co binona, mukabateza umubabaro nk’uw’umuntu agarutse avuye ku rugamba.
Musohora abagore bo mu bantu banje mukabakura mu mazu yabo bakunda. Mukaka umugisha wanje abana babo ibihe vyose.
Haguruka, genda! Kuko ngaha ata buruhukiro bwanyu buriho, kubera yuko hahumanye, harasambutse, ku buryo hatakivurwa.
Haje umubeshi kandi w’umusukanyi akababwira ati: "Ngomba mvugishwe ko muzoronka umuvinyu n’inzoga nyinshi," uwo ni we muvugishwa aba bantu boshima!

"Umusi umwe yewe Yakobo, nzosubira kubegeraniriza hamwe mwese; ni ukuri nzokwegeranya amasigarira yose y’Abisirayeli. Nzobazana ndabashire hamwe nk’intama mu ruhongore, nk’umukuku uri aho urisha; aha hantu hazosubira kwuzura uruja n’uruza rw’abantu.
Uwubacira icanzo azoduga ari imbere yabo; bazomena irembo ry’abansi basohoke. Umwami wabo azobaja imbere mu gusohoka. Uhoraho ubwiwe ni we azobarongora."
Maze ndavuga nti: "Nimwumve yemwe batware bo mu ba Yakobo, yemwe barongozi b’Abisirayeli. Mbega ntimwokwitaho guca imanza zibereye,
mwebwe mwanka ivyiza mugakunda ibibi; yemwe ababaga abantu banje mukabakurako urusato n’inyama mukazikura ku magufa yabo;
yemwe abarya inyama z’abantu banje, mubakurako urusato mukavunagura amagufa yabo; mukabahimbagura mubakurako inyama muteka mu tubehe, hamwe n’izo muteka mu nkono."
Maze mu nyuma mugatakambira Uhoraho , mutewe n’ivyago ariko ntabishure. Muri ico gihe azobahisha mu nyonga hiwe kubera ibibi mwakoze.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: "Nk’uko biri kuri ba kamenyi bazimiza abantu banje, bavuga ‘amahoro’ iyo bafise ico barya, ariko bagategura intambara yo kugwanya umuntu wese yanse kubaha ivyo barya.
Ni co gituma ijoro rizobazako, ntihagire ico mwerekwa, n’umwijima, ntimugire ico muragura. Izuba rizocokerera kuri abo bavugishwa, kandi buzobirirako.
Ba kamenyi bazomaramara n’abaragura bazoteterwa. Bose bazokwitwikira mu maso, kuko ata kwishurwa kuvuye ku Mana."
Ariko jeho, nuzuye inkomezi, nuzuye Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho , nuzuye uguca imanza zibereye n’ubuhizi, ngo menyeshe aba Yakobo ibigabitanyo vyabo, n’Abisirayeli icaha cabo.
Nimwumve, yemwe batware bo mu ba Yakobo, yemwe abaganza abandi bo mu Bisirayeli, mwanka imanza zibereye, ivy’ukuri mukabinyikiza.
Siyoni muhubakisha gusesa amaraso, Yerusalemu mukahubakisha gukora ibibi.

Abatware baho baca imanza bariye ibiturire, abaherezi baho bigishiriza kuronka inyungu, kandi abavugishwa baho baragurira kuronka amahera. Ariko bakarondera Uhoraho ngo abashigikire bavuga bati: "Mbega Uhoraho ntari muri twebwe? Nta cago kizodushikako."
Ni co gituma kubera mwebwe, Siyoni hazorimwa hamere nk’umurima, Yerusalemu hazoba ikigunguzi c’isakamburira, umusozi wubatsweko Ingoro na wo uzomerako ibisaka.
Mu misi y’iherezo umusozi uriko ingoro y’ Uhoraho uzoba ushimangiwe nk’umusozi usumba iyindi yose; uzoshirwa hejuru usumbe udusozi twose; kandi amoko azohondogana aja kuri wo.

Amahanga menshi azoza avuge ati: "Nimuze tuduge tuje ku musozi w’ Uhoraho , mu ngoro y’Imana ya Yakobo. Izotwigisha inzira zayo kugira ngo tuzigenderemwo." Kuko i Siyoni ari ho hazova ivyagezwe, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rive i Yerusalemu.

Azocira imanza amoko menshi atature amatati hagati y’amahanga akomeye ya kure. Inkota zabo bazozicuramwo amasuka, amacumu yabo bayacuremwo imihoro. Nta hanga rizosubira gutera irindi, kandi ntibazosubira kwiga ivy’intambara.
Umuntu wese azokwicara musi y’umuzabibu wiwe no musi y’umusukoni wiwe, kandi nta n’umwe azobatera ubwoba, kuko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose abivuze.
Naho amoko yose yogendera mw’izina ry’imana zabo, tweho tuzogendera mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana yacu ibihe bidashira.
"Kuri uwo musi," ni ko Uhoraho avuze, "nzokoranya ibimuga; nzokoraniriza hamwe abajanywe ari inyagano n’abo nateye umubabaro.
Nzohindura ibimuga bibe amasigarira yanje, n’abirukanywe nzobahindura ihanga rikomeye. Uhoraho azobarongora ari ku musozi Siyoni uhereye uwo musi gushika ibihe bidashira.
Ariko weho, munara w’inderetsi w’umukuku, munara w’ubuhungiro bw’umukobwa w’i Siyoni, uzosubizwa ububasha bwo kuganza kwawe wahoranye; ubwami buzohabwa umukobwa w’i Yerusalemu."
Ni kuki none uboroga, mbega nta mwami ufise? Umutware wawe yapfuye, ko uburibwe bugufashe nk’umugore ageze kwibaruka?

Babara uboroge, yewe mukobwa w’i Siyoni, nk’umugore ari ku bise, kuko ugiye kuva muri iki gisagara uje kuba mu makambi yo mu gahinga. Muzoja i Babiloni; aho ni ho muzotabarirwa. Aho ni ho Uhoraho azobacungurira abakuye mu maboko y’abansi banyu.
Ariko ubu amoko menshi akoraniye hamwe ngo abagwanye. Bavuga bati: "Reka tuhahumanye, amaso yacu yirabire uburyo Siyoni hasamburwa!"
Ariko bo ntibazi ivyiyumviro vy’ Uhoraho ; ntibatahura imigambi yiwe, ko yabegeranirije hamwe nk’imikama y’ingano ku mbuga.

"Haguruka usekure ingano, mukobwa w’i Siyoni, kuko nzoguha amahembe y’ivyuma; ndaguhe ibinono vy’imiringa, kandi uzojanjagura amoko menshi uyagire ubunywenywe." Kandi muzogira inyegu y’ Uhoraho ivyo banyaze, ubutunzi bwabo buzoba ubw’Umwami w’isi yose.
Egeranya ingabo zawe, yewe wa gisagara c’ingabo, kuko umwansi akwugarije. Bazokubita umutware wa Isirayeli, bazomukubita inkoni kw’itama.
"Ariko wewe Betelehemu Efurata, naho uri muto mu bisagara vy’umuryango wa Yuda, muri wewe hazomviramwo uwuzoganza Abisirayeli, kandi amamuko yiwe ni aya kera, yamyeho uhereye mu bihe vya kera."
Nuko rero Abisirayeli bazoba akahebwe kugeza igihe umugore ari ku bise azovyarira umuhungu, n’abasigaye mu bavukanyi biwe bakagaruka bakifatanya n’Abisirayeli.
Azohaguruka aragire umukuku wiwe ari mu nkomezi z’ Uhoraho , mu cubahiro c’izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe. Maze bazokwibera amahoro, kuko muri ico gihe ubukuru bwiwe buzoshika no ku mpera z’isi.
Kandi ni we azoba amahoro yacu aho Abashuri bazoterera igihugu cacu bakagendagenda mu nzitiro zacu. Tuzohagurutsa abungere indwi bo kubagwanya, mbere ni abagabisha umunani,
bazoganzisha inkota igihugu c’i Ashuri, igihugu ca Nimurodi bakiganzishe inkota isokoye. Azodukiza Abashuri aho bazoterera igihugu cacu bakajabuka imbibe zaco.
Amasigarira y’aba Yakobo azoba hagati mu mahanga menshi nk’urume ruvuye k’ Uhoraho , nk’imvura iguye ku vyatsi, itarinda kurindira umuntu n’umwe canke ngo igire umuntu ayitegeka.

Amasigarira y’aba Yakobo azoba mu moko menshi, hagati mu mahanga menshi, nk’intambwe mu bikoko vyo mw’ishamba, nk’umugunza w’intambwe mu mikuku y’intama, iyo irenganye itabagura yongera isiribanga, ata muntu wo gutabara.
Ukuboko kwawe kuzoshirwa hejuru ngo kuneshe abansi bawe, kandi abakugwanya bazoherengetera.
"Kuri uwo musi," ni ko Uhoraho avuze, "Nzoherengeteza amafarasi hagati muri mwebwe nsambure imikogote yawe.
Nzosambura ibisagara vyo mu gihugu cawe nsenyurire hasi inzitiro zawe.
Nzoherengeteza ubupfumu bwawe kandi ntuzosubira kuragura.
Nzoherengeteza ibigirwamana vyawe n’inkingi z’amabuye zawe nzozikura muri wewe. Ntuzoba ucikubita imbere y’ibikorwa vy’intoke zawe.
Nzorandura muri wewe inkingi za Ashera aho nzosamburira ibisagara vyawe.
Nzokwihorana uburake n’ubushangashirwe amahanga atanyumviye."
Nimwumve ivyo Uhoraho avuga: "Haguruke, muburane urubanza rwanje imbere y’imisozi; uturambi nitwumve ivyo mugira muvuge.
Nimwumve yemwe misozi, ivyo Uhoraho abagiriza; nimwumvirize, yemwe matanguriro y’isi y’ibihe vyose. Kuko Uhoraho afitaniye urubanza n’abantu biwe; afise ivyo yagiriza Abisirayeli.
Bwoko bwanje, ni igiki nabakoreye? Nabaruhije gute? Nimunyishure.
Nabakuye muri Egiputa kandi narabacunguye ndabakura mu nzu y’ubuja. Narungitse Mose ngo abarongore, hamwe na Aroni na Miriyamu.

Bantu banje, nimwibuke ivyo Balaki umwami w’i Mowabu yari yagabiye n’ivyo Balamu mwene Beyori yishuye. Nimwibuke urugendo rwanyu kuva i Shitimu gushika i Gilugali, kugira ngo mumenye ibikorwa vyo kugororoka vy’ Uhoraho ."
Mbega norengukana iki imbere y’ Uhoraho ngo nuname imbere y’Imana ishizwe hejuru? Mbega norengukana imbere yiwe ibimazi bituriwe, hamwe n’ishuri imaze umwaka umwe?

Mbega Uhoraho anezerwa n’impfizi z’intama ibihumbi, canke n’inzuzi z’amavuta ya elayo ibihumbi cumi? Mbega notanga imfura yanje kw’ikimazi ku bw’icaha canje, icamwa c’umubiri wanje ku bw’icaha c’umutima wanje?
Yewe muntu, yarakweretse iciza ico ari co. Mbega hari ikindi Uhoraho akugombako? Ni ugukora ibigororotse, gukunda imbabazi, no kugendana n’Imana yawe wicishije bugufi.
Nimwumve! Uhoraho ariko arahamagara iki gisagara, kandi kwubaha izina ryiwe ni bwo bwenge. "Nimutinye inkoni n’uwayitumye.
Mbega nzokwirengagiza za nyungu mbi, yemwe ab’inzu y’abanyakibi, na ya minzane yanyu ipima ibidakwiye, navumye?
Mbega nzogenda ntahanye uwukoresha iminzane y’ibinyoma, n’imifuko y’amabuye y’umunzane adakwiye?
Abatunzi banyu bafise umuryano; ababa ngaha ni ababeshi n’indimi zabo zivuga ivyo guhendana.
Kubera ivyo, natanguye kubahonya, ngo muherengetere kubera ivyaha vyanyu.
Muzorya ntimuhage; muzokwama mwumva inda zigaragara. Muzokwegeranya ariko nta co muzoziganya, kuko ivyo muzoziganya nzobimarisha inkota.
Muzobiba ariko ntimuzokwimbura; muzogana imyelayo ariko ntimuzokoresha amavuta yayo, muzogana inzabibu ariko ntimuzonywa umuvinyu wazo.

Mwitondeye ivyagezwe vya Omuri n’ibikorwa vyose vy’inzu ya Ahabu; mwakurikije imigenzo yabo. Ni co gituma nzobarekurirako uguhona abantu banyu na bo ndabarekurireko ibimaramare; muzokwumva agacokoro k’amahanga."
Ewe jewe ndagowe! Meze nk’uwegeranya ivyamwa mu gihe vyeruye, mu gihe co gutorora mu mizabibu; ata mahando y’inzabibu zo kurya aboneka, ata n’insukoni z’amasega ngo zimpembure.
Abizigirwa baheze mu gihugu; nta mugororotsi n’umwe agisigaye. Umuntu wese abundira kuvisha amaraso; umuntu wese ahiga mugenziwe ngo amute mu mutego.
Ibiganza vyabo vyompi vyamogoreye gukora ibibi; umutware asaba ingero, abacamanza bakira ibiturire. Abahambaye bategekesha agahahazo ngo baronke ivyo bipfuza, kandi bose bahuje umutima.

Umuntu mwiza muri bo ameze nk’umubambangwe, uwurusha abandi ukugororoka arusha ububi uruzitiro rw’amahwa. Umusi wawe wo kugenderwa n’Imana urashitse, umusi abarinzi bawe bazovuza inzamba. Ni igihe cawe co kuzazanirwa.
Ntiwizigire umubanyi; ivyizigiro vyawe ntibibe ku mugenzi. Naho yoba umugore mubumbatirana, wirinde ivyo iminwa yawe ivuga.
Kuko umuhungu ntiyubaha se, n’umukobwa ahagurukiye kugwanya nyina, umukazana akagwanya inabukwe, abansi b’umuntu bakaba abo mu rugo iwe.
Ariko jeho nzokwitega Uhoraho nizigiye, nzororera Imana Umukiza wanje; Imana yanje izonyumva.
Ntunyitambe ku muvyimba, wa mwansi wanje we! Naho naguye, nzovyuka. Naho nicaye mu mwijima, Uhoraho azombera umuco.
Kubera namucumuyeko, nzokwihanganira uburake bw’ Uhoraho , kugeza aho azoburana urubanza rwanje akarutsinda. Azonsohora anshire mu muco; nzobona ukugororoka kwiwe.

Maze umwansi wanje azobibona hanyuma amaramare, umwe yambwira ngo: "Mbega Uhoraho Imana yawe ari hehe?" Amaso yanje azokwibonera ugutemba kwiwe; kandi azosiribangirwa hasi n’ibirenge nk’ivyondo mu nzira.
Umusi wo kwubaka inzitiro zawe urashitse, umusi wo kwagura imbibe zawe.

Kuri uwo musi abantu bazoza bakugana bavuye muri Ashuri no mu bisagara vyo muri Egiputa, mbere kuva muri Egiputa gushika ku ruzi Efurate, no kuva ku kiyaga gushika ku kindi no kuva ku musozi gushika ku wundi.
Isi izohinduka ubweranyange kubera abayibako, bitewe n’ivyo bakoze.
Ragiza abantu bawe inyobozo yawe, umukuku w’ishamvu yawe, wibera ukwawo mw’ishamba, ahantu h’uburagiro hamera. Baragire i Bashani n’i Gileyadi nko mu gihe ca kera.
"Nko mu misi mwava muri Egiputa, nzobereka ibitangaza vyanje."
Amahanga azobibona amaramare, inkomezi zabo zose zihere. Bazoshira amaboko yabo ku munwa bumirwe.
Bazorigata umukungugu nk’inzoka, nk’ibikoko bikwega inda hasi. Bazosohoka bahinda agashitsi bava mu bibundo vyabo; bazohindukirira Uhoraho Imana yacu bari n’ubwoba kandi bazogutinya.
Ni iyihe Mana imeze nkawe, iharira icaha, ikababarira ibigabitanyo vy’amasigarira y’ishamvu yiwe? Ntiwama uratse ibihe vyose ahubwo uhimbarwa no kugira imbabazi.
Uzosubira kutugirira ikigongwe; uzosiribangira ivyaha vyacu musi y’ibirenge vyawe n’ibigabitanyo vyacu uzobita i bwina mu kiyaga.
Uzoba umwizigirwa ku ba Yakobo, uzokwerekana urukundo kuri Aburahamu, nk’uko wabirahiye ba sogokuruza bacu mu bihe vya kera.

name: Nahumu
chapters: Ibi ni ivyo Nahumu yavugishijwe vyerekeye Ninewe. Biri mu gitabu, akaba yabironse mu kwerekwa ari i Elikoshi.
Uhoraho ni Imana ipfuha kandi yihora; Uhoraho ni Imana yihora kandi ifise uburake bwinshi. Uhoraho yihora abamugwanya, kandi uburake bwiwe abwamiza ku bansi biwe.
Uhoraho ateba kuraka, ariko ni umunyenkomezi ahambaye; Uhoraho nta ho azoreka guhana uwagiriwe n’icaha. Yigaragariza mu gashururu no mu gihuhusi, kandi ibicu ni nk’umukungugu musi y’ibirenge vyiwe.
Akankamira ikiyaga kigakama, agakamya inzuzi zose. I Bashani n’i Karumeli harumye, kandi amashurwe y’i Libani arakabiranye.
Imisozi iratigita imbere yiwe, udutumba tugashonga. Isi ihinda agashitsi imbere yiwe, co kimwe n’abayibako bose.
Ni nde yohagarara imbere y’uburake bwiwe, ni nde yokwihanganira uburake bwiwe bw’inkazi? Umujinya wiwe iyo usutswe umeze nk’umuriro; amenagura ibitandara.
Uhoraho ni mwiza, ni ubuhungiro mu gihe c’amagorwa, kandi yitaho abamuhungirako.
Ariko asendanishije nk’umwuzure w’amazi menshi, azorandura Ninewe. Kandi abansi biwe azobakurikirana, gushika no mu mwijima.
Ivyo mutegura vyose vyo kugwanya Uhoraho Azokubita rimwe gusa, abarandure, ntazorinda gukubita irya kabiri.
Abansi biwe bazomera nk’abari mu mahwa y’inzitane, bamere nk’abantu baborewe umuvinyu mwinshi. Bazotongorwa nk’ubwatsi bwumye.
Muri wewe, yewe Ninewe, hariho uwosha abantu afise imigabo mibi k’ Uhoraho , akagira inama mbi abantu.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: "N’aho abansi bawe ari benshi kandi bakaba bakomeye, bazorandurwa baherengetere. Namwe Bayuda bantu banje, n’aho nigeze kubababaza, sinzosubira.
Ngiye kuvuna ingogo iri ku bitugu vyanyu, ncagagure n’iminyororo ibaboshe."

Uku ni ko Uhoraho ategetse ku bwawe, yewe Ninewe: "Ntuzosubira kuronka uruvyaro rwitirirwa izina ryawe. Nzorandura ibishushanyo bibajwe n’ibibumbano biri mu ngoro z’imana zanyu. Nzokwimbira imva, kuko uri umunyakibi."

Ehe ku mpinga z’imisozi, hari ibirenge vy’abazanye inkuru nziza, bazanye inkuru z’amahoro! Gira imisi mikuru yawe, yewe Yuda, ushitse n’ivyo wasezeranye. Nta banyakibi bazosubira kugutera; kuko bazorandurwa baherengetere.
Ehe uwugutera arakwegereje, yewe Ninewe! Rinda inzitiro, rinda amabarabara, kenyera zigume, ambara inkomezi!
Uhoraho agiye kugarukana icubahiro ca Yakobo, nk’icubahiro ca Isirayeli, naho abaranduzi bari bahasahuye, bakahagira nk’umuzabibu wahonye.
Inkinzo z’ingabo ziwe zisize ibara ritukura, n’ingabo zambaye ibitukura. Ivyuma vy’imikogote yiwe birakayangana, ku musi wo kwitegura kwiwe, amacumu akwikiye mu biti vy’amasederi arahungabana.
Imikogote y’intambara irahinda mu mabarabara, inyuragirana ahantu hose. Imeze nk’ibishirira, inyaruka nk’imiravyo.
Umwami w’i Ninewe ahamagaye abakuru b’ingabo ziwe, baza baratsitara mu nzira. Bihuta baja ku nzitiro zaho, bafashe inkinzo zo kwikingira.
Inzugi zija ku ruzi zirabomowe, n’ikirimba c’umwami kirahomvotse.
Itegeko ryasohotse, rivuga ko ab’i Ninewe bajanwa ari inyagano kure. Incoreke zaho ziboroga nk’inuma zikubita ku gikiriza.
I Ninewe hameze nk’itangi y’amazi, abantu baho biruka nk’amazi yayo iyo itobotse. Umwe agasemerera, ati: "Hagarara, hagarara!" Ariko mu bariko barahunga nta n’uwukebuka.
Sahura ifeza! Sahura inzahabu! Ubutunzi bwaho ntibuhera, huzuye ibintu vy’agaciro bidaharurika.
Igisagara kirasahuwe, kirambuwe, kirasenyuwe! Imitima irashonga, amavi acitse intege, imibiri irajugumira, abantu bose barahinduriye mu maso.
Icobo c’intare kiri hehe, ico bagabuririramwo izikiri ntonto, Cari ikibanza intambwe z’ingabo n’ingore zatemberanamwo n’ivyana vyazo ata co zinona.
Intambwe yahigira ivyana vyayo ibikwiye, ikanigira ibikoko ingore yayo, ikuzuza amasenga ivyo yishe, ivyobo vyayo ikavyuzuza ivyo yasahuye.

Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze ati: "Nzokugwanya. Nzoturira imikogote yawe icike umunyota, intambwe zawe zikiri ntonto zimarwe n’inkota. Nta munyago nzogusigira kw’isi, n’amajwi y’intumwa zawe ntazosubira kwumvikana."
Uzobona ibara, yewe wa mugwa wuzuye amaraso, wuzuye ibinyoma, wuzuye ubwambuzi, utigera uburamwo umuvyimba!
Umve urwamo rw’ibimoko, uguhinda kw’amaguru y’imikogote, umuvuduko w’amafarasi, uguhinda kw’imikogote y’intambara!
Ehe uwugwanira kw’ifarasi, inkota zica ibibatsi, n’amacumu ararabagirana! Hari abishwe benshi, ibirundo vy’imivyimba, n’imivyimba myinshi abantu bagenda bayitsitarako.
Ivyo vyose bitewe n’ubusambanyi bwa maraya w’agahebuza, w’ubwiza bukwega, umuhinga mu mareba, yabohesheje amahanga ubusambanyi bwiwe, amoko na yo akayabohesha uburozi bwiwe.
"Nzokugwanya," ni ko Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose avuze. "Nzoduza impuzu zawe ndazigupfuke mu maso. Nzogaragariza amahanga ubwambure bwawe, isi yose ndayereke ibiteye isoni vyawe.
Nzokurundako ibiteye isoni, nerekane ko ukengeretse, ntume uba agatwengo.
Abazokubona bose bazoguhunga, bavuge bati: ‘Ninewe habaye umusaka; ni nde yoharirira?’ "
Mbega uruta igisagara ca Tebesi, cari ku nkengera y’uruzi Nili, gikikujwe n’amazi? Urwo ruzi ni rwo rwari rugikingiye, kandi amazi yari akibereye nk’igihome kigikingira.
Etiyopiya na Egiputa vyari inkomezi zaco zitagira aho ziherera; Puti na Libiya vyari mu vyifatanije na co.

Ariko caratewe kirafatwa, abantu baco batwarwa mu kinyago. Inzoya zaco ziciwe mu mayirabiri zihondagujwe amabuye. Abubahwa baco batwawe nk’abaja hakoreshejwe ubupfindo. Abatware baho baboheshejwe iminyororo.
Na wewe Ninewe uzoborerwa ku bw’umubabaro; urondere ingene wokwinyegeza, uhunge abansi bawe.
Ibihome vyawe bimeze nk’ibiti vy’imisukoni, iyo yeze ivyamwa vyayo vya mbere; barayinyiganyiza, insukoni zayo zigahungurukira mu kanwa k’uwuzirya.
Ehe raba ingabo zawe zose; zisigaye zifise intege nke nk’abagore! Amarembo yawe aratamanzuye, yugururiwe abansi bawe; umuriro na wo wacagaguye ibihindizo vyayo.
Vomera mu bigega vy’amazi, amazi akwiye kuko ugiye guterwa, ukomeze ibihome vyawe! Katura ibumba, ukanyage ubudongo, ufate iforoma yo gufyatura amatafari yo kuzibira ibihengeri.
Ariko na ho nyene, umuriro uzogutongora, inkota izokurigata, nk’uko inzige zirigita ivyatsi. Nta wuzorokoka, naho mwogwira mukangana n’inzige.
Wagwijije abadandaza bangana n’inyenyeri zo kw’ijuru, ariko bameze nk’inzige zitongora ibiterwa vyo mu gihugu, zaheza zikagorora amababa zikigurukira.
Abarinzi bawe bangana n’inzige, n’abatware bawe bangana n’inzige zirundana ku nzitiro iyo hakanye, ariko akazuba katse zikigurukira, kandi nta n’uwumenya irengero ryazo.
Yewe mwami wa Ashuri, abungere barasinziriye kandi ntibazokwikangura; abahambaye bararuhutse ubwa nyuma. Ubwoko bwawe bushwiragiriye mu misozi, kandi nta wo kubegeranya azoboneka.
Nta kintu coshobora kugukiza, kuko uruguma rwawe ntirushobora gukira. Abumvise ivyakubayeko bose bakoma amashi, bakwitamba ku muvyimba. Kuko ukugira nabi kwawe ata we kutasesereje.

name: Habakuki
chapters: Ubu ni ubutumwa bwahawe umuvugishwa Habakuki.
Yewe Uhoraho , mbega nzogeza ryari kuguhamagara ngo umfashe, ariko ntunyumve, canke nkagutakira kubera umuryano ariko ntutabare?
Ni kuki utuma ndaba akarenganyo? Ni kuki wihanganira ibikorwa bibi? Guhonya n’umuryano biri imbere yanje; kandi imitongano n’amatati biri ahantu hose.
Ni co gituma ivyagezwe bitagikurikizwa, n’ubutungane ntibwubahirizwe. Umunyakibi aratsinda umugororotsi, ubutungane bugasibanganywa.
"Nimwitegereze amahanga, murabe hanyuma mutangare mwumirwe. Kuko mu gihe canyu, ngiye gukora ikintu mutokwigera mwemera, naho hogira uwukibabwira.
Ngiye guhagurutsa Abanyababiloni, ubwoko bw’inkazi kandi butagira imbabazi, buzoca mw’isi yose bwigarurire ibindi bihugu.
Ni abo gutinywa kandi bateye ubwoba. Bishingira amategeko nk’uko bishakiye bakigwiriza icubahiro.

Amafarasi yabo anyaruka kurusha ingwe, akerebutse kurusha imfyisi zihiga iyo bwije. Abagendera ku mafarasi babo basimbagurika bihuta, kandi abagendera ku mafarasi babo baza bava kure. Baguruka kurya kw’inkona iyo yihutira gucakira ico irotsa.
Bose bazanwa no gutera intambara. Amasinzi yabo agenda nk’umuyaga wo mu bugaragwa, bakegeranya imbohe zingana n’umusenyi.
Batwenga abami, bagashinyagurira abaganwa. Basuzugura ibisagara vyabo bizitiriwe; maze bakagira ibirundo vy’ivu, bakurira bakabifata.
Bagenda bihuta nk’umuyaga iyo uriko urahita. Ariko ni abo gutsindwa n’urubanza kuko inkomezi zabo ari zo mana yabo."
Yewe Uhoraho , mbega nturi Iyihoraho? Mana yanje, Uwera, utazokwigera upfa. Yewe Uhoraho , wabashiriyeho gushitsa amateka yawe; yewe gitandara canje, wabategetse kuduhana.
