Ariko inyonga zawe ziratunganye ntizikunda kuraba ikibi, ntiwihanganira inkozi y’ikibi. None ni kuki wihanganira abanyazi? Ni iki gituma wirengagiza iyo umunyakibi amira uwumusumvya ubugororotsi?
Abantu wabagize nk’amafi yo ku kiyaga, bamera nk’ibiremwa vyo mu mazi bitagira umurongozi.
Umunyakibi akwegesha abantu igera, akabategesha urusenga nk’urwo kuroba, akabegeraniriza mu co aroberamwo amafi, hanyuma akanezerwa, agahimbarwa.
Maze agashikanira ibimazi izo nsenga, ico aroberamwo akagituririra ibimota neza, kuko kubera urwo rusenga abayeho ubuzima bw’ibihimbaro bikomeye, agahindura imfungurwa uko ashatse.
Mbega azokwama asuka ibiri mu rusenga, atikiza amahanga ata kagongwe?
Nzoduga ku munara wanje, mpagarare ku kirindiro canje. Nzorindira ico ambwira, menye n’ico ndamwishura kuri aya maganya.
Maze Uhoraho aranyishura, ati: "Andika ivyo uhishuriwe, ubishire ahabona ku bisate vy’amabuye ku buryo vyorohera gusoma, uwugenda asemerera."
Kuko ivyo wahishuriwe birafise igihe bizoshikirako. Bivuga ivy’igihe c’iherezo, kandi ntibibesha. Naho vyoteba, ubirindire; nta nkeka bizoba, kandi ntibizoteba.
"Raba umwansi yishize hejuru; ivyipfuzo vyiwe ntibiroranye. Ariko umugororotsi azobeshwaho n’ukwizera kwiwe."

Ni ukuri, umuvinyu uramuhenda; yuzuye ubwibone kandi ntiyigera atekana. Ameze kurya kw’imva itigera ihaga, kandi ameze kurya kw’urupfu rutigera rushirwa, yiyegeranirizako amahanga yose, akagira imbohe abantu bose.
"Ariko, mbega abo bose ntibazomuhindura ikimaramare, bitwengera bavuga bati: ‘Azobona ibara uwirundaniriza ivyo yasahuye, akitungisha mu vyo yagunze abandi! Mbega azobikora kugeza ryari?’ "
Mbega abo mufitiye imyenda ntimuzobwirwa n’uko babahagurukiye? Ntibazokwikangura bagatuma mujugumira? Maze muzohinduka umunyago wabo.
Kuko wasahuye amahanga menshi, abacitse kw’icumu na bo bazobasahura. Kuko mwasheshe amaraso y’abantu; mukarandura ibihugu n’ibisagara, ndetse n’ababibamwo bose.
Azobona ibara uwiyubakira inzu mu nyungu mbi, akishirira icari ciwe hejuru, kugira ngo yikingire icago cose.
Ariko waranduye amahanga menshi, uteza isoni inzu yawe bwite kandi uzanira akaga ubugingo bwawe.
Amabuye yubatse impome azobaha induru, ibiti bizisakaye biyakire.
"Azobona ibara uwubakisha igisagara gusesa amaraso, agakomeresha igisagara akarenganyo."
Mbega Uhoraho Mushoboravyose si we yashinze ko abantu baruhira ibizotongorwa n’umuriro, n’amahanga akaruhira ubusa?
Kuko isi izokwuzura ukumenya ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho , nk’uko amazi yuzura ikiyaga.
"Azobona ibara uwuha inzoga mugenziwe, akamusukira iyiri mu mubindi gushika aborewe, kugira ngo abone ubwambure bwiwe."

Uzotwikirwa n’isoni mu gishingo c’icubahiro. Ubu ni wewe uramukiwe! Nunywe nawe, ubwambure bwawe bugaragare. Igikombe co mu kuboko kw’i buryo kw’ Uhoraho kirabashikiriye, kandi ubumaramare ni bwo buzosubirira ubwiza bwanyu.
Ibibi wakoreye Libani bizokurengera, kandi agatikizo wagiriye inyamaswa zaho kazogutera ubwoba. Kuko washeshe amaraso y’abantu, utikiza ibihugu, ibisagara, hamwe n’ababibamwo bose.
"Mbega igishushanyo kibazwa n’umuntu kimaze iki? Canke ikibumbano kivuga ibinyoma? Kuko ababibumba bizigira ivyo bakoze bo nyene; bakora ibigirwamana bidashobora no kuvuga.
Azobona ibara uwubwira igiti cumye ati: ‘Ba muzima!’ canke akabwira ibuye ati: ‘Kanguka!’ Mbega igishushanyo cokwereka inzira? Cometseko ifeza n’inzahabu ahantu hose; ntikigira ubuzima muri co."
Ariko Uhoraho avyagiye mu Ngoro yiwe yera; amahanga yose nahwekere imbere yiwe.
Iri ni isengesho ry’umuvugishwa Habakuki, riririmbwa mw’ijwi rya Shigiyonoti.

Uhoraho , numwise ukwamamara kwawe, mpagarara ntewe ubwoba n’ibikorwa vyawe bitangaje, yewe Uhoraho . Subira ubikore muri kino gihe cacu, bimenyekanishe mu gihe co kubaho kwacu; ariko mu burake bwawe, wibuke kugira imbabazi.
Imana yazananye i Temani, Uwera yaturutse ku musozi Parani. Sela. Ubwiza bwayo bwari butwikiriye amajuru, kandi amashimwe yayo yuzuye isi.
Ubwiza bwayo bwari bumeze nk’izuba rirashe; imishwarara yava mu kiganza cayo, ahari hanyegejwe ububasha bwayo.
Agatikizo kagendera imbere yayo; akaranda kagakurikira ibirenge vyiwe.
Maze irahagarara, inyiganyiza isi; iritegereza, ijugumiza amahanga. Imisozi yahozeho irasaduka, n’imitumba ya kera cane irasenyuka. Inzira zayo ni iz’ibihe bidashira.
Nabonye amahema y’ab’i Kushani yuzuye umubabaro, n’Abamidiyani aho baba hihebuye.
Yewe Uhoraho , mbega wari urakiye inzuzi? Uburake bwawe bwari ku masoko? Mbega wari uhagurukiye ibiyaga aho waza kw’ifarasi no mu mikogote y’intsinzi?
Wasokoroye umuheto, wegeranya imyampi myinshi. Sela. Watandukanije isi ukoresheje inzuzi,
imisozi yarakubonye irashonga. Amasumo y’amazi arahita, i bwina mu kiyaga hakumvikana urwamo, kigaterera imipfunda yaco hejuru.
Izuba n’ukwezi birahagarara kw’ijuru kubera imyampi irashwe, n’ukurabagiza kw’icumu ryawe ritewe.
Wagendagenze mu gihugu ufise umujinya, uhonyangisha amahanga ugukara kwawe.
Wazanywe no gucungura ubwoko bwawe, no gukiza uwo wasize amavuta. Wafyonyoye umutware w’igihugu cuzuye ikibi, uramuvunagura kuva ku mutwe gushika ku birenge. Sela.
Watobekeranishije umutwe wiwe icumu ryiwe, igihe ingabo ziwe zari zije kudushwiragiza, babikorana umunezero mwinshi ngo bahonye umworo aho yari yinyegeje.
Wahonyangishije ikiyaga ifarasi zawe, hamwe n’imikuba y’amazi menshi.

Naravyumvise nsimbwa n’umutima, iminwa yanje ijugumizwa n’iryo jwi; ukubora kwinjira mu magufa yanje, amaguru yanje arajugumira. Ariko nzorindira nihanganye umusi w’amakuba, aho uzozira kw’ihanga ryaduteye.
Naho umusukoni wanje utoshurika, inzabibu zanje ntizame, naho umwimbu wa elayo worumba imirima ntigire ico yera, naho intama zohera mu rugo, umukuku ugahera mu ruhongore,
nzonezererwa Uhoraho , nzohimbarirwa Imana y’agakiza kanje.

Uhoraho Nyeninganji ni we nkomezi zanje; akomeza ibirenge vyanje nk’ivy’ingeregere, anshoboza kugendera ku dutwe tw’imisozi. Ku mukuru w’abaririmvyi: Iri sengesho rizoririmbwe hakoreshejwe ibicurarangisho vy’imirya.

name: Zefaniya
chapters: Iri ni ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri Zefaniya, mwene Kushi, Kushi mwene Gedaliya, Gedaliya mwene Amariya, Amariya mwene Hezekiya, ku ngoma ya Yosiya mwene Amoni, umwami w’i Buyuda.
"Nzorandura ibintu vyose biri kw’isi," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
"Nzorandura abantu n’ibikoko; nkureho inyoni mu kirere n’amafi mu biyaga, hamwe n’ibigirwamana bituma umunyakibi atsitara. Igihe nzorandura abantu bose nkabakura kw’isi," ni ko Uhoraho avuze,

"nzoramvurira ukuboko kwanje kugwanya Abayuda, no kugwanya abantu bose baba i Yerusalemu. Nzorandura abasenga Bayali bose bazoba bagisigaye muri kino kibanza, n’amazina y’abaherezi basenga ibigirwamana,
bapfukama hejuru ku mazu, bagasenga inyenyeri zo kw’ijuru, bakongera bakunama bakarahira mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho , kandi bagasubira bakarahira mw’izina rya Moleki.
Nzorandura n’abo bose basubiye inyuma batakinsenga, hamwe n’abo batakirondera Uhoraho canke ngo bagire ico bamusiguza."
Nimuhwekere imbere y’ Uhoraho Nyeninganji, kuko umusi w’urubanza rwiwe uri hafi. Uhoraho yarateguye ikimazi; yaramaze gutegura abo kugitanga.
Kandi kuri uwo musi w’ikimazi c’ Uhoraho , nzohana abatware n’abaganwa ari bo bahungu b’umwami, hamwe n’abo bose basenga imana z’abanyamahanga.
Kuri uwo musi nzohana abaja mu misi mikuru yo gusenga ibigirwamana, bakuzuza inzu z’ibigirwamana vyabo umuryano n’uruhendo.
"Kuri uwo musi," ni ko Uhoraho avuze, "induru izokwumvikanira kw’Irembo ry’Amafi, abantu baboroge bava mu gisagara gishasha, kandi ijwi rirenga rizumvikanira ku misozi.
Nimuboroge, yemwe ababa hafi y’utuguriro, kuko abadandaza banyu bose bakuweho, abashora ifeza bose na bo bakaba bahonye.
Ico gihe nzorondeza Yerusalemu urumuri, mpane abantu bose bidibamiye mu vyaha vyabo, bameze nk’umuvinyu ureremba hejuru ku mvuzo, bibwira ko Uhoraho ata na kimwe azokora, kiba kibi canke ciza.
Ubutunzi bwabo buzosahurwa, amazu yabo azosenyurwa. Naho bubaka amazu, ntibazoyabamwo. Naho barima imizabibu, ntibazonywa imitobe yazo.
Umusi uhambaye w’ Uhoraho uri hafi, uri hafi kandi uje wihuta. Amarira yo ku musi w’ Uhoraho azoba ateye agahinda, aho n’umuhizi mu ntambara azoboroga.
Uwo musi uzoba ari umusi w’uburake, umusi w’amarira n’imibabaro, umusi w’ivyago no guhona, umusi w’umwijima w’umuzitanya, umusi w’igipfungu n’ukwiraburanirwa,
umusi w’inzamba n’akaruru k’intambara, yo kugwanya ibisagara bizitiriwe n’iminara yo mu mfuruka zavyo.
Nzoteza ivyago amahanga, agende arajuragirika kurya kw’impumyi, kuko bacumuye k’ Uhoraho . Amaraso yabo azoseswa hasi nk’amazi, n’imibiri yabo ibore nk’umwavu.

Ifeza zabo canke inzahabu zabo nta na kimwe kizoshobora kubakiza, ku musi w’uburake bw’ Uhoraho ." Mu kururumba kw’ishari ryiwe isi yose iyo iva ikagera, izotongorwa n’umuriro, kuko azoshiraho iherezo mu buryo bwihuta ry’abantu bose bari kw’isi.
Nimukoranire hamwe, mwebwe nyene nimwiyegeranirize hamwe, yemwe mwa bantu b’ihanga ritagira isoni.

Mwegerane imbere y’uko itegeko ritangura kuja mu ngiro, imbere y’uko uwo musi ushika ukabatumura nk’uko umuyaga mwinshi utumura umuguruka, imbere y’uko ishavu rihambaye ry’Imana ribashikako, imbere y’uko umusi w’uburake bw’ Uhoraho ubashikira.
Nimurondere Uhoraho , yemwe abaciye bugufi bo muri iki gihugu, mwebwe mukora ivyo ategetse. Rondera ubugororotsi, rondera ukwicisha bugufi; kumbure muzozigamwa ku musi w’ishavu ry’ Uhoraho .
Gaza hazotabwa, na Ashikeloni hacike umusaka. Ashidodi hazokwamburwa abaho ku murango, Ekuroni na ho harandurwe.
Muzobona ibara mwebwe muba ku nkengera z’ikiyaga, mwebwe Bakereti; Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rirabagiriza, yewe Kanani, intara y’Abafilisitiya. Rivuga ngo: "Nzobatikiza, nta n’umwe azosigara."
Intara yegereye ku kiyaga, izohinduka uburagiro, habe ibinogo vy’amazi y’abungere n’impongore z’imikuku.

Ico gihugu, kizokwegukira amasigarira y’abo mu muryango wa Yuda, aho ni ho bazoronka uburagiro. Mw’ijoro bazoruhuka baruhukire mu mazu yahebwe n’ab’i Ashikeloni. Uhoraho Imana yabo azobitaho, abasubize amatungo yabo.
"Narumvise ibitutsi vy’Abanyamowabu, hamwe n’agacokoro c’Abamoni, abatutse abantu banje, batera uruhagarara igihugu cabo.

None rero ndahiye ukubaho kwanje," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze, Imana ya Isirayeli, "Ni ukuri, i Mowabu hazoba nk’i Sodomu, Abamoni na bo babe nk’ab’i Gomora; ahantu huzuye ivyatsi n’ibinogo vyimbwamwo umunyu, ahantu hatazigera hasubira kugira abahaba. Amasigarira y’abantu banje azobasahura; abazorokoka mu gihugu canje bazokwegukira igihugu cabo."
Iyo ni yo mpera bazohabwa kubera ukwishira hejuru kwabo, kuko bacokoye bagashinyagurira abantu b’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose.
Uhoraho azobahindisha agashitsi niyasangangura ibigirwamana vyo muri ico gihugu. Amahanga yose yo ku nkengera z’ikiyaga azomusenga, bamwe bose mu gihugu cabo.
"Kandi namwe abo muri Etiyopiya, inkota y’ Uhoraho izobasogota."
Azoramvura ukuboko kwiwe agwanye abo mu buraruko, arandure Ashuri, Ninewe ahasige ari umusaka, hagadutse nko mu bugaragwa.

Imikuku n’amasho ni ho bizoryama n’ibikoko vy’ubwoko bwose. Ibihuna vyo mu bugaragwa n’ibindi bihurira, vyose bizokwibera ku nkingi zaho. Uguhurira kwavyo kuzokwumvikanira mu madirisha yaho, mu miryango yaho hazoba ibibomoke, n’ibisenge vyubatswe mu masederi bizosigara bigaragara ata kibipfutse.

Ico ni ca gisagara cishira hejuru, cahoze gitekaniwe. Wahoze wishima uvuga uti: "Ndi uwuhambaye kurusha abandi! Nta gisagara na kimwe cogereranywa nanje." Mbega ukuntu habaye umusaka, hasigaye hibera inyamaswa zo mw’ishamba. Abahaca bose bavuza uruhwa, bakahamama amashi.
Uzobona ibara wa gisagara c’abacinyiza, bagarariza kandi banduye!
Nta n’umwe cumvira, kandi nticemera guhanwa. Nticizera Imana, kandi ntikinemera kumwegera.
Abaganwa bari imbere muri co bameze nk’intambwe ziroha; abatware baho na bo ni nk’amabingira y’umugoroba, ata kintu na kimwe asigariza ejo.
Abavugishwa baco nta co bubaha; ni abanyabinyoma. Abaherezi baco bahumanya ahera h’urusengero bakarenga ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho ibigirankana.
Uhoraho aba muri co ni umugororotsi, nta kibi kiri muri we. Uko bukeye aca imanza zibereye, kandi uko uwundi musi uje ntarambirwa, ariko ababi ntibaterwa n’isoni.

"Nahoneje amahanga menshi, nsenyagura ibihome biyakingira n’iminara yabo. Amabarabara yabo nsiga ari nk’ubugaragwa, ata muntu n’umwe akiyacamwo. Ibisagara vyabo vyarasenyutse, ni nk’ubugaragwa nta muntu aharangwa.

Yewe Yerusalemu, nariyumviriye nti: ‘Mu vy’ukuri uzonyubaha, wemere gutozwa indero!’ Maze ikibanza c’ubuhungiro bwabo kibone ingene kizigamwa, kandi n’ibihano vyanje vyose ntibibashikeko. Ariko na ho nyene bagumanye ishaka ryinshi ryo kwama bakora ibibi.

None rero nimurindire gatoya," ni ko Uhoraho avuze, "mu gihe gito nzohaguruka ndabagirize. Namaze gufata ingingo yo kwegeranya amahanga, kwegeranya ubwami bwose, ngo ndabimarireko ishavu, ndabasukeko uburake bwanje bwose. Isi yose izotongorwa, irigitwe n’umuriro w’ishari ryanje.
Maze nzokweza iminwa y’ubwoko bwose, kugira ngo bose bashobore kwambaza izina ry’ Uhoraho , bamukorere bafatanye mu nda.
Abashwiragiriye hakurya y’inzuzi zo muri Etiyopiya, abanyambaza, abasabagiye banje, bazonzanira amashikanwa.
Kuri uwo musi, wewe Yerusalemu, ntuzokwongera kumaramazwa n’ibibi mwankoreye, kuko nzokura muri wewe ab’amanyama bishira hejuru, kandi ntimuzosubira kwishira hejuru ku musozi wanje wera.
Ariko nzosigaza muri mwebwe abitonda n’abaciye bugufi. Amasigarira ya Isirayeli azokwizigira izina ry’ Uhoraho .
Nta kibi bazokora; nta binyoma bazovuga; ururimi rubesha, ntiruzoba mu kanwa kabo. Bazorya baryame, kandi nta n’umwe azobatera ubwoba."
Ririmba, mukobwa w’i Siyoni we; shira ijwi hejuru, Isirayeli we! Nezerwa, uhimbarwe n’umutima wawe wose, mukobwa Yerusalemu!
Kuko Uhoraho yagukuyeko igihano, yasubije inyuma abansi bawe. Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, ari kumwe nawe; nta kibi uzosubira gutinya.
Kuri uwo musi bazobwira Yerusalemu bati: "Ntugire ubwoba, Siyoni; ntureke amaboko yawe ngo adendebukirwe.

Uhoraho Imana yawe ari kumwe nawe, ni umuhizi mu ntambara, ashoboye gukiza. Azogira umunezero mwinshi ku bwawe, mu rukundo rwiwe, ntazokwongera kugukankamira, ariko, azokunezererwa akoresheje indirimbo.
Nzokwegeraniriza muri wewe abo bose bagandariye kubura ya misi mikuru yari yarashinzwe, ntuzongera guteterwa.
Ico gihe nzohana abo bose babacinyiza, kandi nzokiza abacumbagira; nzokoraniriza hamwe abajanywe mu kinyago. Nzobahesha ishimwe n’icubahiro mu mahanga yose aho babaye bababazwa n’ibiteterwe.

Ico gihe ni ho nzobegeraniriza hamwe; kandi ico gihe ni ho nzobatahana i muhira. Nzobahesha icubahiro n’ishimwe mu mahanga yose yo kw’isi, igihe nzobasubiza ubutunzi bwanyu mukavyibonera n’amaso yanyu," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

name: Hagayi
chapters: Mu mwaka ugira kabiri umwami Dariyusi ari ku ngoma, ku musi wa mbere w’ukwezi kugira gatandatu, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryaciye ku wuvugishwa n’Imana Hagayi ribwirwa Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalutiyeli, umukuru w’intara y’i Buyuda, na Yosuwa mwene Yehozadaki, umuherezi mukuru.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: "Aba bantu bavuga bati: ‘Igihe ntikiragera co gusubira kwubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .’ "
Maze Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kuza riciye ku wavugishwa n’Imana Hagayi riti:
"Mbega iki ni igihe c’uko mwebwe mwibera mu mazu yanyu asharije kandi yubatse neza, ariko Ingoro yanje yoyo ikaguma ari umusaka?"
None rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: "Nimwiyumvire neza ku nzira zanyu.

Mwateye vyinshi, ariko mwimbuye bike. Murarya, ariko ntimwigera muhaga. Muranywa, ariko ntimwigera mushira inyota. Murambara, ariko ntimushira imbeho. Muronka imishahara mukayishira mu mifuko itobotse."
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: "Nimugenzure inzira zanyu.
Nimuduge mu misozi muzane ibiti maze mwubake Ingoro yanje, kugira ngo inezereze kandi impeshe icubahiro," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

"Mwari mwiteze kwimbura vyinshi, ariko raba, mwimbuye bike. Ivyo mwashikanye mu ngo ntuma bikeha. Ni kubera iki?" ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose abaza. "Ni kubera inzu yanje, yagumye ari umusaka, mu gihe umwe wese muri mwebwe yitwararitse kwubaka neza inzu yiwe.
Nuko rero, kubera mwebwe, ikirere carabimye urume, eka n’isi yarabimye ivyimburwa.
Nahamagaye uruzuba ngo ruze ku mirima, ku misozi, ku ngano, ku mizabibu, ku mavuta ya elayo ku bindi vyimburwa vyose isi itanga, ku bantu no ku bitungano, no ku vyo mwaruhiye vyose."

Nuko Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalutiyeli, Yosuwa mwene Yehozadaki, umuherezi mukuru, n’amasigarira yose, bumvira ijwi ry’ Uhoraho Imana yabo n’ubutumwa bw’uwavugishwa n’Imana Hagayi, nk’uko Uhoraho Imana yabo yari yamutumye. Abantu bubaha Uhoraho .
Maze Hagayi, intumwa y’ Uhoraho , ashikiriza abantu ubu butumwa buvuye k’ Uhoraho buvuga ngo: "Ndi kumwe namwe," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

Nuko Uhoraho akangura umutima wa Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalutiyeli, umukuru w’intara y’i Buyuda, n’umutima wa Yosuwa mwene Yehozadaki, umuherezi mukuru, n’umutima w’amasigarira yo mu bantu. Baraza batangura kwubaka Ingoro y’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana yabo,
ku musi wa mirongo ibiri na kane w’ukwezi kugira gatandatu. Mu mwaka ugira kabiri umwami Dariyusi ari ku ngoma,
Ku musi wa mirongo ibiri na rimwe w’ukwezi kugira indwi, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho riraza riciye mu wavugishwa n’Imana Hagayi, rivuga riti:
"Vugana na Zerubabeli mwene Sheyalutiyeli, umukuru w’intara y’i Buyuda, na Yosuwa mwene Yehozadaki, umuherezi mukuru, n’amasigarira yose y’abo bantu. Ubabaze uti:
‘Ni nde muri mwebwe agisigaye yoba yarabonye iyi Ngoro mu bwiza bwayo bwa kera? Mbega ubu isa gute? Mbega ntisa n’aho ari ubusa?’

‘Ariko ubu rero shikama, yewe Zerubabeli,’ ni ko Uhoraho avuze. ‘Shikama, yewe Yosuwa mwene Yehozadaki, umuherezi mukuru. Nimushikame mukomere, namwe bantu mwese muri mu gihugu,’ ni ko Uhoraho avuze, ‘maze mukore. Kuko ndi kumwe namwe,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
‘Ibi ni vyo nasezeranye namwe igihe mwava muri Egiputa. Kandi Mpwemu wanje aguma hagati muri mwebwe. Ntimutinye.’
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ‘Mu gihe gito nzosubira kunyiganyiza amajuru n’isi, ikiyaga n’i musozi.’
Nzonyiganyiza amahanga yose, kandi ivyo amahanga yose yipfuza bizoza, maze nzokwuzuza ubwiza iyi Ngoro, ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
‘Ifeza ni izanje n’inzahabu ni izanje,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
‘Ubwiza bw’iyi Ngoro buzoruta ubw’iya kera,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze. ‘Kandi nzozana amahoro aha hantu,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze."
Ku musi wa mirongo ibiri na kane w’ukwezi kw’icenda, mu mwaka ugira kabiri Dariyusi ari ku ngoma, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kuza riciye ku wavugishwa n’Imana Hagayi riti:
"Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ‘Baza abaherezi uko ivyagezwe bivuga:

Umuntu niyatwara inyama zeguriwe Imana mu muzingo w’impuzu wiwe, maze uwo muzingo ugakora ku mukate canke imboga, umuvinyu, amavuta ya elayo canke ibindi vyokurya vyose, mbega ivyo na vyo nyene bizoca biba ivyeguriwe Imana?’ " Maze abaherezi barishura bati: "Oya."
Maze Hagayi aravuga ati: "Umuntu yahumanijwe no gukora ku muvyimba akoze kuri kimwe muri ivyo, mbega gica gihumana?" Ba baherezi barishura bati: "gica gihumana."
Maze Hagayi aravuga ati: " ‘Ni ko bimeze no kuri aba bantu no kuri iri hanga mu nyonga zanje,’ ni ko Uhoraho avuze. ‘Ivyo bakora vyose n’ivyo bashikana vyose biranduye.’
None rero nimwiyumvire kuri ibi uhereye uno musi, mwibuke igihe ata buye ryari bwagerekwe ku rindi mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .

Umuntu yaja kurondera ingero mirongo ibiri mu kigega z’ingano, yasangamwo ingero cumi gusa. Uwaja kurondera ingero mirongo itanu z’umuvinyu mu bwato bwo kuganiramwo, yasangamwo ingero mirongo ibiri gusa.
Nateje igikorwa c’amaboko yanyu kurumba, ukubora n’urubura, ariko na ho nyene ntimwangarutseko, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
‘Kuva uwu musi, umusi wa mirongo ibiri na kane w’ukwezi kugira icenda, mwiyumvire cane ku musi itanguriro ry’uru rusengero rw’ Uhoraho ryashirwaho. Mwiyumvire neza:
Mbega hari n’imbuto zisigaye mu bigega? Kugeza ubu, umuzabibu, n’umusukoni, umukomamanga n’umwelayo ntivyamye ivyamwa vyavyo. Uhereye kuri uwu musi nzobahezagira.’ "
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho riraza riciye kuri Hagayi ubugira kabiri ku musi ugira mirongo ibiri na kane w’uko kwezi nyene, riti:
"Bwira Zerubabeli umukuru w’intara y’i Buyuda ko ngiye kunyiganyiza amajuru n’isi.
Nzotembagaza intebe z’ubwami nsangangure ubushobozi bw’amahanga. Nzotembagaza imikogote n’abayigenderako; amafarasi n’abayagenderako bizotemba, umwe wese yicwe n’inkota y’umuvukanyi wiwe.

‘Kuri uwo musi,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze, ‘nzogutwara, wewe Zerubabeli umusavyi wanje mwene Sheyalutiyeli,’ ni ko Uhoraho avuze, ‘maze ndakugire nk’impeta yo ku rutoke rwanje, kuko nagutoranije,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze."

name: Zakariya
chapters: Mu kwezi kugira umunani kw’umwaka ugira kabiri Dariyusi ari ku ngoma, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryaje ku wavugishwa n’Imana Zakariya mwene Berekiya, Berekiya mwene Ido, rivuga riti:
" Uhoraho yarashavuriye cane ba sogokuruza banyu.
Nuko rero, bwira abantu uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ‘Nimungarukeko,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze, ‘nanje nzobagarukako,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.

Ntimumere nka ba sogokuruza banyu, abo abavugishwa banje ba kera babwiye bati: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: Nimuhindukire muve mu nzira zanyu mbi no mu bikorwa vyanyu bibi, ariko ntibanyumvire canke ngo banshireko n’umutima, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
None ba sogokuruza banyu ubu bari he? Mbega abavugishwa n’Imana bamaho ibihe vyose?

Mbega none amajambo yanje n’ivyo nashinze nkabishikiriza abasavyi banje navugisha ntivyashitse kuri ba sogokuruza banyu? Maze barihana bavuga bati: ‘ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yadukoreye ibikwiranye n’ingeso zacu n’ibikorwa vyacu, nk’uko yari yagabiye kubitugirira.’ "

Ku musi ugira mirongo ibiri na kane w’ukwezi kw’indwi, mu kwezi kwa Shebati, mu mwaka ugira kabiri Dariyusi ari ku ngoma, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kuza ku wavugishwa n’Imana Zakariya mwene Berekiya, Berekiya mwene Ido.

Mw’ijoro nabonye ivyo neretswe, maze imbere yanje hari umugabo yari yicaye kw’ifarasi ifise ibara rigomba gutukura kandi na yo yari ihagaze mu biti vyitwa mirite, ahantu h’umwonga. Inyuma yiwe hari ayandi mafarasi na yo nyene y’akagajo, ayagomba kwera hamwe n’ayera.
Ndabaza nti: "Izo farasi zisigura iki, ga Mwami wanje?" Umumarayika yariko aravugana nanje aranyishura ati: "Ndakwereka ivyo ari vyo."
Maze wa mugabo yari ahagaze muri vya biti vyitwa mirite, aransigurira ati: "Ni abo Uhoraho arungitse kugendura isi yose."
Maze baha icegeranyo wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho yari ahagaze musi y’ivyo biti bati: "Twagenduye isi yose kandi twasanze isi yose itekanye iri mu mahoro."
Maze wa mumarayika w’ Uhoraho arishura ati: " Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, uzogeza ryari kutagirira imbabazi Yerusalemu n’ibisagara vy’i Buyuda, ivyo warakiye kumara iyi myaka mirongo indwi yose?"
Maze Uhoraho abwira amajambo meza kandi aremesha wa mumarayika yavugana nanje.
Nuko wa mumarayika yariko aravugana nanje ambwira ati: "Semerera ubu butumwa ubwire abantu bose uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ‘Ngize ipfuhe ku bwa Yerusalemu na Siyoni,
kandi ndashavuriye cane amahanga yibereye mu mutekano no mu mahoro. Nari narashavuriye gatoya abantu banje, ariko ayo mahanga yabahaye igihano kirengeje.’

Nuko rero uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Nzohindukirira Yerusalemu mfise imbabazi, kandi aho ni ho Ingoro yanje izosubira kwubakwa. Kandi umugozi wo gupima uzosubira kugororwa i Yerusalemu,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
Semerera umenyeshe abantu uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ‘Ibisagara vyanje bizosubira kwuzura bisesekare ivyiza, kandi Uhoraho azosubira kuremesha Siyoni no gutoranya Yerusalemu.’ "
Maze ndavye hejuru, mbona imbere yanje amahembe ane.
Mbaza wa mumarayika yariko aravugana nanje nti: "Ibi ni ibiki?" Anyishura ati: "Ayo mahembe aserukira amahanga ane yashwiragije Abayuda n’Abisirayeli n’ab’i Yerusalemu."
Nuko Uhoraho anyereka abacuzi bane.

Ndabaza nti: "Abo baje gukora iki?" Aranyishura ati: "Wabonye ya mahembe ane ari yo mahanga yashwiragije Abayuda kugira ngo ntihagire uwuzokwongera kuvyura umutwe. Aba bacuzi bazanywe no gutera ubwoba ayo mahanga no guca ayo mahembe yayo yadugije ngo agwanye Abayuda no gusanzaza abantu baho."
Maze nunamuye amaso, mbona umugabo imbere yanje afise umugozi mu ntoke.
Ndamubaza nti: "Ugiye he?" Aranyishura ati: "Ngiye gupima Yerusalemu, ngo ndabe ubwaguke n’uburebure bwaho."
Mu gihe wa mumarayika yariko aravugana nanje yari agiye, uwundi mumarayika araza barahura
maze amubwira ati: "Iruka, ubwire urya musore uti: ‘Yerusalemu kizoba igisagara kitagira inzitiro kubera igitigiri kinini c’abantu n’ibitungwa bizokibamwo.
Kandi jewe ubwanje nzohabera uruzitiro rw’umuriro ruhakikuje rwo kuhakingira,’ uko ni ko Uhoraho avuze, ‘kandi nzohabera n’ubwiza bw’imbere muri co!’ "
"Nimuze! Nimuze! Nimuhunge muve mu gihugu co mu buraruko," ni ko Uhoraho avuze, "kuko nabashwiragirije mu birere bine umuyaga wo mu kirere utumberamwo," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
"Nuze, yewe Siyoni! Hunga wewe uba ku mukobwa Babiloni!"
Kuko uku ari ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: "Nyenubwiza amaze kuntuma kugwanya amahanga yabanyaze ivyanyu, kuko yavuze ko uwubakozeko aba akoze mu mbone y’ijisho ryiwe.
Sinzogenda ntabanguriye ukuboko kwanje kuyagwanya kugira ngo abo bari baragize abagurano na bo babanyage ivyabo. Nuko muzomenya ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ari we yantumye.
Shira akamo hejuru unezerwe, Mukobwa w’i Siyoni. Kuko ndiko ndaza, kandi nzoba hagati muri wewe," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
"Amahanga menshi azokwifatanya n’ Uhoraho kuri uwo musi kandi azohinduka abantu banje. Nzoba muri mwebwe namwe muzomenya ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ari we yabantumyeko.
Uhoraho azoronka i Buyuda nk’umugabane wiwe mu gihugu cejejwe kandi azosubira gutoranya Yerusalemu.
Tekerereza imbere y’ Uhoraho , yemwe abafise umubiri mwese, kuko yikanguye ava ahera hiwe."
Maze anyereka Yosuwa umuherezi mukuru ahagaze imbere y’umumarayika w’ Uhoraho , na Satani ahagaze i buryo bwiwe ngo amwagirize.
Uhoraho abwira Satani ati: " Uhoraho aguhane, Satani! Uhoraho , yitoranirije Yerusalemu, aguhane! Mbega uwu muntu ntameze nk’igishirira cokowe kiva mu muriro?"
Kandi Yosuwa yari yambaye impuzu zanduye ahagaze imbere y’umumarayika.
Uwo mumarayika abwira abari bahagaze imbere yiwe ati: "Nimumwambure izo mpuzu zanduye." Maze abwira Yosuwa ati: "Raba, ndagukuyeko icaha cawe, kandi ngira nkwambike impuzu nziza."
Maze ndavuga nti: "Nimumwambike n’igitambara ciza mu mutwe." Nuko baca bamwambika igitambara ciza mu mutwe, mu gihe umumarayika w’ Uhoraho yari agihagaze ngaho.
Umumarayika w’ Uhoraho abwira Yosuwa aya majambo ati:
"Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ‘Niwamwumvira ukitondera ivyo yihanikirije, uzoganza Ingoro yiwe kandi azokuzeza abo mu rugo rwiwe, kandi azoguha ikibanza hagati y’aba bahagaze ngaha.’ "
"Niwumve yewe Yosuwa umuherezi mukuru, wewe na bagenzi bawe bicara imbere yawe, mukaba ikimenyetso c’ibizoza. Ngiye kuzana umusavyi wanje, yitwa Shami."

Raba ibuye nashize imbere ya Yosuwa! Iryo buye rifise impande indwi, kandi nzokwandika kuri iryo buye ibikwiye kwandikwako, ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze; kandi nzokuraho icaha c’iri hanga ku musi umwe gusa.
" ‘Kuri uwo musi, umwe wese muri mwebwe azotumira umubanyi wiwe ngo bicarane musi y’umuzabibu n’umusukoni wiwe,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze."
Maze umumarayika yavugana nanje aragaruka aza kumvyura, nk’uko umuntu avyurwa iyo yari asinziriye.

Arambaza ati: "Mbega ubona iki?" Ndamwishura nti: "Mbona igiterekwako amatara cose gikozwe mu nzahabu n’igikombe c’amavuta hejuru yaco, mbona n’amatara indwi ari kuri co, kandi gifise n’imiheha indwi ija kuri ayo matara.
Mbona kandi hari n’ibiti vy’imyelayo bibiri i ruhande yaco, kimwe i buryo bw’ico giterekwako amatara ikindi i bubamfu bwaco."
Nca mbaza wa mumarayika yavugana nanje nti: "Ibi ni ibiki, Mwami wanje?"
Aranyishura ati: "Ibi ntuzi ivyo ari vyo?" Ndamwishura nti: "Oya Mwami wanje."
Nuko aca ambwira ati: "Iri ni ijambo ry’ Uhoraho utumwe kubwira Zerubabeli uti: ‘Si ku bw’inkomezi canke ku bw’ubushobozi, ariko ni ku bwa Mpwemu wanje,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.

Wa musozi munini we, uri iki? Imbere ya Zerubabeli uzohinduka ikiyaya. Maze na we azozana ibuye rya nyuma rigumya imfuruka, kandi abantu na bo bazosemerera bavuga bati: ‘Mana rihezagire! Mana rihezagire!’ "
Maze Uhoraho ampa irindi jambo ati:
"Amaboko ya Zerubabeli ni yo yashizeho urufatiro rw’uru rusengero; kandi amaboko yiwe ni yo azorusozera. Maze muzomenya ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ari we yabantumyeko.

Uri nde wewe wubahuka kugaya ibintu kuko bikiri bito biri mu ntango? Nayo arya matara indwi yerekana inyonga z’ Uhoraho zigendagenda mw’isi yose, kandi azonezerwa abonye karisho mu kuboko kwa Zerubabeli?"
Maze mbaza uwo mumarayika nti: "Ibi biti vy’imyelayo bibiri kimwe i buryo ikindi i bubamfu bw’igiterekwako amatara bisigura iki?"
Kandi ndongera ndamubaza nti: "Ayo mashami abiri ari i ruhande y’imiheha ibiri y’inzahabu ivamwo amavuta y’inzahabu ni iki?"
Aranyishura ati: "Ntuzi ivyo ari vyo?" Ndavuga nti: "Oya, Mwami wanje."
Nuko aravuga ati: "Ivyo ni abantu babiri barobanujwe amavuta ngo bakorere Umwami w’isi yose."
Ndasubira ndaraba, mbona imbere yanje umuzingo uguruka.
Maze wa mumarayika arambaza ati: "Ubona iki?" Ndamwishura nti: "Mbona umuzingo uguruka, ufise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo ibiri z’uburebure na cumi z’ubwaguke ."

Aca arambwira ati: "Uyu ni umuvumo ugiye mu gihugu cose; kuko nk’uko wanditseko ku ruhande rumwe, abasuma bose bazokwirukanwa bave mu gihugu, kandi nk’uko wanditseko ku rundi ruhande, abarahira ibinyoma bose bazokwirukanwa.

Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze ati: ‘Nzowutuma usohoke, maze uzokwinjira mu nzu y’umusuma wese no mu nzu y’uwurahira ibinyoma wese mw’izina ryanje. Uzoguma muri iyo nzu kandi uzoyisambura yose, zaba imbaho, yaba n’amabuye ayubatse.’ "
Nuko umumarayika yari yamye avugana nanje aranyegera aza aho ndi arambwira ati: "Rangamiza urabe kirya kintu giserutse."
Ndamubaza nti: "Kirya ni igiki?" Aranyishura ati: "Ni igiseke." Arongerako ati: "Ico giseke cuzuye ukugabitanya kw’abantu bo muri iki gihugu cose."
Maze umupfundikizo waco ukozwe mu muringa ukurwaho, hanyuma mbona muri ca giseke umugore yicayemwo!
Wa mumarayika aca ambwira ati: "Uyu ni ukugabitanya," maze aca amutsindagira muri ca giseke aca ashirako wa mupfundikizo ukozwe mu muringa.
Maze ntaramuye amaso, mbona imbere yanje abagore babiri, baguruka baza aho turi batekeye umuyaga mu mababa yabo! Bari bafise amababa nk’ay’agasoza, baca baterura ca giseke bagitwara mu kirere.
Mbaza wa mumarayika yavugana nanje nti: "Mbega kirya giseke bakijanye he?"
Anyishura ati: "Bakijanye mu gihugu c’i Babiloni aho bazocubakira ingoro. Iyo ngoro niyuzura, ico giseke bazogishira aho categuriwe kigaragare cane."
Nsubiriye kwunamura amaso, mbona imbere yanje imikogote ine isokoroka ivuye hagati y’imisozi ibiri, kandi iyo misozi yari imisozi y’umwakaka.
Umukogote wa mbere wakwegwa n’amafarasi y’akagajo, uwa kabiri wakwegwa n’ayirabura,
uwa gatatu wakwegwa n’ayera, uwa kane na wo wakwegwa n’ayafise amabara menshi, kandi yose yari afise inkomezi nyinshi.
Mbaza wa mumarayika yavugana nanje nti: "Ivyo ni ibiki ga mwami wanje?"
Wa mumarayika aranyishura ati: "Izo ni impwemu zine zo mw’ijuru, zisohotse ziva aho zama zihagaze imbere y’Umwami aganza isi yose.
Urya mukogote ufise amafarasi yirabura ugiye werekeye igihugu co mu buraruko, uw’amafarasi yera werekeye mu burengero, uw’amafarasi afise amabara menshi na wo werekeye mu bumanuko."
Igihe ayo mafarasi y’inkomezi nyinshi yasohoka, yashaka kugendagenda mw’isi yose. Maze uwo mumarayika aca avuga ati: "Nimugendagende mw’isi yose!" Nuko aca agenda kugenzura isi yose.
Maze uwo mumarayika arampamagara ati: "Raba, amwe agiye yerekeye mu gihugu co mu buraruko gusukayo uburake bwanje bituma umutima wanje uruhuka ku vy’igihugu co mu buraruko."
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rirambwira riti:
"Niwakire ifeza n’inzahabu ku bari barajanywe ari inyagano ari bo Heludayi, Tobiya na Yedaya, bashitse bavuye i Babiloni. Ugende uwo musi nyene kwa Yosiya mwene Zefaniya.
Ujane za feza na za nzahabu ucure urugori maze urwambike Yosuwa mwene Yehozadaki, umuherezi mukuru, ku mutwe.
Umubwire uti uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ‘Ehe umuntu yitwa Shami araje, kandi azoshamikira mu kibanza ciwe maze yubake urusengero rw’ Uhoraho .

Ni we azokwubaka urusengero rw’ Uhoraho , azokwambikwa icubahiro c’inganji maze yicare ku ntebe yiwe y’ubwami aganze. Ari ku ntebe yiwe y’ubwami, azoba n’umuherezi, kandi ayo mabanga yiwe abiri azoyahuza neza mu rutonde ntangere.’
Urwo rugori ruzobwa Heludayi, Tobiya, Yedaya na Heni mwene Zefaniya nk’icibutso mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Abari kure bazoza bafashe kwubaka urusengero rw’ Uhoraho , maze muzomenya ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yabantumyeko. Ivyo bizoba nimwagira umwete wo kwumvira Uhoraho Imana yanyu."
Mu mwaka ugira kane umwami Dariyusi ari ku ngoma, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryaje kuri Zakariya ku musi ugira kane w’ukwezi kw’icenda, ari kwo Kisilevu.
Abantu b’i Beteli bari batumye Sharezeri na Regemu-Meleki, hamwe n’abantu babo, ngo babasigurize Uhoraho

mu kubaza abaherezi bo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose n’abavugishwa n’Imana ngo: "Tuzobandanya kuboroga no kwisonzesha mu kwezi kugira gatanu, nk’uko twagumye tubigira muri iyi myaka yose ishize, twibuka umusi urusengero rwasamburwa?"
Nuko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yongera kumbwira ijambo ati:

"Baza abantu bo mu gihugu hamwe n’abaherezi uti: ‘Hamwe mwisonzesha mukaboroga mu kwezi kugira gatanu no mu kugira indwi muri iyi myaka iheze uko ari mirongo indwi, mbega harya vy’ukuri mwisonzesha ku bwanje?
Kandi igihe mwarya mukanywa, ntimwaba muriko murinezereza mwebwe ubwanyu?

Mbega aya si yo majambo Uhoraho yabamenyesheje ayacishije mu bo yavugisha ba kera igihe Yerusalemu n’ibisagara vyari bihakikije vyari mu mutekano kandi vyuzuye ubutunzi, na Negebu n’ibiyaya vyaho bikirimwo abantu?’ "
Maze ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kuza kuri Zakariya riti:
"Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ‘Nimuce imanza zibereye; mugire imbabazi mubabarane.
Ntimucinyize umupfakazi n’impfuvyi, inyambukira canke umukene. Ntimugire inama yo kugirira abandi nabi.’
Ariko banka kwumva; bakomantaza imitima yabo bantera ibitugu biziba amatwi.

Imitima yabo barayikomantaza bayigira nk’ibuye ntibumvira ivyagezwe n’amajambo y’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yari yabatumyeko akoresheje Mpwemu wiwe yavugisha abavugishwa biwe ba kera. Ni co catumye Uhoraho Mushoboravyose araka cane.
‘Aho nahamagara, ntibanyumvirije; ni co catumye igihe bahamagara, nanje ntabumvirije,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
‘Nabasanzarishije agashururu mu mahanga yose, aho babaye inyambukira. Igihugu bavuyemwo casigaye ari imisaka ku buryo ata muntu yagicamwo. Uko ni ko bahinduye imisaka ico gihugu c’igikundiro.’ "
Iri ni ijambo Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yambariye.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: "Mfise ipfuhe ryinshi ku bwa Siyoni; ndahafitiye ipfuhe rirurumba muri jewe kurya kw’umuriro."
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: "Nzogaruka i Siyoni mbe muri Yerusalemu. Maze Yerusalemu hazokwitwa igisagara co kwizigirwa, kandi umusozi w’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose uzokwitwa Umusozi Wera."
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: "Abatama n’abatamakazi bazosubira kandi kugendagenda mu mabarabara y’i Yerusalemu, umwe wese yitwaje inkoni kubera ubusaza.
Amayira y’igisagara azokwuzura abahungu n’abakobwa bakiniraho."
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: "Naho ivyo womenga biratangaje ku masigarira y’aba bantu muri iki gihe, mbega no kuri jewe vyoba ibitangaje?" ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: "Nzokiza abantu banje ndabakure mu bihugu vyo mu buseruko n’ivyo mu burengero.
Nzobagarukana ngo babe i Yerusalemu; bazoba abantu banje, nanje nzoba umwizigirwa n’umugororotsi kuko ndi Imana yabo."

Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: "None rero nimwumve aya majambo: amaboko yanyu nakomere, mwubake urusengero. Ibi ni vyo nyene abavugishwa n’Imana bavuze igihe itanguriro ry’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ryashirwaho.

Imbere y’aho nta muntu yatanga impembo y’umukozi yo ku musi canke ngo akoteshe inka. Nta n’umwe yaja ku bikorwa vyiwe ngo agaruke amahoro kubera abansi, kandi kuko nari nahinduye umwe wese ngo abe umwansi wa mugenziwe.
Ariko ubu nzogirira amasigarira y’ubu bwoko nk’uko nabagirira kera," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
"Imbuto zizokura neza, umuzabibu uzokwama ivyamwa vyawo, isi izotuma haba ivyimburwa, n’amajuru azozana ikime cayo. Ivyo vyose nzobiha amasigarira y’aba bantu ngo bibe umwandu wabo.
Nk’uko mwebwe, Abayuda n’Abisirayeli, mwabaye umuvumo mu mahanga, ni ko nzobakiza, kandi muzoba umugisha. Ntimutinye, ahubwo amaboko yanyu nakomere."
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: ati: "Nk’uko nafashe ingingo yo kubateza ivyago no kutabagirira akagongwe igihe ba sogokuruza banyu bandatsa," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze,
"ni ko n’ubu mfashe ingingo yo gusubira kugirira neza Yerusalemu n’i Buyuda. Ntimutinye.
Ibi ni vyo mukwiye gukora: muvugane ukuri na bagenzi banyu, kandi muce imanza z’ukuri kandi zibereye mu bucamanza bwanyu;
ntimugire inama zo kugirira bagenzi banyu nabi, kandi ntimukunde kurahira ibinyoma. Ivyo ndavyanka," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Maze ijambo ry’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose rinzako.

Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: "Ukwisonzesha no kugandara vyo mu kwezi kugira kane n’ukugira gatanu n’ukw’indwi n’ukw’icumi, ubu birarangiye, bihindutse imisi mikuru y’umunezero ku Bayuda. Nuko rero mukunde ukuri n’amahoro."
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: "Amoko menshi n’ababa mu bisagara vyinshi bazoza,
ababa mu gisagara kimwe bazoja mu kindi babwirane bati: ‘Ingo tujane gutazira no kwambaza Uhoraho Mushoboravyose. Jewe ubwanje ndagiye.’
Kandi amoko menshi n’amahanga ahambaye azoza i Yerusalemu kurondera Uhoraho Mushoboravyose kugira ngo amusabe umuhezagiro."

Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: "Muri iyo misi abantu cumi bo mu ndimi zose n’amahanga bazofata Umuyuda umwe ku buyonga bw’impuzu yiwe bavuge bati: Reka tujane nawe, kuko twumvise ko Imana iri kumwe namwe."

Ivyavugishijwe Zakariya: Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryarumvikanye ryo kwagiriza igihugu ca Haduraki kandi rizoza kuruhukira kuri Damasiko, kuko inyonga z’ Uhoraho ziri ku bantu bose hamwe n’imiryango yose y’Abisirayeli,
ziri no kuri Hamati na ho nyene, ahahana urubibe na ho, no kuri Tiro n’i Sidoni, naho bazi ubwenge bwinshi.
Tiro hiyubakiye uruzitiro; hirundaniriza ifeza nk’umukungugu, n’inzahabu nk’umwavu wo mu mabarabara.
Ariko Imana izojana ubutunzi bwaho bwose kandi izosenyurira inkomezi zaho mu kiyaga, kandi hazotongozwa umuriro.

Igisagara Ashikeloni kizobibona gitinye; i Gaza bazohinda agashitsi kubera ubwoba, na Ekuroni na ho nyene, kuko ivyizigiro vyaho bizoba biheze. Gaza hazobura umwami waho kandi Ashikeloni na ho hazosigara ari ubugaragwa.
Abantu b’ibivyarwa ni bo bazokwibera muri Ashidodi, kandi nzomara ubwibone Abafilisitiya.

Nzokura inyama zikirimwo amaraso mu minwa yabo, nkure n’ivyokurya baterekereye ibigirwamana mu menyo yabo. Abasigaye bazoba inyegu y’Imana yacu kandi bazohinduka umuryango umwe wa Yuda, kandi n’abo muri Ekuroni bazohinduka nk’Abayebusi.
Ariko jewe nzoshira ikirindiro canje ku rusengero rwanje ngo ndarurinde ingabo zoza kurutera. Nta wucinyiza azosubira guca mu bantu banje, kuko ndaharinze.

Nezerwa cane Mukobwa w’i Siyoni! Ushire ijwi ryawe hejuru, Mukobwa w’i Yerusalemu! Raba, umwami wawe arakugendeye, ni umugororotsi kandi afise intsinzi, yicishije bugufi kandi agendera ku ndogoba, mbere aje ku nyana yayo.

Nzokuraho imikogote muri Efurayimu n’amafarasi y’intambara ndayakure muri Yerusalemu, nzovunagura n’imiheto yo ku rugamba. Azovuga ivy’amahoro mu mahanga. Ukuganza kwiwe kuzova ku kiyaga gushike ku kindi no kuva ku ruzi Efurate gushika ku mpera z’isi.
Ariko mweho, kubera amaraso yanje y’isezerano dufitaniye, nzobarekurira imbohe zanyu ndazikure mu rwobo rutagira amazi.
Nimugaruke mu kibanza muzigamirwamwo, yemwe mbohe ziri n’ivyizigiro; mbere n’ubu ndabamenyesheje ko nzobashumbusha incuro zibiri imibabaro.
Nzogonda i Buyuda nk’uko bagonda umuheto maze Efurayimu ndabahindure nk’umwampi. Nzokabura abahungu bawe, ewe Siyoni, ngo batere abahungu bawe, ewe Bugiriki, nzobagira nk’inkota y’umuhizi.
Maze Uhoraho azoseruka hejuru y’abantu biwe; umwampi wiwe uzorabagirana nk’umuravyo. Uhoraho Nyeninganji azovuza inzamba; azogendera mu bihuhusi nk’ivy’umuyaga wo mu bumanuko,

kandi Uhoraho Mushoboravyose azobabera inkinzo ibakingira. Bazosangangura bongere batsinde abansi babo bakoresheje amabuye atereshwa umugozi. Bazokwiha akamo mu ntambara nk’ababorewe umuvinyu; bazoba buzuye amaraso nk’uko igikombe gikoreshwa mu gucucagira imfuruka z’igicaniro.
Uhoraho Imana yabo azotabara abantu biwe kuri uwo musi nk’uko umwungere atabara imikuku yiwe. Bazokayangana mu gihugu ciwe nk’amabuye y’igiciro ari ku rugori.
Ese ukugene bazoba ari beza kandi bateye igomwe! Ingano zizotuma abasore bakura, kandi n’umutobe ni ko uzobera abakobwa.
Nimusabe Uhoraho imvura mu gihe c’impeshi; Uhoraho ni we aganza ibicu n’imituragaro. Atanga imvura y’umuvuvu ku bantu bose, akameza ibiterwa bitotahaye mu mirima y’umuntu wese.

Ibigirwamana bivuga ibinyoma, abahamagara imizimu berekwa ibinyoma. Barotora inzozi z’ibinyoma, bakaremesha abantu mu vy’ubusabusa. Ni co gituma abantu basanzara hirya no hino nk’intama zihahazwa kubera kubura umwungere.
"Uburake bwanje buri ku bungere, kandi nzohana abo batware; kuko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose azokwitwararika umukuku wiwe, ari bo bantu b’i Buyuda, abahindure nk’ifarasi y’ubwibone mu ntambara.
Muri Yuda hazovamwo ibuye rigumya imfuruka, muri we hazovamwo urumambo rugumya ihema, muri we hazovamwo umuheto w’intambara, muri we hazovamwo abatware bose.
Bose hamwe bazoba nk’abahizi mu ntambara basiribangira umwansi wabo mu vyondo vyo mu mabarabara. Bazogwana kuko Uhoraho ari kumwe na bo, kandi bazotuma abansi babo bagwanira ku mafarasi bamaramara.
Nzoha inkomezi Yuda kandi nzotabara imiryango ya Yosefu. Nzobagarukana kuko ndabagirira impuhwe. Nzomera nk’aho ntigeze ndabaheba, kuko ndi Uhoraho Imana yabo kandi nzobishura amasengesho yabo.
Abefurayimu bazoba nk’abahizi, kandi imitima yabo izonezerwa nk’ababorewe umuvinyu. Abana babo bazobibona bahimbarwe; imitima yabo izonezererwa Uhoraho .
Nzobahamagara ndabegeranye. Vy’ukuri nzobacungura; bazoba benshi bagwire nka kera.
Naho nabasanzarije mu mahanga menshi, bazonyibuka bari mu bihugu vya kure. Kandi bo n’abana babo bazobaho, kandi bazogaruka.
Nzobagarukana ndabakure muri Egiputa ndabegeranye ndabakuye muri Ashuri. Nzobazana i Gileyadi n’i Libani, kandi ntibazoronka aho bakwirwa.
Bazoca mu kiyaga c’amarushwa; nzotururuza imipfunda yo mu kiyaga n’i bwina h’uruzi Nili hazokwuma. Ubwibone bwa Ashuri buzotururuzwa n’icumu ry’ubugabe rya Egiputa rizokurwaho.
Nzobaha inkomezi zivuye k’ Uhoraho kandi mw’izina ryiwe bazobaho mu mutekano," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Ugurura amarembo yawe, ewe Libani, kugira ngo umuriro utongore amasederi yawe!
Nimuboroge, yemwe biti vy’ubujwari, kubera amasederi yiciwe; ibiti biteye igomwe vyaguye hasi! Nimuboroge, yemwe biti binini cane vy’i Bashani; kuko ishamba ryari rizitanye ryatemwe!
Umviriza ukuboroga kw’abungere; kuko uburagiro butotahaye bwabo bwakuweho! Umviriza ukuroha kw’intambwe; kuko ubwihisho bwazo bwo kuri Yorodani bwakuweho.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Imana yanje avuze: "Ragira umukuku wagerewe gukererwa.
Abaziguze barazikerera bakigira badahanywe. Abazigurishije na bo bakavuga bati: ‘ Uhoraho ahimbazwe, turi abatunzi!’ N’abungere bazo ubwabo ntibaruha bazigirira akagongwe.

Ni nk’uko nyene, sinzosubira kugirira akagongwe abantu b’iki gihugu," ni ko Uhoraho avuze. "Nzotanga umuntu wese mu maboko y’abagenzi biwe n’umwami wabo. Bazotabagura igihugu, kandi sinzotabara n’umwe ngo ndamubakure mu maboko."
Nuko nca ndagira wa mukuku wagerewe kubagwa, canecane izihahazwa zo mu mukuku. Maze nca nakira inkoni zibiri, imwe ndayita Buntu iyindi Bumwe, maze nca ngenda kuragira wa mukuku.
Mu kwezi kumwe nca nirukana abungere bawo batatu. Wa mukuku uca uranyanka, nanje ndushaho kugenda ndawurambirwa
maze ndavuga nti: "Sinzoba umwungere wanyu. Reka iyiriko irapfa ipfe, iyo kwicwa na yo yicwe. Izisigaye na zo ziryane zihezanye ubwazo."
Nuko mfata ya nkoni yitwa Buntu ndayivunamwo kubiri, kugira ngo nerekane ko nkuyeho isezerano nasezeranye n’amahanga yose.
Rica rikurwaho kuri uwo musi nyene, maze izacinyijwe zo mu mukuku zariko zirandaba zica zimenya ko ari ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .
Ndazibwira nti: "Nimba bibabereye vyiza, nimumpe impembo yanje; ariko bitari uko, nimuyigumye." Nuko bampemba ibiceri vy’ifeza mirongo itatu.
Maze Uhoraho arambarira ati: "Yaterere umubumvyi," ico giciro ciza babonye ko nkwiye! Nuko nca mfata vya biceri vy’ifeza mirongo itatu ndabiterera umubumvyi mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Ndaheza mvuna ya nkoni igira kabiri yitwa Bumwe, mba mvunye ubumwe hagati ya Yuda na Isirayeli.
Maze Uhoraho arambarira ati: "Subira wakire ibikoresho vya wa mwungere w’igipfu.

Kuko ngiye guhagurutsa umwungere w’iki gihugu atazobabara izazimiye, canke ngo arondere imyagazi, canke ngo avure izakomeretse, canke ngo agaburire izikomeye. Ahubwo azorya inyama z’intama z’indobanurwa, kugeza no ku binono.
Aragowe uwo mwungere w’igipfu ata co amaze, uwo ata umukuku! Aragakubitwa inkota ku kuboko no ku jisho ry’i buryo! Ukuboko kwiwe nikunyunyuke rwose, ijisho ryiwe ry’i buryo na ryo rihume rwose!"
Ivyavugishijwe Zakariya: Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryerekeye Abisirayeli. Uhoraho , ni we yashanje amajuru, ashiraho urufatiro rw’isi, kandi ni we arema agashira impwemu mu muntu, avuze ati:
"Ngiye guhindura Yerusalemu kuba igikombe kiboreza amahanga yose ahakikuje. I Buyuda hazokwugarizwa hamwe n’i Yerusalemu.
Kuri uwo musi, aho amahanga yose yo kw’isi azoba yakoraniye kuhagwanya, nzohindura Yerusalemu igitandara kitanyiganyizwa ku mahanga yose. Abazogerageza kukinyiganyiza ni bo bazokomereka.
Kuri uwo musi nzoteza ifarasi yose ubwoba, uwuyigenderako na we ndamuteze ibisazi," ni ko Uhoraho avuze. "Nzogumiza ijisho ryanje kuri Yuda, ariko nzoteza uruhumyi amafarasi yose y’amahanga.
Maze abakuru b’imiryango ya Yuda bazovuga mu mitima yabo bati: ‘Abantu b’i Yerusalemu ni abanyenkomezi, kuko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ari Imana yabo.’

Kuri uwo musi nzohindura imiryango ya Yuda imere nk’umuriro mu kirundo c’inkwi, canke nk’igishirira kiri mu miganda y’ingano. Bazotongora amahanga abakikije i buryo n’i bubamfu, ariko Yerusalemu ho hazoguma hahangamye mu kibanza caho."
Uhoraho azotabara amazu y’Abayuda ubwa mbere, kugira ngo icubahiro c’inzu ya Dawidi n’ic’ababa i Yerusalemu ntikirute ica Yuda.

Kuri uwo musi Uhoraho azokingira ababa i Yerusalemu, kugira ngo umunyantegenke wo muri bo aze abe nka Dawidi, n’uruvyaro rwa Dawidi ruze rube nk’Imana, canke nk’umumarayika w’ Uhoraho agiye imbere yabo.
Kuri uwo musi nzosohokanwa no gusangangura amahanga yose azotera Yerusalemu.
Nzosuka ku nzu ya Dawidi no ku baba i Yerusalemu impwemu y’ubuntu no gusenga. Bazondaba, jewe uwo bacumise, maze baboroge nk’uwuborogera umwana wiwe w’ikinege, bagandare nk’uwugandarira imfura yiwe.
Kuri uwo musi gucura intimba muri Yerusalemu kuzoba kwinshi nka kwa gucura intimba ku bwa Hadadi-Rimoni mu kiyaya c’i Megido.
Igihugu kizoboroga, umuryango wose ukwawo, hamwe n’abagore babo ukwabo: umuryango w’inzu ya Dawidi n’abagore babo, umuryango w’inzu ya Natani n’abagore babo,
umuryango w’inzu ya Lewi n’abagore babo, umuryango wa Shimeyi n’abagore babo,
n’abasigaye bose bo mu miryango n’abagore babo.
"Kuri uwo musi iriba rizotoborerwa abo mu nzu ya Dawidi n’ababa i Yerusalemu, kugira ngo ruboze icaha n’ubuhumane.
Kuri uwo musi, nzozimanganya abasenga ibigirwamana mu gihugu, ku buryo n’amazina yavyo atazosubira kwibukwa," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze. "Nzokuraho ba kamenyi n’impwemu ihumanya mu gihugu.

Kandi nihagira n’umuntu n’umwe yongera kuvugishwa, se na nyina bamwivyariye, bazomubwira bati: ‘Ntugenda udapfuye, kuko wavuze ibinyoma mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho .’ Maze abavyeyi biwe bwite ni bo bazomusogota.
Kuri uwo musi umuntu wese avugishwa azogira isoni zo kuvuga ko yeretswe. Kandi ntibazosubira kwambara impuzu zibaranga nk’abavugishwa kugira ngo babeshe abantu.
Umwe wese azovuga ati: ‘Sindi umuvugishwa. Ndi umurimyi; mbeshejweho n’ukurima isi kuva mu buto bwanje.’
Nihagira uwubabaza ati: ‘Ivyo bikomere ku mubiri wawe vyavuye kuki?’ bazomwishura bati: ‘Ni ivyo nakomerekeye mu nzu y’abagenzi banje.’

Vyuka, yewe wa nkota, ukubite umwungere wanje, ukubite urya muntu ari hafi yanje," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze. "Kubita umwungere, intama zisanzare, nanje nzohindukiriza ukuboko kwanje kugwanya imyagazi.
Mu gihugu cose, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, babiri kuri batatu bazokwicwa; umwe muri batatu ni we azosigara.

Abo bazoba basigaye, ni bo nzocisha mu muriro; nzobamara inkamba nk’ifeza ndabagerageze nk’inzahabu. Bazokwambaza izina ryanje nanje nzobishura; nzovuga nti: ‘Ni abantu banje,’ na bo bazovuga bati: ‘ Uhoraho ni we Mana yacu.’ "
Umusi w’ Uhoraho uraje, ewe Yerusalemu, aho ubutunzi bwawe buzosahurwa bukagabanganirizwa hagati mu nzitiro zawe.

Nzokoraniriza amahanga yose i Yerusalemu ngo bahagwanye; ico gisagara kizofatwa mpiri, amazu asahurwe, n’abagore bafatwe ku nguvu. Igice c’igisagara kizojanwa ari inyagano, ariko abasigaye ntibazokurwa mu gisagara.
Maze Uhoraho azosohokanwa no kugwanya ayo mahanga, nk’uko agwana ku musi w’intambara.

Kuri uwo musi ibirenge vyiwe bizohagarara ku Musozi wa Elayono, uri mu buseruko bw’i Yerusalemu, maze Umusozi wa Elayono uzosadukamwo kubiri uhereye mu buseruko ukageza mu burengero, haboneke ikiyaya kinini, igice kimwe c’uwo musozi cimuke kija mu buraruko ikindi mu bumanuko.

Muzohungira muri ico kiyaya canje c’uwo musozi, kuko kizoshika muri Azeli. Muzohunga nk’uko mwahunze nyamugigima mu misi ya Uziya umwami w’i Buyuda. Maze Uhoraho Imana yanje azoza, ari kumwe n’abejejwe bose.
Kuri uwo musi izuba ntirizokwaka canke ngo habe gukanya, canke umwijima.
Uzoba ari umusi wisa, umusi uzwi n’ Uhoraho wenyene, ata gutandukanya umurango n’ijoro. No mu gihe c’umugoroba umuco uzogumaho.
Kuri uwo musi amazi y’ubugingo azotemba ava i Yerusalemu, igice kimwe kizoja mu buseruko mu Kiyaga c’Umunyu ikindi gice kije mu burengero mu Kiyaga Mediterane, mu ci no mu gihe c’imbeho nyinshi.
Uhoraho azoba umwami w’isi yose. Kuri uwo musi hazoba Uhoraho umwe, kandi izina ryiwe rizoba rimwe rudende.

Igihugu cose, uhereye i Geba ugashika i Rimoni, mu bumanuko bwa Yerusalemu, kizoba nka Araba. Ariko Yerusalemu hazoshirwa hejuru cane uhereye kw’Irembo rya Benyamini ukageza mu kibanza c’Irembo rya Mbere, ukabandanya ukageza kw’Irembo ryo mu Mfuruka, ugakomeza ukava ku munara wa Hananeli ukageza ku bwato bwo kuganiramwo umuvinyu bw’i bwami. Kandi hazoguma mu kibanza caho.
Abantu bazohaba; kandi ntihazokwongera gusamburwa. Yerusalemu hazoba umutekano.
Iki ni co cago Uhoraho azoteza amahanga yose azotera i Yerusalemu: inyama zabo zizobora bakigendagenda, amaso yabo aborere mu bibanza vyayo, n’indimi zabo zizoborera mu kanwa kabo.
Kuri uwo musi abantu bazoterwa ubwoba n’ Uhoraho . Bazosubiranamwo bagwane.
Yuda na we azogwanira i Yerusalemu. Ubutunzi bw’ibihugu bihakikije buzokwegeranywa; inzahabu n’ifeza vyinshi cane n’impuzu.
Icago nk’ico kizoshika ku mafarasi n’inyumbu, ingamiya n’indogoba, n’ibindi bitungano bizoba muri ayo makambi.
Maze abazocika kw’icumu bo mu mahanga yose yateye Yerusalemu bazoduga uko umwaka utashe gusenga Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, no guhimbaza imisi mikuru y’insago.
Kandi nihagira umuntu n’umwe wo muri ayo moko yo kw’isi atazoduga i Yerusalemu gusenga Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, ntazoronka imvura.
Abanyegiputa nibataduga ngo bifatanye n’abandi, nta mvura bazoronka. Uhoraho azobarekurirako icago azoteza amahanga ataza guhimbaza umusi mukuru w’insago.
Ico kizoba ari igihano kuri Egiputa n’igihano ku mahanga yose atazoduga guhimbaza umusi mukuru w’insago.
Kuri uwo musi amajambo "Yerejwe Uhoraho " azokwandikwa ku mijiginya y’amafarasi, n’inkono zo gutekamwo zo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho zizoba nk’ibikoresho vy’imbere y’igicaniro.

Inkono zose z’i Yerusalemu n’i Buyuda zizoba zerejwe Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, kandi abazoza gushikana ibimazi bazokwakira zimwe muri izo nkono bazitekemwo. Kandi kuri uwo musi ntihazoba Umunyakanani mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose.

name: Malaki
chapters: Iri ni ijambo Uhoraho yarungikiye Abisirayeli, arivugishije Malaki.
"Narabakunze," ni ko Uhoraho avuze. "Ariko murabaza muti: ‘Wadukunze gute?’ " "Mbega Esawu ntiyavukana na Yakobo?" ni ko Uhoraho abaza. "Ariko nakunze Yakobo,
Esawu we ndamwanka, imisozi yiwe ndayigira agahinga, itongo ryiwe ndariha imbwebwe zo mu bugaragwa."

Abanyedomu boshobora kuvuga bati: "Naho twahonejwe, tuzosubira twubake ku misaka." Ariko uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: "Naho bokwubaka, nzosambura. Igihugu cabo kizokwitwa igihugu c’inkozi z’ibibi, ubwoko Uhoraho yama arakiye ibihe vyose.
Muzobirabisha amaso yanyu, maze muvuge muti: ‘ Uhoraho arahambaye, ububasha bwiwe burenga n’imbibe za Isirayeli.’

Umwana yubaha umuvyeyi, umukozi akubaha shebuja. Nimba ndi umuvyeyi, icubahiro canje kiri hehe? Nimba ndi shobuja, ukunyubaha kwanyu kuri he?" ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose abaza. "Yemwe baherezi, ni mwebwe mutukisha izina ryanje. Ariko murabaza muti: ‘Twatukishije izina ryawe gute?’
Mwaritukishije mu gushikana ku gicaniro canje ibimazi bihumanye. Ariko mukabaza muti: ‘Twahumanije dute ibimazi?’ Mwabihumanije mu kuvuga muti: ‘Igicaniro c’ Uhoraho nta gaciro kigira.’

Iyo mushikanye ibitungwa bihumye nk’ibimazi, mbega ntimuba mukoze nabi? Iyo mushikanye ibicumbagira n’ibigwaye, ntimuba mugize nabi? Mbega mwobishikanira umutware wanyu yobashimira? Mbega yobibakirira?" ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose abaza.
"Ehe nimwinginge Imana ibagirire ubuntu. Ariko mbega yobemera mushikanye ibimazi bimeze bityo?" ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose abaza.

"Vyoba vyiza hagize umwe wo muri mwebwe yugara imiryango y’Ingoro, kugira ngo ntihagire imicanwa icanirwa ubusa ku bicaniro vyanje, kuko sindabanezererewe. Sinzokwakira ibimazi vyanyu," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.

"Izina ryanje rizoba rurangiranwa mu makungu, kuva mu buseruko kugeza mu burengero. Mu mihingo yose bazonshikanira ibimota neza, n’ishikanwa ryejejwe, kuko izina ryanje rizoba ryabaye rurangiranwa mu makungu," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
"Ariko mwararihumanije aho mwavuga muti: ‘Imeza y’Umwami iranduye, n’ivyokurya vyayo biragayitse.’

Murongera muravuga muti: ‘Gukorera Imana ni umuruho!’ bituma mukura imitima yanyu ku mabwirizwa yanje," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze. "Iyo mushikanye ibikoko bikomeretse, canke bicumbagira, canke bigwaye, mukabitanga nk’ibimazi, mbega novyakira mu maboko yanyu?" ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose abaza.

"Haravumwe umuntu afise impfizi y’intama itagira akanenge yo mu mukuku agasezerana kuyitanga, ariko akiba Uhoraho mu kumushikanira ikimazi kitabereye. Ndi Umwami ahambaye, kandi izina ryanje rikwiye kwubahwa mu mahanga yose!" ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
"None rero yemwe baherezi, iki ni co cagezwe ndabahaye.

Nimutanyumvira ngo mushire imitima yanyu ku kwubaha izina ryanje, nzobarungikira umuvumo, mvume n’imigisha mwahawe. Mbere naramaze no kuyivuma, kuko mutashize imitima yanyu ku kwubaha izina ryanje," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
"Nzohana uruvyaro rwanyu kubera mwebwe; nzobatera mu maso amayezi y’ibimazi vyo ku misi mikuru yanyu, hanyuma ndayabatane.
Hanyuma muzoteba mumenye ko ari jewe nabahaye iki cagezwe, kugira ngo isezerano nagiranye na Lewi rize ryameho," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.

"Isezerano ryanje ryari kuri we, kandi ryari isezerano rizana ubuzima bwiza n’amahoro, iryo ni ryo nabahaye; naribahaye kugira ngo banyubahe, ngire igitinyiro kuri bo, kandi baranyubaha cane bagahindira agashitsi izina ryanje.
Inyigisho z’ukuri zama mu kanwa kabo, kandi iminwa yabo yazira ikinyoma. Bagendanye nanje mu mahoro no mu bugororotsi, kandi bakuye benshi mu vyaha.
Kuko iminwa y’umuherezi ikwiye kuzigama ukumenya Imana, kandi akanwa kiwe ni ko kabarizwamwo ivyagezwe, kuko umuherezi ari intumwa y’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose.
Ariko mwebwe mwarantaye, inyigisho zanyu zicika izigwisha abantu mu vyaha. Mwavuye mw’isezerano rya Lewi," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
"Ni co catumye nemera ko musuzugurwa, mukagawa n’amoko yose, kuko mutagendeye mu nzira zanje, ahubwo mugahengama ku bijanye n’amabwirizwa yanje."
Mbega twese ntidusangiye Data? Mbega twese ntitwaremwe n’Imana imwe? None ni kuki duhemukiranira, tukava mw’isezerano rya ba sogokuruza?
Yuda yarampemukiye, kandi igisesema cakorewe muri Isirayeli n’i Yerusalemu. Abayuda bahumanije Ingoro Uhoraho akunda, mu kurongora abagore basenga ibigirwamana.
Nk’umuntu akora ivyo, uwo ari we wese, akwiye gucibwa mw’ihema rya Yakobo, naho yoba ashikanira amashikanwa Uhoraho Mushoboravyose.
Hari ikindi kibi mukora: mwuzuza amarira yanyu ku gicaniro, mukarira muboroga kubera Uhoraho atakiraba ryiza amashikanwa yanyu, canke ngo ayakire ayakunze avuye mu biganza vyanyu.

Mukibaza muti: "Ni kubera iki?" Reka ndababwire igituma: ni kubera Uhoraho yari icabona igihe mwasezerana n’abagore banyu mukagirirana indahiro n’abagore bo mu busore bwanyu. Mwarabahemukiye, kandi ari bo mwafatanye ngo babe abagore banyu b’isezerano.

Mbega Imana ntiyari yabagize umwe n’abagore banyu? Mu mpwemu no mu mubiri muri abiwe. Kandi ico abipfuzako ni iki? Ashaka ko muvyara abana bamwubaha. Nuko rero nimwirinde mugume mw’isezerano mwagiranye n’abagore bo mu buto bwanyu.

"Kuko ndanka ukwahukana," ni ko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze, "kandi nanka n’umuntu yitwikira umuryano nk’uko yitwikirira umutamana," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze. None rero nimurinde imitima yanyu, mwoye guhemukira abagore banyu.

Mwararuhishije Uhoraho mu majambo yanyu. Ariko murabaza muti: "Twamuruhishije dute?" Muvuga muti: "Ibibi vyose ni vyiza mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , kandi arabinezererwa," canke mukavuga muti: "Mbega iyo Mana ica izibereye iri hehe?"

"Ehe raba ngira ntume intumwa yanje imbere, kugira ngo integurire inzira. Maze ako kanya Uhoraho muriko murarondera azoheza aze mu Ngoro yiwe, umuvugishwa w’isezerano, uwo mwipfuje, agiye kuza," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
Ariko none ni nde azokwihanganira umusi w’ukuza kwiwe? Ni nde azoshobora guhagarara imbere yiwe niyaseruka? Kuko azoba ameze nk’umuriro w’umucuzi, canke nk’isabune y’uwumesura impuzu.
Azokwicara nk’uwutyorora ifeza, yeze Abalewi nk’uwukura imyanda ku nzahabu n’ifeza. Uko ni ko Uhoraho azokwironkera abamushikanira mu bugororotsi ibimazi vyemerwa mu nyonga ziwe,
kandi ibimazi vy’Abayuda n’ivy’ab’i Yerusalemu bizosubira vyemerwe n’ Uhoraho , nk’uko yavyemera mu gihe caheze.

"Maze ico gihe nzobacira urubanza. Nzihutira kwagiriza abarozi, abasambanyi hamwe n’ababeshi, abagunga abakozi impembo zabo, abacinyiza abapfakazi, n’impfuvyi, bakabuza inyambukira gutunganirizwa, kandi ntibantinye," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
"Ndi Uhoraho kandi simpindagurika. Ni co gutuma mwebwe urvyaro rwa Yakobo mutararandurwa.

Uhereye kuva kuri ba sogokuruza, mwamye muta ivyagezwe vyanje, ntimubigenderemwo. Ehe nimungarukeko, nanje nzobagarukako," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze. "Ariko muribaza muti: ‘Mbega twokugarukako dute kandi tutigeze tukuvako?’
Mbega hari uwokwiba Imana? Ariko mwebwe mwaranyivye. Kandi muribaza muti: ‘Twakwivye gute?’ Mwanyivye ibigiracumi n’amashikanwa.
Muri musi y’umuvumo mwe n’ihanga ryanyu ryose, kuko munyiba.

Nimuzane ikigiracumi gikwiye mu bubiko bwanje, kugira ngo mu nzu yanje habemwo ivyokurya. Ehe nimubingeragereshe, jewe Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, murabe ko ntugurura imiryango yo mw’ijuru, nkabacuncuburirako imigisha mukabura n’aho muyikwiza.
Nzozitira inzige n’ingwara ntibitere imirima yanyu, kandi inzabibu zanyu ntizizohunguruka ziteze," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
"Ni ho amahanga yose azobita abahirwe, kuko muzoba igihugu kimpimbara," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
"Mwamvuzeko amajambo mabi," ni ko Uhoraho avuze. "Ariko murabaza muti: ‘Ni igiki twakuvuzeko kibi?’
Mwavuze muti: ‘Gukorera Imana nta kamaro bifise. Mbega gukurikiza ivyo idutegeka no mu kwama tuza imbere y’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose tumeze nk’abagandaye, bitumariye iki?’
Muravuga ngo kuva ubu rero tuzovuga ko abishira hejuru ari bo bahiriwe, ko inkozi z’ibibi ari zo zitera imbere, kandi ko bagerageza Imana ariko ntibagire ico baba."
Maze abubaha Uhoraho baraganira, Uhoraho na we yumviriza ivyo bavuga. Igitabu c’icibutso gica candikirwa imbere yiwe, candikwamwo amazina y’abo bose bubaha Uhoraho , bagahesha icubahiro izina ryiwe.

"Kuri wa musi, nzocirako imanza," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze, "bazoba ari ubutunzi niharije kandi budasanzwe. Nzobazigamira mu mbabazi zanje nk’uko umuvyeyi agirira impuhwe akazigama umwana wiwe amwubaha.
Kandi muzobona ubudasa hagati y’abagororotsi n’abanyakibi, no hagati y’abakorera Imana n’abatayikorera," ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

"Nta nkeka uwo musi uraje, kandi uje waka nk’itanure. Abibona n’inkozi z’ibibi bazoba nk’ubwatsi bwumye, kandi uwo musi uje uzobatongora," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze. "Nta kimeze nk’umuzi canke ishami kizosigara kuri bo.

Ariko mwebwe muhindira agashitsi imbere y’izina ryanje, izuba ry’ubugororotsi rizobarasira, rifise ugukiza mu mishwarara yaryo. Maze muzosohoka mwishire mwizane, mutamba mwiginagura nk’uko inyana ziginagura iyo zisohowe ziva mu ruhongore.
Kandi ku musi nzokorerako ivyo, muzohonyanga inkozi z’ibibi, babe nk’umukungugu musi y’ibirenge vyanyu," ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
Nimwibuke Ivyagezwe vy’umusavyi wanje Mose, amabwirizwa n’ivyagezwe namugereye i Horebu kubw’Abisirayeli bose.
"Raba nzobarungikira Eliya uwuvugishwa n’Imana, imbere y’uko uwo musi w’ Uhoraho uteye ubwoba ushika.
Ubutumwa bwiwe buzosubiza imitima y’abavyeyi ku bana babo, n’imitima y’abana ku bavyeyi babo. Ahandi ho nzoza ndanduze isi umuvumo."

name: Matayo
chapters: Uru ni urukurikirane rwa ba sekuruza ba Yesu ari we Kristo, yakomotse kuri Dawidi wo mu ruvyaro rwa Aburahamu:
Aburahamu yavyaye Isaka, Isaka yavyaye Yakobo, Yakobo yavyaye Yuda n’abandi bavukana,
Yuda yavyaye Peresi na Zera kuri Tamari, Peresi yavyaye Hezironi, Hezironi yavyaye Ramu,
Ramu yavyaye Aminadabu, Aminadabu yavyaye Nahashoni, Nahashoni yavyaye Salimoni,
Salimoni yavyaye Bowazi kuri Rahabu, Bowazi yavyaye Obedi kuri Rusi, Obedi yavyaye Isayi,
hanyuma Isayi avyara umwami Dawidi. Dawidi na we yavyaye Salomo, amuvyara kuri Batisheba yahora ari muka Uriya,
Salomo yavyaye Rehobowamu, Rehobowamu yavyaye Abiya, Abiya yavyaye Asa,
Asa yavyaye Yehoshafati, Yehoshafati yavyaye Yehoramu, Yehoramu yavyaye Uziya,
Uziya yavyaye Yotamu, Yotamu yavyaye Ahazi, Ahazi yavyaye Hezekiya,
Hezekiya yavyaye Manase Manase yavyaye Amoni, Amoni yavyaye Yosiya,
hanyuma Yosiya avyara Yekoniya n’abo bavukana igihe bajanwa kuba abanyagano i Babiloni.
Bamaze kuva mu buja i Babiloni, Yekoniya yavyaye Shalutiyeli, Shalutiyeli yavyaye Zerubabeli,
Zerubabeli yavyaye Abiyudi, Abiyudi yavyaye Eliyakimu, Eliyakimu yavyaye Azori,
Azori yavyaye Sadoki, Sadoki yavyaye Akimu, Akimu yavyaye Elihudi,
Elihudi yavyaye Eliyazeri, Eliyazeri yavyaye Matani, Matani yavyaye Yakobo,
hanyuma Yakobo avyara Yosefu, umugabo wa Mariya, nyina wa Yesu ari we Kristo.

Ni ukuvuga ko habayeho urukurikirane rw’imiryango cumi n’ine kuva kuri Aburahamu gushika kuri Dawidi; n’iyindi cumi n’ine kuva kuri Dawidi gushika igihe bajanwa kuba abanyagano i Babiloni; hongera haba urundi rukurikirane rw’imiryango cumi n’ine kuva bagarutse bavuye mu buja gushika kuri Kristo.
Uku ni ko ukuvuka kwa Yesu ari we Kristo kwagenze: nyina wiwe Mariya yari akowe na Yosefu, ariko imbere y’uko babana, asama inda ivuye ku bushobozi bwa Mpwemu Yera.
Kubera ko Yosefu yari umuntu atunganye, yiyumvira ingene yomuheba mu mpisho, kuko atagomba kumutetereza mu bantu.
Ariko, akivyiyumvira, umumarayika w’Umwami Imana araza avugana na we mu ndoto amubwira ati: "Yosefu mwana wa Dawidi, ntutinye kurongora Mariya, kuko inda afise yavuye kuri Mpwemu Yera.
Azovyara umwana w’umuhungu, nawe uze umwite Yesu, kuko ari we azokiza abantu biwe ivyaha vyabo."
Ivyo vyose vyabaye kugira ngo ivyo Umwami Imana yari yaravugishije abavugishwa na we bishike, ngo:
"Ehe, inkumi itarigera iryamana n’umugabo izosama inda ivyare umwana w’umuhungu kandi bazomwita Emanuweli" (bisobanurwa ngo "Imana iri kumwe natwe").
Yosefu amaze kwikangura, aca akora ivyo umumarayika w’Umwami Imana yamubwiye, atwara Mariya iwe nk’umugore wiwe.
Ariko ntibigeze baryamana nk’umugore n’umugabo kugeza amaze kuvyara uwo mwana w’umuhungu; hanyuma amwita Yesu.
Yesu amaze kuvukira i Betelehemu mu ntara yitwa Yudaya, ku ngoma y’umwami Herode, abanyabwenge mu vy’inyenyeri bavuye mu buseruko baja i Yerusalemu.
Barabaza bati: "Umwami w’Abayuda yavutse ari hehe? Twabonye inyenyeri yiwe mu buseruko none tuzanywe no kumusenga."
Umwami Herode yumvise iyo nkuru abura amahoro, eka n’ab’i Yerusalemu bose.
Aca akoranya abaherezi bakurubakuru n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe, ababaza ati: "Vyanditswe ko Kristo azovukira hehe?"
Baramwishura bati: "Ni i Betelehemu mu ntara ya Yudaya, kuko ari ko vyanditswe n’uwavugishwa n’Imana ngo:
‘Kandi wewe, Betelehemu mu ntara ya Yudaya, nturi mutoya mu bisagara vya Yudaya, kuko muri wewe hazokomoka umurongozi azoragira ubwoko bwanje bwa Isirayeli.’ "
Hanyuma Herode ahamagaza mu mpisho ba banyabwenge agerageza kubabaza neza igihe iyo nyenyeri yabonekeye.
Nuko abarungika i Betelehemu, ababwira ati: "Genda mubaze neza ivyerekeye uwo mwana. Mumaze kumubona, muce mugaruka mumbwire kugira ngo nanje nje kumushengerera."
Bamaze kwumva ivyo umwami ababariye, baca babandanya urugendo. Ya nyenyeri babona mu buseruko ica ibaja imbere kugeza ihagaze hejuru y’aho uwo mwana yari ari.
Babonye ya nyenyeri ihagaze bagira umunezero mwinshi.

Binjiye mu nzu, babona uwo mwana ari kumwe na nyina Mariya, barapfukama baramusenga. Hanyuma batekurura udusaho turimwo ivy’agaciro bagendanye babimuhako ishikanwa rigizwe n’inzahabu, n’utundi tuntu tumota neza.
Hanyuma, Imana imaze kubamenyesha mu nzozi ngo ntibasubire kwa Herode, baca bisubirira iwabo bajanye iyindi nzira.

Bamaze kugenda, umumarayika w’Umwami Imana araza avugana na Yosefu mu nzozi, amubwira ati: "Fata umwana na nyina ubahungishirize muri Egiputa; uzogumeyo kugeza aho nzokubwirira kugaruka, kuko Herode ariko arondera umwana ngo amwice."
Yosefu avyuka hakiri mw’ijoro, afata umwana na nyina, abahungishiriza muri Egiputa,
agumayo kugeza Herode apfuye. Uko ni ko Umwami Imana yashikije ivyo yari yaravuze aciye ku wavugishwa na we ngo: "Nahamagaye umwana wanje ngo ave muri Egiputa."

Herode abonye ko ba banyabwenge mu vy’inyenyeri bamuhenze, arashavura cane, aca arungika abasoda kwica abana bose b’i Betelehemu no mu micungararo yaho bafise imyaka ibiri n’abatarayikwiza, akurikije igihe yabonaniye na ba banyabwenge.
Uko ni ko ivyo uwavugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya yavuze vyashitse ati:
"I Rama humvikanye induru, amarira n’amaborogo menshi: Rasheli aririra abana biwe kandi yanse guhozwa kuko batakiriho."
Herode amaze gupfa, umumarayika w’Umwami Imana abonekera Yosefu mu ndoto ari muri Egiputa,
amubwira ati: "Haguruka ujane umwana na nyina usubire mu gihugu ca Isirayeli, kuko abahora barondera kwica uwo mwana bamaze gupfa."
Nuko Yosefu arahaguruka, afata umwana na nyina basubira mu gihugu ca Isirayeli.
Ariko amaze kwumva ko Arukelayo ari we atwara intara y’i Yudaya mu gishingo ca se Herode, aca aratinya kujayo, mu nyuma amaze kumenyeshwa n’Imana mu ndoto, aja mu ntara y’i Galilaya,
baca baja kuba mu gisagara citwa Nazareti. Uko ni ko ivyo abavugishwa n’Imana bavuze vyashitse ngo: "Azokwitwa Umunyanazareti."
Muri iyo misi haza Yohana Umubatizi, yigishiriza mu bugaragwa bw’i Yudaya,
avuga ati: "Nimwihane kuko Ubwami bw’ijuru buri hafi."
Uwo Yohana ni we yari yaravuzwe n’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yesaya, igihe yavuga ati: "Hari ijwi ry’uwusemerera mu bugaragwa ati: ‘Nimutegurire Uhoraho aho aca, mugorore inzira agenderamwo.’ "
Yohana yambara impuzu ikozwe mu bwoya bw’ingamiya, akayikenyeza umukanda w’urusato mu rukenyerero. Ivyokurya vyiwe vyari inzige n’ubuki bwo mw’ishamba.
Abantu bava i Yerusalemu, i Yudaya no mu karere k’uruzi Yorodani, bakaja iyo ari.
Bamaze kwatura ivyaha vyabo yaca ababatiza muri Yorodani.
Ariko abonye ko Abafarisayo n’Abasadukayo benshi baje aho ari ngo ababatize, arababaza ati: "Mwa bana b’inzoka mwe, ni nde yababuriye ngo muhunge uburake bw’Imana bugiye kuza?
Nimukore ibikorwa vyerekana ko mwihanye,
mureke kwibwira mu mitima yanyu muti: ‘Turi uruvyaro rwa Aburahamu,’ kuko ndababwira ko no muri aya mabuye mubona, Imana ishobora gukuramwo abana ba Aburahamu.
Mbere incabiti ibanguriwe kw’imerero ry’ibiti: igiti cose kitama ivyamwa vyiza kigiye gucibwa gitererwe mu muriro.
Jewe ndababatiza mu mazi kuko mwihanye ivyaha, ariko uwuje inyuma yanje arandusha ubushobozi, mbere ntibimbereye no kumutwaza ibirato. We azobabatiza muri Mpwemu Yera no mu muriro.
Afise urutaro rwo kugosora mu minwe, azokubura ikibanza co gusekuriramwo. Ahejeje kugosora azokwegeraniriza ingano mu kigega umuguruka na wo awuturirire mu muriro utazokwigera uzima."
Maze Yesu ava i Galilaya aja kuri Yorodani ngo abatizwe na Yohana.
Ariko Yohana agerageza kumwankira, avuga ati: "Ni jewe nkwiye kubatizwa nawe, none uje ngo abe ari jewe nkubatiza?"
Yesu aramwishura ati: "Reka tubikore gutyo, kuko bikwiye ko dushitsa ibigororotse vyose." Yohana aca yemera kumubatiza.
Yesu amaze kubatizwa, aca ava mu mazi. Uwo mwanya nyene, ijuru riruguruka, abona Mpwemu w’Imana amanuka mw’ishusho y’inuma ashika kuri we.
Hanyuma ijwi ryumvikana rivuye mw’ijuru rivuga riti: "Uwu ni Umwana wanje nkunda, akampimbara."
Hanyuma Yesu aca ajanwa na Mpwemu mu bugaragwa kugira ngo ageragezwe na Satani.
Amaze imisi mirongo ine n’amajoro mirongo ine ata co arya kandi ata co anywa, yumva arashonje.
Umugeragezi aca aramwegera, amubwira ati: "Niwaba uri Umwana w’Imana, bwira aya mabuye ahinduke imikate."
Yesu aramwishura ati: "Handitswe ngo: ‘Umuntu ntabeshwaho n’ivyokurya gusa, ariko atungwa n’ijambo ryose rivuye mu kanwa k’Imana.’ "
Hanyuma wa mubi amujana i Yerusalemu, igisagara cera, amuhagarika ku rusengero ahantu hataramutse,
amubwira ati: "Niwaba uri Umwana w’Imana, niwikororere hasi, kuko handitswe ngo: ‘Azotegeka abamarayika biwe bakuzigame. Bazokurerura mu maboko yabo kugira ngo ntutsitare kw’ibuye.’ "
Yesu na we aramwishura ati: "Handitswe ngo: ‘Ntukagerageze Uhoraho Imana yawe.’ "
Hanyuma Satani yongera kumujana ku musozi muremure cane amwereka ubwami bwose bwo mw’isi n’ubwiza bwabwo.
Aramubwira ati: "Ivyo vyose ndabiguha niwapfukama ukansenga."
Yesu aramwishura ati: "Mva i ruhande Satani! Kuko handitswe ngo: ‘Usenge Uhoraho Imana yawe, kandi abe ari yo yonyene ukorera.’ "
Kuva ako kanya Satani aca aramureka, maze abamarayika baraza baramukorera.
Yesu yumvise ko Yohana yashizwe mw’ibohero, aca aja i Galilaya.
Hanyuma ava i Nazareti, aja kuba i Kaperinawumu, igisagara cari hafi y’ikiyaga mu ntara ya Zabuloni na Nafutali,
kugira ngo ivyavuzwe n’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yesaya bishike. Yavuze ati:
"Mu ntara ya Zabuloni n’intara ya Nafutali, mu bice vyegereye ikiyaga, hakurya ya Yorodani, i Galilaya haba Abanyamahanga benshi;
abantu bahora bicaye mu mwijima, babonye umuco mwinshi, kandi ababa mu gihugu c’igitutu c’urupfu, umuco warabarasiye."
Kuva ico gihe Yesu aca atangura kuvuga Ubutumwa Bwiza no kwigisha, ati: "Nimwihane kuko Ubwami bw’ijuru buri hafi."
Yesu ariko aragendagenda ku nkengera y’ikiyaga c’i Galilaya, abona abavukana babiri, Simoni batazira Petero na Andereya mwene nyina, bariko baterera urusenga mu kiyaga kuko bari abarovyi.
Yesu arababwira ati: "Nimunkurikire, nzobagira abarovyi b’abantu."
Ubwo nyene, baca basiga ngaho insenga zabo, baramukurikira.
Abandanije, abona abavukana babiri, Yakobo na Yohana bene Zebedayo bari kumwe na se mu bwato, bariko barasana insenga zabo. Maze Yesu arabahamagara,
baca basiga ubwato na se baramukurikira.
Ico gihe Yesu agendagenda mu ntara yose ya Galilaya yigishiriza mu masinagogi yaho, avuga Ubutumwa Bwiza bw’Ubwami, akiza abantu ingwara zose n’ubumuga bwose.

Nuko inkuru ziwe zikwiragira hose, gushika no muri Siriya. Bamuzanira abarwayi bose: abafise ububabare butandukanye, ababoshwe n’abadayimoni, abagwaye intandara, hamwe n’abatikakaza kubera bababara mu mubiri; bose arabakiza.
Maze amasinzi y’abantu baramukurikira, bavuye i Galilaya, i Dekapolisi , i Yerusalemu, i Yudaya, no hakurya ya Yorodani.
Yesu abonye abantu baje ari benshi, aca aduga umusozi. Amaze kwicara, abigishwa biwe baramwegera,
aca atangura kubigisha. Arababwira ati:
"Hahiriwe abumva ko bakenye mu buryo bw’impwemu, kuko Ubwami bw’ijuru ari ubwabo.
Hahiriwe abarira, kuko ari bo bazohozwa.
Hahiriwe abaciye bugufi, kuko bazoragwa isi.
Hahiriwe abafise inzara n’inyota vyo kugororoka, kuko bazohazwa.
Hahiriwe abagira imbabazi, kuko na bo bazozigirirwa.
Hahiriwe abafise imitima itanduye, kuko bazobona Imana.
Hahiriwe abaharanira amahoro, kuko bazokwitwa abana b’Imana.
Hahiriwe abahamwa bahorwa ukugororoka, kuko Ubwami bw’ijuru ari ubwabo.
Namwe muzoba muhiriwe abantu nibabatuka, bakabahama, bakabavugako bababeshera ibibi vyinshi babampora.
Muze munezerwe kandi muhimbarwe kuko impera yanyu izoba ari nini mw’ijuru. Uko ni ko bahamye abavugishwa n’Imana babitangiye imbere.
Muri umunyu mu bantu bo mw’isi. Ariko iyo umunyu utakaje uburyohe bwawo, mbega bwosubiramwo gute? Nta co uba ukimaze atari ugutabwa hanze abantu bakawuhonyanga.
Muri umuco mu bantu bo mw’isi. Igisagara kiri hejuru ku gasozi, ntigishobora kunyegezwa.
Ni ko bimeze no kw’itara, nta woridomeka ngo ace aryubikako igiseke. Ahubwo arishira ku giterekwako itara kugira ngo riboneshereze abari mu nzu bose.
Uko ni ko mukwiye kureka umuco wanyu ukakira imbere y’abantu kugira ngo babone ibikorwa vyanyu vyiza, hanyuma bahimbaze So wo mw’ijuru.
Ntimwibaze ko nazanywe no gukuraho Ivyagezwe canke ivyanditswe n’abavugishwa n’Imana. Oya sinazanywe no kubikuraho, ahubwo nazanywe no kubishitsa.
Ndababwire ukuri, igihe cose ijuru n’isi bizoba bikiriho, nta n’akadome na gatoya canke agakwabu ko mu Vyagezwe kazovako, kugeza ivyo vyagezwe bishikije intumbero yavyo.

Ni co gituma umuntu wese atazokurikiza ayo mabwirizwa naho ryoba ritoya ryo muri yo kandi akigisha abandi kutayakurikiza azoba uwa nyuma mu Bwami bw’ijuru. Ariko uwo wese azoyakurikiza akigisha n’abandi kuyakurikiza azoba mukuru mu Bwami bw’ijuru.
Ndababwire ukuri, ukugororoka kwanyu niyo kutaruta ukw’abigisha b’ivyagezwe n’ukw’Abafarisayo, ntimuzoruha mwinjira mu Bwami bw’ijuru.
Mwarumvise ko ba sogokuruza bari barigishijwe ngo: ‘Ntukice, uwica wese azotsindwa n’urubanza’ ;

ariko jeho ndababwira ko umuntu wese ashavurira mwenewabo aba akwiye gucirwa urubanza kandi uwubwiye umuvukanyi ngo: Wa mburabwenge we, aba akwiye guhanwa n’abacamanza. Kandi uwubwiye umuntu ngo: Wa musazi we aba akwiye gutererwa mu muriro wa Gehinomu.
Mu gihe rero uriko urashikanira Imana ikimazi ku gicaniro, ukibuka ko hariho ikintu upfa na mugenzawe,
siga ikimazi cawe ngaho imbere y’igicaniro, ubanze ugende wiyuzuze na mugenzawe hanyuma ugaruke utange ico kimazi.
Nihagira umuntu aja kukwitwarira mu rubanza, wihutire kwiyuzuza na we mukiri mu nzira, kugira ngo ntagushikirize umucamanza hanyuma na we akagutanga ku mukuru w’ibohero, uwo na we akaguta mw’ibohero.
Ndakubwire ukuri, ntuzovayo utarishe n’igiceri ca nyuma umuheraniye.
Mwarumvise ko vyavuzwe ngo: ‘Ntugasambane.’
Ariko jeho ndababwira nti umuntu wese araba umugore akipfuza gusambana na we aba yamaze gukora ico caha mu mutima.
Ijisho ryawe ry’i buryo niryatuma wipfuza, ukagwa mu caha, urikureyo urite kure yawe, kuko vyokubera vyiza kubura igihimba kimwe c’umubiri wawe hako umubiri wawe wose utabwa muri Gehinomu.
Ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo nikwatuma ucumura, uguce ugute kure yawe, kuko vyokubera vyiza, kubura igihimba kimwe c’umubiri hako umubiri wawe wose utabwa muri Gehinomu.
Vyaravuzwe mu vyagezwe ngo: ‘Umuntu niyirukana umugore wiwe, ategerezwa kumuha urwandiko rwemeza ko bahukanye.’
Ariko jeho ndababwira yuko umuntu wese yirukana umugore wiwe atamuhoye ubusambanyi, aba amutumye gusambana kandi uwurongoye umugore yahukanye, na we aba asambanye.
Kandi, mwarumvise ko ba sogokuruza babwiwe ngo: ‘Ntukivuguruze ku vyo warahiye, ariko ushitse ivyo wemereye Uhoraho.’
Ariko jeho ndababwiye nti, ntimukarahire na rimwe: ntimukarahire ijuru kuko ari yo ntebe y’Imana; kandi
ntimukarahire isi kuko ari yo ntebe y’ibirenge vyayo; ntimukarahire Yerusalemu kuko ari co gisagara c’Imana, Umwami asumba bose.
Kandi ntukarahire umutwe wawe kuko udashobora gutuma n’agashatsi na kamwe kawo kera canke kirabura.
Muvuge ngo ‘ego’ iyo ari ego canke ‘oya’ iyo ari oya, ibindi vyose wongerako biba bivuye kuri wa mubi.
Mwarumvise ko vyavuzwe mu vyagezwe ngo: ‘Ijisho rihorwe irindi, n’iryinyo rihorwe irindi.’
Ariko jeho ndababwiye nti: ntimukihore ababagirira nabi. Umuntu niyagukubita ikofe mu musaya w’i buryo, umuhindukirize n’uw’i bubamfu.
Kandi umuntu niyagomba kukuburanya kugira ngo akunyage ishati yawe, umuhebere n’ikoti na yo.
Umuntu niyagutegeka kugenda ikilometero n’amaguru umutwaje ibintu, ugende ibilometero bibiri.
Umuntu niyagusaba ikintu ukimuhe, kandi uwugomba ko umugurana ntumwirengagize.
Mwarumvise ko vyavuzwe mu vyagezwe ngo: ‘Ukunde mugenzawe ariko wanke umwansi wawe.’
Jeho ndababwiye nti: mukunde abansi banyu kandi musengere ababagirira nabi,
kugira ngo mumere nk’abana ba Data wo mw’ijuru, kuko atuma izuba ryiwe ryakira ababi n’abeza akagwishiriza imvura abagororotse n’abatagororotse.
Nimwakunda ababakunda gusa, n’igiki cotuma muhabwa impera n’Imana? Mbega abatozakori bo si uko babigenza?
Nimwaramutsa incuti zanyu gusa, ni igiki muzoba murushije abandi? Mbega abatizera Imana bo ntibabigenza batyo?
Nuko rero nimube intungane, nk’uko So wo mw’ijuru na we ari intungane!
Mwirinde ntimukore ibikorwa vyo kugororoka murondera gushimwa n’abantu. Kuko nimwabikora gutyo, So wo mw’ijuru ntazobaha impera.
Nihagira ico uha umukene, ntuze uvuze inzamba nk’uko indyarya zibikora mu masinagogi no ku mabarabara barondera gushimwa n’abantu. Ndababwire ukuri; abo baramaze guhabwa impera zabo zose.
Ariko niwagira ico uha umukene, ukuboko kwawe kw’i bubamfu, ntigukwiye kumenya ico ukuboko kw’i buryo gukoze.
Gutyo, gutanga kwawe kugume ari ibanga, kandi So wo mw’ijuru abona ibikorerwa mw’ibanga, azobiguhembera.
Kandi, iyo musenga, ntimumere nka za ndyarya kuko zikunda gusenga zihagaze mu masinagogi no mu mayirabiri, kugira ngo abantu bose bababone. Ndababwire ukuri, abo baramaze guhabwa impera zabo zose.
Ariko, wewe ugomvye gusenga, winjire mu cumba cawe, wugare umuryango, hanyuma usenge. So wo mw’ijuru, we abona ivyo mw’ibanga, azobiguhembera.
Iyo musenga, ntimuvuge amajambo menshi nk’abatizera Imana, biyumvira ko Imana ibumva kubera amajambo menshi bavuze.
Ntimugire nka bo, kuko Data wo mw’ijuru azi neza ivyo mukeneye imbere y’uko munabimusaba.
Mukwiye gusenga muvuga muti: Data wa twese uri mw’ijuru, izina ryawe niryubahwe,
Ubwami bwawe buze, ivyo ugomba bibe mw’isi nk’uko biba mw’ijuru.
Uduhe ivyokurya bidukwiye uwu musi,
uduharire ivyaha vyacu, nk’uko natwe duharira abaducumuyeko.
Ntudutererane ibitugerageza, uhubwo udukize wa mubi. [ Kuko Ubwami, ubushobozi n’ubwiza ari ivyawe ibihe vyose. Amen. ]
Kuko nimwaharira abantu ibibi babakoreye, na So wo mw’ijuru azobaharira namwe.
Ariko nimutaharira abandi ibibi vyabo, na So wo mw’ijuru ntazobaharira namwe ibibi vyanyu.

Iyo mwisonzesheje, ntimwerekane ko mubabaye nk’uko za ndyarya zibigira: kuko baca bijirirwa mu maso kugira ngo abababona bose babashimire ukwisonzesha kwabo. Ndababwire ukuri: iyo ni yo mpera yonyene bazoronka.
Ariko wewe, iyo wisonzesheje, woge mu maso hanyuma wisige amavuta mu mutwe,
kugira ngo ntiwereke abantu ko wisonzesheje; ahubwo uvyereke So ari ahihishije; maze So, we abona ibikorerwa mw’ibanga, azobiguhembera.
Ntimukirundanirize ubutunzi mw’isi, aho imiswa, inyenzi n’ingese bishobora kubwonona, kandi n’ibisuma bigashobora kumena bikabwiba.
Ariko, mwirundanirize ubutunzi mw’ijuru, aho imiswa, inyenzi n’ingese bidashika ngo bibwonone canke abasuma badashika ngo bamene babwibe;
kuko aho ubutunzi bwawe buri, ari ho n’umutima wawe uzoba.
Amaso ni yo matara y’umubiri. Iyo amaso yawe abona neza, umubiri wawe wose uba mu muco.
Ariko iyo atabona neza, umubiri wawe wose uca uba mu mwijima. Nimba wibaza ko ufise umuco kandi ari umwijima, umwijima uri muri wewe n’umuzitanya!
